detail: Check run notes when REVIEW.md came from an unprotected default branch, was skipped because branch protection was unconfirmed, or linked to files the PR modifies or more than 64 links.

feature: Code Review: managed PR review service
detail: Multi-agent review on Anthropic infrastructure: find, verify to drop false positives, dedupe and rank by severity, then post inline comments, summary and check run; never approves or blocks merge.

feature: Code Review availability and exclusions
detail: GitHub repos only (including Enterprise Server and ghe.com data residency); unavailable with Zero Data Retention, HIPAA configuration, BAA coverage or customer-managed encryption keys; needs Claude org even for Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry users.

feature: Code Review: model chosen by service, read-only repo access
detail: Admins cannot pick the model; reviews read the diff and surrounding code without building or running it, cannot push commits, and may resolve their own threads.

feature: Code Review reads REVIEW.md from base or default branch
detail: Review instructions come from the base/default branch, never from the PR's own changes.

feature: Local /code-review command
detail: Run /code-review in a Claude Code session on any plan to review your branch locally.

feature: Ultrareview cloud review
detail: Cloud sandbox review started from Claude Code; needs a claude.ai sign-in and is not available everywhere.

feature: Review options: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, custom subagent or skill
detail: Alternatives to managed Code Review: run Claude in your own CI with an API key, or build your own reviewer as a subagent or skill.

feature: Slash command /add-dir
detail: Add an extra working directory for file access, with tab-completed path suggestions; most .claude config in it is not discovered.

feature: Slash command /advisor
detail: Turn the advisor tool on or off; a second model is consulted for guidance at key moments, selectable by name or full model ID.

feature: Slash command /agents
detail: Reminds you to ask Claude to create or manage subagents or edit agent files; older versions opened an interactive manager.

feature: Slash command /artifact-capabilities
detail: Bundled skill loading the reference for runtime capabilities a published artifact can use, such as calling connectors.

feature: Slash command /artifact-diagramming
detail: Bundled skill giving diagram guidance for artifacts: when a diagram helps and how to write legible inline SVG in light and dark.

feature: Slash command /artifacts
detail: List artifacts you own or that are shared with you, then attach one to the session, open it in the browser, or copy its link.

feature: Slash command /auto-mode-setup
detail: Drafts autoMode.environment entries from your project and recent sessions for review and saves them to user settings.

feature: Slash command /autocompact
detail: Set how full the context window gets before automatic compaction (e.g. 500k tokens or auto); saved to user settings.

feature: Slash command /autofix-pr
detail: Spawns a cloud session that watches the branch's PR and pushes fixes when CI fails or reviewers comment.

feature: Slash command /background
detail: Detach the session to run as a background agent, optionally with one more instruction; monitor with claude agents.

feature: Slash command /batch
detail: Bundled skill that decomposes a large change into 5 to 30 independent units, shows a plan, then runs one background sub-agent per unit.

feature: Slash command /branch
detail: Branch the current conversation to try another direction, keeping the original resumable.

feature: Slash command /btw
detail: Ask a side question without adding it to the conversation; no argument shows earlier side questions.

feature: Slash command /bug
detail: Report a bug or share the conversation, choosing how much history to include behind a consent screen.

feature: Slash command /cd
detail: Move the session to a new working directory keeping the conversation.

feature: Slash command /chrome
detail: Configure Claude in Chrome settings from the CLI.

feature: Slash command /claude-api
detail: Bundled skill loading Claude API reference with sub-modes such as migrate, cost-optimize, latency-optimize and build-eval.

feature: Slash command /claude-in-chrome
detail: Bundled skill to have Claude do browser tasks like testing a page, filling a form or reading console logs via Claude in Chrome.

feature: Slash command /clear
detail: Start a new empty conversation, optionally naming the previous one for the resume picker.

feature: Slash command /code-review
detail: Reviews the current diff, a PR, branch or path with effort levels low to ultra, plus --fix, --comment and --max-findings options.

feature: Slash command /color
detail: Set the prompt bar color for the session from eight colors or default.

feature: Slash command /compact
detail: Summarize the conversation to free context, optionally with focus instructions.

feature: Slash command /config
detail: Open Settings, or set values directly with key=value pairs such as theme or model, also in non-interactive mode.

feature: Slash command /context
detail: Visualize context usage as a colored grid with optimization suggestions and capacity warnings.

feature: Slash command /copy
detail: Copy the last (or Nth-latest) assistant response, with a picker for individual code blocks.

feature: Slash command /cost
detail: Alias for /usage.

feature: Slash command /dataviz
detail: Bundled skill with chart design guidance: picks chart form, assigns color by role and validates palette for colorblind safety.

feature: Slash command /debug
detail: Bundled skill that enables debug logging for the session and troubleshoots from the debug log.

feature: Slash command /deep-research
detail: Bundled workflow that fans out web searches, cross-checks sources and synthesizes a cited report.

feature: Slash command /design
detail: Bundled skill drafting UI mockups, flows, landing pages or posters as artboards on a Claude Design canvas artifact.

feature: Slash command /design consent and /design revoke
detail: Grant or withdraw Claude's access to Claude Design; the user must type the consent command themselves.

feature: Slash command /design-login
detail: Authorize design-system access for /design-sync with a claude.ai account; the standalone Claude Design site is stated to close by Dec 14, 2026.

feature: Slash command /design-sync
detail: Bundled skill converting a repo's React design system and uploading it to Claude Design so designs use real components.

feature: Slash command /desktop
detail: Continue the current session in the Claude Code Desktop app; alias /app.

feature: Slash command /diff
detail: Review working-tree changes, including Claude's edits so far.

feature: Slash command /doctor
detail: Setup checkup skill diagnosing installation, settings, extensions and CLAUDE.md problems and proposing fixes after confirmation; has a prompt-audit mode.

feature: Slash command /effort
detail: Set effort level low to xhigh, max or auto, show status, or toggle ultracode.

feature: Slash command /exit
detail: Exit the CLI; in an attached background session it detaches and the session keeps running; alias /quit.

feature: Slash command /export
detail: Export the conversation as plain text to a file or clipboard.

feature: Slash command /fast
detail: Toggle fast mode on or off, even mid-response.

feature: Slash command /feedback
detail: Send product feedback via the same consent dialog as /bug.

feature: Slash command /fewer-permission-prompts
detail: Bundled skill scanning transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP calls and adding an allowlist to project settings.

feature: Slash command /focus
detail: Toggle a focus view showing only last prompt, a one-line tool summary with diffstats and the final response.

feature: Slash command /fork
detail: Copy the conversation into a new background session and keep working, optionally starting it on a prompt.

feature: Slash command /goal
detail: Set a completion condition so Claude keeps working across turns until it is met; with no argument shows status, clear removes it.

feature: Slash command /heapdump
detail: Hidden command writing a JS heap snapshot and memory breakdown for diagnosing memory usage.

feature: Slash command /help
detail: Show help and available commands.

feature: Slash command /hooks
detail: View configured hooks.

feature: Slash command /ide
detail: Manage IDE integrations and show status.

feature: Slash command /import
detail: Bring Codex, Gemini CLI or Cursor config (instructions, MCP servers, commands, subagents, skills) into Claude Code, with dry-run and yes flags.

feature: Slash command /init
detail: Generate a starter CLAUDE.md; an env flag enables an interactive flow covering skills, hooks and personal memory; can import Codex/Gemini config.

feature: Slash command /insights
detail: Generate an HTML report analyzing recent local sessions: projects, usage patterns, problems and features to try; not in cloud sessions.

feature: Slash command /install-github-app
detail: Install the Claude GitHub App for a repo with optional GitHub Actions workflow and secrets setup; github.com only.

feature: Slash command /install-slack-app
detail: Install the Claude Slack app via an OAuth flow in the browser.

feature: Slash command /keybindings
detail: Open the keyboard shortcuts file for editing.

feature: Slash command /list-agents
detail: List subagents, agent-team teammates and other sessions Claude can message, with their names.

feature: Slash command /login
detail: Sign in to an Anthropic account.

feature: Slash command /logout
detail: Sign out of the Anthropic account.

feature: Slash command /loop
detail: Bundled skill that repeats a prompt while the session is open; omit the interval and Claude self-paces.

feature: Slash command /mcp
detail: Manage MCP server connections and OAuth; supports reconnect, enable and disable for one server or all.

feature: Slash command /memory
detail: Edit CLAUDE.md files, toggle auto memory and view auto memory entries.

feature: Slash command /mobile
detail: Show a QR code to download the Claude mobile app; aliases /ios and /android.

feature: Slash command /model
detail: Switch model and save as default, adjust effort with arrow keys, or open a picker with a per-session option.

feature: Slash command /output-style
detail: List or switch output styles such as concise.

feature: Slash command /passes
detail: Share a free week of Claude Code with friends; shown only to eligible accounts.

feature: Slash command /permissions
detail: Manage allow, ask and deny rules, working directories and review recent auto mode denials.

feature: Slash command /plan
detail: Enter plan mode from the prompt, optionally with a task description.

feature: Slash command /plugin
detail: Manage plugins: open the menu or list, install, enable or disable directly.

feature: Slash command /plugin-authoring
detail: Bundled skill loading the reference for writing mods (plugins that change Claude's interface or behavior).

feature: Slash command /powerup
detail: Interactive lessons with animated demos teaching Claude Code features.

feature: Slash command /pr-comments
detail: Removed in v2.1.91; ask Claude directly to view PR comments.

feature: Slash command /privacy-settings
detail: View and update privacy settings.

feature: Slash command /radio
detail: Open Claude FM lo-fi radio in the browser or print its stream URL.

feature: Slash command /rate-limit-options
detail: Show ways to continue when a usage limit blocks a request: wait for auto-continue, add usage credits and more.

feature: Slash command /recap
detail: Generate a one-line summary of the current session on demand.

feature: Slash command /release-notes
detail: View the changelog in an interactive version picker.

feature: Slash command /reload-plugins
detail: Reload active plugins to apply changes without restart, reporting counts and load errors.

feature: Slash command /reload-skills
detail: Re-scan skill and command directories so new or changed skills become available without restart.

feature: Slash command /remote-control
detail: Make the session available for Remote Control from claude.ai; alias /rc.

feature: Slash command /remote-env
detail: Choose the default cloud environment for cloud sessions started from the CLI.

feature: Slash command /rename
detail: Rename the session shown on the prompt bar, or auto-generate a name.

feature: Slash command /restart
detail: Restart Claude Code and resume the session to apply an installed update; native macOS/Linux install only; alias /update.

feature: Slash command /resume
detail: Resume a conversation by ID or name or open the picker, which marks background sessions.

feature: Slash command /review
detail: Alias of /code-review.

feature: Slash command /rewind
detail: Rewind conversation and/or code to a checkpoint or summarize from a selected message; aliases /checkpoint, /undo.

feature: Slash command /run
detail: Bundled skill that launches and drives your project's app to see a change working.

feature: Slash command /run-skill-generator
detail: Bundled skill that writes a per-project skill teaching /run and /verify how to build and launch the app.

feature: Slash command /sandbox
detail: Toggle sandbox mode on supported platforms.

feature: Slash command /schedule
detail: Create, update, list or run cloud scheduled tasks (formerly routines) conversationally, and ask about recent runs.

feature: Slash command /scroll-speed
detail: Adjust mouse wheel scroll speed interactively in fullscreen rendering.

feature: Slash command /security-review
detail: Analyze the branch diff against origin's default branch for injection, auth and data-exposure risks.

feature: Slash command /setup-bedrock
detail: Wizard for Amazon Bedrock auth, region and model pins; hidden until the Bedrock env flag is set.

feature: Slash command /setup-vertex
detail: Wizard for Google Cloud Agent Platform auth, project, region and model pins; hidden until its env flag is set.

feature: Slash command /simplify
detail: Bundled skill running four parallel review agents for reuse, simplification and efficiency, then applying fixes.

feature: Slash command /skill-doctor
detail: Show each skill's context cost and usage frequency to find skills to turn off; feature-flag gated.

feature: Slash command /skills
detail: List skills with filtering, sort by token count and cycle a skill's visibility to Claude and the menu.

feature: Slash command /slides
detail: Bundled skill making a Claude Slides presentation artifact from a brief.

feature: Slash command /stats
detail: Alias for /usage opening on the Stats tab.

feature: Slash command /status
detail: Open Settings on the Status tab showing version, model, account and connectivity, plus background job state.

feature: Slash command /statusline
detail: Configure the status line by description or auto-configure from the shell prompt.

feature: Slash command /stickers
detail: Check Claude Code sticker availability.

feature: Slash command /stop
detail: Stop the attached background session or one you reply to, keeping transcript and worktree.

feature: Slash command /subtask
detail: Spawn a forked background subagent that inherits the full conversation and returns its result when done.

feature: Slash command /tasks
detail: View and manage background work in the session, including finished subagents; alias /bashes.

feature: Slash command /team-onboarding
detail: Generate a team onboarding guide from the last 30 days of your usage that a teammate can paste as a first message.

feature: Slash command /teleport
detail: Pull a cloud session into the terminal via a picker; alias /tp.

feature: Slash command /terminal-setup
detail: Install a Shift+Enter newline keybinding in VS Code, Cursor, Alacritty, Zed and similar; in Apple Terminal, disable the bell.

feature: Slash command /theme
detail: Change color theme: auto, light/dark, colorblind-accessible, ANSI and custom themes.

feature: Slash command /tui
detail: Switch between classic and fullscreen flicker-free terminal renderers and relaunch.

feature: Slash command /ultraplan
detail: Removed; use plan mode instead (formerly sent planning to a cloud session).

feature: Slash command /ultrareview
detail: Deep multi-agent code review in a cloud sandbox for a PR or branch.

feature: Slash command /update-config
detail: Bundled skill that edits settings.json for described changes such as permissions, env vars or hooks.

feature: Slash command /upgrade
detail: Open the upgrade page to switch plan tier; not shown on Enterprise.

feature: Slash command /usage
detail: Show session cost, plan usage limits and activity stats with a breakdown of what counts against plan limits.

feature: Slash command /usage-credits
detail: Configure usage credits or request them from an admin when a limit is hit.

feature: Slash command /verify
detail: Bundled skill that builds and runs the app to confirm a change works rather than relying on tests.

feature: Slash command /vim
detail: Removed in v2.1.92; use /config Editor mode instead.

feature: Slash command /voice
detail: Toggle voice dictation in hold or tap mode; requires a Claude.ai account.

feature: Slash command /web-setup
detail: Connect GitHub for cloud sessions using local gh CLI credentials.

feature: Slash command /workflow-authoring
detail: Bundled skill loading the reference for writing dynamic workflow scripts.

feature: Slash command /workflows
detail: Open the workflow progress view to watch, pause, resume or save workflows.

feature: Command menu filtering and hidden commands
detail: The / menu highlights only on name matches, reports Unknown command after typos, hides unavailable commands, and keeps some commands hidden until fully typed.

feature: Commands only recognized at message start; stack up to six skills
detail: A command works only at the start of a message; several skills can be chained in one message and trailing text goes to each; commands sent mid-response are queued.

feature: MCP prompts as slash commands
detail: Prompts exposed by connected MCP servers appear as commands in the menu.

feature: Prompt-driven code exploration and bug fixing
detail: Ask Claude for codebase overviews, to find and trace code, diagnose errors from pasted traces, and apply fixes in any surface.

feature: Refactoring, test generation and documentation
detail: Claude finds legacy code, refactors in increments, writes tests matching existing project style, and adds docs such as JSDoc.

feature: Create pull requests from the session
detail: Ask Claude to create a PR; session links to the PR when made via gh pr create and is findable with claude --from-pr or the resume picker.

feature: Use Claude Code in notes and non-code folders
detail: Works in any directory such as a notes vault, reading files fresh on each tool call so outside edits are seen.

feature: Image input: drag, paste or path
detail: Add images by drag-and-drop, Ctrl+V (Alt+V on Windows/WSL) or file path; multiple images per conversation; Cmd/Ctrl+click an [Image #N] reference to open it.

feature: @ file, directory and MCP resource references
detail: Type @ for path suggestions to include a file (up to 25k tokens, text under 256KB), a directory listing, or an MCP resource; adds CLAUDE.md from parent folders.

feature: Disable @ file mentions setting
detail: An env variable stops @ references from including content; PreToolUse hooks do not fire on @ includes, so Read deny rules are the control.

feature: Scheduling options: cloud, desktop, GitHub Actions, /loop
detail: Four ways to run Claude on a schedule: cloud scheduled tasks (run with computer off, API or GitHub triggers), desktop tasks (local files), GitHub Actions in CI, and /loop in a session.

feature: Ask Claude about its own capabilities
detail: Claude answers questions about Claude Code features from current documentation; /powerup offers interactive lessons.

feature: Resume conversations: --continue and --resume
detail: Conversations are saved locally; --continue resumes the latest session in the directory, --resume or /resume opens a picker.

feature: Parallel sessions with git worktrees
detail: claude --worktree <name> starts an isolated checkout on its own branch so concurrent sessions do not collide.

feature: Plan mode for review before edits
detail: Plan mode reads and proposes a plan without editing until approved; enter with --permission-mode plan or Shift+Tab, status bar shows plan mode on.

feature: Delegate research to subagents
detail: Subagents explore in their own context window and return only a summary, keeping the main context clean.

feature: Pipe into scripts with claude -p
detail: Non-interactive print mode accepts piped input for CI, pre-commit hooks and batch jobs.

feature: Claude Code model tiers: Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku
detail: Sonnet is the recommended default, Opus for large refactors and hard debugging, Haiku for quick mechanical edits; Fable is opt-in via /model fable for the hardest long-running tasks.

feature: Automatic model fallback for cybersecurity and biology content
detail: Flagged cybersecurity or biology content falls back to Opus (Fable) or an earlier model of the same family; flagged biology content on Opus 5 and Sonnet 5.5 is refused.

feature: Permission modes cycle with Shift+Tab
detail: Shift+Tab cycles Manual (asks before edits and most shell commands), acceptEdits, and plan mode.

feature: Checkpointing and Esc-Esc rewind
detail: Checkpoints are automatic; pressing Esc twice or /rewind rolls conversation and file changes back to an earlier point.

feature: Project .mcp.json for MCP connectors
detail: A .mcp.json at the project root wires Claude to trackers such as GitHub, Jira or Linear; Claude can write the config for you.

feature: Skills as reusable slash commands
detail: A SKILL.md in .claude/skills/<name>/ becomes a reusable prompt run with /name; Claude can create one for you.

feature: Hooks on Claude Code events
detail: Shell commands fire on events such as Stop, e.g. a desktop notification when a long task finishes.

feature: Plugin marketplace via /plugin
detail: Skills and other extensions are bundled and shared as plugins; /plugin browses and installs in one step.

feature: Native install script and IDE extensions
detail: Install with the claude.ai install script then run claude in a repo; VS Code extension and JetBrains plugin offer the same agent.

feature: Team and Enterprise: no training on code or prompts
detail: On Team or Enterprise plans Anthropic does not train on Claude Code code or prompts; CLI talks directly to the API with optional OS sandboxing for shell commands.

feature: Computer use in the Claude Code CLI
detail: Claude opens apps, clicks and types on your Mac screen to build and test native apps, run UI tests, debug layout and drive GUI-only tools like the iOS Simulator; research preview, interactive sessions only.
plans: Pro, Max, Ultra (not Team or Enterprise)

feature: Computer use tool-priority order
detail: Claude prefers an MCP server, then Bash, then Claude in Chrome for browser work, and uses screen control only as the broadest and slowest last resort.

feature: Enable computer-use built-in MCP server
detail: Off by default; enable computer-use in /mcp once per project, then grant macOS Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions.

feature: Per-session app approval for computer use
detail: Each app Claude needs is approved per session (Allow for this session or Deny), with warnings for terminals/IDEs, Finder and System Settings; control level is view-only for browsers, click-only for terminals/IDEs, full otherwise.

feature: Computer use hides other apps and excludes the terminal from screenshots
detail: While working, non-approved apps are hidden and restored after the turn; the terminal stays visible but is never captured.

feature: Computer use lock: one session at a time
detail: A session holds a lock from its first action until it exits; a second session's computer use fails until the first exits, with automatic release if it crashed.

feature: Press Esc to stop computer use
detail: A notification announces use and Esc anywhere (or Ctrl+C) aborts immediately; the key press is consumed so injected content cannot use it.

feature: Automatic screenshot downscaling
detail: Screenshots are downscaled before reaching the model with no setting to change the size.

feature: Computer use CLI vs Desktop differences
detail: Desktop supports macOS and Windows with a Settings toggle, configurable denied-apps list and optional auto-unhide; CLI is macOS only with no denied-apps list and always auto-unhides.

feature: Computer use unavailable with third-party providers
detail: Requires claude.ai authentication; not available via Bedrock, Google Agent Platform or Microsoft Foundry, nor on Linux or in -p mode.

feature: Context window contents at startup
detail: CLAUDE.md, auto memory, MCP tool names, skill descriptions and output style load into context before the first prompt; AGENTS.md can load instead of CLAUDE.md.

feature: What survives compaction
detail: After /compact or auto-compaction, CLAUDE.md, auto memory, plan, skill descriptions and up to five recent files are re-injected; invoked skills are capped at 5,000 tokens each and 25,000 total; background tasks keep running.

feature: Automatic compaction when context fills
detail: Claude Code compacts automatically near the limit; users can compact with a focus, summarize from/up to a message via /rewind, set /autocompact threshold, /clear, or delegate reads to subagents.

feature: 1M-token context window on supported models
detail: Fable models, Sonnet 5 and later, Haiku 5.5, Opus 4.6 and later and Sonnet 4.6 support a 1M window selectable via a [1m] variant; availability varies by plan.

feature: Live context breakdown with /context
detail: Shows usage by category with optimization suggestions and which memory files loaded; /memory opens them for editing.

feature: Path-scoped rules and nested CLAUDE.md load on demand
detail: Rules with paths frontmatter and subdirectory CLAUDE.md files load when matching files are read and are summarized away on compaction unless moved to the root file.

feature: CLAUDE_CODE_PROCESS_WRAPPER corporate launcher
detail: Admins route every Claude Code self-launched process (background service, agent view sessions, update relaunches, Remote Control and agent-team panes) through a launcher script that must end in exec; ignored on Windows.

feature: processWrapper setting and managed-settings enforcement
detail: Same launcher as a named setting (v2.1.210+); managed settings override user and shell values, project and local settings are ignored, and it appears in the remote-managed-settings approval dialog.

feature: Launcher status verification
detail: /status shows a Self-exec entry with the resolved launch command and mismatch warnings; claude daemon status prints the same; claude daemon stop --any restarts the service wrapped.

feature: Launcher contract and refusal on failure
detail: Launcher must pass arguments and environment untouched, reach exec within about 3 seconds, not read stdin or print; if it cannot run, Claude Code refuses to start rather than run unwrapped.

feature: Processes outside the launcher
detail: User-started terminal sessions, claude-cli:// deep link sessions, worktree+tmux relaunch and the Chrome native messaging host do not go through the launcher.

feature: CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX wraps shell commands
detail: Separate prefix that wraps Bash tool calls, hooks and stdio MCP server commands, passed as one quoted string.

feature: /usage session cost block
detail: Shows session token use and a locally computed dollar cost at list price (or org-configured rates), per-model usage and durations; resets on /clear; data-residency responses multiply by 1.1.

feature: Prompt cache statistics line
detail: Session block summarizes cache requests, share of input from cache, misses, expected rebuilds and whether the cache is warm.

feature: Plan usage breakdown and recommendations
detail: On paid plans /usage attributes recent usage to skills, subagents, plugins and MCP servers and lists recommendations with usage shares; d/w switch 24 hours vs 7 days; computed from local history.

feature: Loops rows in usage breakdown
detail: Lists heaviest /loop or session-scoped scheduled tasks with frequency, run count and tokens per run.

feature: Press f in /usage to apply recommendations
detail: Runs /effort suggestions and prompts Claude to propose other fixes step by step; not available while Remote Control is connected.

feature: Usage-credits spend row
detail: Shows monthly usage-credit spend against a personal or org limit; Pro/Max/Ultra see Unlimited when no limit is set.

feature: Last-known usage fallback
detail: If the usage endpoint fails, /usage shows bars from within the last 60 minutes with a note, and r retries.

feature: Live token count beside spinner
detail: Shows elapsed time and approximate output tokens for the current turn; hidden in screen reader mode.

feature: /insights usage report
detail: Analyzes up to 200 recent sessions into an HTML report at ~/.claude/usage-data/report.html with friction points and suggestions; works on any plan or provider.

feature: /usage-credits add or request usage credits
detail: Opens usage settings to turn credits on, see balance and limits; members without billing access send a confirmed request to admins; not with API key auth.

feature: Raise or remove spend limit from the CLI
detail: On Pro/Max/Ultra, hitting the spend limit with credits left prompts to change the limit without leaving the CLI.

feature: Wait and auto-continue after usage limit reset
detail: On v2.1.234+ Claude Code can wait for a limit reset and continue the interrupted task; /rate-limit-options lets the user choose, and admins can control auto-start.

feature: Limit message types
detail: Distinguishes session or weekly seat limits (shared across models), model-family limits, usage-credit spend limits, gateway caps, and non-limit context warnings.

feature: modelPricing managed setting for contracted rates
detail: Admins set per-million-token rates or a multiplier in managed settings so /usage, status line and OpenTelemetry match the contract; ignored in user or project settings.

feature: Teams and Enterprise seat allowance for Claude Code
detail: Usage draws from a per-seat allowance on rolling five-hour and weekly windows shared with chat and Cowork; seat tier is Standard or Premium.

feature: Spend report, adoption dashboard and CSV export
detail: Org analytics show estimated usage-credit spend per user and model (daily, CSV) and a dashboard of daily active users, sessions and contribution metrics.

feature: Spend limits at organization, group or member level
detail: With usage credits on, admins cap spend beyond the seat allowance at org, group or individual level.

feature: Enterprise Analytics API
detail: Returns per-user usage and cost across Claude surfaces using a read:analytics key created by a Primary Owner.

feature: Console workspaces and Claude Code workspace for API orgs
detail: API organizations get an auto-created Claude Code workspace, workspace spend limits and rate limits, a per-member dashboard and Claude Code Analytics API.

feature: Recommended TPM and RPM per user by team size
detail: Guidance table lowers per-user tokens and requests per minute as organization size grows, applied at organization level.

feature: Cloud provider cost attribution
detail: On Bedrock, Google Agent Platform or Foundry, billing is in the cloud account; attribution via OpenTelemetry, a self-hosted Claude apps gateway with per-user spend limits, or an LLM gateway.

feature: OpenTelemetry export of usage metrics
detail: Streams per-user token and cost metrics to your own observability stack on every setup.

feature: Agent teams are experimental and cost more
detail: Agent teams are off by default (enable with an env flag) and use roughly 7x tokens in plan mode since each teammate has its own context.

feature: Extended thinking default and controls
detail: Thinking is on by default; lower effort via /effort or /model, disable in /config, or cap MAX_THINKING_TOKENS; cannot be turned off on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 or Fable.

feature: Custom compaction instructions in CLAUDE.md
detail: A Compact instructions section in CLAUDE.md tells compaction what to preserve.

feature: MCP tool search deferral
detail: MCP tool definitions are deferred by default so only names enter context until used; /mcp disables unused servers.

feature: Code intelligence plugins
detail: Language-server plugins give symbol navigation and report type errors after edits.

feature: PreToolUse hooks that rewrite tool input
detail: Hooks can preprocess or trim tool output, such as limiting test output, by returning updatedInput.

feature: Background token use: recap, idle compaction, prompt suggestions
detail: Session recap, idle compaction and next-prompt suggestions use tokens while idle; suggestions are skipped near the usage limit.

feature: Cross-session inbound messages can be held
detail: crossSessionInbound setting set to hold stops other sessions' messages from starting idle turns.

feature: Goal check-ins while background work waits
detail: An active goal triggers at most three idle check-in turns per goal between user prompts.

feature: Billing support from in-product Get help
detail: Subscribers click their initials at claude.ai and choose Get help for billing questions.

feature: Cross-session messaging
detail: Claude can send plain-text messages between your Claude Code sessions on one machine, other machines or the cloud to hand over findings or coordinate worktrees; on by default in v2.1.224+ (v2.1.234+ on native Windows).

feature: @-mention a session as message target
detail: Typing @ plus a session name picks a live session from typeahead (v2.1.232+); names with spaces go in quotes; ambiguous names prompt a choice.

feature: Notice when another session goes idle
detail: Claude can subscribe to one notice when a local session next goes idle or exits (v2.1.236+), expiring after 12 hours; only the main conversation can ask.

feature: /list-agents (/peers) session listing
detail: Lists subagents, teammates, local sessions, cloud sessions and Remote Control sessions with offline status; details are withheld while Remote Control is connected.

feature: Messages to other machines and cloud sessions
detail: Local messages stay on a per-session socket; cross-machine and cloud messages go through Anthropic servers via Remote Control; offline targets receive on reconnect; cloud sessions cannot reply via SendMessage.

feature: Incoming message safety rules
detail: Messages from other sessions cannot approve permissions, change configuration or run slash commands, and the receiver's own permission prompts still apply.

feature: Message preview in transcript
detail: Messages show as a dim one-line preview with sender; Ctrl+O, click in fullscreen or --verbose reveals the full text; pending ones list under Waiting to be delivered.

feature: crossSessionInbound: accept, hold or refuse
detail: Setting (also a /config row named Messages from your other sessions) controls delivery of incoming messages; default decides by permission-mode class and opens an approve/deny dialog that expires after five minutes.

feature: Non-interactive sessions can receive messages
detail: claude -p workers bind an inbox and can receive messages; held ones expire per dialogExpiry unless crossSessionInbound is accept; bare mode does not bind.

feature: Session inbox socket for scripts and hooks
detail: Each session exposes a Unix socket or Windows named pipe path in /status and an env variable with a per-session token so hooks and scripts can post messages.

feature: isolatePeerMachines approval for cross-machine sends
detail: When true, Claude must get explicit approval before any message leaves the machine, even in bypass mode; cannot be switched off from a project file.

feature: Turn off messaging via deny rules and refuse
detail: Admins can deny SendMessage and ListAgents and set crossSessionInbound to refuse in managed settings; denying SendMessage also removes subagent and teammate messaging.

feature: Cross-session messaging limits
detail: Plain text only, about one million characters per local message, burst refusal, per-sender throttling, at most 50 queued, long exchanges pause until the user prompts, containers and WSL cannot reach the host.

feature: Training policy for Claude Code by plan
detail: Free, Pro, Max and Ultra accounts choose whether data (including Claude Code) trains future models; Team, Enterprise, API and third-party platforms are not trained on unless the customer opts in.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra; Team, Enterprise

feature: Development Partner Program
detail: Org admins can opt in to supply materials for model training.

feature: /feedback, /bug and /share transcript retention
detail: Transcripts submitted through these commands are retained for 5 years; Claude-drafted feedback is queued locally and sent only when the user chooses.

feature: Session quality survey and optional transcript upload
detail: A rating prompt records only the rating; a separate optional question asks to upload transcripts (kept up to 6 months, secrets redacted) with Yes, No or Don't ask again; can be disabled by env var.

feature: Data retention by account type
detail: Consumer: 5 years if model-improvement is allowed, 30 days if not; commercial: 30 days, or zero data retention for qualified Enterprise orgs; changeable at claude.ai privacy controls.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Local session transcript caching
detail: Transcripts are stored locally in plaintext for 30 days by default (cleanupPeriodDays) for resume; Desktop and Cowork sessions are exempt by default.

feature: Delete cloud sessions
detail: Users can delete individual cloud sessions, permanently removing the session event data.

feature: Encryption in transit and at rest by provider
detail: Data goes over TLS 1.2+; at-rest encryption depends on provider (Anthropic AES-256, Bedrock KMS option, Google CMEK, Foundry by hosting option).

feature: Cloud session data handling
detail: Cloud sessions run in isolated Anthropic VMs, GitHub credentials stay encrypted server-side behind a proxy, and outbound traffic passes a security proxy.

feature: Telemetry and error-report opt-outs
detail: Metrics and error reports can be turned off separately or together with env variables; error reports are on only for Pro/Max/Ultra sign-ins on v2.1.198+ with direct API and no ZDR/HIPAA.

feature: Feedback history scope choice
detail: Before submitting a report the user chooses current session only or also same-project sessions from the last 24 hours or 7 days; with third-party providers the report is saved locally instead.

feature: Default telemetry by API provider
detail: Telemetry, error reports and bug reporting default off on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS; surveys and WebFetch safety check stay on.

feature: WebFetch domain safety check
detail: Before fetching, the hostname only is sent to Anthropic's blocklist check; cached five minutes; can be disabled with skipWebFetchPreflight.

feature: /context category breakdown and /context all
detail: Breaks context into system prompt, tools, MCP tools, subagents, memory files, skills and messages; fullscreen collapses details until /context all.

feature: Config inspection commands
detail: /memory, /skills, /hooks, /mcp, /permissions, /doctor, /debug and /status each show one configuration area: memory files, skills, hooks, MCP servers, rules, checkups, debug logging and active settings sources.

feature: Settings precedence across managed, local, project, user
detail: Managed settings apply first; otherwise local overrides project overrides user, with flags and env variables as another layer; hot-reloads edits without restart.

feature: claude doctor read-only diagnostics
detail: Prints installation and settings diagnostics from the terminal without starting a session; /doctor inside a session also proposes fixes.

feature: MCP project server approval and reset
detail: Project .mcp.json servers need one-time approval; claude mcp reset-project-choices re-prompts; claude --debug=mcp writes server stderr to a debug log.

feature: claude --safe-mode
detail: Starts a session with CLAUDE.md, skills, plugins, hooks, MCP servers, custom commands, agents, output styles and keybindings disabled while auth, models, tools and permissions work; managed policy still applies.

feature: Clean config directory test
detail: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR plus --setting-sources user launches with fresh configuration to isolate problems.

feature: Hook matcher rules
detail: Matchers are case-sensitive strings; | or , (v2.1.191+) separate tool names; arrays are invalid; hooks live in settings.json (plugins use hooks.json).

feature: Skill folder layout and invocation flags
detail: Skills must be .claude/skills/name/SKILL.md; disable-model-invocation shows a user-only badge in /skills.

feature: Built-in Explore and Plan agents skip CLAUDE.md
detail: Custom subagents load CLAUDE.md like the main thread unless omitClaudeMd is set; Explore and Plan do not.

feature: Bash deny rules match literal command strings
detail: Deny rules do not catch aliases like /bin/rm; hooks or the sandbox give hard guarantees.

feature: claude-cli:// deep links open Claude Code with a prefilled prompt
detail: A custom URL scheme opens a terminal with Claude Code in a chosen directory and the prompt filled but not sent; usable in runbooks, alerts, READMEs, CI notices.

feature: Deep link parameters q, cwd and repo
detail: q prefills up to 5,000 characters of URL-encoded text; cwd sets an absolute working directory (unsafe paths rejected); repo resolves an owner/name slug to a previously used local clone; cwd wins if both given.

feature: Deep link safety banner
detail: A Prompt from an external link warning stays until the prompt is sent or cleared, with a character count for prompts over 1,000; nothing runs until Enter.

feature: Deep link handler registration per OS
detail: Handler is registered on first interactive message or agent view start in a trusted folder, writing only user-level locations on macOS, Linux and Windows; opens iTerm2, Ghostty, kitty, Alacritty, WezTerm, Terminal.app, or $TERMINAL / Windows Terminal.

feature: disableDeepLinkRegistration setting
detail: Set to disable in settings (or managed settings to enforce) to stop handler registration.

feature: VS Code and Desktop link handlers
detail: VS Code extension has its own vscode://anthropic.claude-code/open link opening an editor tab; Claude Desktop handles claude:// links including opening an SSH session.

feature: iOS Simulator pane in Claude Code Desktop
detail: Claude builds, installs, launches and taps through your app in Apple's iOS Simulator while a live pane streams the device next to the chat; public beta on macOS, local sessions only, not for HIPAA orgs or third-party providers.

feature: Simulator pane requirements
detail: Needs Desktop v1.24012.0+, a Mac and Xcode 26.x or 27 with an iOS runtime; xcode-select picks which Xcode when several are installed.

feature: Interact with the simulator yourself
detail: Tap, swipe, press hardware buttons via Cmd shortcuts, rotate, switch devices, save screenshots (Cmd+S) or recordings (Cmd+R) to Desktop, detach, and tune frame rate and resolution.

feature: Shared device control and Claude-is-using-device badge
detail: User and Claude drive the same device; a badge shows when Claude is acting; panes can be minimized or closed while Claude keeps using the device.

feature: Simulator device lifecycle
detail: Claude reuses a running simulator or one you name; simulators it booted shut down on quit, archive, or 10 minutes after detach; manually booted ones are never auto-shut down.

feature: Per-device consent for Claude's simulator access
detail: Claude asks once per device before controlling or screenshotting it; building, opening URLs and installing/launching still follow the permission mode; screenshots are sent to Anthropic under normal retention.

feature: Disable simulator access by setting or policy
detail: Users can turn it off in Desktop settings; admins use disableMobileSimulatorTools (pane stays usable manually) or requireCoworkFullVmSandbox (disables pane and tools).

feature: iPhone Duo simulator folding
detail: With Desktop v4.29.0+ and Xcode 27.1+, test closed, half-open (1 to 179 degrees) and open poses by button, slider or asking Claude; Claude may offer to export Xcode agent skills.

feature: Simulators only, not physical devices
detail: Claude cannot control a physical iPhone or iPad; users describe or screenshot results instead.

feature: Claude desktop app for Linux (beta)
detail: Chat, Cowork and Claude Code in the desktop app on Debian-based Linux (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+; x86_64 or arm64) with parallel sessions, diff review, terminal, editor and app preview.

feature: Linux install via apt repository or .deb
detail: Install from Anthropic's signed apt repository or a downloaded .deb; updates arrive only through system package updates, not in-app; uninstall with apt remove.

feature: Cowork on Linux needs virtualization
detail: Cowork runs in a QEMU/KVM virtual machine requiring hardware virtualization, QEMU and UEFI packages, /dev/kvm access via kvm group and the vhost_vsock module.

feature: Linux desktop sign-in storage
detail: Sign-in is saved in the desktop keyring (GNOME Keyring or KDE Wallet); otherwise the user must sign in on every launch; cannot run as root without --no-sandbox.

feature: Linux desktop gaps: computer use, dictation, distros
detail: Computer use and voice dictation are not available; Quick Entry hotkey works on X11 and needs a GlobalShortcuts portal on Wayland; Fedora/RHEL not supported yet.

feature: Sign in with subscription, SSO or third-party providers
detail: Desktop signs in with a claude.ai subscription or org SSO, or with API key, Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry or an LLM gateway via the third-party deployment.

feature: Claude Code in the desktop app Code tab
detail: The Code tab in the Claude desktop app (macOS, Windows, Linux beta) includes Claude Code with no Node.js or CLI install; requires a paid plan.

feature: Desktop app downloads per platform
detail: Universal macOS dmg (Intel and Apple Silicon), Windows x64 and ARM64 installers, and Linux apt or deb.

feature: Environment selector: Local, Cloud, SSH, WSL
detail: Sessions run locally, in the cloud (continues when the app closes), over SSH on a remote machine (Claude Code auto-installed there), or in a WSL 2 distribution.

feature: Project folder and model picker in session row
detail: A row under the prompt box holds environment, project folder, model picker and permission mode controls.

feature: Desktop permission modes: Auto, Manual, Accept edits, Plan
detail: Auto uses a background classifier that blocks risky actions; Manual asks for every edit or command; Accept edits auto-applies edits; Plan proposes without editing.

feature: Diff view with +/- indicator and line comments
detail: After edits, a +12 -1 style indicator opens a file-by-file diff where you comment on lines and Claude revises; can also run /code-review.

feature: Interrupt and steer a running task
detail: Stop button interrupts immediately, or type a correction and press Enter to redirect without stopping.

feature: @filename context and slash command browser
detail: @ pulls files into the prompt; / or + > Slash commands lists built-in commands, skills and plugin skills.

feature: Desktop plugins
detail: Install plugins adding skills, agents and MCP servers from within the desktop app.

feature: Arrangeable workspace panes and integrated terminal
detail: Drag chat, diff, terminal, file and browser panes into any layout; Ctrl+` opens the terminal.

feature: Browser pane previews your dev server
detail: Running a dev server opens the app in a Browser pane that can also open external sites so Claude can view, test endpoints and inspect logs.

feature: Pull request CI monitoring with auto-fix
detail: After a PR opens, Claude Code monitors CI checks and can fix failures automatically.

feature: Parallel sessions, worktrees, tasks pane and side chat
detail: Open multiple sessions from the sidebar, optionally each in a git worktree, watch subagents and background commands in the tasks pane, and open side chats.

feature: WSL 2 sessions in Claude Code Desktop
detail: On Windows 10/11 with WSL 2 and git in the distro, sessions run inside the Linux distribution with native paths; per-distribution and folder workspace trust.

feature: WSL session limits
detail: Plugins are not available; files can be viewed but not edited in the file pane; attachments may be image-only; terminal and connectors roll out separately and are absent with third-party providers.

feature: WSL sessions may be blocked on managed devices
detail: Organization-managed Windows devices can prevent WSL sessions, controlled by admins.

feature: Desktop scheduled tasks page (local and cloud)
detail: The Scheduled tasks page in the Code tab lists local tasks (run on your machine while app open and awake) and cloud tasks (run with computer off, triggered by schedule, API or GitHub events); formerly called routines.

feature: Comparison of cloud, desktop and /loop scheduling
detail: Cloud has 1-hour minimum and fresh clone; desktop has local file access with 1-hour form minimum; /loop needs an open session with 1-minute minimum.

feature: Create a local scheduled task
detail: Name (kebab-case folder), instructions, Only on this computer, local folder, schedule, permission mode and model; needs Desktop 1.1.5368+; can also be created by describing it in a session.

feature: One-time scheduled reminders
detail: Asking Claude for a single future run creates a one-time task that disables itself after firing.

feature: Schedule options: Hourly, Daily, Weekdays, Weekly, Manual, Custom cron
detail: Presets plus run-on-demand Manual and local-time cron Custom (no more often than hourly in forms); Claude can set faster or one-off times when asked.

feature: Scheduled task isolated worktree option
detail: Edit form Worktree checkbox gives each run its own git worktree instead of the working directory's current state.

feature: Local task execution rules and sleep handling
detail: App checks every minute, adds a deterministic few-minute stagger, and skips runs if the computer sleeps; Keep computer awake setting prevents idle sleep.

feature: Missed-run catch-up
detail: On launch or wake, one catch-up run starts for the most recent missed time within seven days, with a notification.

feature: Per-task permission mode, model and always-allow approvals
detail: Each task has its own permission mode and model (or admin default); Run now helps approve prompts, saved approvals are reviewable and revocable in an Always allowed panel; requiresUserInteraction MCP tools stall runs.

feature: Manage tasks: Run now, pause, edit, history, delete
detail: Detail page offers Run now, Active/Paused toggle, Edit, history including skipped runs with reasons, and Delete (sessions archived, SKILL.md folder stays on disk).

feature: Task prompt stored as SKILL.md on disk
detail: Each task's prompt lives in ~/.claude/scheduled-tasks/<name>/SKILL.md with frontmatter; edits apply next run; tasks can update themselves via update_scheduled_task with approval.

feature: Scheduled group in session sidebar
detail: Runs open as sessions from History or a Scheduled sidebar group, where Claude can edit files, run commands, commit and open PRs.

feature: Claude Code Dev Container Feature
detail: Installs Claude Code into any dev container via a Dev Container Feature (latest release, auto-updates by default); adds the VS Code extension where supported; works with VS Code, Codespaces, JetBrains, Cursor.

feature: Sign in to Claude Code inside a container
detail: Run claude in the container and sign in through a browser with a Claude or Console account, or use Bedrock, Agent Platform or Foundry credentials passed as environment variables; a paste-code fallback exists when no browser opens.

feature: Persist authentication across container rebuilds
detail: Mount a named volume at ~/.claude and set CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR so token, settings and history survive rebuilds; Codespaces can carry auth with secrets like a setup-token OAuth token.

feature: Enforce organization policy in a dev container
detail: Copy managed-settings.json to /etc/claude-code in the image, or deliver via server-managed settings or MDM; containerEnv can disable telemetry and the auto-updater, and pin a CLI version via npm.

feature: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC disables telemetry and feature flags
detail: Opts out of telemetry and error reporting but also disables Remote Control and other feature-flag dependent features.

feature: Restrict container network egress with a firewall script
detail: The reference container ships init-firewall.sh limiting outbound traffic using NET_ADMIN and NET_RAW capabilities; optional.

feature: --dangerously-skip-permissions in dev containers
detail: Unattended operation in a non-root container; rejected as root; risk of exfiltration of credentials; pair with egress limits, or use auto mode, or block via disableBypassPermissionsMode.

feature: Reference dev container example
detail: Anthropic's claude-code repo includes an example container with CLI, firewall, persistent volumes and Zsh; provided as a working example, not a maintained base image.

feature: Project-scope MCP servers in dev containers
detail: Define MCP servers in .mcp.json at the repo root so they ship with the container config; install stdio binaries in the Dockerfile and allow remote domains.

feature: Code tab in Claude Desktop
detail: Claude Code runs as the Code tab inside the Claude desktop app next to chat and Cowork; each conversation is an independent session with its own history and project folder.

feature: Desktop download for macOS, Windows, Windows ARM64
detail: Claude Desktop installs on macOS (universal Intel and Apple Silicon), Windows x64 and Windows ARM64.

feature: Claude Desktop on Linux (beta)
detail: Linux build installs through apt or a .deb package on Ubuntu and Debian.

feature: Parallel sessions in sidebar
detail: The sidebar lists sessions and lets several run in parallel, each tracking its own context and changes.

feature: Session start row: environment, folder, permission mode, model
detail: Before the first message the user picks environment, project folder (or repositories for cloud), permission mode and model; mode and model can change mid-session.

feature: Saved local or SSH environment
detail: A saved environment already holds its folders, so no project folder control shows; folders change by editing the environment.

feature: Interrupt or redirect Claude mid-run
detail: Stop button interrupts immediately; typing a correction and pressing Enter sends it without stopping, and Claude reads it after the current action.

feature: Plus menu: attachments, skills, connectors, plugins
detail: The + button next to the prompt box adds file attachments, skills, connectors and plugins.

feature: Prompt suggestions
detail: After a reply a gray suggested next prompt appears in the empty box; Tab or Right arrow accepts it, Enter alone does not send it; it costs plan usage; toggle in Settings > Code.

feature: @mention files
detail: Typing @ plus a filename adds a file to context; in cloud sessions @ lists files only after the first message.

feature: Attach images, PDFs and files
detail: Attach via the + button or drag and drop screenshots, mockups and documents; WSL sessions may allow images only, other files by @mention.

feature: Permission mode: Manual
detail: Claude asks before editing files or running commands and shows a diff to accept or reject each change.

feature: Permission mode: Accept edits
detail: Auto-accepts file edits and common filesystem commands like mkdir, touch, mv but asks before other terminal commands.

feature: Permission mode: Plan
detail: Claude explores read-only and proposes a plan without editing source; applies to the session only.

feature: Permission mode: Auto
detail: No routine prompts; a background classifier checks shell commands and network requests against the request; no separate settings toggle.

feature: Permission mode: Bypass permissions
detail: Runs without prompts apart from actions no mode approves; on Pro, Max, Ultra it must be enabled in Settings > Code; on Team and Enterprise org policy controls it; for sandboxes only.

feature: Default permission mode setting and per-folder memory
detail: permissions.defaultMode sets the default for new local sessions; a mode picked in a session is remembered per folder and outranks project settings.

feature: Cloud session permission modes
detail: Cloud sessions offer Accept edits, Plan and Auto; Bypass permissions is unavailable, including in self-hosted environments.

feature: Auto mode availability and model requirements
detail: Auto mode needs a supported Opus, Sonnet, Haiku or Fable model on the Anthropic API; admins can disable it with the disableAutoMode managed key.

feature: Preview app in Browser pane
detail: Claude starts a dev server and opens it in the Browser pane, verifying changes with screenshots, DOM inspection, clicks and forms; works for frontends and backend APIs and logs.

feature: Auto-verify changes after every edit
detail: By default Claude verifies its changes after each edit using the preview.

feature: Open HTML, PDF or video path in Browser pane
detail: Clicking such a path in chat opens it in the Browser pane in local sessions; SSH and WSL sessions can preview HTML files.

feature: Dev servers menu
detail: The Browser pane header menu starts, stops, or stops all dev servers.

feature: Keep cookies option in Browser pane
detail: Choose whether the Browser keeps cookies after quitting the app; not available in SSH sessions.

feature: Clear browsing data
detail: The Browser pane menu clears saved browser data.

feature: Browser tools toggle
detail: Turning Browser tools off in Settings > Code disables the Browser entirely.

feature: SSH sessions lack Browser pane tools
detail: In SSH sessions Claude cannot open the app in the pane or auto-verify; the user forwards the remote port to view the app.

feature: Configure preview servers in .claude/launch.json
detail: Claude writes the initial server config from the project; custom dev commands are edited in launch.json.

feature: HTML preview in SSH and WSL with notices
detail: HTML previews run scripts but may not load web content; an Export button saves the file to open in a browser where web content loads.

feature: disableRemotePreviewScripts managed setting
detail: Admins can stop scripts in SSH and WSL HTML previews; needs Desktop v5.1231.0 or later and may need parentSettingsBehavior merge.

feature: Tabbed Browser pane for external sites
detail: Browser pane is a tabbed browser opened with Cmd+Shift+B or Ctrl+Shift+B; supports sign-in including Google OAuth popups.

feature: Link-opening choice: Browser pane or default browser
detail: First external link click asks; changeable via Open links in built-in browser; Cmd or Ctrl click opens the default browser.

feature: External-page safety: classifier and allowlist
detail: Auto-mode classifiers review Claude's write actions on external pages in every mode; other modes also check a domain allowlist before navigating.

feature: Site approval card: Allow once, Always allow, Deny
detail: Outside Auto and Bypass a card asks before Claude uses an unapproved site; always-allow is stored per site on the device and revocable in Settings.

feature: Claude never buys, creates accounts or bypasses CAPTCHAs on sites
detail: Even on approved sites those actions need user input.

feature: Browser pane vs Claude in Chrome extension
detail: Browser pane uses a clean profile with no logins; the Chrome extension shares the user's logged-in browser state.

feature: browserExternalPageTools and disableBrowserExternalNavigation
detail: Admins can turn off Claude's tools on external pages or block all external navigation; the Browser honors the Chrome extension allow and blocklists.

feature: Diff view
detail: Review changes file by file from the Changes card line counts before creating a PR.

feature: Inline diff comments
detail: Hover a line, click +, type a comment and press Enter; Cmd+Enter or Ctrl+Enter submits all comments and Claude revises.

feature: /code-review with Code review card
detail: Findings appear grouped by file with Walk through in Changes, Fix this one, dismiss and Apply fixes.

feature: PR monitoring: CI status in Changes card
detail: After opening a PR its CI check status shows in the session details panel; needs the GitHub CLI installed and authenticated.

feature: PR Auto-fix
detail: Claude fixes failing checks and, in local sessions, addresses new review comments from owner, org members, collaborators or GitHub Apps.

feature: PR Merge when ready
detail: Turns on GitHub auto-merge (squash unless merge queue); disabled in SSH and WSL; repo must allow auto-merge.

feature: Auto-archive session after PR merge or close
detail: Setting in Settings > Code archives the session automatically; cloud and still-running sessions do not archive themselves.

feature: Pane layout: chat, diff, browser, terminal, file, plan, tasks, subagent
detail: Panes can be dragged, resized and closed with Cmd+\ or Ctrl+\; iOS Simulator pane on macOS; needs Desktop v1.2581.0 or later.

feature: Pop panes out into their own window
detail: Diff or terminal panes can pop out to a separate window and dock back.

feature: Session details panel (session rail)
detail: Cards beside chat show where the session runs, changes, running processes and context usage; hide or show from the title bar.

feature: Minimize a pane
detail: Minimize Terminal, Browser, iOS Simulator or side chat to a small view in the details panel or floating in a corner that can be moved and resized; needs Desktop v4.0.0.

feature: iOS Simulator pane
detail: Claude runs and tests an iOS app in a Simulator pane while the user watches; macOS only, works without computer use.

feature: Integrated terminal
detail: Terminal pane (Ctrl+backtick) opens in the session working directory sharing Claude's environment; extra tabs via +; available in local and SSH sessions.

feature: File pane editor
detail: Click a path in chat to open a file; local sessions can edit it, except view-only files like .mcp.json and .claude/settings.json; cloud, SSH and WSL are view-only.

feature: File pane Auto save toggle
detail: Edits save automatically by default; turning Auto save off adds Save and Cancel, and a changed-on-disk warning offers Override or Discard.

feature: File path context menu
detail: Right-click a path to Attach as context, Open in an installed editor (VS Code, Cursor, Zed), Show in Finder or Explorer, or Copy absolute path, relative path or filename.

feature: Transcript view modes: Normal, Thinking, Verbose
detail: Normal collapses tool calls; Thinking adds Claude's thinking; Verbose shows every tool call and step; switch from the session menu or Ctrl+O.

feature: Desktop keyboard shortcuts
detail: Cmd+/ lists shortcuts including new session, close session, switch sessions, stop, toggle diff, Browser and terminal, select element in Browser (Cmd+Shift+S), side chat (Cmd+;), permission mode, model and effort menus.

feature: Context window usage card and /context
detail: Context card or usage ring shows context fullness by category; /context prints a per-category breakdown; the ring also shows plan usage shared across Claude Code surfaces.

feature: Computer use in Code tab
detail: Claude opens apps and controls the screen on macOS (14 or later) and Windows; needs Pro, Max or Ultra and is unavailable on Team and Enterprise.

feature: Computer use background mode on macOS
detail: On macOS Claude can work in approved apps while the user keeps working.

feature: Computer use tool precedence
detail: Claude prefers a connector, then Bash, then Claude in Chrome, then the iOS Simulator pane, and uses screen control last.

feature: Enable computer use setting and macOS permissions
detail: Toggle under Settings > This computer > System or Capabilities; macOS also needs Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions; Windows takes effect at once.

feature: Computer use per-app approval and tiers
detail: Prompt asks Allow for this session or Deny (30 minutes in Dispatch sessions); tiers are view-only for browsers and trading platforms, click-only for terminals and IDEs, full access for others.

feature: Computer use denied apps and unhide setting
detail: Denied apps are rejected without prompting; Unhide apps when Claude finishes restores windows Claude hid.

feature: New session and split view
detail: + New or Cmd+N starts a session; Option or Alt click or right-click Open in Split view shows two sessions side by side, or open one in its own window.

feature: Run a session in its own Git worktree
detail: Worktree toggle runs a session in an isolated worktree under .claude/worktrees by default; default can be set per saved environment.

feature: Worktree location, branch prefix and .worktreeinclude
detail: Settings set a custom worktree directory and a branch prefix; .worktreeinclude copies gitignored files like .env into new worktrees.

feature: Add folders to a running session
detail: + then Add folder adds a folder to a local or SSH session without a worktree; folders can also be set in a saved environment.

feature: Archive a session
detail: Session menu Archive moves it to archived sessions; uncommitted worktree changes may be discarded, with Archive anyway prompt, and a worktree is removed about 30 days after archive.

feature: Unarchive session
detail: Open from the Archived tab and select Unarchive to restore the session and worktree changes.

feature: Group, sort and find sessions
detail: Group and sort icon in the session list arranges sessions; View all opens the Archived tab; session title in the title bar renames a session.

feature: Automatic context compaction and /compact
detail: When context fills Claude summarizes and continues; /compact triggers summarization early.

feature: OS notification when a Code session finishes
detail: Desktop sends an OS notification when a session completes a task while you are not viewing it; project sessions use the project's notifications.

feature: Side chat (/btw, Cmd+;)
detail: Ask a question using session context without adding it to the main conversation; available in local, SSH and WSL; not saved after the app closes.

feature: Background tasks pane
detail: Shows subagents, background shell commands and dynamic workflows in the session; click an entry to see output or stop it.

feature: Work across sessions
detail: Claude can list, read, message, rename and archive other desktop sessions on request; sees only local, SSH and WSL Code-tab sessions, by default the 20 most recent.

feature: Cross-session safety behaviors
detail: Approval card before archiving except in Auto and Bypass; messages respect receiving session's crossSessionInbound control and are quoted with their source.

feature: Claude-suggested tasks: Start, Do it here, Options, Start all
detail: Claude suggests out-of-scope work as a card; Start launches it in another session, Do it here sends it to the current session, Options edits environment, model, worktree and permissions, Start all launches many.

feature: Cloud sessions in Desktop
detail: Choose Cloud in the environment selector to run on Anthropic-managed infrastructure that continues after the app closes; check progress from claude.ai/code or mobile.

feature: Cloud sessions with multiple repositories
detail: Cloud sessions can select several repositories.

feature: Projects for many cloud sessions
detail: A project lets Claude start and track many cloud sessions from one conversation.

feature: Continue session in cloud (Open in)
detail: Session menu Open in Cloud continues the session as a cloud session with conversation carried as summary; not possible for SSH or WSL sessions.

feature: Open session folder in editor or file manager
detail: Open in also opens the session's folder in an installed editor or file manager.

feature: Remote Control makes local sessions visible on other devices
detail: A connected local session appears at claude.ai/code and in Claude apps on devices signed into the account.

feature: Remote Control switch and /remote-control
detail: Per-session switch in the Environment card or /remote-control connects a session; shows already-on message when auto-connected.

feature: Connect new sessions to Remote Control setting
detail: Settings > Code toggle makes new sessions connect automatically unless managed remoteControlAtStartup is false.

feature: remoteControlAtStartup and disableRemoteControl controls
detail: Admins or users set these keys to stop sessions connecting; admin console can prevent users turning it on; needs Desktop v4.4212.0.

feature: Archiving a session also archives its Remote Control copy
detail: Archiving in Desktop hides the session from other devices' default lists.

feature: Dispatch sessions: Code sessions started from phone
detail: Dispatch, a persistent Cowork conversation, can spawn Code sessions for bug fixes, dependency updates, tests or PRs; push notification on finish or approval; not available to new users.

feature: Dispatch computer-use approvals expire after 30 minutes
detail: Apps approved in Dispatch-spawned sessions re-prompt after 30 minutes instead of lasting the session.

feature: Customize and Plugins sidebar entries
detail: Customize or Plugins in the sidebar manages connectors, skills and plugins; Cowork sources these from the claude.ai account configuration.

feature: Skills and plugins synced from claude.ai account
detail: Skills and plugins enabled on the claude.ai account load in Code sessions and terminal sessions signed in with the same account.

feature: Connectors via + menu (MCP with graphical setup)
detail: Add connectors from the + menu or Plugins directory in local and SSH sessions; Claude can then read calendars, send messages, create issues; manage under Customize.

feature: Custom connectors and manual MCP servers
detail: Integrations outside the directory can be added by settings files or created as custom remote-MCP connectors.

feature: Skills via slash commands
detail: Type / or + > Slash commands to browse built-in commands, custom, project and plugin skills; Claude also loads them automatically; commands can be sent while Claude works.

feature: Personal skills from ~/.claude/skills
detail: Local sessions load personal skills from the home folder; SSH sessions read the remote host's; disableSideloadFlags can withhold account skills.

feature: Install plugins from desktop
detail: Plugin browser in the + menu or sidebar installs, enables, disables and uninstalls plugins (skills, agents, hooks, MCP servers, LSP configs) scoped to user, project or local.

feature: Plugin limits in cloud and WSL sessions
detail: Plugin browser is unavailable in cloud sessions and plugins are not available in WSL sessions.

feature: launch.json preview server config
detail: launch.json at the session folder root holds JSON-with-comments server entries with name, runtimeExecutable, runtimeArgs, port; multiple configurations supported.

feature: autoVerify setting
detail: autoVerify in launch.json or the Browser pane menu toggle Auto-verify changes; on by default; preview tools stay available when off.

feature: launch.json fields: cwd, env, program, args, url
detail: Each preview configuration can set a working directory, extra environment variables (not for secrets), a node script via program and args, and an override preview url.

feature: Preview url override and attach to running server
detail: A url entry opens the preview at another address such as local HTTPS or *.localhost, or attaches to an already running server when no command is given; localhost urls must be bare origin with matching port.

feature: autoPort handling for port conflicts
detail: autoPort true picks a free port, false fails when a specific port is needed, unset picks the next free port except for hardcoded script ports; servers read PORT.

feature: Environment types: Local, Cloud, SSH, WSL
detail: Local runs on the machine, Cloud on Anthropic infrastructure, SSH on a remote machine, WSL inside a WSL 2 distribution on Windows.

feature: Create a saved environment
detail: New environment dialog at the bottom of the selector has Local, SSH and Cloud tabs; saves where Claude runs plus folders for local and SSH.

feature: Auto-created environments
detail: On first use of the current layout Desktop creates up to eight environments from the most used local and SSH folders of the last month; editable or deletable.

feature: Edit, delete or archive environments
detail: Gear icon on an environment edits or deletes it; cloud environments are archived instead.

feature: Environment variables for local sessions
detail: Saved local environments hold KEY=value variables for sessions started from them; user-wide variables go in the env key of ~/.claude/settings.json.

feature: Local environment editor with encrypted variables
detail: Gear on the computer's own entry saves KEY=value pairs stored encrypted on the machine for local sessions; dev servers need a restart to receive them.

feature: Desktop-set environment variables (API_TIMEOUT_MS, ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL)
detail: Local sessions get a 15 minute API timeout and Anthropic's API host from Desktop regardless of user values; longer timeouts need the CLI; gateways use third-party inference configuration.

feature: Turn off extended thinking via MAX_THINKING_TOKENS
detail: Setting it to 0 in a saved local environment disables thinking on the API except models that always think; Opus 5 also needs effort high or lower.

feature: Adaptive reasoning and fixed thinking budgets
detail: Newer models always use adaptive reasoning with no fixed budget; Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 can use a fixed budget by disabling adaptive thinking.

feature: Local sessions can be disabled by admin
detail: The Local entry grays out with Disabled by your organization; new sessions default to the first SSH connection and saved local environments error.

feature: Cloud sessions use subscription limits
detail: Cloud session usage counts against subscription plan limits with no separate compute charge; environments added, edited or archived from the selector.

feature: SSH sessions
detail: Run Claude Code on a remote machine (VMs, dev containers, servers) with Desktop as the interface; remote can be Linux, macOS or Windows and Claude Code installs automatically on first connection.

feature: SSH connection form
detail: Add SSH connection takes optional name, host (user@host or ~/.ssh/config entry), port, key path and remote worktree folder.

feature: SSH remote machine requirements
detail: Needs x86_64 or arm64, SSH with SFTP, non-noexec home install folder (about 1 GB), a working shell and network access; MaxSessions 1 servers need specific client versions.

feature: SSH host key verification prompt
detail: Desktop asks to Trust and connect or Trust new key on first connect or key change, and the user should compare fingerprints with the machine's own.

feature: Proxy and CA certificate for SSH sessions
detail: Linux remotes behind proxies need HTTPS_PROXY and NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS in the remote ~/.claude/settings.json because shell profiles are not read.

feature: OpenSSH client and ~/.ssh/config support
detail: Desktop connects through OpenSSH (7.6 or later, Windows 9.4 or later, non-Store install) honoring Host, ProxyJump, IdentityFile and ProxyCommand; otherwise a built-in client with limits.

feature: Jump hosts and containers over SSH
detail: ProxyJump or ProxyCommand reaches machines behind a bastion or a Docker container running sshd; RemoteCommand is not run.

feature: SSH connection timeout behavior
detail: Desktop gives ssh 30 seconds then retries with 90 on macOS or Linux via jump hosts; a user ConnectTimeout overrides; phone approvals must land within 45 seconds.

feature: SSH forwarding settings are disabled by Desktop
detail: Desktop turns off agent, X11, port and tunnel forwarding on its connection; users forward ports themselves with ssh -L to view remote dev servers.

feature: Windows remote machines over SSH
detail: Supported with Microsoft OpenSSH Server (x64 or ARM64, cmd, PowerShell 5.1 or Git Bash) but less tested; limits include no terminal for Windows-path folders, unsandboxed commands and fork limits.

feature: Keep a task running while Desktop is disconnected
detail: SSH tasks keep running on the remote under an installed helper through sleep, network loss or quitting; with a Claude account the sign-in may expire so overnight runs are not reliable.

feature: SSH task limits while disconnected
detail: Tasks can end when sign-in expires, the remote kills user processes, idle terminals log out, helper updates, or after 30 days without connecting; worktree edits, connectors and workflows can fail while disconnected.

feature: Pending approvals wait while away
detail: Approval prompts or questions wait on the remote without a time limit and show when Desktop rejoins; Auto mode, allow rules and PermissionRequest, Notification, Stop and StopFailure hooks reduce interruptions.

feature: Reconnect after sleep or network loss
detail: Desktop reconnects on its own only with a prompt-free login such as an agent key; otherwise a notification or message shows the prompt; output buffer of 16 MiB may leave gaps.

feature: Reopen a session after quitting Desktop
detail: The task goes on if Desktop can rejoin its process; otherwise it restarts from saved history and loses pending approvals; older Windows and third-party versions cannot rejoin.

feature: SSH session worktree location
detail: New SSH worktrees go in the connection's Worktree folder, then remote worktree.location setting, then project .claude/worktrees; ignored on Windows remotes or when org restricts folders; needs Desktop v1.44121.0.

feature: Remote helper install under ~/.claude/remote
detail: Desktop installs a helper and Claude Code per user on Linux or macOS remotes, no sudo, socket with restrictive modes; removal means quit Desktop, kill processes, delete the folder.

feature: Archive ends an SSH session's process
detail: Archiving a session while connected ends its remote Claude Code process, which otherwise keeps running.

feature: SSH connection port tests in server logs
detail: Desktop probes the SSH port with connections closed before login, which may trip fail2ban or OpenSSH penalties; admins can exempt addresses.

feature: Use MCP servers configured on the remote machine
detail: SSH sessions read ~/.claude.json and .mcp.json on the remote and start stdio servers there.

feature: claude://code/new SSH deep link
detail: A deep link with ssh_host, ssh_port, ssh_folder and q opens a new session for a machine and folder with a prefilled, never auto-sent prompt after a confirmation dialog; needs Desktop v2.110.0.

feature: sshHostCommands: create SSH machines from a command
