detail: Settings entries add an item like Create Dev box that runs a user command to make a remote machine and saves the printed host; Desktop does not stop machines; needs Claude account and recent versions.

feature: sshHostCommands command rules and Create another machine
detail: Command is a program that prints the new host (one line or JSON with sshHost, sshPort, startDirectory); 10 minute limit; Create another makes a fresh machine while earlier sessions continue.

feature: Stop using a machine created by a command
detail: Archive every session on the machine, remove or replace the entry and restart Desktop so Desktop stops reconnecting; machines are deleted with the user's own tool.

feature: Distribute sshHostCommands to a team
detail: Admins deploy sshHostCommands in managed settings or MDM so users see a Create item; strictPluginOnlyCustomization hooks restricts users' own entries.

feature: sshConfigs: pre-configured SSH connections
detail: Managed settings push connections with id, name, sshHost, port and key; users can set only their own Worktree folder on them.

feature: sshHostAllowlist: restrict SSH hosts
detail: Managed list of case-insensitive host patterns limits Desktop SSH hosts including jump hosts; empty array disables SSH sessions; Desktop only, not network egress control.

feature: disableDesktopLocalSessions with SSH distribution
detail: Admins can disable local sessions and limit SSH sessions to chosen hosts by deploying three managed keys together.

feature: Admin console controls for Desktop, Cloud sessions, Remote Control
detail: Admin settings console toggles whether org users can use Claude Code in desktop, cloud sessions and Remote Control; HIPAA Enterprise orgs have them off by default.

feature: Cowork OpenTelemetry vs Code tab telemetry
detail: The admin OpenTelemetry form applies to Cowork only; Code tab sessions export telemetry via OTEL env keys in managed settings.

feature: permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode managed key
detail: Prevents users enabling Bypass permissions mode.

feature: autoMode managed setting
detail: Customizes what the Auto mode classifier trusts and blocks organization-wide.

feature: disableMobileSimulatorTools managed setting
detail: Blocks Claude's tools for the iOS Simulator pane while the user's own taps still work.

feature: disableSshSavedPasswords managed setting
detail: Stops Desktop offering to remember SSH passwords and using saved ones; needs v1.49585.0.

feature: managedMcpServers (3P deployments)
detail: Pushes http, sse or stdio MCP server configs with optional toolPolicy to all users; third-party Desktop deployments only.

feature: Managed settings reach by session type
detail: Local sessions read device files and eligible remote settings; cloud gets server-managed settings; SSH reads the remote host file; Cowork reads device policy but not admin-console settings.

feature: Connector tool controls for claude.ai connectors
detail: Connected claude.ai connectors are delivered directly to Claude Code, so managed-mcp.json cannot block them; org connector tool controls do.

feature: Device management policies (MDM)
detail: IT manages Desktop via Jamf or Kandji preference domain on macOS, registry on Windows, root-owned JSON on Linux: enable Claude Code, auto-updates, deployment URL.

feature: forceLoginOrgUUID restricts sign-in to an organization
detail: Desktop policy limits which claude.ai organizations may sign in and stops use of personal API keys or Console accounts; needs v1.2581.0.

feature: Network allowlist for Desktop
detail: Desktop needs HTTPS to anthropic.com, claude.ai, claude.com, claude.app and claudeusercontent domains; bridge host needs IP allowlist routing for Chrome.

feature: Artifact external hosts
detail: Artifacts load fonts from Google Fonts and scripts only from a fixed list of CDNs; blocked fonts fall back, blocked libraries break the artifact.

feature: SSO for Team and Enterprise
detail: Orgs can require SSO (SAML or OIDC) for all users.

feature: Data handling by session type
detail: Local sessions process code locally, cloud sessions on Anthropic infrastructure or self-hosted environment; context goes to the configured model provider.

feature: Enterprise deployment: dmg via MDM and Windows MSIX
detail: macOS distributes via MDM with the dmg; Windows deploys MSIX with silent install options.

feature: Move CLI session to Desktop with /desktop and claude --desktop
detail: /desktop saves the CLI session and opens it in Desktop; claude --desktop with --continue or --resume opens a session; macOS and x64 Windows with a Claude subscription only.

feature: /resume in Desktop local sessions
detail: Picks up a CLI session from inside a local Desktop session; not in SSH, WSL or cloud sessions.

feature: Desktop and CLI share configuration
detail: Desktop and CLI run the same engine, can run at once on one project, keep separate session lists and share CLAUDE.md memory and config.

feature: /resume picker for CLI sessions
detail: In a local Desktop session /resume lists CLI sessions on this computer, searchable by title, folder or branch, and continues the same session, not a copy.

feature: CLI flag equivalents in Desktop
detail: Model picker, mode selector, sidebar sessions, Verbose view and add folders replace flags; print and output-format are unavailable because Desktop is interactive only.

feature: MCP servers from claude_desktop_config.json
detail: Local Code sessions also load MCP servers defined for the Claude Desktop chat app; the CLI imports them with claude mcp add-from-claude-desktop.

feature: Desktop vs CLI feature differences
detail: Desktop adds attachments, autocomplete @mentions, plugin UI, scheduled tasks, Dispatch sessions and iOS Simulator pane; lacks scripting, dontAsk mode, and by default third-party providers.

feature: Scheduled tasks in Desktop
detail: Desktop supports scheduled recurring tasks through its own scheduled tasks feature, unlike the CLI's cron approach.

feature: No inline code suggestions or agent teams in Desktop
detail: Desktop has no autocomplete-style completions and no agent teams; dynamic workflows run in Desktop and Claude can message other sessions.

feature: Terminal-dialog commands in Desktop
detail: Commands that open terminal panels such as /permissions are unavailable in Desktop; /config opens Settings > Code.

feature: Release channel setting (Stable or Latest)
detail: Settings > This computer > System lets Desktop v4.29.0 or later use the Latest channel for newer versions sooner.

feature: Check for Updates and auto-update
detail: Menu entry checks for updates; Desktop auto-updates on launch on macOS and Windows; Linux updates via apt; admins can disable auto-updates.

feature: /status shows Claude Code version
detail: The Code tab runs its own copy of Claude Code, updated by the app and separate from the terminal CLI.

feature: requiredMaximumVersion limit on Claude Code
detail: Admins can cap the Claude Code version, which makes Desktop local sessions fail if its copy is newer.

feature: Git and Git LFS requirements
detail: Worktree sessions need Git; LFS repos need Git LFS installed.

feature: Help menu logs and Get Support
detail: Help > Troubleshooting opens or saves Desktop logs including ssh.log; Help > Get Support opens support.

feature: Authentication requirement: paid plan for Code tab
detail: The Code tab requires an active Pro, Max, Ultra, Team or Enterprise subscription.

feature: Copy branch name for cloud session branches
detail: Click the branch name in a session and select Copy branch name to fetch a cloud-created branch locally.

feature: Fast mode toggle (/fast)
detail: Runs supported models up to 2.5x faster at higher per-token cost using the same model. Toggled with /fast (Space then Enter) or the fastMode setting; a small arrow icon shows next to the prompt while on.

feature: Fast mode supported models and pricing
detail: Supported on Fable 5.2 ($16/$80 per MTok), Opus 5.5 ($8/$40, default fast model), Opus 5 and Opus 4.8 ($10/$50, research preview); not on Sonnet, Haiku or Opus 4.7. Pricing is flat across the 1M context window.

feature: Fast mode for Opus 4.8 retiring
detail: Fast mode on Opus 4.8 was deprecated Oct 30 2026 and requests are rejected after Nov 30 2026; switch to Opus 5.5 or run /fast off. Opus 4.7 fast mode already removed.

feature: Fast mode billed from usage credits only
detail: On subscription plans fast mode draws from usage credits even when plan usage remains, and is not covered by plan rate limits. /fast reports an error until usage credits are turned on (Settings > Usage, or /usage-credits).

feature: Owner must enable fast mode for Team and Enterprise
detail: Fast mode is off by default for organizations; an Owner enables it in Organization settings > Claude Code (Console admins in Claude Code preferences). Managed fastMode:false or an availableModels allowlist can also block it.

feature: Fast mode persistence and per-session opt-in
detail: Fast mode persists across sessions by default; setting fastModePerSessionOptIn makes every session start with it off. Managed opt-in restricts /fast on to interactive terminal sessions. VS Code offers a Toggle fast mode command.

feature: Fast mode in cloud sessions
detail: /fast on turns it on for one cloud session only (not saved); claude.ai/code also has a switch in the model menu when the plan and model support it. Needs Claude Code v2.1.271+.

feature: Fast mode rate-limit fallback and credit exhaustion
detail: On hitting the fast rate limit it falls back to standard speed with a gray icon and re-enables after cooldown. Running out of credits retries at standard speed and shows a notification.

feature: Fast mode on Google Cloud Agent Platform
detail: Available for Fable 5.2 in global, us or eu regions via /fast or --settings in non-interactive mode; not saved as default and falls back to standard speed if refused. Not available on Bedrock, Foundry or Claude Platform on AWS.

feature: Fast mode behind LLM gateways
detail: The availability check goes direct to api.anthropic.com; skip variables (CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FAST_MODE_NETWORK_ERRORS, CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FAST_MODE_ORG_CHECK) and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FAST_MODE exist for gateway or disable cases.

feature: Fast mode combined with effort level
detail: Fast mode lowers latency at the same quality; lower effort reduces thinking time. They can be combined for maximum speed on simple tasks.

feature: Where fast mode spend is shown
detail: Pro/Max/Ultra see it in Settings > Usage under usage credits; Team/Enterprise members use /usage; Console orgs group by Speed in Usage and Cost pages.

feature: Claude Code features by provider and sign-in method
detail: CLI, SDK, IDE extensions, subagents, hooks, commands, skills, CLAUDE.md, plugins, MCP, checkpoints, sandboxing, workflows and OpenTelemetry work on every provider; subscription-only features need a claude.ai login.

feature: Subscription-only Claude Code features
detail: Cloud sessions, mobile, Slack, Desktop, cloud scheduled tasks, Ultrareview, Code Review, Remote Control, Chrome extension, computer use, Artifacts and voice dictation need a claude.ai account, not an API key or cloud provider.

feature: Plan availability table for Claude Code features
detail: Cloud sessions and scheduled tasks on all plans; Remote Control and Channels admin-enabled on Team/Enterprise; computer use Pro/Max/Ultra only; Code Review Team/Enterprise only; analytics dashboard and server-managed settings Team/Enterprise; SCIM, Compliance API and Analytics API Enterprise only.

feature: Dispatch (Desktop) closed to new users
detail: Dispatch sessions in Desktop are not available to new users on Pro, Max or Ultra and not on Team or Enterprise.

feature: Ultra is the new name for Max 20x; Max replaces Max 5x
detail: Max and Ultra have identical Claude Code features; they differ in usage limits and price.

feature: Web search availability by provider
detail: Works on claude subscription, Console, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud Anthropic-managed and Foundry; not on Bedrock; limited to newer models on Google-managed Agent Platform.

feature: Auto mode model restrictions on cloud providers
detail: On Bedrock, Agent Platform and Foundry auto mode supports only newer Sonnet, Opus, Haiku 5.5 and Fable models.

feature: Advisor feature availability
detail: Advisor works on subscription, Console, Claude Platform on AWS and Google Anthropic-managed (v2.1.300+); not on Bedrock, Agent Platform or Foundry, and requires gateways to forward requests intact.

feature: Code Mode (experimental)
detail: Experimental feature available on claude subscription and Console only, with requirements.

feature: Cross-session messaging
detail: Sessions can message each other; same-machine only unless connected via Remote Control, which also reaches cloud sessions and other machines. Needs v2.1.224+ on macOS/Linux, v2.1.234+ on Windows; /list-agents and /peers exist only when enabled.

feature: Channels availability
detail: Channels work on subscription and Console only, admin-enabled on Team and Enterprise; not on cloud providers.

feature: GitHub Actions and GitLab CI/CD provider support
detail: GitHub Actions works on subscription, Console, Bedrock, Agent Platform and Foundry; GitLab CI/CD on all but Foundry. Alternatives to cloud sessions and /schedule on providers: CI runners and /loop.

feature: Analytics dashboard, server-managed settings and Zero Data Retention by provider
detail: Analytics dashboard and API on subscription/Console; server-managed settings Team/Enterprise only; Zero Data Retention for qualified Enterprise accounts, on request on Google Anthropic-managed, per cloud agreement elsewhere.

feature: claude.ai connectors in Claude Code, tool search limits
detail: claude.ai connectors load only when the subscription is the active auth; tool search is unsupported on Azure-hosted Foundry and older models on Agent Platform.

feature: /voice requires claude.ai account
detail: The /voice command works only with a claude.ai sign-in; /design-sync and /import are unavailable on cloud providers and Claude apps gateway.

feature: Explore subagent model when parent runs Fable
detail: Built-in Explore subagent runs on Opus on subscription, Console or ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL gateways; on other providers it runs on Fable.

feature: LLM gateway disables Remote Control and similar features
detail: When ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL points away from api.anthropic.com, Claude Code turns off features like Remote Control regardless of the gateway.

feature: Claude Desktop on 3P and gateway routing
detail: Desktop Code tab can run on Bedrock, Agent Platform, Foundry, a self-hosted gateway or Claude API key via Claude Desktop on 3P; gateway routing configurable in app or by admin.

feature: HIPAA configuration turns off some features
detail: Enterprise organizations with the HIPAA configuration applied have some plan-table features disabled.

feature: CLAUDE.md persistent project instructions
detail: Markdown files loaded every session (managed, user, project levels, plus nested ones discovered as files are touched); additive across levels; @path imports; guidance to keep under 200 lines; /doctor proposes trims.

feature: .claude/rules path-scoped rules
detail: Rule files load every session or only when files matching a paths frontmatter are opened, keeping CLAUDE.md small.

feature: Output styles
detail: Set Claude's role, tone and response format for a whole session; one active at a time, switchable, with built-in styles such as Concise and custom ones.

feature: Skills as slash-invocable or automatic workflows
detail: Markdown skills invoked with /name or loaded automatically by description match; can run in isolated context via context: fork; disable-model-invocation keeps description out of context; skillOverrides setting adjusts visibility.

feature: Bundled skills (/code-review, /batch, /debug)
detail: Claude Code ships built-in skills that work with no setup.

feature: Code intelligence via language server plugins
detail: Install a code intelligence plugin per language to give Claude symbol navigation and live type errors after edits; the LSP tool is inactive until installed.

feature: MCP servers with deferred tool schemas
detail: Connect external services; tool search on by default so idle tools cost little context; /mcp shows status, /context all shows token use; remote servers auto-reconnect; scopes local > project > user.

feature: Subagents and forks
detail: Isolated workers with their own context that return summaries; can preload skills, be named and message each other, or fork the current conversation; omitClaudeMd option; Explore and Plan agents skip CLAUDE.md.

feature: Dynamic workflows
detail: Claude writes a script that runs many subagents in the background, optionally cross-checking findings, and returns one result; started by asking for a workflow in the prompt.

feature: Hooks on lifecycle events
detail: Run a shell script, HTTP request, MCP tool call, prompt or subagent at events like PreToolUse, PostToolUse, SessionStart, prompt submission, permission requests and compaction; deterministic guardrails; exit code 2 feeds errors back to Claude.

feature: Plugins and marketplaces
detail: Bundle skills, hooks, subagents and MCP servers into an installable unit with namespaced skills (/plugin:skill), distributed through marketplaces.

feature: Artifacts from Claude Code sessions
detail: Publish session output as a private interactive web page, e.g. a timeline that updates as work proceeds.

feature: Feature layering and precedence
detail: Skills override by name (managed > user > project), subagents (managed > CLI flag > project > user > plugin), MCP (local > project > user); hooks merge from all sources.

feature: Fullscreen rendering (/tui fullscreen|default)
detail: Flicker-free alternate-screen renderer with flat memory in long chats; switch with /tui fullscreen, /tui default, or /tui to show current; carries over session state on relaunch; CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER env var; is default for newer installs.

feature: Fullscreen startup dialog and failed-start fallback
detail: Classic-renderer users may see a startup offer (shown at most three launches, Not now stops it); after crashed fullscreen starts Claude Code falls back to classic and prints a notice.

feature: Mouse support in terminal UI
detail: Click to place the prompt cursor, pick slash/@ suggestions, choose menu options, toggle multi-select, change /config values, scroll lists with wheel or scrollbar, expand collapsed tool results, and Cmd/Ctrl-click URLs and file paths.

feature: Text selection and copy on select
detail: Drag, double-click (word/URL) and triple-click (line) select text; copies automatically on release unless Copy on select is off in /config, then Ctrl+Shift+c copies; Shift+arrows extend selection.

feature: Scrolling shortcuts and Jump to bottom
detail: PgUp/PgDn half-screen, Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End, mouse wheel; scrolling up pauses auto-follow and shows a Jump to bottom button with new-message count; sticky header shows last scrolled-past prompt; rebindable scroll actions.

feature: Auto-scroll setting
detail: Turn off Auto-scroll in /config to keep auto-follow paused after sending a message or reaching the bottom.

feature: Scroll speed (/scroll-speed) and wheel acceleration
detail: Interactive dialog or CLAUDE_CODE_SCROLL_SPEED (up to 20) multiplies wheel distance; wheelScrollAccelerationEnabled turns off fast-spin acceleration; JetBrains terminal uses its own handling.

feature: Transcript mode with search (Ctrl+o)
detail: Ctrl+o toggles transcript mode with less-style keys: / search, n/N next/prev match, j/k, g/G, braces to jump between prompts, page keys; [ writes full conversation to native scrollback and v opens it in $EDITOR.

feature: /focus quiet view
detail: Shows only the last prompt, a one-line tool-call summary with edit diffstats, and the final response; persists across sessions and toggles off by running again.

feature: Live diff panel (/diff)
detail: In fullscreen, /diff opens a side panel showing changes accumulate while Claude works.

feature: /clear and screen redraw (Ctrl+L, Cmd+K)
detail: /clear starts a new conversation; Ctrl+L or Cmd+K redraws a garbled display while keeping the conversation and input.

feature: Disable mouse capture options
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE keeps flicker-free rendering with native selection; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS keeps wheel scrolling but disables clicks; clipboard written via pbcopy, wl-copy/xclip, PowerShell, tmux buffer or OSC 52 over SSH.

feature: Screen reader mode uses classic renderer
detail: In screen reader mode Claude Code keeps the classic renderer except for attached background sessions and refuses /tui fullscreen with an explanation.

feature: Terminal compatibility notes for fullscreen (tmux, iTerm2, ConPTY)
detail: Works in tmux (set mouse on to scroll); incompatible with iTerm2 tmux -CC; CLAUDE_CODE_ALT_SCREEN_FULL_REPAINT fixes stale text on Windows Terminal; /terminal-setup enables iTerm2 clipboard access.

feature: Background sessions and agent view always fullscreen
detail: Sessions opened from agent view or claude attach always render fullscreen regardless of tui setting.

feature: /feedback command
detail: Report fullscreen or other issues from inside Claude Code; switching back with /tui default may show an optional reason prompt.

feature: Claude apps gateway (self-hosted, in claude binary)
detail: Anthropic's own gateway built into claude: developers sign in via corporate SSO with /login, model access and managed settings enforced by IdP group, OTLP usage metrics emitted; routes to Anthropic API, Bedrock, Foundry, Google Cloud or Claude Platform on AWS.

feature: Gateway sign-in limits for CI
detail: Gateway sign-in is browser SSO with no service-token flow, so CI pipelines cannot authenticate through it and should use the provider directly; claude -p and SDK runs reuse a developer's gateway session on that machine.

feature: Third-party LLM gateway support
detail: Claude Code can route through an organization's existing LLM gateway; Anthropic does not endorse or support routing to non-Claude models. Gateway credentials bill the provider account, not the claude.ai subscription.

feature: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL alone keeps subscription billing
detail: Setting only a base URL with no gateway credential still routes through the gateway but keeps the saved claude.ai login as the active credential, so subscription limits apply.

feature: Gateway telemetry and network controls
detail: Client analytics to Anthropic turn off on Claude apps gateway sign-in; DISABLE_TELEMETRY in managed settings covers pre-sign-in; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC turns off optional streams; corporate HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY respected.

feature: Per-group availableModels allowlist on gateway
detail: Claude apps gateway can restrict which models each IdP group may choose; the developer still selects with /model within the list.

feature: GitHub Actions on Bedrock, Agent Platform or Foundry
detail: Claude Code GitHub Action can run inference through your own cloud via use_bedrock, use_vertex or use_foundry inputs, authenticating with GitHub OIDC tokens so no long-lived cloud credentials are stored.

feature: GitHub identity choices for the Action
detail: Use the official Claude GitHub App, a custom GitHub App with only Contents, Issues and Pull requests read/write, or the automatic GITHUB_TOKEN (which does not trigger other CI workflows).

feature: Cost bound for CI runs via --max-turns
detail: Add --max-turns to claude_args to cap run length and cost in GitHub Actions.

feature: Public repo trigger caution for @claude workflows
detail: On public repos any commenter can start the workflow and credential steps run before the write-access check, so add a commenter-permission verification step first.

feature: Claude Code GitHub Action (@claude mentions)
detail: Mention @claude in PR or issue comments, reviews or new issues to have Claude analyze code, implement changes and push commits, replying and updating in a comment; trigger phrase configurable.

feature: /install-github-app quick setup
detail: Guided command that installs the Claude GitHub App, selects @claude and PR review workflows, stores an API key or subscription token as a secret and opens a PR with workflow files; github.com repos only; Esc stops partway.

feature: Interactive vs automation mode
detail: No prompt input means the Action waits for the trigger phrase; a prompt input runs it on any GitHub event (including cron) with output in the run log unless told to post.

feature: Action authentication options
detail: Use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, a CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN from claude setup-token (subscription plans), or workload identity federation through a Console service account; org-wide secrets recommended with API keys since OAuth tokens tie to one person.

feature: GitHub App permission set and org rollout
detail: The shared Claude GitHub App requests a broad permission set (Actions, Checks, Contents, Issues, PRs, Workflows and more) that cannot be partially accepted; custom app covers only the Action; org-level install, secrets and reusable workflows supported.

feature: Who can trigger Action runs
detail: Requires write access on issue/PR events (allowed_non_write_users overrides) and rejects bot actors unless listed in allowed_bots to prevent loops.

feature: Run skills and plugins in the Action
detail: The prompt can invoke a repo skill (/skill-name) or a plugin skill installed via plugin_marketplaces and plugins inputs; PR review workflow posts inline comments with --comment and skips drafts, closed and trivial PRs.

feature: Scheduled runs in the Action
detail: Cron-triggered automation, e.g. a daily report, with tools granted through --allowedTools or settings permissions; GitHub runs schedules from the default branch and disables them after 60 idle days on public repos.

feature: Action inputs and claude_args
detail: Inputs include prompt, claude_args, anthropic_api_key, claude_code_oauth_token, github_token, plugin_marketplaces, plugins, settings, trigger_phrase, use_bedrock/vertex/foundry; claude_args passes --max-turns, --model, --mcp-config, --allowedTools, --debug.

feature: Action cost model and controls
detail: Runs use GitHub Actions minutes plus API tokens (or the subscription when using an OAuth token); reduce with specific requests, concise CLAUDE.md, --max-turns, timeouts and concurrency controls.

feature: Upgrade from Action beta to v1
detail: Beta workflows must change @beta to @v1, drop mode, rename direct_prompt to prompt, and move max_turns/model into claude_args; custom_instructions becomes --append-system-prompt.

feature: GitHub Enterprise Server support
detail: An Owner connects a self-hosted GHES instance once (Organization settings > Git providers, guided manifest or manual setup with CA certificate and read replicas); then cloud sessions, Code Review, Claude Security and teleport work on GHES repos.

feature: GHES limitations
detail: Contribution metrics and the GitHub MCP server do not work with GHES; /install-github-app is github.com only (set up Actions manually, use the gh CLI for GHES).

feature: Cloud sessions and teleport on GHES
detail: claude --cloud auto-detects the GHES host from the git remote and runs the session in the cloud, monitored at claude.ai/code; claude --teleport pulls a cloud session into a local checkout of the same repo.

feature: Plugin marketplaces hosted on GHES
detail: Add with a full git URL (/plugin marketplace add); extraKnownMarketplaces pre-registers them, strictKnownMarketplaces with hostPattern allowlists a host; claude.ai org-level adds sync via the GitHub App while user-level adds need each user's own GHES connection; cloud sessions unreliable.

feature: GHES network requirements and Test connection
detail: Anthropic-hosted sessions and reviews need the GHES instance reachable from Anthropic's outbound IPs; Test connection in Git providers settings runs two checks; self-hosted environment runners clone from inside the network.

feature: Per-user GHES account connection
detail: Each user must connect their own GitHub Enterprise account (via the claude.ai/code repository picker or Git providers page) for user-level marketplace adds and some cloud session access.

feature: Claude Security (public beta on Enterprise)
detail: Security scanning product at claude.ai/security, supported on GHES repositories for Enterprise plans.

feature: Claude Code GitLab CI/CD integration (beta)
detail: Add a job to .gitlab-ci.yml running claude -p to turn issues into MRs, implement features, fix bugs and respond to @claude comments; maintained by GitLab; runs on your runners with branch protection and approvals.

feature: GitLab providers and auth options
detail: Uses Claude API with a masked ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or Bedrock via AWS OIDC role, or Agent Platform via Workload Identity Federation; CI_JOB_TOKEN or a project access token with api scope for GitLab operations.

feature: GitLab mention-driven triggers
detail: A note webhook and event listener can call the pipeline trigger API with AI_FLOW_INPUT, AI_FLOW_CONTEXT and AI_FLOW_EVENT variables when a comment contains @claude; job runs with acceptEdits permission mode and allowed tools including the GitLab MCP.

feature: GitLab CI cost controls
detail: Costs are runner minutes plus API tokens; limit with --max-turns, job timeout, specific @claude requests and concurrency limits.

feature: Environment variables in shell or settings env block
detail: Variables set in a shell last for that session; the env key in user, project, local or managed settings.json applies always. Settings values replace inherited shell ones, cannot unset (use empty string), and some (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, OTel exporters) are ignored in project/local files.

feature: Env var precedence vs flags and commands
detail: /model and --model override ANTHROPIC_MODEL, while CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL overrides --effort and /effort; managed settings beat user/project env; boolean vars accept 1/true/yes/on and 0/false/no/off, but a few treat any non-empty value as on.

feature: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY overrides subscription
detail: A set API key is used instead of the Pro/Max/Ultra/Team/Enterprise login (always in -p mode; interactive mode asks once to approve); ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, ANTHROPIC_PROFILE and workload identity federation vars (ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID, ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID, ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID) offer other auth routes.

feature: Cloud provider endpoint and credential variables
detail: Variables for Bedrock (API key, base URL, Mantle, region prefix, service tier default/flex/priority), Claude Platform on AWS, Foundry (resource, base URL, API key or bearer token), Google Cloud Anthropic-managed and Agent Platform (project, location, workspace, base URL).

feature: Pin models behind aliases (ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL)
detail: Set which model ID the fable, opus, sonnet and haiku aliases resolve to, plus per-alias display name, description and supported capabilities for the /model picker; ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL sets the starting model; opusplan uses Opus in plan mode and Sonnet otherwise.

feature: Custom model entry in /model picker
detail: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION with NAME, DESCRIPTION and SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES adds a gateway-specific or non-standard model to the picker.

feature: ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL (deprecated)
detail: Old way to name the Haiku-class model for background tasks; replaced by ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL.

feature: Request headers, betas and timeouts
detail: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS and ANTHROPIC_BETAS add headers/beta flags; API_TIMEOUT_MS (default 10 min), API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT and stream watchdog timeouts tune slow networks and gateways; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS and NONSTREAMING_FALLBACK help proxies.

feature: Bash tool timeout and output limits
detail: BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS (2 min default), BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS (10 min), BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH (30000 chars, max 150000) and CLAUDE_BASH_MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR control foreground shell commands.

feature: Detailed beta tracing endpoint
detail: ENABLE_BETA_TRACING_DETAILED with BETA_TRACING_ENDPOINT sends logs and traces to an OTLP/HTTP endpoint; ignored in project and local settings.

feature: Force bundle upload for claude --cloud
detail: CCR_FORCE_BUNDLE=1 makes cloud sessions upload the local repository instead of cloning from its remote.

feature: Subprocess markers (CLAUDECODE, CLAUDE_CODE_CHILD_SESSION)
detail: Set to 1 in spawned shells, hooks, status line commands and MCP subprocesses so scripts can detect a Claude Code parent; nested interactive sessions are excluded from resume, continue and history unless forced.

feature: Subagent controls (stall timeout, auto-background, disable built-ins)
detail: CLAUDE_ASYNC_AGENT_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS (10 min default), CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS moves subagents to background after about two minutes, CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_DISABLE_BUILTIN_AGENTS and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPLORE_PLAN_AGENTS remove built-in agents.

feature: Auto-compact window and threshold
detail: CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE compacts earlier (cannot raise) and CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW sets the window in tokens (100000 or more).

feature: Screen reader mode variables
detail: CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER=1 gives flat text without borders or animation; CLAUDE_AX_STARTUP_QUIET_MS (default 3000) and CLAUDE_AX_PREPARK_MS tune timing; CLAUDE_CODE_ACCESSIBILITY keeps the native cursor for screen magnifiers.

feature: Remote Control mobile push presence file
detail: CLAUDE_CLIENT_PRESENCE_FILE lets an external screen-lock tool suppress mobile pushes while you are at the computer; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NOTIFICATION_PRESENCE_CHECK sends desktop notifications even when the terminal is focused.

feature: Memory loading controls
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD loads memory from --add-dir folders; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS stops all CLAUDE.md loading; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY turns auto memory off (0 forces on).

feature: Artifact tool env toggles
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ARTIFACT turns off the publish-as-private-page tool; CLAUDE_CODE_ARTIFACT_AUTO_OPEN=0 stops auto-opening the browser; ARTIFACT_COMMENTS and COMMENTS_AUTOREACT=0 stop Claude reading or auto-replying to artifact comments; ARTIFACT_PUBLISH_EDITS=0 splits edit and publish.

feature: mTLS and CA certificate configuration
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT, CLIENT_KEY and passphrase enable mutual TLS; CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE chooses bundled and/or system CA stores; mTLS reload on stale connection can be disabled.

feature: Auto mode classifier model and server review
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL picks the classifier model; CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0 uses client-side classification instead of server-side review of auto mode actions.

feature: IDE auto-connect override
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_CONNECT_IDE false stops, and true forces, connecting to an IDE from its integrated terminal; takes precedence over the autoConnectIde setting.

feature: Bash edit diff and checkpointing toggles
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_BASH_EDIT_DIFF records diffs of files changed by shell commands; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_CHECKPOINTING disables checkpoints so /rewind cannot restore code.

feature: Disable background tasks, agent view, cron and advisor
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS removes run_in_background and Ctrl+B; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AGENT_VIEW turns off claude agents, --bg and /background; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON turns off /loop and session tasks; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL turns off /advisor.

feature: Background session handoff and memory-pressure reaping
detail: Background sessions hand in-flight shells and subagents to the next process when the supervisor restarts (can be disabled); background shells are terminated under critical memory pressure after 30 idle minutes (can be disabled); macOS stable path option avoids repeated permission prompts.

feature: Disable 1M context window
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT removes [1m] variants from the picker and holds models to 200K, for compliance needs.

feature: Adaptive thinking and effort controls
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING falls back to a fixed budget on Opus/Sonnet 4.6 only (newer models always adaptive); CLAUDE_CODE_ALWAYS_ENABLE_EFFORT sends effort for custom model IDs; legacy Opus 4/4.1 auto-remap can be disabled.

feature: Disable bundled skills and file mentions
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS removes built-in skills and workflows; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTACHMENTS and DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS stop @ mention expansion so paths are passed as text.

feature: Claude in Chrome prompt toggle for embedding hosts
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CFC_PROMPT keeps Chrome browser tools but omits Claude Code's Chrome prompt section and /claude-in-chrome skill, for hosts supplying their own guidance.

feature: Destructive removal safeguards in auto and bypass modes
detail: Critical-path rm commands (including inline bash -c scripts and mounted drives like /Volumes) get time limits, denials or prompts; env vars can disable the dangerous-rm timeout, inline-shell check and mounted-drive prompt, but only when set in the launching environment.

feature: Disable nonessential traffic and feature flags
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC (any non-empty value) stops auto-updates, telemetry, error reporting, /feedback, release notes and PR badge checks, and disables Remote Control via feature-flag fetching; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEATURE_FLAGS does the flag part only.

feature: Session quality survey toggle
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY disables the 'How is Claude doing?' survey (also off under telemetry opt-outs); feedbackSurveyRate sets a sample rate.

feature: Git instructions removal
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS removes built-in commit/PR instructions and the git status snapshot from context.

feature: Debug logging variables
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DEBUG_LOGS_DIR sets the debug log file path and CLAUDE_CODE_DEBUG_LOG_LEVEL sets minimum level (verbose, debug, info, warn, error); enabled separately with --debug, /debug or --debug-file.

feature: Terminal and platform tweaks (Backspace, automount roots, config lock)
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_BS_AS_CTRL_BACKSPACE fixes Windows word-delete; CLAUDE_CODE_AUTOMOUNT_ROOTS skips slow automounts; CLAUDE_CODE_CONFIG_LOCK_WAIT_MS tunes ~/.claude.json lock wait for claude mcp add/remove.

feature: Removed env vars (AUTO_BACKGROUND_WORKER_CHECKIN_SECONDS, CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS)
detail: Worker check-in seconds variable removed in v2.1.283 (use CLAUDE_CODE_WORKER_CHECKIN_SCHEDULE); connect timeout variable removed in v2.1.186 and now a no-op.

feature: Bedrock stream and fallback tweaks
detail: Variables control Bedrock content-type handling behind gateways, AWS credential chain timeout (default 60s), and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MODEL_ACCESS_FALLBACK stops auto-switching to an older model when access is lost mid-session on Bedrock or Agent Platform.

feature: Official plugin marketplace auto-registration
detail: The official marketplace registers itself on first interactive launch; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_OFFICIAL_MARKETPLACE_AUTOINSTALL skips it permanently and it can be added later with claude plugin marketplace add; policy skills directory loading can be skipped for CI.

feature: Notification hooks for unanswered permission requests
detail: In Desktop and VS Code, Notification hooks fire for unanswered permission requests; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_PERMISSION_PROMPT_NOTIFY_HOOKS stops that.

feature: Refusal fallback model switch
detail: Claude Code can automatically switch models when a safety classifier flags a request (switchModelsOnFlag setting); CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK turns it off; a fallbackModel setting handles repeated overloaded (529) errors.

feature: Terminal title and session status reports
detail: Claude Code updates the terminal title from conversation context using a background small-model title request and reports session status to the terminal; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE turns these off.

feature: Thinking toggles and ultrathink keyword
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_THINKING omits the thinking parameter for gateways; MAX_THINKING_TOKENS=0 explicitly disables extended thinking; the ultrathink keyword gives one-off deep reasoning and can be disabled with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRATHINK.

feature: Ultrareview trust check bypass
detail: claude ultrareview normally refuses untrusted workspaces non-interactively; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ULTRAREVIEW_TRUST_CHECK skips it for CI folders you trust.

feature: WebFetch off switch and web search cap
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH turns off WebFetch while WebSearch stays; CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_WEB_SEARCHES_PER_SESSION caps searches (default 200).

feature: Disable workflows
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS or the disableWorkflows setting turns off dynamic workflows.

feature: Effort level via CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL
detail: Set low, medium, high, xhigh or max (model-dependent), overriding --effort and /effort; auto or unset sends no effort so the API default applies; maxEffortLevel cap still applies.

feature: Session recap (away summary)
detail: A recap shown on return to a session, toggled in /config (awaySummaryEnabled) and overridable with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY.

feature: Claude in Chrome default on/off at startup
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_CFC or claudeInChromeDefaultEnabled sets whether CLI sessions start with Chrome integration; --chrome and --no-chrome flags win; project settings cannot turn it on.

feature: Survey routing to own OpenTelemetry collector
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY_FOR_OTEL sends survey ratings only to your OTEL collector when Anthropic-bound traffic is blocked; CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY enables OTel metrics and logs.

feature: Fine-grained tool streaming
detail: Tool call inputs stream as generated (default on for Anthropic API) so long file writes do not appear to hang; CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FINE_GRAINED_TOOL_STREAMING opts out or forces on behind proxies.

feature: Gateway model discovery for /model picker
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY fills the picker from the gateway's /v1/models (3s default timeout), still filtered by the availableModels allowlist.

feature: Prompt suggestions
detail: Grayed-out predicted prompts in the input, toggled in /config (Prompt suggestions) or CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION; paused when the account is near its usage limit.

feature: /share report bundle
detail: /share sends a report and session transcript to Anthropic; CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_SHARE_BUNDLE saves it to a local archive in ~/.claude/feedback-bundles instead unless org policy disables /share.

feature: Task tracking tools (TaskCreate/Update/Get/List vs TodoWrite)
detail: Task list tools are provided by default on supported models; CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TASKS=0 uses legacy TodoWrite and CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS enables them on every model.

feature: bypassPermissions removal prompt skip
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_EVEN_MORE_DANGEROUSLY_SKIP_PERMISSIONS runs dangerous rm with no prompt in bypassPermissions mode; must be set in the launching environment.

feature: Agent teams (experimental)
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 enables agent teams, disabled by default.

feature: Code Mode start flag and org block
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_CODE_MODE=1 starts sessions in experimental Code Mode; 0 or managed settings can block it for an organization.

feature: File read, glob and search limits
detail: File reads cap at 25,000 tokens (CLAUDE_CODE_FILE_READ_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS; allow_large can exceed); Glob includes dotfiles and gitignored files by default (toggles available); Glob/Grep time out at 20s (60s on WSL).

feature: Fork subagents and forward subagent text
detail: Fork mode (Claude starts forks of the conversation) is on by default, off with CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT=0; CLAUDE_CODE_FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT emits subagent text in stream-json output.

feature: Terminal rendering compat (strikethrough, synchronized output, terminal images)
detail: Env vars force strikethrough for ~~text~~, DEC 2026 synchronized output, and kitty-protocol image drawing for mod Image elements when auto-detection fails.

feature: Full sign-in link
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_FULL_SIGN_IN_LINK prints the full claude.ai login URL instead of a short one.

feature: Windows Git Bash path and PowerShell launcher
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH points to bash.exe on Windows; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WINDOWS_SHELL_LAUNCHER runs PowerShell commands directly (background ones then stop when the session exits); a PowerShell cmd-builtin delete check on system paths can be disabled.

feature: Goal check-ins
detail: A long-running goal prompts Claude to check on background work every 30 minutes by default (CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES, 0 turns off, max one week).

feature: Request compression and hide working directory
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODIES=0 turns off gzip of API, telemetry and artifact publish bodies; CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_CWD hides the path in the startup logo for screenshares.

feature: IDE connection overrides
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_HOST_OVERRIDE sets the extension host; CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_SKIP_AUTO_INSTALL stops /ide installing the extension (VS Code, Cursor, Devin Desktop); CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_SKIP_VALID_CHECK skips lockfile validation.

feature: Idle compaction
detail: Conversations at or above 200,000 tokens (minimum 100,000) are compacted automatically when idle; on by default, off with idleCompaction false.

feature: Self-paced /loop keepalive
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE runs one extra iteration of an interactive self-paced /loop when it ends with nothing scheduled.

feature: Subagent concurrency and depth limits
detail: Up to 20 concurrent subagents and nesting depth 3 by default (CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS, CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH); total-subagents-per-session cap removed in v2.1.224.

feature: Context window, output token and retry limits
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS corrects assumed window for custom IDs; CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS caps output; CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES (default 10, max 15) with CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG for long outages; CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_TURNS caps agentic turns.

feature: MCP timing, description and environment controls
detail: Settings for MCP tool idle timeout (5 min network, 30 min stdio), auto-backgrounding long calls after 2 minutes, startup wait for non-interactive sessions, max description length (4096), and an allowlist env for stdio servers.

feature: Cross-session messaging inbox socket and token
detail: Sessions with messaging on bind a per-session inbox socket and export CLAUDE_CODE_MESSAGING_SOCKET and token to hooks and shells; messages pass through inbound controls; token required on native Windows.

feature: Non-interactive session hooks (exit delay, session state events, deferred tool resume)
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_EXIT_AFTER_STOP_DELAY auto-exits idle SDK sessions; CLAUDE_CODE_EMIT_SESSION_STATE_EVENTS adds state messages to stream-json; deferred tool calls can be skipped or dropped on -p resume.

feature: Native terminal cursor option
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_NATIVE_CURSOR shows the terminal's own cursor at the input caret so it follows terminal blink and shape settings.

feature: /init interactive setup flow
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT makes /init ask which files (CLAUDE.md, skills, hooks) to generate before exploring the codebase; otherwise /init writes a CLAUDE.md automatically.

feature: Headless OAuth token sign-in
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (from claude setup-token) or a one-time refresh token with scopes authenticates SDK and automated environments instead of /login and beats keychain credentials.

feature: OpenTelemetry export tuning
detail: Variables set content attribute max length (60 KB), exporter diagnostics to stderr, flush and shutdown timeouts, dynamic header refresh (29 min), and W3C trace context propagation through custom proxies.

feature: Package manager auto-update (Homebrew, WinGet)
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_PACKAGE_MANAGER_AUTO_UPDATE lets Claude Code run the package manager upgrade in the background for Homebrew and WinGet installs; others only show the command.

feature: Perforce-aware write protection
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE makes Edit, Write and NotebookEdit fail with a p4 edit hint on read-only synced files, preserving Perforce tracking.

feature: Plugin environment variables (dirs, cache, git, seed, HTTPS, offline, watch)
detail: Set the plugins root, load plugin dirs per session, mod hot-reload, git clone timeout (120s), prefer HTTPS for owner/repo shorthand, keep marketplace checkout offline, seed read-only plugin directories into containers, and wait for sync plugin install in -p mode.

feature: Restricted mode and safe mode
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_RESTRICTED starts in restricted mode (--restricted); CLAUDE_CODE_SAFE_MODE (--safe-mode) skips CLAUDE.md, skills, plugins, hooks, MCP, commands, agents, styles, themes, keybindings and auto memory for troubleshooting while managed policy still applies.

feature: Minimal/bare mode and shorter system prompt
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE (--bare) runs with a minimal prompt and Bash, read and edit tools only; CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT chooses the full or abbreviated system prompt per model.

feature: Resume interrupted turns and resume hints
detail: Env vars auto-continue a session that ended mid-turn (with age bound, custom continue prompt, and showing cut-off tool calls), print a custom resume command at exit, and skip writing history or transcripts for ephemeral sessions.

feature: Retry watchdog for unattended sessions
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG retries 429/529 capacity errors indefinitely (backoff up to 5 min, ~300 retries for transient errors) and can wait out a usage limit; fails at once on spend limits or exhausted credits.

feature: Prompt cache TTL choice (5m or 1h)
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL and the subagent variant select a 5-minute or 1-hour cache lifetime; 1-hour writes are billed higher; FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M overrides.

feature: Subagent default model and effort
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL sets the default model for subagents, team teammates and workflow agents (alias or full name); _FORCE forces one model; CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT sets default effort; CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_HISTORY=0 hides ended subagents in /tasks.

feature: Subprocess credential scrub and script call caps
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB strips credentials from Bash, hook and MCP subprocess environments (keeps GitHub tokens/proxy); CLAUDE_CODE_SCRIPT_CAPS limits how many times named scripts may run per session.

feature: Shell choice and wrapper (CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL, SHELL_PREFIX, PROCESS_WRAPPER)
detail: Pick bash or zsh for the Bash tool, wrap spawned commands with an audit prefix, launch Claude-started processes via a corporate launcher, and set PowerShell execution-policy behavior.

feature: Hook timing limits (SessionEnd budget, Stop block cap)
detail: SessionEnd hooks get a 1.5s budget raised to the highest per-hook timeout up to 60s; Stop and SubagentStop hooks can block a turn from ending at most 8 consecutive times by default.

feature: Claude-drafted feedback toggle
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_SEND_FEEDBACK turns Claude-drafted feedback off or on where the account has access; /feedback and feedbackDrafts setting also gate it.

feature: Cloud session and bridge session identifiers
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE and CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID are set in cloud sessions; CLAUDE_CODE_BRIDGE_SESSION_ID is set while Remote Control is connected so scripts can link back to the claude.ai/code session.

feature: Auth skip variables for gateways
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_*_AUTH variables (Bedrock, Mantle, Vertex, Foundry, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud) skip client-side auth for gateways that sign requests; AWS credential cache and startup model-access memory can be turned off.

feature: Storage location overrides
detail: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR with CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME chooses where transcripts and auto memory live per tenant; CLAUDE_CODE_STARTUP_FAILURE_RESULTS reports why startup failed in stream-json.

feature: Sync claude.ai skills into the CLI
detail: Terminal sessions signed in with claude.ai download the skills enabled on the account; CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_SKILLS forces it (and makes -p wait up to a timeout) with install and wait timeouts configurable.

feature: Syntax highlighting and tmux truecolor
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_SYNTAX_HIGHLIGHT=false disables highlight in diffs (syntaxHighlightingDisabled for code blocks); CLAUDE_CODE_TMUX_TRUECOLOR allows 24-bit color in tmux instead of the 256-color clamp.

feature: Shared task list across sessions
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID lets multiple Claude Code instances coordinate on one task list.

feature: Tool memory cap on Linux and WSL
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT (e.g. 4G) caps memory of Bash, PowerShell and Monitor commands, with options to exclude MCP/LSP processes; sandboxed Bash gets a short TMPDIR; CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR overrides the temp directory.

feature: Transcript size trimming for long non-interactive sessions
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC removes pre-compaction history from transcript files over 5 MB in -p and SDK sessions; resume restores the same conversation.

feature: Dialog deadline for remote clients
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_USER_DIALOG_TIMEOUT_MS cancels dialogs forwarded to Remote Control or SDK hosts, held cross-session message approvals and the Fable usage-credits consent prompt; overrides dialogExpiry.

feature: Fable usage-credits consent prompt
detail: A mid-session consent prompt appears for using Fable models against usage credits; a timeout bounds it in unattended sessions.

feature: Provider selection flags
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK, _MANTLE, _VERTEX, _FOUNDRY, _ANTHROPIC_AWS and _ANTHROPIC_GOOGLE_CLOUD choose the model provider.

feature: PowerShell tool
detail: Claude can run PowerShell natively; automatic on Windows without Git Bash, on by default for claude.ai and Console accounts with Git Bash, opt-in elsewhere including Linux/macOS with pwsh via CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL.

feature: Low disk and memory warnings to Claude
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_WARN_DISK_FREE_GIB and CLAUDE_CODE_WARN_MEMORY_FREE_GIB (Linux/WSL) add a system reminder when free space or memory drops below a threshold.

feature: WebFetch cache and deadline, web search refill
detail: WebFetch caches pages 15 minutes by default (adjustable) with a 5 minute download deadline; WebSearch limit refills 100 calls per hour in interactive sessions and 0 in non-interactive ones.

feature: Workflow concurrency and prompt-cache stagger
detail: A workflow runs up to 16 agents at once (1 to 256 configurable); agents sharing a prompt prefix wait up to 5s so later ones read the cache; background subagent check-in reminders are configurable.

feature: You should know suggestions mod debug
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_YOU_SHOULD_KNOW_DEBUG shows the last three checks of the You should know suggestions mod above the prompt.

feature: Multiple accounts via CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
detail: Overrides ~/.claude so separate config dirs run accounts side by side (e.g. a work alias); stores settings, history and plugins there.

feature: Subprocess environment variables Claude sets (EFFORT, SESSION_ID, PID, ENV_FILE, JOB_DIR)
detail: Bash and hook subprocesses receive effort level, session ID, Claude PID, and a persisted env file for venv activation; background sessions get a CLAUDE_JOB_DIR scratch dir that needs no write permission prompts.

feature: Remote Control session name prefix
detail: CLAUDE_REMOTE_CONTROL_SESSION_NAME_PREFIX (or --remote-control-session-name-prefix) sets the prefix of auto-generated Remote Control session names, default the hostname.

feature: Streaming idle watchdogs
detail: Event-level and byte-level watchdogs close stalled streams (min 5 minutes when set); first-byte deadline and Bedrock watchdog are configurable or can be disabled.

feature: Removed CLAUDE_SUBAGENT_BG_SHELL_MAX_MS
detail: Cap on subagent background shell runtime was removed in v2.1.260 and is now a no-op.

feature: Disable auto-updates and installation checks
detail: DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER stops background updates (manual claude update still works); DISABLE_UPDATES blocks all updates and install; DISABLE_INSTALLATION_CHECKS hides install warnings; FORCE_AUTOUPDATE_PLUGINS keeps plugin updates on.

feature: Disable auto compaction or all compaction
detail: DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT turns off automatic and idle compaction (manual /compact remains); DISABLE_COMPACT disables /compact too.

feature: Hide cost warnings, /usage-credits and /upgrade
detail: DISABLE_COST_WARNINGS hides cost messages; DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND hides /usage-credits (buy extra usage); DISABLE_UPGRADE_COMMAND hides /upgrade.

feature: Hide slash commands for managed deployments
detail: Variables hide /doctor and /checkup, /feedback (also /bug and /share), /install-github-app, /login and /logout.

feature: Telemetry and error reporting opt-outs
detail: DISABLE_TELEMETRY, DO_NOT_TRACK and DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING opt out (telemetry events exclude code, file paths and commands); some opt-outs also turn off feature-flag fetching.

feature: Prompt caching controls
detail: DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING (and per Fable, Haiku, Opus, Sonnet variants) turns caching off; ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H requests a 1-hour TTL (subscribers get it automatically on the main conversation within included usage); DISABLE_INTERLEAVED_THINKING drops the beta header.

feature: claude.ai MCP connectors in Claude Code toggle
detail: Logged-in users get their claude.ai connectors by default; ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS=false or disableClaudeAiConnectors stops fetching them.

feature: MCP tool search modes (ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH)
detail: Unset/true defers MCP tool definitions; auto switches on at 10% of context (or auto:N); false loads all tools upfront.

feature: Clickable terminal hyperlinks (OSC 8)
detail: Footer PR/MR badge and sign-in URLs are links where the terminal supports it; FORCE_HYPERLINK forces on or off.

feature: Proxy settings (HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, NO_PROXY, proxy DNS)
detail: Standard proxy variables route traffic; CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS lets the proxy resolve DNS; a bare host:port proxy value is repaired or rejected at startup.

feature: Demo mode (IS_DEMO)
detail: Hides your email and organization name from the header and /status and skips onboarding, for streaming or recording.

feature: MCP output size limits
detail: MCP tool responses capped at 25,000 tokens by default with a warning above 10,000; results over 50,000 characters are saved to a file; tools can raise limits per tool.

feature: Structured output retries with --json-schema
detail: In -p mode a response failing the JSON schema is retried up to 5 attempts (MAX_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_RETRIES) before the run fails; also applies to workflow subagent outputs.

feature: Extended thinking budget (MAX_THINKING_TOKENS)
detail: Fixed thinking budget (min 1,024, capped below max output); 0 disables thinking on the Anthropic API except on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 and Fable models, which cannot have thinking off; adaptive models ignore the number.

feature: MCP OAuth with preconfigured credentials
detail: MCP_CLIENT_SECRET and MCP_OAUTH_CALLBACK_PORT supply client secret and fixed callback port for servers needing pre-registered OAuth apps.

feature: MCP startup connection, discovery cache and client runtime
detail: MCP servers connect non-blockingly by default (batches of 20 remote, 3 local; 30s connect timeout); an optional discovery cache lets remote servers show a cached status and connect on first tool call; v1/v2 client runtime pinning and protocol negotiation env vars exist.

feature: MCP tool execution timeout
detail: MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT defaults to about 28 hours overall, with a 60s per-request limit for HTTP/SSE/connector servers unless raised; per-server timeout in .mcp.json overrides.

feature: OpenTelemetry content and attribute gates
detail: Opt-in flags include user prompts, assistant responses, tool content and details, raw API bodies (inline or to files), redacted managed settings with digest, and host name/id; metric attributes for account UUID, session ID, version, entrypoint, repository and resource attributes are individually toggleable.

feature: Skill metadata character budget
detail: SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET overrides the budget for skill descriptions shown to the Skill tool (1% of context, fallback 8,000 characters).

feature: Removed TASK_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH and TaskOutput tool
detail: Removed in v2.1.277; Claude reads background task output files with Read instead.

feature: Use system ripgrep instead of bundled
detail: USE_BUILTIN_RIPGREP=0 makes Claude Code use the system rg.

feature: Per-model Google Cloud Agent Platform region overrides
detail: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_* variables override the region per model, covering (model name) through Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5/5.1/5.2 and Haiku 4.5/5.5.

feature: Standard OpenTelemetry exporter variables
detail: OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER, OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER, OTLP endpoint, protocol, headers and export interval are supported; export-enabling variables are ignored in project and local settings.

feature: Subprocess environment scrub behavior
detail: With CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB, API keys and credential-looking names or values are removed from Bash, hook and MCP subprocesses, passwords stripped from registry URLs; GitHub tokens, proxy and git config vars stay; on Linux Bash runs in an isolated PID namespace.

feature: Features unavailable when feature-flag fetching is off
detail: Remote Control, cross-machine session messaging, /import, /skill-doctor, /restart on Pro/Max/Ultra, claude.ai skill and plugin sync, You should know mod, advisor, MCP tasks, Code Mode, other-org public artifacts, default PowerShell tool and drafted feedback need flags; fetching is skipped on telemetry opt-outs, third-party providers and Claude apps gateway.

feature: First-session flag fetch delay
detail: A flag-gated feature may be missing in the first session after install or upgrade; flags are saved for the next session, but clean CI environments or gateway-token-only auth never get them.

feature: AGENTS.md as project instructions
detail: If a repo has AGENTS.md and no CLAUDE.md, Claude reads it as project instructions; a Project instructions setting in /config chooses to read both or only CLAUDE.md. Needs v2.1.277 or later.

feature: Agent teams
detail: Several independent Claude Code sessions coordinated by a lead with a shared task list and peer messaging; each teammate has its own context and can be addressed directly. Disabled by default.

feature: Agentic loop and interrupt
detail: Claude gathers context, acts, verifies and repeats until done; the user can interrupt at any point to redirect.

feature: Publish session output as an artifact
detail: Claude Code can publish a live interactive page to a private claude.ai URL that updates in place on republish and appears in the same gallery as chat artifacts; sharing depends on plan.

feature: Auto memory
detail: Claude writes notes for itself from corrections and preferences, stored per git repo and shared across worktrees; the first 200 lines or 25 KB of MEMORY.md load at session start.

feature: Auto mode permission mode
detail: A classifier model reviews actions so most run without prompts, blocking scope escalation, untrusted infrastructure and prompt injection; explicit ask rules still prompt. Default start mode from v2.1.283 in terminal and VS Code.

feature: Bare mode (--bare)
detail: Starts without hooks, skills, commands, subagents, plugins, MCP servers, auto memory or CLAUDE.md (except --add-dir skills); suited to CI and scripts.

feature: Bundled skills
detail: Prompt-based playbooks shipped with Claude Code such as /batch, /code-review, /debug and /loop that can spawn agents and adapt to the codebase.

feature: Channels (Telegram, Discord, iMessage)
detail: MCP servers that push events into a running session and can reply back, so Claude reacts while the user is away from the terminal.

feature: Checkpoints and /rewind
detail: A restore point is made at each prompt; Esc twice or /rewind restores code, conversation or both, or summarizes from a chosen message. Bash-made file changes are not undone unless edit tools touched the file.

feature: Project .claude directory
detail: Project-scoped settings, hooks, skills, subagents, rules and auto memory live in .claude/ at repo root, with user defaults in ~/.claude/.

feature: CLAUDE.md persistent instructions
detail: Markdown instructions loaded each session from project, .claude, user or managed-policy locations; all found files are concatenated broadest to narrowest and the root file survives compaction.

feature: Cloud sessions
detail: Claude Code sessions that keep running on Anthropic-managed or self-hosted cloud infrastructure after the laptop closes; started from claude.ai/code, mobile app, Desktop Cloud mode, --cloud or cloud scheduled tasks.

feature: Custom slash commands
detail: Reusable /name instructions: built-ins like /clear, /model, /compact, plus user files in .claude/commands/ or plugin commands; skills are the recommended packaging.

feature: Compaction and /compact
detail: Conversation is auto-summarized near the context limit; /compact can run manually with a focus hint. Root CLAUDE.md and auto memory survive, chat-only instructions may not.

feature: claude.ai connectors in Claude Code
detail: MCP servers added to a claude.ai account appear in /mcp when signed in with that account; organizations can provision connectors and per-tool controls.

feature: Context window and /context
detail: Shows what fills working memory (history, files, outputs, CLAUDE.md, memory, skills); /context displays usage.

feature: Dispatch from phone to Desktop
detail: Sending a coding task from the Claude mobile app routes it to a Claude Code session in the Desktop app.

feature: Effort level
detail: Controls adaptive reasoning depth; higher means more thinking tokens, lower is faster and cheaper. Supported on Fable models, Opus 4.6+, Sonnet 4.6+ and Haiku 5.5.

feature: Extended thinking
detail: Visible step-by-step reasoning before replying, tuned by effort level or MAX_THINKING_TOKENS on fixed-budget models; shown as gray italic text in the terminal.

feature: Frontmatter configuration for skills, subagents, styles, rules
detail: YAML blocks at file top configure skills, subagents, output styles and rules, with each file type accepting its own fields.

feature: Hooks
detail: User-defined handlers fired at lifecycle points (before tool, after edit, session start) as shell command, HTTP endpoint, MCP tool, LLM prompt or subagent; configured as event, matcher, handler.

feature: Managed settings
detail: Org-wide settings enforced by IT via the admin console or OS-level files; users and projects cannot override them.

feature: MCP servers
detail: Servers giving Claude tools for Slack, Jira, databases, browsers and more, added via /mcp, claude mcp add, .mcp.json, a plugin or a claude.ai connector.

feature: MCP Tool Search
detail: Defers MCP tool schemas so only names and server instructions load at startup; full schemas are fetched on demand.

feature: Non-interactive mode (-p)
detail: Runs one prompt and exits for CI, scripts and piping; the run is saved as a resumable session unless --no-session-persistence. Formerly headless mode.

feature: Output styles
detail: A configuration that changes the instructions Claude Code gives the model to set tone, format or behavior, optionally dropping default software-engineering instructions.

feature: Permission modes
detail: Session approval baseline cycled with Shift+Tab or a selector: default (Manual), acceptEdits, plan, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions.

feature: Permission rules
detail: Allow, ask or deny entries by tool name and argument pattern, evaluated deny then ask then allow, first match wins.

feature: Plan mode (/plan)
detail: Claude researches and proposes changes without editing source, then asks approval before acting; enter with /plan or Shift+Tab.

feature: Plugins and marketplaces
detail: Installable bundles of skills, hooks, subagents and MCP servers, namespaced plugin:skill and distributed through marketplaces.

feature: Project trust dialog
detail: Accepting a directory is required before Claude Code loads its config; saved per directory except home, where trust is session-only. Untrusted folders hold back project allow rules and marketplaces.

feature: Prompt injection defenses
detail: Permission system, command injection detection and trust verification; auto mode adds a server-side probe on tool results and an action classifier.

feature: Remote Control
detail: Continue a local Claude Code session from phone or browser via claude.ai while code execution and files stay on the user's machine.

feature: Rules in .claude/rules
detail: Modular instruction files loaded with CLAUDE.md, optionally path-scoped by frontmatter so they load only when matching files are touched.

feature: Sandboxing
detail: OS-level filesystem and network isolation for the Bash tool, separate from permission rules.

feature: Sessions: resume, continue, fork
detail: Sessions tied to a directory can be resumed with claude -c, forked with --fork-session, or run in parallel; /clear starts new while old stays in /resume.

feature: Settings layers precedence
detail: Order from highest: managed policy, --settings flag, local .claude/settings.local.json, project settings, user settings; most lists merge.

feature: Skills (SKILL.md)
detail: Instruction files Claude loads when relevant or the user invokes with /skill-name; follow the Agent Skills standard with invocation control and subagent execution; successor to custom commands.

feature: Subagents
detail: Specialized assistants with own context, system prompt, tools and permissions that return a summary; built-in Explore, Plan and general-purpose.

feature: Surfaces share one engine
detail: Claude Code runs in CLI, VS Code, JetBrains, Desktop and claude.ai; local sessions read local config while cloud sessions start from a fresh clone. Slack and Chrome are integrations.

feature: System prompt flags
detail: --append-system-prompt adds to and --system-prompt replaces the system prompt; CLAUDE.md and output-style text arrive as system reminders instead.

feature: Teleport (/teleport)
detail: Pulls a cloud session into the local terminal; --cloud sends a local task to the cloud.

feature: Transcripts
detail: Sessions are stored as JSONL under ~/.claude/projects and read back on resume; a transcript viewer shows the on-screen view.

feature: Verification loop
detail: Giving Claude a runnable check (tests, build, screenshot compare) so it iterates until pass; prerequisite for /goal and unattended runs.

feature: Worktree isolation (-w)
detail: Runs Claude in a separate git worktree under .claude/worktrees/ via -w or isolation: worktree in subagent config so parallel agents edit separate copies.

feature: Renamed terms: headless, web session, custom commands, slash commands
detail: Headless is now non-interactive mode, web session is cloud session, custom commands are skills, slash commands are just commands.

feature: /goal completion condition loop
detail: Sets a condition up to 4,000 chars; after each turn a model checks it and Claude keeps working until met, judged impossible, or an unrecoverable error. One goal per session; new replaces old.

feature: /goal status and clear
detail: /goal alone shows condition, runtime, turns evaluated, token spend and latest reason; /goal clear (aliases stop, off, reset, none, cancel) removes it.

feature: Goal restored on session resume
detail: An active goal is restored on --continue, --resume and the picker with turn count, timer and token baseline reset; achieved or cleared goals are not restored.

feature: /goal in non-interactive, Desktop and Remote Control
detail: Works with claude -p (run to completion; use stream-json --verbose to see progress), in the desktop app and via Remote Control; Ctrl+C stops it.

feature: Goal evaluator verdicts
detail: A small fast model returns not yet met, met or impossible with a reason (Ctrl+O shows it); repeated no-progress turns stop the loop with a warning.

feature: Goal errors: clear, retry or pause
detail: Auth failure, full disk, exhausted credits, context overflow or unavailable model clear the goal; overloads retry up to three times then pause; rate or usage limits pause and can auto-resume.

feature: Goal check-ins for background work
detail: Evaluation is deferred while subagents or background shells run; a check-in comes after 30 minutes, backing off up to 4x, with at most three idle check-ins; CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES=0 disables them and retries.

feature: Goal evaluator model and cost
detail: Evaluator uses the small fast model (ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL changes it) and its tokens are billed in addition to main spend.

feature: /goal availability requirements
detail: Needs workspace trust like hooks and is unavailable when disableAllHooks is true or allowManagedHooksOnly is set.

feature: Sign in via Google Cloud Agent Platform (Vertex)
detail: The login prompt's 3rd-party platform option offers a wizard for ADC, service account key or env credentials, project and region; /setup-vertex reopens it and saves to user settings.

feature: Vertex region endpoints
detail: CLOUD_ML_REGION accepts global, multi-region (eu, us) or specific regions; per-model VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_* variables override for models lacking global support.

feature: Vertex credential auto-refresh (gcpAuthRefresh)
detail: A configured command runs when GCP credentials are expired, with a 5-second validity check and 3-minute timeout; X.509 Workload Identity Federation is supported.

feature: Vertex model pinning and defaults
detail: Aliases resolve to built-in defaults unless pinned via ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL; without a pin the primary model is the Opus default and billed at Opus rates; background tasks use Sonnet unless Haiku is set.

feature: Vertex startup model checks and fallback
detail: At launch Claude Code verifies model access, offers to update older pins, and falls back to earlier or Sonnet models with a notice; refusals are remembered up to a day; mid-session disablement switches model.

feature: Enforce available models allowlist
detail: With enforceAvailableModels in managed settings, startup checks use only models in availableModels (v2.1.287+); a fallback chain or CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MODEL_ACCESS_FALLBACK=1 changes switching.

feature: 1M token context on Vertex
detail: Fable, Sonnet 5+ and Opus 4.7+ use 1M context by default on Agent Platform; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT=1 keeps 200K; Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 need the [1m] variant.

feature: Prompt caching controls on Vertex
detail: Caching is on by default; DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING=1 turns it off and ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H=1 requests a 1-hour TTL at a higher write price.

feature: /logout unavailable on Vertex
detail: Because Google Cloud credentials handle auth, the /logout command is not available.

feature: MCP tool search by model generation on Vertex
detail: Tool search is on by default for Opus 4.5, Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5 and later; earlier models load tool definitions upfront; ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false disables it.

feature: /status verify provider config
detail: /status shows API provider, GCP project, region and resolved model to confirm setup.

feature: Run Claude Code non-interactively (claude -p)
detail: Pass -p with a prompt to run once and exit with code 0 on success or non-zero on failure; combines with --continue, --allowedTools and --output-format; --bg and --cloud with a task are rejected.

feature: Bare mode for scripted runs
detail: --bare skips auto-discovery of hooks, skills, commands, subagents, plugins, MCP, auto memory and CLAUDE.md, and uses API-key auth rather than subscription login; context is supplied by flags like --settings, --mcp-config, --agents, --plugin-dir. Planned to become default for -p.

feature: Load context explicitly in bare mode
detail: Flags supply system prompt additions (--append-system-prompt[-file]), settings, MCP config, custom agents and plugins (--plugin-dir, --plugin-url).

feature: Print-mode waits for background work
detail: After the final turn a -p run waits for background commands, subagents, workflows, Monitor watches and loop wakeups, with a 10-minute idle cap adjustable via CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS.

feature: SIGTERM and SIGINT handling in print mode
detail: SIGTERM exits 143, kills child processes, runs SessionEnd hooks only and leaves the turn unfinished; SIGINT or SDK interrupt() ends the turn cleanly; CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN=1 resumes it.

feature: Pipe data into Claude via stdin
detail: Non-interactive mode reads stdin (capped at 10MB) so logs or diffs can be piped in and output redirected; json output includes total_cost_usd and per-model cost estimates.

feature: Structured output formats
detail: --output-format text (default), json (result, session ID, metadata) or stream-json (newline-delimited events); --json-schema validates and returns structured_output.

feature: Stream tokens and partial messages
detail: stream-json with --verbose and --include-partial-messages emits token deltas; the last line is a result message with cost and session data.

feature: Subagent and forked-skill messages in stream
detail: Subagent messages carry parent_tool_use_id for nesting; --forward-subagent-text also forwards their text and thinking blocks at every depth.

feature: api_retry system events
detail: Before retrying a failed API call Claude Code emits an event with attempt, max_retries, delay, status and an error category such as rate_limit, overloaded or billing_error.

feature: system/init session metadata
detail: First stream event reports model, tools, MCP servers, plugins, plugin_errors, mcp_server_errors and a capabilities array so CI can fail on plugins or MCP servers that did not load.

feature: Plugin install progress events
detail: With CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGIN_INSTALL set, system/plugin_install events report started, installed, failed and completed for marketplace plugins.

feature: Pre-approve tools with --allowedTools
detail: Lists tools (and permission-rule patterns like Bash(git diff *)) that run without prompting; in Manual mode unapproved calls are denied unless a PermissionRequest hook or --permission-prompt-tool approves.

feature: Permission modes in -p runs
detail: --permission-mode accepts auto, dontAsk (deny anything that would prompt) and acceptEdits (auto-approve file edits and common filesystem commands); -p starts in Manual mode since v2.1.302 when nothing sets a mode.

feature: --permission-prompts none for unattended runs
detail: Denies anything that would prompt, tells Claude nobody can approve, removes AskUserQuestion and cancels MCP elicitations; permission_denied events are streamed. Needs v2.1.259+; permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting makes it persistent.

feature: Slash commands in -p mode
detail: User skills and custom commands work by including /name in the prompt; /model, /effort, /fast, /color, /rename, /mcp, /config key=value and /output-style take arguments; terminal-only commands like /login are unavailable.
