feature: Customize system prompt in scripts
detail: --append-system-prompt adds instructions while keeping defaults; --system-prompt replaces them and drops the git status snapshot.

feature: Continue or resume conversations in -p
detail: --continue picks up the latest conversation (opening finished background sessions on v2.1.257+); --resume takes a session ID or transcript file path and finds sessions across projects on the machine.

feature: Use Claude Code in build scripts and CI
detail: Examples show typo-linter diff piping, PR security review, commit creation and GitHub Actions / GitLab CI use via the Agent SDK.

feature: Agent SDK in CLI, Python and TypeScript
detail: The same tools, agent loop and context management as Claude Code are available as a CLI and as Python and TypeScript packages.

feature: HIPAA configuration for Claude Code local mode
detail: An Enterprise organization setting for PHI under a BAA that restricts features in Claude Code and Cowork local sessions; applies only to Enterprise sign-ins connecting directly to the Claude API.

feature: HIPAA eligible connections
detail: Bedrock, Vertex/Agent Platform, Foundry, gateways, custom base URLs, API keys, Console keys and token-only sessions are not eligible for the HIPAA configuration.

feature: HIPAA minimum app versions
detail: Requires Claude Code v2.1.285+ and Claude Desktop v2.19675.0+; older versions are rejected with an API error or an Update required dialog.

feature: Network allowlist hosts for Claude Code
detail: Admins must allow api.anthropic.com, claude.ai, claude.com, platform.claude.com, sso.claude.com, downloads.claude.ai and mcp-proxy.anthropic.com over HTTPS 443; policy is fetched at start and about hourly.

feature: Managed settings for HIPAA sign-in and retention
detail: forceLoginMethod, forceLoginOrgUUID, allowedProviders and cleanupPeriodDays enforce claude.ai sign-in to one org, block cloud providers and set uniform session-data retention; they also block API-key auth.

feature: Restrict Claude Desktop sign-in to org
detail: The Desktop policy must set forceLoginOrgUUID separately since CLI managed settings do not change the Desktop sign-in screen.

feature: HIPAA status indicators
detail: Startup notice, a HIPAA configured footer tag, /status Organization configuration line, and a title-bar label in Desktop confirm the configuration; claude doctor shows policy source.

feature: Code tab off until Owner re-enables
detail: Applying HIPAA turns the Desktop Code tab off; an Owner re-enables it with the Desktop toggle in Organization settings > Claude Code.

feature: Features disabled under HIPAA
detail: WebFetch, cloud sessions (--cloud, /teleport), Remote Control, /feedback and /bug, artifact publishing and MCP tool search are off; web search still works.

feature: Anthropic credentials stripped from child processes
detail: Under HIPAA, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN are removed from shell commands, hooks and MCP servers; cloud and GitHub credentials stay.

feature: Local session data retention and Desktop cleanup
detail: Retention sweep deletes old data after cleanupPeriodDays when Claude Code starts; with HIPAA, Desktop deletes inactive local Code sessions (starred too) while running and removes clean worktrees.

feature: claude purge to delete local data
detail: claude purge --all --yes (v2.1.288+; claude project purge earlier) deletes transcripts, auto memory, tasks, debug, file-history, history and project entries; paste-cache needs manual deletion.

feature: Offboarding does not delete local data
detail: Removing a seat or /logout deletes nothing on the device; admins must wipe the computer to remove local data.

feature: requiredMinimumVersion managed setting
detail: Makes versions v2.1.163 through v2.1.284 refuse to start below the set version; older versions ignore it.

feature: Hooks configuration and /hooks browser
detail: Hooks are defined in settings JSON and browsed with /hooks grouped by event; scopes are user, project, local, managed, plugin, skill and subagent frontmatter; disableAllHooks turns them off.

feature: Hook lifecycle events
detail: Over 30 events including SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, Stop, SubagentStart/Stop, PreCompact, ConfigChange, CwdChanged, FileChanged, WorktreeCreate, PreModelSwitch and SessionEnd.

feature: Hook handler types
detail: Handlers can be command (shell), http (POST to URL), mcp_tool, prompt (single-turn LLM check) or agent (multi-turn verifier, experimental).

feature: Hook matchers and if filter
detail: Matchers filter by tool name, session source, notification type, agent type and more; the if field adds permission-rule patterns like Bash(git *) on tool events.

feature: Hook exit codes and JSON decisions
detail: Exit 0 means no objection, exit 2 blocks with stderr feedback; JSON output can deny, ask, allow or defer a tool call, inject additionalContext or modify input; most restrictive result wins across parallel hooks.

feature: Prompt-based hooks
detail: A model evaluates a prompt and returns ok true/false with reason; on Stop it keeps Claude working, on PreToolUse it denies; continueOnBlock and impossible fields refine behavior.

feature: Agent-based hooks
detail: A subagent with tool access (60s default, up to 50 turns) verifies conditions such as passing tests before allowing Stop.

feature: HTTP hooks
detail: POST event JSON to an endpoint with env-interpolated headers limited to allowedEnvVars; 2xx body can block; onFailure block makes failures blocking.

feature: Desktop notification hook when Claude needs input
detail: A Notification hook with osascript, notify-send or PowerShell alerts the user when Claude awaits input or permission.

feature: Notification types for matchers
detail: permission_prompt, idle_prompt, auth_success, auth_storage_failure, elicitation_*, agent_needs_input, agent_completed, quota_auto_resume_fired/stale/disabled and plugin_notification can be matched individually.

feature: Auto-format after edits hook
detail: A PostToolUse hook on Edit|Write can run a formatter such as Prettier on each edited file.

feature: Block edits to protected files hook
detail: A PreToolUse script exits 2 to block Edit or Write on paths like .env or .git/, feeding the reason back to Claude.

feature: Re-inject context after compaction
detail: A SessionStart hook with compact matcher adds stdout text to context after each compaction.

feature: Audit configuration changes hook
detail: ConfigChange fires on settings or skills file changes (user, project, local, policy, skills) and can log or block them.

feature: Reload environment on directory or file change
detail: CwdChanged and FileChanged hooks write to CLAUDE_ENV_FILE so direnv or devbox variables refresh before Bash commands.

feature: Auto-approve permission prompts via hook
detail: A PermissionRequest hook can return allow, optionally with updatedPermissions setMode, e.g. for ExitPlanMode; broad matchers would approve everything.

feature: Hook timeouts and Stop block cap
detail: Defaults: 10 min for command/http/mcp_tool, 30s prompt, 60s agent, 1.5s SessionEnd budget; a Stop hook is overridden after eight consecutive blocks, adjustable via CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP.

feature: Hooks cannot loosen permissions; deny wins in every mode
detail: Hook allow does not bypass deny rules or network-path, requiresUserInteraction and org ask prompts; a hook deny blocks even in bypassPermissions.

feature: Hook debugging tools
detail: Ctrl+O transcript shows hook outcomes; claude --debug or --debug-file and /debug write logs revealing malformed JSON or misplaced fields.

feature: PreModelSwitch and PostModelSwitch hooks
detail: Run before or after a model change and can allow, deny or ask-confirm the switch, matched by model name.

feature: Hooks managed-only mode
detail: allowManagedHooksOnly in managed settings makes only managed hooks run and /hooks shows a notice.

feature: Agentic loop: gather context, act, verify
detail: Claude Code works in repeated phases of gathering context, taking action and checking results, and the user can interrupt or steer at any point.

feature: Built-in tool categories
detail: Tools cover file operations, search, shell execution, web search and fetch, and code intelligence (type errors, definitions, references) via code intelligence plugins.

feature: Execution environments: Local, Cloud, Remote Control
detail: Code can run on the user's machine, on Anthropic-managed or self-hosted cloud VMs, or on the user's machine while driven from a browser.

feature: Interfaces: terminal, desktop, IDE, web, Slack, CI
detail: The same agent loop is reachable from the terminal, desktop app, IDE extensions, claude.ai/code, Remote Control, Slack and CI/CD pipelines.

feature: Project, terminal and git state access
detail: Claude can read the project directory, run any terminal command, and see the current branch, uncommitted changes and recent commits.

feature: Sessions saved locally as JSONL
detail: Every message, tool use and result is stored in plaintext files under ~/.claude/projects, enabling rewind, resume and fork.

feature: Resume a session (--continue, --resume)
detail: Reopens a past session under the same session ID and appends to it; sessions are tied to the working directory.

feature: Fork a session (--fork-session, /branch)
detail: Copies conversation history into a new session ID and leaves the original unchanged.

feature: Session picker shows current worktree sessions
detail: The /resume picker lists the current worktree's sessions by default, with shortcuts to widen to other worktrees or projects.

feature: Parallel sessions with git worktrees
detail: Separate worktree directories let several Claude sessions run on different branches at once.

feature: Conversation persists across branch switches
detail: Switching git branches changes the files Claude sees but keeps the conversation history.

feature: Switch model with /model or --model
detail: Sonnet is suggested for most coding and Opus for harder architectural reasoning; the model can be changed mid-session or at launch.

feature: Context window with automatic compaction
detail: When context nears its limit, the conversation is summarized automatically; early instructions can be lost, so persistent rules belong in CLAUDE.md.

feature: Compact Instructions section and /compact focus
detail: A Compact Instructions section in CLAUDE.md or a focus argument to /compact steers what the summary preserves.

feature: Auto-compaction thrash guard
detail: If one huge output refills context right after each summary, auto-compaction stops after a few tries and shows an error instead of looping.

feature: /context shows context usage
detail: Displays what is occupying the context window.

feature: MCP tool definitions deferred by default
detail: Tool names and server instructions use context until a tool is called, with definitions loaded on demand through tool search.

feature: Skills load on demand
detail: Only skill descriptions are seen at start; full content loads when used. disable-model-invocation or skillOverrides keeps descriptions out of context.

feature: Subagents with their own context
detail: Subagents run in a fresh context window and return a summary; a fork subagent starts with a copy of the conversation.

feature: CLAUDE.md project instructions
detail: A markdown file of project conventions loaded every session; an AGENTS.md can be read in its place.

feature: Auto memory (MEMORY.md)
detail: Claude saves learnings such as preferences across sessions; the first 200 lines or 25KB of MEMORY.md load at session start.

feature: System-reminder context added by Claude Code
detail: Claude Code injects CLAUDE.md, output style instructions, changed-file notes and commit/PR attribution lines on its own.

feature: attribution and includeGitInstructions settings
detail: attribution edits or removes commit and PR attribution lines; includeGitInstructions=false removes built-in git instructions.

feature: Checkpoints: rewind file edits with Esc Esc
detail: Files are snapshotted before edits; double Esc or asking Claude undoes them. Checkpoints skip remote actions and symlinked or hard-linked files.

feature: Permission modes cycled with Shift+Tab
detail: Modes: Auto (classifier approves safe actions), Manual (ask before edits and commands), Accept edits, and Plan (propose without editing).

feature: Auto mode default start mode
detail: From v2.1.283 Auto is the default starting mode in terminal and VS Code; earlier versions defaulted to it only on Pro, Max, Ultra and Team.

feature: Allowlist commands in .claude/settings.json
detail: Trusted commands such as npm test can be pre-approved; settings scope from organization policy down to personal.

feature: /init generates a starter CLAUDE.md
detail: Built-in command that scaffolds project instructions.

feature: /doctor setup checkup
detail: Diagnoses installation and configuration problems and can fix them.

feature: Interrupt with Esc or queue a correction with Enter
detail: Esc cancels the running tool call; typing and pressing Enter queues a steering message read after current tool calls finish.

feature: JetBrains plugin supported IDEs
detail: Plugin works with IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, Android Studio, WebStorm, PhpStorm and GoLand.

feature: Quick launch shortcut in JetBrains
detail: Cmd+Esc (Mac) or Ctrl+Esc opens Claude Code from the editor, or use the UI button.

feature: IDE diff viewer for edits
detail: Changes open in the IDE's native diff viewer; the Diff tool setting in /config switches between auto and terminal.

feature: IDE selection and active-tab context sharing
detail: Current selection and open file path are sent with each prompt; Read deny rules block this for matching files; transcript shows a Selected N lines notice.

feature: File reference shortcut in JetBrains
detail: Cmd+Option+K (Mac) or Alt+Ctrl+K inserts references like @src/auth.ts#L1-99.

feature: IDE diagnostics sharing via getDiagnostics
detail: Claude can read the IDE's lint and syntax inspections by calling the getDiagnostics tool; it does not poll on its own after edits.

feature: Install JetBrains plugin plus CLI
detail: The plugin runs the claude command in the integrated terminal and does not bundle the CLI; installed from JetBrains Marketplace and needs an IDE restart.

feature: Plan access for JetBrains
detail: Works with any paid Claude subscription (Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise) or a Console account; no API key required.

feature: /ide connects an external terminal to the IDE
detail: Running /ide in an external terminal attaches Claude Code to the open JetBrains project and confirms with a Connected message.

feature: JetBrains plugin settings
detail: Settings under Tools > Claude Code [Beta]: custom Claude command, suppress not-found notice, Option+Enter for newlines (macOS), and automatic plugin updates.

feature: Custom Claude command incl. WSL form
detail: Plugin can run a custom command such as a full path, npx, or wsl -d <distro> -- bash -lic claude.

feature: Option+Enter multi-line prompts in JetBrains (macOS)
detail: Optional toggle making Option+Enter insert newlines; needs a terminal restart.

feature: Fix ESC not interrupting in JetBrains terminal
detail: Disable Move focus to the editor with Escape or remove the Switch focus to Editor shortcut so ESC can interrupt Claude.

feature: JetBrains Remote Development support
detail: The plugin must be installed on the remote host, not the local client.

feature: WSL2 connectivity fixes
detail: For No available IDEs detected on WSL2, add a Windows Firewall rule for the WSL subnet or switch WSL2 to mirrored networking (Windows 11 22H2+).

feature: Accept connections from all network interfaces
detail: Optional plugin setting that exposes the unencrypted local IDE server port to the LAN; default is loopback only; token still required.

feature: Built-in ide MCP server
detail: Plugin runs a local authenticated WebSocket MCP server with a per-start token in ~/.claude/ide lock file; only getDiagnostics is visible to the model.

feature: acceptEdits risk warning in JetBrains
detail: Edits in acceptEdits or auto mode can alter IDE config files that auto-execute; Manual mode for edits is recommended.

feature: Ctrl+C interrupt or clear input
detail: Interrupts a running operation; with nothing running first press clears the prompt, second exits.

feature: Bring back a cleared draft with Up
detail: Up restores a draft cleared with Ctrl+C; the 10 most recent cleared drafts (with pastes and images) are kept per session.

feature: Ctrl+X Ctrl+K stops background subagents
detail: Press twice within 3 seconds to stop all background subagents and disable artifact auto-replies for the session.

feature: Ctrl+D exits session
detail: First press shows a hint, second within 800ms exits; with text in the prompt it deletes the next character.

feature: Edit prompt in external editor (Ctrl+G)
detail: Opens the prompt in the default text editor; optional Show last response in external editor setting prepends Claude's reply as commented context.

feature: Ctrl+L redraw screen
detail: Forces a full terminal redraw without losing input or history.

feature: Ctrl+O transcript viewer
detail: Shows detailed tool usage with timestamps and models, and expands collapsed lines such as MCP calls and messages from other sessions.

feature: Ctrl+R reverse history search
detail: Searches earlier prompts interactively; fullscreen mode shows a dialog with preview and Ctrl+S to switch scope between session, project and all projects.

feature: Paste image from clipboard
detail: Ctrl+V, Cmd+V (iTerm2) or Alt+V (Windows/WSL) inserts an [Image #N] chip that can be referenced in the prompt.

feature: Ctrl+B backgrounds running tasks
detail: Moves a running Bash command or agent to the background; tmux users press it twice.

feature: Ctrl+T toggles task checklist
detail: Shows or hides Claude's to-do checklist; distinct from /tasks which lists shells and subagents.

feature: Ctrl+S stash and restore prompt
detail: Stashes the current input (including pastes, cursor and shell mode) and restores it on an empty prompt.

feature: Ctrl+Z suspend (Unix)
detail: Suspends Claude Code to the shell; fg resumes.

feature: Tab accepts suggestion or adds permission comment
detail: Tab accepts autocomplete; on permission prompts it opens a comment field on the focused Yes or No option.

feature: Up/Down history navigation
detail: Arrows move the cursor in multi-line input, then navigate command history; Up with queued messages takes them back.

feature: Esc interrupts or closes dialog
detail: Stops the current response while keeping work done, closes dialogs, deselects footer items, and declines a permission prompt.

feature: Esc Esc clears draft or opens rewind menu
detail: Double Esc clears a typed draft (saved to history); on empty input it opens the rewind menu to restore code and conversation.

feature: Ctrl+Enter sends queued messages now
detail: Sends queued messages and draft immediately; Ctrl+X Ctrl+S works in any terminal. Needs v2.1.275+.

feature: Shift+Tab cycles permission modes
detail: Cycles default (Manual), acceptEdits, plan, then bypassPermissions and auto where available; also approves plans and allows for the session on prompts.

feature: Option/Alt+P switches model
detail: Changes model without clearing the prompt.

feature: Option/Alt+T toggles extended thinking
detail: No effect on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5 or Fable models, which always think.

feature: Option/Alt+O toggles fast mode
detail: Turns fast mode on or off.

feature: Ctrl+A / Ctrl+E line start and end
detail: Move to start or end of the current logical line.

feature: Ctrl+K delete to end of line
detail: Deletes and stores text for pasting.

feature: Ctrl+U delete to line start
detail: Stores deleted text; repeat to clear across lines; Cmd+Backspace maps to it on macOS terminals.

feature: Ctrl+W delete back to whitespace
detail: Removes a whole path or flag in one press.

feature: Ctrl+Y and Alt+Y yank and cycle
detail: Pastes last deleted text and cycles earlier deletions.

feature: Alt+B, Alt+F, Alt+D word motions
detail: Word-wise move and delete treating punctuation as separators; needs Option as Meta on macOS.

feature: Ctrl+_ undo last input edit
detail: Restores previous input text and cursor.

feature: Word boundary behavior in editing shortcuts
detail: Alt-word shortcuts split on punctuation while Ctrl+W deletes to whitespace; CJK text moves one word at a time (v2.1.261+).

feature: Syntax highlighting toggle in /theme picker
detail: Ctrl+T inside the /theme picker turns code-block syntax coloring on or off.

feature: Multi-line input methods
detail: Backslash+Enter, Option+Enter, native Shift+Enter in iTerm2/WezTerm/Ghostty/Kitty/Warp/Windows Terminal 1.25+, Ctrl+J, or paste directly.

feature: Quick prefixes: / ! @ : ?
detail: Slash opens commands and skills, ! shell mode, @ file path mention (and other live sessions), colon emoji shortcodes, ? on empty input shows shortcut help.

feature: @ mentions suggest other live sessions
detail: With cross-session messaging, typing letters after @ also suggests other local sessions to message (v2.1.232+).

feature: Transcript viewer shortcuts
detail: In transcript view: ? help, { } jump between prompts, Ctrl+E show all (classic only), [ write to scrollback, v open in editor, q/Esc/Ctrl+C exit.

feature: Hold or tap Space for voice dictation
detail: Hold Space to record or use /voice tap for tap-to-toggle; requires voice dictation enabled and key is rebindable.

feature: Slash command menu with filtering
detail: Typing / lists built-in commands, skills, plugin and MCP commands; some depend on platform or plan and some are hidden; fullscreen supports mouse hover and click.

feature: Mid-prompt command completion
detail: Typing / after a space completes command names inside a prompt with Tab; plugin skills match on bare names.

feature: Vim editor mode
detail: Enable via /config Editor mode: INSERT/NORMAL/VISUAL with i,I,a,A,o,O,v,V entry keys, Esc or Ctrl+[ to normal.

feature: Vim navigation motions
detail: h j k l, w e b, 0 $ ^, gg G, f/F/t/T with ; and , repeat, % bracket jump (v2.1.301+), and / for history search.

feature: Vim editing operators and text objects
detail: x, r, dd, D, dw/de/db, df/dt, dj/dk, dgg/dG, cc, C, cw, s, S, yy, p, P, >>, <<, J, u, . plus iw/aw, quotes, brackets text objects.

feature: Vim visual mode
detail: Character-wise v and line-wise V selection with d, y, c, p, r, ~ u U, > <, J, o; block-wise Ctrl+V unsupported.

feature: vimInsertModeRemaps (e.g. jj to Escape)
detail: Maps a two-key INSERT sequence to Escape; honored only in user settings, --settings and managed settings, not project files.

feature: Cancel a question in vim mode
detail: Press Esc twice while typing in the Other row of an AskUserQuestion prompt, or bind a one-key cancel.

feature: Per-directory command history
detail: Up-arrow recall is stored per working directory and reaches past sessions; /clear starts a new session but keeps prior history; duplicate consecutive prompts collapse.

feature: Ctrl+R finds text inside pasted content
detail: Searching a word from a long pasted block finds the earlier prompt (v2.1.314+).

feature: Background Bash commands
detail: Commands can run asynchronously with task IDs and file output; timeouts move commands to background instead of killing; output over 5GB is terminated.

feature: Background task cleanup and memory-pressure reaping
detail: Tasks end with the session; on macOS/Linux idle sessions under critical memory pressure stop background tasks (disable with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP).

feature: Disable background commands env var
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS=1 or bare mode removes Ctrl+B and other background features.

feature: Shell mode with ! prefix
detail: Runs a command directly, adds output to context and lets Claude respond; supports Tab history and path autocomplete, Ctrl+B backgrounding, and exits with Esc/Backspace/Ctrl+U.

feature: Shell-mode commands run outside the sandbox
detail: Commands typed with ! are not sandboxed even when sandboxing is on, except in strict sandbox sessions.

feature: respondToBashCommands setting
detail: Set false so ! command output joins context without Claude auto-responding.

feature: Queue messages while Claude works
detail: Messages typed during a turn are queued and shown gray until handled; messages arrive after current tool calls, commands run after the turn ends.

feature: Take back queued messages with Up
detail: Up from the first line pulls queued messages into the input box for editing; queued shell commands only come back on an empty box.

feature: Background a session with queued messages
detail: Pressing Left to background the session carries queued messages along; commands and IDE-selection messages block it with a notice.

feature: /model, /effort, /fast apply immediately
detail: These commands run during a turn: model switches on the next request, effort on the next message, fast mode from the next turn.

feature: Prompt suggestions
detail: After responses Claude proposes a next prompt; Tab or Right accepts. Uses a small cached background request counted against plan usage.

feature: Turn off prompt suggestions
detail: Off via /config toggle, promptSuggestionEnabled=false, or CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION=false; admins can disable via managed settings.

feature: When prompt suggestions are skipped
detail: Skipped for cold cache, errors, plan mode, near usage limit, non-flag sessions and agent-team teammates; -p needs --prompt-suggestions.

feature: You should know suggestions mod
detail: Optional built-in mod (off by default, v2.1.287+) where a side agent surfaces one missed tradeoff; answers: Learn more, Knew this already, Dismiss; costs usage.

feature: Emoji shortcodes
detail: Typing :name: inserts an emoji and :he opens suggestions; disable with emojiCompletionEnabled=false.

feature: Spell check in prompt input
detail: Opt-in (v2.1.235+) underlining via aspell, hunspell or ispell with enabled, checker, language and color options; skips code-like text and CJK.

feature: Invisible Unicode characters stripped from prompts
detail: Tag characters, bidi controls and zero-width spaces are removed on Enter, with a notice, to block hidden injected instructions.

feature: /diff reviews working tree changes
detail: Opens a diff panel (fullscreen) or dialog (classic) over uncommitted and Claude-made edits, with per-turn T1/T2 views.

feature: Diff panel details
detail: Needs fullscreen, git, 110+ columns, v2.1.287+; ask button attaches a file's diff, Ctrl+X B cycles comparison base, auto-opens at 144+ columns.

feature: Diff dialog keys
detail: Up/Down select, Enter open, Esc back, Tab to source picker or ask button; compares against HEAD or the last chosen base.

feature: /btw side questions
detail: Ask a no-tools question answered from current context without entering history; overlay keys: c copy, f fork to subagent, x clear, Shift+arrows browse earlier.

feature: /btw in VS Code panel and about subagents
detail: VS Code shows a persistent panel for follow-ups (v2.1.227+); from an open subagent transcript /btw answers from that transcript (v2.1.314+).

feature: Task list (Ctrl+T) and shared lists
detail: Claude's checklist shows up to five items, persists across compaction, and CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID shares a list across sessions; default only on certain models.

feature: Session recap and /recap
detail: A one-line recap appears after 3+ minutes away; /recap generates on demand; capped at 400 characters; toggle Session recap in /config.

feature: Auto-continue after usage limit reset
detail: On claude.ai subscriptions Claude waits and resumes the task at reset (v2.1.234+); stops after three continuations; /rate-limit-options manages it.

feature: Usage-limit wait cancel and conditions
detail: Esc or Ctrl+C cancels; wait is not auto-started for resets over 24 hours, Remote Control, teammates, API/cloud billing; manual start via menu.

feature: autoContinueAtUsageLimit setting
detail: Continue automatically at usage limit toggle in /config or user settings; /config key=value form can only turn it off.

feature: /usage-credits and /upgrade during wait
detail: Adding credits, upgrading or switching model during a wait triggers an immediate availability check.

feature: PR review status badge
detail: Footer shows a clickable PR link coloured green approved, yellow pending, red changes requested, gray draft; needs GitHub token or gh login.

feature: GitLab merge request badge
detail: Footer MR !N badge for GitLab merge requests (v2.1.234+) needs glab authenticated; green mergeable, yellow open, gray draft.

feature: Clickable owner/repo#123 issue links
detail: Terminal hyperlinks for issue references on GitHub, GitLab; none for Bitbucket, Codeberg, Gitea; FORCE_HYPERLINK toggles.

feature: Hooks: user-defined automation at lifecycle points
detail: Hooks run shell commands, HTTP calls, MCP tools, LLM prompts or subagents at lifecycle events, in terminal, IDE, desktop and cloud sessions.

feature: Five hook handler types
detail: command, http, mcp_tool, prompt and agent handlers; agent hooks are experimental.

feature: Hook event catalog
detail: About 30 events: SessionStart/End, Setup, UserPromptSubmit/Expansion, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest/Denied, PostToolUse/Failure/Batch, Notification, Stop/StopFailure, Subagent*, Task*, compaction, model switch, worktree, file and config events.

feature: Hook locations and scope
detail: User, project, local, managed policy, plugin hooks.json, skill frontmatter and subagent frontmatter, merged across levels.

feature: allowManagedHooksOnly
detail: Admin setting blocking user, project, local and plugin hooks (except force-enabled plugins) and narrowing statusLine and fileSuggestion to managed settings.

feature: HTTP hook allowlists
detail: allowedHttpHookUrls and httpHookAllowedEnvVars restrict which URLs hooks can call and which env vars go in headers.

feature: Hook matcher patterns
detail: Matchers are exact names, pipe/comma lists, or JS regex, filtering by tool name, session source, notification type, agent type, etc.

feature: MCP tool matching in hooks
detail: MCP tools match as mcp__server__tool; plugin servers use scoped names; .* is required to match a whole server.

feature: Monitor command matching
detail: Bash matchers also run on Monitor tool commands (v2.1.314+) but allow and updatedInput apply only with a Monitor-inclusive matcher.

feature: if field filtering by permission rule
detail: Per-handler if uses permission-rule syntax (e.g. Bash(git *), Edit(*.ts)) so the process spawns only on matching tool calls.

feature: Command hook exec form vs shell form
detail: Setting args spawns the executable directly without a shell; omitting it uses sh, Git Bash or PowerShell.

feature: Hook timeouts and defaults
detail: Defaults 600s for command/http/mcp_tool, 30s prompt, 60s agent, lower on UserPromptSubmit and model-switch events, 10s on MessageDisplay.

feature: Async hooks (async, asyncRewake)
detail: Background command hooks that cannot block; results arrive next turn, and asyncRewake exit 2 wakes Claude immediately.

feature: Hook shell option
detail: shell: bash or powershell chooses the interpreter; PowerShell is default on Windows without Git Bash.

feature: onFailure block or continue
detail: Lets a failing, timing-out or invalid hook block the action (v2.1.295+; mcp_tool v2.1.328+); otherwise failures are non-blocking.

feature: once field for skill hooks
detail: Removes a skill-frontmatter hook after its first successful run.

feature: statusMessage spinner text
detail: Custom spinner message while a hook runs.

feature: Path placeholders for hooks
detail: CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA resolve scripts independent of working directory; project dir stays put in worktrees.

feature: Hooks in skills and subagents frontmatter
detail: Frontmatter hooks live only while the skill or subagent is active; skill sources capped at 1,024 hooks and 16,384 matcher characters.

feature: strictPluginOnlyCustomization for hooks
detail: Admin lock restricting hooks to plugins and managed settings; skills outside plugins lose frontmatter hooks.

feature: /hooks read-only menu
detail: Browse configured hooks, their source and full command, and all events.

feature: disableAllHooks setting
detail: Turns off all non-managed hooks; precedence follows settings levels; managed hooks only disabled at managed level.

feature: Hook input JSON common fields
detail: session_id, prompt_id, transcript_path, cwd, scratchpad_dir, permission_mode, effort, agent_id/agent_type, hook_event_name.

feature: Exit code semantics
detail: 0 success, 2 blocking error (stderr as reason) on blockable events, other codes non-blocking; per-event table of what exit 2 does.

feature: JSON output fields
detail: continue, stopReason, systemMessage, terminalSequence, plus decision/reason and hookSpecificOutput; additionalContext capped at 10,000 characters.

feature: terminalSequence desktop notifications from hooks
detail: Hooks can emit allowlisted OSC and BEL sequences for notifications, titles and progress; tmux needs allow-passthrough.

feature: additionalContext injection
detail: Hooks add facts to Claude's context as system reminders, delivered at event-specific points.

feature: Decision control patterns per event
detail: Top-level decision block, PreToolUse permissionDecision allow/deny/ask/defer, PermissionRequest behavior, MessageDisplay displayContent, context-only events.

feature: SessionStart hook
detail: Runs on startup, resume, clear, compact and fork; can add context, initialUserMessage, sessionTitle, watchPaths and reloadSkills.

feature: SessionStart resume cost fields
detail: Resumed sessions report seconds since last response, context tokens, cache expiry and estimated cache write cost (v2.1.251+).

feature: CLAUDE_ENV_FILE persists environment variables
detail: SessionStart, Setup, CwdChanged and FileChanged hooks can write exports used by later shell commands; PowerShell accepts only plain assignments.

feature: Setup hook for init and maintenance
detail: Fires only with --init-only or --init/--maintenance in -p mode for CI and scripts.

feature: InstructionsLoaded hook
detail: Async observability event when CLAUDE.md or rules files load, with load reason and parent or trigger path.

feature: UserPromptSubmit hook
detail: Validate, block or add context to a prompt; also fires for scheduled tasks, subagent reports and cross-session messages; can set sessionTitle.

feature: suppressOriginalPrompt
detail: Leaves the blocked prompt text out of the block message; prompt may still be stored locally.

feature: UserPromptExpansion hook
detail: Intercepts typed slash commands and MCP prompts before expansion to block or add context.

feature: MessageDisplay hook
detail: Rewrites assistant text on screen as it streams (display only); transcript and Claude keep the original.

feature: PreToolUse hook and tool input schemas
detail: Fires before every tool call for Bash, PowerShell, Write, Edit, Read, Glob, Grep, WebFetch, WebSearch, Agent, AskUserQuestion, ExitPlanMode and MCP tools; file paths arrive absolute.

feature: PreToolUse updatedInput
detail: A hook can rewrite tool arguments; in auto mode a changed call can be re-reviewed by the classifier.

feature: Defer a tool call for later (-p mode)
detail: permissionDecision defer pauses a headless run with stop_reason tool_deferred so an app can collect input and resume.

feature: Answer AskUserQuestion via hook
detail: A PreToolUse hook can supply answers with allow plus updatedInput for headless runs.

feature: bashEditDiff in PostToolUse
detail: Bash edits to git repos can be reported as changed files and diffs (v2.1.269+, best effort, public beta).

feature: PermissionRequest hook
detail: Allow or deny on the user's behalf, modify input or apply updatedPermissions (rules, mode, directories) to session or settings files.

feature: Permission update entries
detail: addRules, replaceRules, removeRules, setMode, addDirectories, removeDirectories with session, local, project or user destinations.

feature: PostToolUse hook and updatedToolOutput
detail: Runs after success; can add context or replace the tool output Claude sees; managed hooks also run after some failures.

feature: classifierContext for auto mode
detail: PostToolUse hooks can annotate results for the auto mode classifier (v2.1.236+), capped at 2,000 characters.

feature: PostToolUseFailure hook
detail: Fires on execution failures with error text; can add context but not rewrite output.

feature: PostToolBatch hook
detail: Runs once after a parallel tool batch resolves and can inject context or stop the loop.

feature: PermissionDenied hook
detail: Fires on auto mode denials; retry:true tells the model it may retry unless the classifier gave no verdict.

feature: Notification hook types
detail: Types: permission_prompt, idle_prompt, auth_success, auth_storage_failure, elicitation_*, agent_needs_input, agent_completed, quota_auto_resume_*, plugin_notification.

feature: Notification timing
detail: permission_prompt after ~6 seconds idle, idle_prompt ~60 seconds after a response; desktop/VS Code hosts time permission prompts differently.

feature: SubagentStart and SubagentStop hooks
detail: Fire when subagents begin or finish; Start can inject context; Stop can keep the subagent running; plugin agents use scoped names.

feature: SubagentHandback report delivery
detail: In auto mode (v2.1.271+) subagents deliver reports through SubagentHandback, readable from tool_input.message.

feature: TaskCreated and TaskCompleted hooks
detail: Enforce naming or completion criteria; exit 2 cancels creation or keeps the task open.

feature: Stop hook and continuation cap
detail: Runs when Claude finishes; block makes it continue; capped at 8 consecutive continuations (CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP); input lists background tasks and session crons.

feature: /goal as a built-in Stop hook
detail: A shortcut for a session-scoped prompt-based Stop hook keeping Claude working until a condition holds.

feature: StopFailure hook
detail: Fires on API-error turn endings with error types such as rate_limit, billing_error, server_error; output ignored apart from terminalSequence.

feature: TeammateIdle hook
detail: Agent-team quality gate; exit 2 or block keeps the teammate working, continue:false lets it idle.

feature: ConfigChange hook
detail: Audit or block changes to settings and skill files (except policy settings).

feature: CwdChanged hook
detail: Reacts to working-directory changes (e.g. direnv) and can set watchPaths.

feature: DirectoryAdded hook
detail: Runs after /add-dir or SDK register_repo_root to prepare a new repo; does not fire for --add-dir.

feature: FileChanged hook
detail: Filesystem-watcher event on named files with add/change/unlink events and dynamic watchPaths.

feature: WorktreeCreate and WorktreeRemove hooks
detail: Replace git worktree creation (e.g. SVN, Perforce) by returning a path, with paired cleanup hook.

feature: PreCompact and PostCompact hooks
detail: PreCompact can block compaction or add summary instructions via stdout; PostCompact receives the summary.

feature: PreModelSwitch hook
detail: Can block or ask before /model, pickers, /config or fast-mode switches, with cache-warm cost estimate (v2.1.251+).

feature: PostModelSwitch hook
detail: Adds model-specific guidance after any model change, including auto fallback and resume.

feature: SessionEnd hook
detail: Cleanup hook on clear, resume, logout, exit; default 1.5s budget raisable to 60s with CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS.

feature: Elicitation and ElicitationResult hooks
detail: Answer, decline or modify MCP server input requests programmatically, skipping or editing the dialog.

feature: Prompt-based hooks
detail: An LLM evaluates a condition and returns ok/reason; supports continueOnBlock and impossible fields on certain events.

feature: Agent-based hooks
detail: A subagent with Read/Grep/Glob up to 50 turns verifies conditions before allowing an action; experimental.

feature: Hook workspace trust
detail: Settings hooks wait for the workspace trust dialog in interactive mode, but -p and SDK sessions treat the folder as trusted.

feature: Windows PowerShell hooks
detail: shell: powershell uses pwsh or Windows PowerShell; env placeholders are rewritten for PowerShell.

feature: Debug hooks with --debug
detail: Hook execution and timing are logged to ~/.claude/debug/<session>.txt or --debug-file.

feature: Block @-file mentions bypassing hooks
detail: @ referenced files skip PreToolUse; use Read deny rules or CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_MENTIONS=1 (v2.1.299+) to force tool reads.

feature: PreToolUse ask labels hook source
detail: Ask prompts from hooks show a [settings], [plugin:name] or [skill] source label.

feature: Custom keybindings file via /keybindings
detail: The /keybindings command creates or opens ~/.claude/keybindings.json, an object holding an array of binding blocks, each tied to a context; edits are picked up live without restart.

feature: Keybindings file optional schema and docs fields
detail: The file may carry a JSON Schema URL for editor autocompletion and a docs URL alongside the bindings array.

feature: Keybinding contexts (about 28 scopes)
detail: Bindings are scoped to contexts such as Global, Chat, Autocomplete, Settings, Confirmation, Tabs, Help, Transcript, HistorySearch, Task, ThemePicker, Attachments, Footer, DiffDialog, ModelPicker, EffortSlider, Select, Plugin, Agents, Scroll and mod pane contexts.

feature: Keybinding action naming and command:<name> binding
detail: Actions use namespace:action names; command:<name> binds a key to run any slash command, e.g. a key that runs /compact.

feature: Interrupt current operation (Ctrl+C)
detail: Global action app:interrupt cancels the running operation; Ctrl+C is reserved and cannot be rebound.

feature: Exit Claude Code (Ctrl+D twice)
detail: Pressing Ctrl+D twice within 800 ms exits; reserved key.

feature: Force terminal redraw action
detail: app:redraw, unbound by default, forces a full terminal redraw.

feature: Toggle to-do checklist visibility (Ctrl+T)
detail: Shows or hides Claude's task checklist; distinct from the /tasks background-task view.

feature: Toggle verbose transcript (Ctrl+O)
detail: Switches the verbose transcript view on or off.

feature: Prompt history search (Ctrl+R)
detail: Opens history search; Up and Down step through earlier prompts. In fullscreen rendering it opens a dialog and Ctrl+S cycles scope between session, project and everywhere.

feature: Cancel current input (Escape)
detail: chat:cancel clears or cancels what you are typing.

feature: Redraw screen preserving input (Ctrl+L, Cmd+K)
detail: chat:clearInput and chat:clearScreen force a full redraw while keeping the conversation and draft.

feature: Stop all background subagents (Ctrl+X Ctrl+K)
detail: Pressed twice within 3 seconds, stops every background subagent in the session and turns off artifact auto-replies for the rest of it.

feature: Cycle permission modes (Shift+Tab)
detail: chat:cycleMode rotates through permission modes; on Windows without VT mode it defaults to Meta+M.

feature: Open model picker (Meta+P)
detail: Shortcut opens the model picker from the prompt.

feature: Toggle fast mode (Meta+O)
detail: Shortcut turns fast mode on or off.

feature: Toggle extended thinking (Meta+T)
detail: Shortcut toggles extended thinking for the session.

feature: Submit message (Enter) and insert newline (Ctrl+J)
detail: Enter submits; Ctrl+J inserts a newline without submitting.

feature: Queue message while Claude works (Ctrl+X Enter)
detail: chat:queueSubmit sends a message marked to wait its turn so it never interrupts the running turn, even with an autocomplete suggestion highlighted. Needs v2.1.247+.

feature: Send queued messages now (Ctrl+Enter, Ctrl+X Ctrl+S)
detail: chat:sendNow delivers queued messages and the draft immediately; in shell mode it only queues the command. Ctrl+X Ctrl+S works in terminals that do not report extended keys. Needs v2.1.275+.

feature: Undo last input action (Ctrl+_)
detail: chat:undo reverses the last edit in the prompt.

feature: Edit prompt in external editor (Ctrl+G, Ctrl+X Ctrl+E)
detail: Opens the draft in your external editor; the agent view dispatch input follows the single-key binding.

feature: Stash current prompt (Ctrl+S)
detail: chat:stash sets the draft aside for later.

feature: Paste image from clipboard (Ctrl+V, Alt+V on Windows/WSL)
detail: chat:imagePaste attaches a clipboard image; on WSL both shortcuts are active.

feature: Autocomplete menu keys
detail: Tab accepts a suggestion, Escape dismisses the menu, Up and Down move through suggestions.

feature: Permission and confirmation dialog keys
detail: Enter confirms, Escape declines, Up/Down move options, Space toggles, Tab toggles fast mode in the /fast dialog, Shift+Tab on a file permission prompt allows the action for the rest of the session when offered.

feature: Double Ctrl+C or Ctrl+D closes dialogs
detail: In most dialogs a second press closes the dialog rather than exiting Claude Code.

feature: Transcript viewer keys
detail: Ctrl+E toggles show-all content in the classic renderer; q, Ctrl+C or Escape exits the transcript.

feature: Background the current task (Ctrl+B)
detail: task:background, also Ctrl+X Ctrl+B, moves the running foreground task to the background.

feature: Toggle syntax highlighting in theme picker (Ctrl+T)
detail: Switches syntax highlighting on or off while choosing a theme.

feature: Tab navigation keys
detail: Tab/Right and Shift+Tab/Left move between tabs in tabbed dialogs such as /help and /sandbox; Up and Down move focus between the tab row and content.

feature: Attachment navigation keys
detail: Left and Right move among image attachments, Backspace or Delete removes one, Down or Escape exits.

feature: Footer item navigation keys
detail: Arrow keys and Ctrl+P/N move across footer items (tasks, teams, diff, artifacts), Enter opens one, x stops the selected agent or workflow or dismisses a finished row.

feature: Rewind menu message selection keys
detail: The rewind menu list uses the shared Select keys; Home and End jump to the ends. A MessageSelector block can rebind keys for that list only.

feature: Diff viewer keys (earlier viewer)
detail: Escape closes (or goes back), Left/Right switch diff source, Up/Down or K/J move files, Enter opens a file; pager keys scroll the detail view. Applies when the cc-plugin-diff mod is disabled.

feature: Diff panel comparison base cycle (Ctrl+X B)
detail: In fullscreen rendering, cycles the diff panel base between this session, uncommitted changes and branch; Ctrl/Meta+Up/Down scroll an overflowing file list.

feature: Diff panel noise filter and pre-session toggles
detail: Unbound actions to hide test and generated files and to collapse changes from before the session, in the earlier panel only.

feature: Model picker effort keys
detail: Left and Right lower or raise effort level; s applies the highlighted model to this session only.

feature: Effort slider keys (/effort)
detail: Left/Right change effort level, Tab toggles ultracode when offered, s applies the level to this session only. Slider actions need v2.1.257 to v2.1.284.

feature: Select list keys
detail: Down/J/Ctrl+N and Up/K/Ctrl+P move, PageUp/PageDown page, Home/End jump, Enter accepts, Escape cancels; list panels like /skills, /mcp, /tasks honor rebinds.

feature: Plugin dialog keys
detail: Space toggles plugin selection, I installs selected plugins, F favorites a plugin so it sorts near the top of Installed.

feature: Above-prompt band keys
detail: Ctrl+X Ctrl+A collapses or expands the mod band above the prompt; Ctrl+X Tab moves focus into it; Tab/Shift+Tab, Enter, Escape and arrows operate its buttons, inputs and selects.

feature: Mod pane keys
detail: Panes scroll with arrows and page keys, resize with Ctrl+X arrows, and close with Ctrl+X X; pane:next/previous switch panes when several are open.

feature: Settings panel keys
detail: / enters search, R retries loading usage data, F sends the applicable /usage recommendations (v2.1.305+), Enter or Space changes a setting; changes save instantly and Escape closes.

feature: Agent view keys (claude agents)
detail: Ctrl+S switches grouping between state and directory, Ctrl+T pins a session, Ctrl+F finds by name, Ctrl+R renames, Ctrl+Up/Down jump between groups. Needs v2.1.257+, some v2.1.288+.

feature: Voice dictation push-to-talk (Space)
detail: voice:pushToTalk dictates a prompt, hold or tap depending on /voice mode, when dictation is enabled.

feature: Fullscreen scroll keys and mouse wheel
detail: Wheel, PageUp/Down, Ctrl+Home to start and Ctrl+End to latest message (re-enabling auto-follow); half- and full-page actions are unbound by default.

feature: Text selection and copy in fullscreen
detail: Ctrl+Shift+C or Cmd+C copies; Shift plus arrows, Home or End extend the selection; a clear-selection action needs v2.1.234+.

feature: Keystroke syntax: modifiers and special keys
detail: Modifiers ctrl, shift, alt/opt/option/meta, cmd/command/super/win joined by +; named keys include escape, enter, tab, space, arrows, page/home/end, backspace, delete, wheelup/wheeldown. cmd works only in terminals reporting Super.

feature: Chord keybindings
detail: Space-separated keystrokes form a chord; each must follow the previous within 3 seconds or the chord cancels with a notice.

feature: Non-US keyboard layout handling
detail: Ctrl shortcuts match by US-layout key position under non-Latin layouts when the terminal uses the Kitty protocol; AZERTY-style layouts match the typed letter.

feature: Unbind default shortcuts with null
detail: Setting an action to null removes a default key, including chords; freeing the ctrl+x prefix requires unbinding every chord using it across contexts.

feature: Reserved shortcuts that cannot be rebound
detail: Ctrl+C, Ctrl+D, Ctrl+M, Ctrl+[, Ctrl+I, Ctrl+H and Caps Lock are fixed.

feature: Terminal multiplexer conflicts
detail: Ctrl+B (tmux), Ctrl+A (screen) and Ctrl+Z (suspend) may clash with Claude Code shortcuts.

feature: Bare-letter bindings still type in text fields
detail: Printable keys without Ctrl, Alt or Cmd go to a focused dialog text field, so bindings like y and n do not block typing.

feature: Vim mode and keybindings coexist
detail: With vim editor mode on, vim handles cursor and motions; Escape switches INSERT to NORMAL rather than chat:cancel; vim keys are remapped via vimInsertModeRemaps; ? shows help and / opens history search in NORMAL.

feature: One-key cancel for questions in vim mode
detail: Binding a Ctrl or Alt key to select:cancel in the Select context cancels a single-select question from the Other row without two Escapes; not in screen reader or multi-select.

feature: Keybinding validation warnings
detail: Invalid JSON, misspelled modifiers, spaces next to +, bad contexts, unknown actions, reserved conflicts and duplicates are logged to the debug log (view with --debug).

feature: Terms that govern Claude Code by plan
detail: Consumer Terms apply to Free, Pro, Max and Ultra users; Commercial Terms apply to Team, Enterprise and API users.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Embedding Claude Code in other products: conditions
detail: Preinstalling or hosting Claude Code requires Commercial Terms, an unmodified binary with all sign-in methods intact, and each end user paying with their own credentials rather than resale.

feature: HIPAA configuration for Claude Code
detail: Under a signed BAA, CLI or Desktop Code tab on Claude for Enterprise with HIPAA enabled is covered; cloud sessions, Remote Control, mobile app Code and gateway or third-party-cloud routing are not.

feature: Zero Data Retention for Claude Code
detail: BAA also extends to Claude Code with ZDR enabled for an organization; not available to every organization.

feature: OAuth sign-in limited to subscribers' own use
detail: Subscription OAuth is for ordinary use of Claude Code and native apps by plan purchasers; third parties may not offer Claude.ai login or route requests through consumer plan credentials.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Plan usage limits assume individual use
detail: Advertised Pro, Max and Ultra limits presume ordinary individual use of Claude Code and the Agent SDK.

feature: Trust Center and vulnerability reporting
detail: Security info lives in the Trust Center and Transparency Hub; vulnerabilities are reported through a HackerOne form.

feature: Route Claude Code through an existing LLM gateway
detail: Any gateway exposing a supported API format works; gives central credentials, usage tracking by developer or team, budgets and rate limits, audit logging and provider switching. Non-Claude models are not supported.

feature: Gateway rollout sequence
detail: Deploy gateway with provider key, issue each developer a gateway credential, distribute base URL and credential by managed settings, then have each developer verify the configuration.

feature: Pin organization to one gateway with allowedProviders
detail: Setting allowedProviders to customEndpoint with the gateway ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL in managed env makes Claude Code refuse any other destination. Needs v2.1.285+. Desktop Cowork sessions need the anthropic entry too.

feature: Gateway credentials replace subscription limits
detail: While a gateway credential variable or apiKeyHelper is active, requests bill per token to the credential owner and subscription limits do not apply; setting only the base URL keeps the claude.ai login active.

feature: Per-directory CLAUDE.md files in large repos
detail: Claude loads CLAUDE.md from the launch directory and every parent at start, and subdirectory files on demand, so a root file holds global rules and each area adds its own.

feature: Launch location sets file access and loaded instructions
detail: Starting at repo root gives access to every file and loads only the root CLAUDE.md; starting in a subdirectory limits access to that subtree plus loads its and all ancestors' CLAUDE.md. Project .claude/settings.json is not inherited from parents.

feature: Path-scoped rules in .claude/rules/
detail: A rule with a paths glob loads when Claude touches matching files; an alternative to per-directory CLAUDE.md for centralized conventions.

feature: claudeMdExcludes setting
detail: Glob or absolute-path patterns that stop chosen CLAUDE.md and rules files from loading; usable at user, project, local or managed scope and merged across scopes, but cannot skip a managed CLAUDE.md.

feature: /context all lists loaded memory files
detail: Running /context all shows which CLAUDE.md files loaded under Memory files.

feature: /doctor checkup to trim oversized CLAUDE.md
detail: The /doctor checkup helps shrink a CLAUDE.md that has grown too large.

feature: Read deny rules for generated and vendored code
detail: permissions.deny entries like Read(./**/dist/**/*) block Claude's file tools and recognized Bash file commands from opening those paths; searches already honor .gitignore. Subprocess file opens and grep -r in Bash are not covered.

feature: Deny rules scoped to project, local or managed settings
detail: Rules can be committed for the whole repo, kept personal in settings.local.json, or enforced org-wide through managed settings; relative patterns anchor at the session's working directory.

feature: Code intelligence plugins (language servers)
detail: Plugins for TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust and others connect Claude to a language server for go-to-definition, references and type errors; install with /plugin install typescript-lsp@claude-plugins-official. Needs the language server binary and GitHub access.

feature: Plugin marketplace add and update commands
detail: /plugin marketplace add and /plugin marketplace update refresh or register the official claude-plugins-official catalog; internal Git hosts or local paths work on restricted networks.

feature: enabledPlugins project setting
detail: Turns a plugin on for everyone in a repository, though each person still installs it.

feature: Worktree sessions with --worktree
detail: The --worktree flag starts a session in a new git worktree to keep changes isolated from the main checkout.

feature: worktree.sparsePaths for sparse checkout
detail: Lists directories to check out in a new worktree via git sparse-checkout, plus root-level files; paths are repo-root-relative and shared by all worktrees in the session. Include .claude to carry repo settings.

feature: worktree.symlinkDirectories
detail: Symlinks heavy directories such as node_modules from the main repo into each worktree instead of copying.

feature: Subagent worktree isolation
detail: Subagents running in worktrees each get a lightweight sparse checkout rather than the full tree.

feature: additionalDirectories setting for cross-package access
detail: Grants read and write access to sibling packages or other repos outside the working directory; does not load their CLAUDE.md, rules or skills.

feature: --add-dir flag and /add-dir command
detail: Adds a directory at launch or runtime; its skills load, and CLAUDE.md and rules load only if CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD is set.

feature: Per-directory skills in .claude/skills/
detail: Skills committed inside a subdirectory load on demand when Claude works on files there; skills discovered depend on the launch directory and can accumulate when started from the root.

feature: Skill paths frontmatter glob scoping
detail: A skill can name file globs so it loads automatically only when matching files are in play.

feature: Skill descriptions get cut when many skills exist
detail: With many skills, some lose their descriptions and keep only names, so short keyword-first descriptions are advised.

feature: Plugins for centralized conventions
detail: Versioned bundles of skills, hooks and commands owned by a platform team, namespaced plugin:skill, installable for everyone through managed settings.

feature: MCP server exposing a code search or RAG index
detail: Organizations can surface an existing repository search service as an MCP tool so Claude queries it rather than reading files.

feature: SessionStart hook recommends plugins
detail: A hook can read the launch directory, look it up in a committed path-to-plugin map and print a recommendation into Claude's context.

feature: Stop hook proposes CLAUDE.md updates
detail: A Stop hook receives the transcript path so a script can review the session and suggest instruction updates.

feature: Skill usage telemetry via OpenTelemetry
detail: With the logs exporter and OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1, skill_activated events record skill names and whether a command, Claude or another skill triggered them.

feature: Plan mode plan file survives compaction
detail: Plans from plan mode are written to a file that Claude Code re-injects after each context compaction during long cross-package work.

feature: Check for an admin-configured gateway with /status
detail: The Status tab shows an Anthropic base URL line and an Auth token, API key or apiKeyHelper line when a gateway is active; a login screen at startup means no credential was distributed.

feature: Gateway credential variables
detail: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN sends a Bearer Authorization header, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY sends x-api-key, apiKeyHelper sends both; the wrong one yields 401.

feature: Set gateway URL and credential in shell or settings env block
detail: Shell exports last one session; env in ~/.claude/settings.json or settings.local.json persists and also reaches background agents; settings-file value wins on conflict; never put the credential in committed project settings.

feature: Gateway credential overrides saved login; /logout clears login
detail: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN takes over immediately; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY asks for one-time approval in interactive mode (re-enable via /config Use custom API key); /logout removes the saved login.

feature: VS Code extension gateway config
detail: Gateway variables go in the claudeCode.environmentVariables VS Code user setting, which the extension checks before launch.

feature: Desktop app third-party inference gateway config
detail: Desktop reads gateway routing from its third-party inference configuration, either admin-distributed or entered via Help > Troubleshooting > Enable Developer Mode > Developer > Configure Third-Party Inference; admin config makes the form read-only.

feature: Gateway mode disables cloud environments and Remote Control in desktop
detail: With a gateway configuration, the environment selector hides Anthropic-hosted cloud environments and Remote Control is unavailable.

feature: SSH sessions on desktop behind a gateway
detail: In beta on Claude Desktop v1.40609.0+, off by default until hosts are listed in sshHostAllowlist; the remote machine must be able to reach the gateway address.

feature: GitHub Actions gateway config
detail: Workflow env sets ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (and custom headers); the gateway key goes in the anthropic_api_key input, plus ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN for bearer-token gateways.

feature: Agent SDK gateway config via env option
detail: The SDK passes env vars to the spawned Claude Code process; TypeScript env replaces the environment (spread process.env), Python merges.

feature: Slack and cloud sessions excluded from gateway
detail: Claude Code in Slack and cloud sessions do not honor gateway variables, so keep them disabled for users whose traffic must stay on the gateway.

feature: Remote Control and voice dictation need claude.ai identity
detail: Both are unavailable while a gateway credential or apiKeyHelper is active; Remote Control is also off when the base URL points to a non-Anthropic host. claude doctor names the blocker.

feature: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS
detail: Adds extra Name: Value request headers (newline-separated, \n in JSON) for tenant or routing; routing-style headers need approval.

feature: Gateway model discovery in /model picker
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY=1 makes Claude Code list the gateway's models at startup in the picker, showing gateway descriptions or 'From gateway'; hidden if a modelPicker lineup replaces built-ins.

feature: apiKeyHelper for rotating credentials
detail: A command printing the credential to stdout, cached five minutes by default (CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS changes it); extra output makes it fail on v2.1.227+.

feature: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC
detail: Stops version checks, telemetry and similar background calls for egress-restricted networks; also disables auto-update and the fast mode availability check, but not gateway model discovery or the WebFetch safety check (skipWebFetchPreflight).

feature: Route through gateway to Bedrock
detail: Set ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK and CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_BEDROCK_AUTH; leave AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK unset if the gateway issues credentials.

feature: Route through gateway to Google Vertex (Agent Platform)
detail: Set ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL, project ID, region, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX and skip-auth; per-model region overrides, model pins and declared capabilities still apply.

feature: Route through gateway to Microsoft Foundry
detail: ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY (x-api-key) or ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_AUTH_TOKEN (Bearer, v2.1.203+) with CLAUDE_CODE_USE_FOUNDRY; CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FOUNDRY_AUTH for gateways injecting their own header.

feature: Route through gateway to Claude Platform on AWS
detail: Set ANTHROPIC_AWS_BASE_URL, workspace ID, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_ANTHROPIC_AWS and skip-auth.

feature: Provider route confirmation in /status
detail: Status shows API provider, provider base URL, auth-skipped rows and a Proxy row when a corporate proxy is used.

feature: Gateway troubleshooting: 401, 400 betas, context limit
detail: Documents fixes such as CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1 for rejected fields, CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING for older upstreams, CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW (min 100,000) and CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS for gateway context limits.

feature: Fast mode behind gateways
detail: /fast needs api.anthropic.com reachability; CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FAST_MODE_NETWORK_ERRORS and CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FAST_MODE_ORG_CHECK bypass the checks for gateway-issued keys or bearer tokens.

feature: /feedback saves locally behind a gateway
detail: Without an Anthropic credential the report is written to ~/.claude/feedback-bundles/ instead of being sent.

feature: Artifact tool schema rejected by gateways (v2.1.265-267)
detail: A gradual rollout sent a regex with Unicode classes that some gateways rejected; fixed in v2.1.268, or artifacts can be disabled.

feature: Advisor tool entry rejected by gateways (v2.1.275)
detail: Requests carried an advisor tool declaration even when off; fixed in v2.1.276, or set CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1.

feature: forceLoginMethod conflicts with gateway credentials
detail: Managed settings forceLoginMethod, forceLoginOrgUUID or forceLoginGatewayUrl cannot coexist with API key, auth token or apiKeyHelper.

feature: TLS and WAF issues behind gateways
detail: NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS trusts corporate CAs; a WAF's cross-site-scripting body rule may 403 real prompts so /v1/messages should be exempt.

feature: Supported gateway API formats
detail: Gateways may expose Anthropic Messages (/v1/messages), Amazon Bedrock InvokeModel or Google Agent Platform rawPredict; Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS use the Messages format. Token-count endpoints are optional (character estimate fallback).

feature: Gateway streaming requirements
detail: Responses must stream unbuffered with full event sequence through message_delta and message_stop, keep SSE ping events to avoid the idle-timeout abort, and Bedrock event-stream bodies must not be converted.

feature: Behavior differs by connection method
detail: Bedrock/Vertex format sends provider model IDs and a safe subset of betas; Messages format sends the full set; Claude apps gateway sign-in sends the safe subset with Anthropic IDs; background-task model and one-hour cache TTL handling also vary.

feature: Unrecognized model IDs assume 1M context window
detail: Since v2.1.323 Claude Code assumes a 1M token window for unknown IDs; modelOverrides maps a gateway alias to a known model's capabilities.

feature: Request headers sent to gateways
detail: Authorization/x-api-key, anthropic-version, anthropic-beta (forward verbatim, including the OAuth capability for claude.ai logins), plus x-claude-code-session-id, agent-id and parent-agent-id for attributing usage to sessions and subagents.

feature: Gateway hint headers (CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS)
detail: From v2.1.273, optional routing headers carry request class, subagent type, compaction trigger, post-compaction flag, previous tool durations and a prompt ID; default on for direct API, off for custom base URLs unless set to 1, 0 disables everywhere. No prompt text is included.

feature: Response headers Claude Code reads
detail: content-type for streams, retry-after in integer seconds (over 60 stops retries), x-should-retry, and anthropic-ratelimit-unified-* which drive plan usage display and distinguish plan limits from throttling.

feature: System prompt attribution block
detail: A client version and fingerprint block is prepended to the system prompt and stripped by api.anthropic.com; CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER=0 omits it for gateways, but auto mode classifier requests to Anthropic keep it. Stable per conversation from v2.1.181.

feature: Fine-grained tool streaming off behind custom base URL
detail: Off by default through gateways; CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FINE_GRAINED_TOOL_STREAMING=1 enables it.

feature: Adaptive reasoning request field
detail: Claude Code sends thinking type adaptive for current models and unknown aliases; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING=1 turns it off for Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6; auto retry switches thinking type once on rejection.

feature: Context management beta
detail: A context_management field paired with a beta header; Claude Code retries without it on rejection (v2.1.304+).

feature: Effort per turn and output_config.effort
detail: Effort and structured-output settings travel in output_config with beta headers; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUTS=1 (v2.1.288+) removes only the format; effort rejections trigger a retry without it (v2.1.310+).

feature: Mid-conversation system messages
detail: Newer models receive reminders as system-role messages; on rejection Claude Code retries with that text in user messages until /clear or compaction.

feature: Prompt caching and one-hour TTL
detail: cache_control markers must be forwarded unchanged; one-hour TTL is opt-in via the ttl field, with an extended-cache-ttl beta value on the Messages format.

feature: Automatic retry on rejected capabilities
detail: Claude Code retries without advisor tool entries, thinking signatures bound to another conversation, rejected beta values, and tool search fields, then remembers the omission for the session or conversation.

feature: MCP tool search through a gateway
detail: defer_loading fields and tool_reference blocks must be forwarded; on rejection (v2.1.305+) Claude Code resends with all MCP tools loaded upfront.

feature: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS
detail: Stops pre-release betas: context management, beta tool fields, structured output format, task budget and MCP tool search, while leaving extended context, interleaved thinking, effort, adaptive thinking and OAuth values. Managed settings can keep tool search on (v2.1.227+).

feature: Auto mode server-side classifier review control
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0 turns off server classifier review; /status shows Auto mode server Enabled or Disabled.

feature: ANTHROPIC_BETAS and CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY
detail: Developers can add their own beta header values and request body fields, which the experimental-beta switch does not strip.

feature: Gateway model discovery details
detail: With ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL on Messages format, GET /v1/models (3 s timeout, adjustable by CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS v2.1.269+) lists models whose id contains claude or anthropic; no redirects; skipped when any CLAUDE_CODE_USE_* is set.

feature: Discovered model picker entries
detail: Entries use display_name or the recognized model name, show a one-line description or 'From gateway', collapse into built-in aliases when they match, and respect the availableModels managed setting.

feature: Gateway model cache file
detail: Discovered models are cached in ~/.claude/cache/gateway-models.json (under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR if set) and reused if the next startup fetch fails.

feature: Gateway sessions excluded from HIPAA configuration
detail: Sessions routed through a gateway are not eligible for the HIPAA configuration.

feature: Startup probes and direct calls bypassing gateway
detail: HEAD /api/hello warming probe and, on Bedrock, inference-profile lookups hit the gateway; fast mode and WebFetch safety checks call api.anthropic.com directly.

feature: Gateway requirements for rollout
detail: Gateway must serve HTTPS at the exact distributed address (no redirects), accept a supported format, stream with pings, route Claude model names, forward anthropic headers and bodies unchanged, return upstream errors unmodified, and exempt the path from WAF body inspection.

feature: Per-developer gateway keys
detail: One gateway key per developer enables per-developer usage attribution and one-credential offboarding; Bearer gateways use ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, x-api-key gateways use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

feature: Five-step rollout with checkpoints
detail: Confirm routing for each model name, issue developer credentials, test with claude -p, distribute config, then verify a streaming request and /status from a developer machine.

feature: Distribute gateway config via managed settings env block
detail: MDM, registry policy or config management pushes ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and an apiKeyHelper (one helper per machine fetching that developer's key) so developers configure nothing.

feature: Optional distributed variables
detail: Custom headers, hint headers, model discovery, experimental-beta disable, fast-mode skip checks, ANTHROPIC_MODEL and default Haiku model, and provider-specific base URLs are added when the gateway needs them; route both override and built-in model IDs.

feature: Desktop, CI and WSL delivered separately
detail: Desktop reads a separate third-party inference file via MDM; CI runners need env vars in the runner; WSL reads Windows managed settings only when wslInheritsWindowsSettings is true.

feature: No HIPAA eligibility behind a gateway; restrict features via managed keys
detail: Gateway sessions are outside the HIPAA configuration; admins can restrict features with managed keys, but cloud sessions have no managed key and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC is not a substitute.

feature: Verify with /status Setting sources line
detail: /status Status tab shows Anthropic base URL and a Setting sources line that includes managed settings when distribution worked.

feature: Gateway maintenance guidance
detail: Forward anthropic headers verbatim, test new Claude Code releases, add new model names to gateway routing, rotate credentials with apiKeyHelper, and size rate limits for up to 10 client retries honoring Retry-After.

feature: Pin Claude Code version with requiredMaximumVersion or DISABLE_UPDATES
detail: Admins can hold developers on a tested version to control feature-flag defaults, model capability assumptions and default model changes across upgrades.

feature: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL and alias pins
detail: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL (v2.1.236+) fixes the starting model and ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS/SONNET/HAIKU_MODEL fix what aliases resolve to, so upgrades do not shift them.

feature: MCP control patterns for admins
detail: Admins choose between disabling MCP, a fixed deployment, provided servers, an approved catalog, plugin-only servers, a soft allowlist, a denylist or no restrictions; Anthropic reviews directory connectors but does not audit any server.

feature: managed-mcp.json exclusive control
detail: A file at a system path (macOS /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode, Linux /etc/claude-code, Windows C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode) makes Claude Code load only the listed servers plus managed, in-process and a few built-in ones; users cannot add others, including via --mcp-config.

feature: Disable MCP entirely with empty managed-mcp.json
detail: An empty mcpServers map blocks all user MCP servers; claude mcp add fails with an enterprise-policy error and prior user servers stop loading.

feature: Per-user credentials in managed MCP
detail: Avoid secrets in the world-readable file; use ${VAR} expansion, OAuth or per-user headers, or headersHelper for dynamic credentials.

feature: --mcp-config and --strict-mcp-config under managed-mcp.json
detail: On workstations Claude Code exits at startup if these flags are used; in cloud sessions on hosts with the file, only managed servers load and others are skipped with a stderr warning.

feature: allowAllClaudeAiMcps setting
detail: Lets claude.ai connectors load alongside managed-mcp.json; read only from admin-controlled sources, and a managed file on a cloud-session host still suppresses its connectors.

feature: allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp setting
detail: Managed-mcp.json blocks Claude in Chrome in terminal sessions by default (claude --chrome exits with an error); this device-level managed setting (v2.1.282+) allows it.

feature: managedMcpServers: org-provided remote servers
detail: Managed settings can supply HTTP/SSE servers (https only, no command/env/headersHelper, no ${VAR}) to every user alongside their own (v2.1.259+); they take precedence over same-name or same-URL user servers and users cannot remove them.

feature: Provided servers shown under Managed MCPs in /mcp
detail: Users can disable a provided server for themselves in /mcp; URLs show host only and claude mcp get lists header names without values.

feature: managedMcpServers load timing and live updates
detail: With server-managed settings the cache is withheld until the server confirms; running interactive sessions connect, reconnect or disconnect servers when the key changes, while -p runs keep removed ones until exit.

feature: allowedMcpServers and deniedMcpServers lists
detail: Entries match by serverUrl (wildcards), serverCommand (exact argument array) or serverName; unset allowlist allows all, empty blocks all, denylist always wins, and --mcp-config servers are filtered too.

feature: allowManagedMcpServersOnly lock
detail: Makes the managed allowlist authoritative by ignoring user, project and local allowlists, while denylists still merge from every scope (cross-source reading needs v2.1.273+).

feature: serverName entries are not a security control
detail: Names are user-chosen labels; use serverUrl or serverCommand to enforce, though denylist serverName can block claude.ai connectors by display name.

feature: serverUrl wildcard and port matching rules
detail: Hostnames match case-insensitively; patterns with a full hostname match only the default port, a * in the host matches every port; examples cover subdomains, localhost and any-scheme patterns.

feature: Environment variable expansion in policy entries
detail: Policy entries expand from a pinned environment (v2.1.219+) so user settings cannot alter allowlist meaning; allowlist entries whose expansion changes URL scope are ignored.

feature: Server evaluation order and allowlist exemptions
detail: Merge lists, check denylist, then allowlist; managed servers, built-in servers (Chrome, IDE), Claude Tag Slack tools and in-process sdk servers skip the allowlist.

feature: strictPluginOnlyCustomization for MCP
detail: With mcp in the list, users cannot add servers via ~/.claude.json or .mcp.json, while plugin servers and provided servers still load.

feature: No built-in MCP registry; plugins marketplace as catalog
detail: Claude Code has no browsable MCP registry; admins share approved claude mcp add commands or publish servers as plugins in a managed marketplace browsable via /plugin.

feature: User-visible messages when MCP policy blocks a server
detail: Specific errors appear for claude mcp add under exclusive control, denylist, allowlist or plugin-only rules, for claude mcp remove on provided servers, and as a notice when managed-mcp.json takes effect; blocked servers silently vanish from /mcp.

feature: Validate managed MCP with claude mcp list
detail: claude mcp list should show only managed servers and MCP config diagnostics lists enterprise config errors.

feature: Monitor MCP usage with OpenTelemetry
detail: OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 adds MCP server and tool names to tool events and cost/token counters for aggregation.

feature: disableClaudeAiConnectors and desktop connector governance
detail: Connectors delivered in-process to desktop local and SSH sessions are governed from claude.ai organization settings, not these Claude Code controls.

feature: Managed settings override all user levels
detail: Org-deployed settings outrank user, project, local and --settings values, with a few exceptions where a stricter lower value still counts; managed model and autoCompactWindow are only defaults, restrict with availableModels.
