detail: Archiving a session in claude.ai/code stops runners from repeatedly retrying a pending message.

feature: Report issues to Anthropic account team
detail: Issues with self-hosted environments are reported through the customer's Anthropic account team.

feature: Server-managed settings for Claude Code
detail: Owners push Claude Code configuration from the claude.ai admin console; clients fetch it on sign-in with no device-management tooling.

feature: Admin console page for managed settings
detail: Organization settings > Claude Code > Managed settings holds the JSON; only Owner and Primary Owner roles can view or edit it.

feature: Managed settings JSON editor with schema warnings
detail: Editor validates against the published settings schema and shows warnings; the save button relabels to Update with errors or Add with errors but still saves.

feature: Server vs endpoint-managed settings
detail: Choose between settings delivered from Anthropic servers (no MDM, unmanaged devices) and settings deployed by MDM, registry or file (OS-protected, stronger guarantees).

feature: Server-managed settings reach cloud sessions
detail: Endpoint-managed settings do not reach Anthropic-hosted cloud sessions, so organizations using cloud sessions need server-managed settings too.

feature: Managed hooks across the organization
detail: Admins can deliver hook definitions (for example an audit script after file edits) that run for all users.

feature: Managed permission deny list and bypass-mode lock
detail: Admins deliver permission deny rules and can disable the bypass-permissions mode for everyone.

feature: Allow only managed permission rules
detail: The allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly key makes managed rules the only ones honored, ignoring user and project permission rules.

feature: Managed auto mode classifier configuration
detail: An autoMode block delivered by managed settings tells the auto mode classifier which repos, buckets and domains the organization trusts.

feature: Managed-only settings keys
detail: A set of keys is read only from managed settings and has no effect in user or project files.

feature: Group-specific managed configurations
detail: On Enterprise, each SCIM-synced or custom group can get its own configuration; each member receives only the highest-ranked matching one and configurations do not merge.

feature: Everyone-else catch-all configuration
detail: A catch-all configuration applies to members matching no group configuration; without it they get no server-managed settings.

feature: Drag-to-rank group configurations
detail: Admins order group configurations by dragging; members in several groups get the top-ranked one.

feature: Check effective settings lookup
detail: Admins search a member to see which configuration they would receive before switching modes.

feature: Switch between group-based and organization-wide mode
detail: A banner switch activates group configurations (rolls out within about an hour) and can revert while keeping group configs saved.

feature: Group configs unavailable with HIPAA enabled
detail: Group-based configurations are not yet available for organizations that enabled HIPAA.

feature: Group model limits only apply to local sessions
detail: Cloud and remote Cowork sessions take the availableModels list from the catch-all or org-wide config, not from group configs.

feature: Team plan applies one configuration to all users
detail: Team organizations cannot use group configurations; settings apply uniformly.

feature: Managed MCP server policy keys
detail: allowedMcpServers and deniedMcpServers can be delivered; a managed-mcp.json file cannot be distributed this way.

feature: Managed remote MCP servers
detail: managedMcpServers provides http and sse servers to all users without taking exclusive control; waits up to 30 seconds at startup for confirmation.

feature: OS-only settings not honored via server delivery
detail: Keys such as policyHelper and wslInheritsWindowsSettings must be deployed through MDM or a managed settings file.

feature: Managed source precedence
detail: Server-managed and endpoint-managed settings share the top tier; by default the first source delivering a policy key wins, with exceptions for lock keys, env, providers and sign-in keys.

feature: Cross-source lock keys
detail: A small set of keys, such as sandbox allowlist locks, are honored when any admin-controlled managed source sets them.

feature: Managed env block merges per variable
detail: Environment variables merge across admin sources, higher priority winning per variable, except telemetry units and credential-paired routing variables.

feature: Managed allowedProviders list
detail: Server-managed provider allowlist combines with machine-set lists; sessions on non-listed providers are refused.

feature: Force sign-in method and organization via managed settings
detail: forceLoginOrgUUID and forceLoginMethod (claudeai, console) can be set in server-managed settings; gateway sign-in keys are never read from server delivery.

feature: Enforce Anthropic sign-in key
detail: enforceAnthropicSignIn is a managed key whose source depends on its settings reference entry.

feature: Settings fetch at startup and hourly refresh
detail: Clients fetch at startup and poll hourly; most updates apply to running sessions without restart, while model, OTel exporter config and env removals apply at next launch.

feature: Five-second wait for first-launch policy
detail: On sign-in without cached settings Claude Code waits up to five seconds so policy and company announcements show from the first screen.

feature: Cached managed settings with 24-hour expiry
detail: Last fetched policy is cached and applied at startup, expiring 24 hours after the last successful fetch; a warning shows when the cache is used.

feature: Withheld env categories until server confirms
detail: Cached proxy, TLS, API routing, credential and config-directory variables stay withheld until the fresh fetch confirms the payload.

feature: Cached modelPricing waits for confirmation
detail: Cached modelPricing is not applied until the fetch confirms; until then usage and status line costs show at list price.

feature: Proxy needed for settings fetch
detail: HTTPS_PROXY must be set in endpoint-managed env, shell or user settings when the settings fetch needs a proxy.

feature: Partial validation of delivered settings
detail: Invalid entries are dropped with a validation error while valid ones apply; some keys fall back to stricter values; requires v2.1.169+.

feature: Failed payload reports no-applicable-settings error
detail: If every setting fails validation, nothing applies and the cache is unchanged; startup notice, /status and claude doctor report the cause.

feature: Debug managed settings delivery
detail: claude --debug-file with a search for Remote settings helps diagnose delivery issues.

feature: Fail-closed startup (forceRemoteSettingsRefresh)
detail: With this key true, the CLI blocks until settings are freshly fetched and exits if the fetch fails; claude auth subcommands are exempt.

feature: Anthropic can require org settings before a session starts
detail: On a Team or Enterprise login, expired sign-in or missing settings with no cache can block session start until re-login or network access.

feature: Claude apps gateway managed settings
detail: Gateway-signed-in clients on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry or Claude Platform on AWS fetch managed settings from the gateway and exit if it is unreachable at startup.

feature: Gateway session expired prompt
detail: A 401 from the gateway on an attended launch prints a message and opens signed out until /login is run.

feature: Security approval dialog for risky managed settings
detail: Shell-command settings, sandbox binary and weakening settings, risky env variables and hooks require user approval; rejecting makes Claude Code exit.

feature: Approval memory per organization or gateway
detail: Approvals are remembered per org (claude.ai login), per gateway, or per cache for other credentials; changes in the settings re-trigger the dialog.

feature: Approval dialog unavailable in non-interactive runs
detail: In claude -p, Agent SDK, VS Code chat panel and desktop Code tab, approval-needing settings apply for that run only and are not recorded.

feature: Managed CLAUDE.md via claudeMd key
detail: Organization instruction text can be delivered without an approval dialog since it is not an executable command; permissions still apply.

feature: Privacy toggles applied without approval when truthy
detail: DISABLE_TELEMETRY, DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING, DO_NOT_TRACK and nonessential-traffic switches apply silently when set to turn things off.

feature: Custom headers approval depends on header names
detail: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS tagging headers apply silently; credential, routing or API-behavior headers require approval.

feature: Company announcements at startup
detail: companyAnnouncements shows an organization message on the first screen at startup.

feature: Platform requirements for delivery
detail: Needs direct api.anthropic.com access and a Team/Enterprise OAuth login, OAuth token, API key or user_oauth profile; apiKeyHelper keys and workload identity federation do not trigger fetch.

feature: Console API keys get a separate org's settings
detail: A Console API key belongs to a different organization, so admin settings do not reach it; use a setup-token OAuth token or endpoint-managed file for CI.

feature: Cowork sessions do not fetch server-managed settings
detail: Claude Code inside Cowork in the desktop app ignores admin-console managed settings; marketplace allow/block lists are still enforced by claude.ai.

feature: Third-party provider bypasses server-managed settings
detail: Setting a CLAUDE_CODE_USE_* provider variable or custom ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL skips the fetch.

feature: Server-managed settings audit logging
detail: Settings-change audit events (action, account, device, old and new values) are available through the compliance API or audit export via the account team.

feature: Server-managed settings are client-side controls
detail: Not a security boundary on unmanaged devices; cache edits, older versions or modified binaries can bypass them.

feature: ConfigChange hooks for local settings edits
detail: Hooks can log edits to local settings files but do not run for server-managed or MDM changes and cannot block policy changes.

feature: Tenant Restrictions network-level access control
detail: Help Center article covers restricting which organizations users can reach with supplied credentials.

feature: claude doctor managed settings line
detail: claude doctor (v2.1.248+) reports loaded, none configured, fetch failed with cache status, or skipped with reason.

feature: /status shows managed settings source
detail: Setting sources line lists Enterprise managed settings (remote) when server delivery applies.

feature: /permissions shows effective rules
detail: Users run /permissions to see effective permission rules including managed ones.

feature: Continue most recent session (--continue)
detail: claude --continue reopens the latest session in the current directory.

feature: Resume via session picker (--resume)
detail: claude --resume opens an interactive picker of past sessions.

feature: Resume by name
detail: claude --resume <name> resumes a named session directly; ambiguous names open the picker pre-filled.

feature: Resume by session ID or transcript path
detail: IDs resolve from any directory, searching the current project then others; a .jsonl transcript path also works.

feature: Resume from pull request (--from-pr)
detail: Opens the picker filtered to sessions linked to a given PR number.

feature: /resume switches session inside Claude Code
detail: Switch to another session mid-conversation; /resume <name> resumes directly or errors when ambiguous.

feature: Resume a running background session
detail: Resuming a running background session attaches to it, optionally sending a prompt first; blocked with piped IO or config flags; requires v2.1.285+.

feature: /resume moves current conversation to background
detail: Moves the current chat to the background and attaches to the running one; press left arrow on empty prompt to return to agent view.

feature: What a resumed session restores
detail: Restores history (from last compaction), model, agent, permission mode, active goal and scheduled tasks; interrupted tools are not rerun.

feature: Flags to pass again on resume
detail: MCP config, plugin dir, add-dir, settings, fallback model and tool allow/deny flags are not restored.

feature: Permission mode restore rules on resume
detail: Terminal resume restores the prior mode (bypass not restored, plan and auto conditionally); picker and /resume follow different rules.

feature: Resume in plan mode with -p
detail: Non-interactive resume returns to plan mode only when a permission-prompt tool is set and no conflicting flags or deny rules apply.

feature: Resume this conversation dialog with usage estimate
detail: On Pro, Max and Ultra, long or stale conversations show the share of the 5-hour limit the saved context would use, offering Resume or Start a new conversation.

feature: Session picker scope: worktree, all worktrees, all projects
detail: Default shows current worktree and /add-dir sessions; Ctrl+W widens to all worktrees, Ctrl+A to every project.

feature: Background sessions marked bg in picker
detail: Background sessions appear in the list tagged bg.

feature: Loop, -p and SDK sessions hidden from picker
detail: Sessions begun with /loop, claude -p or the Agent SDK are omitted from picker and --continue but resumable by ID; claude -p --continue includes them.

feature: --continue opens finished background sessions
detail: Finished background sessions can be continued (v2.1.257+); a still-running one makes it exit with its ID.

feature: Resume sessions from other worktrees and projects
detail: Other worktree sessions resume in place or in current dir if gone; unrelated projects copy a cd-and-resume command.

feature: /cd relocates session storage
detail: Moving a session with /cd files it under the new directory's project.

feature: Name session at startup (-n)
detail: claude -n <name> names the session.

feature: /rename session
detail: Renames during a session; name shows on the prompt bar.

feature: Rename from picker (Ctrl+R)
detail: Rename the highlighted session in the picker.

feature: Auto title on plan accept
detail: Accepting a plan gives an unnamed session a plan-based generated title.

feature: Rename Remote Control session from claude.ai or app
detail: Names set in claude.ai or the Claude app apply in the CLI (v2.1.221+).

feature: Default display name and generated title
detail: Unnamed sessions get a dir-name-plus-suffix label for listings and a Haiku-class generated title that works as a resume handle.

feature: Disable generated terminal title
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE=1 stops title generation for terminal and SDK sessions.

feature: Session picker keyboard shortcuts
detail: Arrows or j/k navigate, Enter resumes, Space previews, Ctrl+R renames, typing searches, Ctrl+A/W/B widen or filter, Esc exits.

feature: Search picker by pull request URL
detail: Pasting a GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, GitLab or Bitbucket PR/MR URL finds the session that created it.

feature: Filter picker to current git branch (Ctrl+B)
detail: Toggles filtering to sessions from the current branch.

feature: Session preview in picker
detail: Space (or Ctrl+V) previews a session's content.

feature: Picker row labels
detail: Rows show name, generated title, summary or prompt, in that order of preference.

feature: /branch to fork a conversation
detail: Copies the conversation so far into a new session (optional name), leaving the original intact and listed in the picker.

feature: Fork with --fork-session
detail: Combine with --continue or --resume to fork from the command line; new process loses session-scoped permission grants.

feature: What a branch inherits
detail: Permission grants, running background subagents/commands and Remote Control connection follow the new branch when using /branch.

feature: Concurrent resume warning
detail: Resuming the same session in two terminals writes to one transcript and may lose messages; use --fork-session.

feature: /clear starts fresh context
detail: Saves previous session for /resume; keeps a manual name but not generated title; /clear <name> names the old one.

feature: /compact with instructions
detail: Replaces history with a summary, optionally focused by instructions.

feature: /context shows context consumers
detail: Shows what currently uses the context window.

feature: /export transcript
detail: Menu to copy the conversation or save as plain text; a filename argument writes directly.

feature: Script access to sessions
detail: claude -p with json or stream-json output, -p --resume, hook transcript_path, and the Agent SDK give structured session data.

feature: Transcript storage as JSONL
detail: Sessions stored at ~/.claude/projects/<project>/<id>.jsonl; format is internal and may change.

feature: Configurable transcript location and retention
detail: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR moves storage; cleanupPeriodDays changes the 30-day default; desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays limits Desktop/Cowork transcripts.

feature: Suppress transcript writes
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_PROMPT_HISTORY disables all writes; --no-session-persistence does so for one -p run; TRANSCRIPT_LOCAL_GC caps -p file size.

feature: claude purge deletes project session data
detail: Deletes a project's transcripts and related state sooner than the retention sweep.

feature: claude rm for background sessions
detail: Deleting a background session keeps its transcript resumable.

feature: Custom project directory name
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME (with CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, 1-64 safe characters, v2.1.234+) names transcript and memory directory, for embedding hosts.

feature: Separate session lists per surface
detail: Desktop app, claude.ai/code and VS Code each keep their own list; desktop can resume CLI sessions.

feature: Personal settings file (~/.claude/settings.json)
detail: User-level settings apply to all projects; example sets model, effort, editor mode, theme, status line, tips, notifications, permissions, update channel and retention.

feature: Default model setting
detail: model key starts every session on a chosen model.

feature: Per-model effort level (modelSettings)
detail: modelSettings stores an effortLevel per model, such as xhigh; /effort saves per model and --effort sets one session.

feature: Vim editor mode for prompt
detail: editorMode vim gives Vim keybindings in the prompt.

feature: Color themes including daltonized
detail: theme key selects a theme such as light-daltonized.

feature: Custom status line command
detail: statusLine runs a command (e.g. jq over session JSON) to show model and context percentage below the prompt, with padding.

feature: Hide spinner tips
detail: spinnerTipsEnabled false hides rotating tips.

feature: Preferred notification channel
detail: preferredNotifChannel such as terminal_bell rings for finished tasks or permission prompts.

feature: Pre-approved permission rules
detail: permissions.allow lists commands or file reads that run without asking.

feature: Auto-update channel
detail: autoUpdatesChannel (e.g. stable) picks the release channel.

feature: Session data cleanup period
detail: cleanupPeriodDays deletes transcripts and local session data older than N days.

feature: Team shared project settings (.claude/settings.json)
detail: Repository-committed file shares permissions, hooks, marketplaces, plugins and sandbox; cloud sessions read it too.

feature: Ask rules for confirmation
detail: permissions.ask makes commands like git push prompt first.

feature: Deny rules for secrets
detail: permissions.deny blocks reads of .env and secrets paths; applies in trusted and untrusted folders.

feature: Allow rules wait for folder trust
detail: Project allow rules and extraKnownMarketplaces take effect only after the user trusts that folder.

feature: PreToolUse hook running a repo script
detail: Hook runs a script such as block-rm.sh before Bash commands and can block them.

feature: Team plugin marketplace and enabled plugins
detail: extraKnownMarketplaces registers a marketplace on every clone and enabledPlugins turns plugins on; external-source plugins still need one-time install.

feature: Sandbox settings for commands
detail: sandbox enables command sandboxing with extra writable paths and allowed network domains; adds Read deny paths to unreadable files.

feature: Telemetry settings ignored in repo files
detail: OpenTelemetry exporter variables in repository settings are ignored; set in managed or personal settings.

feature: Plans directory setting
detail: plansDirectory keeps plan files inside the repository.

feature: Organization managed-settings.json example
detail: Deployed as a file, MDM or console JSON; applies uniformly to everything it reaches; per-group values need separate profiles or Enterprise group configs.

feature: Restrict available models
detail: availableModels with enforceAvailableModels limits sessions to listed models (e.g. opus, sonnet), making the Default option obey the list.

feature: Disable bypass permissions mode
detail: permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode removes the bypass mode from every session.

feature: Allow only managed MCP servers
detail: allowedMcpServers pins servers by URL; allowManagedMcpServersOnly makes the managed list the only allowlist.

feature: Strict known marketplaces
detail: strictKnownMarketplaces restricts plugins to approved marketplaces such as one GitHub repo.

feature: Strict managed sandbox
detail: Managed sandbox with failIfUnavailable, no unsandboxed retry, fixed domain allowlist and allowManagedDomainsOnly.

feature: Required minimum version
detail: requiredMinimumVersion makes Claude Code refuse to start on older versions.

feature: Advisor model setting
detail: Picks the stronger model that answers when Claude calls the server-side advisor tool; /advisor opens a picker with No advisor option; --advisor overrides per session; must be at least as capable as the main model; unavailable on Bedrock.

feature: Always-thinking toggle
detail: Setting false turns extended thinking off for every session; models that always think ignore it; on third-party providers the thinking parameter is just omitted; MAX_THINKING_TOKENS overrides per session.

feature: Restrict selectable models (availableModels)
detail: Allowlist of model aliases or IDs people may select for sessions, subagents, skills and advisor; managed list constrains /model, --model and the model key.

feature: availableModelsMatch: prefix or exact
detail: Managed key choosing whether a model ID entry also permits later versions (prefix, default) or only the named version (exact); exact also limits the Default option.

feature: deniedModels block list
detail: Managed key that blocks specific models or whole families, hiding them from /model even if allowlisted; a version-less ID also blocks later minor versions.

feature: Default effort level setting
detail: effortLevel sets default reasoning effort (low, medium, high, xhigh) for models without a saved level; --effort and CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL override per session; /effort saves per model.

feature: enforceAvailableModels for Default option
detail: When true, the /model Default choice resolves to the first available model in the allowlist instead of a model outside it; no effect without availableModels.

feature: Fallback model chain
detail: fallbackModel lists backup models (up to three) tried in order when the primary is overloaded or unavailable; switches for the rest of the turn with a notice; --fallback-model overrides.

feature: Fast mode setting
detail: fastMode turns fast mode (faster, higher cost per token) on for sessions; /fast writes it; supported on certain Opus and Fable models only; env var can disable it.

feature: Require per-session fast mode opt-in
detail: fastModePerSessionOptIn makes each person run /fast every session; Team and Enterprise owners can deploy it via server-managed settings, which also refuses /fast on outside interactive terminals.

feature: Response language setting
detail: language makes Claude reply in any named language, also sets voice dictation language and session-title language; value is not validated.

feature: Maximum effort cap
detail: maxEffortLevel caps reasoning effort across /effort, picker, flags, skills and model defaults on every provider; lowest cap across scopes wins; per-model caps via modelSettings.

feature: Default model setting
detail: model sets the model new sessions start with; --model and ANTHROPIC_MODEL override per session; an admin organization default model can override it.

feature: Model ID overrides for providers
detail: modelOverrides maps Anthropic model IDs to provider IDs such as Bedrock inference profile ARNs for governance, cost allocation or regional routing.

feature: Custom /model picker lineup
detail: modelPicker lists the models the /model picker offers with custom order, labels, descriptions and a behavesAs hint; can replace or extend the built-in lineup; rows that cannot be served are dropped or grayed out.

feature: Contracted-rate spend reporting
detail: Managed modelPricing reports spend at organization rates (multiplier 0-10 and per-model input/output/cache rates) in /usage, status line, SDK cost, --max-budget-usd and OpenTelemetry.

feature: Per-model saved effort and compact window
detail: modelSettings stores per-model effortLevel, maxEffortLevel and autoCompactWindow (100000+ tokens or auto); /effort and the picker slider write it; /effort auto clears it.

feature: Output style setting
detail: outputStyle selects a built-in (e.g. Explanatory) or custom style that changes role, tone and format; takes effect next message.

feature: Prompt cache lifetime (main conversation)
detail: promptCacheTtl chooses 5m or 1h cache for interactive, -p and SDK turns; 1h keeps cache warm longer but bills cache writes higher.

feature: Prompt cache lifetime (subagents and helpers)
detail: subagentPromptCacheTtl sets 5m or 1h cache for subagents, workflows, compaction and session-title requests.

feature: Show thinking summaries
detail: showThinkingSummaries true shows full thinking summaries when expanding thinking with Ctrl+O; otherwise thinking is redacted to a collapsed stub.

feature: Switch models when a message is flagged
detail: switchModelsOnFlag chooses automatic switch to the fallback model when a safety classifier flags a request, or pause and ask (appears in /config); non-interactive runs end in error when false.

feature: Ultracode: plan a workflow for every task
detail: ultracode setting starts sessions with Claude planning a dynamic workflow for each substantive task; needs workflows enabled and a model supporting xhigh; /effort ultracode toggles per session.

feature: Managed-only permission rules
detail: allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly makes managed settings the sole source of allow, ask, deny rules, hides always-allow choices and ignores skill allowed-tools frontmatter from user and project sources.

feature: Auto mode classifier custom rules
detail: autoMode adds environment, allow, soft_deny and hard_deny prose rules to the auto mode classifier; include $defaults to keep built-ins; user or managed scope only.

feature: Classify all shell commands in auto mode
detail: autoMode.classifyAllShell sends every Bash and PowerShell command through the classifier and suspends shell allow rules while auto mode is active.

feature: Disable auto mode
detail: disableAutoMode set to disable removes auto mode from the Shift+Tab cycle and starts such sessions in default mode; for admins to prevent auto mode.

feature: Permissions object: allow, ask, deny and default mode
detail: permissions groups allow/ask/deny rule arrays, additional directories, read/write blocks, defaultMode, denyInsteadOfPrompting and disable options.

feature: Auto mode reviews shell commands in plan mode
detail: useAutoModeDuringPlan (default true; /config 'Use auto mode during plan') lets the classifier review shell commands while planning; false prompts for each non-read-only command.

feature: Permission allow rules
detail: permissions.allow approves listed tool uses without asking; rule syntax Tool or Tool(specifier) such as Bash(npm run *), Read(./.env), WebFetch(domain:x); MCP wildcards only in tool name; --allowedTools per session.

feature: Permission ask rules
detail: permissions.ask forces a prompt for listed tool uses even in acceptEdits or bypass modes; dontAsk mode denies them instead; hooks or mods can still allow.

feature: Permission deny rules
detail: permissions.deny blocks listed tool uses and hides matching files from search and reads; applies to file tools, recognized Bash file commands and redirections; glob tool names like * or mcp__* work; --disallowedTools per session.

feature: Additional working directories
detail: permissions.additionalDirectories (plus --add-dir and /add-dir) grants file access to directories outside the start folder; project entries need workspace trust.

feature: Block reads outside working directories
detail: permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories makes Read, Grep, Glob and LSP refuse outside paths in every mode including bypass, and extends to sandboxed commands; auto mode prompt can set it.

feature: Block writes outside working directories
detail: permissions.blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories makes Write, Edit and NotebookEdit refuse outside paths in every mode, removes worktree tools, and refuses settings-file writes; plan files and scratchpad stay writable.

feature: Default permission mode setting
detail: permissions.defaultMode picks the starting mode: default/manual, acceptEdits, plan, auto, dontAsk or bypassPermissions; auto and bypass only honored from user settings; --permission-mode overrides.

feature: Deny instead of prompting (unattended sessions)
detail: permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting denies calls that would wait on a prompt so unattended sessions keep running; also drops AskUserQuestion and plan tools, cancels MCP elicitation, stops after 20 consecutive refusals in auto mode.

feature: Disable bypassPermissions mode
detail: permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode set to disable rejects --dangerously-skip-permissions and subagent bypass frontmatter; typically managed by admins.

feature: Skip auto mode first-use notice
detail: skipAutoPermissionPrompt hides the one-time explanation shown when you first enter auto mode yourself; user or managed only.

feature: Skip bypass-mode confirmation dialog
detail: skipDangerousModePermissionPrompt skips the confirmation before bypassPermissions mode; written when you accept the dialog once; untrusted repos cannot set it.

feature: Bash sandbox for commands
detail: sandbox object isolates Bash commands from filesystem and network (and credentials) on macOS, Linux and WSL2; off by default; /sandbox panel writes enabled to local settings.

feature: Fail if sandbox unavailable
detail: sandbox.failIfUnavailable makes Claude Code exit at startup when sandboxing is enabled but cannot start; otherwise commands run unsandboxed; for managed security gates.

feature: Auto-allow sandboxed Bash commands
detail: sandbox.autoAllowBashIfSandboxed runs sandboxed commands without a permission prompt (default false since v2.1.324); deny and scoped ask rules still apply.

feature: Sandbox excluded commands
detail: sandbox.excludedCommands lists command patterns run outside the sandbox (e.g. docker *); compound, cd, sudo, substitution and redirect shapes stay sandboxed; still go through permissions.

feature: Strict sandbox mode (no unsandboxed retry)
detail: sandbox.allowUnsandboxedCommands false stops Claude retrying blocked commands outside the sandbox via dangerouslyDisableSandbox; shown as Strict sandbox mode in /sandbox Overrides; managed false makes sandbox admin-required.

feature: Sandbox filesystem path controls
detail: sandbox.filesystem allowWrite, denyWrite, denyRead, allowRead lists with path prefixes (/, ~/, ./) and wildcard rules differing on Linux; Edit/Read permission rules feed the same lists.

feature: Sandbox allowManagedReadPathsOnly
detail: Managed lock honoring only allowRead entries from managed settings so developers cannot re-open blocked read paths.

feature: Disable sandbox filesystem isolation
detail: sandbox.filesystem.disabled keeps network isolation but gives commands unrestricted filesystem access; user or managed only.

feature: Sandbox ignoreViolations
detail: sandbox.ignoreViolations silences violation reports for expected probe paths per command substring; access is still blocked.

feature: Weaker nested sandbox for Docker
detail: sandbox.enableWeakerNestedSandbox lets the Linux sandbox run inside an unprivileged container by bind-mounting existing /proc; reduces security.

feature: Weaker network isolation on macOS
detail: sandbox.enableWeakerNetworkIsolation lets Go-based tools (gh, gcloud, terraform) verify TLS behind a MITM proxy via trustd; opens an exfiltration path.

feature: Allow Apple Events in sandbox
detail: sandbox.allowAppleEvents on macOS lets sandboxed open/osascript send Apple Events; removes code-execution isolation; user or managed only.

feature: Allow nested user namespaces in sandbox
detail: sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces on Linux/WSL2 lets Chromium, Electron, nested bubblewrap and unshare create user namespaces; disables a security boundary; ignored from project files.

feature: Custom ripgrep in sandbox
detail: sandbox.ripgrep points the sandbox at your own ripgrep binary with optional args.

feature: Custom bubblewrap path
detail: Managed sandbox.bwrapPath names an absolute bwrap binary outside PATH, e.g. air-gapped hosts.

feature: Custom socat path for sandbox
detail: Managed sandbox.socatPath names a socat binary outside PATH for the sandbox network proxy (Linux and WSL2).

feature: Sandbox credential protection (deny or mask)
detail: sandbox.credentials declares credential files and env vars to hide (deny) or replace with placeholders the sandbox proxy swaps for real values on outbound requests (mask); no built-in list; mask honored only from user, managed or --settings.

feature: Sandbox credential files: deny or mask
detail: sandbox.credentials.files blocks reads of credential files or masks them (Linux/WSL2 sentinel copy; unreadable on macOS) with injectHosts, extract regex, decode jwt, maskClaims, maskDuplicates and onExtractNoMatch options.

feature: Sandbox credential env vars: deny or mask
detail: sandbox.credentials.envVars removes or masks environment variables (e.g. GITHUB_TOKEN) inside the sandbox, with extract regex, JWT decode and maskClaims, injectHosts and onExtractNoMatch options.

feature: Allow plaintext credential injection
detail: sandbox.credentials.allowPlaintextInject permits mask substitution on plain HTTP as well as TLS-terminated HTTPS; for trusted test networks only.

feature: AWS credential pairs for re-signing
detail: sandbox.credentials.awsPairs links custom-named AWS key, secret and session-token variables so the proxy can SigV4 re-sign requests.

feature: SigV4 unsupported request handling
detail: sandbox.credentials.sigv4 sets deny or passthrough for streaming, presigned and SigV4A AWS request forms the proxy cannot re-sign.

feature: Sandbox network controls
detail: sandbox.network controls hosts, ports and sockets sandboxed commands reach via an enforcing proxy; WebFetch domain rules feed the same lists.

feature: Sandbox allowed Unix sockets (macOS)
detail: sandbox.network.allowUnixSockets lists socket paths sandboxed commands can use on macOS; ignored on Linux and WSL2; broad sockets like docker.sock grant wide control.

feature: Allow all Unix sockets in sandbox
detail: sandbox.network.allowAllUnixSockets lets commands use every Unix socket (and AF_VSOCK on Linux); only way to permit sockets on Linux/WSL2; on WSL2 reopens Windows interop.

feature: Allow local binding in sandbox (macOS)
detail: sandbox.network.allowLocalBinding lets sandboxed commands listen on ports and reach localhost on macOS, e.g. dev servers; no effect on Linux/WSL2.

feature: Allow Mach lookup services (macOS)
detail: sandbox.network.allowMachLookup lists XPC/Mach service names (e.g. com.apple.CoreSimulator.*) for tools like iOS Simulator or Playwright.

feature: Sandbox allowed domains
detail: sandbox.network.allowedDomains pre-allows hosts (wildcards, optional :port, bracketed IPv6) so the sandbox does not prompt.

feature: Sandbox denied domains
detail: sandbox.network.deniedDomains blocks hosts even inside an allowed wildcard; merges from every source even with managed-only lock.

feature: Strict network allowlist
detail: sandbox.network.strictAllowlist denies hosts outside the allowlist instead of prompting; sandboxed commands only; user or managed.

feature: Managed-only network allowlist
detail: sandbox.network.allowManagedDomainsOnly honors only managed allowed domains and auto-blocks everything else; makes sandbox admin-required.

feature: Custom HTTP proxy for sandbox
detail: sandbox.network.httpProxyPort routes sandbox HTTP traffic through your own proxy to inspect, filter or log; Claude Code stops applying its domain lists to that traffic.

feature: Custom SOCKS proxy for sandbox
detail: sandbox.network.socksProxyPort routes sandbox SOCKS5 traffic through your own proxy.

feature: Sandbox TLS termination (experimental)
detail: sandbox.network.tlsTerminate lets the proxy read HTTPS contents with an ephemeral or supplied CA; required for credential masking.

feature: Auto-compact toggle
detail: autoCompactEnabled (/config Auto-compact) compacts the conversation automatically near the context limit; manual /compact still works; DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT overrides.

feature: Auto-compact window size
detail: autoCompactWindow sets tokens (100000 minimum, capped at model window) before auto compaction; --autocompact flag and /autocompact command override or save per model.

feature: Auto memory directory
detail: autoMemoryDirectory stores auto memory in a chosen directory instead of ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory; project-supplied values need workspace trust.

feature: Auto memory on/off
detail: autoMemoryEnabled (also /memory toggle) lets Claude read and write auto memory; false stops both; env var CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY overrides.

feature: Inline Bash output limit
detail: bashOutputMaxChars sets 4000-128000 characters of command output sent to Claude inline (default 30000); longer output is saved to a file with a preview.

feature: Organization-wide CLAUDE.md
detail: Managed claudeMd injects CLAUDE.md-style instructions as managed memory loaded before user and project files.

feature: Exclude CLAUDE.md files
detail: claudeMdExcludes skips matching CLAUDE.md files (glob or absolute path) in user, project, local memory; managed policy files cannot be excluded.

feature: Environment variables in settings
detail: env sets environment variables for every session and subprocess; project/local files cannot set storage-location, telemetry, sign-in and similar sensitive variables; empty string cancels a shell export.

feature: File checkpoints for /rewind
detail: fileCheckpointingEnabled (/config Rewind code) snapshots files before each edit so /rewind can restore them; ignored in -p and SDK runs unless enabled separately.

feature: Idle compaction
detail: idleCompaction compacts a long conversation after about an hour away (before the one-hour cache expires, context at least 200k by default) and shows a notice; toggle in /config; CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS sets threshold.

feature: Plans directory
detail: plansDirectory chooses where plan-mode plan files are stored relative to the project root (default ~/.claude/plans); paths outside the project fall back.

feature: Skill listing context budget
detail: skillListingBudgetFraction (default 1% of context) caps how much context the skill listing uses; over the cap, least-used skills lose descriptions; /doctor shows usage.

feature: Skill description length cap
detail: skillListingMaxDescChars caps characters of description and when_to_use shown per skill in the listing (default 1536).

feature: taskOutputMaxChars (removed)
detail: Setting that sized TaskOutput tool output; removed in v2.1.277 along with the tool and has no effect now.

feature: Question auto-continue timeout
detail: askUserQuestionTimeout (/config) lets an unanswered AskUserQuestion dialog auto-submit selected options after 60s, 5m or 10m; default never.

feature: Continue automatically at usage limit
detail: autoContinueAtUsageLimit (/config) waits in the open session and resumes the task after a claude.ai usage limit resets; default on; can be started manually from the limit menu.

feature: Auto-scroll in fullscreen
detail: autoScrollEnabled (/config) makes fullscreen rendering follow new output to the bottom; false keeps scroll position; permission prompts still show.

feature: Screen-reader mode
detail: axScreenReader renders flat text without borders or animations using the classic renderer; --ax-screen-reader and CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER override; cannot be set from project files.

feature: Record files changed by Bash
detail: bashEditDiffEnabled records which Git files changed while a Bash command ran, shows a diff and passes the list to PostToolUse hooks; on by default only in auto and bypass modes.

feature: Company announcements at startup
detail: companyAnnouncements shows one random organization message at each session start (first entry on first launch).

feature: Default shell for ! commands
detail: defaultShell picks Bash or PowerShell for ! prefixed commands; PowerShell needs the PowerShell tool on; falls back to the other shell if unavailable.

feature: Dialog expiry
detail: dialogExpiry sets 60s, 5m (default), 10m or never for dialogs forwarded to Remote Control/SDK hosts, held cross-session messages and the Fable credits consent prompt; /config row.

feature: Editor mode (vim)
detail: editorMode chooses normal or vim key bindings (NORMAL, INSERT, VISUAL) in the prompt input; /config Editor mode.

feature: Emoji shortcode completion
detail: emojiCompletionEnabled shows emoji suggestions after : and replaces completed shortcodes like :heart:; can be disabled.

feature: Custom @ file suggestion command
detail: fileSuggestion runs your command (JSON query on stdin, up to 15 paths out, 5s limit) to supply @ autocomplete instead of the built-in traversal.

feature: Footer link badges from regex
detail: footerLinksRegexes turns matched IDs in turn output (e.g. issue keys) into clickable badges below the input using a URL template and named capture groups.

feature: Footer badge limits
detail: Footer link badges must keep the template's origin, URLs up to 2048 chars, https/http or editor deep-link schemes (vscode, cursor, zed, jetbrains, slack, linear, notion, figma), labels truncated to 28 columns, max 5 badges; /clear removes them.

feature: keybindingFlavor (deprecated)
detail: Former classic/readline word-editing switch; no effect since v2.1.261 because word editing always follows readline conventions.

feature: Prose width cap
detail: maxProseWidth (minimum 40 columns) wraps paragraphs, headings, lists and quotes at a readable width in wide terminals while tables and code keep full width.

feature: Reduce motion
detail: prefersReducedMotion (/config Reduce motion) reduces or removes spinner, shimmer and flash animations.

feature: Prompt suggestions toggle
detail: promptSuggestionEnabled (/config Prompt suggestions) shows grayed-out predicted prompts in the input; needs claude.ai or Console account with telemetry on.

feature: Respect .gitignore in file picker
detail: respectGitignore (/config) controls whether the @ file picker omits gitignored files; default true.

feature: Respond to ! shell commands toggle
detail: respondToBashCommands false adds ! command output to context without Claude replying, so several commands can be run before asking.

feature: Clear context on plan accept
detail: showClearContextOnPlanAccept adds a 'Yes, clear context and ...' first choice on the plan approval menu that approves, clears context and implements from the plan, showing context used by planning.

feature: Turn duration message
detail: showTurnDuration (/config) shows or hides the 'Cooked for ... done <time>' line after each response.

feature: Spell check in prompt input
detail: spellcheck underlines misspellings in the prompt using aspell, hunspell or ispell you install; options enabled, checker, language and color; off by default.

feature: Spinner tips toggle
detail: spinnerTipsEnabled (/config Show tips) shows or hides rotating feature tips while Claude works.

feature: Custom spinner tips
detail: spinnerTipsOverride adds or replaces tips with ids, cooldownSessions, priority, a tipsFile (256 KB), a label prefix and excludeDefault; project files may only add plain strings; max 200 tips.

feature: Custom spinner verbs
detail: spinnerVerbs appends to or replaces the rotating verbs shown while a turn runs.

feature: Custom status line
detail: statusLine runs your command to render a line below the prompt (model, cost, git branch) with padding, refreshInterval and hideVimModeIndicator options; limited to managed value under managed-hooks-only.

feature: Disable syntax highlighting
detail: syntaxHighlightingDisabled shows diffs, code blocks and previews as plain text, e.g. for theme clashes or screen readers.

feature: Terminal progress bar
detail: terminalProgressBarEnabled (/config) reports busy state to tab or taskbar in ConEmu, Ghostty 1.2+ and iTerm2 3.6.6+, including while background subagents or workflows run.

feature: Terminal title from /rename
detail: terminalTitleFromRename false keeps the generated tab title instead of the session name set by /rename or --name.

feature: Color theme
detail: theme (/config) picks auto, dark, light, dark/light daltonized (colorblind-friendly), dark/light ANSI-only, or a custom theme from ~/.claude/themes or a plugin; default dark.

feature: Time format
detail: timeFormat (/config) shows times as auto, 12-hour, 24-hour, 24-hour UTC, or a strftime pattern in the turn duration and transcript viewer.

feature: Time zone
detail: timeZone shows interface times in an IANA zone instead of system time; settings-file only.

feature: Fullscreen or classic renderer
detail: tui (/tui fullscreen|default) selects flicker-free alt-screen renderer with virtualized scrollback or classic renderer; env vars override; agent-view sessions always fullscreen.

feature: Verbose output
detail: verbose (/config) shows full tool input and output inline instead of collapsed summaries; Ctrl+O toggles expanded transcript.

feature: Transcript view mode
detail: viewMode starts sessions in default, verbose or focus view (focus shows last prompt, one-line tool summaries with diffstats and final response; needs fullscreen renderer).

feature: Vim INSERT-mode remaps
detail: vimInsertModeRemaps maps a two-key sequence like jj to Escape in vim editor mode.

feature: Voice dictation setting
detail: voice object (written by /voice) turns dictation on with hold-to-talk or tap-to-start/tap-to-send mode and optional autoSubmit on release; requires a claude.ai account.

feature: voiceEnabled (deprecated)
detail: Older single-Boolean form of the voice dictation toggle replaced by voice.enabled since v2.1.92.

feature: Mouse-wheel scroll acceleration
detail: wheelScrollAccelerationEnabled false gives constant scroll per wheel notch in fullscreen rendering.

feature: Attribution on commits and PRs
detail: attribution object customizes or hides (false) the Co-Authored-By trailer on commits, text in PR descriptions and the session URL; user CLAUDE.md rules take precedence unless set in managed settings.

feature: includeCoAuthoredBy (deprecated)
detail: Old Boolean for hiding the commit trailer and PR text; replaced by attribution since v2.0.62.

feature: Built-in git instructions toggle
detail: includeGitInstructions false removes Claude's built-in commit/PR workflow instructions and the git status snapshot (branch, status, recent commits) from context; cloud sessions never include the snapshot.

feature: PR link URL template
detail: prUrlTemplate points rendered PR links at an internal review tool using {host}, {owner}, {repo}, {number}, {url}; GitLab MR links unchanged.

feature: Commit attribution text
detail: attribution.commit sets or empties the commit trailer; default is Co-Authored-By naming the model used (or Claude / Claude Code when unknown).

feature: PR attribution text
detail: attribution.pr sets or empties the line added to pull request descriptions; default is a Generated with Claude Code line.

feature: Session URL in commits and PRs
detail: attribution.sessionUrl false omits the claude.ai session link (Claude-Session trailer, PR URL) from cloud and Remote Control commits and PRs.

feature: Allowed HTTP hook URLs
detail: allowedHttpHookUrls restricts HTTP hooks to URL patterns (wildcards allowed) merged across settings files.

feature: Managed hooks only
detail: allowManagedHooksOnly runs only managed, SDK and force-enabled plugin hooks; blocks user/project/local hooks, other plugin hooks and monitors, command plugins and narrows status line and file suggestion to managed; /goal cannot run.

feature: Disable all hooks
detail: disableAllHooks turns off hooks, custom status line and file suggestion command (and mods) without deleting them; managed scope disables even managed hooks; /goal cannot run.

feature: Disable dynamic workflows (org-wide)
detail: disableWorkflows true turns off dynamic workflows and bundled workflow commands for everyone settings reach; env var CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS per session.

feature: Dynamic workflows toggle
detail: enableWorkflows (/config Dynamic workflows) turns dynamic workflows on or off for yourself; default on except on the Pro plan where off.

feature: Hooks configuration
detail: hooks registers commands, prompts, agents, HTTP requests or MCP tools at lifecycle events (e.g. PreToolUse) with matcher groups; hooks merge across files and managed ones cannot be removed.

feature: HTTP hook allowed env vars
detail: httpHookAllowedEnvVars limits which environment variables HTTP hooks may interpolate into headers; works with each hook's allowedEnvVars.

feature: Ultracode keyword trigger
detail: workflowKeywordTriggerEnabled (/config) lets typing 'ultracode' in a prompt start a dynamic workflow; false lets you type it freely.

feature: Workflow size guideline
detail: workflowSizeGuideline advises agent count for workflows: unrestricted, small (<5), medium (<10, default), large (<50); Pro default small; /config Dynamic workflow size.

feature: Disable bundled skills
detail: disableBundledSkills removes skills and workflows shipped with Claude Code and hides built-in commands like /init from the model.

feature: Disable inline shell in skills
detail: disableSkillShellExecution replaces inline shell blocks in skills and custom commands with a disabled notice; managed true cannot be overridden; bundled and managed skills unaffected.

feature: Skill visibility overrides
detail: skillOverrides sets each skill to on, name-only, user-invocable-only or off to control what Claude sees and /autocomplete lists; /skills menu writes local settings; not for plugin skills.

feature: claude.ai skills sync toggle
detail: syncClaudeAiSkills false stops downloading skills enabled on your claude.ai account into ~/.claude/skills/synced and stops loading them; skills sync in terminal, Cowork and cloud sessions by default.

feature: claude.ai plugins sync toggle
detail: syncClaudeAiPlugins false stops downloading account-enabled plugins (loaded as name@synced) in terminal and Cowork sessions; per-plugin off via enabledPlugins.

feature: Allowed channel plugins
detail: Managed allowedChannelPlugins replaces the default Anthropic allowlist of channel plugins (e.g. telegram) that can push messages into sessions; empty array blocks all.

feature: Blocked plugin marketplaces
detail: Managed blockedMarketplaces blocks marketplace sources (github owner wildcards, skills-dir) on add, install, update and auto-update; also applied by claude.ai admin console for git marketplaces.

feature: Channels enablement
detail: Managed channelsEnabled allows channels; blocked by default on Team and Enterprise and on Console accounts with managed settings, allowed on Pro, Max, Ultra.

feature: Block command-sourced plugins
detail: Managed disableCommandPluginSources stops plugins that install by running a marketplace-declared command, and marketplace headersHelper commands.

feature: Plugin install suggestions marketplaces
detail: Managed pluginSuggestionMarketplaces names marketplaces whose plugins can surface as contextual install suggestions in spinner tips and /plugin Discover.

feature: Plugin trust warning custom text
detail: Managed pluginTrustMessage appends organization text to the plugin install trust warning.

feature: Strict marketplace allowlist
detail: Managed strictKnownMarketplaces allows only listed marketplace sources (github, git, url, file, directory, hostPattern, pathPattern, skills-dir); empty array blocks all including the official one.

feature: Strict plugin-only customization
detail: Managed strictPluginOnlyCustomization locks skills, agents, hooks and/or MCP servers from user and project sources so only managed and marketplace plugin ones load; also stops skills-directory plugins.

feature: Enabled plugins per scope
detail: enabledPlugins turns plugins on or off keyed plugin@marketplace across user, project, local, managed scopes; managed false blocks install everywhere.

feature: Extra known marketplaces
detail: extraKnownMarketplaces registers marketplaces (github, git, url with headers/headersHelper, file, directory, inline settings) for a repo or org with optional autoUpdate; official marketplaces auto-update by default.

feature: Plugin configuration answers store
detail: pluginConfigs holds answers to plugin config dialogs (secrets go to Keychain or credentials file); also stores built-in plugin options like AGENTS.md instruction file loading.

feature: Organization mods run before user mods
detail: prependPlugins lists managed plugins whose mods run before every user-installed mod, in order; sec-default@builtin is the built-in guard.

feature: Organization mods run after user mods
detail: appendPlugins lists managed plugins whose mods run after every user-installed mod.

feature: Claude.ai connectors alongside managed MCP
detail: Managed allowAllClaudeAiMcps loads claude.ai connectors next to a deployed managed-mcp.json, which otherwise has exclusive control and suppresses them.

feature: Claude in Chrome with managed MCP
detail: Managed allowClaudeInChromeWithManagedMcp lets the built-in Claude in Chrome server run alongside managed-mcp.json in terminal sessions; only from device-level managed settings.

feature: MCP server allowlist
detail: allowedMcpServers allows only servers matching serverName, serverCommand or serverUrl patterns, including plugin, claude.ai and --mcp-config servers; built-in, IDE and org-delivered servers are exempt; empty list blocks all user-added servers.

feature: Managed-only MCP allowlist
detail: Managed allowManagedMcpServersOnly makes the managed allowedMcpServers the only allowlist; deny lists still merge from every scope.

feature: MCP server denylist
detail: deniedMcpServers blocks servers by serverName (incl. claude.ai connector display names), serverCommand or serverUrl wherever defined; takes precedence over the allowlist.

feature: Disable claude.ai connectors
detail: disableClaudeAiConnectors true stops Claude Code from fetching or connecting claude.ai MCP connectors; a project file can opt a repo out; ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS=false per session.

feature: Reject project .mcp.json servers
detail: disabledMcpjsonServers rejects named servers from a project's .mcp.json without prompting; written when you reject in the approval dialog.

feature: Approve all project MCP servers
detail: enableAllProjectMcpServers approves every server in project .mcp.json without prompting; ignored from the shared project file in untrusted folders.

feature: Approve specific project MCP servers
detail: enabledMcpjsonServers approves named servers from a project's .mcp.json so they connect without asking.

feature: Managed remote MCP servers
detail: Managed managedMcpServers provides remote http/sse MCP servers to every user, who cannot edit or remove them but may add their own.

feature: Default agent (main thread as subagent)
detail: agent runs the main session as a named built-in or custom subagent with its prompt, tools and model; also default for sessions dispatched from claude agents; --agent overrides.

feature: Cross-session inbound messages
detail: crossSessionInbound chooses accept, hold (notice only) or refuse for messages from your other Claude Code sessions; /config row 'Messages from your other sessions'; stricter project value applies.

feature: Disable agent view and background agents
detail: disableAgentView turns off claude agents, --bg, /background and the on-demand supervisor; org-enforceable.

feature: Approve cross-machine session messages
detail: isolatePeerMachines requires approval before SendMessage reaches your sessions on other machines, even in bypassPermissions mode.

feature: Corporate launcher process wrapper
detail: processWrapper (macOS/Linux) puts a corporate launcher command in front of Claude Code's background processes; ignored on Windows.

feature: Agent team display mode
detail: teammateMode shows agent team teammates in-process (default), auto (split panes in tmux/iTerm2), tmux or iterm2 split panes; --teammate-mode overrides.

feature: Worktree configuration
detail: worktree object configures git worktrees for --worktree, EnterWorktree, isolated subagents and background sessions; .worktreeinclude file copies gitignored files like .env into new worktrees.

feature: Worktree base ref
detail: worktree.baseRef: fresh branches new worktrees from origin default branch (default), head branches from your local HEAD including unpushed commits.

feature: Symlink directories into worktrees
detail: worktree.symlinkDirectories symlinks directories such as node_modules or .cache from the main repo into each worktree to save disk.

feature: Sparse worktree checkout
detail: worktree.sparsePaths checks out only listed directories (plus root files) in each worktree via sparse-checkout, faster in monorepos.

feature: Background session isolation
detail: worktree.bgIsolation: worktree (default) blocks Edit/Write in the main checkout until EnterWorktree; none lets background jobs edit the working copy; sessions moved to background via arrow or /background edit in place.

feature: Desktop SSH worktree location
detail: worktree.location sets where Desktop SSH sessions create worktrees on the remote machine instead of the project's .claude/worktrees; Desktop SSH connection setting takes precedence.

feature: Push when Claude decides
detail: agentPushNotifEnabled (/config 'Push when Claude decides') lets Claude push to your phone when it judges something worth sending, e.g. long task done, while Remote Control is connected; setup via mobile push notifications.

feature: Session recap on return
detail: awaySummaryEnabled (/config Session recap) shows a one-line recap after a few minutes away; never in non-interactive mode.

feature: disableArtifact (deprecated)
detail: Old key to turn off the Artifact tool, which publishes session output as a private claude.ai page; replaced by enableArtifact.

feature: Disable claude-cli:// deep link handler
detail: disableDeepLinkRegistration set to disable stops registering the claude-cli:// protocol handler that lets external tools open a session with a pre-filled prompt.

feature: Disable on-device Code sessions in Desktop
detail: Managed disableDesktopLocalSessions grays out the local computer/WSL entry, defaults new sessions to SSH, and refuses to start local sessions; SSH to other hosts and cloud unaffected.

feature: Disable Remote Control
detail: disableRemoteControl true refuses claude remote-control, --remote-control, auto-start and the in-session toggle; usable via MDM.

feature: Disable scripts in SSH/WSL HTML previews
detail: Managed disableRemotePreviewScripts stops scripts running in the Desktop Browser pane's HTML previews from SSH and WSL sessions; external browsing unaffected.

feature: Artifact tool toggle
detail: enableArtifact false (/config Artifacts) turns off the Artifact tool that publishes output as a private web page on claude.ai; no file or admin setting can be overridden back on.

feature: Push when actions required
detail: inputNeededNotifEnabled (/config 'Push when actions required') sends a phone push when a permission prompt or question awaits input, while Remote Control is connected.

feature: Local notification channel
detail: preferredNotifChannel (/config Local notifications) picks auto, terminal_bell, iterm2, iterm2_with_bell, kitty, ghostty or notifications_disabled for task-complete and permission-prompt alerts.

feature: Default cloud environment
detail: remote.defaultEnvironmentId sets the default cloud (or self-hosted ccpool_) environment for claude --cloud sessions; /remote-env writes it; --environment overrides.

feature: Remote Control auto-connect
detail: remoteControlAtStartup (/config 'Enable Remote Control for all sessions') connects Remote Control when each interactive session starts; --remote-control forces on; project true is ignored.

feature: Desktop SSH connections (sshConfigs)
detail: sshConfigs adds shared SSH connections (id, name, sshHost, port, identity file) to the Desktop environment selector; users can set their own worktree folder but not edit others.

feature: Desktop SSH host allowlist
detail: Managed sshHostAllowlist limits Desktop SSH sessions (and jump hosts) to host patterns; empty array turns SSH sessions off.

feature: SSH connections from a command
detail: sshHostCommands adds Desktop SSH connections whose host is printed by a command (e.g. dev-box creator); needs recent Desktop and a Claude account sign-in.

feature: Allowed API providers
detail: Managed allowedProviders limits which services Claude is reachable through: anthropic, bedrock, vertex, foundry, anthropicAws, anthropicGoogleCloud, mantle, customEndpoint (pinned via managed env), gateway; unlisted providers refused at startup, login and mid-session.

feature: API key helper command
detail: apiKeyHelper runs your shell command to produce the credential sent as X-Api-Key and Bearer headers, for rotating or vault-fetched keys; value is cached and rerun on expiry.

feature: AWS auth refresh command (Bedrock)
detail: awsAuthRefresh runs your command (e.g. aws sso login) when STS check fails for Bedrock credentials; concurrent processes share one run with a 60s wait fallback.

feature: AWS credential export command (Bedrock)
detail: awsCredentialExport runs your command printing AWS credentials JSON, scoped to Claude's own Bedrock client so shell commands keep ambient credentials; always run when set.

feature: Enforce Anthropic sign-in
detail: Managed enforceAnthropicSignIn requires a claude.ai login on Anthropic's API or an Enterprise Admin Console sign-in (with forceLoginOrgUUID); also stops Desktop sessions on cloud providers or gateways.

feature: Force login method
detail: forceLoginMethod restricts login to claudeai, console or a cloud gateway; claudeai also hides the keyless Console sign-in; applies to VS Code, SDK, setup-token and install-github-app flows.

feature: Cloud gateway URL for login
detail: forceLoginGatewayUrl sets the gateway the /login Cloud gateway screen connects to, making machines gateway-only when set in managed settings.

feature: Force login organization
detail: forceLoginOrgUUID requires claude.ai logins to belong to one or several organizations (managed); in other files pre-selects the organization at login; hides keyless Console sign-in.

feature: Allow gateway on internal public IPv4 blocks
detail: Managed gatewayInternalNetworks (max four CIDR blocks /8-/32) lets /login accept a cloud gateway on public address space the org uses internally.

feature: Google Cloud auth refresh command
detail: gcpAuthRefresh runs your command to refresh Application Default Credentials for Google Cloud's Agent Platform when expired; concurrent processes share one run.

feature: OpenTelemetry headers helper
detail: otelHeadersHelper runs your command at startup and periodically to produce rotating OTLP export headers as JSON; refresh interval via env var.

feature: Auto-update channel
detail: autoUpdatesChannel (/config Auto-update channel) follows latest (default) or stable (about a week old, skipping major regressions); claude install stable|latest also sets it; Homebrew casks choose channel by package.

feature: Minimum auto-update version
detail: minimumVersion stops auto-updates and claude update installing versions below it; written when you stay on your version while switching channels; managed value cannot be overridden.

feature: Required maximum version
detail: Managed requiredMaximumVersion makes Claude Code refuse to start above a version and skips newer auto-updates; claude update/install/doctor keep working; Desktop local sessions can fail if its bundled copy is newer.

feature: Required minimum version
detail: Managed requiredMinimumVersion makes Claude Code exit at startup when older than a version; claude update, install and doctor still work for recovery.

feature: Block Claude tools on external pages (Desktop Browser pane)
detail: Managed browserExternalPageTools disabled stops Claude reading or acting on external pages in the Desktop Browser pane while people and localhost previews still work.

feature: Disable external browsing in Desktop Browser pane
detail: Managed disableBrowserExternalNavigation turns off external sites in the Desktop Browser pane for people and Claude; localhost previews work; SSH/WSL HTML previews run without scripts.

feature: Disable Claude's iOS Simulator tools
detail: Managed disableMobileSimulatorTools blocks Claude's tools for the Desktop iOS Simulator pane; people keep manual use and cannot re-enable it in-app.

feature: Transcript retention period
detail: cleanupPeriodDays sets days (minimum 1, default 30) before session transcripts and app data are deleted, removing old sessions from /resume; Desktop/Cowork transcripts are kept by default.

feature: Desktop and Cowork transcript age limit
detail: desktopSessionCleanupPeriodDays sets an optional age limit (0 = none) for transcripts of Claude Desktop or Cowork sessions; deletion needs older than both this and cleanupPeriodDays.

feature: Claude-drafted feedback mode
detail: feedbackDrafts (/config Claude-drafted feedback) sets notify (card above prompt, up to three per session), quiet (footer count, review in /feedback) or off (removes SendFeedback tool).

feature: Session quality survey rate
detail: feedbackSurveyRate sets probability (0-1) that the session quality survey appears; 0 hides it; default set remotely or 0.005 on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry; also covers VS Code.

feature: Skip WebFetch domain safety check
detail: skipWebFetchPreflight true skips the hostname check sent to api.anthropic.com before WebFetch; for restrictive-egress cloud deployments; pair with WebFetch permission rules.

feature: Disable sideload flags
detail: Managed disableSideloadFlags rejects --plugin-dir, --plugin-url, --agents, --mcp-config, CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS and SDK addPlugins that bypass marketplace restrictions; cloud sessions drop server-delivered MCP config.

feature: Fail-closed server-managed settings refresh
detail: Managed forceRemoteSettingsRefresh blocks CLI startup until server-managed settings are freshly fetched and exits on failure; claude auth subcommands exempt.

feature: Managed sources behavior (first-wins or merge)
detail: Managed managedSourcesBehavior chooses whether only the highest-priority managed source applies or all admin sources combine (lists merge, locks take strictest, allowlists whole, env per variable).

feature: Parent settings from embedding hosts
detail: Managed parentSettingsBehavior first-wins drops or merge applies (through a restrictive filter) settings supplied by hosts like the Agent SDK or IDE/Desktop alongside an admin managed tier.

feature: Policy helper program
detail: Managed policyHelper runs an executable at startup (and optionally on an interval) that emits managedSettings JSON from device posture, identity or a remote service; failure at startup blocks launch.

feature: Policy helper path
detail: policyHelper.path names the absolute helper executable (Windows: .exe drive or UNC path); required when policyHelper is set.

feature: Policy helper timeout
detail: policyHelper.timeoutMs sets the wait before a run is treated as failed (minimum 1000, default 10000).

feature: Policy helper refresh interval
detail: policyHelper.refreshIntervalMs re-runs the helper in the background (0 off, else at least 60000) so policy changes reach running sessions without restart.

feature: WSL inherits Windows managed settings
detail: Managed wslInheritsWindowsSettings makes WSL read managed settings from the Windows policy chain (HKLM/ProgramFiles) instead of only /etc/claude-code.

feature: Auto-connect to IDE from external terminal
detail: autoConnectIde (in ~/.claude.json; /config row) connects to a running VS Code or JetBrains IDE when Claude Code starts in an external terminal; --ide connects regardless.

feature: Auto-install IDE extension via /ide
detail: autoInstallIdeExtension (global config) lets /ide install the Claude Code extension in a running VS Code, Cursor or Devin Desktop from an external terminal; env var can skip.

feature: Claude in Chrome enabled by default
detail: claudeInChromeDefaultEnabled (global config; /chrome, /config) starts interactive CLI and VS Code sessions with Chrome integration on without --chrome; --no-chrome overrides; remote-control project sessions follow it.

feature: Skip the /copy picker
detail: copyFullResponse (global config; /config) makes /copy always copy the full response instead of offering a choice among code blocks or blockquotes.

feature: Copy on select
detail: copyOnSelect (global config; /config in fullscreen) copies mouse-selected text to the clipboard automatically in fullscreen rendering and agent view; default on.

feature: Open agent view by default
detail: defaultToAgentsView (global config; /config) makes claude with no arguments open agent view instead of a new conversation unless agent view is disabled.

feature: Diff tool: IDE or terminal
detail: diffTool (global config; /config when IDE connected) shows proposed Edit/Write diffs in the connected VS Code or JetBrains diff viewer (auto) or keeps them in the terminal.

feature: Show last response in external editor
detail: externalEditorContext (global config; /config) makes the Ctrl+G external editor buffer start with Claude's last response (last 50 lines) as # comments that are stripped on save.

feature: Left arrow opens agent view
detail: leftArrowOpensAgents (global config; /config '← opens agents') lets pressing left arrow on an empty prompt background the session and open agent view; attached sessions still detach.

feature: PR status footer badge
detail: prStatusFooterEnabled (global config; /config) shows a footer badge with a colored underline for the current branch's open pull or merge request status.

feature: Ctrl+E command explanation (removed)
detail: Model-generated explanation of Bash/PowerShell permission prompts via Ctrl+E and its off switch; removed in v2.1.257.

feature: Default teammate model (removed)
detail: Setting for the model of agent team teammates without a named model; removed in v2.1.234 along with its /config row.

feature: Four settings scopes: user, shared project, project local, managed
detail: Settings live in JSON files with a scope: user (~/.claude/settings.json), shared project (.claude/settings.json), project local (.claude/settings.local.json) and managed policy from an organization.

feature: User settings file
detail: Personal preferences such as theme, editor mode, default model and own permission rules, applied in every project on the machine.

feature: Shared project settings committed to git
detail: Team permissions, hooks, plugins and env variables stored in the repo so everyone who clones gets them; some keys wait for folder trust.

feature: Project local settings file
detail: Personal per-project overrides, auto-added to global git excludes the first time Claude Code writes it; Bash 'don't ask again' approvals are saved here.

feature: Managed settings delivery: file, MDM, server-managed, host
detail: Organizations enforce policy via managed-settings.json, MDM/OS policy, server-managed settings from the claude.ai admin console or a Claude apps gateway, or an embedding host such as Claude Desktop.

feature: Managed model keys: availableModels and deniedModels lock models
detail: A managed model value is only a default; availableModels and deniedModels are the real locks and override user lists, while --model picks only from allowed models.

feature: /config menu
detail: Terminal menu with a Config tab for personal options like theme, editor mode and verbose output; /config key=value sets one option directly. Not available in VS Code chat panel or desktop app.

feature: /status shows loaded setting sources
detail: Status tab lists each settings file loaded and, for managed settings, how they reached the machine; /status and /config open the same dialog on different tabs.

feature: claude doctor lists rejected settings
detail: Read-only diagnostics command that lists settings entries Claude Code dropped, install health and update status; useful after a -p run ignores a setting.

feature: Settings error and warning dialogs
detail: Invalid JSON or rejected values show a Settings Error dialog offering to fix with Claude, exit or continue; individual bad entries produce a Warning and are skipped. Print mode shows no dialog.

feature: Settings JSON schema for editor autocomplete
detail: A published $schema URL gives autocomplete and validation for settings files in VS Code, Cursor and other editors; it can lag behind newest releases.

feature: --settings flag for one-session overrides
detail: Pass inline JSON or a file path at launch to override any user-level key for that session only, above user/project/local but below managed settings.

feature: Per-key flags and environment variables
detail: Some keys have their own flag (--model, --effort) or paired env variable (ANTHROPIC_MODEL) that overrides settings files, decided pair by pair.

feature: Live reload of settings files
detail: Edits to user, project, local and managed files, including permissions, hooks and credential helpers, apply to a running session without restart; a ConfigChange hook fires for direct edits.

feature: Settings precedence stack
detail: Highest wins: managed, command line, project local, shared project, user. List keys like permissions.allow merge across files instead of overriding.

feature: Special merge rules for model keys
detail: fallbackModel and modelPicker take the whole value from the highest source; availableModels from managed is applied as-is; modelSettings resolves per model together with effortLevel.

feature: Restrictive keys honored from any scope
detail: Keys like disableClaudeAiConnectors, enableArtifact false, isolatePeerMachines, blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories, blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories and denyInsteadOfPrompting keep their stricter value even against managed settings.

feature: Block reads and writes outside working directory
detail: Settings permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories and blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories stop file tools leaving the project folder; removing them needs a restart of running sessions.

feature: permissions.defaultMode auto and bypassPermissions only from user or managed
detail: These default permission modes do not take effect from project or local settings; use user/managed settings or --permission-mode for one session.

feature: Telemetry export env vars ignored from project settings
detail: Telemetry export variables in an env block don't take effect from shared or local project files except a few off values.

feature: Workspace trust gates project allow rules
detail: permissions.allow, additionalDirectories, extraKnownMarketplaces and most env values from a committed file apply only after the user trusts the folder; deny and ask rules apply immediately.

feature: Settings repo-root placement of local file
detail: In a git repo the local settings file is read and written at the repository root (main checkout in a worktree), with exceptions outside git, in home dir, on Windows or with ownership mismatches.

feature: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR relocates config folder
detail: Setting this variable moves settings, session history and plugins from ~/.claude (or %USERPROFILE%\.claude) to another directory.

feature: ~/.claude.json self-managed state file
detail: Claude Code writes this file for account details, MCP server configs, per-project trust decisions and global config keys; corrupted copies are backed up and the user is asked to fix or reset.

feature: /model picker with s to switch without saving
detail: /model saves the default for new sessions; pressing s in the picker switches the model for the session only. /effort sets effort level mid-session.

feature: Settings in cloud sessions
detail: Cloud sessions read only committed project settings (single repo), plus server-managed settings; user and local files, device MDM files and most repo keys in multi-repo sessions or projects don't apply.

feature: /config in cloud opens claude.ai settings page
detail: In the browser cloud session /config opens the claude.ai Code settings page; change a cloud setting via environment variables on the environment.

feature: Cowork sessions skip server-managed settings
detail: In a local Cowork session in Claude Desktop, Claude Code ignores console server-managed settings but reads device policy unless requireCoworkFullVmSandbox is set.

feature: Output style saved to local settings
detail: The Output style choice in /config is written to .claude/settings.local.json rather than user settings.

feature: Spinner tips toggle (spinnerTipsEnabled)
detail: Setting controls the one-line tips shown under the spinner while Claude works.

feature: System requirements
detail: macOS 13+, Windows 10 1809+/Server 2019+, Ubuntu 20.04+, Debian 10+, Alpine 3.19+; 4 GB RAM, x64 or ARM64; internet; Bash, Zsh, PowerShell or CMD; supported countries only.

feature: Native installer (curl/PowerShell/CMD)
detail: Recommended install via a shell script for macOS/Linux/WSL, PowerShell or CMD on Windows; installs a binary that auto-updates in the background.

feature: Install via Homebrew with stable and latest casks
detail: claude-code cask tracks stable (about a week behind); claude-code@latest tracks latest; no auto-update unless CLAUDE_CODE_PACKAGE_MANAGER_AUTO_UPDATE=1.

feature: Install via WinGet
detail: winget install Anthropic.ClaudeCode; updates are manual or via the package-manager auto-update env variable.

feature: Install via apt, dnf, apk repositories
