detail: Signed Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora/RHEL and Alpine repositories with stable and latest channels; updates arrive via normal system upgrades.

feature: Install via npm
detail: Global npm package @anthropic-ai/claude-code requiring Node 22+, installing the same native binary through per-platform optional dependencies; never use sudo.

feature: Native Windows vs WSL 1 vs WSL 2
detail: Native Windows works without Git for Windows but has no sandboxing; WSL 2 supports sandboxing; WSL 1 does not.

feature: Windows Bash tool via Git Bash, PowerShell tool fallback
detail: With Git for Windows Claude uses Git Bash for the Bash tool (path override via CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH); without it, shell commands run via the PowerShell tool, toggled by CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL.

feature: Alpine/musl requirements
detail: Alpine needs bash and curl installed first; Claude Code requires bash or zsh.

feature: claude --version and claude doctor
detail: Version command verifies install; doctor prints read-only install health, settings validation errors and last auto-update result.

feature: Claude Code requires Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise or Console account
detail: Free claude.ai plan has no Claude Code access; log in via browser prompts, or use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY after approval, or Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform or Microsoft Foundry.

feature: Background auto-updates
detail: Native installs check at startup and periodically, download in the background and apply on next start; custom launchers are left alone and all versions are kept.

feature: Release channel: latest or stable
detail: autoUpdatesChannel (also /config Auto-update channel) picks latest or a roughly one-week-old stable build; new models may need latest.

feature: minimumVersion pin
detail: Prevents auto-update and claude update from installing below a version, to move to stable without downgrading; /config can fill in the current version; managed minimumVersion enforces org-wide.

feature: requiredMinimumVersion and requiredMaximumVersion
detail: Managed settings that make Claude Code refuse to start outside an allowed version range.

feature: Disable auto-updates: DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER and DISABLE_UPDATES
detail: DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER stops background checks only; DISABLE_UPDATES blocks every update path including claude update and install.

feature: claude update manual update
detail: Applies an update immediately and reports the new version or that it is up to date.

feature: Install a specific version or channel
detail: Installer accepts a version number or stable/latest argument; the chosen channel becomes the auto-update default.

feature: Network storage install guidance
detail: Install on local disk, keep each version in its own directory and disable Claude Code updates on shared NFS homes to avoid crashes from deleted binaries.

feature: Signed release manifest with SHA256 checksums
detail: Releases from 2.1.89 publish a GPG-signed manifest of platform binary checksums; macOS binaries are notarized, Windows signed, Linux verified via manifest or package signatures.

feature: Uninstall paths and removing configuration
detail: Per-method uninstall commands; removing ~/.claude, ~/.claude.json, .claude and .mcp.json deletes settings, MCP config and session history; VS Code, JetBrains and desktop also recreate ~/.claude.

feature: Desktop app download for macOS, Windows, Linux
detail: Graphical alternative to the terminal for using Claude Code.

feature: Skills: SKILL.md instructions invoked by /name or automatically
detail: A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md; Claude loads it when relevant or the user runs /skill-name. The body loads only on use so long references cost little context. Follows the open Agent Skills standard.

feature: Custom commands merged into skills
detail: Files in .claude/commands/ still work and Claude can invoke them; add disable-model-invocation to stop that, or convert to a skill folder for supporting files.

feature: Bundled skills (/doctor, /code-review, /batch, /debug, /loop, /claude-api)
detail: Prompt-based skills shipped with Claude Code that orchestrate work with tools; most are in every session, some like /workflow-authoring need dynamic workflows. disableBundledSkills turns them off.

feature: /doctor setup checkup
detail: Diagnoses install health, unused extensions and slow hooks, duplicate CLAUDE.md content, permission suggestions (auto mode, read-only pre-approvals) and plan usage changes; asks before changing anything. Stays typable even with bundled skills off.

feature: /doctor prompt-audit
detail: Checks CLAUDE.md files, skills and other config for outdated or conflicting instructions.

feature: /run, /verify and /run-skill-generator
detail: /run launches and drives the app to see a change working; /verify builds and runs to confirm a change; /run-skill-generator records a per-project launch recipe as .claude/skills/run-<name>/. /verify can record its own recipe.

feature: Pre-commit verify/simplify instruction
detail: If a user, project or personal skill named verify or simplify exists and is model-invocable, Claude is told to run it before each non-doc, non-test commit (needs includeGitInstructions on).

feature: /claude-api skill with subcommands
detail: Loads Claude API and Managed Agents reference for the project language, auto-activates on anthropic SDK imports; subcommands include migrate, upgrade, api-version, managed-agents-onboard, managed-agents-secure, prompt-audit, cost-optimize, latency-optimize, build-eval, hillclimb, preserved-thinking-migration.

feature: Skill locations: enterprise, personal, project, nested, plugin, account
detail: Where a skill lives decides where it loads: managed directory for all users, ~/.claude/skills for all projects, .claude/skills per repo, nested subdirectories, --add-dir directories, plugins as /plugin:skill, and skills synced from a claude.ai account.

feature: Nested and monorepo skill discovery
detail: Project skills load from the start dir up to repo root; skills below it load when Claude touches files there, or sooner via /add-dir. Same-named nested skills appear as /dir:name.

feature: Skills from --add-dir directories with prefixed names
detail: A skill from an added directory that clashes with another gets a prefix, e.g. /cli:verify.

feature: Same-name skill resolution order
detail: Enterprise beats personal beats project; a custom skill replaces a bundled or built-in command (not its aliases); skill beats .claude/commands file; plugin skills are namespaced.

feature: Skills in Cowork and cloud sessions
detail: Cowork and cloud sessions (including scheduled cloud tasks) don't read ~/.claude/skills; they load skills enabled on the claude.ai account (managed at claude.ai/customize/skills) or committed repo skills. Desktop scheduled tasks run locally and do read personal skills.

feature: Skills synced from claude.ai into the terminal
detail: Signed-in terminal sessions download account-enabled skills (including Anthropic's pdf, xlsx) into ~/.claude/skills/synced and re-check about every 10 min active or 40 min idle; shown under 'claude.ai sync'; download only, never uploaded.

feature: syncClaudeAiSkills setting and org Skills toggle
detail: Users can set syncClaudeAiSkills false to stop syncing (existing skills moved to .trash); organizations turn off Skills on claude.ai or set the key in managed settings to stop sync for everyone.

feature: Synced skills run as /anthropic-skills:name when names clash
detail: A synced skill answers to its short name unless another command uses it, then only its full anthropic-skills: name; the name namespace is reserved and local skills with it don't load.

feature: Synced skill body restrictions in terminal and VS Code
detail: In terminal and VS Code, a synced skill's ! commands, @ file references and path placeholders are not executed or substituted; descriptions are sanitized.

feature: Live skill change detection and /reload-skills
detail: Adding, editing or removing skills under watched directories applies mid-session; /reload-skills forces a refresh.

feature: Removing skills by source
detail: Delete the folder for personal/project, admin deletes enterprise, /plugin uninstall for plugin skills, turn off in claude.ai for synced, or skillOverrides off / disableBundledSkills for bundled.

feature: Skill folder as a plugin (.claude-plugin/plugin.json)
detail: A personal or project skill folder with a plugin manifest loads as name@skills-dir with its own agents, hooks and MCP servers; project ones need workspace trust and admin approval.

feature: Skill frontmatter: name, description, when_to_use
detail: Name sets the command; description plus when_to_use drive automatic triggering and are truncated to 1,536 characters in the skill listing.

feature: Skill frontmatter: argument-hint and arguments
detail: argument-hint shows an autocomplete hint; arguments declares named positional arguments usable as $name.

feature: Skill frontmatter: disable-model-invocation and user-invocable
detail: disable-model-invocation true makes a skill manual-only (and keeps it out of subagent preload and scheduled-task prompts); user-invocable false hides it from the / menu so only Claude can use it.

feature: Skill frontmatter: allowed-tools pre-approval
detail: Lists tools Claude may use without prompting for the turn the skill is invoked; clears at the next message; supports ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR} in Bash rules. Ignored when managed allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly applies.

feature: Skill frontmatter: disallowed-tools
detail: Removes listed tools from Claude's pool while the skill is active, until the next user message.

feature: Skill frontmatter: model and effort overrides
detail: A skill can set the model and effort level (low, medium, high, xhigh, max) for the current turn only; respects org availableModels; with context fork they apply to the subagent.

feature: Skill frontmatter: context fork, agent, background
detail: context: fork runs the skill in an isolated subagent (agent picks type such as Explore, Plan or a custom one); runs in background by default, background: false waits for the result.

feature: Skill frontmatter: hooks
detail: A skill can register hooks when invoked that stay active for the session; blocked for non-plugin skills when managed strictPluginOnlyCustomization locks hooks.

feature: Skill frontmatter: paths globs
detail: Glob patterns that activate the skill only when Claude works with matching files.

feature: Skill frontmatter: shell bash or powershell
detail: Chooses the shell for inline ! commands; powershell needs the PowerShell tool enabled.

feature: Skill frontmatter: metadata, license, compatibility
detail: Free-form metadata map and Agent Skills spec fields accepted but not acted on by Claude Code.

feature: claude.ai skill uploads accept only spec frontmatter fields
detail: Uploads to claude.ai or the Skills API allow only name, description, license, compatibility, metadata and allowed-tools; other Claude Code fields cause a hard error.

feature: Skill command naming rules
detail: Command name comes from folder or frontmatter name; plugin skills are prefixed plugin:name; commands in subfolders become dir:name; names with invisible or special characters are refused.

feature: Skill string substitutions
detail: $ARGUMENTS, $ARGUMENTS[N], $N, $name, ${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID}, ${CLAUDE_EFFORT}, ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}, ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}, ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} and ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA} are replaced in skill content; backslash escapes literal $.

feature: Supporting files in a skill folder
detail: Skills can bundle reference docs, examples and scripts loaded on demand; keep SKILL.md under 500 lines.

feature: Control who invokes a skill and where the name is typed
detail: A /name at message start runs the skill directly; after plain text it only grants permission for Claude to run it; manual-only skills are blocked if Claude tries on its own.

feature: Skill content persists across turns and compaction
detail: Invoked skill text stays in context; on auto-compaction the latest invocation of each skill is re-attached up to 5,000 tokens each within a 25,000-token shared budget.

feature: Stack several skills in one message
detail: At the terminal prompt, up to six skills can be typed at the start of a message and all load with trailing text as arguments; not in SDK or -p mode.

feature: Dynamic context injection with !`command`
detail: Shell commands in a skill run before Claude sees it and their output is inlined; multi-line blocks use ```!; a failing command aborts the invocation; disableSkillShellExecution disables it.

feature: Permission checks on injected skill commands
detail: Injected commands never prompt; deny rules abort, unmatched ones abort unless pre-approved via allowed-tools, and in auto mode they load with an instruction for Claude to run them.

feature: Skill-run subagents lose checkpoint coverage
detail: Edits made by a backgrounded forked skill are not restored by /rewind.

feature: Restrict skill access with Skill permission rules
detail: Deny the Skill tool to disable all skills, or use Skill(name) and Skill(name *) allow/deny rules, including anthropic-skills: names for synced skills.

feature: skillOverrides: on, name-only, user-invocable-only, off
detail: Settings map that controls skill visibility without editing SKILL.md; /skills menu cycles states with Space and saves to local settings; off also hides from Remote Control and SDK lists. Plugin skills unaffected.

feature: /skill-doctor skill usage report
detail: Reports each skill's context cost and usage, flags never-invoked ones and unused plugins; shows in the /plugin Stats tab or as text with -p; not available over Remote Control.

feature: Skill listing budget settings
detail: Descriptions share a budget of 1% of context; skillListingBudgetFraction, SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET and skillListingMaxDescChars adjust it; /context shows the cost.

feature: Evaluate skills: claude plugin eval and skill-creator plugin
detail: plugin eval runs prompts with and without a plugin and gates CI; the skill-creator plugin builds test cases, runs isolated subagent grading, benchmarks, blind A/B and description tuning.

feature: claude plugin validate for SKILL.md frontmatter
detail: Finds skill files whose YAML fails to parse.

feature: Share skills via project, plugin or managed settings
detail: Skills are distributed by committing .claude/skills, packaging in a plugin, or deploying through managed settings.

feature: Skills trash recovery
detail: Removed or disabled synced skills move to ~/.claude/skills/.trash and are swept after 30 days by default.

feature: Project skills also load in Claude Tag channels
detail: Skills committed to a repo are also loaded when that repo is used in a Claude Tag channel.

feature: Skills settings: Cowork scheduled tasks load account skills
detail: Interactive and scheduled Cowork sessions load skills enabled for the claude.ai account at session start.

feature: Claude Code in Slack: @Claude starts a cloud coding session
detail: Mentioning @Claude with a coding task in a channel creates a Claude Code cloud session under the user's own account, repositories and plan limits. Earlier version, answers only Pro/Max/Ultra accounts in workspaces not connected to Claude Tag.

feature: Slack use cases: bug fixes, quick reviews, parallel tasks
detail: Delegate bug investigation, small features or refactors and let work run asynchronously with notifications on completion.

feature: Slack prerequisites
detail: Needs Pro/Max/Ultra plan, a workspace not connected to Claude Tag, cloud sessions enabled, GitHub connected at claude.ai/code with a repo, and Slack linked to the Claude account.

feature: Install Claude app from Slack App Marketplace
detail: A workspace admin adds the Claude app; each user then clicks Connect Claude account in the App Home to link their account.

feature: Routing Mode: Code only or Code + Chat
detail: App Home setting: Code only sends every @mention to Claude Code; Code + Chat auto-routes between Claude Code sessions and regular Claude chat replies.

feature: Switch to code repo button
detail: When Claude answers in Chat but a coding session was wanted, the button lets the user pick a repository and restarts the request as a Claude Code session.

feature: Invite Claude to channels with /invite @Claude
detail: Claude is not auto-added anywhere and only responds to @mentions in channels (public or private) where it was invited; not in DMs.

feature: Automatic coding-intent detection
detail: In Code + Chat mode Claude decides whether a mention is a coding task; users can also explicitly tell it to treat a request as coding.

feature: Slack context gathering from thread or channel
detail: In a thread Claude reads the thread; in a channel it reads recent messages plus channel name, topic and description to pick a repo and understand the task. Context may contain instructions, so use only in trusted conversations.

feature: Slack progress updates and completion DM
detail: Claude posts status updates in the thread, then edits its message with the final response and action buttons and sends the user a direct message linking to it.

feature: View session button
detail: Opens the full Claude Code session at claude.ai/code to read the transcript, continue the session or make more requests.

feature: Create PR button
detail: After a session finishes, opens GitHub's compare page for the session branch so the user can open a pull request.

feature: Select repository prompt
detail: If Claude can't infer the repo from the conversation it asks the user to choose one from a list.

feature: Slack per-user access model
detail: Sessions run under each user's own Claude account, count toward their own plan limits, and can use only repositories they personally connected; they appear in their claude.ai/code history.

feature: Slack workspace admin controls
detail: Workspace admins decide whether to install the app, Enterprise Grid admins choose which workspaces get it, and removing the app immediately revokes access for all users.

feature: Channel-based access control for Claude in Slack
detail: Admins limit use by choosing which channels Claude is invited to and who can access those channels.

feature: Slack-created sessions visible to org
detail: For Team and Enterprise accounts, sessions started from Claude in Slack are automatically visible to the organization via cloud session sharing.

feature: Slack vs web guidance
detail: Use Slack for async tasks and team visibility; use the web for file uploads, real-time interaction and longer complex tasks.

feature: Claude Tag as the replacement for Team and Enterprise
detail: Claude Tag runs @Claude as an organization's shared identity with admin-configured access and is the path for Team and Enterprise; it is not available on individual plans.

feature: Legacy Claude in Slack bot retired October 5, 2026
detail: In workspaces connected to an organization, the earlier bot stops responding and posts a retirement notice; an Owner must turn on Claude Tag for the channel, workspace or org default in admin settings.

feature: Workspace not set up for Claude Tag notice
detail: Replies with this notice when no org connected the workspace and the linked account isn't Pro, Max or Ultra; the @Claude connect command starts setup.

feature: Claude Tag channel sessions need an organization-shared environment
detail: Channel sessions can't run in a personal cloud environment; an Owner shares the environment with the org or recreates it, and can set it as org default or per channel.

feature: Claude Code not enabled error requires web onboarding
detail: Each user must sign in at claude.ai/code once and finish onboarding so a default cloud environment exists.

feature: Slack limitations: GitHub only, one PR per session
detail: Repositories must be on GitHub, each session can create one pull request, and cloud session access is required.

feature: Custom status line bar running a shell script
detail: A configurable bar at the bottom of the terminal that runs any script, feeding it JSON session data on stdin and showing its output; runs locally and uses no API tokens. Appears above the built-in footer badges.

feature: /statusline command generates a status line from natural language
detail: Describe what to show and Claude writes a script in ~/.claude and updates settings; asking it to delete or clear removes the status line.

feature: statusLine setting: type, command, padding
detail: Manual config in user or project settings with a command (script path or inline shell) and optional horizontal padding in characters.

feature: statusLine refreshInterval
detail: Re-runs the command every N seconds (min 1) in addition to event triggers, for clocks or when subagents change git state while idle.

feature: hideVimModeIndicator
detail: Suppresses the built-in INSERT mode text when the script renders vim.mode itself.

feature: Footer hints hidden when a custom status line is set
detail: A custom status line removes hints such as '? for shortcuts' and the hold-space voice dictation hint.

feature: footerLinksRegexes clickable footer badges
detail: Setting that adds clickable link badges in the footer when an ID matching a regex appears in the conversation, without scripting.

feature: Status line update triggers and debounce
detail: Runs at session start/resume and after new assistant messages, /compact, permission mode change, vim mode toggle, command edits, refresh timer, rate-limit reset time and prompt-cache expiry; debounced 300 ms and in-flight runs are cancelled.

feature: Status line output: multiple lines, ANSI colors, OSC 8 links
detail: Scripts can print several rows, color text with ANSI codes and make clickable links (Cmd/Ctrl+click) in terminals like iTerm2, Kitty, WezTerm; Terminal.app doesn't support links; FORCE_HYPERLINK overrides detection.

feature: Status line temporarily hides during help menu and permission prompts
detail: The bar is hidden during some UI interactions; it stays blank until workspace trust is accepted and goes blank if the script exits non-zero.

feature: COLUMNS and LINES passed to status line script
detail: Terminal size is exposed to the script via environment variables because tput cannot read it.

feature: Status line data: model, directory, workspace, repo, worktree
detail: JSON includes model id/name, cwd, project dir, added dirs, git worktree, repo host/owner/name and worktree session fields (name, path, branch, original cwd/branch).

feature: Status line data: session cost and duration
detail: Includes estimated session cost in USD (list price unless modelPricing set), total wall time, API wait time and lines added/removed; cost resets on /clear.

feature: Status line data: context window usage
detail: Provides token counts, window size, used and remaining percentage (input-only formula), current_usage breakdown and an exceeds-200k flag.

feature: Status line data: 5-hour and 7-day rate limit usage
detail: Pro, Max and Ultra subscribers get used percentage and reset time for the 5-hour and weekly windows after the first API response.

feature: Status line data: gateway spend limit
detail: Behind a Claude apps gateway, shows spend-limit percentage, reset time and, from v2.1.284, estimated dollars used, limit and period (daily/weekly/monthly).

feature: Status line data: prompt cache statistics
detail: Exposes warm state, TTL (5m or 1h), expiry, requests, misses, hit ratio, tokens written, last miss cause and re-cache cost; the same stats appear on the /usage 'Prompt cache (main)' line.

feature: Status line data: fast mode, effort level, thinking
detail: Shows whether fast mode and extended thinking are on and the session effort level (low, medium, high, xhigh, max) when the model supports it.

feature: Status line data: session id, name, prompt id, transcript, version
detail: Exposes session id, custom or AI-generated session name, current prompt UUID, transcript path and Claude Code version.

feature: Status line data: output style, vim mode, agent name
detail: Includes the active output style, vim mode (NORMAL, INSERT, VISUAL, VISUAL LINE) and agent name when --agent is used.

feature: Status line data: open PR or GitLab merge request
detail: Gives PR/MR number, URL, review state (approved, pending, changes_requested, draft) and kind for the current branch, mirroring the footer PR badge.

feature: Status line on Windows via Git Bash or PowerShell
detail: Commands run through Git Bash if installed, else PowerShell; use forward slashes in paths or invoke PowerShell scripts explicitly.

feature: disableAllHooks and allowManagedHooksOnly affect the status line
detail: With disableAllHooks only a managed statusLine runs; allowManagedHooksOnly removes a user's custom status line unless managed settings supply one.

feature: Notifications share the status line row
detail: System notices (MCP errors, auto-updates, context-low) show on the right of the row outside fullscreen; verbose mode adds a context token counter; narrow terminals may truncate the status line.

feature: Debugging a status line with claude --debug
detail: Debug logs the script's stderr on each run and its exit code on the first run in a session.

feature: Subagents: specialized assistants with their own context
detail: Each subagent has its own context window, system prompt, tool access and permissions; Claude delegates matching tasks and gets back a summary. Its requests count toward the same plan usage limits.

feature: Subagent description budget warning at 15,000 tokens
detail: Startup warns when combined custom subagent descriptions exceed 15,000 tokens; everything still loads.

feature: Built-in Explore subagent
detail: Fast read-only agent for searching codebases (Write/Edit denied), skips CLAUDE.md and git status; Claude picks quick, medium or very thorough. Runs on the parent model, or on Opus for subscription/Console users when the parent is Fable; a custom Explore overrides it.

feature: Built-in Plan subagent
detail: Read-only research agent used in plan mode to gather codebase context in a separate window; inherits the parent model.

feature: Built-in general-purpose subagent
detail: Capable agent with all subagent tools for multi-step work needing exploration and edits.

feature: Other helper agents: claude, statusline-setup, claude-code-guide, web-fetch
detail: claude is a catch-all and the default for dispatched background sessions; statusline-setup (Sonnet) runs /statusline; claude-code-guide (Haiku) answers feature questions; web-fetch (Haiku) reads web pages.

feature: Disable built-in subagents
detail: Deny Agent(Explore) etc. in permissions, deny the Agent tool, set CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPLORE_PLAN_AGENTS=1 for Explore/Plan only, or CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_DISABLE_BUILTIN_AGENTS=1 in non-interactive and SDK use.

feature: Create a subagent by asking Claude
detail: Describe the subagent and where to save it; Claude writes a Markdown file with name, description, tools, model and prompt, and delegations show as tool-call rows like code-improver(...).

feature: /agents command now prints a reminder instead of a wizard
detail: From v2.1.198 on /agents tells users to ask Claude or edit agent folders; v2.1.197 and earlier open an interactive wizard with Running and Library tabs.

feature: Subagent scopes and priority
detail: Managed settings beat --agents flag, which beats project .claude/agents, user ~/.claude/agents and plugin agents; nested project dirs are scanned and the closest definition wins; files are scanned recursively.

feature: --agents flag for session-only subagents
detail: Pass JSON (or a file path in non-interactive mode, v2.1.281+) defining agents with prompt and frontmatter fields; not saved to disk.

feature: Managed subagents from admin directory
detail: Admins place agent files in the managed settings directory; they take precedence over same-named project/user agents.

feature: Plugin subagents with scoped names and security limits
detail: Plugin agents appear as plugin:agent (plus subfolders) in @-mention; hooks, mcpServers and permissionMode frontmatter are ignored for plugin agents.

feature: Live reload of agent files
detail: Edits to ~/.claude/agents and .claude/agents are picked up within seconds; --add-dir agent folders and --disable-slash-commands sessions need a restart.

feature: --append-subagent-system-prompt and file variant
detail: Non-interactive flags append text to every subagent's system prompt (forks excepted).

feature: Subagent worktree isolation guards
detail: Subagents with isolation: worktree run commands inside their worktree; commands resolving to the main checkout or redirecting git there are blocked.

feature: Subagent frontmatter: name and description
detail: Only required fields; name up to 256 chars with no colon, description tells Claude when to delegate ('use proactively' encourages it).

feature: Subagent frontmatter: tools and disallowedTools
detail: Allowlist or denylist of tools (including whole MCP servers with mcp__server__*); disallowedTools applies first; a specifier still removes the whole tool.

feature: Subagent frontmatter: model
detail: Choose sonnet, opus, haiku, fable, a full model ID or inherit; resolution order is per-invocation parameter, definition, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, then the parent model.

feature: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE runs every subagent on one model
detail: With the variable pair set, definition model fields and per-call models are ignored for all subagents, teammates and workflow agents (forks excepted).

feature: Org allowlist fallback for blocked subagent model
detail: If availableModels blocks a subagent's model it falls back to the newest permitted family version, the SUBAGENT_MODEL value, or the parent model, with a warning.

feature: /tasks shows each subagent's model and effort
detail: Subagent rows name the running model and any effort level (v2.1.242+).

feature: Extended thinking inherited by subagents
detail: Subagents use the main conversation's thinking configuration; there is no per-subagent thinking setting.

feature: Subagent effort level: frontmatter, per-call, env
detail: effort field (low to max) sets the level; Claude can pass an effort per invocation (v2.1.292+); CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL overrides both, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT sets a default.

feature: Tools removed from all subagents
detail: AskUserQuestion, EnterPlanMode, ExitPlanMode (unless plan mode), ScheduleWakeup, Workflow, propose_skills, EndConversation and others are never available to subagents; Agent is withheld at the depth limit.

feature: Background subagents get a reduced built-in tool set
detail: Background subagents keep MCP tools, Read, Grep, Glob, LSP, Bash, Edit, Write, WebFetch, WebSearch, Skill, Monitor, SendMessage, Artifact and a few others; most other built-ins are removed.

feature: Restrict spawnable subagent types with Agent(type)
detail: For an agent run as main thread via --agent, tools: Agent(worker, researcher) allowlists which subagents it may spawn; omitting Agent forbids spawning.

feature: Task tool renamed Agent
detail: Since v2.1.63 the Task tool is called Agent; Task(...) rules keep working as aliases.

feature: Subagent-scoped MCP servers
detail: mcpServers frontmatter attaches servers only to the subagent (inline definitions of stdio, http, sse or ws type, or names of existing servers), disconnecting when it finishes and keeping their tools out of the main context.

feature: Trust required for inline MCP servers in project agents
detail: Inline servers in project or --add-dir agent files load only after the folder is trusted; managed policies like allowedMcpServers and --strict-mcp-config also apply.

feature: Subagent permissionMode
detail: Per-subagent mode: default (manual), acceptEdits, auto, dontAsk, bypassPermissions (only inherited) or plan; the main conversation's bypass, acceptEdits, auto or plan mode overrides it.

feature: Auto mode classifier reviews subagent work
detail: In auto mode the classifier checks a subagent's tool calls and its final report before delivery (not for agent-team teammates).

feature: Preload skills into subagents
detail: skills frontmatter injects full content of up to 32 skills at startup; skills with disable-model-invocation can't be preloaded; subagents can still invoke other skills unless Skill is denied.

feature: Persistent subagent memory: user, project, local scopes
detail: memory frontmatter gives a subagent a directory (~/.claude/agent-memory, .claude/agent-memory or agent-memory-local) whose first 200 lines or 25KB of MEMORY.md load into its prompt; needs auto memory on.

feature: Subagent hooks: frontmatter and SubagentStart/SubagentStop
detail: Hooks in agent frontmatter (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop) run while the subagent is active; settings.json SubagentStart/Stop hooks match by agent name; frontmatter hooks from project agents need trusted folders.

feature: Deny specific subagents with Agent(name) rules
detail: permissions.deny entries or --disallowedTools block named built-in or custom subagents, including Agent(fork).

feature: Automatic delegation and @-mention of subagents
detail: Claude delegates by description; users can name an agent, @-mention it from the typeahead (@agent-name also works manually), or run the whole session as it.

feature: --agent flag and agent setting run the session as a subagent
detail: Starts the main thread with the agent's prompt, tool limits and model (prompt replaces the default system prompt), shown as @name in the header; persists on resume; project default via agent setting.

feature: Foreground vs background subagents
detail: Foreground blocks the conversation with prompts passed through; background runs concurrently and surfaces permission prompts naming the subagent (approve, or Esc to deny one call). Spawned subagents default to background.

feature: Ctrl+B moves a running subagent to background
detail: In the terminal Ctrl+B (or Run in background in VS Code) backgrounds a waiting subagent when fork mode is off; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS=1 makes Claude always wait.

feature: Subagent panel and /tasks listing
detail: Finished subagent rows clear immediately with a 30-second /tasks hint; failed or stopped ones stay 30 seconds (x to clear); older transcripts reopen via Earlier in this session (v2.1.319+).

feature: Named subagents and agent-team teammates
detail: With agent teams on, Claude can name a subagent to make it addressable by SendMessage; a named spawn then launches as a teammate.

feature: API error handling in subagents
detail: Foreground errors return partial output with a note or a terminated-early error; background ones are marked failed with last output; a configured fallback model chain lets the subagent continue.

feature: Subagent output scanning
detail: Final reports are scanned: text imitating system tags gets backslashes and instruction-shaped text gets a marker line; reports arrive under a header saying their instructions carry no user authority.

feature: Subagent usage patterns: isolate, parallel, chain
detail: Documented patterns: isolate high-volume output, run parallel research subagents, chain subagents in sequence; many detailed results consume main context.

feature: /btw side questions without a subagent
detail: For a question about something already in the conversation, /btw answers with no tool access and isn't added to history; from v2.1.314 it can answer from an open subagent transcript.

feature: Nested subagents up to three layers
detail: Subagents may spawn subagents; depth limit set by CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH (1 disables); the panel shows a tree with (+N) descendant counts.

feature: Concurrent subagent limit of 20
detail: Spawning a 21st running subagent fails; CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS changes it and ultracode sessions are exempt; forks and resumes don't check it.

feature: What a subagent loads at startup
detail: Own system prompt, task message, CLAUDE.md files (unless omitted), git status snapshot, preloaded skills and sibling roster; not output style, parent auto memory, or conversation history.

feature: omitClaudeMd frontmatter
detail: Starts a subagent without user, project and local CLAUDE.md files (managed policy still loads) for agents that need only their delegation prompt.

feature: Resume subagents with SendMessage
detail: Claude can resume a finished or stopped subagent by ID or name with full prior history in the background; user-stopped agents are not auto-resumed; transcripts stored under ~/.claude/projects/.../subagents and cleaned after cleanupPeriodDays (30).

feature: maxTurns limit with partial output
detail: Stops a subagent after N agentic turns and marks output partial so it can be resumed.

feature: Subagent auto-compaction and autoCompactWindow
detail: Subagents compact automatically as their own windows fill; autoCompactWindow (100000+ tokens) makes one compact earlier; CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE applies too.

feature: Forks: subagents that inherit the whole conversation
detail: A fork keeps the parent's system prompt, tools, model and history, shares its prompt cache (cheaper) and returns only its final result; can use worktree isolation; cannot spawn forks.

feature: /subtask starts a fork
detail: /subtask <task> forks the conversation into a background panel row while you keep working; Claude can also fork on its own while fork mode is on (default from v2.1.302). /fork copies the whole session when agent view is on.

feature: Fork panel keys and follow-up messages
detail: Up/Down move rows, Enter opens a transcript to send follow-ups, x stops or dismisses, Esc returns to prompt; Ctrl+Enter or Ctrl+X Ctrl+S sends mid-work; /compact, /clear, /rewind need confirmation from this view and /model, /fast don't run there.

feature: Fork mode toggle (CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT)
detail: Set to 0 to stop Claude forking and let it wait for subagents; Agent(fork) deny stops forks only.

feature: Related: background agents, cross-session messaging, agent teams
detail: Pointers to agent view for many parallel sessions, cross-session messaging between sessions, and agent teams Claude supervises.

feature: Subagent frontmatter: color, initialPrompt, background, isolation
detail: color tints the subagent in the task list; initialPrompt auto-submits a first turn when run as the main agent; background forces background; isolation worktree gives a temporary git worktree cleaned up if unchanged.

feature: Subagent frontmatter experimental.cacheTtl
detail: Sets the prompt cache lifetime (5m or 1h) for a subagent's requests; 1h is ignored while a subscription uses usage credits.

feature: claude plugin validate for agents directories
detail: Checks agent files whose frontmatter fails to parse; files with no name are silently treated as documentation.

feature: Multiline prompt via Ctrl+J or backslash-Enter
detail: Enter submits; Ctrl+J or typing a backslash then Enter inserts a line break in every terminal with no setup.

feature: Shift+Enter newline (terminal dependent)
detail: Works out of the box in Ghostty, Kitty, iTerm2, WezTerm, Warp, Windows Terminal 1.25+, and kitty-protocol terminals (v2.1.269+). Unavailable in gnome-terminal and JetBrains terminals.

feature: /terminal-setup installs Shift+Enter binding
detail: One-time command for VS Code, Cursor, Devin Desktop, old Alacritty and Zed that writes a Shift+Enter keybinding into the terminal config; leaves existing bindings, must run outside tmux.

feature: /terminal-setup adjusts VS Code GPU and scroll settings
detail: In VS Code-family editors it turns GPU acceleration off to avoid garbled text and tunes mouse wheel sensitivity for fullscreen mode.

feature: /terminal-setup merges Zed keymap with backup
detail: In Zed it backs up keymap.json then merges the binding; if parse, backup or verify fails, or the file is a symlink, it prints the block to add manually.

feature: Custom newline/submit keys via chat:newline and chat:submit
detail: Keybindings file actions let you rebind newline or swap Enter and Shift+Enter behavior.

feature: Option-as-Meta setup on macOS
detail: Option shortcuts (Option+Enter newline, Option+P model switch) need the terminal to send Option as Meta; instructions for Apple Terminal, iTerm2 (Esc+) and VS Code setting.

feature: /terminal-setup enables Apple Terminal Option-as-Meta
detail: On macOS 26 and earlier it turns on Option as Meta and disables the profile's audible bell, except in screen reader mode where the bell is left on.

feature: /terminal-setup enables iTerm2 clipboard access
detail: In iTerm2 it permits applications to access the clipboard so /copy can write to the system clipboard; requires an iTerm2 restart.

feature: Desktop notification on task finish or permission prompt
detail: When Claude finishes or needs a permission decision while you are away, it emits a notification; shown as desktop alerts in Ghostty, Kitty and iTerm2, a silent bell in Apple Terminal, nothing elsewhere.

feature: preferredNotifChannel setting
detail: Chooses the notification channel: auto (default), terminal_bell, iterm2, kitty or ghostty; terminal_bell forces the bell character in any terminal.

feature: Notification forwarding over SSH
detail: With channel auto, Ghostty, Kitty and iTerm2 desktop notifications can arrive from a remote session; iTerm2 needs Notification Center Alerts and escape-sequence alerts enabled.

feature: Notification hook to play sound or run a command
detail: A Notification hook in settings can run any command, e.g. play a system sound, alongside the built-in notification.

feature: Session status reported to terminals (OSC 7501)
detail: Terminals implementing the Program Status Protocol can show per-session working, waiting or done state; needs v2.1.295+, not in tmux or background sessions; tab title omits status glyph then.

feature: tmux configuration for Shift+Enter and notifications
detail: Add allow-passthrough, focus-events and extended-keys lines to tmux.conf so Shift+Enter and desktop notifications work; panes in unviewed windows send no notification.

feature: Windows Backspace handling variable
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_BS_AS_CTRL_BACKSPACE set to 0 or 1 fixes terminals where Backspace deletes a word on Windows or Ctrl+Backspace deletes one char on Mac/Linux.

feature: /theme command and auto light/dark theme
detail: Pick a theme matching your terminal; auto option follows the terminal's light or dark background. Also available in /config.

feature: Built-in theme presets
detail: Presets: dark, light, dark-daltonized, light-daltonized, dark-ansi and light-ansi.

feature: Custom themes as JSON files
detail: Create via New custom theme in /theme or JSON in ~/.claude/themes with name, base and overrides; Ctrl+E edits; hot-reloaded; colors accept hex, rgb, ansi256 or ansi names.

feature: Theme color token overrides
detail: Tokens cover accent, text, status, input border, plan/accept-edits/bash/IDE/fast-mode indicators, diff backgrounds, message backgrounds, usage meter, You/Claude labels, shimmer variants.

feature: Subagent and ultrathink rainbow colors
detail: Eight named subagent colors and seven rainbow colors for the ultrathink word are individually themeable.

feature: Plugin-contributed themes
detail: Installed plugins can contribute themes that appear in /theme.

feature: Custom status line
detail: A configurable bar at the bottom can show model, directory, git branch or other context.

feature: Fullscreen rendering mode via /tui fullscreen
detail: Removes flicker and scroll jumps; scrolling and search use mouse/PageUp inside the app; setting is saved and conversation relaunches intact; also CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER env.

feature: Screen reader mode forces plain scrolling text
detail: In screen reader mode fullscreen is not applied and /tui fullscreen explains why.

feature: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_SYNC_OUTPUT to stop flicker
detail: Forces synchronized output for terminals not auto-detected, without changing renderer.

feature: maxProseWidth setting
detail: Wraps Claude's prose at a set column count in wide terminals.

feature: Large paste collapsed to placeholder
detail: Pastes over 800 characters or three lines show as [Pasted text #N +lines] but full content is sent; invisible Unicode is stripped on submit.

feature: Pasted text marked as untrusted to the model
detail: Claude is told pasted content may contain instructions you did not write and follows them only if your typed message asks.

feature: Delete and restore collapsed paste
detail: Word/line delete shortcuts remove a placeholder whole; Ctrl+Y or vim p restores it.

feature: Paste cache for recalled prompts
detail: Pasted content is stored under ~/.claude/paste-cache so recalled prompts resend it; expired cache entries are dropped with a notice, or cancel the submit for shell/slash commands.

feature: Vim editor mode for prompt
detail: Enable via /config Editor mode or editorMode vim; subset of NORMAL/VISUAL motions and operators; Enter still submits in INSERT; o/O or Ctrl+J add newlines.

feature: vimInsertModeRemaps
detail: Setting maps two-key INSERT sequences such as jj to Escape.

feature: Claude for Teams: self-service seats with Claude Code and web
detail: Per-seat subscription with pay-as-you-go option, SSO, admin tools, billing management, and server-managed Claude Code settings; includes both Claude Code and Claude on the web.

feature: Claude for Enterprise: domain capture, RBAC, compliance API
detail: Adds domain capture, role-based permissions and compliance API access on top of Teams.

feature: Deployment through cloud providers
detail: Claude Code can run via Anthropic Console, Amazon Bedrock, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud Agent Platform, or Microsoft Foundry; these do not include Claude on the web and bill pay-as-you-go.

feature: Authentication method per deployment option
detail: Teams/Enterprise use claude.ai SSO or email; Console uses API key or Console sign-in; cloud providers use API key or cloud credentials/Entra ID; wizard offered at login for Bedrock and Vertex.

feature: Cost tracking per deployment
detail: Usage dashboard for Anthropic options; AWS Cost Explorer, GCP Billing or Azure Cost Management for cloud providers.

feature: Claude apps gateway
detail: Self-hosted gateway that adds IdP sign-in in front of Bedrock, AWS, Google, Foundry or the Anthropic API.

feature: Corporate proxy and LLM gateway configuration
detail: HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY route traffic via a proxy; ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and provider variants route through a gateway for usage tracking, budgets and central auth; /status shows provider and proxy.

feature: CMEK and telemetry through gateways
detail: Customer-managed keys do not cover operational telemetry when using a gateway or custom base URL; DISABLE_TELEMETRY via managed settings turns it off org-wide.

feature: Pin model versions via default-model env vars
detail: For cloud providers, set default Fable, Opus, Sonnet and Haiku model variables so aliases do not move unexpectedly.

feature: allowedProviders managed setting
detail: Restricts which deployment providers a managed machine may use (e.g. bedrock only); needs v2.1.285+; Cowork sessions on Desktop count as anthropic.

feature: Organization-wide CLAUDE.md and shared MCP config
detail: Admins can deploy CLAUDE.md at multiple levels and check a .mcp.json into repos so everyone gets the same integrations.

feature: Managed security permissions
detail: Security teams can set managed permissions controlling what Claude Code may do.

feature: Agent tool spawns subagents with own context
detail: Delegates a task to a subagent with a separate context window; only the final result returns to the parent. Subagents run in background by default; foreground ones show permission prompts inline.

feature: Agent teams teammates and forked subagents
detail: With agent teams a named Agent call launches a teammate that reports via messages; fork mode launches a subagent that inherits the full conversation.

feature: Subagent tool allowlist and denylist
detail: Subagent definitions can set tools, disallowedTools and maxTurns; denylist wins; background subagent permission prompts surface in the main session and Esc denies one call.

feature: Artifact tool publishes HTML/Markdown to claude.ai
detail: Publishes a file as a private interactive page shareable by public link or within a Team/Enterprise org (public sharing needs an Owner to enable); needs /login.

feature: AskUserQuestion multiple-choice clarification
detail: Claude asks multiple-choice questions; answer by picking or typing via Other/notes; questions stay open unless a timeout is set.

feature: askUserQuestionTimeout auto-continue
detail: Setting of 60s, 5m or 10m closes an unanswered question and lets Claude proceed; 20-second countdown, any key resets; never applies in background, screen reader or Remote Control sessions.

feature: Bash tool: shell commands with persisted cwd
detail: Runs commands in separate processes; cd persists within project or added dirs, env vars do not; shell rc aliases are applied; CLAUDE_ENV_FILE or SessionStart hook persists variables.

feature: Bash timeouts: default 2 min, max 10 min
detail: Claude sets per-command timeouts; BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS and BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS change defaults and ceiling; PowerShell follows the same rules.

feature: Bash output limits and bashOutputMaxChars
detail: About 30,000 characters inline for valid results (10,000 for failures), overflow saved to file with preview; setting bashOutputMaxChars up to 128,000; commands over 5 GB output are killed.

feature: Background commands via run_in_background and /tasks
detail: Long-running processes run as background tasks; list and stop them with /tasks; foreground commands auto-move to background at timeout (except sleep).

feature: Background command time limits in unattended runs
detail: In -p runs, SDK, CI and cloud sessions background commands get 30 min default (10 for text -p), max 2 hours; local interactive sessions have none; env vars raise limits.

feature: Tool memory cap on Linux and WSL
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT caps memory for Bash, PowerShell and Monitor commands via cgroup, with an exclusion list for MCP, LSP, hooks, plugin, helper and agent processes.

feature: Edit tool: exact string replacement with safety checks
detail: Needs unique exact old_string or replace_all; read-before-edit required by older models; tolerates files changed on disk if match is unambiguous; can edit after viewing via cat/grep/sed.

feature: Perforce read-only file protection
detail: CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE=1 makes Edit/Write/NotebookEdit refuse read-only files and prompt Claude to run p4 edit.

feature: Non-UTF-8 files refused by Edit and NotebookEdit
detail: Edit tools refuse legacy-encoded or binary files to avoid corruption; Write can replace but saves as UTF-8 and blocks content containing replacement characters.

feature: Write tool: create or overwrite whole files
detail: Creates or fully overwrites a file; no append; read required before overwriting for older models and notebooks; Edit is used for partial changes.

feature: Read tool: text, images, PDFs, notebooks
detail: Returns numbered lines; images PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP are shown visually and resized (128 MB cap); PDFs over 10 pages read in 20-page ranges via poppler; .ipynb returns cells with outputs; binary types like xlsx refused.

feature: Large file reads: 25,000-token default, allow_large
detail: One Read returns up to 25,000 tokens and refuses files over 256 KB without offset/limit; v2.1.296+ can read whole files sized to remaining context.

feature: Glob tool file pattern search
detail: Finds files by glob, sorted by modification time, capped at 100; default on Windows only (macOS/Linux/WSL use bfs/ugrep through Bash) and does not honor .gitignore unless configured.

feature: Grep tool built on ripgrep
detail: Three output modes (files_with_matches, content, count), glob and type filters, multiline option, respects .gitignore; absent by default on macOS/Linux/WSL.

feature: LSP code intelligence tool
detail: Reports type errors after edits and supports go-to-definition, references, type info, symbols, implementations and call hierarchy; needs a code intelligence plugin and language server; inactive in cloud sessions.

feature: Monitor tool: background watch feeding events to Claude
detail: Runs a script or WebSocket subscription whose output lines become events (log tails, PR/CI polling, file changes); 5-minute default deadline, 30 max; uses Bash permission rules.

feature: Monitor WebSocket source and restrictions
detail: ws:// or wss:// feeds, each text message an event, binary placeholdered, over 1 MiB ends watch; private, link-local and metadata addresses denied; prompts unless allowed.

feature: Plugins can declare auto-start monitors
detail: Plugin-defined monitors start automatically when the plugin is active.

feature: NotebookEdit: replace, insert, delete cells
detail: Edits Jupyter notebooks cell by cell by cell_id; replacing a code cell clears outputs and execution count; permissions use Edit path rules.

feature: PowerShell tool
detail: Native PowerShell execution; automatic on Windows without Git Bash, opt-in on macOS/Linux/WSL (needs pwsh 7+); process-scope execution-policy bypass unless respected via env; preview with no sandbox and no profiles.

feature: defaultShell powershell and per-hook/skill shell
detail: Settings let interactive ! commands, individual command hooks and skill injections run in PowerShell.

feature: EnterWorktree and ExitWorktree tools
detail: Create an isolated git worktree and switch in, or enter an existing one by path; paths outside .claude/worktrees prompt; removed when blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories is on.

feature: CronCreate, CronList, CronDelete session-scoped schedules
detail: Schedule recurring or one-shot prompts within the current session, list and cancel them.

feature: ScheduleWakeup for self-paced /loop
detail: Claude picks the next loop iteration time between one minute and one hour, or stops the loop.

feature: RemoteTrigger cloud scheduled tasks via /schedule
detail: Creates, updates, runs and lists cloud scheduled tasks (routines) on claude.ai; backs /schedule; not available on Bedrock, AWS, Google or Foundry.

feature: Cross-session messaging: ListAgents and SendMessage
detail: Claude can list and message subagents, teammates, other local sessions and, over Remote Control, cloud and remote sessions; v2.1.224+; backs /list-agents.

feature: PushNotification tool
detail: Sends a desktop notification locally and a phone push with Remote Control or in cloud sessions; delivery uses Anthropic infrastructure so unavailable on third-party providers.

feature: SendUserFile delivers files to your device
detail: Sends generated reports, diagrams or builds with a caption to a connected Remote Control client or cloud session; display option render or attach.

feature: ListPlugins, SearchPlugins, ListSkills, SearchSkills
detail: Let Claude browse plugins and skills enabled for your claude.ai account; only in cloud sessions or the desktop app.

feature: SuggestPluginInstall, SuggestSkills, propose_skills cards
detail: Show cards of suggested plugins or skills to add to your claude.ai account, including cloud Cowork sessions.

feature: Skill tool executes skills in conversation
detail: Runs a skill; may prompt when the skill sets allowed-tools, disallowed-tools or hooks; permission rules Skill(name *).

feature: MCP resource tools
detail: ListMcpResourcesTool and ReadMcpResourceTool list and read resources from connected MCP servers; WaitForMcpServers waits for servers still connecting.

feature: ToolSearch loads deferred tools
detail: With MCP tool search enabled Claude searches and loads deferred tools on demand.

feature: Workflow tool: dynamic multi-subagent workflows
detail: Runs a script that orchestrates many background subagents and returns one consolidated result.

feature: Task tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/List/Update, TodoWrite)
detail: Session task checklist tools; on by default only for older models (Opus 4.7, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5 and earlier), opt-in via CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS; always on in background and cloud sessions.

feature: TaskStop stops background tasks or agents
detail: Stops a running background task, teammate or named background agent by ID or name.

feature: Plan mode tools EnterPlanMode and ExitPlanMode
detail: Claude can switch into plan mode to design before coding and present a plan for approval.

feature: ReportFindings structured code-review list
detail: Reports code review findings with file, summary, failure scenario and optional category for rendering in a structured list.

feature: SubagentHandback delivers subagent report
detail: In auto mode local subagents deliver their final report through it; classifier reviews the report; v2.1.271+.

feature: ShareOnboardingGuide for /team-onboarding
detail: Uploads ONBOARDING.md and returns a link teammates can open in Claude Code.

feature: Claude-drafted feedback reports (SendFeedback)
detail: Claude drafts feedback when tools fail or you flag a mistake; card lets you review (1), send (2 twice) or dismiss (0); queue of 10 drafts expiring after 30 days; v2.1.238+.

feature: /feedback queue review and transcript option
detail: Lists drafts across sessions to edit title, area, details, toggle Send transcript, send or discard; w writes a report manually; /bug opens the dialog.

feature: feedbackDrafts setting and CLAUDE_CODE_SEND_FEEDBACK
detail: feedbackDrafts off or quiet (count only) or env var 0 turns drafting off; admins can set it in managed settings; absent under Zero Data Retention or HIPAA config.

feature: EndConversation tool
detail: Claude can end a session after persistent abuse or when you ask and confirm; the session locks (only /clear, /resume, /help, /exit, /feedback run); cannot be blocked by deny rules; Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Fable 5 or later, terminal only.

feature: WebFetch tool
detail: Fetches a URL and answers a question about it via a separate model call; 15-minute cache, 5-minute download deadline, reads first 100,000 characters; refuses localhost; sends Claude-User user agent.

feature: WebFetch permission rules and domain allowlisting
detail: Allow, ask or deny per domain (including wildcard subdomains) or tool-wide; auto mode classifier reviews fetches; preapproved documentation domains skip prompts; WebFetch off via deny or env var.

feature: web-fetch built-in subagent
detail: When signed in with claude.ai (v2.1.287+), page reads go through a Haiku-class subagent that reads up to about 48,000 characters and answers; can be disabled with Agent(web-fetch) deny rule.

feature: WebSearch tool
detail: Queries Anthropic's search backend for titles and URLs with up to eight searches per call and allowed or blocked domain filters; backend not configurable; unavailable on Bedrock.

feature: WebSearch session limit of 200 with refill
detail: Interactive sessions cap at 200 searches (subagents count), refilling about 100 per hour on v2.1.290+; raise with env var or reset with /clear; per-turn in -p and SDK.

feature: Permission rule format ToolName(specifier)
detail: Same rule syntax works in settings, /permissions, CLI flags, skills' allowed-tools and hook if conditions; Edit allow grants read and Read deny blocks write.

feature: Auto mode classifier decides permission prompts
detail: In auto mode a classifier replaces most permission prompts; file tools still prompt outside working directories; Terminal and VS Code sessions start in auto mode by default.

feature: Advisor tool (server-side)
detail: A server tool run by the API with no name for permission rules or hooks.

feature: Native installer: macOS/Linux script, Windows PowerShell and CMD
detail: One-line installers place the claude binary in ~/.local/bin (or %USERPROFILE%\.local\bin) and keep versions under ~/.local/share/claude; recommended install method that self-updates.

feature: Alternative installs: Homebrew cask and WinGet
detail: brew install --cask claude-code tracks stable (about a week behind), claude-code@latest tracks newest; winget install Anthropic.ClaudeCode; neither auto-updates by default.

feature: npm global install and npm 12 postinstall caveat
detail: npm package fetches a per-platform native binary; npm 12 skips the postinstall step unless allow-scripts is configured; eight platform packages published (darwin, linux incl. musl, win32 x64/arm64).

feature: System requirements: macOS 13+, 64-bit Windows, 4 GB RAM
detail: Install needs about 512 MB free memory; Claude Code needs at least 4 GB RAM; 32-bit Windows, FreeBSD and CPUs without AVX are unsupported; WSL1 needs WSL2 or linker workaround.

feature: Install location and XDG directories
detail: Install writes to ~/.claude/downloads, ~/.local/bin, ~/.local/share/claude, ~/.local/state/claude, ~/.cache/claude and ~/.claude.json; honors XDG vars and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR.

feature: Release verification and download retries
detail: Updates verify release authenticity and refuse to install on failure; downloads retry up to three attempts and time out after 10 minutes.

feature: Background auto-update with footer failure notice
detail: Native installs update themselves; a red 'Auto-update failed' footer points to claude doctor and claude update; custom launcher symlinks are left alone.

feature: claude update and claude doctor commands
detail: claude update installs the latest version from the shell; claude doctor prints installation diagnostics including Keychain write access and last update attempt.

feature: Windows shell requirements: Git Bash or PowerShell
detail: Git for Windows is optional; without it the PowerShell tool is used; CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH points to a specific bash.exe (only bash/sh names accepted).

feature: Region restriction on installer
detail: Claude Code is not available in unsupported countries; install script returns App unavailable in region.

feature: Corporate proxy and CA certificate support
detail: HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY, CURL_CA_BUNDLE and NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS let install and runtime trust proxy certificates; Windows uses the OS certificate store.

feature: Install behind server-managed settings
detail: From v2.1.246 install and update do not show the security approval dialog; shown in the next interactive session unless forceRemoteSettingsRefresh is set.

feature: Login reset with /logout and /login
detail: Re-authenticate by /logout, restart, claude; press c to copy the OAuth URL when the browser does not open; claude auth login reads a pasted code from stdin.

feature: Remote and WSL2 login via copy-code flow
detail: Over SSH, containers or WSL2 sign in through a displayed URL in a local browser and paste the returned code; BROWSER env var can open a Windows browser from WSL2.

feature: Subscription vs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY precedence
detail: An ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment overrides subscription OAuth (always in -p mode); /status shows the active auth method.

feature: Console users need Claude Code or Developer role
detail: Console accounts get 403 without the Claude Code or Developer role assigned by admins on the Members page.

feature: Enterprise custom roles can gate Claude Code access
detail: On the Custom role, Claude Code access comes only from custom roles assigned to a user's groups; Owners can grant it or switch to a standard role.

feature: Credential storage in macOS Keychain with plaintext fallback
detail: Credentials go to the login Keychain; if it rejects writes Claude Code falls back to ~/.claude/.credentials.json; /logout removes all stored credentials including MCP logins and plugin secrets.

feature: Shared login renewal across parallel sessions
detail: Sessions on one machine share a saved login and coordinate token refresh so only one process renews at a time.

feature: Cloud provider credential setup (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry)
detail: Authenticate via AWS credentials, gcloud application-default login plus project/region vars, or Azure CLI/API key; IDE extensions need the env set in the IDE.

feature: Support paths: GitHub issues, /feedback, Get help
detail: Report via GitHub issues, /feedback in session, or Get help from the account menu at claude.ai or the Console.

feature: Claude Code Desktop app as no-terminal alternative
detail: Graphical install and use of Claude Code for macOS and Windows, with an apt-based Linux install.

feature: VS Code extension bundles a private CLI
detail: The extension ships its own CLI copy for its panel and does not put claude on PATH; standalone install needed for terminal use.

feature: /doctor in-session diagnostics with fixes
detail: Checks installation, settings, extensions and context usage and proposes fixes it applies after confirmation; claude doctor from the shell when startup fails.

feature: claude --safe-mode isolates plugins, MCP and hooks
detail: Starts without plugins, MCP servers and hooks to test whether one causes high usage or faults.

feature: /compact context compaction
detail: Summarizes the conversation to cut context and memory; accepts a focus argument; reports when too few messages exist.

feature: Memory warning above 2.5 GB heap
detail: A critical warning appears when heap passes 2.5 GB; restart with claude --continue or /compact outside fullscreen to clear it.

feature: /heapdump writes heap snapshot and diagnostics
detail: Hidden command saves a .heapsnapshot and diagnostics JSON to ~/Desktop and prints a memory summary with leak indicators; snapshot contains conversation and credentials.

feature: Markdown tables capped at 200 rows in terminal
detail: Displays first 200 rows with a count of the rest; full table stays in the conversation and /copy copies all rows.

feature: Autocompact thrashing protection
detail: Stops retrying automatic compaction when large outputs refill context repeatedly; recovery via chunked reads, focused /compact, subagents, /clear or /context inspection.

feature: Resume a session with claude --resume
detail: Restarting does not lose the conversation; resume in the same directory.

feature: Ctrl+C cancels current operation
detail: Interrupts a running operation when Claude seems unresponsive.

feature: /scroll-speed and CLAUDE_CODE_SCROLL_SPEED
detail: Sets lines per mouse-wheel notch in fullscreen rendering; PgUp/PgDn scroll half a screen; /tui default returns to classic renderer.

feature: /copy command copies output to clipboard
detail: Copies the last response or a single code block from the Claude Code process, bypassing sandbox limits, and writes a fallback file with its path.

feature: Clipboard over SSH via OSC 52
detail: Selection and /copy send text to the local terminal using OSC 52; iTerm2 needs clipboard access enabled, Terminal.app unsupported; CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE=1 or native-selection keys as fallback.

feature: Bundled ripgrep with system override
detail: Search and @file mentions use a bundled ripgrep; USE_BUILTIN_RIPGREP=0 switches to a system install, confirmed in claude doctor.

feature: WSL search performance on /mnt/c
detail: Cross-filesystem reads can reduce search matches; keep projects on the Linux filesystem or use native Windows.

feature: Troubleshooting hub for errors and permissions
detail: Directs to pages for install, login, configuration, permission modes, API errors, disk-full errors, VS Code and JetBrains issues.

feature: Ultrareview: cloud multi-agent code review (/code-review ultra)
detail: Research preview. Runs a fleet of reviewer agents in a cloud sandbox, independently reproducing each finding; takes 5-15 minutes in the background; /ultrareview alias when available.

feature: Ultrareview availability limits
detail: Needs a claude.ai sign-in; unavailable on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, Zero Data Retention, HIPAA or CMEK orgs, where it falls back to a local review.

feature: Ultrareview scope: branch, base, commit or PR
detail: No argument reviews current branch against default including uncommitted changes; pass a base branch, commit or tag, or a github.com PR number; typo suggestions; uploads repo bundle unless PR mode.

feature: Ultrareview launch confirmation dialog
detail: Shows scope, file and line counts, remaining free runs and estimated cost before starting; only runs when you invoke it.

feature: Post ultrareview findings to PR as a comment
detail: v2.1.227+: choose per run to post findings as one plain comment from your GitHub account via the Anthropic API; off by default; --post preselects; keep session open until done.

feature: Ultrareview plain-words note
detail: Multi-word text after the command is kept as a note shown in the dialog and tied to findings; single words are read as branch or PR references.

feature: Ultrareview diff limits and fallbacks
detail: Up to 500 files and 8,000 changed lines by default; refuses empty diffs; first-commit and no-merge-base cases review all files after confirmation; too-large repos prompt PR mode.

feature: Ultrareview pricing: 3 one-time free runs then usage credits
detail: Three non-refreshing free runs per account on Pro, Max and Ultra, then typically $5 to $25 per review billed as usage credits; early stop still uses a free run; credits must be on.

feature: /usage-credits command
detail: Check or change whether usage credits are turned on for the account or organization.

feature: Track ultrareview with /tasks
detail: See running and finished reviews, open details or stop one; stopping archives the cloud session with no partial findings; claude --resume re-attaches after account switch.

feature: claude ultrareview non-interactive subcommand
detail: For CI and scripts: blocks until done and prints findings to stdout; flags --json, --timeout (default 45 min), --post, --no-post, --trust-workspace; exit codes 0, 1, 130.

feature: Workspace trust prompt for ultrareview
detail: Asks Trust folder y/N interactively; in CI fails with Workspace not trusted unless --trust-workspace (v2.1.309+) is passed.

feature: Code Review on GitHub PRs with inline comments
detail: Separate Code Review integration posts findings as inline PR comments automatically without a CLI step.

feature: /code-review local vs ultra comparison
detail: Local /code-review is quick, scales with an effort argument and counts toward normal usage; ultra is a cloud fleet with verification for pre-merge confidence.

feature: Voice dictation in Claude Code CLI
detail: Speak prompts that transcribe live into the input and mix with typing; enabled with /voice; audio is streamed to Anthropic servers for transcription.

feature: Dictation requirements: claude.ai account and local microphone
detail: Needs a claude.ai sign-in (not API key, Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry) and a local mic; not in cloud, SSH or VS Code Remote sessions; WSL needs WSLg.

feature: Dictation does not use tokens or usage limits
detail: Transcription does not consume messages or tokens and is not counted in /usage.

feature: /voice command with hold, tap, off modes
detail: Toggles dictation or sets hold or tap mode; setting persists via voice.enabled and voice.mode in settings; runs a microphone check and macOS permission prompt.

feature: Hold-to-record push-to-talk (default Space)
detail: Hold Space to record; footer shows keep holding then listening; cursor becomes a level meter unless reduced motion; transcript appears dimmed then finalizes on release at the cursor.

feature: autoSubmit option for hold mode
detail: voice.autoSubmit true sends the prompt on key release when the transcript has at least three words.

feature: Tap-to-record and send mode
detail: Tap once to start (only with empty input), tap again to stop and auto-submit transcripts of 3+ words; stops after 15 seconds silence or two minutes; footer shows REC.

feature: Cancel dictation with Esc or Ctrl+C
detail: Discards the transcript and restores the prompt without interrupting Claude or counting toward exit presses.

feature: Coding-tuned transcription with project hints
detail: Recognizes terms like regex, OAuth, JSON and localhost, and adds project name and git branch as hints.

feature: Dictation languages (20)
detail: Uses the language setting; supports Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, French, German, Greek, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian; falls back to English.

feature: Rebind dictation key (voice:pushToTalk)
detail: Bind a different key or modifier combo like meta+k in keybindings.json; modifier combos skip hold warmup; Caps Lock cannot be bound.

feature: Dictation in agent view
detail: In hold mode, push-to-talk works in the dispatch input or peek-panel reply for background sessions.

feature: Voice dictation in VS Code extension
detail: Same claude.ai requirement, microphone button, ends after 15 seconds without speech or two minutes; uses VS Code speech language when language unset; not in remote sessions.

feature: Linux audio fallback and troubleshooting
detail: Native recorder with arecord or SoX fallback; WSL needs sox with PulseAudio backend; errors paused after three failures in 10 seconds; org policy can disable voice.

feature: Claude Code cloud sessions
detail: Runs Claude Code on Anthropic-managed VMs: clones a GitHub repo, makes changes, runs tests and pushes a branch; counts toward plan usage with no separate VM charge; persists across devices.
plans: Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise (premium or Chat + Claude Code seats)

feature: Ways to start a cloud session
detail: From claude.ai/code, the Claude mobile app Code tab, Desktop app with Cloud selected, or claude --cloud in the terminal.
plans: Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise (premium or Chat + Claude Code seats)

feature: Cloud vs local vs Remote Control comparison
detail: Cloud keeps running if you disconnect and ignores local config; local uses your machine and config; Remote Control drives a local session from claude.ai or mobile.

feature: Parallel cloud tasks, one session and branch each
detail: Submit several independent tasks at once without managing worktrees; closing the tab does not stop a session.

feature: Self-hosted cloud environments
detail: Sessions can run on an organization's own runners where network, setup and push behavior are operator-configured.

feature: Connect GitHub to claude.ai/code
detail: One-time GitHub authorization; public repos clonable, private repos need the Claude GitHub App installed per account or org; install enables Auto-fix of CI failures and review comments.

feature: Owner must enable GitHub connector on Team/Enterprise
detail: Sign in with GitHub works only after an Owner turns on the GitHub connector; an optional Quick setup toggle enables /web-setup and auto-creates environments.

feature: /web-setup connects GitHub CLI token
detail: Sends your gh token (stored encrypted with your account) so cloud sessions access any repo the token can reach without the GitHub App; warns when replacing a browser connection; needs claude.ai login.

feature: Remove GitHub access for cloud sessions
detail: Disconnect GitHub at claude.ai/customize/connectors to delete stored credentials; revoke the token on GitHub to invalidate it.

feature: Cloud sessions unavailable under ZDR, HIPAA or CMEK
detail: Organizations with Zero Data Retention, HIPAA configuration or customer-managed keys cannot use cloud sessions or /web-setup; admins can also disable cloud sessions by policy.

feature: Cloud environments with Default environment
detail: Saved configuration for network access, env vars and setup scripts; Default is auto-created on Pro/Max/Ultra and created in onboarding on Team/Enterprise with Limited network access.

feature: Environment setup scripts and network access levels
detail: Setup script runs on clone with about five-minute cache budget; Limited access reaches allowlisted package registries, None blocks all; SessionStart hook for heavy downloads.

feature: Repository and branch selector, multi-repo sessions
detail: Pick one or more repositories and a starting branch below the input; No repository option at claude.ai/code.

feature: Cloud permission modes: Auto, Accept edits, Plan
detail: Auto uses a classifier (needs a supporting model and org allowance), Accept edits pushes without asking, Plan waits for approval; Manual and Bypass are not offered.

feature: Pre-fill new sessions via URL parameters
detail: claude.ai/code accepts prompt (or q), prompt_url, repositories (or repo) and environment query parameters to prefill the form for integrations.

feature: Session Changes card and diff view
detail: Shows lines added and removed after a push; opens a diff against the base branch or a chosen Compare against branch; panel can be shown via Activity panel or session rail and opened as a pane.

feature: Inline diff comments bundled with next message
detail: Click + beside a diff line to leave a comment; comments queue and are sent with your next message with file and line context.

feature: Create PR or draft PR from the Changes card
detail: Creates a pull request with generated title and description; right-click to switch the button to Create draft PR; session stays live afterwards.

feature: Auto-fix pull requests
detail: Claude can monitor a PR and respond to CI failures and review comments in repos with the Claude GitHub App.

feature: Monitor cloud sessions from phone
detail: Claude mobile apps for iOS and Android show sessions; /mobile in the CLI shows a QR code to the app store link.

feature: Archive or delete cloud sessions
detail: Archive hides a session from the list; delete removes it permanently; sessions keep running after the tab closes until the task finishes.

feature: Cloud scheduled tasks (routines) via /schedule
detail: Recurring work on a schedule, by API call or on GitHub events, runnable via Run now; available once cloud setup is complete.

feature: claude --cloud bundles local repo without GitHub
detail: Terminal flag starts a cloud session and can upload a local repository when GitHub is not connected.

feature: Claude Code not available on your account notice
detail: Seat lacks Claude Code; switch organization or ask an Owner for a seat that includes Claude Code.

feature: Claude Code VS Code extension
detail: Native graphical chat panel for VS Code (1.94+), also installable in Cursor, Devin Desktop and Kiro via Open VSX; extension version equals the bundled Claude Code version.
plans: Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise, Console

feature: Extension sign-in with subscription or Console account
detail: Browser sign-in with any paid Claude plan or Console account, no API key needed; third-party providers and Claude apps gateway supported; Learn Claude Code onboarding checklist.

feature: Ways to open the Claude panel
detail: Spark icon in editor toolbar (file open), Activity Bar sessions list, Command Palette, status bar item; panel draggable to secondary or primary sidebar or editor area.

feature: Automatic selection and open-file context
detail: Claude sees selected text and the open file; footer shows line count; Option/Alt+K inserts an @file#lines mention; attachSelection and attachOpenFile settings turn each off.

feature: Selection withheld from excluded or gitignored files
detail: In the chat panel, text selected in files matching files.exclude, search.exclude or gitignore is withheld (path only); does not apply in terminal mode.

feature: Inline diff review of proposed edits
