detail: In Manual mode edits show a side-by-side diff to accept, reject or redirect; edits made in the diff are reported to Claude; per-change Accept/Reject buttons (v2.1.275+, not over 100 changes) and cursor commands.

feature: Permission modes: Auto, Manual, Plan, Edit automatically
detail: Mode indicator below the prompt switches between classifier-reviewed Auto, ask-first Manual, Plan (opens plan as Markdown with inline comments) and auto-accept edits; initialPermissionMode sets the start mode.

feature: /plan command with task and open
detail: /plan enters plan mode or shows the current plan; /plan <task> starts planning it; /plan open opens the plan file; v2.1.280+.

feature: Model picker and effort row
detail: Click model name, Switch model or /model to change model mid-session; Effort row saves a default per model (max is session-only).

feature: Ultracode switch for workflows
detail: With dynamic workflows enabled and a supporting model, an Ultracode toggle makes Claude plan a workflow for each substantial task; v2.1.284+.

feature: Extended thinking switch and thinking summaries
detail: Thinking toggle in the command menu (absent when thinking is mandatory); showThinkingSummaries setting reveals thinking text; Ctrl+O expands blocks.

feature: Command menu with Customize section
detail: Typing / opens a menu: attach files, switch model, Slash commands dialog, skills (with visibility toggles), output styles, hooks, permissions, memory, instructions, status, sandbox, Claude in Chrome, export.

feature: /skills dialog with per-skill visibility
detail: Lists skills with On or Name only visibility that you can change, except locked plugin skills; v2.1.280+.

feature: Output styles picker and custom style builder
detail: Choose an output style including custom ones or have Claude write a new style file at project or user level.

feature: Hooks viewer and editor
detail: Shows hooks by event; add, edit or remove hooks in user, project and local settings; managed and plugin hooks read-only; v2.1.269+.

feature: Permission rules viewer and editor
detail: Lists Allow, Ask and Deny rules; add or remove rules in user, project or local settings; others read-only.

feature: Auto memory toggle and memory browser
detail: Turn auto memory on or off, browse saved memories, view, edit, delete or open their files, reveal folders; v2.1.274+.

feature: Edit CLAUDE.md instruction files from menu
detail: Instructions entry opens CLAUDE.md files, creating the file if absent.

feature: /status and /sandbox in the extension
detail: Status shows version, account, model and MCP details; Sandbox shows and switches sandbox mode and excluded commands; v2.1.280+.

feature: Claude in Chrome from VS Code (@browser)
detail: /chrome manages the connection; @browser asks Claude to drive Chrome (needs extension 1.0.36+) using your logged-in browser state to test and debug web apps.

feature: /export conversation to clipboard or file
detail: Copies conversation as plain text or saves to a file; /export name.txt skips the dialog.

feature: Enable Remote Control for all sessions setting
detail: Toggle sets remoteControlAtStartup so new and already-open sessions connect to Remote Control; also across VS Code windows (v2.1.261+).

feature: Focus view hides tool activity
detail: Collapses tool calls, results and thinking behind expandable rows; toggle via menu, Ctrl+Option/Alt+F or command; keeps to-do list and pending question; shows subagent progress.

feature: Sign out via menu or /logout
detail: Settings section Sign out or /logout; not offered on third-party providers.

feature: Report a problem, /bug and /feedback
detail: Submits report to Anthropic when signed in first-party; otherwise saves a redacted local archive under ~/.claude/feedback-bundles with a Show folder button; hidden when org policy disables feedback.

feature: /btw side questions in a side panel
detail: Ask a question about the session without adding to the conversation; thread persists across reloads, keeps newest 20 exchanges, trash icon clears; v2.1.227+.

feature: Copy response and /copy
detail: Hover Copy response or /copy (or /copy 2 for second-to-last).

feature: Bookmark responses and Bookmarks panel
detail: Bookmark or unbookmark a response; review via panel icon, command menu or /bookmarks; v2.1.286+.

feature: Files Claude sends you (SendUserFile) shown in chat
detail: With Remote Control connected, Sent file rows open in the editor; network-path files are shown unlinked for credential safety; v2.1.295+.

feature: Context usage indicator and /compact
detail: Shows context window use above contextUsageThreshold (default 50%); auto-compacts or /compact manually.

feature: Prompt cache clock
detail: Clock icon counts down remaining prompt cache life (5 minutes or 1 hour), turns red when expired or after compaction.

feature: Agent map for subagents and background tasks
detail: Agent count at the prompt opens a tree of subagents with status, time and tokens; view prompts, tool calls and transcripts, stop agents; also lists background shell commands and monitors; /tasks and /workflows open it.

feature: Run in background button for commands and subagents
detail: Appears after about two seconds on a running command or when waiting on a subagent; moves it to a background task that notifies Claude; v2.1.287+.

feature: Multi-line input with Shift+Enter
detail: Shift+Enter inserts a newline, including in question free-text fields; useCtrlEnterToSend changes send key.

feature: Prompt suggestions
detail: Gray suggested next prompt after replies, accept with Tab; uses a small background request counting toward usage; disable with promptSuggestionEnabled false.

feature: @-mention files and folders with fuzzy matching
detail: @name finds files; trailing slash for folders; Explorer right-click Claude Code: Add to Chat (v2.1.327+).

feature: Read specific PDF pages
detail: Ask for a page, range or open-ended range; needs poppler-utils on the host.

feature: @terminal:name to include terminal output
detail: Reference a terminal's output in a prompt without copy-paste.

feature: Attach images and files
detail: Paste images from clipboard, Shift-drag files into the prompt box, remove with X.

feature: Paste handling and invisible character removal
detail: Pasted text stays visible (no placeholder); invisible Unicode characters are stripped with a notice, and a send is held back to show the cleaned text.

feature: LaTeX math typesetting in chat panel
detail: Typesets display ($$, \[ \], math fence) and inline ($..$, \(..\)) math; copy yields TeX source; v2.1.301+, not in terminal mode; heuristics avoid prices and shell text.

feature: Session history with search, resume and web tab
detail: Search or browse past conversations; Local and Web tabs; Web resumes claude.ai cloud sessions by downloading a copy (no sync back) and lists Remote Control sessions; needs claude.ai sign-in.

feature: Rename, archive and auto-archive sessions
detail: AI-generated titles, rename and archive via hover, Archived sessions group with unarchive (one or all); auto-archive after 14 days inactivity configurable (1, 2, 7, 14, or off).

feature: Plan mode restored on resume
detail: Resuming a conversation that ended in plan mode restores it (v2.1.246+) unless overridden by settings or deny rules.

feature: Open here anyway for conversations open elsewhere
detail: Notice warns when a conversation is open in another process and lets you take it over.

feature: /usage account and usage dialog
detail: Shows account and plan limit bars (session and week), recommendations with a Fix button (v2.1.305+), attribution by skill, subagent, plugin and MCP server, Day/Week toggle; cost and tokens for API or provider sign-ins.

feature: Checkpoints: fork conversation and rewind code
detail: Hover a message to fork conversation, rewind code, or both; /fork forks from the latest message, optionally with text (v2.1.330+).

feature: Panel placement and editor group locking
detail: Panel docks in secondary or primary sidebar or editor area; lockEditorGroups keeps files out of the Claude tab's group.

feature: Chat font settings
detail: Uses chat.fontSize, chat.fontFamily, chat.editor.fontSize and chat.editor.fontFamily; window zoom scales everything.

feature: Continue after reload
detail: Editor-tab conversations return after reload; sidebar ones if active within 10 minutes; interrupted steps resume with a notice (v2.1.274+); continueAfterReload toggles; crash-loop protection leaves conversations unopened with Open it anyway.

feature: Multiple conversations in tabs or windows with status dots
detail: Open in New Tab or New Window; blue dot means permission pending, orange means finished while hidden.

feature: Session groups in the sessions list
detail: Create, rename, delete groups, multi-select and move sessions, add a tab to a group; saved per workspace folder; v2.1.229+.

feature: Sessions list filters (Active and status)
detail: Active toggle and status filters (Needs input, Working, Completed, Open, Closed) persisted across reloads.

feature: Terminal mode (useTerminal)
detail: Switch the extension to a CLI-style interface instead of the graphical panel; math and focus-last-message unavailable there.

feature: Plugin manager (/plugins) with install scopes
detail: Tabs for Plugins and Marketplaces; enable/disable (for me or everyone), install at user, project or local scope, configure options with masked secrets, uninstall with data keep/delete choice.

feature: Shareable install-plugin deep link
detail: vscode://anthropic.claude-code/install-plugin with plugin and optional marketplace (owner/repo, https or git SSH, optional ref) opens the scope choice; validated; nothing installs without a choice.

feature: Marketplace management
detail: Add GitHub, URL or local marketplaces, refresh, remove (uninstalls their plugins after confirmation); shared with the CLI.

feature: Plugins that draw in the panel (mods)
detail: Plugin mods can add panes, toasts, status lines and custom message rendering, labeled by plugin (From, Edited by, Prompt from); turn off by disabling the plugin; v2.1.299+.

feature: Git workflows: commits and pull requests
detail: Ask Claude to stage, commit with descriptive messages and create PRs with generated descriptions; worktree banner with Open worktree reopens sessions that moved into a worktree.

feature: Jupyter notebook editing via NotebookEdit
detail: Replacing a cell clears output and execution count; no kernel restart; save notebook first since autosave does not apply; mcp__ide__executeCode runs Python in the active kernel only after a Quick Pick Execute confirmation.

feature: Dictation toggle in VS Code (Cmd/Ctrl+D)
detail: claude-vscode.toggleDictation starts or stops voice dictation when Claude is focused; needs claude.ai sign-in.

feature: Keyboard shortcuts and commands
detail: Focus Input (Cmd/Ctrl+Esc), Open in New Tab (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Esc), New Conversation (Cmd/Ctrl+N when enabled), Reopen Closed Session (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+T), Focus last message, Rename Session Tab, Mark Unread, Show Logs, Logout.

feature: vscode://anthropic.claude-code/open URI handler
detail: Opens a new Claude tab from scripts or bookmarklets with optional URL-encoded prompt prefill (not auto-submitted) and session ID to resume.

feature: VS Code extension settings
detail: Includes useTerminal, initialPermissionMode, preferredLocation, autosave, scrollToBottomOnSend, pinPrompt, showMessageTimestamps, spinnerVerbs, escapeStopsClaude, hideOnboarding, respectGitIgnore, usePythonEnvironment, environmentVariables, claudeProcessWrapper.

feature: Allow bypass permissions in selector
detail: allowDangerouslySkipPermissions adds Bypass permissions to the mode selector; intended only for internet-less sandboxes.

feature: Third-party providers and Claude apps gateway sign-in
detail: disableLoginPrompt for Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry (no plan usage bars, dictation or Web tab); gateway sign-in with URL and certificate fingerprint verification (v2.1.316+).

feature: Screen reader support in chat panel
detail: Announces completed replies, permission requests, questions, plan reviews, status, queued messages, errors; labeled turn headings; permission-destination arrow keys; Focus last message command; v2.1.236+.

feature: Extension vs CLI feature differences and /ide
detail: Extension has a subset of commands, no ! shortcut or tab completion; CLI connects to the extension via /ide or integrated terminal for diffs and diagnostics; they share history (claude --resume).

feature: /mcp dialog to manage MCP servers
detail: Add, remove (local, user, project scope), enable/disable, reconnect and manage OAuth for MCP servers; shared config with claude mcp add.

feature: Built-in IDE MCP server and diagnostics tools
detail: Local loopback server with token auth exposes getDiagnostics (Problems panel errors) and executeCode to the model; chat panel uses claude-vscode getDiagnostics (v2.1.285+); deny by name.

feature: Uninstall and prevent auto-reinstall of extension
detail: Uninstall from Extensions view; /ide or older CLI can reinstall it unless autoInstallIdeExtension or CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_SKIP_AUTO_INSTALL is set.

feature: VS Code troubleshooting commands
detail: Developer: Reload Window, Claude Code: Show Logs, Open Walkthrough; fixes for Cmd+Esc Game Overlay conflict on macOS Tahoe, Ctrl+J newline unbinding via keybindings.json, blank panel, TLS-proxy dictation failures.

feature: Dynamic workflows: scripted multi-agent orchestration
detail: Claude writes a JavaScript script that runs many subagents in the background while the session stays responsive; the script holds the loop and intermediate results so only the final answer reaches context. Suited to audits, migrations and cross-checked research.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Dynamic workflows on Pro need enabling
detail: On the Pro plan the feature is switched on from the Dynamic workflows row in /config.

feature: Bundled /deep-research workflow
detail: Fans out web searches across angles, fetches and cross-checks sources, votes on each claim and returns a cited report with refuted claims dropped; unverifiable claims are listed as unverified. Needs the WebSearch tool.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: /workflows progress view
detail: Lists running and completed workflow runs and opens a per-phase view with agent counts, each agent's prompt, recent tool calls, result and token use; also a one-line summary in the task panel under the input.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Workflow progress view keys
detail: Arrows select phase or agent, Enter/right drills in, Esc/left backs out, j/k scroll detail, f cycles status filter, p pauses or resumes, x stops agent or run, r restarts a running agent, s saves script.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Stop a workflow from the list
detail: Select a run in /workflows and press x to stop it without opening it; stopped run stays in the task panel while its processes still run.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Ask for a workflow with the ultracode keyword
detail: Typing the word ultracode (or asking in plain words for a workflow) in your own prompt makes Claude write a workflow for that task; the keyword is highlighted in the input.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Dismiss or disable the ultracode keyword
detail: Option+W (macOS) or Alt+W dismisses the highlight for a prompt, backspace right after it also does; an Ultracode keyword trigger toggle in /config turns it off.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Ultracode keyword only works on human-typed prompts
detail: The keyword opts in only at the interactive prompt, IDE panel, Remote Control or SDK input stamped human; not for -p prompts, unstamped SDK input, scheduled tasks or webhook/PR-comment content.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: /effort ultracode: workflows for every task
detail: Session setting that makes Claude plan a workflow for each substantive task; costs more tokens and reaches usage limits sooner. Also claude --effort ultracode (sets xhigh), an /effort slider Tab toggle, /effort ultracode off, and an ultracode settings key.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Ultracode skips large-run guards
detail: With ultracode on, the Large workflow warning, the concurrent subagent limit for Agent-tool subagents and the auto-mode first-launch approval are not applied.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Workflow approval prompt (CLI)
detail: Per-run prompt offers Yes run it, Yes and don't ask again for this named workflow in this project, View raw script, or No; Ctrl+G opens the script in an editor and Tab adds a comment.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Workflow approval by permission mode
detail: Auto mode asks once then records consent; manual and accept-edits ask every run; bypass permissions and -p/SDK never prompt. -p/SDK need an allow rule (Workflow or Workflow(name)), auto mode, bypass, a PreToolUse hook or a host permission tool.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Workflow approval card in Desktop
detail: Desktop shows a card with workflow name, phases and token caution with Once, Always and Deny, and progress in the Background tasks side pane.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Save a workflow as a slash command
detail: In /workflows press s, Tab to choose project .claude/workflows/ (shared) or ~/.claude/workflows/ (personal); it then runs as /<name> and appears in autocomplete. Project wins on name clash; nearest .claude/workflows wins in monorepos; symlink targets refused.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Distribute workflows in plugins
detail: A workflows/ directory at plugin root (or manifest workflows field) ships scripts, namespaced as /plugin-name:workflow-name.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Pass args to a saved workflow
detail: Saved workflows read structured input from a global args, e.g. a list of issue numbers given in the prompt; undefined if omitted.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Workflow script API
detail: Scripts are plain JavaScript with top-level await using agent(), pipeline(), parallel(), phase(), log() and args; agent calls can take a JSON schema (validated, retried up to 5 times) and return null if stopped or failed.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Workflow script constraints
detail: No import(), no direct file or shell access, no mid-run user input, and Date.now/Math.random/new Date() throw so relaunches replay identically; meta must be a plain literal object with name and description.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: /workflow-authoring skill and /reload-skills
detail: Bundled skill loads the script-writing reference before editing saved workflows (needs v2.1.248+); /reload-skills re-reads workflow directories after edits.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Workflow run limits
detail: Up to 16 concurrent agents by default (1-256 via env var, v2.1.269+), 4,096 items per parallel/pipeline call, and 1,000 agents per run.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Workflow prompt-cache sharing
detail: Matching agents share a prompt-cache prefix; the first agent runs ahead by up to 5 s by default (env-configurable, 0 disables); workflow agent cache lasts 5 minutes unless subagentPromptCacheTtl is 1h.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Resume or relaunch a paused or stopped workflow
detail: Press p in /workflows to resume a paused run; for a stopped run ask Claude to relaunch. Completed agents return saved results; a changed prompt, failed or stopped-mid-run agent reruns along with later agents. Needs the same session, or claude --resume; cloud sessions keep results.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Workflow pauses at a usage limit and auto-continues
detail: On a claude.ai subscription an interactive terminal or Code-tab run waits for the limit to reset (within 24 h, max two waits) and continues; needs autoContinueAtUsageLimit and the Code tab Auto-continue checkbox. Not in -p, SDK, background, Remote Control, SSH/WSL, Dispatch or scheduled sessions.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Auto-restart of stalled workflow agents
detail: An agent silent too long restarts up to five times (shown as retry N); stallMs per agent or CLAUDE_ASYNC_AGENT_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS sets the window; failures give null inside parallel/pipeline or end the run if awaited.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Large workflow warning and cost controls
detail: Runs over 25 agents or 1.5M projected tokens show a Large workflow warning in the task panel; agents use the session model unless set, and allowlist-blocked models are substituted.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Dynamic workflow size guideline
detail: Setting (/config or workflowSizeGuideline) advising agent count: unrestricted, small (<5), medium (<10, default), large (<50); Pro defaults to small on v2.1.271+; advice, not a cap.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Turn workflows off
detail: Per user via /config toggle, disableWorkflows in settings.json or CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS=1; org-wide via managed settings or the Claude Code admin settings toggle. Removes /workflows, commands, authoring skill and ultracode; runs in progress continue.
plans: All paid plans, API, Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Foundry

feature: Admin toggle to disable workflows org-wide
detail: The Claude Code admin settings page on claude.ai has a toggle that disables dynamic workflows for the whole organization.

feature: claude --worktree / -w: isolated session in a git worktree
detail: Creates a worktree under .claude/worktrees/<name> on branch worktree-<name> and starts Claude there; a random name is generated if omitted; needs workspace trust interactively.

feature: Ask Claude to work in a worktree (EnterWorktree)
detail: Claude can create or switch worktrees mid-session with EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree; entering a path outside .claude/worktrees needs approval that only bypass mode skips.

feature: Hooks keep project dir, cwd follows worktree
detail: After entering a worktree CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR still points to the project root while the hook input cwd is the worktree.

feature: Worktree tools removed by blockWritesOutsideWorkingDirectories
detail: With that permission key on, EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree vanish; use claude --worktree, claude --bg --worktree, worktree.bgIsolation none, or a git worktree add under the start directory.

feature: Worktree exit cleanup prompt
detail: On exit Claude checks for changes, untracked files, submodule work and new commits: clean unnamed worktrees are removed, named ones prompt, dirty ones prompt keep or remove; keeping prints a claude --worktree <name> --resume command.

feature: Worktrees from -p runs are not cleaned automatically
detail: Non-interactive runs have no exit prompt and leave locked worktrees until a later sweep or manual git worktree unlock/remove.

feature: Resume a session back into its worktree
detail: Resuming (including --continue and --resume with -p and the Agent SDK) returns an isolated session to its worktree after a safety check; --fork-session starts in the launch directory; deleted worktrees fall back with a notice.

feature: Worktree isolation enforcement
detail: In an isolated session, and its subagents, Claude Code blocks edits to the main checkout, commands whose cwd is the main checkout, git redirects (-C, GIT_DIR) and command shapes it cannot verify; cp or redirects are not tracked.

feature: Subagents in their own worktrees
detail: Ask for worktrees for agents or add isolation: worktree to a custom subagent's frontmatter; each gets a temporary worktree removed if unchanged, and loads instructions from the main conversation, not the worktree.

feature: Periodic sweep of subagent and background worktrees
detail: Removes Claude-created subagent and background-session worktrees older than cleanupPeriodDays unless they hold work, submodule changes, filter-driver issues, are active, or were made by git worktree add; locks are held while an agent runs.

feature: worktree.baseRef: fresh or head
detail: Fresh (default) branches from the remote default branch (fetching if stale >24 h, 5 s cap, fallback to local HEAD); head branches from current local HEAD. Branch names cannot be set.

feature: --worktree from a pull or merge request
detail: claude --worktree "#1234" or a GitHub PR / GitLab MR URL fetches the head commit from origin into .claude/worktrees/pr-<number>; fails rather than prompting for credentials.

feature: .worktreeinclude: copy gitignored files
detail: A gitignore-syntax file in the project root lists ignored files like .env copied into every new worktree (CLI, subagents, desktop parallel sessions); not processed when a WorktreeCreate hook is used.

feature: Reopening a named worktree resets or keeps its tip
detail: Reusing a name opens the existing worktree; with fresh base it resets to the default branch only if clean, on its own branch, with no commits or a merged PR and no sandbox write limits; otherwise keeps the old tip.

feature: WorktreeCreate and WorktreeRemove hooks
detail: Hooks replace git worktree logic to place worktrees elsewhere or support SVN, Perforce or Mercurial; the create hook prints the directory; also lets /batch run outside git (v2.1.281+).

feature: What worktrees share with main checkout
detail: Shared .git directory, project-scope plugins, saved Bash permission approvals (to main .claude/settings.local.json), and untracked .claude skills, agents and commands read through from the main checkout (skills v2.1.277+).

feature: Desktop worktree sessions read config from main checkout
detail: Desktop-started worktree sessions load settings, hooks, skills, agents, commands and .mcp.json from the main root, while CLAUDE.md and rules load from the worktree.

feature: Manual git worktree use with Claude
detail: Create worktrees with git worktree add (new or existing branch, outside repo), run claude inside, list and remove with git worktree commands.

feature: Worktree creation safeguards
detail: Refuses symlinked .claude paths, skips repo-config filter drivers (Git LFS shows pointer files; git lfs pull fixes), ignores git replace objects, and errors on partial clones, non-git dirs, mismatched-repo leftovers and worktrees resolving into the main checkout.

feature: Worktree resume notices
detail: Interactive resumes show messages when a worktree is gone, unverifiable, refused or cannot be re-entered; -p/SDK stop with an error and stream-json startup_failure_reason worktree_unverified or worktree_resume_refused.

feature: Zero data retention for Claude Code
detail: Qualified Enterprise accounts can have prompts and responses processed in real time and not stored after return, except for law or misuse; enabled only by Anthropic, not admin settings, and per organization.

feature: ZDR enterprise admin capabilities
detail: ZDR organizations still get per-user cost controls, the analytics dashboard (usage metrics only, no contribution metrics), server-managed settings and audit logs.

feature: Force login to ZDR organization
detail: Managed settings forceLoginMethod and forceLoginOrgUUID require claude.ai logins to belong to the ZDR org; personal accounts or other-org keys are not covered.

feature: ZDR scope exclusions
detail: ZDR does not cover claude.ai chat, Cowork, Artifacts, Claude in Chrome, analytics metadata, seat management data or third-party integrations and MCP servers.

feature: Features disabled under ZDR
detail: Cloud sessions, unified Chat and Cowork, Claude Tag, Artifacts in Claude Code, Claude Docs, /feedback /bug /share and Remote Control are blocked server-side for ZDR organizations.

feature: Fable models under ZDR
detail: Fable 5, 5.1 and 5.2 require data retention by default so may be hidden or disabled in /model for ZDR orgs; other models stay available, Fable is not default and best resolves to Opus.

feature: Policy-violation retention under ZDR
detail: Flagged sessions may keep inputs and outputs up to 2 years even with ZDR.

feature: HIPAA BAA coverage without ZDR
detail: Enterprise orgs with HIPAA enabled can put the Claude Code CLI and Desktop Code tab (local mode) and Cowork local mode under a BAA once the HIPAA configuration is applied; others need ZDR.

feature: Request ZDR via account team
detail: ZDR is requested through sales or the account team, reviewed, audit-logged, and not available on Bedrock, Google Cloud or Foundry through Anthropic; pay-as-you-go ZDR users can migrate to Enterprise.

feature: Compliance certifications (commercial products)
detail: Anthropic lists HIPAA-ready configuration with BAA available, ISO 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 42001:2023 and SOC 2 Type I and II for commercial products, with documents on a Trust Portal.

feature: Output blocked by content filtering policy error
detail: Replies can be stopped with this error when the filter thinks Claude would reproduce existing material; repeatedly trying to elicit copyrighted content can bring a warning, suspension or termination.

feature: Report copyright or IP infringement
detail: Rights holders can submit a notice by web form or mail with signature, work description, location, contact details and good-faith and perjury statements; repeat infringers can lose accounts.

feature: Privacy Center
detail: Anthropic points users to a Privacy Center for its privacy practices.

feature: Claude Desktop on macOS, Windows and Linux
detail: Desktop apps for macOS 13+, Windows 10+ and Linux (beta; Ubuntu 22.04+/Debian 12+, x64 or arm64). Chat is on every plan; Claude Code and Cowork need a paid plan.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Linux install through apt repository
detail: Linux users can install from Anthropic's signed apt repository so updates come with normal system package updates; the app does not self-update on Linux.

feature: Linux install from downloaded .deb
detail: A .deb can be downloaded per architecture and installed, but this does not enrol the machine in regular package updates; a key fingerprint verification step is offered.

feature: Linux limitations: no computer use or dictation
detail: On Linux Desktop computer use and dictation are unavailable; the Quick Entry global hotkey works on X11 and on Wayland relies on the GlobalShortcuts portal.

feature: Release channel: Stable or Latest
detail: Settings > Desktop app lets users choose Stable (default, fewer updates, more tested) or Latest (about daily builds, less reliable). Not on Linux, Microsoft Store installs or IT-managed machines; needs Desktop 4.29.0+.

feature: Switching Latest back to Stable keeps newer version
detail: Choosing Stable does not downgrade; the app stays on the Latest build until a newer Stable ships, so urgent fixes are missed meanwhile. Reinstalling risks locally stored data, especially on Windows.

feature: Check for Updates menu item
detail: Mac has Claude > Check for Updates and Windows has Help > Check for Updates to apply a new channel immediately.

feature: Desktop extensions directory
detail: Settings > Desktop app > Extensions > Manage opens a curated directory of one-click installable local extensions (filesystem, iMessage and more) with code signing, encrypted secret storage and enterprise policy controls.

feature: Claude Cowork in Desktop
detail: Cowork brings Claude Code style agentic work to a visual interface: local file access, long tasks, parallel workstreams and spreadsheets or decks as output. It runs in an isolated VM limited to connected folders and egress settings.

feature: Cowork on Linux requirements
detail: Linux Cowork needs KVM virtualization, membership of the kvm group, QEMU packages, about 25 GB disk and at least 8 GB RAM (4 GB used while running).

feature: Dictation on Claude mobile
detail: Microphone icon in the chat input turns speech to text, sent as a written prompt with a text reply; arrow sends and X cancels. Different from voice mode.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Dictation languages
detail: Dictation supports English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Turkish and Ukrainian; non-English support is in beta.

feature: Speech Input Language setting
detail: Tap your initials then Speech Input Language to change the dictation language; the first use asks for a language.

feature: Dictation audio deleted after transcription
detail: Audio is deleted after conversion to text and only the text prompt is kept; Free, Pro, Max and Ultra users may opt to share recordings to improve dictation and voice mode.

feature: Google Workspace connectors (Gmail, Calendar, Drive)
detail: Connect Gmail, Google Calendar and Drive so Claude can search, draft and act on them inside a chat, with citations linking to the source emails, events or documents.
plans: All plans; Team/Enterprise owner must enable first

feature: Gmail: search, read, draft, label
detail: Natural language search and reading of mail and thread metadata, drafting with formatting, label and thread management and listing saved drafts.

feature: Gmail: send, reply, forward with approval
detail: Claude can send, reply to and forward mail; outside Auto mode it asks approval each time, and in Auto mode it may run unprompted unless flagged. Team/Enterprise owners decide if members can allow no-ask runs.

feature: Gmail attachments up to about 12 MB
detail: Claude can open attachments to read them, up to roughly 12 MB; needs code execution and file creation on, and is not available in every organization.

feature: Google Calendar actions
detail: View events and shared calendars, create, update and delete events, find mutual availability, manage attendees, answer invites and set recurring meetings.

feature: Google Drive actions
detail: Search and read Docs, Sheets, Slides, PDFs, images and Office files; look up metadata, upload any type with optional conversion, create folders, view permissions and recent changes.

feature: Drive share, move, trash with approval
detail: Sharing, moving and trashing Drive files asks for approval outside Auto mode; Team/Enterprise owners choose whether members may skip asking.

feature: Save Claude-generated files to Drive
detail: Files Claude creates can be saved directly to Drive when code execution and file creation are enabled.

feature: Add Drive files to a chat
detail: Plus menu > Add from Google Drive, search recent docs or paste a URL; several files may be added if they fit in context, and Docs stay synced to the latest version. Only text is extracted, not images.

feature: Add Drive files to private project knowledge
detail: In a project Files section, + > Drive adds docs as synced knowledge; unavailable for shared projects.

feature: Live co-editing of Google Docs, Sheets, Slides
detail: Separate Docs, Sheets and Slides connectors let Claude and the user edit the same file simultaneously in a pane beside the chat; Claude can also create new Google files when asked by name and read Docs comments and suggestions.

feature: Google file pane requirements and Open in Google
detail: The pane works on web in Chrome and on Desktop with built-in browser on; elsewhere use Open in Google on the file card. The pane needs its own Google sign-in, and a different account prompts a switch.

feature: Google file cards and pane header actions
detail: Each created or edited Google file appears as a card in chat; the pane header copies the Google link, opens it in Google or shows the share dialog.

feature: Per-connector toggles under the plus menu
detail: Plus > Connectors lets each Google connector be switched on or off per chat; if one is off when needed Claude prompts to connect.

feature: Google file limits: no Slides charts, generic doc stays local
detail: Claude cannot add charts to Slides and Slides edits may not show live; asking for a doc without naming Google creates a downloadable local file. Some Gmail filters, big mailboxes and API quotas also limit results.

feature: Google connector data handling
detail: Access is limited to the connected account and its existing permissions, retrieved data is stored with the chat and deleted when the chat is deleted, encrypted, and not used for training.

feature: Org-level enable or disable of Google connectors
detail: Owners and Primary Owners enable or disable the Google connectors in Organization settings > Connectors; admins may need to mark Claude trusted in Google Workspace API controls.

feature: Reconnect Google connector
detail: Customize > Connectors > Disconnect then re-authenticate on next use fixes reconnect errors; fallback is deleting the Claude connection in the Google account settings.

feature: Claude Meetings uses Calendar connection
detail: Claude Meetings (beta) also relies on the Google Calendar connection but works differently from the standard connector.

feature: GitHub integration for chats
detail: Plus > Add from GitHub lets users pick files and folders from a repository to give Claude as context; prompts GitHub authentication if needed.

feature: GitHub repos in project knowledge with Sync and Configure files
detail: In a project, add a repo by search or URL, choose files and folders, press Sync to refresh and Configure files to change selection.

feature: Private repo access via GitHub App
detail: Private repos need the Claude GitHub App installed on all or selected repos; non-admins can send an access request to org admins.

feature: GitHub SSO organization authorization
detail: Organizations requiring SSO need each user to grant the Claude app under GitHub application settings; the repo picker shows a banner, and reconnecting does not fix it. EMU needs a managed-account sign-in.

feature: GitHub linking blocked by zero data retention
detail: Organizations with zero data retention for Claude Code cannot link the GitHub App in Organization settings > Git providers, and also lack contribution metrics in Claude Code analytics.

feature: GitHub sync scope
detail: Only file names and contents on a branch are synced, not commits, PRs or metadata; multiple repos allowed if they fit the context window.

feature: Instructions for Claude (account-wide)
detail: Settings > Your Claude lets users write general instructions applied to every conversation; Cowork global instructions merge into it in the new experience.

feature: Project instructions
detail: Instructions scoped to chats inside one project; projects exist on free accounts with a cap of five projects, while another passage says project instructions are paid-only.

feature: Skills as personalization
detail: Skills adjust tone and format, apply your writing patterns or add specialised capabilities on demand.

feature: Switch Pro from monthly to annual billing
detail: Settings > Billing > Adjust plan > Get Pro annual plan > Confirm; switches immediately, credits unused monthly time on the first annual invoice and sets next billing a year out.

feature: Console roles: User, Claude Code User, Limited Developer, Developer, Billing, Ad
detail: Six org-level roles govern Console access from playground-only to full admin (manage users, API keys, billing, usage, vaults, session traces, file downloads, MCP tunnels).

feature: Console workspace-level permissions
detail: Org Admins get Workspace Admin everywhere, Billing holders see cost across workspaces, and workspace roles can add permissions above the org baseline.

feature: Ask Claude App Intent
detail: On iOS 18+ users can ask Claude from Spotlight, Siri, the Share menu or any intent-aware app without opening the app.

feature: Claude in Apple Shortcuts
detail: The Ask Claude action can be chained with other actions in the Shortcuts app to build automated workflows, such as summarising shared text.

feature: Ask Claude intent uses default model and counts toward usage
detail: The intent and Shortcuts actions use the model shown as default in the app, and every message counts against the overall usage limit.

feature: Claude Home Screen and Today View widget
detail: iOS 18+ widget with buttons to start a new chat, open the app straight into dictation, or take a photo to share; usage counts toward limits.

feature: Analyze Photo with Claude control
detail: A Control Center and Lock Screen control that sends an image to Claude for analysis without opening the app.

feature: Open Claude Lock Screen control
detail: iOS 18+ lets users add an Open Claude control to the Lock Screen bottom slots.

feature: Open Claude Control Center control
detail: An Open Claude control can be added to Control Center through Add a Control.

feature: Action button launches Claude
detail: The iPhone Action button can be set to the Controls option and pointed at Open Claude.

feature: SSO parent organization model
detail: SSO settings live in a parent organization that holds domain verification and one identity provider and can be shared by several Claude and Console orgs; Enterprise gets it automatically, Team when SSO is first enabled, Console by request.

feature: Merge organizations under a parent org
detail: Team or Enterprise orgs with verified domains can invite other orgs whose members all use those domains; the invited admin must approve within 14 days from Organization settings. Console orgs cannot initiate.

feature: Restrict organization creation toggle
detail: After domain verification, owners can block creating new Claude or Console orgs, personal accounts included, on verified domains.

feature: Provisioning: invite only, JIT, SCIM
detail: Invite-only and JIT work on Team, Enterprise and Console; SCIM is Enterprise only (a Console org merged under a Team parent gets no SCIM).

feature: Require SSO for Claude and effect on personal accounts
detail: Members added to SSO can switch between work and prior personal accounts; non-SSO users keep Continue with email unless Require SSO is on, which makes their personal accounts inaccessible though not deleted.

feature: Domain memberships export
detail: Organization and access page lists accounts on verified domains and downloads them as CSV or JSON.

feature: Log out of all active sessions
detail: Settings > Account > Log Out signs the account out on every browser, mobile device, desktop app, Claude Code (including CI setup tokens) and tools like Chrome and Slack; API keys are unaffected. Not offered in mobile apps.

feature: Web session lasts 28 days and refreshes hourly
detail: A claude.ai session lasts 28 days from last activity and is refreshed each hour of use.

feature: Sign out of Claude Code only by removing token
detail: Claude Code sign-ins appear under Settings > Account or Settings > Claude Code where the trash icon removes a token and logs that tool out alone.

feature: Sign back in with Google or emailed link
detail: After a global logout you authenticate again with Google login or a login link sent by email.

feature: Delete a Console organization
detail: A Console Admin can delete the org from Organization page by typing a confirmation; it affects all members, needs any balance paid, and Support can restore within seven days.

feature: API usage tiers assigned automatically
detail: API rate-limit tiers rise automatically with no deposit; higher limits can be requested in Console once 50% of limits are used. Team-linked Console orgs get at least Build tier for the $500 monthly API credit.

feature: Mathematical equations and calculations
detail: Claude processes equations and calculations but critical results should be checked with dedicated math software.

feature: Custom data retention for chats, projects, artifacts
detail: Owners set a retention period (minimum 30 days) in Organization settings > Data and Privacy; default is indefinite, project retention overrides chat retention, and expired data is permanently deleted.

feature: What resets the retention clock
detail: Opening or messaging a chat or project, editing project knowledge or instructions, and starting or touching Cowork sessions from a project restart the period; artifacts count from last open or edit.

feature: Retention exclusions and audit logging
detail: Retention does not apply to standalone Claude Design, Claude Tag, Managed Agents or other cloud Claude Code features, public-link artifacts are spared, and retention changes are written to audit logs.

feature: Rate chats (thumbs feedback) org toggle
detail: Owners switch the members' thumbs up/down feedback to Anthropic on or off in Organization settings > Data and Privacy.

feature: Console feedback switch
detail: Console Admins turn thumbs feedback on or off under Usage data and feedback on the Data retention page.

feature: Claude Android home screen widget
detail: Resizable widget on Android 8.0+ with buttons for a new chat, camera capture and voice dictation; first dictation use shows an explanation and may ask for mic permission; usage counts toward limits.

feature: Share a chat snapshot by link
detail: Share button creates a link to a snapshot of the chat up to that moment including artifacts; later messages stay private until it is unshared and reshared.

feature: Shared snapshots hide files and raw tool data
detail: Attached files and raw MCP tool-call data are not exposed in the snapshot; Personal Finance figures and charts in replies can be.

feature: Unshare by setting visibility to Private
detail: The Share menu visibility dropdown switches Public back to Private to kill the link.

feature: Shared chats manager in Privacy settings
detail: Settings > Privacy > Shared chats lists title, date and link of each shared chat with an Unshare button.

feature: Team and Enterprise chats share only inside the org
detail: On these plans chat links work only for members of the same organization, not publicly.

feature: Web search with citations
detail: Claude searches the live web, shows a searching indicator and answers with citations, links and quotes; supported across current Fable, Opus, Sonnet and Haiku models.

feature: Web search toggle in plus menu
detail: Classic chats have a Web search item under + that can be switched per chat; in the new Claude experience there is no toggle and Claude searches when useful.

feature: Org must enable web search
detail: Owners enable web search workspace-wide in Organization settings > Capabilities before members can use it.

feature: Web fetch of pasted URLs
detail: With web search on, Claude fetches whole pages from URLs you give it; on Free the full article enters context and can burn much of the usage limit.

feature: Image results in web search
detail: Claude can show images from Bing-powered search results with source links, no separate setting.

feature: Free usage limit resets every five hours
detail: Free accounts have a limit that resets each five hours and web search and fetch both consume it.

feature: Web search limitations and location use
detail: Search can be slow, links may break, and IP-inferred location may localize results; searches count toward usage.

feature: Report content in shared chats
detail: Shared chat content can be reported with an in-product report button or a standalone form; any output violating policy or law can be reported by form.

feature: Site-owner controls to block content from Claude web search
detail: Site owners can remove or password-protect content, use noindex or robots.txt, block Anthropic's bots, or request removal of a URL by proving ownership.

feature: Report safety issues
detail: Safety issues or over-blocking by safety mechanisms can be reported by email with reproduction detail.

feature: Interface languages
detail: Display languages are English, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Latin American Spanish and Spain Spanish; Claude still answers in whatever language you write.

feature: Language setting from profile menu
detail: Profile icon > Language changes the interface language immediately.

feature: Separate voice spoken language setting
detail: Voice mode language is set at Settings > Capabilities > Voice > Spoken language (or Settings > General > Voice > Language), independent of display language.

feature: Install extensions from the directory
detail: Settings > Desktop app > Extensions > Browse extensions lists Anthropic-reviewed local MCP servers installed with one click, with a form for required settings such as API keys.

feature: Install a custom .mcpb extension
detail: Advanced settings > Extension Developer > Install Extension loads a packaged .mcpb file for private or in-development local MCP servers.

feature: Admin control of desktop extensions
detail: Team and Enterprise owners can enable or disable public extensions, keep an allowlist and upload custom extensions for one-click team install; machine-level policy overrides in-app controls.

feature: Desktop extension runtimes and secure secrets
detail: Extensions can be Node.js (built-in runtime), Python or binary servers; fields marked sensitive are stored in the OS keychain; directory extensions auto-update, private ones update manually.

feature: Check connected MCP servers and logs
detail: The + menu Connectors list or the Extensions page and Developer settings show server status and logs.

feature: Max plan at $100 per month
detail: Max gives five times Pro usage per five hours and per week, priority access to new models and features, Claude Code, long background tasks and monthly API credits; monthly billing only; mobile prices may differ.

feature: Max limits: five-hour, weekly all-model and weekly Fable
detail: Max has a five-hour limit, a weekly limit across all models and a separate weekly Fable limit, resetting at a fixed account-specific time shown in Settings > Usage; extra caps may apply.

feature: Limit resets
detail: A limit reset can restore the five-hour or weekly allowance to full.

feature: Upgrade proration rules from Pro, annual Pro, Max to Ultra
detail: Moving between plans prorates charges; annual Pro balances above the Max price become account credit if billing addresses match; Google Play upgrades charge full price and convert unused value into extra days.

feature: No standing discounts or one-off coupons
detail: Individual plans have no regular discounts and Support cannot issue coupons; promotions are announced occasionally and nonprofits can get discounted Team and Enterprise pricing.

feature: Sign up for or upgrade to Max
detail: New users choose Max during onboarding; Free and Pro users use Settings > Billing > Upgrade to Max. A Pro upgrade takes effect immediately, restarts the billing cycle with prorated credit and resets usage to Max limits.

feature: Max auto-renews and can be cancelled anytime
detail: The subscription renews each period by default and can be cancelled at any time.

feature: Research mode
detail: A plus-menu Research toggle makes Claude run chained multi-step searches over the web and enabled connectors and produce a cited report; needs web search on.

feature: Mobile research skips connectors silently
detail: Research started in the mobile app searches the web only without error; use web or Desktop to include connectors, and local MCP servers are never used.

feature: Research uses connector tools without per-call approval
detail: During research Claude calls enabled connector tools automatically, including Gmail, Calendar and Docs.

feature: Research always runs on Opus 5.5 with Opus 4.8 fallback
detail: Research ignores the chat's chosen model; Team and Enterprise members whose admin disabled both Opus models cannot use research.

feature: Research drains usage faster
detail: Research follows normal limits but consumes them faster because of many sources.

feature: Choosing web search, extended thinking or research
detail: Web search suits quick factual lookups of one or two calls, extended thinking suits hard reasoning without web, and research suits five-plus-call reports over one to three minutes; thinking and research can be combined.

feature: Voice mode (spoken conversation)
detail: Full two-way spoken conversation with Claude, with voice and text switchable inside one chat with context carried over; built to work best on phones.

feature: Enable voice mode via sound wave icon
detail: Sound wave icon at lower right of the chat starts voice mode on web and Desktop; Stop button ends it.

feature: Voice mode icon in mobile input field
detail: Tap the sound wave next to the mic in the input, pick a voice, then speak.

feature: Hands-free mode (default)
detail: Claude listens continuously, answers at natural pauses and stops when you speak again.

feature: Push-to-talk mode
detail: Hold a button while speaking for noisy places or when background voices confuse hands-free mode.

feature: Choose voice and pace
detail: A preset set of voices with previews; change in Settings > Capabilities > Voice (web) or the in-call settings button (mobile, voice and pace).

feature: Model selector inside voice mode
detail: Voice starts on the last used model family and auto-updates to its latest generation; a selector lets you switch families mid-call; Fable is not available in voice.

feature: Connected tools and web search in voice mode
detail: Voice can use web search and connectors like Gmail, Calendar, Docs and Slack; Free can connect one tool, paid more; some results cannot be shown on screen.

feature: Voice usage counts toward plan limits
detail: Voice conversations consume the normal usage limits.

feature: Voice recordings deleted, transcript kept
detail: Audio is discarded after transcription; the transcript stays in chat history; Free through Ultra users may opt in to share recordings.

feature: Voice safety limits
detail: Only preset voices are offered to prevent cloning or impersonation, replies are generative, and the usage policy and misuse detection still apply.

feature: Voice mode in Cowork and Claude Code
detail: In the new Claude experience voice works in any conversation including working tasks; in Cowork and Claude Code only dictation is available.

feature: Enterprise voice mode disable via Support
detail: Enterprise owners must ask Support to turn voice mode off for their organization.

feature: Voice mode in many languages
detail: Voice supports many languages in beta on all plans; language is set in voice settings or by asking Claude to switch mid-call.

feature: Promotions limited to first-time paid subscribers
detail: Coupons show an error for current or past paid subscribers and for App Store subscribers, who must cancel and resubscribe directly to qualify.

feature: Claude for Education admin setup
detail: Owners follow SSO, JIT/SCIM, project sharing, connectors, web search, audit logs, seat management, retention and feedback settings, plus a documented university support path; Anthropic supports only Owners directly.

feature: Enforce SSO for Claude.ai on Education
detail: With enforcement on, users with personal accounts outside the SSO app lose access (accounts are not deleted); without it they can use Continue with email.

feature: Claude for Teachers (K-12)
detail: K-12 educators are pointed to a separate Claude for Teachers offering.

feature: University-sponsored Claude for Education plan
detail: Includes enlarged context, newest models, Projects, higher usage limits, priority access and file uploads such as PDF, DOCX, CSV, TXT and HTML, with possible university customisation.

feature: Conversations sync across web, desktop and mobile
detail: Sign in with the university account on web, macOS 13+/Windows 10+ desktop, iOS 18+ or Android 8+ and conversations carry over; mobile adds photo analysis and dictation.

feature: Existing personal account with university email
detail: Users can switch between personal and university accounts or close the personal one and move what can move; exports cannot be imported into the university account.

feature: Usage warnings and length limit errors
detail: Warnings appear before limits; a length error means the prompt exceeds the context window so shorten it or start a new chat.

feature: (model name) sweepstakes referral link (past promotion)
detail: A May to June 2025 promotion where referral links at claude.ai/invite earned sweepstakes entries (max 100 per user) for four-month Max 5x prizes; ages 18 and over in listed countries.

feature: Claude Code included in Pro, Max and Ultra
detail: Individual paid plans include Claude Code in the terminal and in IDEs (VS Code and forks like Cursor, JetBrains) under one subscription, with login using the same Claude credentials.

feature: Switch Claude Code from Console PAYG to subscription with /login
detail: Running /login in Claude Code moves it from Console pay-as-you-go to a plan; /logout, claude update and a terminal restart fix a missing account option.

feature: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY overrides subscription
detail: If this environment variable is set, Claude Code authenticates with the API key and bills API usage instead of using subscription allowance.

feature: Shared limits across Claude and Claude Code
detail: Pro and Max have a five-hour and weekly limit; Ultra has weekly limit and verified Ultra has no five-hour limit; Max and Ultra add a weekly Fable limit; all activity in both tools counts together, with warnings near limits.

feature: Claude Code wrap-up allowance at five-hour limit
detail: When the five-hour limit hits mid-response Claude Code may finish the step in progress (shows Usage limit reached, wrapping up), counted toward weekly limit; Pro once per week, Max each time; rolling out gradually.

feature: Usage credits to continue after limits
detail: Pro, Max and Ultra users can enable usage credits to keep working after hitting limits, or buy Console API credits; Max and Ultra monthly API credits cannot be used in the apps or Claude Code.

feature: Decline API credits and check /status
detail: In Claude Code users can refuse the API credits prompt, watch allowance with /status, and logging in with plan credentials only (no Console) prevents the prompt; Console auto-reload applies only if API credits are chosen.

feature: Development Partner Program
detail: Organizations can opt in to share Claude Code input and output tokens for model improvement; data kept up to two years, applies org-wide with members notified, ZDR accounts excluded and invoice customers contact their account executive.

feature: Government and regulator point of contact
detail: Authorities can email a dedicated address for official requests and removal submissions; users reporting illegal content use the separate content removal mechanisms.

feature: Custom connectors via remote MCP
detail: Users add a remote MCP server URL under Customize > Connectors (Add > Custom > Web); Free is limited to one custom connector; works on Claude, Cowork and Desktop for all plans.

feature: Remote connector reached from Anthropic cloud on port 443
detail: Claude connects to the MCP server from Anthropic infrastructure, so it must be public on HTTPS port 443 or allowlist Anthropic IP ranges; local desktop MCP servers are a separate mechanism.

feature: Connector authentication choices
detail: Choose Sign in now, Sign in when needed or No sign in; pick OAuth client as Claude's published identity, automatic registration or own client with ID and secret; or add fixed request headers like API keys.

feature: Who may add custom connectors to an org
detail: On Team only Owners add them; on Enterprise Owners and custom roles with Manage access to Libraries; members then connect individually unless the connector uses a shared credential.

feature: Remove or edit custom connector
detail: Connectors are removed via Customize > Connectors or org settings; editing requires removing and re-adding.

feature: Interactive connectors with inline cards and fullscreen view
detail: Some connectors render live dashboards, task boards or design tools in chat as inline cards or a fullscreen view while the composer stays available; org owners can disable specific interactive tool calls.

feature: Connector tool approval and Allow always
detail: Tool requests ask for approval with an Allow always option, and a Search and tools menu lets users disable tools; research runs connector tools without approvals so write tools should be disabled.

feature: Connectors Directory and browse paths
detail: Browse connectors from the plus menu (or /) > Connectors > Manage connectors or from Customize > Connectors; installing connectors on mobile is in beta.

feature: Connectors inherit the user's permissions
detail: Claude reaches only what the signed-in person can reach in the source service; connectors work across Claude, Desktop, Claude Code and the API, and can read and take actions.

feature: Claude proposes connected apps on its own
detail: Once an app is connected Claude may bring it into a conversation when relevant without being named.

feature: Per-conversation connector toggles
detail: Plus menu or / > Connectors enables each connected service for the current chat; connections made on web or Desktop show up on mobile.

feature: Tool access modes: Auto or On demand
detail: A Tool access setting under Connectors controls how connector tools load; Auto is default and On demand is suggested for ten or more connectors.

feature: Org-level connector enablement and Enterprise-managed auth
detail: Owners enable connectors via Browse connectors > Add to your team; each member still authenticates, except Enterprise-managed auth (beta) which authorizes once for the whole org.

feature: Let members request connectors
detail: Members press Request in the directory; on by default for Team, off for Enterprise until an Owner turns it on; owners approve, decline or decline and block from the Requests tab in Notifications.

feature: Restrict connector actions org-wide
detail: Owners set each tool category or tool in a connector's Tools tab to Always allow, Needs approval or Blocked, such as read-only email; Enterprise custom roles apply the stricter rule.

feature: Restrict verified-domain connectors to your enterprise
detail: Enterprise owners can stop services on their verified domains from being connected to Claude accounts outside the organization.

feature: Disable sharing of chats that use connectors
detail: Orgs can turn off Share chats that use connectors, which also blocks sharing chats in projects with synced content.

feature: Always ask before using a connector tool
detail: A setting makes Claude ask before each use of a chosen connector tool in chat and Cowork.

feature: Plaid under Personal Finance
detail: The Plaid connector belongs to Personal Finance with its own requirements and limits.

feature: AI for Science free API credits
detail: A program giving free API credits to academic and nonprofit researchers on priority science topics (biology focus); credits do not apply to the Claude web app and no usage-policy exemption.

feature: AI for Science credit size and review cadence
detail: Approved programs get up to $20,000 in API credits for six months, reviewed monthly (first Monday), allocated to one org ID that can be shared among researchers; no fine-tuning access or non-public models.

feature: (model name) contest with referral link banner (past promotion)
detail: A 2025 ten-day referral contest for Free, Pro and Max users (not Team, Enterprise or API) in listed countries, awarding four months of Max or a $100 coupon for existing Max users; link found in an in-app banner.

feature: Report universal jailbreaks and security vulnerabilities
detail: A public form takes universal jailbreak reports for biological-threat safety levels, and a responsible disclosure policy covers security vulnerability reports.

feature: RAG for projects
detail: When project knowledge nears the context limit Claude automatically switches to retrieval mode, expanding capacity up to 10x with a visible RAG indicator and a project knowledge search tool call; it reverts when knowledge shrinks.

feature: RAG works with web search, extended thinking and research
detail: RAG-enabled projects stay compatible with all Claude tools; no setup and users cannot toggle it.

feature: Enterprise single seat plus usage at API rates
detail: Current Enterprise bills a per-user annual seat fee covering web, desktop, mobile, Claude Code and Cowork with no included tokens; all token use is billed at API rates, 1.1x for US-only inference.

feature: Self-serve Enterprise prepaid credits and payment methods
detail: Usage is bought upfront as an org-shared credit pool, stops when empty, USD only, payable by card, debit or ACH, and added from Organization settings > Usage; seats cannot be removed mid-term.

feature: Sales-assisted Enterprise monthly invoicing
detail: Usage is invoiced monthly in arrears with a payment link by email, bank transfer or card (bank transfer only at $50,000 or more); AWS Marketplace purchases are billed in arrears.

feature: Enterprise spend limits at org and user level
detail: Owners and roles with Billing Can manage set org and per-user limits in Organization settings > Usage; the lower applies and usage stops when reached; unlimited still bills; limit alerts available.

feature: Blocked by a spend limit analytics
detail: A usage dashboard shows members blocked now, near limit and member-days lost with a chart and forecast for all members and top 10% spenders, and lets admins raise defaults.

feature: Legacy Enterprise seat types transition
detail: Chat, Chat + Claude Code and Standard/Premium seats are closed to new contracts and move to the single Enterprise seat at renewal.

feature: EU point of contact and DSA user numbers
detail: EU users reach support through a chat tool serving as the DSA contact, and Anthropic publishes six-monthly EU active user averages, currently below the 45 million threshold.

feature: Connectors Directory FAQ moved to developer docs
detail: The directory FAQ now lives in Claude developer docs covering connector overview, building and submitting.

feature: Five-hour session and weekly usage limits
detail: Paid plans have a session limit starting at the first message and resetting five hours later, plus weekly all-model limits (and Fable limits on some plans) with a fixed per-account reset; progress shows in Settings > Usage; verified Ultra has no five-hour limit.

feature: Usage shared across Claude surfaces
detail: claude.ai, Claude Code and Desktop draw from one allowance affected by length, features, model and effort level.

feature: Usage credits instead of stopping at limits
detail: With usage credits enabled work continues on credits when limits hit; upgrading applies new limits immediately; usage-based Enterprise is consumption billed.

feature: Context window up to 1M tokens on paid plans
detail: Newest models allow up to 1M tokens, others 500K or 200K, with part reserved for the reply; length limit differs from usage limit.

feature: Automatic context management with code execution
detail: With code execution on, Claude summarizes earlier messages near the limit (shown as organizing its thoughts) while keeping full history, using more usage.

feature: Thinking toggle and effort level reduce usage
detail: On models with a thinking toggle you can turn it off, on always-thinking models like Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 pick lower effort, and disable unneeded connectors or web search.

feature: Remote connectors vs desktop extensions
detail: Remote connectors suit cloud services and work on all surfaces; desktop extensions run locally and exist only in Desktop and Claude Code; plugins can bundle either, with local MCPs working in Cowork and Claude Code not chat.

feature: Canvas LMS Claude LTI integration
detail: Education admins create an LTI developer key in Canvas, install it by client ID with Course Navigation and Assignment Edit placements, then enable Canvas in Organization settings > Connectors with domain, client ID and deployment ID.

feature: Education account defaults: exports, audit log, thumbs feedback off
detail: In Claude for Education the Primary Owner manages data and by default owner data exports, audit logs and thumbs feedback are disabled until requested from Support; Anthropic acts as data processor.

feature: Search past chats
detail: Claude can search earlier conversations on request (RAG shown as tool calls), across non-project chats and within a single project's own chats; skips chats that used Personal Finance accounts.

feature: Search and reference chats toggle
detail: Settings > Your Claude (or Memory) switch turns past-chat search off; it also controls whether Claude Duet (research preview for Pro, Max, Ultra) can search past chats.

feature: Past chat citations with delete option
detail: When Claude uses an earlier chat it shows citations linking to the source chats and offers deletion of specific conversations.

feature: Incognito chat excluded from search and memory
detail: The ghost icon on a new non-project chat opens a temporary chat not saved to history or memory; on Team and Enterprise it still appears in exports and retention. Past-chat search is unavailable with customer-managed encryption keys.

feature: Memory generated from chats
detail: Claude saves memory as individual topics while you chat (not post-hoc summaries), or when told to remember something; on by default for Free, Pro, Max and Ultra.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra; Team/Enterprise owner-controlled

feature: Per-project memory and Use account memory toggle
detail: Each project keeps its own memory used with non-project memory but not other projects; a project-page Use account memory switch fully separates it.

feature: Shared memory across chat and cloud Cowork
detail: Memory flows between chat and Cowork tasks that run in the cloud; local Cowork sessions do not use memory; Claude Duet also uses and adds to it.

feature: Turn memory off for a single chat
detail: Before the first message, plus menu > Memory switches it off for that chat or task (also in projects and before starting voice); the chat stays in history, shows a crossed-out icon on web and a locked switch on mobile.

feature: Pause or reset memory
detail: Turning off Generate memory from chats offers Pause (keeps memory, stops use and saving) or Reset (permanently deletes all memories including project memory).

feature: Include sensitive topics in memory opt-in
detail: Health, politics, religion and similar topics are not saved by default; an opt-in setting (or one-time prompt) saves them going forward with a notice above the message box, and removes saved items if declined or turned off.

feature: Never-remembered data classes
detail: Government ID numbers, criminal history, financial account numbers and immigration status are never saved to memory even if asked.

feature: View, edit and delete memory topics
detail: Settings > Your Claude > Manage lists memory as Topics that can be opened, edited with the pencil or deleted, and users can also tell Claude in chat what to remember, change or forget.

feature: Import and export memory (experimental)
detail: Memory can be imported from other AI assistants or exported for backup or migration.

feature: Org-level memory control and default
detail: Owners toggle memory in Organization settings > Capabilities; orgs created on or after Oct 31, 2026 start with it on for members, older orgs off until the member enables it; HIPAA, government and Claude for Teachers orgs do not start on; owners cannot view or edit members' memories.

feature: Memory and retention interplay for orgs
detail: Org-wide off stops use but keeps entries for re-enable; a chat retention period also applies to memory (not project memory) under the unified experience; incognito chats stay exportable at least 30 days; audit logs record only org toggles.

feature: Legacy memory summary experience
detail: A few orgs still use legacy memory with a 24-hour synthesised summary, project summaries, a pencil-edit manage modal, no Cowork support, and a monthly recap hidden when paused.

feature: Payment method verification prompt
detail: A login modal asks users to Verify now for a payment method, and Remind me later hides it for 24 hours.

feature: Update Claude for iOS via App Store
detail: Update manually from App Store My Account pending updates; Intune-managed Enterprise installs are updated by IT.

feature: Update Claude for Android via Google Play
detail: Update manually from Play Store > Manage apps & device > Updates available.

feature: Claude Code included with Team and Enterprise seats
detail: Every Team seat includes Claude Code (Premium seats more usage); new and self-serve Enterprise seats include it; Desktop has a Code tab that needs nothing else installed, with terminal and IDE (VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains) options.

feature: Authenticate Claude Code with Claude account with subscription
detail: /login then Claude account with subscription then Authorize links the Team or Enterprise seat; skills and plugins from the Claude account sync into Claude Code on v2.1.273+.

feature: Claude Code under HIPAA-ready Enterprise
detail: BAA covers Claude Code in terminal and Desktop Code tab only after HIPAA configuration or ZDR; IDE extensions are not covered and should not touch PHI.

feature: Team and seat-based Enterprise usage credits for Claude Code
detail: Usage credits let members keep working after included limits; usage-based Enterprise has no per-seat limits; monthly API credits cannot be used in Claude Code or the apps.

feature: Claude with iOS system apps
detail: Claude can draft texts and emails that open pre-filled in Messages, Mail or third-party apps, read the calendar and create events, create reminders and items in existing lists, find nearby places and show them on an interactive map with Apple Maps directions.

feature: iOS integration limits
detail: Team and Enterprise lack the location tool, Claude cannot read messages, emails or contacts, cannot create reminder lists, and edits only events you own.

feature: Apple Health analysis with native charts
detail: Claude reads activity, workouts, vitals, body measurements, sleep and nutrition from Apple Health and shows bar, line and progress charts; read-only, US only, not medical advice, not saved to memory unless sensitive topics on.

feature: iOS permission prompts for calendar, location, reminders, health
detail: Messages and Mail need no permission; calendar read, location, reminders and health prompt contextually with options such as Allow once.

feature: Manage iOS permissions for Claude
detail: Location, calendar and reminders can be switched between While Using App, Ask next time or Never in iOS Settings > Claude; Health data types are managed in Settings > Health > Data Access.

feature: Claude with Android system apps
detail: Claude can draft messages and emails in default or third-party apps, read the calendar and create events, set alarms and timers through the Clock app, find nearby places and show them on an interactive map opening Google Maps.

feature: Android integration limits
detail: Team and Enterprise lack location, reminders exist only on iOS, Claude cannot read messages or contacts, and event editing depends on ownership.

feature: Health Connect analysis with native charts
detail: Claude reads activity, workouts, vitals, body, sleep and nutrition from Health Connect and charts them; needs Android 14+, US only, read-only, no work profiles, and not saved to memory by default.

feature: Manage Android permissions for Claude
detail: Permissions (Allow once, Always, Don't allow) can be changed under Settings > Apps > Claude > Permissions and Health Connect has its own app permissions screen.

feature: /security-review command
detail: Runs an on-demand security analysis of the codebase for SQL injection, XSS, authentication flaws, insecure data handling and dependency vulnerabilities, with explanations and optional fixes, in the terminal or Desktop Code tab.

feature: GitHub Action for automated PR security review
detail: A configurable action reviews each new pull request for vulnerabilities, filters false positives and posts inline comments with recommended fixes.

feature: /model command in Claude Code
detail: Typing /model in the terminal or Desktop Code tab opens an interactive model menu that applies immediately, and /status shows the current model.

feature: --model flag and ANTHROPIC_MODEL default
detail: A --model flag sets the model for one terminal session and an ANTHROPIC_MODEL environment variable in the shell config sets a permanent default.

feature: Models selectable in Claude Code
detail: Claude Code accepts Fable 5.2, 5.1 and 5, Opus 5.5, 5, 4.8, 4.7, 4.6 and 4.5, Sonnet 5.5, 5, 4.6 and 4.5, and Haiku 5.5 and 4.5 by model ID.

feature: Team seat types: Standard and Premium
detail: Standard seats include base features, usage limits and Claude Code; Premium adds higher usage limits; orgs can mix them, and only Admins and above see each member's tier.

feature: Buy and reduce Team seats
detail: Owners add or reduce seats via Organization and access > Total seats > Seat breakdown; additions prorate immediately while reductions take effect at renewal with no refund.

feature: Reassign seat tier and No seat assigned option
detail: Admins change a member's Tier in Organization settings > Members; Standard to Premium prorates, Premium to Standard applies at renewal; No seat assigned parks a member without removing them.

feature: Seats are named single-user
detail: Each seat belongs to one named person with no credential sharing, no transfer of unused usage and no rotation among active users; JIT or SCIM users get the highest available seat type.

feature: Agent usage policy restrictions
detail: Agents must not be used for surveillance, facial recognition, phishing or impersonation, scaled abuse such as spam, DDoS or fake engagement, or unauthorized system access including malware, privilege escalation and unlicensed financial transactions.

feature: Usage credits for Team and seat-based Enterprise
detail: Owners enable credits at Organization settings > Usage so members keep working in Claude, Cowork and Claude Code after seat limits, billed at API rates; Team prepays with auto-reload and seat-based Enterprise bills monthly.

feature: Org, seat-tier, group and per-user spend limits
detail: Owners set monthly credit spend limits for the org, per seat tier or group (Enterprise) and per user where available with an MTD spend column; a user at limit pauses until month end.

feature: Request usage credits flow
detail: Seat-based Enterprise members hitting limits see Request usage credits, admins review requests in Usage and get a daily email; owners can turn requests off.
