feature: Usage credits expire after 12 months and are non-refundable
detail: Credits bought for Team and seat-based Enterprise expire 12 months after purchase, carry over on Team to Enterprise migration, and a spend limit can be slightly exceeded by the last request; owners may disable credits entirely.

feature: Claude in Chrome extension
detail: A Chrome-only extension (no other Chromium browsers or mobile) lets Claude read, click, type, navigate and fill forms; available on paid plans in the side panel, Cowork and Claude Code and works with all public models.

feature: Side panel runs as a Cowork session
detail: On Max, Ultra, Team (Pro as rollout reaches, Enterprise when admin enables) the side panel saves history, syncs sessions to web, Desktop and mobile, and shares skills, plugins and connectors; starts in Automatically approve mode.

feature: Switch back to classic side panel
detail: Three-dot menu > Switch back to classic returns to the older panel, the only one with recorded workflows.

feature: Record a workflow (classic panel)
detail: Users record browser steps, stop, and save them as a shortcut that Claude replays; not available when the panel runs as Cowork.

feature: Scheduled browser tasks
detail: Shortcuts can run on a daily, weekly, monthly or annual schedule from the clock icon, using alarms and notifications permissions.

feature: Shortcuts via slash menu
detail: Good prompts are saved as shortcuts called up by typing / and edited or deleted in extension settings.

feature: Multi-tab control in a Claude tab group
detail: Claude opens tabs in a coloured group and can act across dragged-in tabs at once.

feature: Console logs and network debugging
detail: Claude reads console errors, network requests and DOM state, supporting build-test-verify loops with Claude Code and Figma comparison.

feature: Built-in site navigation knowledge
detail: Claude knows how to operate Slack, Google Calendar, Gmail, Docs and GitHub so short commands work.

feature: Sign in with 1Password
detail: Claude can ask 1Password for a login, approved by biometrics, without seeing the password or code; beta on macOS.

feature: Background workflows and notifications
detail: Tasks keep running while tabs change if Chrome is open, with notifications on completion or when permission is needed.

feature: Visual context and image upload
detail: Users share screenshots or regions and give Claude images to upload to forms or reports.

feature: Contextual prompt suggestions
detail: The panel suggests prompts based on the site being viewed.

feature: Extension permission list
detail: Install grants sidePanel, storage, scripting, debugger, tabGroups, tabs, alarms, notifications, display size, webNavigation (high-risk site intervention), downloads, offscreen sound, nativeMessaging and unlimited storage.

feature: Connect Claude in Chrome to Desktop and choose preferred browser
detail: Customize > Connectors > Claude in Chrome adds a per-conversation connector; Cowork also has a built-in browser (rolling out) and Settings > Cowork > Preferred browser picks which to use.

feature: Admin controls for Claude in Chrome
detail: Admins control extension availability and website allowlists and blocklists; Enterprise needs owner enablement of Chrome and Cowork in the cloud for the Cowork side panel.

feature: Removing a member does not delete their data
detail: Removed members' accounts persist until Support permanently deletes them at an owner's written request; run a data export first and remove SCIM users in the IdP.

feature: Project and chat access after member removal
detail: Private projects become inaccessible, org-shared ones show under Team and specific shares under Shared with me, and the removed user's chats and shared chat links show Conversation not found.

feature: Re-adding a member restores chats, projects and skills
detail: Adding the same email back restores earlier content and skills reappear in Customize > Skills; exports and Enterprise retention still apply.

feature: Switch Team plan to annual billing
detail: Owners use Switch to Annual in Organization settings > Billing or /upgrade; the annual plan starts immediately with credit for unused monthly time.

feature: Re-signup restrictions after account deletion
detail: A deleted account's email may be blocked from new signup for 30 days and permanently if the old account was disabled for policy violations.

feature: Code execution and file creation
detail: Claude runs code in a sandbox to build downloadable Excel, PowerPoint, Word and PDF files, PNG charts, Python analysis and ML models, and can convert between formats or extract PDF tables; max 30MB per file.

feature: Code execution and file creation toggle
detail: Settings > Capabilities (named Create and edit files in new layout, and Capabilities on mobile) switches it, on by default with network access for Free through Ultra.

feature: Network egress modes for code execution
detail: Team and Enterprise owners pick off, package managers only (default), package managers plus allowed domains, or all domains minus a legal blocklist; Enterprise defaults to egress off; MCP connections bypass this setting.

feature: Code execution sandbox safeguards
detail: Isolated per-user containers, task duration caps, prompt injection classifier, action summaries and no public sharing of chats with file artifacts for Free to Ultra mitigate injection and exfiltration risk.

feature: Project files in the code environment
detail: Project files are available to Claude's computing environment while staying in context, with an extended context window for multi-step work.

feature: File creation counts toward usage limits
detail: File creation draws from the plan limits and uses more than ordinary chat.

feature: Mobile file download opens preview or app
detail: Tapping Download on mobile opens the file in the system preview or a related app such as Word.

feature: Artifacts built through the computing environment
detail: HTML and React apps, markdown, mermaid and SVG artifacts still work with file creation on, now generated via the computing environment; chats using Personal Finance accounts may be unable to create files or artifacts.

feature: Model Safety Bug Bounty Program
detail: A HackerOne program paying up to $35,000 for universal jailbreaks of Constitutional Classifiers on biological threat topics, with NDA, a free model alias for red-teaming and rolling applications.

feature: Import memory from another AI via paste flow
detail: Settings > Your Claude > Start import gives an export prompt to run in the other service, then paste the result and Add to memory; Claude extracts entries, may drop non-work details, and a See what Claude learned about you button follows.

feature: Export memory as verbatim text
detail: Memory can be viewed in Settings > Your Claude > Manage or exported by asking Claude to write out its memories verbatim, then saved to a local file.

feature: Import memory card on home screen (legacy memory)
detail: Legacy memory users see an Import memory to Claude card on the home screen and imports appear within 24 hours.

feature: Refreshed Claude Mobile look
detail: A redesigned mobile look rolls out gradually starting on iOS, needs iOS 26 or later, and needs no toggle.

feature: Computer use (beta) for Team and Enterprise
detail: Claude can see a user's screen and work in allowed desktop apps in the new Claude experience in Desktop, and from web and mobile where Computer access is on; rolling out gradually.

feature: Desktop release channel Stable or Latest
detail: Users choose a channel for Desktop updates; Stable is default and Latest ships about daily.

feature: Claude Meetings in Google Meet
detail: Claude joins a Meet call as a visible participant taking notes, answering questions and building docs, whiteboards and slides during the call.

feature: Project cost-code tags for spend tracking
detail: Eligible Enterprise orgs tag projects with charge codes or client-matter numbers to see spend by tag.

feature: Enterprise security center, inference hooks, centralized management
detail: New Enterprise security and admin controls including a security center, inference hooks and extra access controls, several in beta.

feature: Personal Finance (link bank, card, loan, investment accounts)
detail: Users link financial accounts to see balances and spending on one page and ask Claude about their money; US only.

feature: Claude Duet proactive agent app
detail: A research preview app where Claude works as a proactive agent that also uses memory and past-chat search.

feature: (model name), Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 launched
detail: Haiku 5.5 is the cheap fast small model, Sonnet 5.5 a faster lower-cost companion to Opus 5.5, and Opus 5.5 matches Fable 5.1 on most work at 40% lower cost than Opus 5.

feature: Fable 5, Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 model releases
detail: Fable 5.1 and Mythos 5.1 launched September 2026 for coding and knowledge work; Fable 5 access was suspended June 12 and restored July 1, 2026.

feature: Monthly API credits for Max and Team
detail: Max and Team plans include monthly Claude Platform credits claimed by linking a Console org in billing settings.

feature: Plugin developer portal
detail: Developers submit plugins to the Claude directory, track review and see usage analytics.

feature: New Claude experience: Cowork in every conversation
detail: Everything Cowork does is available from any chat without choosing a mode, carrying over chats, tasks, projects, connectors and skills; rolling out to Pro and Max on web, desktop and mobile.

feature: Claude Design, Slides and Docs in any conversation
detail: Designs, decks and living documents can be requested in any conversation, including Claude Code and the Artifacts tab, with on-canvas editing and design-system import; artifacts on every plan, and Enterprise beta.

feature: Salesforce in Claude plugin
detail: A plugin with 37 sales skills for accounts, opportunities and pipeline, available to Salesforce-approved orgs on paid plans.

feature: Smart reports for Enterprise
detail: Reports analysing team Claude use, cost, friction and repeated patterns worth packaging as shared skills.

feature: Memory topics, Cowork memory and sensitive topics (Aug 2026)
detail: Memory spans chat and cloud Cowork with editable Topics under Settings > Memory and a sensitive topics setting.

feature: Skill and plugin security scanning
detail: Enterprise admins can auto-scan third-party skills and plugins for malicious content on upload or edit.

feature: Self-serve HIPAA configuration
detail: Eligible admins review the BAA, download the guide and enable HIPAA configuration in one flow for Enterprise and the API.

feature: Monthly recap at Settings > Reflect
detail: A beta page shows topics, most active day and peak hour and working-style observations; needs memory on; on Free, Pro and Max on web and Desktop.

feature: Break reminders and quiet hours
detail: Settings > Time and focus lets users set optional break reminders and quiet hours.

feature: Cowork on web and mobile with remote sessions
detail: Cowork sessions can run remotely in the cloud, saved to the account, continue when the laptop closes and run scheduled tasks with no device online; rolling out starting with Max.

feature: Microsoft 365 connector write tools
detail: With Entra admin consent and org enablement Claude can draft, send and organise email, manage calendar, edit mailbox settings and create or update OneDrive and SharePoint files; Teams stays read-only.

feature: Model entitlements and effort-level controls
detail: Enterprise admins restrict which models and effort levels users can access.

feature: Trusted Devices for Remote Control
detail: Admins require device verification before members view or steer local Claude Code sessions remotely.

feature: Claude Tag in Slack
detail: Team and Enterprise members tag Claude in Slack conversations to delegate tasks while they work on other things.

feature: Edit Claude drafts in place
detail: Drafts open beside the chat and users highlight text and type a change so Claude edits at that spot.

feature: Admin permissions in custom roles
detail: Enterprise custom roles can grant access to areas like billing or privacy without Owner status.

feature: Connector permissions in custom roles
detail: Enterprise custom roles control which connectors and individual tools each role may use.

feature: Compliance API integrations with security tools
detail: Compliance API integrations let IT govern Claude in their existing security and compliance stack.

feature: Claude Design by Anthropic Labs
detail: A collaborative product for designs, prototypes, slides and one-pagers launched April 2026 with Opus 4.7.

feature: Cowork generally available with analytics, API and OpenTelemetry
detail: Cowork reached GA on macOS and Windows with Analytics API coverage, usage analytics and OpenTelemetry monitoring.

feature: Role-based access controls with groups
detail: Enterprise admins arrange users in groups (manual or SCIM) with custom roles per group, group spend limits and per-team Cowork enablement.

feature: Interactive apps in mobile chat
detail: The mobile app renders interactive connector apps such as live charts and diagrams inside conversations.

feature: Computer use research preview for Pro and Max
detail: Claude can open files, run dev tools, point, click and navigate the screen in Cowork and Claude Code and let Dispatch act while the user is away.

feature: Persistent agent thread to control Cowork from phone
detail: Pro and Max users manage Cowork tasks through a persistent thread in Desktop or mobile (Dispatch).

feature: Inline interactive charts, diagrams and visualizations
detail: Claude can create custom charts and diagrams inline in responses.

feature: Claude for Excel and PowerPoint add-ins share context
detail: Office add-ins share conversation context across both apps, support skills and can use an LLM gateway for Bedrock, Vertex AI or Foundry; Excel supports pivot tables, conditional formatting and a ctrl+option+c shortcut.

feature: Memory for free users
detail: Memory from chat history became available to all plans including Free in March 2026.

feature: Scheduled tasks in Cowork and Customize section
detail: Recurring and on-demand tasks can be scheduled in Cowork and Desktop gained a Customize section grouping skills, plugins and connectors.

feature: Cowork plugin marketplace and org admin controls
detail: A plugin marketplace with Team and Enterprise admin controls arrived February 2026.

feature: Sonnet 4.6 with 1M token beta context
detail: Sonnet 4.6 launched with a 1M token context window in beta.

feature: Enterprise Analytics API
detail: Programmatic per-day, per-org usage and engagement data for Claude and Claude Code Remote.

feature: Self-serve Enterprise plan
detail: Any org can buy Enterprise online with one seat type covering Claude, Claude Code and Cowork.

feature: Opus 4.6 and Opus 4.7 releases
detail: Opus 4.6 (Feb 2026) and Opus 4.7 (April 2026, better vision and long coding) became available.

feature: Claude for PowerPoint add-in
detail: Claude became available as a PowerPoint add-in; Excel add-in gained pivot and conditional formatting editing.

feature: Cowork research preview expansion (Jan 2026)
detail: Cowork launched Jan 12 for Max on macOS in an isolated VM with local files and MCP, then Pro on Jan 16.

feature: Opus 4 and 4.1 removed from selector and Claude Code
detail: Opus 4 and 4.1 were retired from the model selector and Claude Code in January 2026.

feature: Health and fitness data on mobile (Jan 2026 launch)
detail: Claude can analyse health data on iOS and Android with native charts; Pro and Max, US only, Android 14+.

feature: HIPAA-ready Enterprise plans
detail: A HIPAA-ready version of Claude for Enterprise orgs processing PHI.

feature: Org-managed skills and Agent Skills standard
detail: Team and Enterprise get org-wide skill management, a partner skills directory and open Agent Skills format.

feature: Claude in Chrome history: plan approval and model choice
detail: Earlier updates added Follow a plan approval, model choice among Haiku 4.5, Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.5, and org admin controls in Admin settings > Browser extension.

feature: Context window compaction (Nov 2025)
detail: Earlier messages are summarised near the context limit enabling effectively endless chats and fewer length errors.

feature: Embed code for published artifacts (Aug 2025)
detail: Free, Pro and Max users can generate an embed code for shared published artifacts.

feature: Extra usage purchase for Team and Enterprise (Aug 2025)
detail: Setting lets members buy more usage after hitting limits for chat or Claude Code.

feature: Project sharing and permissions for Team and Enterprise
detail: Projects can be shared org-wide or with specific people with permissions.

feature: Search past conversations (Aug 2025 launch)
detail: Max, Team and Enterprise users first got past-chat search.

feature: Claude Code usage analytics dashboard
detail: Team owners, Enterprise admins and Console Admin/Billing/Developer roles see lines accepted, suggestion accept rate, daily active users and sessions, top commands and per-user CSV export under Analytics > Claude Code; daily refresh, monthly reset.

feature: Claude Code Value tab
detail: A tab estimates productivity lift, cost per commit and annual value with adjustable inputs shown inline.

feature: Claude Code contribution metrics with GitHub
detail: Beta metrics compare merged PRs, lines committed and PRs opened with and without Claude Code via the Claude GitHub App; needs GitHub Cloud, not for Console or ZDR orgs.

feature: Incognito chat via ghost icon
detail: Ghost icon on new non-project chats starts a temporary chat with a black border and label, closed with an x, not saved to history, memory, training or recap; cannot be converted or reopened.

feature: Incognito chat retention and new-experience limits
detail: Incognito chats are kept 30 days by default (or the Enterprise retention period), appear in Team and Enterprise exports and the Compliance API, and in the new Claude experience cannot create files or run code; profile preferences still apply.

feature: Incognito unavailable inside projects
detail: The ghost icon is absent in projects; use the Memory switch off in the plus menu instead.

feature: Claude in Xcode 26
detail: Xcode 26's Intelligence settings log in with a Claude account for a coding assistant with project context, file attachments, documentation generation, explanations, SwiftUI previews, inline edits and automatic fixes; usage shares plan limits.
plans: Pro, Max, Ultra, Team/Enterprise premium seats

feature: API key environment variable beats subscription login
detail: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set in the environment takes priority over a claude.ai login and bills API rates; Claude Code warns on conflict at setup and after login, and /status shows the active method.

feature: Output ownership and no competing-model training
detail: Users own outputs but may not use them to train general chatbots or competing models; building classifiers like sentiment or search tools is allowed.

feature: Australian DIS Standard concern reporting and thumbs-down reporting
detail: Australian users can report concerns by form, and any reply can be reported via the thumbs down button in Claude.

feature: Refund request flow via Get help messenger
detail: Users open Get help > Claude Refund Request, pick a reason and check eligibility; payments are non-refundable except under terms or law; EEA and UK get prorated refunds within 14 days.

feature: App Store purchases are refunded by Apple only
detail: iOS subscribers request refunds at Apple's report-a-problem site and must cancel separately; Android needs Support eligibility check or order number.

feature: Usage credit refunds and Team in-place upgrade proration
detail: Credit purchases are non-refundable except on moving to Team, closing a personal account or domain claim; upgrading in place to Team auto-cancels the individual plan with prorated refund in about 24 hours.

feature: Claude Code dynamic workflows
detail: Enterprise feature letting Claude run hours-long migrations, audits and codebase-wide hunts in one session, on by default from June 8, 2026 and disabled through custom roles, managed settings disableWorkflows or Organization settings > Claude Code.

feature: IDE support list
detail: Claude Code supports VS Code and forks including Cursor and JetBrains IDEs; no Visual Studio 2022 integration.

feature: Subagents with per-agent tool selection
detail: Subagents work via the SDK with an optional tools field to restrict MCP tools, are not yet in GitHub Actions, and the UI collapses output beyond three parallel subagents.

feature: Permissions via settings.json allow and deny lists
detail: Permissions use pattern matching in global and local settings files, built up by choosing Yes, and don't ask again for similar commands.

feature: No codebase index; agentic search instead
detail: Claude Code does not build a vector index and navigates code with search and read tools on demand.

feature: CI/CD, GitHub Actions, GitLab and corporate proxies
detail: Claude Code integrates with GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD and git, works through Anthropic-API-compatible proxies like LiteLLM, and can use Bedrock or Vertex with keyless setup.

feature: Claude.md as team memory
detail: Shared Claude.md files in each machine's .claude directory are the only team knowledge mechanism; no public code filtering is planned.

feature: Add Console users to Claude Code
detail: Add members with Claude Code User or Developer role and have them run /login; do not hand-create API keys.

feature: Claude Free plan
detail: Free at $0 with limited usage per five hours and per week, chat on web, desktop and mobile, web search, file creation, code execution, memory, connectors, artifacts and Claude Design, Slides and Docs.

feature: Claude Pro $20 monthly or $17 annual
detail: More usage than Free, scheduled and handed-off tasks, Claude Data, Sheets and Whiteboards (beta), Claude Code, Science, Projects, Opus, Claude in Chrome, Microsoft 365 and usage credits; Fable only through usage credits.

feature: Claude Max $100: 5x usage and Fable included
detail: Five times Pro usage every five hours and week, Fable included up to half the weekly limit, $100 monthly API credits, early and priority access.

feature: Claude Ultra $200: no five-hour limit, 10x weekly
detail: Verified accounts have no five-hour limit, 10x Pro weekly usage, Fable up to half the weekly limit and $200 monthly API credits; billed monthly.

feature: Claude plan matrix: Projects, Research, Skills, Voice available on Free
detail: Projects are capped at five on Free and unlimited when paid; Research, Claude Data, Sheets, Whiteboards, Code, Chrome, Science and Microsoft 365 are paid only; artifacts, Design, Docs, Slides, connectors, voice, web search, incognito, skills and memory are on every plan.

feature: Team-only features: Claude Motion, Tag, project sharing, enterprise search
detail: Claude Motion (beta), Claude Tag, project sharing and collaboration and enterprise search are not on individual plans; SSO, SCIM, audit logs, RBAC, HIPAA, retention and compliance API are Team or Enterprise only.

feature: Claude shared usage pool and payment rules
detail: One usage pool spans web, desktop, mobile and Claude Code with a rolling five-hour window and weekly limits visible in Settings > Usage; individual plans pay by card, Max and Ultra monthly only; Team Premium is 5x Standard; Enterprise $20 per seat plus API-rate usage.

feature: ChatGPT Free, Go, Plus and Pro price ladder
detail: Free $0, Go $8 (may include ads), Plus $20, and Pro from $100 in three tiers (100, 200, 500) with matching monthly API credits.

feature: ChatGPT Free plan contents
detail: Unlimited text chats on (model name) with abuse guardrails, plus limited uploads, images, voice, deep research, memory, Codex and ChatGPT Work on desktop.

feature: ChatGPT Plus plan contents
detail: Advanced (model name) reasoning, expanded uploads, images, deep research and memory, projects, scheduled tasks, custom GPTs, expanded Codex, ChatGPT Work on desktop, web and mobile, and early access.

feature: ChatGPT Pro plan contents
detail: Three usage tiers, Pro reasoning on (model name), longer Codex and Work sessions, the Dot always-on agent, unlimited faster images, maximum deep research and memory, and research previews.

feature: ChatGPT feature list in plan comparison
detail: Lists ChatGPT Work, Codex, Dots, Plugins, Space, Health, Finances, voice with video, skills, Sites, built-in browser, Office and Sheets extensions, developer mode (beta), study mode, interactive tables and charts, memory sources and monthly API credits.

feature: ChatGPT model lineup and Free context
detail: Models named include (model name), (model name), Sol and Luna, (model name) variants and legacy ones; Free Instant context is 27K tokens, about 12 pages of input.

feature: ChatGPT payment, Teachers and education discounts
detail: Go, Plus, Pro and Business pay by card with monthly billing (Business and Enterprise annual); Enterprise by invoice; free ChatGPT for Teachers for verified US K-12 through June 2027, Edu, and nonprofits up to 75% off.

feature: Usage credits: pay-as-you-go after plan limits
detail: Paid plans can switch to consumption pricing at standard API rates once a five-hour, weekly or Fable weekly limit is used up, instead of being blocked.

feature: Usage limit structure: five-hour session plus weekly limits
detail: Most paid plans have a five-hour session limit and a weekly limit; Max and Ultra add a separate weekly limit for Fable; verified Ultra accounts have no five-hour limit.

feature: Enable usage credits toggle in Settings > Usage
detail: Turn on in the Usage credits section, add a payment method, set spend preferences and buy credits; can be disabled again at any time.

feature: Monthly spend limit for usage credits
detail: Set a monthly cap with Adjust limit or choose Set to unlimited.

feature: Buy usage credits with purchase amount and expiry shown
detail: Choose an amount in Buy usage credits; the expiration date is displayed before confirming.

feature: Auto-reload of usage credits
detail: Automatically buys credits when balance falls below a chosen threshold; available on web only.

feature: Buy credits and set spend limit in mobile apps
detail: Where in-app purchases are available, credits and a spend limit can be managed in the mobile apps, including for plans bought via App Store or Play.

feature: Usage credit alerts
detail: Notifications arrive when approaching usage credit limits.

feature: Now using credits notice
detail: When a limit is hit with credits enabled, the approaching-limit banner may linger and then changes to Now using credits once the next request runs on credits.

feature: Usage credit expiry: 12 months for purchases from Dec 7 2026
detail: Credits bought on or after 7 Dec 2026 expire after 12 months (one-time, bundles, auto-reload); earlier purchases do not expire; dates shown in Settings and emailed beforehand; varies by country.

feature: Usage credit refund rules
detail: Purchases are non-refundable, also on cancel or account deletion, except when upgrading to Team in place, moving to an organization, Start fresh, domain claim closure, local law or fraud; used credits never refunded.

feature: Credits need an active paid plan
detail: After cancelling, the balance stays but can only be used with an active paid plan; deleting the account forfeits it.

feature: Usage dashboard separates plan usage from credit usage
detail: Settings > Usage shows real-time consumption, month-to-date credit spend and usage history.

feature: Monthly API credits separate from usage credits
detail: Monthly API credits included with Max, Ultra and Team do not apply to usage credits in Claude, Claude Code or Cowork.

feature: Usage credits apply to Claude Code, Research and project content
detail: Credits cover chat and Claude Code terminal use combined, Research mode overage, and all tokens including project files.

feature: Usage limit warnings
detail: Approaching session or weekly limit warnings appear, showing percent used when available.

feature: Limit reached messages
detail: Without credits, a message states when the five-hour or weekly limit resets.

feature: Usage credits banner wording
detail: With credits on, messages say it is continuing with usage credits instead of blocking.

feature: Length limit error and automatic summarization
detail: Oversized messages trigger a length limit error; paid plans with code execution auto-summarize earlier messages in long chats while keeping full history.

feature: Login error troubleshooting
detail: Generic login errors: avoid VPN, disable extensions, clear cache and cookies, check status page.

feature: Capacity constraint message
detail: A system-wide demand message that is not an outage and does not appear on the status page.

feature: Status page for incidents
detail: status.claude.com lists confirmed outages with scope and resolution progress.

feature: Enterprise search (Ask Your Org project)
detail: Preconfigured project in the sidebar that searches connected company tools with Anthropic-maintained instructions and cited answers.

feature: Owner setup of Ask Your Org
detail: Owner chooses connectors (Documents and Chat required, Email optional), names the project 'Ask [Name]' and finishes setup; on by default in Admin settings.

feature: Disable Ask Your Org organization-wide
detail: Owner can disable it under Organization settings > Capabilities or during setup.

feature: Per-user connector authentication in enterprise search
detail: Each user authenticates connectors such as Slack, Google, Microsoft 365; custom connectors with shared credentials give everyone the same access.

feature: Add custom connectors to enterprise search
detail: Owners and users can add directory connectors or custom connectors if the organization permits.

feature: Search and tools toggles in enterprise search project
detail: Enable or disable connectors from Search and tools; changes apply to new conversations.

feature: Star or unstar enterprise search project
detail: Project is starred by default; user can unstar it, or reopen via claude.ai/ask-your-org and star again.

feature: Permission-aware enterprise search without indexing
detail: Results respect each user's permissions in source systems, are fetched through MCP calls and not indexed by Anthropic; conversations are private and follow Enterprise retention.

feature: Enterprise search availability by app
detail: Works in Claude Desktop and web but not in the iOS or Android apps; counts toward standard usage limits.

feature: Skills: folders of instructions loaded on demand
detail: Skills are instruction/script/resource folders Claude loads through progressive disclosure when relevant; require code execution; also in Claude Code and API beta.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Anthropic built-in skills
detail: Anthropic-maintained skills such as Excel, Word, PowerPoint and PDF creation that Claude invokes automatically.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Custom skills
detail: User or organization-authored skills for brand rules, templates, meeting notes, task creation, analysis workflows.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Organization provisioned skills
detail: Owners provision skills that appear in every member's list, set enabled or disabled by default.

feature: Partner skills in Skills Directory
detail: Skills from partners such as Notion, Figma, Atlassian designed to pair with their MCP connectors.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Agent Skills open standard
detail: Skills follow the open agentskills.io spec so the format is portable across platforms.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Skill and plugin scanning
detail: Enterprise organizations can scan uploaded skills and plugins for malicious content.

feature: Skills directory via Customize > Skills > Browse skills
detail: Browse the directory from Customize, Skills, plus button.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Record a skill from screen recording
detail: In Cowork on Claude for Mac, record screen, clicks, typing and voice and Claude proposes a skill; up to about 10 minutes with a countdown; not in chat, on Windows, or on Free/Enterprise.

feature: Recording needs macOS Accessibility and Screen recording permissions
detail: First recording asks for Accessibility and Screen recording; macOS may ask to restart Claude.

feature: Record a skill entry points
detail: Start from the plus button in the composer (Record a skill) or Customize > Skills > Add > Record your screen; microphone can be muted or changed.

feature: Skill proposal card: Save, Update or Dismiss
detail: After recording Claude proposes a NEW skill or an update to an overlapping one; Content can be expanded to review before saving.

feature: Recording retention: only screenshots kept
detail: Video and audio are not retained; screenshots remain in the Cowork task and disappear when the task is deleted.

feature: Skill file format: skill.md with name and description
detail: Skill is a folder with skill.md and YAML frontmatter: name up to 64 characters, description up to 200 characters, optional dependencies.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Skill resources and scripts
detail: Skills can include extra reference files and executable scripts (Python, Node); Claude and Claude Code can install packages from PyPI/npm, API skills cannot.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Package skill as ZIP with folder as root
detail: Folder name must match skill name and the ZIP root must be the skill folder.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Edit skill files beside chat with Edit with Claude
detail: Highlight text in an opened skill file and ask Claude for changes; multi-file edit requests apply together.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Enable skills: code execution and Skills toggles
detail: Individual plans need Code execution and file creation on in Settings > Capabilities; Team/Enterprise owners enable Cloud code execution and Skills in Organization settings > Plugins & skills > Policy.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Customize > Skills list with per-skill toggles
detail: Toggle example, Anthropic, custom and provisioned skills; shows enable/upload dates and descriptions.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Upload a custom skill ZIP
detail: Customize > Skills > plus > Create skill > Upload a skill; uploaded skills are private until shared.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Download or delete custom skills
detail: Three-dot menu offers Download and Delete with confirmation; re-upload to restore; custom skills do not migrate to a Team/Enterprise org so download first.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Share a skill with people or groups
detail: Share via three-dot menu with named people or, on Enterprise, groups; recipients get view-only copies, greyed until enabled, with automatic updates and revocable access; works in chat and Cowork.

feature: Skill sharing admin toggles
detail: Skill sharing, Share with organization and Share with groups toggles in Plugins & skills Policy; sharing off by default for HIPAA or regulated setups; custom roles need a share capability.

feature: Publish a skill to the organization
detail: Publish to org offers Available to install, Installed by default or Required; optional owner review with pending, changes requested, published states and email on approval; updates re-reviewed.

feature: Skills list sections: Personal, Shared with you, Organization
detail: Team and Enterprise lists are split into three sections; organization skills are installed from the directory.

feature: Install organization skill from directory in Cowork
detail: Customize > plus > Skills tab > Install; can be toggled off and re-enabled later.

feature: Skills in Claude for Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Outlook add-ins
detail: Enabled skills apply automatically in the Office add-ins, selectable by typing slash in the sidebar; Excel/PowerPoint can load a skill's template into the open file.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Skills sync to Claude Code
detail: Claude Code v2.1.273+ signed in with the same account lists synced skills under claude.ai sync via /skills; one-way, checks about every 10 minutes; not with API key or Bedrock; syncClaudeAiSkills=false disables.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Admin can disable user skill creation
detail: Owners can turn off user-created skills; custom roles can lack Create skills capability, while provisioned skills stay usable.

feature: Enterprise skill scanning on upload
detail: With scanning on, third-party skills are checked in about one to two minutes and blocked if flagged until fixed.

feature: Skill upload error causes
detail: Uploads fail on oversize ZIP, folder/name mismatch, missing skill.md or invalid characters.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Microsoft 365 connector (SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, Teams)
detail: Lets Claude search work/school Microsoft 365 data using each user's own permissions; read-only by default; personal Microsoft accounts need no admin setup.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Owner enables Microsoft 365 connector for the org
detail: Team/Enterprise owners add it in Organization settings > Connectors > Add > All available > Add to your team.

feature: Entra Global Administrator consent for Microsoft 365
detail: A one-time tenant consent, granted either during the Claude connect flow (consent for the organization) or manually by adding two service principals and visiting admin-consent URLs.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Restrict Microsoft 365 connector to assigned users in Entra
detail: Set Assignment required on both M365 MCP Server and Client enterprise apps and add the same users or groups.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Revoke individual Microsoft Graph permissions for the connector
detail: Admins can revoke scopes in Entra; affected tools then fail with Failed to call tool and users can switch the tool off.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Microsoft 365 write tools with Always allow, Needs approval, Blocked
detail: Write tools send mail, manage drafts and events, update mailbox settings, write OneDrive/SharePoint files and send Teams messages; each has a per-tool setting, and Enterprise custom roles can limit who gets them.

feature: Teams write tool settings and starting chats
detail: Teams send, post and reply tools can be Needs approval or Blocked (Always allow for connectors added after Nov 9 2026); starting a new chat can be Always allow.

feature: Write tool approval limit on 11 tools until Dec 9 2026
detail: For orgs that added the connector earlier, 11 mail, calendar and Teams send tools require user confirmation each use until at least 9 Dec 2026, after which unset ones become Needs approval.

feature: Always allow applies to scheduled tasks and Auto-approve
detail: Always allow tools can run without asking in Automatically approve mode and in scheduled tasks or routines; Needs approval tools may lose access in scheduled tasks; Cowork needs its own Allow Always allow setting.

feature: Microsoft 365 write limits: no attachments, agent header on email
detail: Write tools reject messages with attachments, add an agent-initiated header to sent email, and calendar changes notify attendees; per-user write and send limits apply.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Microsoft 365 readable file types
detail: Reads Word, Excel, PowerPoint (including legacy formats), PDF and plain text such as txt, md, csv from SharePoint and OneDrive; OneNote cannot be read.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Microsoft 365 email search scope
detail: Covers the primary mailbox including Archive folder and accessible shared mailboxes, but not the Online Archive mailbox.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Teams meeting transcripts access needs Teams admin setting
detail: Transcripts and speaker attribution require a Teams admin to turn on Graph transcript API access.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Microsoft 365 connector works with enterprise search
detail: When enterprise search is on, Microsoft 365 is searched alongside Slack and Google Workspace.

feature: Conditional Access troubleshooting for the M365 connector
detail: Server-side token calls come from Anthropic IPs so sign-in frequency or location policies can block them; admins can exclude those IP ranges but not for device-compliance policies; reconnect cycles tied to sign-in frequency.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Members disconnect Microsoft 365 or owners remove it
detail: Users disconnect in Customize > Connectors; owners remove it org-wide in Organization settings > Connectors.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Microsoft 365 connector is on-demand with no content caching
detail: Acts as a proxy retrieving data only during active queries; credentials encrypted; tool results in stored chats are kept and only the requesting user sees raw results.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Microsoft 365 auth: OAuth on-behalf-of with PKCE
detail: Two-stage token exchange, no passwords stored, tenants cryptographically isolated; refresh tokens last 90 days of inactivity, access tokens about 60-90 minutes.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Two-step org approval for Microsoft 365 connector
detail: Owner enables it in Organization settings, then an Entra Global Admin consents; a pilot group can be gated with Entra app assignment.

feature: Restrict verified-domain connectors to your enterprise
detail: Setting that stops members from connecting a work Microsoft 365 account to a Claude account outside the organization.

feature: Conditional Access support matrix for Microsoft 365 connector
detail: Group scoping and MFA supported, device compliance checked against the connecting device, location/network and sign-in frequency policies not supported without IP exclusion.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Microsoft 365 read and search tools
detail: SharePoint document and folder search, Outlook email search, calendar search, meeting availability, Teams chat search and read-by-URI.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Microsoft 365 email write tools
detail: Send, forward, send draft, create/update/delete drafts, label messages and threads, create/delete inbox rules and set automatic replies.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Microsoft 365 calendar write tools
detail: Create, update, delete and respond (accept, decline, tentative) to calendar events.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Microsoft 365 file write tools for OneDrive and SharePoint
detail: Upload, update, create folders, rename, move, copy and delete (to recycle bin) files.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Microsoft 365 Teams write tools
detail: Send chat messages, post or reply in channels and start chats; cannot change Teams settings, memberships or permissions.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Confirmation before sending mail, messages or calendar changes
detail: Outside auto-approve modes, Claude asks to confirm sends, forwards, Teams messages, event changes and automatic replies in chat and Cowork.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Personal Microsoft account connection
detail: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra users can connect Outlook.com/Hotmail/Live accounts via separate apps with self-consent, writes available without admin setting, no Teams tools; not shown on Team/Enterprise.

feature: Microsoft 365 connector limitations
detail: User-level delegated access only (no service principal), SharePoint search is tenant-wide with no Selected-site scoping, Online Archive not searched.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Desktop extension allowlist
detail: Owners can switch on an allowlist (off by default) so only approved desktop extensions can be used; requires desktop 0.13.91 or later.

feature: Allowlist force-removes existing extensions and blocks MCPB drag-install
detail: Enabling deletes installed extensions not on the list and limits installs to the in-app registry; does not guard against local tampering after install.

feature: Block all desktop extensions option
detail: Enterprise owners can turn off every extension, including allowlisted ones, and stop new installs.

feature: Add or remove extensions from allowlist
detail: Organization settings > Connectors > Desktop tab: Browse extensions, Add to your team, or Remove from allowlist.

feature: Upload custom desktop extension (.mcpb)
detail: Owners upload .mcpb bundles scoped to their organization; manifest name must be unique.

feature: Update custom extension to new version
detail: Upload new version from the kebab menu with an incremented manifest version and unchanged name.

feature: Local policy keys override allowlist
detail: Machine-level isDesktopExtensionDirectoryEnabled or isDesktopExtensionEnabled set to false override the in-app allowlist.

feature: Deploy Claude Desktop on macOS via PKG or DMG
detail: Admins deploy a universal (Intel and Apple Silicon) PKG, recommended, or DMG, through MDM such as Jamf, Kandji or Intune; installs to Applications and auto-updates.

feature: Cowork installed with Claude Desktop on Mac
detail: Cowork is installed automatically with the macOS desktop app.

feature: Desktop update permissions by install location
detail: User-folder installs update without admin rights; /Applications installs need admin write access; shared machines should disable auto-update and use MDM.

feature: Claude Code cloud sessions
detail: Sessions run on cloud infrastructure against a GitHub repository, can continue after you leave, and end by pushing a branch and offering a pull request.

feature: Start cloud session from desktop, web, mobile or terminal
detail: Start from Claude Desktop, claude.ai/code, Claude Mobile, or the terminal with claude --cloud.

feature: Parallel cloud tasks
detail: Multiple isolated tasks, even on the same repo, can run at once, each producing its own pull request.

feature: Cloud VM with repo setup commands and configurable network access
detail: Each task gets an isolated VM with the repo cloned, runs repo-defined setup commands, and has configurable internet access.

feature: Cloud sessions keep GitHub credentials in a secure proxy
detail: Credentials are not exposed inside the environment; network is restricted.

feature: Open in CLI to take over a cloud session
detail: Move a cloud task to a local CLI session when guidance is needed mid-task.

feature: Cloud vs local session guidance
detail: Cloud suits well-defined, queued or backlog work and repos not cloned locally; local suits exploratory work, uncommitted changes and rapid iteration.

feature: Desktop managed via MDM policies (macOS plist, Windows registry)
detail: Team/Enterprise admins push settings through configuration profiles on macOS or Group Policy/Intune registry keys on Windows; machine-wide keys beat user-level ones.

feature: Policy: allowedWorkspaceFolders
detail: Restricts which folders users can mount into Cowork; Enterprise can also set it in Organization settings.

feature: Policy: autoUpdaterEnforcementHours
detail: Sets 1-72 hours before the app force-restarts to apply a prepared update (default 72).

feature: Policy: disableAutoUpdates
detail: Turns off auto-update so MDM controls versions; users can still update from the app menu in the Org-settings version.

feature: Policy: effortLevel for Claude Code in Desktop
detail: Sets default effort (low, medium, high, xhigh, max) for Code sessions at each session start; not for Cowork; needs desktop 1.25927.0+.

feature: Policy: forceLoginOrgUUID
detail: Requires sign-in to one or several specified organizations; a single UUID also pre-selects the org.

feature: Policy: isClaudeCodeForDesktopEnabled
detail: Enables or disables Claude Code in desktop (default on).

feature: Policy: isDesktopExtensionEnabled and extension directory
detail: Turn desktop extensions and the extension directory on or off.

feature: Policy: isLocalDevMcpEnabled
detail: Enables or disables local MCP servers users add.

feature: Policy: secureVmFeaturesEnabled for Cowork
detail: Enables Cowork access in desktop (default on).

feature: Policy: Cowork EDR sensor integration
detail: coworkEDRIntegration and coworkEDRIntegrationVendor install an EDR vendor's signed sensor package in Cowork (beta).

feature: Policy: computerUseEnabled
detail: Setting false disables computer use for every account on the machine; needs desktop 5.1231.0+.

feature: Release channel setting hidden when any policy key is set
detail: Any desktop policy key hides the Release channel choice and forces Stable.

feature: Limit Claude Desktop to allowed organizations (shadow IT)
detail: Enterprise Organization setting blocks personal accounts and other orgs on a computer after a member signs in; lapses after 30 days unused; MDM forceLoginOrgUUID blocks earlier.

feature: Organization settings controls for desktop (beta)
detail: Enterprise owners set auto-updates, allowed workspace folders with Read only marking, local MCP servers and Block all desktop extensions without MDM; needs desktop 4.29.0+.

feature: Deploy Claude Desktop on Windows via MSIX
detail: MSIX packages (x64, arm64) deploy via Intune, SCCM, Group Policy, DISM or PowerShell; per-user by default, machine-wide via Add-AppxProvisionedPackage.

feature: Windows installer needs admin for Cowork
detail: Full features including Cowork need administrator install (UAC); non-admin users can install without Cowork; MSIX never installs without its Cowork service.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Cowork on Windows needs Virtual Machine Platform
detail: Requires the Windows Virtual Machine Platform feature and a restart; VMs or VDI without nested virtualization are unsupported.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Windows auto-update about every four hours
detail: Desktop self-updates unless disableAutoUpdates=1; admins choose MDM or in-app updater as single update owner.

feature: Windows install troubleshooting
detail: Covers AppLocker, parameter-incorrect after MDM, 0x80073D28, 0x80073CF6 partial registration repair that clears local app data, and HCS service errors.

feature: Windows EDR sensor in Cowork (beta)
detail: Endpoint detection sensors can run inside Cowork on Windows in beta.

feature: Quick entry on Mac: double-tap Option
detail: Global shortcut opens a text box from any app to start a chat; New chat shows five most recent conversations; macOS 12+, desktop app must be running.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Quick entry screenshot capture
detail: Drag-select a screen area from quick entry to attach it to the message; needs Screen recording permission.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Quick entry share application window
detail: Click an app window in quick entry to attach its contents.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Quick entry voice dictation via Caps Lock
detail: Off by default; Caps Lock starts and stops real-time transcription, then send; macOS 14+ and Speech recognition permission; Mac only.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Quick access shortcut options
detail: Settings > Desktop app: Double-tap Option, Option+Space, or custom shortcut; voice shortcut Caps Lock, custom or disabled.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Quick entry macOS permissions
detail: Needs Screen recording, Accessibility and (for dictation) Speech recognition, managed in System Settings.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Desktop extensions run local MCP servers
detail: Installable packages with a built-in Node.js runtime give Claude Desktop access to local files, tools, and internal systems behind the firewall using the user's existing authenticated context.

feature: Desktop extension distribution via marketplace and org upload
detail: Extensions install in one click, update through the extension marketplace, and owners can upload custom ones and control access with the allowlist.

feature: Model deprecation lifecycle and adaptation guidance
detail: Anthropic retires models roughly a year after release; advises testing newer models early and using memory, past chat search and projects to carry style across.

feature: Usage analytics dashboard for admins
detail: Owners (and Enterprise Admins except spend) see summary, who is using Claude, adoption, skills, connectors, results and cost sections under Analytics.

feature: Analytics: agentic work and estimated time saved
detail: Beta metric on how agentic work is, plus estimated time saved, PRs, designs, file operations, conversations and MCP writes.

feature: Spend analytics and CSV spend report
detail: Per-user per-model CSV for MTD, last month, last 90 days or custom range (up to 90 days back, one-day delay), with tokens, requests, gross and net spend.

feature: Seat-based Enterprise spend shows only overage
detail: Seat-based Enterprise spend reports need usage credits on and cover overage only.

feature: Chat analytics
detail: Chats per day, active-user percentage, top members, projects per day with users/messages, and artifacts created.

feature: Claude Code analytics: Productivity, Usage, Value tabs
detail: PRs and lines of code, suggestion accept rate, leaderboards, skills and MCP servers, sessions by agent, productivity lift, cost per PR with adjustable formulas.

feature: Claude Design analytics
detail: Daily, weekly, monthly active users in UTC; requires Claude Design enabled.

feature: Cowork analytics
detail: Sessions per day, share of users with sessions, and daily/weekly/monthly active users.

feature: Surveys for organizations
detail: Admins ask short in-product questions shown as a card in Cowork or chat; results by surface and group with per-survey CSV export.

feature: Member individual usage analytics
detail: On usage-based Enterprise, members see own usage by product, model and skill versus spend limits in Settings > Usage; admin Member analytics toggle, default on since July 11 2026.

feature: Analytics API for Enterprise
detail: Primary Owner enables the Analytics API and creates read:analytics keys under Organization settings > API to pull the same metrics programmatically.

feature: Blocked by a spend limit view
detail: Organization settings > Usage shows members blocked or near limits, built for usage-based Enterprise.

feature: Claude in Chrome availability
detail: Available on paid plans in the Chrome side panel, Cowork and Claude Code; the side panel runs as a Cowork session, and on Enterprise needs an owner to enable Chrome and Cowork in the cloud.

feature: Chrome side panel as a Cowork session
detail: Conversations save to history and reopen on other devices; defaults to Automatically approve mode; three-dot menu offers Switch back to classic.

feature: Chrome extension blocked-site categories
detail: Default blocked categories include financial services, banking, investment, crypto exchanges, adult and pirated content; admins can restrict more.

feature: Chrome extension connects to Claude Desktop and Claude Code
detail: Extension pairs with desktop (Claude in Chrome toggle in Connectors) and Claude Code.

feature: Browser tasks count toward plan usage limits
detail: Chrome usage shares limits with Claude and Claude Code and is more compute-intensive; long-running tasks use more.

feature: Chrome feedback: thumbs, prompt injection report
detail: Thumbs up/down in the side panel, report suspected prompt injection, email safety issues or contact Support.

feature: Chrome prompt-injection classifiers
detail: One classifier screens incoming content and another checks each action before it runs; actions are blocked or paused for approval when flagged.

feature: Automatic action screening in Automatically approve mode
detail: Claude assesses each action for risk, runs lower-risk ones and stops on unsafe ones; the check sees the latest screenshot, which Anthropic may retain.

feature: Manually approve mode for the Chrome side panel
detail: Switch from default Automatically approve to review every action.

feature: Action confirmations for high-risk browser actions
detail: Confirmation required for steps like downloading files or entering sensitive information; asks permission before financial sites.

feature: Claude in Chrome prohibited actions
detail: Will not trade stocks, bypass captchas, input sensitive data or scrape facial images.

feature: 1Password for Claude sign-in in browser
detail: With 1Password, Claude can complete sign-in tasks without credentials or one-time codes entering its context.

feature: Chrome screenshots capture visible tab content
detail: Claude screenshots tabs it works in and visible data enters the conversation; side-panel sessions are stored in history.

feature: Claude in Chrome off by default under HIPAA
detail: In HIPAA-enabled orgs an Owner must turn it on and allow specific sites; it is not covered by the BAA.

feature: Chrome extension beta status and Pro rollout
detail: Described as beta in the browser; Cowork side panel on Max, Ultra, Team with Pro rolling out.

feature: Browser permission mode: Manually approve
detail: Claude pauses before each action; classic panel shows an approvable plan with sites, Cowork panel asks Allow all for this website, Allow this time only or Deny.

feature: Browser permission mode: Automatically approve
detail: Claude keeps working while a safety check blocks unsafe actions, falling back to asking if blocks repeat; default for the Cowork side panel.

feature: Browser permission mode: Skip all approvals
detail: No pausing and no automatic checks, except connector tools set to Always ask.

feature: Per-site permission prompts: allow once, always allow, decline
detail: New permissions required prompt on sensitive sites; always-allow still asks before downloads, sensitive input and authorizations.

feature: Extension settings: approved sites and permission history
detail: Extension settings Permissions page lists always-allowed sites, lets you revoke, and shows history.

feature: Actions always needing explicit permission
detail: Changing permission settings, granting authorizations, entering sensitive info and permanent deletions require approval in every mode.

feature: Browser actions Claude never takes
detail: Purchases, account creation, card/ID data, untrusted downloads, financial advice or trades, modifying system files, following instructions found in emails or web content.

feature: Claude in Chrome org toggle
detail: Owners switch the extension on or off for the whole organization; on by default for Team and Enterprise, off under HIPAA until enabled.

feature: Site allowlist and blocklist for Chrome and Cowork browser
detail: One list governs both the extension and Cowork built-in browser; a manually opened blocked URL loads with a banner and Claude tools disabled.

feature: Enable Cowork side panel for Enterprise
detail: Needs Cowork in the cloud on, then Claude in Chrome toggle on, then extension deployed; panel sessions sync to history and support skills, plugins, connectors.

feature: 1Password for Claude admin toggle
detail: Off by default; lets Mac users sign in via 1Password without Claude seeing credentials; needs 1Password app and extension, Claude Desktop and Chrome extension.

feature: Disable Chrome handoff from Claude Desktop
detail: Turn off the extension in org settings or disable isLocalDevMcpEnabled to stop desktop tasks from driving the browser.

feature: Chrome extension deployment: self-service or managed
detail: Users install from Chrome Web Store, or admins push via Google Workspace admin console or MDM; pilots can be limited this way.

feature: Chrome per-role capability and network endpoints
detail: Custom roles on Enterprise can grant or withhold Claude in Chrome separately from Cowork; needs claude.ai, api.anthropic.com and a bridge websocket endpoint allowed; ZDR not supported.

feature: Cowork built-in browser in Claude Desktop
detail: Cowork has a browser inside the desktop app needing no extension, on by default on Enterprise and managed separately.

feature: Gift a Claude subscription
detail: Gifts for Pro, Max or Ultra were delivered by email or shareable link; purchasing is currently unavailable for all accounts and earlier gifts expire 365 days after purchase.

feature: Redeem a gift subscription on web
detail: Redeem at claude.ai/gift/redeem or via emailed link on web only; no card needed; any Claude account can redeem; no stacking multiple gifts.

feature: Gift redemption outcomes by current plan
detail: New/free users upgrade immediately, Pro extended or upgraded temporarily with unused time credited, lower-tier gifts to Max/Ultra become account credit.

feature: Gift redemption blocked while mobile subscription active
detail: iOS or Android store subscribers must wait until it ends; the gift does not expire meanwhile.

feature: Billing address determines tax
detail: Self-serve plans take the billing address from the payment method (Settings > Billing); sales-assisted plans edit it under Billing Addresses.

feature: Lock a fixed billing address via Support
detail: Support can fix an address that survives payment method changes after business-location documentation such as a VAT certificate.

feature: Team plan payment methods
detail: Credit, debit or prepaid cards only; ACH and other methods not accepted; owner updates in Organization settings > Billing.

feature: Team billing email and invoice name
detail: Billing email changes go through Support with owner authorization; owner can use a different name on invoices when editing payment method.

feature: Team seat billing and proration
detail: Charged at cycle start per member count; added seats prorated immediately; removing members gives no credit but frees the seat.

feature: Team invoices in Organization settings > Billing
detail: Owners view and download invoices via Stripe; invoices also emailed to billing addresses.

feature: Team tax-exempt status via Support
detail: Not selectable at signup; submit documentation to Support to mark exempt and receive a credit note.

feature: Upgrade personal plan to Team in place
detail: Direct-purchase personal subscription is cancelled with prorated refund about 24 hours after Team payment; Apple App Store differs; opt-out checkbox keeps personal account separate.

feature: Team monthly API credits viewed in Console
detail: Credits and expiry listed in Console Settings > Billing; usage never charged to the Claude plan.

feature: Resubscribe to Team
detail: Owner resubscribes in Organization settings > Billing.

feature: Compliance API
detail: Programmatic access to activity feed events, chat data, file content and audit log events across Claude deployments; only the Primary Owner enables it and creates keys.

feature: Compliance API security integrations
detail: Third-party security and compliance platforms integrate with the Compliance API for monitoring.

feature: Claude for Government priority support path
detail: Desktop Org Admins and Tenant Admins reach Support via the admin portal Support link; page sits outside the FedRAMP boundary so no sensitive data in the bot.

feature: Minimum age 18 enforced via app store age signal
detail: Mobile app blocks sign-up or sign-in when the App Store or Play Store reports the user under 18, as required by some US state laws; fixes go through Apple or Google.

feature: Active sessions list
detail: Settings > Account shows devices and browsers signed in with approximate location, last active time and a Current badge.

feature: Terminate a session remotely
detail: Three-dot menu on a session terminates it with confirmation, forcing that device to log in again.

feature: Log out of current session from Active sessions
detail: Current session row offers Log out, same as main menu.

feature: Shortened session length (session security)
detail: Admins force re-login after a maximum session length: Enterprise 1, 7, 14 or 28 days; Console 1, 3 or 7 days; shorter setting wins across multiple orgs.

feature: Single sign-on (SAML and OpenID Connect)
detail: Owners or Primary Owners configure SSO via WorkOS with Okta, Entra ID, Google, OneLogin, JumpCloud and Duo SAML guides; test sign-in at the end.

feature: Domain verification by DNS TXT record
detail: Verify one or more domains under one IdP using an anthropic-domain-verification TXT value shown once; verification alone does not affect users.

feature: Restrict organization creation on verified domains
detail: Toggle after verification prevents users creating new Claude or Console orgs, including personal accounts, with verified domains.

feature: Require SSO for Claude and for Console
detail: Toggles force Continue with SSO; otherwise email login also allowed.

feature: User provisioning: invite only or JIT
detail: Invite only is default; Just-in-Time provisioning creates users with the User role on first IdP login.

feature: Update SSO certificate or client secret
detail: Manage SSO lets admins refresh SAML cert or OIDC secret and re-test; an expired one with Require SSO on locks everyone out until Support helps.

feature: Disconnect SSO
detail: Turn off Require SSO then Delete connection (type DELETE CONNECTION), which signs out everyone on verified domains and cannot be undone.

feature: IdP-initiated login limitation for Console
detail: Console orgs sharing settings with Team/Enterprise do not support IdP-initiated login; use a Console bookmark with sso=true.

feature: Admin lockout recovery via Support
detail: Owners contact Support to regain access after cert expiry, IdP change or group mapping removing admins.

feature: JIT provisioning
detail: Users assigned to the IdP app are created on first SSO login with the User role; never removes members automatically.

feature: SCIM directory sync
detail: Automatic provisioning and deprovisioning from the IdP, no login needed; Enterprise and Console only, with preview of removals before applying and optional welcome email toggle.

feature: Group mappings for roles and seat tiers
detail: With JIT or SCIM, IdP groups map to roles and seat tiers; all users need a role group; highest-permission role wins; Primary Owner exempt.

feature: Role and seat catalog
detail: Team: Owner, Admin, User with Premium or Standard seats; Enterprise adds Custom role and Chat or Chat + Claude Code seats; Console has Admin, Developer, Limited Developer, Billing, Claude Code User, User.

feature: Custom role via SCIM-synced groups
detail: Custom role users get permissions only from custom roles attached to groups, which sync from IdP only with SCIM; JIT needs manual groups.

feature: Primary Owner exemption and transfer
detail: Primary Owner is skipped by SCIM reconciliation, cannot be assigned by group mapping, and is transferred manually in Members.

feature: Provisioning troubleshooting: seats, sync now, Entra 40-minute push
detail: Provisioning needs available seats; Sync now triggers a sync; Entra pushes SCIM every 40 minutes.

feature: Invite members by email with seat type and role
detail: Admins add members in Members with seat type and role; invites occupy seats immediately and expire after 21 days; email must use an allowed domain.

feature: Bulk add members
detail: Paste comma- or newline-separated emails to invite many at once.

feature: Organization discovery to join
detail: Colleagues with matching email domain can find the org at signup and request to join, with auto or approval-based admission.

feature: Shareable invite link
detail: Admin-generated link; default on for Team, off for non-SSO Enterprise, unavailable under SSO; joiners get lowest seat tier; disabling or regenerating invalidates old links.

feature: Member-to-member invites
detail: Any member can invite teammates; admin approval one-by-one (default) or automatic; on by default for Team, off for Enterprise.

feature: Remove member frees seat
detail: Removal ends access immediately, frees the seat without reducing seat count, and keeps account history if re-added.

feature: Export member list CSV
detail: Admins export name, email, role and seat type from Members.

feature: Pending invitations: resend or revoke
detail: Pending tab lets admins resend expired invites or remove them.

feature: Sign a member out everywhere (beta)
detail: Ends all sessions and trusted devices from Members menu or Admin API; member stays; also signs out their other accounts and does not stop scheduled Code routines or unlink Cowork computers.

feature: Transfer Primary Owner
detail: Current Primary Owner transfers the single Primary Owner role via the Role dropdown by confirming the new owner's email.

feature: Seat type visible only to admins
detail: Standard or Premium seat tier appears in the Tier column for Admins and above only.

feature: Personal and work account toggle
detail: Members who join with an email that has a personal account can switch between both from the account menu.

feature: Anthropic software directory submission terms
detail: Developers who submit MCP servers, skills, plugins or apps grant Anthropic display licenses, and Anthropic may refuse or remove any listing at any time.

feature: Software directory policy: safety and privacy rules
detail: Listed software may not evade guardrails, read Claude's memory or chat history, or collect more context than needed.

feature: Software directory policy: tool description rules
detail: Tool descriptions must be narrow, accurate, non-conflicting and human-readable, with no hidden instructions or dynamically fetched behavior.

feature: Software directory policy: unsupported categories
detail: Disallows autonomous money movement, crypto, non-design AI image/video/audio generation, ads and adult content.

feature: MCP server directory requirements
detail: Needs OAuth 2.0 for authenticated remote servers, tool annotations (readOnlyHint, destructiveHint, title), tool names up to 64 characters, Streamable HTTP, token-frugal responses.

feature: Directory developer requirements
detail: Privacy policy link, support contact, documentation, a test account and three example prompts are required; material changes may trigger re-review.

feature: Crisis support banner with helplines
detail: A separate detection system can show a banner with crisis helplines when a chat touches distress or self-harm; dismissible, reappears no sooner than about two hours, location-based via ThroughLine.

feature: Digital safety plan via Koko
detail: Banner can link to a free, anonymous five-minute safety plan from Koko, available in nine languages; Claude conversations are not shared with Koko or helplines.

feature: Sign in with Google
detail: Continue with Google on web, desktop and mobile; can be unlinked in Google account settings.

feature: Sign in with emailed secure link
detail: Continue with email sends a login link; opening it on another device shows a verification code to enter on the original device.

feature: No dedicated account password
detail: Claude accounts cannot have a password; sign-in is Google, email link or SSO.

feature: Switch between personal and Team/Enterprise accounts
detail: Click initials in the lower left to choose the account when both share an email; otherwise log out and in.

feature: Sign in with Apple Hide My Email accounts
detail: Use the privaterelay address with Continue with email to log in on other devices; email shown in iOS app settings.

feature: Subscription plans limited to native apps and Claude Code
detail: Plan authentication is for Anthropic's own apps and Claude Code; third-party tools should use API keys or linked billing.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Tenant Restrictions via network proxy header
detail: Proxy injects anthropic-allowed-org-ids so only listed org UUIDs can use Claude on corporate networks, covering web, desktop, API key and OAuth, plus artifacts; up to 500 UUIDs over at most 10 header lines.

feature: Tenant Restrictions supported proxy platforms
detail: Documented for Cato, Cloudflare Zero Trust, Island, Netskope, Palo Alto Prisma Access, Zscaler and generic header-injecting HTTPS proxies; TLS inspection required.

feature: IP allowlisting (public beta)
detail: Enterprise Owners set an allowlist of approved IPs themselves; artifacts shared outside the organization are not limited by it.

feature: HIPAA-ready Enterprise plan with BAA
detail: Primary Owner can self-enable HIPAA from Organization settings > Data and privacy with click-to-accept BAA; irreversible, resets some settings; Team and individual plans cannot.

feature: HIPAA coverage tiers for features
detail: Features are covered by the BAA, available but uncovered, or disabled; Claude Code and Cowork covered only after applying HIPAA configuration in local mode (cloud features unavailable) or ZDR for Code.

feature: Existing API BAA does not cover Enterprise plan
detail: API BAAs signed before Dec 2 2025 need a new BAA to add the Enterprise plan.

feature: Change team name
detail: Owners edit the team name under Organization settings > Organization.

feature: Members edit their own name only
detail: Admins cannot rename members; users edit Full name in Settings > Account.

feature: Multiple Team plans or organizations
detail: Multiple Team plans can be bought separately; multiple Enterprise plans go through Sales.

feature: Allowed email domains management
detail: Owners add or remove allowed domains in Identity and access; public domains like gmail can be allowed for other members.

feature: Claude Cowork agentic tasks
detail: Cowork brings Claude Code's agentic approach to knowledge work: describe an outcome and Claude plans, runs code in an isolated cloud environment, coordinates sub-agents and delivers finished files.

feature: Cowork availability by surface and plan
detail: Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux beta) on all paid plans; web and mobile on Pro, Max, Ultra, Team (beta) and Enterprise when owner enables; Chrome side panel on all paid plans.

feature: Unified chat and Cowork home
detail: The new experience merges Chat and Cowork into one message box; Cowork selector or Chat to switch where still shown; rolling out to Pro, Max, Ultra, with Team beta.

feature: Cloud sessions that continue when you close your laptop
detail: Cowork sessions run on Anthropic servers, follow the account across devices and keep working while away; local files, browser and computer need the desktop app open.

feature: Cowork shared memory with chat and per-task Memory off
detail: Cloud sessions use chat memory and feed back to it; Memory can be turned off in the plus menu before the first message and cannot change later.

feature: Cowork direct local file access on desktop
detail: Desktop Cowork reads and writes local files without upload; Claude requires explicit Allow before permanently deleting files.

feature: Cowork professional outputs and Edit with Claude
detail: Produces Excel with formulas, PowerPoint and documents editable with Claude for Excel/PowerPoint; highlight Markdown draft text and click Edit with Claude.

feature: Cowork projects
detail: Group tasks into workspaces with files, instructions and memory.

feature: Cowork browser actions
detail: Built-in desktop browser by default, or Claude in Chrome if installed; preferred browser set in Settings > Cowork.

feature: Cowork permission modes: Manual, Auto, Skip
detail: Manual asks before each action, Auto reviews each action with a safety check (rolling out as default on Pro, Max, Ultra, Team; Manual default on Enterprise), Skip does no checks; admins can disable Auto.

feature: Connector tool permissions: Always allow, Needs approval, Always ask, Blocked
detail: Per-tool permission levels interact with the mode; Always ask (rolling out) forces a prompt each use, set under Customize > Connectors > Permissions; scheduled tasks may wait or skip.

feature: Cowork global instructions and folder instructions
detail: Standing instructions in Settings > Cowork (or Instructions for Claude in the new settings), plus per-folder instructions Claude can update.

feature: Cowork plugins
detail: Plugins bundle skills, connectors and sub-agents, saved to the account and usable in chat, Claude Code and Cowork.

feature: Scheduled tasks in Cowork
detail: Use /schedule or the Scheduled sidebar to run tasks on demand or on a cadence, in the cloud with no device online.

feature: Delete a Cowork task
detail: Delete from the task menu or Tasks list; removed from history at once and from backend within 30 days.

feature: Cowork limitations: no session sharing, desktop-only features
detail: Sessions cannot be shared (artifacts can); live artifacts made before Aug 19 2026 and plugins with local MCP servers work only in desktop.

feature: Cowork org control of web search and egress
detail: Team/Enterprise owners can turn off web search for Cowork and Chat in Capabilities; network egress rules do not cover web fetch, search or MCPs.

feature: Organization data export
detail: Primary Owners export conversation and user data from Organization settings > Data and privacy; link emailed, expires in 24 hours and may work once; excludes generated Word/Excel/PowerPoint/PDF files and deleted items.

feature: Allow members to export their own data
detail: Owners can enable member self-export of their own chats from Settings > Privacy on web and desktop, not iOS or Android and without uploaded file contents.

feature: Cowork isolated temporary cloud environment
detail: Each session runs in its own environment on Anthropic servers that cannot reach your network and is removed at session end; isolation does not limit what connected apps or folders expose.

feature: Cowork prompt-injection defenses
detail: Training, content classifiers on untrusted content, auto-mode action screening and deletion permission prompts; advice to use Manual for sensitive tasks.

feature: Cowork computer use with per-app permission
detail: Claude clicks and types on screen after asking permission for each application, with no sandbox, screenshots for context; users can block sensitive apps.

feature: Stream Cowork events to SIEM via OpenTelemetry
detail: Team and Enterprise owners can send Cowork events to observability tools through OpenTelemetry.

feature: Cowork sessions visible to Compliance API
detail: Web and mobile Cowork sessions are retrievable through the Compliance API.

feature: Scheduled task review page
detail: Past runs of scheduled tasks are reviewed from the Scheduled page in the left sidebar; tasks can be paused or deleted.

feature: Cowork with Excel and PowerPoint add-ins shares context across apps
detail: Add-ins let Claude pass data between Excel and PowerPoint during a session.

feature: Cowork local-to-cloud change on Oct 6
