detail: On Pro, Max, Ultra new desktop tasks run in the cloud while earlier local sessions continue locally.

feature: Single Enterprise seat model
detail: New usage-based Enterprise plans use one per-user monthly seat (billed annually) covering web, desktop, mobile and Claude Code; minimum 20 seats.

feature: Legacy Enterprise seat types
detail: Chat, Chat + Claude Code, Standard and Premium seats are not sold to new contracts and move to the single seat at renewal; HIPAA orgs keep the Chat/Chat+Code split.

feature: Named-user seat rule
detail: Each Enterprise seat belongs to one named person; credentials cannot be shared or rotated to dodge limits.

feature: Purchase Enterprise seats mid-term
detail: Owners add seats any time under Organization and access with prorated immediate charge; self-serve reductions only at renewal.

feature: No seat assigned option
detail: Temporarily removes a member's access without removing them; they do not count toward the seat limit but pending invites do.

feature: Enterprise cancellation
detail: Self-serve owners cancel in Billing effective at end of annual term; sales-assisted via account contact.

feature: Switch identity provider procedure
detail: Steps to migrate SSO to a new IdP: pause SCIM, set Invite only, delete the directory and SSO connection (irreversible, signs users out), then reconfigure and re-enable; emails must match exactly.

feature: Console member invitations
detail: Console admins invite up to 50 emails at a time with a role; invitations expire after three weeks and can be revoked.

feature: Interactive connectors (MCP Apps) in chat
detail: Connectors can render live interactive apps such as Asana boards or Figma views inside the conversation, with clicks, filters and approvals; rolling out to side panel and nav pinning for new experience accounts.

feature: Interactive connector display modes
detail: Inline card, side panel beside the chat (expandable) or full-screen view with chat input still available.

feature: Open and pin interactive connectors from navigation
detail: Open a supported connector full page without asking Claude and pin it to the sidebar; pins are per browser and not on mobile yet.

feature: Interactive connector directory badge and examples
detail: Directory shows an Interactive badge; listed ones include Amplitude, Asana, Box, Canva, Clay, Figma, Hex and Slack.

feature: Admin disable interactive tool calls
detail: Owners can disable the tool calls that render interactive views under Organization settings > Connectors without disabling the connector.

feature: Interactive connector security and limits
detail: Sandboxed iframes with strict CSP and JSON-RPC messaging; purchases via in-chat views are not supported; individuals disable tools via Search and tools menu.

feature: Claude-generated custom visuals when no connector UI fits
detail: Claude builds its own diagrams, charts and simple interactive elements when no connected interactive interface handles the request.

feature: Organization discovery
detail: Users signing up with a work email can find and join the company's Team/Enterprise org; admins enable per domain via Discoverable toggle, unavailable with SSO; default on for new Team, off for Enterprise.

feature: Join approval mode: automatic or admin approval
detail: Approve automatically adds joiners at the lowest seat tier and buys a seat if needed; Require admin approval holds requests; also applies to member-sent invites.

feature: Joining an org with an existing personal account
detail: Keep both accounts, or use the org only choosing Bring what you can or Start fresh; custom skills, Claude Docs and connected apps do not move.

feature: Join via invite link, email invite or admin add
detail: Alternative join paths besides discovery; disabled or regenerated links stop working.

feature: Enable or disable Cowork for the organization
detail: Owners toggle Cowork under Organization settings > Cowork; on by default, off by default under HIPAA; Enterprise can scope it to groups with custom roles.

feature: Run Cowork in the cloud toggle
detail: Team: on by default; Enterprise: off by default and needs a custom-role capability grant; unavailable when HIPAA local-mode configuration is applied.

feature: Built-in browser toggle for Cowork
detail: Org Capabilities setting, default on for Team and Enterprise (off under HIPAA until enabled), separate from the Claude in Chrome toggle.

feature: Computer use beta for Team and Enterprise
detail: Not available in tasks started with the Cowork option; works in the new Claude experience once an owner enables it, rolling out gradually.

feature: Auto mode org settings
detail: Allow Automatically approve mode and Start new tasks in Automatically approve mode toggles control availability and default; Enterprise defaults to Manual outside the Chrome side panel.

feature: Allow Always allow for connector tools (Cowork)
detail: Off by default; when off members approve write-capable connector tools per task and saved always-allow preferences are ignored; most restrictive layer wins with custom roles.

feature: Plugin marketplaces and install states
detail: Owners distribute plugins as Installed by default, Available to install, Required or Not available, with per-group overrides on Enterprise; plugins ride the Cowork toggle.

feature: Cowork company branding
detail: Owners configure organization branding shown on a redesigned Cowork home screen.

feature: Cowork projects admin note
detail: Projects have no admin controls; folder-tied projects work only on desktop and local project data stays on the user's computer.

feature: Local Cowork conversation storage
detail: Local sessions store history on the user's computer outside Anthropic retention; Enterprise admins can retrieve via Compliance API, no deletion endpoints yet.

feature: EDR sensor inside local Cowork VM (beta)
detail: Admins run their EDR sensor in the Cowork VM on macOS and Windows; not for cloud sessions.

feature: Cowork network egress settings apply per new session
detail: Changes to egress allowlists affect only new sessions and do not cover web fetch, web search or MCPs.

feature: Weather visual in chat
detail: Claude can show current weather and forecasts powered by Google Maps, Fahrenheit for US and Celsius elsewhere; visual on web and desktop, text on mobile; needs web search.

feature: Recipe cards
detail: Formatted recipe cards with serving and unit changes and Get cooking step-by-step mode; web and desktop only; images from Bing.

feature: Custom visuals in chat (beta)
detail: Claude builds diagrams, flowcharts and explorable charts from scratch within the conversation; web and desktop only.

feature: Sports scores and standings
detail: Text results for NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, WNBA, MLS, NCAA, major soccer leagues, tennis, golf, NASCAR, cricket and MMA, including live scores; no detailed stats for golf or NASCAR.

feature: Interactive input questions
detail: Claude can ask multiple-choice, multi-select or ranking questions as clickable options at the bottom of chat; typing still works.

feature: Maps and image search toggles for organizations
detail: Team on by default, Enterprise off until owner enables in Capabilities; Google gets IP and consented location, Bing click data, prompts are rewritten as generic queries.

feature: Provision skills org-wide
detail: Owners upload a skill ZIP (with SKILL.md) or create one in Plugins & skills; it appears enabled by default for all members, who can toggle it off, and syncs to Claude Code.

feature: Provision skills to groups via plugins
detail: Enterprise bundles skills into a plugin assigned to a group; appears in chat, Cowork and terminal Code for those members.

feature: User-created skills policy toggle
detail: Turn off to stop users creating or uploading skills while provisioned and Anthropic skills stay usable; custom roles also need Create skills capability.

feature: Publishing policy: Requires review, Open, Off
detail: Controls whether users can publish skills and plugins to the org library, with owner review, scan gating or no publishing; defaults differ by plan.

feature: Review requests tab for submissions
detail: Reviewers see submitter, scan result, files, diffs and possible duplicates, then Approve (choose offering and groups) or Request changes with a note.

feature: Inventory tab for org skills and plugins
detail: Lists items with version history, default access (Available, Installed by default, Not available, Required), group access, share link and removal.

feature: Skill sharing and Share with groups toggles
detail: Independent toggles let users share with colleagues or groups; shared items are view-only and audited as role_assignment events in audit log and Compliance API.

feature: Skill and plugin security scanning
detail: Enterprise scans uploaded third-party skills and plugins; pass installs, risky shows caution banner, malicious is blocked; unavailable with CMEK, ZDR or HIPAA.

feature: HIPAA configuration turns off skills
detail: Applying the local-mode HIPAA configuration disables Skills and user-created skills until an owner re-enables, and group sharing cannot be turned on; skills not covered by the BAA.

feature: Tool access setting: Auto mode (default)
detail: Per-conversation setting under + > Connectors > Tool access; Auto lets Claude decide dynamically which connectors to load for the task.

feature: Tool access setting: Always available
detail: Loads every connected connector at the start of each conversation; best for fewer than 10 connectors, costs more conversation space up front.

feature: Tool access setting: On demand
detail: Connectors load only after Claude searches for the relevant one; suited to 10+ connectors or length-limit problems, adds one extra step before using a connector.

feature: Tool access also in Cowork; menu reached by + button or slash
detail: Tool access modes apply in chat, Cowork, Claude Desktop and mobile; open via the + button bottom left or typing / then Connectors > Tool access. Choice is per conversation only.

feature: Organization invite link
detail: Admins can generate, copy, disable and regenerate a link that lets teammates join without per-email invites; in Organization settings > Identity and access.

feature: Invite link availability by plan and SSO
detail: On by default for Team, off by default for non-SSO Enterprise (admin can enable), not available for SSO organizations where the identity provider provisions members.

feature: Invite link expiry and rotation
detail: Links expire automatically 90 days after creation; disabling invalidates all links, regenerating makes a new one and kills the old.

feature: Invite link joiners: seat tier and approval bypass
detail: People joining by link get the lowest available seat tier (a standard seat is created if none free) and are always added automatically, ignoring the new-member approval setting.

feature: Invite link respects allowed domains and plan seat maximum
detail: Only emails on the org's allowed-domain list can join; joiners see an error if the plan's maximum seat count is reached.

feature: Self-serve upgrade from Team to Enterprise
detail: Upgrade the existing org at claude.ai/upgrade keeping chats, projects and memberships; 20-seat minimum, per-user spend limit and starting usage balance, credit card only at migration; irreversible.

feature: Sales-assisted Team to Enterprise migration
detail: Done through an account executive with an agreed go-live; brief access outage during provisioning and all users should log out and back in afterwards.

feature: Capabilities that are default-off on Enterprise
detail: Skills (and skill creation and sharing), code execution and file creation, Claude Design/Slides/Docs artifacts, standalone Claude Design at claude.ai/design, and Claude in Chrome start disabled; existing data is retained and returns when re-enabled.

feature: Enterprise billing after migration: usage credits roll over, no monthly API credits
detail: Unused Team usage credits roll over to the usage-based Enterprise plan; Enterprise is not eligible for monthly API credits (existing ones stay until expiry). Org spend limit reached locks all users until raised or new month.

feature: Seat assignment check and self-serve seat adding after migration
detail: Some users may show No seat assigned after cutover and lack access until fixed; Owners can add seats via Organization settings > Organization and access > Manage under Total seats.

feature: Turning on SSO forces re-login; DNS and SCIM sync timing
detail: Enabling SSO logs existing users out; domain verification DNS takes up to 24-48h; Entra ID pushes SCIM roughly every 40 minutes, Okta more often.

feature: Groups for organizing members
detail: Groups collect members by team or department to apply spend limits, custom-role access and resource sharing (projects, skills, plugins); created manually or synced via SCIM; up to 1000 groups per org, performance dips above 250 memberships per member.

feature: Create, edit and delete groups
detail: Organization settings > Groups: add group with name, optional display name, roles, visibility and members (or add all); bulk edit via checkboxes; deleting removes the group's project access but keeps roles and members.

feature: SCIM group sync and its restrictions
detail: IdP groups sync automatically with a SCIM sync button for manual refresh; synced groups cannot be renamed or deleted in Claude; only direct memberships are honored, nested groups ignored.

feature: Group visibility settings (discover, share with, see members)
detail: Three per-group toggles, each granted to group members or everyone, control whether members can find the group, share resources with it, or see its member names and emails; set per organization, not shared across child orgs.

feature: Revoke a group's access to shared projects, skills and plugins
detail: Turning off sharing only blocks new shares; a separate option removes existing project access (and another for skills/plugins); artifacts shared with the group must be unshared from the artifact itself.

feature: Custom member role driven by groups
detail: Setting a member's role to Custom gives no default permissions; access comes only from custom roles on their groups. With SCIM group mappings the role is recalculated on sync, and a member in no groups cannot access any product.

feature: Group spend limits
detail: Per-user monthly limit applied to every member of a group, optional shared pooled monthly budget; set in Organization settings > Usage > By group/tier; individual limits override group limits.

feature: Multi-group spend limit resolution setting
detail: Admin chooses whether a member in several limited groups gets the higher or lower group limit; order is individual limit, then group limit, then none.

feature: Blocked by a spend limit view
detail: Section at top of Organization settings > Usage shows who is blocked or near limits; full detail only for usage-based Enterprise plans.

feature: Organization plugin marketplaces
detail: Owners create marketplaces and distribute curated plugins to the whole org; plugins show up in chat, the Desktop Chat tab, Cowork and Claude Code under the same account. Requires Cowork and Skills enabled.

feature: Plugins and skills Inventory tab
detail: Lists every skill and plugin the org governs, including user-created ones, with source, version, capabilities, audience and 30-day usage; filter by source, audience, type; row menu for details, version history and default/group access.

feature: Anthropic-built marketplaces (Knowledge Work default)
detail: Anthropic provides function-specific marketplaces (such as legal, finance); Knowledge Work is added by default and can be removed; others added via Browse Anthropic sources.

feature: Manual plugin upload to a marketplace
detail: Upload plugin ZIP files (under 200 MB) to a new or existing marketplace; same-name upload overwrites the previous version.

feature: GitHub-synced plugin marketplace
detail: Connect a private or internal github.com or GitHub Enterprise repo through the Claude GitHub App; optional automatic sync on merged PRs with a plugin version bump, manual Re-sync, syncs up to 30 minutes, failed syncs keep last version.

feature: GitLab-synced plugin marketplace
detail: Sync from gitlab.com (private/internal) or self-managed GitLab via access token, optional private CA cert and push webhook set up automatically or by hand; Owner role needed; Claude Code cloud sessions do not support GitLab.

feature: Plugin installation preferences (four levels)
detail: Per plugin: Installed by default (members can turn off), Available to install (Discover tab), Not available (hidden), Required (cannot be removed, also stays on in synced Claude Code); changes apply on next session or refresh.

feature: Group-level plugin access overrides
detail: Enterprise admins can override a plugin's org-wide preference per group; resolution is group, then org, then marketplace default, and with multiple groups the most permissive setting wins; overrides persist across re-syncs.

feature: Allow list and block list for plugin marketplaces
detail: Owners set strictKnownMarketplaces and blockedMarketplaces in Claude Code managed settings; applies to Git marketplaces added in Claude, Desktop, Cowork and Code, not to existing marketplaces or uploaded plugins; block beats allow.

feature: Plugin marketplace limits and naming rules
detail: Max 1000 plugins per marketplace, 200 MB per ZIP, 64-character lowercase-hyphen names, 30-minute sync timeout, several reserved marketplace names blocked; scanning can reject plugins flagged for malicious content.

feature: Plugins in chat, Desktop and Cowork
detail: Plugins bundle skills, connectors and sub-agents; available in web chat, the Desktop Chat tab and Cowork, saved to the account so they sync to Claude Code. Hooks and sub-agents run only in Cowork and Code and show grayed out in chat.

feature: Plugins sync one-way into Claude Code
detail: Installed and org-distributed plugins sync to Claude Code (v2.1.273+) at each start for Claude-account sign-ins, running skills, sub-agents, hooks and MCP servers locally; no sync with API-key or cloud-provider sign-in; syncClaudeAiPlugins=false stops it.

feature: Plugin library and Plugin Create plugin
detail: Built-in library covers sales, finance, legal, marketing, HR, engineering, design, operations, data analysis and partner plugins such as Salesforce; Plugin Create helps build custom plugins from templates.

feature: Customize menu: install plugin from Discover or upload
detail: Customize sidebar menu groups plugins, skills and connectors; install from Plugins > Discover > Add, or upload your own plugin file; plugins are stored on the account, not the computer.

feature: Skill and plugin scanning for malicious content
detail: When enabled by an Enterprise admin, plugins are scanned at install or update: malicious ones are blocked and risky ones show a caution banner; published plugins stay unlisted until the scan passes.

feature: Plugin skills via slash or plus menu; plugin commands in Cowork
detail: Type / or click + to see skills from installed plugins in chat and Cowork; in Cowork a plugin command runs as /plugin-name:command.

feature: Customize an installed plugin in Cowork
detail: The Customize button on an installed plugin opens a Cowork task where Claude helps adjust the plugin's skills and connectors to your workflow.

feature: Plugin and skill sharing and publishing policy
detail: Owners enable Skill sharing, Share with groups (needs a custom-role capability) and a Publishing setting on the Policy tab of Organization settings > Plugins & skills.

feature: Share a plugin with people or a group
detail: Plugin authors share uploaded or created plugins with named colleagues (Team, Enterprise) or groups (Enterprise); recipients see it grayed out under Shared with you, view-only, auto-updated, revocable. Marketplace plugins cannot be shared.

feature: Publish a plugin to the organization library with review
detail: Authors click Publish to org and propose Available, Installed by default or Required; reviewers can change the audience, request changes or approve, with pending, changes requested and published statuses and an email on approval; updates are re-reviewed.

feature: Add or remove plugin marketplaces as a user
detail: Users add Anthropic marketplaces (Knowledge Work, Life Sciences, Financial Services, Legal) or a repo from GitHub, public GitLab or Bitbucket, and can remove any, including the default; org allow/block lists can refuse repos.

feature: Cowork scheduled tasks
detail: Describe a task once and Claude runs it automatically (hourly, daily, weekly, weekdays or on demand), each run as its own Cowork session using connectors, skills and plugins; runs remotely even with computer asleep.

feature: Cowork availability by surface and plan
detail: Cowork on desktop for all paid plans; on web and mobile for Pro, Max, Ultra and Team (beta on Team) and Enterprise when an owner enables it; a unified chat plus Cowork experience is rolling out.

feature: Create scheduled task with Claude or manually
detail: Create from conversation (new experience) or Scheduled > New task > Create with Claude, or Set up manually with name, prompt, approval mode, frequency, optional model and optional folder.

feature: Scheduled task Require this computer option
detail: Choosing a folder turns on Require this computer, so the task only runs while the computer is awake and Claude Desktop is open; offered only to orgs with Computer access on.

feature: Manage scheduled tasks: pause, resume, delete, run now, edit
detail: The Scheduled sidebar page lists tasks and upcoming/past runs and lets you edit instructions, cadence or approval mode, pause, resume, delete or run on demand.

feature: Scheduled task limits with connectors and finance
detail: Scheduled tasks cannot use linked Personal Finance accounts, and tools set to Always ask may wait or be skipped; local scheduled tasks migrate to the cloud automatically where Cowork in the cloud is on.

feature: SSO and SCIM email-match requirement (all IdPs)
detail: Claude matches SSO logins to provisioned seats by exact email string; mismatch between SCIM and SSO attributes causes Account creation is blocked, landing on free personal account, or Claude Code auth failure.

feature: Restrict organization creation setting
detail: Identity and access setting that stops unprovisioned users from creating free personal accounts; recommended to prevent rogue free orgs after SSO/SCIM mismatches. Ghost seats require Support to deprovision.

feature: Google Workspace SSO/SCIM mismatch fix
detail: Align SCIM auto-provisioning and SAML Name ID/attributes to primaryEmail, then suspend and re-enable provisioning for a full sync; Team plans have no SCIM.

feature: Microsoft Entra ID SSO/SCIM mismatch fix
detail: Point SCIM emails[work].value to the mail attribute (not userPrincipalName), check OIDC email optional claim under App registrations, and use Restart provisioning for a full sync.

feature: Okta SSO/SCIM mismatch fix
detail: Use user.email for both SCIM mapping and SAML/OIDC claim instead of user.login, then Force Sync or Push Users to re-evaluate.

feature: Claude Code enterprise login command
detail: Affected users re-run claude auth login --enterprise to verify the email matches their provisioned seat after an SSO/SCIM fix.

feature: OneLogin SSO/SCIM mismatch fix
detail: Map both the Parameters-tab SCIM value and the SAML email attribute to OneLogin's Email field (not Username) and run a Re-sync or re-provision users; domain must be verified for re-invites.

feature: Ping Identity (PingOne and PingFederate) SSO/SCIM mismatch fix
detail: Map emails[primary].value and the SAML/OIDC email claim to the same email attribute, trace PingFederate contract layers end to end, then force a full provisioning cycle.

feature: SSO setup: Google Workspace
detail: Custom SAML app with Name ID EMAIL = primary email, optional SCIM autoprovisioning mapped to primaryEmail; needs Super Admin; values come from the WorkOS flow at claude.ai/admin-settings/identity.

feature: SSO setup: Microsoft Entra ID
detail: Enterprise application with SAML plus SCIM; requires Entra P1/P2 for SCIM and Global or Application Administrator; sign-on URL claude.ai/login; SCIM only on Enterprise and eligible Console orgs, Team uses JIT.

feature: SSO setup: Okta with optional groups claim
detail: SAML 2.0 (recommended) or OIDC app with email attribute; with group mappings enabled a groups attribute statement is required or users get no mapped role and may be removed from the org at next login under JIT.

feature: SSO setup: OneLogin
detail: SAML Custom Connector (Advanced) as service-provider initiated with Email nameID, SCIM with create/update/delete users, assignment by user or rules.

feature: SSO setup: PingOne and PingFederate
detail: PingOne SAML application with email attribute mapping and outbound SCIM provisioning by population; PingFederate uses an SP connection and outbound channel with Support-guided setup.

feature: SCIM vs JIT provisioning by plan
detail: SCIM directory provisioning is limited to Enterprise and eligible Console orgs; Team plans use just-in-time provisioning on first SSO login.

feature: Custom roles (capability, admin, connector and model grants)
detail: Enterprise owners define roles that grant or restrict features, admin areas, connectors and models; assigned to groups and only effective for members whose role is Custom.

feature: Feature access precedence chain
detail: Most restrictive level wins: Anthropic contract overrides, then org-level toggle, then custom role grants, then the user's own setting; org toggle is the main switch.

feature: Role capability: Chat, code execution and file creation, memory, web search
detail: Individually toggled capabilities for chat on web/desktop/mobile, running code and creating files, cross-conversation memory, and web search; Chat is on by default in all custom roles.

feature: Role capability: project sharing (share, public projects)
detail: Separate toggles for sharing projects with users, groups or org, and for sharing with everyone in the org; turning off does not revoke existing shares.

feature: Role capability: skills (create, share with members, org, groups, scanning)
detail: Toggles for creating or uploading custom skills, sharing skills/plugins with named people, with the whole org, with groups, and running security scans on uploads.

feature: Role capability: Claude Code, cloud sessions, remote control, fast mode
detail: Separate toggles for Claude Code access, cloud sessions (off also disables remote control and fixes in Claude Security), controlling local sessions from claude.ai/code or mobile, and faster model options.

feature: Claude Code dynamic workflows
detail: Lets Claude run large engineering jobs such as migrations, audits and codebase-wide bug hunts in one session lasting hours with high token use; on by default org-wide, disableWorkflows managed setting or an Organization settings > Claude Code toggle turns it off.

feature: Role capability: Claude Security
detail: Gives members access to finding and fixing code security vulnerabilities with Claude.

feature: Role capability: Artifacts, Design, Docs, Slides, Design systems, Motion
detail: Separate toggles for creating/publishing artifacts, Claude Design, Docs, Slides, design systems and short exportable motion pieces; users without them can still open, comment on and use what is shared with them.

feature: Role capability: standalone Claude Design
detail: Controls access to claude.ai/design separately from Design inside conversations and the Artifacts tab.

feature: Role capability: Cowork and Cowork in the cloud
detail: Toggles Cowork access and running Cowork tasks on Anthropic infrastructure so they continue across desktop, web and mobile.

feature: Role capability: Claude Meetings and external-guest meetings
detail: Lets members add Claude to meetings to take notes, create artifacts and delegate tasks; a separate toggle allows meetings with external guests.

feature: Role capability: Claude in Chrome
detail: Controls access to the browser extension that browses and acts on pages for the user.

feature: Role capability: Computer access
detail: Lets members reach their computer files, apps and browser from scheduled tasks, web or mobile Claude and unified chats; Desktop-run sessions and Code remote control are unaffected.

feature: Role capability: Computer use (beta)
detail: Lets Claude see the screen and use allowed apps in Chat and Cowork unified through Claude Desktop; rolling out gradually; included in All capabilities but not All generally available.

feature: Role capability: Scheduled tasks (formerly Routines)
detail: Allows scheduled and webhook-triggered routines running Claude Code autonomously in the cloud; off also disables cloud Cowork scheduled tasks and unified-experience scheduled routines.

feature: Grant all capabilities or all generally available
detail: Roles can use All capabilities (includes beta and research preview) or All generally available and automatically pick up new launches, versus Only selected.

feature: Role changes take up to 15 minutes; deleting a role
detail: Edits may take 15 minutes and need a refresh; deleting a role strips its permissions from all assigned groups.

feature: Permissions are additive across roles
detail: A member in several groups gets the union of all roles' grants and one role cannot subtract another's permission; layered base-plus-extra roles are the intended pattern.

feature: View effective role
detail: Row menu on a member or group shows every capability, admin permission and connector with the role that grants it; read-only and only for Custom-role members.

feature: Admin permission levels: No access, Can view, Can manage
detail: Each admin area is granted all-or-nothing as hidden, read-only with disabled controls, or full read/write.

feature: Delegated admin areas (identity, billing, analytics, privacy, users, libraries,
detail: Custom roles can delegate identity and access, billing, analytics, privacy, user management, libraries, directory management and Claude Design admin without making someone Owner.

feature: Owner access permission
detail: Gives a custom role all Owner admin permissions while capabilities, connectors and models stay role-governed; matches Owner not Primary Owner; changing an Owner to Custom removes built-in Owner access.

feature: Admin items that stay Owner-only
detail: Managing Owners and Admins, API keys and workspaces, compliance API and security keys, and org-level capability toggles cannot be delegated.

feature: Connector permission levels per role
detail: Per connector or per tool a role can be Always allow, Needs approval or Blocked (or Custom per tool); most permissive across roles, capped by the org-wide tool policy, enforced on web, desktop, mobile, Cowork and Code.

feature: Cowork approval setting for write tools
detail: Org setting Allow Always allow for connector tools, off by default, gates write-capable connector tools in Cowork regardless of role grants, so members approve per task.

feature: Model access and effort caps per role
detail: Roles pick which models members may use, cap effort per model, and set a default model and effort; limited by org model settings; Haiku models cannot be disabled.

feature: Restricted-feature messages members see
detail: Disabled org-wide shows This feature is disabled for your organization; not granted shows Contact your admin; no product access lands members on their settings page.

feature: RBAC rollout guidance: patterns and pilot migration
detail: Recommended base-plus-additive roles, tier, department and admin-delegation patterns; export members CSV first, bulk Change role to Custom via Members page, pilot a group, rollback by restoring built-in role.

feature: Dual-seat plans: seat type overrides custom roles
detail: On legacy Chat and Chat + Claude Code seats a role cannot grant Claude Code to a Chat-only seat; seat limits and role capability both must allow.

feature: Connector How members connect: Individually or Managed authorization
detail: Role-level choice whether members sign in to connectors themselves or connect automatically through the identity provider; managed is tried first with individual fallback; settable per connector.

feature: Per-tool connector permissions and cross-role conflict warnings
detail: Custom setting lists each connector tool (for example allow only Jira search); new roles default to Needs approval; All connectors row covers future connectors; conflict warnings name roles granting more.

feature: SCIM group-to-role mapping and group-only sync
detail: Map IdP groups to the Custom role, sync Groups only via Check for updates, then assign roles; manual groups only for Invite-only or JIT modes; SCIM sync button forces refresh.

feature: Parent and child organization behavior for groups and roles
detail: Groups and SCIM sync live at parent level and propagate; roles, spend limits and visibility are set per child organization.

feature: Dispatch: message Claude from phone to work on your desktop
detail: Single persistent thread reachable from phone or desktop; tasks run on the desktop with local files, connectors, plugins and apps, development tasks open in Claude Code and knowledge work in Cowork, results come back as a message plus push notification.

feature: Dispatch availability and limitations
detail: Limited beta on some plans and closed to new users; needs Desktop (macOS, Windows x64, Linux) awake and open plus the mobile app; one thread only with no new threads; setup toggles give file access and keep computer awake.

feature: Dispatch with computer use; not on Linux
detail: Dispatch tasks can drive desktop apps through computer use, except on the Linux beta where only files, connectors and plugins work.

feature: Custom visuals (inline diagrams, charts, interactive)
detail: Claude builds HTML-based diagrams, charts and comparisons inline when useful or on request; interactive with buttons, sliders and full-screen; no setting to turn on.

feature: Keep a custom visual: copy as image, download SVG/HTML, save as artifact
detail: Visuals are ephemeral by default; options to copy a static image, download .svg or .html, or convert to a persistent artifact.

feature: Custom visuals limits: no mobile, shared chats need login, Cowork differences
detail: Not rendered in iOS or Android apps; shared-chat recipients must log in on web or desktop; in Cowork no share link and no click-to-follow-up; Opus recommended for complex visuals and style preferences are remembered.

feature: Japan consumption tax (JCT) 10% on plans
detail: From April 1 2026 a 10% consumption tax is added to all plan prices for Japanese customers; billing currency unchanged with JCT in yen on qualified invoices usable by corporates for input tax credits.

feature: Cowork projects
detail: Dedicated workspaces with own instructions, scheduled tasks, context (local folder, linked chat project, URL) and memory; saved to the Claude account so they follow across devices; requires latest Desktop.

feature: Create Cowork project: from scratch, import chat project, existing folder
detail: Three creation paths; import copies one chat project's files and instructions (no bulk) into a new local project; existing folder path lets you name, set instructions and attach files.

feature: Cowork project memory and Use account memory toggle
detail: Memory is on per project and does not cross projects, but is shared with non-project chats unless Use account memory is turned off on the project page.

feature: Share Cowork projects with Can view or Can edit
detail: Team and Enterprise members share projects with colleagues at view or edit level; group sharing is in beta for Enterprise.

feature: Archive Cowork project and local-to-account migration
detail: Archiving hides the project but leaves local files; Desktop auto-moves folder-based projects (name, description, instructions, memory copy) to the account while folders stay local; Team/Enterprise need unified chat and Cowork; not available in Claude Code.

feature: Computer use in Cowork and Claude Code
detail: Claude can click, type and open apps on the user's computer when no connector exists, working on macOS and Windows in Claude Desktop; order of preference is connectors, then browser, then screen interaction.

feature: Computer use background mode on macOS 15+ and Full control option
detail: On macOS 15 or later Claude works in background windows without taking pointer or keyboard; setting How Claude uses the apps you allow can be switched to Full control; macOS 14 required minimum.

feature: Computer use per-app permissions, blocklist and app tiers
detail: Claude asks to approve each app; browsers and many trading apps are view-only, terminals and editors click/scroll only, music/video/e-book apps off limits, user blocklist denies apps; action review scans for prompt injection.

feature: Enable computer use toggle
detail: Settings > Capabilities (or Settings > System) toggle, on by default on some accounts, lets Claude list installed apps; each app and first use still need confirmation.

feature: Computer use on Team and Enterprise
detail: Beta, off until an owner enables it, works only in the new unified experience (not Cowork-option tasks or Code); web and mobile use also need the Computer access org setting and a connected computer chosen under + > Devices.

feature: Computer use screenshots visible to action review and memory safeguards
detail: Claude screenshots the screen, the automated check in Automatically approve mode sees the latest screenshot; memory skips sensitive topics by default unless Include sensitive topics in memory is on.

feature: Console to Enterprise comparison for Claude Code
detail: Enterprise adds cloud sessions incl. mobile, Slack Claude Tag, Code Review, native UI for managed settings, RBAC, model governance, audit logs and Compliance API, per-member usage views and group spend controls not available on Console.

feature: Managed settings keys for Claude Code (policy)
detail: Org-wide keys include permissions deny/allow/ask, disableBypassPermissionsMode, disableAutoMode, forceLoginOrgUUID, forceLoginMethod, allowedMcpServers, deniedMcpServers, managed-only rules/hooks/MCP, sandbox.enabled, cleanupPeriodDays, companyAnnouncements.

feature: Server-managed vs endpoint-managed settings
detail: Server-managed settings are set in Organization settings > Claude Code and fetched at start and hourly; endpoint-managed use MDM or a file at OS paths; the first non-empty source wins and they do not merge; /status shows which is active.

feature: Switch Claude Code login with /login; leftover credential checks
detail: Developers run /login choosing Claude account with subscription, pick the Enterprise org, verify with /status; env vars like ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN override; CI uses claude setup-token.

feature: Hierarchical spend limits: org, group, individual
detail: Owners set org ceiling, group limits and per-member limits; unlimited still bills; users hitting a limit lose Claude and Claude Code until reset or raised; notify-at-limit and threshold alerts exist.

feature: Enterprise analytics for Claude Code and Analytics API
detail: Dashboards show lines accepted, acceptance rate, PRs, commits and month-to-date spend per member; the Enterprise Analytics API gives per-user engagement and cost; analytics history does not migrate from Console.

feature: Add seats and members; SCIM sync to assign seats
detail: Owners add seats under Billing (prorated), add members individually or in bulk, and SCIM group mappings assign seat types; unseated users show Unassigned; Entra syncs about every 40 min with an on-demand Sync button.

feature: Claude Code Code Review (PR analysis on GitHub)
detail: Fleet of agents reviews GitHub pull requests and posts inline comments with severity markers (normal, nit, pre-existing), runs on PR open, every push or manual request, around 20 minutes average, does not approve or block PRs.

feature: Code Review billed via usage credits
detail: Code Review usage is billed separately through usage credits and does not count against included plan usage; unavailable for zero-data-retention orgs.

feature: Code Review setup via GitHub App and repository selection
detail: Owners install the Claude GitHub App from Organization settings > Claude Code > Code Review (read/write on contents, issues, PRs), choose repos and a trigger each; GHES and GitHub Enterprise Cloud data residency supported via separate flow.

feature: Code Review triggers: once after creation, after every push, manual
detail: Per-repo Review Behavior dropdown; manual uses a top-level PR comment starting with @claude review (open non-draft PR, collaborator access), which also opts the PR into push-triggered reviews; auto-resolves threads when fixed.

feature: Code Review customization via CLAUDE.md and REVIEW.md
detail: CLAUDE.md violations become nit findings and outdated doc statements are flagged; REVIEW.md at the repo root adds review-specific rules to always flag or skip; both additive to default correctness checks.

feature: Code Review cost, spend cap and analytics dashboard
detail: Reviews average roughly $15-25 each by token use; monthly cap set under Organization settings > Usage for the Code Review service; dashboard shows PRs reviewed, weekly cost, auto-resolved feedback and per-repo breakdown; not addable to custom roles.

feature: Usage bundles (pre-purchased discounted credits)
detail: Buy $50, $250 or $1000 bundles at 10%, 20% or 30% off; one pool works across Claude, Desktop, Mobile, Claude Code, Cowork and third-party products; applies only after plan included usage is exhausted; non-refundable.

feature: Usage bundle monthly purchase caps
detail: Individual plans can buy up to $2000 of discounted bundles per month and Team owners up to $3000; beyond cap billed at standard credit rates; requires usage credits enabled; bought via Settings > Usage > Buy usage.

feature: Unified directory for skills, connectors and plugins
detail: Customize in the sidebar has Skills, Connectors and Plugins tabs each with a Discover view; installed directory skills are view-only (download, edit and upload your own copy); org tab lists provisioned and published skills.

feature: Publishing setting: Open or Requires review
detail: Owners choose on the Policy tab whether users can publish skills and plugins to the organization directory openly or with review; separate Skill sharing covers sharing with specific colleagues.

feature: Identity verification via Persona
detail: Some capabilities or integrity checks prompt for individual or business verification using a physical government photo ID, live selfie and for orgs legal name, address and registration number; data held by Persona and not used for training; digital IDs and photocopies rejected.

feature: Verification failure retries and ban appeals
detail: Multiple retry attempts in the flow, contact form after attempts run out, and an appeal form for accounts banned for usage policy violations.

feature: Custom OpenTelemetry collector for Office agents
detail: Enterprise and direct-provider (Bedrock, Vertex, gateway) orgs route full audit spans of Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Outlook agent turns to their own collector over OTLP/HTTP; spans go only to the custom endpoint and include prompts and tool inputs but not assistant text.

feature: Office agents OTEL configuration channels
detail: Enterprise sets otlp_endpoint and otlp_headers under Organization settings > Office agents; direct-provider deployments use manifest URL parameters, Entra directory extension claims or a bootstrap endpoint response, with bootstrap winning on conflict.

feature: Office agent telemetry span types and surface labels
detail: Spans cover query, model stream, tool execution (with accept decision manual/auto/deferred), compaction and file upload; surfaces labeled sheet, doc, slide, mail; Enterprise mode adds user identity and MCP metadata, direct provider omits them.

feature: Cowork OpenTelemetry monitoring
detail: Admins stream Cowork events (prompts, tool and MCP calls, file access, skills and plugins used, human approval decisions, API requests, cost) to any OTel collector via Organization settings > Cowork with HTTP/JSON or protobuf and auth headers; works for cloud and local sessions.

feature: Cowork OTEL content capture off by default (otlpContentCapture)
detail: Prompt text, responses and tool inputs are metadata-only unless the otlpContentCapture device policy enables them for Desktop-started sessions; user emails, connected folder paths and API errors are always included; web, mobile and cloud scheduled sessions are metadata only.

feature: Compliance API covers Cowork, Claude Code and chats
detail: One audit trail attributing sessions across Cowork (Claude, Desktop, Mobile) and Claude Code (CLI, Desktop) to individual users, usable alongside OTel.

feature: SCIM sync: what syncs and how triggered
detail: Members and pushed SCIM groups sync from the IdP via WorkOS, polled every minute and eventually consistent (minutes to hours); manual sync via Sync button under Organization and access or Check for updates under Groups; switching to SCIM removes members not in the directory.

feature: Group mappings enforce roles and seat tiers; disabling restores manual assignmen
detail: With group mappings on, roles and seat tiers come from IdP groups and cannot be overridden manually, and mapping changes need a manual Sync; disabling keeps existing roles and gives new members the User role.

feature: SCIM sync preview before applying
detail: Admin console previews counts of members to add, remove or modify and warns when a sync would remove an unusually large share; sync choices are members, groups or both, roughly one minute per 100 members.

feature: SCIM resync risks: email change, role mapping gaps, child orgs
detail: Changing an email creates a new member record; members missing from role group mappings are removed (seat-tier mappings are lenient); resyncs cascade to child orgs under the same parent; verify via Export CSV or Manage SCIM.

feature: Beta and research preview labels and current list
detail: Research preview is earlier and more likely to change, beta is more stable; listed betas include Managed Agents, Code Security Center, Claude Data certified queries and live sharing, Motion, Sheets, Whiteboards, Enterprise security center, Admin API sign-out, self-serve IP allowlist, Desktop org settings, Centralized management, cost-code tags, Personal Finance, Meetings.

feature: Claude Sheets, Whiteboards and Motion artifacts (beta)
detail: Beta artifact types listed for Claude Sheets, Claude Whiteboards and Claude Motion alongside Claude Data certified queries and live sharing.

feature: Personal Finance connector (beta)
detail: Connector listed in beta that links personal financial accounts; scheduled Cowork tasks cannot use those linked accounts.

feature: Enterprise admin betas: security center, IP allowlist, Admin API sign-out, centr
detail: Listed beta admin features: Enterprise security center, self-serve IP allowlist, sign members out through the Admin API, Claude Desktop settings in org settings, centralized management, project-tag spend by cost code.

feature: Organization instructions
detail: Owners set custom instructions (max 3,000 characters) in Organization settings > Organization and access that apply to every conversation org-wide, visible only to Owners, take precedence over individual instructions, take up to an hour to apply, and cannot override safety rules.

feature: Individual user instructions interact with org instructions
detail: Each user's own instructions apply only to their conversations and fill gaps that organization instructions do not cover; contradictions resolve in favor of the organization.

feature: Claude Code in Claude Desktop Code tab
detail: Desktop with a paid plan includes Claude Code with nothing else to install; open the Code tab and pick a repo folder; shares the account sign-in.

feature: Claude Code terminal install options
detail: Install via native script for macOS/Linux/WSL, PowerShell script for Windows, Homebrew cask, or npm (Node 18+, no sudo); verify with claude --version; native installer bundles its own runtime.

feature: Claude Code authentication methods
detail: Sign in with /login using a paid plan (SSO supported), a Console API key via ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, Amazon Bedrock via CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK, or Google Vertex via CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX; manual code-paste flow when the localhost callback is blocked.

feature: Claude Code approval prompts and permission modes via Shift+Tab
detail: Claude asks before editing files or running commands showing a diff with Yes, Yes and do not ask again for edits, or No; Shift+Tab cycles Plan, Accept Edits and default modes; git checkout undoes uncommitted changes.

feature: /init generates CLAUDE.md
detail: Command explores the repo and drafts a project memory file with build/test commands, structure and conventions that Claude reads at every session start.

feature: claude doctor diagnostics and install troubleshooting
detail: claude doctor prints a diagnostic report to attach to support; guidance covers PATH, npm EACCES, Node 18 requirement, WSL, proxy and corporate TLS (NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS), stuck login, Bedrock/Vertex credentials and 403 model-not-available.

feature: Claude Code usage metering by sign-in type
detail: Enterprise seat shares a rolling-window usage pool with a limit reached and reset-time message; API-key sign-in (Console, Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry) is pay-as-you-go with no hard stop and /cost shows session spend.

feature: /model switching and opusplan in Claude Code
detail: /model lists and switches models mid-session without losing conversation; Sonnet for most work, Opus for hard problems, Haiku for quick tasks; /model opusplan plans with Opus and executes with Sonnet.

feature: Context management commands: /clear, /compact, /context, /cost
detail: /clear wipes chat history keeping CLAUDE.md, /compact summarizes to free space (auto-compacts near the limit), /context inspects loaded context, /cost shows session token and dollar usage; live context indicator shown.

feature: CLAUDE.md locations and loading
detail: Merged from ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (all projects), repo-root CLAUDE.md and on-demand subdirectory files; read at session start without truncation; prompt caching bills repeats at cache-read rate; edits picked up after /compact or /memory.

feature: /memory command and ask-to-remember
detail: /memory opens memory files for editing and shows what is in use; asking Claude to remember a rule appends it to the right CLAUDE.md.

feature: @path file references in Claude Code prompts
detail: Typing @ with a path references a file directly; note that it injects the whole file plus its CLAUDE.md tree into context.

feature: Plan mode (read-only) and Accept Edits mode
detail: Plan mode explores and proposes without editing or running commands, toggled by Shift+Tab (twice from default) or /plan; Accept Edits auto-approves file edits for the session while shell commands still prompt.

feature: Permissions, tools, MCP and subagents (/permissions, /agents)
detail: Permission rules adjustable per project via /permissions; MCP servers plug in GitHub, Jira, databases; subagents run focused subtasks in their own context and are configured via /agents.

feature: Claude Code hooks
detail: Shell commands that run automatically at lifecycle points (before a tool, after an edit, session start) for formatting, linting or blocking unsafe commands; viewed with /hooks.

feature: Skills in Claude Code as slash commands
detail: Skills are packaged instructions invoked with / or loaded automatically; custom ones live in .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (legacy .claude/commands still works); /skills lists them.

feature: Slash command /help, /init, /status, /doctor, /feedback
detail: Help lists commands, init drafts CLAUDE.md, status shows account/model/directory/version, doctor diagnoses installs, feedback (alias bug) reports an issue with session context.

feature: Slash command /clear (aliases /reset, /new) and /compact
detail: Clear wipes history while keeping project memory; compact summarizes the conversation and accepts optional focus instructions.

feature: Slash command /btw side question
detail: Asks a quick question without adding it to the main conversation or consuming context; single-turn, no tool calls, usable while Claude is working.

feature: Slash command /rewind and Esc Esc checkpoints
detail: Rolls conversation and/or code back to an earlier checkpoint; double Escape opens the rewind menu.

feature: Slash commands /cost, /usage, /context
detail: Show session token and spend, plan usage limits and rate-limit status, and a visualization of what fills the context window.

feature: Slash commands /add-dir, /permissions, /config (alias /settings), /plan, /mcp, /
detail: Add extra directory access for the session, view or change tool approvals, open settings (theme, editor mode), enter Plan Mode with optional task, manage MCP servers, and manage subagents.

feature: Slash commands /diff, /copy, /export
detail: Interactive viewer of uncommitted changes and per-turn diffs, copy the last response or a code block, and save the conversation to file or clipboard.

feature: Slash commands /simplify, /resume (alias /continue), /login, /logout, /exit
detail: Bundled /simplify reviews changed files and applies reuse/quality fixes; resume reopens an earlier session; login and logout switch accounts; exit quits (alias /quit).

feature: Claude Code keyboard shortcuts
detail: Shift+Tab cycles permission modes (auto, manual, acceptEdits, plan), Esc interrupts, Ctrl+C cancels or exits, Ctrl+R searches prompt history, Ctrl+O shows verbose transcript, arrows scroll history, ? lists shortcuts.

feature: Claude Code use cases: fix tests, explain code, triage errors, refactor plan, wr
detail: Described workflows for debugging a failing test, walking through unfamiliar code, finding where behavior lives, mapping stack traces to code, plan-first refactors and style-matching test generation.

feature: Review a PR with /pr in Claude Code
detail: With GitHub CLI authenticated, /pr URL fetches the diff, review comments and CI status and reviews changed files in repo context.

feature: Work an issue end to end via issue tracker MCP
detail: After a one-time .mcp.json connector setup Claude queries the tracker, reads the ticket, fixes and tests it, ending in a reviewable diff.

feature: Turn a recurring task into a skill
detail: Ask Claude to write a SKILL.md under .claude/skills/<name>/ and the slash command is available immediately and shared with anyone who clones the repo.

feature: Parallel sessions with git worktrees
detail: claude --worktree (optionally --tmux) or the Desktop Code tab checkbox starts an isolated worktree session; WorktreeCreate and WorktreeRemove hooks give the same for non-git VCS.

feature: Subagent worktree isolation and /batch
detail: Agents with isolation: worktree run in separate worktrees; /batch interviews you about a migration then fans work out to many worktree agents that each test and open a PR.

feature: Claude Code /effort levels
detail: Choose low, medium, high, xhigh, max or auto effort; xhigh gives deeper reasoning than high, max reasons as long as needed and drains usage faster.

feature: Session naming and auto-naming after plan mode
detail: claude --name sets a session name upfront and Claude auto-names sessions after plan mode.

feature: Explanatory and Learning output styles
detail: Set in /config: Explanatory narrates frameworks and patterns, Learning coaches the user through changes; custom styles are possible.

feature: Claude Code auto-memory and /dream
detail: Auto-memory saves preferences, corrections and patterns between sessions into ~/.claude/projects/<project>/memory/, configured via /memory, separate from hand-written CLAUDE.md files.

feature: @claude in pull requests via GitHub Action
detail: /install-github-app installs the GitHub Action so tagging @claude in PR comments can add rules to CLAUDE.md.

feature: Claude Code Chrome extension for verification
detail: Chrome or Edge extension lets Claude Code use a browser to test and iterate on frontend work; Desktop app can also start and test web servers in a built-in browser.

feature: /simplify bundled skill with parallel review agents
detail: Run after changes to review changed code for reuse, quality, efficiency and CLAUDE.md compliance in one pass using parallel agents.

feature: Custom subagents and claude --agent
detail: Markdown files in .claude/agents/ define named agents with color, tools, permission mode and model; claude --agent <name> or an agent setting runs the main conversation as that agent; say use subagents to add compute.

feature: Hook events: SessionStart, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PermissionRequest, Stop, Pos
detail: Lifecycle hooks used to load context, log commands, auto-format after edits, route permission prompts to Slack or Opus, run end-of-task checks and re-inject instructions after compaction.

feature: Pre-approved permissions with /permissions and wildcards
detail: Allowlist safe commands with patterns like Bash(bun run *) or Edit(/docs/**) in a checked-in .claude/settings.json as an alternative to skipping permissions.

feature: Auto mode permission classifier
detail: Classifiers evaluate each action so safe operations auto-approve and risky ones are flagged; selectable via Shift+Tab.

feature: /sandbox open-source sandbox runtime
detail: Opt-in local sandbox with file and network isolation in three modes: sandboxed Bash with auto-allow, sandboxed Bash with regular permissions, or none.

feature: Long-running task options: permission-mode dontAsk and skip-permissions flag
detail: For sandboxed runs use --permission-mode=dontAsk or --dangerously-skip-permissions; other options are background verification agents, Stop hooks, or a community plugin.

feature: /loop local recurring tasks and /schedule cloud jobs
detail: /loop runs a prompt or command on an interval locally for up to 3 days; /schedule creates cloud jobs that run even when the laptop is closed.

feature: Teleport and remote control of Claude Code sessions
detail: --teleport or /teleport moves a cloud session to your machine, /remote-control controls a local session from phone or web, claude remote-control spawns a local session from mobile (CLI v2.1.51+), and a /config toggle enables it for all sessions.

feature: Claude Code in the mobile app Code tab and iMessage plugin
detail: Mobile Claude app has a Code tab; an iMessage plugin from the official marketplace lets Apple devices send tasks.

feature: Cloud sessions from claude.ai/code and & command
detail: Run additional sessions in the cloud, send a session to the cloud with &, or switch contexts with --teleport; setup scripts run before each new cloud session and are skipped on resume.

feature: Claude Code MCP servers and plugins (/plugin)
detail: Add MCP servers via claude mcp add or settings; plugins bundle LSPs, MCPs, skills, agents and hooks from the official or an internal marketplace referenced in settings.json.

feature: Terminal setup, status line, /color, keybindings, spinner verbs
detail: /terminal-setup enables Shift+Enter newlines, /statusline builds a custom status line, /color tints the prompt, /keybindings remaps keys stored in ~/.claude/keybindings.json, Vim mode in /config, custom spinner verbs.

feature: Claude Code voice input
detail: /voice with held space bar in the CLI, a microphone button in Desktop, system dictation on iOS and macOS fn twice; voice is available to all users including Code Desktop and Cowork but may be policy-disabled.

feature: SDK and multi-repo options: --bare, --add-dir, /branch fork
detail: --bare speeds non-interactive claude -p startup roughly tenfold by skipping local config discovery; --add-dir or additionalDirectories grants extra folders; /branch or --resume with --fork-session forks a session.

feature: Claude Code install and update paths (WinGet, auto-update, claude update)
detail: Native installs auto-update in the background and claude update forces it; Homebrew and WinGet installs need manual brew upgrade or winget upgrade; WinGet package is available besides curl, PowerShell and Homebrew.

feature: Claude Code is included with paid plans and Console access
detail: Included in paid Claude plans and Console API access; SSO handled automatically; a 403 after login means the admin has not enabled Claude Code for the workspace.

feature: Claude Code IDE extensions (VS Code, JetBrains)
detail: Extensions for VS Code and JetBrains IDEs offer the same features embedded in the editor.

feature: SSH login: press c to copy the auth URL
detail: Over SSH the login prompt lets you copy the URL, sign in with a local browser and paste the returned code; stray ANTHROPIC_API_KEY causes organization disabled errors, check with /status.

feature: Permission modes auto, manual, acceptEdits, plan
detail: Shift+Tab cycles: auto auto-approves with a background safety check (unless org-disabled and on supported models), manual asks before risky actions, acceptEdits allows edits but asks for commands, plan is read-only; approvals last per session unless persisted via permissions.allow.

feature: Paste or drag screenshots into Claude Code with Ctrl+V
detail: Images can be dragged into the terminal or pasted with Ctrl+V (not Cmd+V on Mac) for error dialogs, mockups and whiteboard photos.

feature: Resume sessions: claude --continue and claude --resume
detail: --continue resumes the most recent session and --resume opens a picker; sessions are stored locally per project directory.

feature: Extended thinking on by default in Claude Code
detail: Reasoning is hidden in normal view and shown in the verbose transcript with Ctrl+O; /effort adjusts depth; Ctrl+C cancels generation without losing the conversation.

feature: Wire up MCP in Claude Code via .mcp.json or claude mcp add
detail: Project-root .mcp.json entries name a server package and env vars; restart and run /mcp to confirm; OAuth MCP servers cannot prompt in non-interactive mode.

feature: Non-interactive mode claude -p for CI and scripts
detail: Runs once and prints the result using a logged-in session or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; interactive approvals do not carry over, so CI should prefer API-key auth and env-var MCP tokens.

feature: Automatic checkpoints and /rewind
detail: A checkpoint is taken at every prompt and /rewind rolls back; committed work needs git revert.

feature: Share Claude Code setup via repo and plugins
detail: Checking .claude/ (CLAUDE.md, skills, MCP config) into the repo shares setup; skills can be packaged as plugins installed with /plugin.

feature: Claude Code terminal gotchas: ripgrep, SSH/tmux, WSL, Alpine
detail: Bundled ripgrep may fail on Alpine (install system copy and set USE_BUILTIN_RIPGREP=0), Shift-select bypasses mouse capture over SSH/tmux, WSL is slow on /mnt/c paths.

feature: Claude Code data handling and training policy
detail: Under Team/Enterprise terms code and conversations are not used for training unless the org opts into model improvement; only needed portions go to the API; /feedback and shared survey transcripts are sent to Anthropic.

feature: Claude Code session visibility and secret blocking
detail: Local sessions stay on the machine per project and are not visible to teammates (company monitoring may apply); cloud sessions with Team visibility or from Slack can be seen by org members; Read deny rules like Read(.env*) block files.

feature: acceptEdits mode scope
detail: Edits proceed without prompting but shell commands, network calls and anything outside the working directory still ask.

feature: Claude Code champion kit (internal adoption guidance)
detail: Guidance for engineering champions covering sharing wins, answering questions with prompts, a 30-day playbook and objection handling; recommends Plan mode, /init, skills and Stop-hook notifications.

feature: Stop hook desktop notification pattern and @-mention directories
detail: Example techniques: a Stop hook notifies when long tasks finish, @directory references let Claude check a folder, and pasting failing output beats rephrasing.

feature: Claude Code built into Claude Desktop Code tab
detail: Sign in to Claude Desktop with a company account and open the Code tab to use Claude Code without any terminal setup.

feature: Claude Code terminal install script
detail: Install the CLI with a curl shell script, cd into a repo and run claude.

feature: Claude Code VS Code extension and JetBrains plugin
detail: Same agent, models and features embedded in VS Code and JetBrains editors, installed from the editor marketplace.

feature: Claude Code /model switch mid-session (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku)
detail: Change model during a session; Sonnet is the suggested everyday default, Opus for hard refactors/debugging, Haiku for quick mechanical work.

feature: Claude Code /init writes CLAUDE.md
detail: Reads the repo and writes a CLAUDE.md with build commands, architecture and conventions that every later session loads automatically.

feature: Claude Code @-references for files and directories
detail: Type @ plus a path to pull a file or whole directory into context; Tab autocompletes paths.

feature: Claude Code auto memory via 'remember that...'
detail: Telling Claude to remember a project fact saves it to auto memory so future sessions start knowing it.

feature: Claude Code permission modes cycled with Shift+Tab
detail: Default asks before risky actions; acceptEdits lets edits and common filesystem commands through; plan proposes changes for approval first.

feature: Claude Code checkpoints and /rewind
detail: Automatic checkpointing; /rewind or pressing Esc twice rolls the conversation and file changes back to an earlier point.

feature: Claude Code MCP connectors via .mcp.json
detail: A project-root .mcp.json config wires Claude Code to trackers like GitHub, Jira or Linear; Claude can write the config on request.

feature: Claude Code skills as custom slash commands
detail: A SKILL.md in .claude/skills/<name>/ becomes a reusable /name command; Claude can author it for you.

feature: Claude Code hooks (e.g. Stop hook notification)
detail: Shell commands that fire on Claude Code events; a Stop hook can send a desktop notification when a long task ends.

feature: Claude Code subagents (automatic and custom)
detail: Claude spins up parallel specialised subagents for big jobs without cluttering the main chat; users can define custom ones.

feature: Claude Code /effort levels incl. max
detail: /effort max pushes reasoning to the top level for hard problems, trading time for depth.

feature: Claude Code image input by drag or Ctrl+V paste
detail: Drag screenshots, mockups or photos into the terminal or paste with Ctrl+V (also on macOS, not Cmd+V).

feature: Claude Code git workflows: commits, branches, PRs, PR review
detail: Handles conventional commit messages, branches and PR summaries, and can walk through a pasted PR URL diff.

feature: Claude Code background commands
detail: Builds, test suites and dev servers can run in the background while the conversation continues, when asked explicitly.

feature: Claude Code /plugin browse and install
detail: Skills are bundled as plugins; /plugin browses available ones and installs in one step.

feature: Claude Code shortcuts: Ctrl+C stop, / command list, Esc Esc rewind
detail: Ctrl+C stops a task mid-run, typing / lists all commands, Esc twice opens the rewind menu.

feature: Claude Code permission gating and optional OS sandbox
detail: Edits, shell commands and outside-directory access need approval; reads inside the working directory do not prompt; optional OS-level sandboxing for shell commands; talks directly to Anthropic API.

feature: No training on Claude Code data under Enterprise agreement
detail: Under the Enterprise plan Anthropic does not use code or prompts from Claude Code to train models.

feature: Design systems extracted from codebases, decks and brand assets
detail: Claude extracts colors, typography, components and layout patterns from uploaded assets and applies them to every new design and deck. Beta on Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise; on by default except Enterprise where an owner enables it in Organization settings > Artifacts.

feature: Create a design system from chat or via /design-sync in Claude Code
detail: Ask Claude in chat to build one from connected apps, files, Figma, decks, logos and fonts; or run /design-sync in Claude Code to read tokens and components from React code.

feature: Move team design systems from claude.ai/design into chat artifacts
detail: Design tab banner 'Move team design systems' turns each into an artifact usable in any chat or Claude Code; 'Let Claude clean it up' tidies guide, tokens, components. Org artifact retention can delete one nobody opens for the period.

feature: Manage design systems in Settings > Capabilities
detail: Manage link next to Design systems (or Settings > Design systems); Enterprise admins can reserve publishing, org default and deleting for specific users.

feature: Design system keyboard navigation
detail: Sections list opens beside the section; Return enters it, Cmd/Ctrl+F6 switches between list and section, Cmd/Ctrl+Z undoes outside text boxes. Live component previews are not reachable by Tab.

feature: Standalone Claude Design at claude.ai/design: org design system with Published toggle
detail: Switch/create organization, upload codebase, prototypes, decks or single assets; review palette, typography, components, layouts; Published toggle makes org projects use it. Has its own separate admin setting.

feature: Update a design system via Open and Remix
detail: From org settings open the system and use Remix to chat with Claude to change it.

feature: Claude Design admin: separate toggles for in-chat Design and standalone claude.ai/design
detail: In-chat Design template is set under Artifacts admin; standalone is Organization settings > Claude Design > Enable toggle. Default on for Team; Enterprise on by default from Oct 15, 2026. Standalone design closes Dec 14, 2026.

feature: Custom roles with Design capability to phase standalone Claude Design access
detail: Enterprise can gate standalone Claude Design with custom roles using the Design capability under Artifacts; also restrict who publishes design systems, sets org default and deletes them.

feature: Multiple design systems per organization
detail: An org can hold several design systems for different brands or sub-teams; projects inherit the published one automatically.

feature: Claude Slides: on-brand decks exported to PowerPoint or PDF
detail: Presentations moved from Claude Design to a separate Claude Slides tool built from notes, reports or a conversation; has its own setting under Organization settings > Artifacts.

feature: Claude Design: prototypes, mockups, microsites and landing pages
detail: Describe a UI and get an interactive prototype, one-pager, microsite or landing page on a canvas beside the chat.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Design preview sandbox isolation and signed tokens
detail: Previews run in sandboxed iframes on a separate Anthropic content domain; short-lived signed tokens are re-checked against sharing permissions on every open, so revoking access is immediate.

feature: Claude Design export: zip, PDF, PPTX, Google Slides, standalone HTML
detail: Export button offers these formats plus handoff to Claude Code (local agent or Claude Code Web) and send-to partner tools such as Canva, Gamma, HubSpot, Miro, Netlify, Vercel, v0, Lovable, Replit, Wix, Base44, Adobe products.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Claude Design as an artifact template in chat, Artifacts tab, Claude Code and mobile
detail: Ask in chat, pick Output > Design, use the Artifacts tab Design template, run /design in Claude Code, or request a design in the mobile app and view it full screen later in the Artifacts tab.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: /design-sync and /design in Claude Code
detail: /design-sync pulls a design system from GitHub, files or local code so designs use real components; /design imports a design into the codebase, exports code as live prototype or builds end to end.

feature: Claude Design refinement: chat, inline comments, direct canvas edit
detail: Chat for broad changes, click-to-comment for targeted fixes, canvas drag/resize/align for visual tweaks; Claude can offer 2-3 variations and review accessibility. Comments may intermittently vanish; paste into chat as workaround.

feature: Claude Design context attachments: screenshots, decks, repositories
detail: Attach screenshots, images, existing decks/docs or link a code repo at any time so output matches existing styling.

feature: Claude Design editor keyboard navigation and screen reader announcements
detail: F6/Shift+F6 (or Cmd/Ctrl+F6) move between top bar, canvas and properties panel; Tab, Space, Return, Escape navigate artboards and layers; arrow keys move artboards 1px or 10px with Shift; Alt+arrow moves layers; screen readers hear position and move confirmations.

feature: Claude Design editor shortcuts: duplicate, group, flip, zoom, guides
detail: Cmd/Ctrl+D duplicate, +G group, +Shift+G ungroup, Shift+H/V flip, +A select all, +Z/+Shift+Z undo/redo, zoom +/-/0, Shift+G toggles layout guides, Cmd/Ctrl+\ toggles properties panel.

feature: Claude Design color picker contrast feedback
detail: When choosing a text color the picker tells whether contrast against the background is good or poor.

feature: Claude Design save a direction and try another
detail: Ask Claude to save the current work and try a different approach; there is no version history yet.

feature: Claude Design sharing: private by default, view, comment or edit
detail: Share button sets who can open and their permission; sharing settings cannot be changed in iOS/Android apps; simultaneous multi-person editing is basic and unreliable.

feature: Claude Design uses shared plan usage limits
detail: No separate Design allowance anymore; draws from the same pool as chat and Claude Code, unavailable at limit unless usage credits are enabled.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Claude Design known limitations
detail: Keyboard cannot place new layers/artboards; large repos may lag so link from Claude Code; 'chat upstream error' fixed by new chat tab; layer-list delete acts on canvas selection.

feature: Standalone claude.ai/design retirement Dec 14, 2026
detail: Standalone Claude Design shuts down; projects and design systems should be moved to Claude, rolling out gradually to paid plans.

feature: Cyber Verification Program (CVP) with three access tiers
detail: Verified security professionals get fewer cyber-safeguard interruptions on Mythos, Opus and Sonnet models. Tiers: Defense Access, Red Team Access, Specialized Access. Not on Free plan.

feature: CVP Defense Access tier eligibility and limits
detail: Security operations, incident response, malware analysis, triage; individuals and organizations on Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise or API; no default user cap; individual access covers only you.

feature: CVP Red Team Access tier (offensive testing, up to 75 users)
detail: Authorized pen testing, red teaming, exploit development; organizations only on Enterprise or API; max 75 approved users; reviews target two weeks.

feature: CVP Specialized Access tier (critical infrastructure, up to 25 users)
detail: For authorized high-risk testing of systemically important systems; organizations only on Enterprise or API; max 25 users; reviewed in depth with the US government, no set time target.

feature: CVP security attestations and prohibited activities
detail: Defense needs MFA and 7-day key rotation, requiring phishing-resistant MFA and no long-lived keys from Dec 15, 2026; higher tiers add company-domain accounts, managed devices, outbound controls, background checks. Mass destruction, DoS, extortion, election interference always banned.

feature: CVP data retention requirement
detail: Retention is required for all enrolled users; orgs with a Fable/Mythos retention exemption can use CVP with zero data retention for internal use.

feature: CVP internal vs external use approval
detail: Default approval covers internal security work only; client work needs a separate application for a managed service or a constrained Defense product; unconstrained products not yet available.

feature: CVP application via Verification Portal with identity verification
detail: Owner or Primary Owner applies once per org; individuals use government photo ID and selfie, orgs give legal name and registration; reapply after 7 days if rejected; applications cannot be edited or withdrawn after submitting.

feature: Turn on CVP: automatic on Pro/Max/Ultra/Team, custom role grant on Enterprise
detail: Team access applies to every user and cannot be split; Enterprise owners add the grant under Organization settings > Roles > custom role > Models tab; built-in roles are not covered.

feature: Mythos model usage limits by plan
detail: Pro can use Mythos only with usage credits; Max and Ultra share up to 50% of weekly limit between Mythos and Fable models, after which credits or another model are needed.

feature: Domain claiming: discover and claim personal accounts on a verified domain
detail: Enterprise admins can list personal Free/Pro/Max/Ultra accounts on their domain (email, plan, created, last active; CSV export) and claim them. Team plans can only verify a domain and block new personal accounts.

feature: Domain capture prerequisites and one-way toggle
detail: Requires restricted org creation, DNS verification, enforced SSO and JIT or SCIM; toggle 'Migrate accounts using your domain' under Organization settings > Organization and access > Security cannot be reversed. SCIM wins over JIT if both active.

feature: 30-day migration window with bring-what-you-can or start-fresh
detail: Single deadline per claim; users keep chats, projects, files and memory (needs a seat) or start fresh; unmigrated accounts close and data is deleted; only one claim at a time; no custom deadline; HIPAA/CMEK orgs allow start fresh only.

feature: Personal subscriptions cancelled with prorated refund on domain claim
detail: Direct Pro/Max/Ultra plans auto-cancel with refund and credits refunded; Google Play cancellation requested; Apple App Store subscribers must cancel themselves in Apple ID settings.

feature: Domain-claim banner 'Choose what happens to your personal data'
detail: Email plus in-product banner on web and desktop with 'See options'; deadline at least 30 days out.

feature: What does not move when migrating a personal account
detail: Custom skills, Claude Docs, cloud Cowork tasks and connected apps stay in the personal account and are deleted; original uploaded files are not in exports.

feature: Post-claim data download link
detail: If no choice is made or Start fresh is chosen, an emailed download link works for 24 hours, likely once, only when signed in with same email; Claude for Teachers and FERPA accounts must export beforehand.

feature: Sign in via SSO after migration; signed out everywhere
