detail: After a move users sign in at claude.ai with work email via SSO and are signed out on all devices; personal and Enterprise accounts cannot coexist on a claimed domain; separate personal-email accounts unaffected.

feature: Claude Security: codebase vulnerability scanning with deep baseline scan
detail: Beta for Enterprise. Create a project with up to eight repos (GitHub, GitHub Enterprise Server, or other Git with token); Claude writes a threat model and scans across files and repos; folder scope for monorepos; repos can be scan-scope or context-only.

feature: Claude Security continuous scanning on new commits
detail: Scans changes on a risk-based cadence (no fixed schedule), choosing full or incremental scope visible in the Activity tab; pause/resume scans from project menu; scans are stochastic.

feature: Claude Security threat model and project chat
detail: Resources tab holds editable threat model and architecture docs that drive what is flagged and its severity; project chat lets users correct the model; model for chat chosen from org-allowed list; scans use a Mythos model.

feature: Claude Security findings with severity and structure
detail: Findings rated Critical/High/Medium/Low against the threat model, with category/CWE, location, evidence, attack path, fix guidance, history and resolution (fixed, dismissed as false positive, accepted risk, duplicate, other) with triage note and assignee.

feature: Claude Security Fix button opens Claude Code and fix tracking
detail: Fix launches Claude Code (or gives a prompt to paste); later scans auto-mark findings fixed and reopen them if still unresolved; findings can be manually marked fixed or dismissed and reopened.

feature: Claude Security API, connector (MCP) and webhooks
detail: Personal access token API to list/read/resolve findings and manage projects; MCP connector for Claude and Claude Code; webhooks (Slack, Jira etc.) for new findings with signing secret rotation and Standard Webhooks.

feature: Claude Security access: Full, Triage, View roles and RBAC capabilities
detail: Project sharing with Full/Triage/View or whole org; custom roles need both Claude Security and Claude Code capabilities (not covered by 'All generally available'); admins choose who creates and views/triages/manages all projects.

feature: Claude Security billed at token cost with spend limit and launch credits
detail: No platform fee; separate spend limit and per-project usage view; seat-based Enterprise needs Claude Code seat and usage credits on; launch offer up to $25,000/month credits for two months through Dec 31, 2026.

feature: Claude Security not available with ZDR or CMEK
detail: No zero data retention support; enabling customer-managed keys turns Claude Security off. Claude Code plugin alternative exists for ZDR or third-party model access.

feature: Earlier Claude Security version retired Nov 25, 2026; project move
detail: Existing projects auto-move to new experience with findings copied and original archived; scan history, schedules and PR links are not copied; moved projects may start charged continuous monitoring; 'Move your projects' button; irreversible.

feature: Claude Security plugin for Claude Code
detail: Separate plugin using same scanner technology without Anthropic-hosted agent infrastructure; supports ZDR and third-party model providers; uses models in the user's Claude Code account.

feature: Live artifacts (Cowork artifacts made before Aug 19, 2026)
detail: Older Cowork artifacts keep working and sharing but cannot be edited in place; republish via Share as a new artifact (existing link shows new version). CMEK, ZDR and HIPAA-ready orgs keep live artifacts. Marked with a Cowork label in the Artifacts view.

feature: Live artifact sharing stays within the organization and uses viewer's access
detail: No external or public links or per-person selection; anyone in the org with the link opens it, and it connects to the viewer's own connectors so inaccessible sources show errors.

feature: Chat and Cowork unified into one Claude experience
detail: New experience combining chat and Cowork rolling out to Pro, Max, Ultra; Team and Enterprise where 'Chat and Cowork unified' is on; the message box no longer shows separate Chat/Cowork options.

feature: claude:// deep links open Claude Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux)
detail: URL scheme launches the app if closed and navigates to a new chat (with prefilled q up to ~14,000 chars), an existing chat or project by ID.

feature: Deep links for Claude Code and Cowork sessions with folder and file params
detail: claude://code/new and claude://cowork/new prefill the composer with q, and folder (confirmation dialog always shown) and file params; Cowork accepts repeated folder/file; Code accepts only first folder.

feature: claude:// and universal links open Claude Code sessions in mobile apps
detail: claude://code opens Code tab or session by ID; code/new accepts q, mode (plan or code), repo (owner/name from connected GitHub) and branch; https://claude.ai/code links work as universal links. Requires Claude Code access.

feature: Analytics chat: ask plain-language questions about org usage
detail: Analytics > Analytics Chat tab returns charts, tables or stat cards plus summary for adoption, spend, seats, groups, Claude Code/Cowork, connectors and skills; follow-ups keep context; defaults last 30 days.

feature: Analytics chat limits and export
detail: Data refreshes daily (1-2 day lag), user lists capped at 20, queries up to two minutes, no web search, file uploads or connectors, current org only; charts downloadable by hover and click.

feature: Claude proactively suggests connected apps
detail: When context fits (e.g. AllTrails, Instacart), Claude brings up a connected app unprompted, using memory for relevance; shows multiple matching apps for the user to choose; mobile app installation is beta.

feature: Confirmation before connected apps book or buy; no paid placements
detail: Claude checks details before any booking or purchase; no sponsored ranking or ads in app suggestions; app data is not used for training.

feature: Toggle a connector off per conversation or disconnect entirely
detail: Use + > Connectors toggle for one chat, or Customize > Connectors to disconnect an app immediately.

feature: Console organization discovery and join
detail: Business-email Console sign-ups see discoverable orgs and can join; admin sets domain Discoverable toggle and New member approval (automatic or admin approval); personal and .edu domains cannot be added; unavailable with SSO.

feature: Agent SDK and claude -p draw from subscription limits; monthly API credits on Max, Ultra, Team
detail: Signed in with a plan, SDK and claude -p use subscription limits; Max, Ultra and Team also get monthly API credits usable with a linked Console API key for API, Managed Agents, Agent SDK and claude -p.

feature: Enterprise per-seat usage-based pricing with shared pool and surface token intensity
detail: Org consumption pool is shared; Claude Code and Cowork consume far more tokens than chat; M365 add-ins, Design, Chrome and Claude Tag appear as separate products in analytics and spend export.

feature: Enterprise spend limits at org, group, user and seat-type level
detail: Org ceiling, per-user group limits, individual overrides always win, multi-group setting picks higher or lower, no limit anywhere means unlimited; set under Organization settings > Usage > By group/tier in dollars or Unlimited.

feature: Pooled group budgets with alerts
detail: A group shares one monthly amount; members also keep individual limits; largest pool used first or custom priority; billing admins alerted at 50/75/95/100%; not in Admin API yet; Billing role can edit all pools.

feature: RBAC groups and custom roles gate surfaces like Claude Code
detail: Groups manually created or synced from IdP; role grants only apply to members on Custom role (built-in User keeps everything); group owners can get Analytics view role.

feature: Org default model: Anthropic recommended or admin chosen
detail: Recommended default is Sonnet in chat/unified experience and Opus in Claude Code and Cowork; applies to chat, Cowork, Claude Code CLI 2.1.199+, and Claude for Microsoft 365; managed settings pin wins for CLI and IDE.

feature: Sticky model picker and 'Always start with default model and effort' switch
detail: By default new chats start on the member's last model; admin switch under Organization settings > Models (also per role) forces org default model and effort; sticky model upgrades with launches.

feature: Model access and effort caps per organization and custom role
detail: Models enabled org-wide as ceiling; roles grant subsets additively; per-model max effort caps and role default effort; unsupported in Claude in Chrome and Claude Security; older Claude Code CLI shows but rejects restricted options.

feature: Model lineup guidance: Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku and effort levels
detail: Fable for hardest very-high-token work, Opus for complex multi-step, Sonnet for everyday, Haiku for lightweight; effort level shown by model name, higher effort uses more tokens.

feature: Organization instructions injected into every conversation
detail: Admins set standing guidance applied across org conversations, e.g. confirm before token-heavy artifacts, link internal docs, reinforce model norms.

feature: Analytics dashboard, spend CSV export and per-skill ROI
detail: claude.ai/analytics shows WAU, seat utilization, top connectors, spend MTD/QTD/YTD, by model, top-10 users; per-surface views; Skills view with users/cost per use; spend report export for MTD, last month, 90 days or custom.

feature: Spend by project tags (beta)
detail: Eligible orgs add project tags such as WBS or client-matter codes to see spend by tag in Organization settings > Usage; works only inside projects; tag names visible to all.

feature: Analytics API, per-user skill/plugin/connector usage and Admin API
detail: read:analytics key from Organization settings > API; requests max 31 days, data from Jan 1 2026; group by user, RBAC group, model, region, tier; Admin API reads and sets per-user limits and user-management endpoints (beta).

feature: Spend-threshold alerts at 75% and 90% of org limit
detail: Admins are alerted as the org-level cap is approached; users get in-product notices near their own limit.

feature: In-product surveys from Analytics
detail: Admins send short surveys to groups in Cowork or chat between tasks; response rate, charts, written feed, CSV with respondent emails; not anonymous; not available with CMEK; no PHI.

feature: Time at limit view and smart reports
detail: Usage page charts how often members hit limits with forecast; smart reports sample transcripts scoped to team/date/products to show cost per output type, frictions, recommended skills and costly sessions.

feature: Hitting a spend cap: Request more usage, resets 00:00 UTC on the 1st
detail: Users notified near limit; in-flight request finishes then blocked; 'Request more usage' sends admin an increase request; limits reset monthly at 00:00 UTC on the 1st.

feature: Claude Tag spend limit and per-channel limits
detail: Channel work bills to the org usage balance, not seats, so user/group caps do not apply; configure at admin usage settings; DMs bill to the sender's seat.

feature: Claude Compliance API data scope for Enterprise
detail: Exposes chats, uploaded files, projects, Cowork and Claude Code session content (tool calls, skills, artifacts as text), M365 add-in and Claude Science sessions (beta), and activity feed of logins, admin actions and config changes.

feature: Compliance API for Claude Platform (activity events only)
detail: Platform customers get admin, system and resource events but no prompt or response content; contact sales to enable.

feature: Enable Compliance API: Primary Owner toggle and key creation
detail: Only Primary Owner can turn it on in Organization settings > API and create keys covering all linked orgs; Owners create keys for their own org; Admins see nothing; parent org controls linked orgs.

feature: Third-party Compliance API integrations (DLP, SIEM, eDiscovery, archive, posture)
detail: Long catalog of vendors (e.g. Microsoft Purview, CrowdStrike, Netskope, Cloudflare, Zscaler, Datadog, Elastic, Cribl, Global Relay, Okta, Wiz) that ingest Claude activity; some in beta or private preview with GA dates planned late 2026 to Jan 2027.

feature: Age assurance: 18+ only with verification via Yoti or Persona
detail: Confirm 18+ at signup; accounts with minor signals are disabled and reinstated after verification by facial age estimation, ID photo, or Yoti Digital ID app; providers delete images/biometrics, Anthropic keeps only the result and method.

feature: Support contacts: human support routing for Enterprise
detail: Owners configure which groups reach human support; others get AI support; 'Always include Admins and Owners' checkbox on by default; set under Organization settings > Organization and access; effective June 8, 2026.

feature: Microsoft 365 connector: Outlook, Calendar, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams
detail: Search and analyze mail, events, files, SharePoint and Teams with a work or school account; one Microsoft account at a time; available on all plans; connect via Customize > Connectors; works on mobile once connected.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Microsoft 365 write tools: email, calendar, files, Teams messages
detail: If admin enables, Claude drafts/sends mail, manages inbox rules and auto-replies, edits calendar events, creates/updates OneDrive and SharePoint files, and posts Teams messages; sent mail carries an agent-initiated header; no attachments; per-user limits.

feature: M365 confirmation prompts and Always allow rules
detail: Claude asks before sending or changing; Always allow possible per tool (admin-dependent on Team/Enterprise, new rules from Nov 9 and Dec 9, 2026; not for HIPAA orgs); Automatically approve mode and scheduled tasks can skip asking.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Personal Microsoft account connector (Outlook.com, OneDrive)
detail: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra can connect personal accounts without admin: Outlook mail/calendar and OneDrive with write tools on by default; no SharePoint, Teams, shared mailboxes, inbox rules or auto-replies; deleted files go to recycle bin.

feature: M365 supported file types and gaps
detail: Reads Word, Excel, PowerPoint (incl. legacy), PDF and text formats (txt, md, csv, tsv, json, xml, html, log); OneNote unsupported; Sites.Selected scoping not supported; shared mailboxes searchable; Online Archive mailbox not searched.

feature: Per-tool permissions and per-chat toggle for M365
detail: Toggle individual tools under Tool permissions in connector settings, or switch the connector on/off per chat from + > Connectors; disconnect from Customize > Connectors.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Organization default model and default effort (Organization settings > Models)
detail: Choose Anthropic recommended (auto-updating) or a specific model plus default effort; applies to new chats in chat, Cowork, Claude Code, Office, Design, Science; only models enabled under Model access selectable; managed by Primary Owner, Owner or Identity & Access role.

feature: Custom role default model and effort; most capable wins for multiple roles
detail: A role's default model overrides the org default for Custom-role members; with several roles the most capable family then newest model applies; role effort cap cannot exceed org cap.

feature: Always-start-on-default setting and projects behavior
detail: New projects start on the default; existing chat projects keep the model last picked in that project; new Cowork tasks in a project start on default.

feature: Claude Code managed-settings model overrides org default
detail: managed-settings.json model setting wins for local terminal and IDE sessions but not cloud sessions or Claude Code in Desktop; CLI versions before 2.1.199 ignore the org default; availableModels may be bypassed unless enforced.

feature: Fable models safeguards with fallback to Opus
detail: Fable 5/5.1/5.2 are Mythos-class; classifiers check every request incl. memory, connectors, search and files; offensive cyber falls back to Opus 4.8, biology/chemistry/frontier-LLM requests fall back to Opus 5; reasoning-extraction attempts blocked with no fallback.

feature: Automatic model switching notice and picker behavior
detail: On fallback Claude reruns the request on Opus in the same conversation, labels the answering model, keeps the picker on Opus afterward; switching back may trigger fallback again unless the message is edited.

feature: Switch models when a message is flagged toggle
detail: Settings > Capabilities (or Config > MODEL & OUTPUT in Claude Code); off means a blocked request pauses so you can edit/retry or manually pick another model.

feature: Billing of blocked and fallback Fable requests
detail: Pre-output blocks in biology, distillation and frontier-LLM categories are billed; other pre-output blocks free; midstream blocks charge streamed tokens; fallback Opus response billed separately with a cache-miss credit.

feature: Enterprise Admin API: spend limits endpoints (public beta)
detail: Read effective per-member limit, source (seat tier, group, org) and period-to-date spend; set or remove per-user override; amounts in minor units, null unlimited, 0 disables credits; monthly period only; 60 req/min; needs usage credits and Primary Owner key with read/write:spend_limits.

feature: Spend limit increase request queue (approve or deny via API)
detail: Members request more usage in claude.ai; admins list, approve with an amount or deny, optionally suppressing the email; denied members lose the request button for 30 days; one pending request per member.

feature: Restrict verified-domain connectors to your Enterprise
detail: Setting under Organization settings > Organization and access blocks personal Claude accounts from connecting 21 services (Gmail, Slack, Google Drive, Microsoft 365, Notion, Figma, etc.) with a verified-domain email; applies only to new connections and the parent org's children; fails open when the service shares no identity.

feature: US-only inference for Enterprise
detail: Toggle at Organization settings > Data and privacy keeps all model processing (including titles and memory) in the US across all apps; billed 1.1x API rates on newer models; inference only, not connectors or storage; usage-based Enterprise only.

feature: Fable models by plan: included up to 50% weekly on Max/Ultra/premium seats, credits on Pro/standard
detail: Max, Ultra and premium Team/Enterprise seats can spend up to half of weekly limit on Fable then use credits or switch; Pro and standard seats use pay-as-you-go credits; usage-based Enterprise billed at API rates; not on Free.

feature: Fable availability gates: Claude Code versions and Enterprise enablement
detail: Claude Code needs 2.1.321+ for Fable 5.2, 2.1.255+ for 5.1, 2.1.170+ for 5; Cowork needs latest Desktop; Enterprise Fable 5.2 off until admin enables, auto-added to roles after seven days unless opted out.

feature: Fable 5 weekly-limit promotion ended July 19, 2026
detail: Earlier promo that let Fable 5 use up to 50% of weekly limits free on Pro/Team ended; some got a one-time credit; extra Fable launch offers exist for Fable 5.2.

feature: Covered Models: 30-day minimum retention and no ZDR
detail: Fable 5/5.1/5.2 and limited-access Mythos 5/5.1/5.2 are Covered Models; prompts and completions kept at least 30 days with automated safety review; zero data retention unavailable except transitional ZDR for eligible orgs ahead of Enterprise Frontier Safeguards.

feature: Consumer plans already retain data; Covered Models retention effective June 9, 2026
detail: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra on web/desktop/mobile/Claude Code are unaffected; policy hits ZDR orgs; 30-day retention with no default human access, tamper-proof access logs, auto-delete after 30 days, optional CMEK and access-transparency logs.

feature: Covered Models under HIPAA BAA: eligible configurations
detail: Covered Models accessible under BAA via HIPAA-ready API, Enterprise chat, and Claude Code/Cowork local mode with the HIPAA configuration (without ZDR); ZDR orgs cannot use Covered Models; BAA does not cover third-party clouds or Cowork in the cloud.

feature: Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK)
detail: Eligible Enterprise and Platform orgs provision a key in AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS or Azure Key Vault so Anthropic encrypts chats, projects and files with it; operations logged in the customer's cloud audit logs; optional.

feature: Claude Cowork on desktop, web, mobile and Chrome side panel
detail: Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux, beta) on all paid plans; web and mobile on Pro, Max, Ultra, Team (beta) and Enterprise when enabled; Chrome side panel on all paid plans and starts a Cowork session directly.

feature: Cowork in the cloud: background work, scheduled tasks with no device online
detail: Work runs on Anthropic servers so it continues when the laptop closes; same sessions and files across devices; from Oct 6, 2026 new Pro/Max/Ultra tasks always run in the cloud and 'Only on your computer' option was removed.

feature: Move a Cowork task to local Claude Code via Download task data and /port-task-data
detail: Download task data from a task, open the folder in Claude Code and run /port-task-data; 'Export your Cowork data' on desktop home keeps a copy of everything; tasks started locally before Oct 6 stay local with a banner.

feature: Cowork surface matrix: local files, browser use and computer use need Desktop app open
detail: Start/steer/resume, connectors, skills, plugins, previews, scheduled tasks, projects on all; local file access, browser use, computer use and local MCP connectors reach your machine only via Desktop while open; computer use on Pro/Max/Ultra, beta on Team/Enterprise.

feature: Turn off Memory per Cowork task via + menu
detail: Disable Memory in the + menu before starting so the task neither uses nor adds to memory.

feature: Phone notification when Cowork task finishes or needs input
detail: Cloud sessions can be started on one surface and resumed on another; a phone notification arrives on completion or a question.

feature: Cowork built-in browser in Desktop or your own Chrome via Claude in Chrome
detail: Desktop uses an embedded browser by default or Chrome extension if preferred; the built-in browser is reachable from web/mobile when Desktop is online.

feature: Enterprise-managed auth for connectors: IdP-managed (GA) and Claude-issued (beta)
detail: Authorize a connector once for the org so members get it automatically at first login; IdP-managed uses SSO (Okta supported), Claude-issued uses an org issuer URL and email matching with no IdP needed.

feature: Per-role managed authorization, scopes and pilot rollout for connectors
detail: Setup under Organization settings > Connectors: choose identity source, which built-in or custom roles get it, and which scopes; role's Connectors tab sets individual vs managed vs per-connector; browser sign-in can stay on as fallback.

feature: Connectors supporting managed auth (Slack, Notion, Atlassian, HubSpot, Figma, Datadog, etc.)
detail: About 21 connectors provision via enterprise-managed auth; Claude-issued beta covers 14 of them; personal connectors can still be added by individuals; any MCP provider can add support.

feature: Consumer products 18+ only; no photorealistic image or video output
detail: First-party consumer services are restricted to adults; Claude does not generate photorealistic image or video; developers on the API must follow child-safety obligations.

feature: Claude Tag: tag @Claude in Slack channels to do work (beta)
detail: Replaces Claude in Slack since Aug 3, 2026; Claude works under its own identity, remembers channel context, schedules follow-ups and checks in proactively; visible to all channel members who can steer it.

feature: Claude Tag surfaces: channel tagging, DM and AI assistant panel
detail: DMs and the right-side assistant panel use the user's own Claude capabilities and billing; channel tags use org identity, admin-set tools and org billing.

feature: Claude Tag member access modes and role capability
detail: Organization settings > Claude Tag: open to whole Slack workspace, any Claude org member, or role-based (Enterprise, 'Claude Tag in Slack' capability on a custom role); only Primary Owner or Owner sets access and channels.

feature: Claude Tag spend limits: org cap, per-channel limits, alerts at 75% and 95%
detail: Consumption-based hard org cap plus per-channel limits with defaults for new channels; over-limit work is declined and users can ask admins for more from Slack; per-channel analytics.

feature: Claude Tag access tiers, guest channel setting and memory/activity review
detail: Credentials and repos at org, workspace and private-channel levels; guest channels set to Restrict, Channel only or Allow; owners view/edit/delete per-channel memory and an Activity page of tasks and calls; Slack chats separate from Claude history and deleted within 30 days on uninstall.

feature: Monthly recap (Reflect) in Settings > Wellbeing
detail: Beta recap of the past month with headline summary, most active day, peak hour, total chats, daily chart, topic breakdown and AI-fluency skill cards (delegation, description, discernment, diligence); ranges: this month, 3, 6 months, year; refresh icon.

feature: Recap requires memory and skips sensitive conversations
detail: Shown only when memory is on; excludes incognito chats, health-integration chats, Personal Finance linked-account chats and local-only Code/Cowork sessions; sensitive topics never lead or get counts; off by turning off Generate memory from chat history; not on Team/Enterprise or mobile page; generated only when opened and free of usage.

feature: Break reminders and quiet hours (Settings > Wellbeing)
detail: Optional beta nudge after a chosen daily time with Claude (stop, snooze or dismiss) and quiet hours by weekday with start/end times and a Continue option; neither is a hard lock; apply across web, desktop and mobile.

feature: Org and role model access toggles; Haiku always available
detail: Organization settings > Models enables or disables each model for everyone; roles grant subsets; Haiku cannot be disabled; additive across roles; disabled model in an open chat falls back to default.

feature: Effort level caps per model at org and role level
detail: Max effort per model capped org-wide and per role (highest cap wins across roles); menu hides higher levels; enforced across chat, Cowork, Claude Code 2.1.199+, M365, Tag, Design; not yet in Claude in Chrome or Claude Security.

feature: Commercial no-training default and configurable Enterprise retention
detail: Team, Enterprise, Platform and API content is not used for training by default; Enterprise owners can set an org-wide retention period; frontier models keep 30-day governed retention; human review only for flagged content with tamper-proof logs viewable with Access Transparency.

feature: In-tenancy options via AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud Vertex AI
detail: Claude models available in customer's own cloud environment for data-residency policy, though safety monitoring is not switched off by that alone.

feature: Claude Code screen reader mode (--ax-screen-reader)
detail: Needs v2.1.181+; enable with the flag, CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER=1 or axScreenReader in settings.json; labeled you:/claude:/tool: lines, numbered menus, no spinners or box drawing, terminal bell on reply/permission/tool finish. CLAUDE_CODE_ACCESSIBILITY=1 only keeps cursor visible.

feature: Claude for Teachers: free Pro-level access for verified US K-12 educators
detail: Free through July 30, 2028 for individuals (school email) or school/district Enterprise orgs via SSO; includes Pro features, Claude Code and Cowork, Learning Commons standards connector, teaching skills, MagicSchool/TeachFX/Canva for Education connectors; not for students.

feature: Claude for Teachers K-12 data terms, FERPA configuration and admin deletion
detail: No training on inputs/outputs; educator is controller, Anthropic processor; no student data sale; FERPA-configured setting; district admins read or delete member data via the Compliance API; AES-256, TLS 1.2+, SOC 2; data returned and deleted in 30 days on exit.

feature: Teachers plan limits and disabled Team features
detail: Higher limits than Free with rolling five-hour and weekly caps; individual accounts hide billing, seats, invites, roles, SSO/domain capture and premium seats.

feature: Skill and plugin security scanning with pass, warn, fail
detail: Enterprise automatically scans third-party skills, plugin skills, hooks and your own saved skills on upload/edit in about 1-2 minutes; warn shows an acknowledge banner, fail blocks; not for MCP servers, pre-existing items, or CMEK/ZDR/HIPAA orgs.

feature: Scanning policy toggle, role capability and Allow anyway override
detail: Owners enable under Organization settings > Plugins & skills > Policy; custom role capability narrows who is scanned; Owners or Libraries-manage roles can Allow anyway per version and Revoke; results in Inventory and Requests tabs.

feature: 1Password for Claude: sign-in during browser tasks without Claude seeing secrets
detail: Beta on paid plans using Claude Desktop on macOS with Claude in Chrome; Claude requests a login, user approves/swaps/denies with biometrics, 1Password fills it directly; supports logins and TOTP only, scoped per task.

feature: 1Password Agentic Mode locks the vault while an AI controls the browser
detail: On by default in the 1Password extension; hides its interface and exposes only logins approved for the current task.

feature: Enable 1Password for Claude per organization (off by default)
detail: Owner or Primary Owner turns on Enable for your team and Password managers under Organization settings > Claude in Chrome; users connect via banner, in-chat prompt or Settings > Connectors.

feature: Opus 5 and Opus 5.5 safeguards and fallbacks
detail: Cyber exploit/pen-test requests fall back to Opus 4.8; Opus 5.5 biology and frontier-LLM requests fall back to Opus 5; Opus 5 has no biology fallback; reasoning-extraction (distillation) attempts blocked outright; secure coding and health education stay allowed.

feature: Life Sciences Verification Program (LSVP)
detail: Verified life sciences organizations get Claude's most capable models for internal R&D despite biology safeguards; Opus 5.5 is not yet in the Cyber Verification Program, though Opus 5 with fewer cyber limits is.

feature: Send feedback on incorrectly blocked requests
detail: Users can report false-positive fallbacks via Send feedback to help refine classifiers.

feature: Inference hooks: org-hosted allow/deny check on every prompt and tool call
detail: Owners enable so every prompt, tool call and uploaded file text is sent to the customer's server for allow or deny before Claude proceeds; covers Claude, Claude Code, Cowork and other Enterprise products for DLP and transcript archival.

feature: Invisible text watermark on Claude output
detail: Supported Claude models embed an imperceptible watermark in generated text at model level; it survives copy-paste and some editing, on every first-party surface and cloud partners.

feature: Content Credentials (C2PA) on generated files
detail: Files Claude creates (e.g. PNG, JPEG) carry signed C2PA provenance metadata showing they were processed by Claude, where file generation is supported.

feature: Free Claude Content Checker
detail: A free tool to check whether a file carries a Claude-issued Content Credential.

feature: Watermark detection API (private preview)
detail: Text watermark detection is offered only to eligible organizations (regulators, media, researchers, some enterprises) via a request form; wider access planned.

feature: Marking limits: non-default sampling, short or edited text
detail: Marks may be missing on short passages, heavily edited or translated text, stripped metadata, and on older models when temperature/top_p/top_k are non-default; a mark is not proof of authorship.

feature: Claude for Teachers free for verified US K-12 educators
detail: Free through July 30, 2028 for individual verified teachers or whole districts; includes full Enterprise product, K-12 teaching plugin, Learning Commons connector with state standards; teachers only, not students.

feature: District Claude for Teachers organization setup
detail: Authorized admin applies at claude.ai/k12districts, accepts K-12 terms and DPA, is verified by Goodstack, then verifies the email domain via DNS TXT record; one open application per domain.

feature: K-12 org: SSO, JIT/SCIM, restrict organization creation
detail: Admins require SSO, enable just-in-time or SCIM provisioning, and restrict organization creation so district emails cannot make personal accounts; email invites turn off once auto-creation is on.

feature: Migrate existing teacher accounts into the district org
detail: Starting from 500 seats (more on request), Migrate accounts opens a 30-day window; each existing account on the domain chooses to bring what it can, start fresh, or do nothing (account then closes and is deleted). Export is under Data and privacy.

feature: Enterprise admin controls for K-12 org
detail: Roles, verified domains, SSO, SCIM, connector allowlist (none on by default), default model, org-wide instructions, usage tracking and Compliance API.

feature: Claude Science desktop research app
detail: Beta desktop app where Claude writes and runs code in a sandbox, reads granted folders, pulls from scientific databases via connectors, connects to your compute clusters, runs long analyses and saves versioned artifacts with provenance. macOS 13+, Windows 11 x64, Linux x64.

feature: Claude Science owner toggle
detail: On Team and Enterprise an Owner or Primary Owner must enable Claude Science in Organization settings; on by default for the Team plan for scientists.

feature: Built-in browser in Cowork side panel
detail: Cowork opens a browser in the side panel of Claude Desktop; Claude navigates, reads, clicks, types and fills forms while you watch, with the same capabilities as Claude in Chrome and no install. Desktop must be open and online; web/mobile tasks use it too.

feature: Import browser cookies into built-in browser
detail: On first open, import logins site by site from Chrome, Edge, Brave, Chromium, Firefox (macOS/Linux) or Firefox only (Windows); not Safari. Sites are all preselected, sensitive ones listed first; logins persist across Cowork sessions.

feature: Owner can disable cookie import and built-in browser
detail: Team/Enterprise owners can turn off cookie import or the built-in browser and Claude in Chrome for the organization.

feature: Preferred browser setting for Cowork
detail: Settings > Cowork > Preferred browser chooses Built-in browser or Chrome (Claude in Chrome); Chrome stays default if the extension is installed; Claude falls back to the other and says so, asking first if you named one.

feature: Browser safeguards: site permission, blocked sites, action checks
detail: Claude asks permission the first time on a site, blocks high-risk sites, and checks every action against the request; prompt injection risk remains and sensitive tasks (finance, medical) are discouraged.

feature: New unified chat and Cowork experience rollout
detail: Message box without separate Chat and Cowork options indicates the combined experience, rolling out to Pro, Max, Ultra; Team/Enterprise where Chat and Cowork unified is on.

feature: Invoices for Pro, Max, Ultra (web purchases)
detail: Invoice emailed per renewal (monthly or annual); viewable under Settings > Billing > Invoices. Mobile-app subscriptions are billed and receipted by Apple or Google instead.

feature: Mid-cycle upgrade resets billing cycle with proration
detail: Upgrading charges one full cycle of the new plan minus unused old-plan value immediately; excess value becomes account credit applied to future invoices.

feature: Usage credit receipts and auto-reload
detail: Usage credit purchases, including auto-reload and bundles, are billed separately with their own receipts.

feature: Invoice name, address and tax/VAT ID
detail: Name comes from the payment method; check 'Use a different name on invoices' in Settings > Billing; tax/VAT ID can be added; issued invoices cannot be edited, changes apply to future ones.

feature: Change subscription currency
detail: To switch currency, cancel at end of term and re-purchase, which uses the currency options offered to new subscribers in your region.

feature: Team invoices: renewal, seat change, credit notes
detail: Renewal invoices at cycle start for all seats; adding or upgrading seats mid-cycle bills prorated immediately; removing members gives no credit (reduce seat allocation before renewal); credit notes for partial refunds.

feature: Team owner invoice download and billing emails
detail: Owners open invoices in Organization settings > Billing > Invoices (opens Stripe, then Download invoice); billing email changes go through Support; projected total excludes tax.

feature: Team seat upgrade Standard to Premium prorated
detail: Upgrading a seat from Standard to Premium charges the prorated price difference immediately.

feature: Console invoices and Invoice history (API)
detail: Monthly usage invoices via Stripe or prepaid credit receipts; Admin or Billing role users download at platform billing page; invoices under $0.50 roll forward as applied balance; bank-transfer payments must match exactly.

feature: Claude Team plan for scientists (discounted)
detail: For verified academic and non-profit research groups: Standard seats free, Premium $15/user/month ($180 annual), 12 months, 1-25 seats, includes Claude Science, Code, Cowork, SSO; reviewed in about 7 business days.

feature: Team for scientists pooled API credits
detail: Monthly Claude API credits of $20 per Standard seat and $100 per Premium seat, pooled and capped at $500; Premium seats give 5x usage and higher limits for long analyses.

feature: Apply discounted pricing to existing Team plan
detail: After eligibility verification, apply at Settings > Account > Program verifications; annual plans switch to monthly with unused term as account credit; inactive groups (90 days) may return to standard pricing.

feature: AI for Science grant program
detail: Application-based grant program for ambitious research projects needing more capacity than a seat provides.

feature: Admin toggle: built-in browser
detail: Owners switch the built-in browser on or off in Organization settings > Capabilities; on by default for Team and Enterprise (off for HIPAA orgs until enabled); also governs the Claude Code browser, which then opens only local dev servers. Enterprise users are not notified.

feature: Admin toggle: import cookies from other browsers
detail: Separate switch under Built-in browser; on by default (off for HIPAA orgs); when off, import option disappears and the app refuses imports; earlier-imported cookies remain; changes take up to an hour and are logged in Compliance API.

feature: Admin toggle: Claude in Chrome with shared site allow/blocklists
detail: Managed in Organization settings > Claude in Chrome; site allowlists and blocklists apply to both the extension and the built-in browser; HIPAA orgs start with it off.

feature: HIPAA configuration disables built-in browser in local-mode Code and Cowork
detail: With the HIPAA configuration on Claude Code (local mode) and Cowork (local mode), the built-in browser is unavailable and no setting enables it.

feature: Browser safety-check screenshots may be retained
detail: Automated per-action safety checks can see the latest screenshot and Anthropic may keep a copy in its record of the check.

feature: Unified conversation: chat and Cowork merged
detail: One conversation with no mode choice; Claude decides what tools to use, from quick answers to research, reports, spreadsheets and decks. Cannot switch back once the account has it; existing tasks, projects, skills carry over.

feature: Hand off a whole task and run several at once
detail: Describe an outcome and Claude searches, reads files, runs code and assembles results; multiple tasks can run simultaneously.

feature: Tasks keep running in the cloud when you leave
detail: Longer tasks continue after closing the laptop or page; tasks using local files or apps require Claude Desktop open.

feature: Finished files: documents, spreadsheets with formulas, PowerPoint decks
detail: Claude returns editable documents, spreadsheets with working formulas and presentations that open in PowerPoint, downloadable and refinable.

feature: Claude Design, Slides and Docs from any conversation
detail: On paid plans ask for on-brand visuals/mockups (Design), presentations (Slides) or living team documents (Docs); edit directly or by instruction, then share by link or export.

feature: Custom visuals in chat
detail: Claude builds charts, diagrams and interactive visuals inline in the conversation.

feature: Connected apps used during tasks
detail: Google Drive, Gmail, Microsoft 365, Slack and other connectors are pulled in mid-task; connect under Customize > Connectors.

feature: Folder access in Claude Desktop
detail: Grant Claude a local folder to read, organize and create files; listed under Trusted folders, with a Storage folder in Settings; requires Desktop open.

feature: Browsing via built-in browser or Claude in Chrome
detail: Claude opens sites, reads, clicks and fills forms in either browser; works only while Desktop is open.

feature: Computer use in Cowork
detail: Claude clicks, types and navigates apps on your screen; on Pro, Max, Ultra now, Team and Enterprise in gradual beta once an owner enables it; delete-confirmation protection does not cover it.

feature: Scheduled recurring tasks (can run in cloud)
detail: Ask Claude to run a task on a schedule such as weekly inbox summaries; scheduled tasks can run in the cloud while your computer is off.

feature: Monitor and steer tasks from Claude Mobile
detail: Desktop-started tasks appear on mobile where you can see progress, answer Claude's questions and redirect; tasks can also start on the phone and run in the cloud.

feature: Skills and plugins in the unified experience
detail: Skills teach Claude your preferred steps; plugins bundle skills and connectors for a role.

feature: Permission mode: Auto vs Manual
detail: Message-box setting per conversation. Auto (default rolling out on Pro, Max, Ultra, Team) runs with automated safety checks; Manual (Enterprise default) asks before each action. Can stop or redirect at any time.

feature: Connector tool 'Always ask'
detail: A connector tool can be set so Claude asks before each use.

feature: Single Recents list for chats and tasks
detail: Quick questions and longer tasks share one conversation list; Cowork tasks sit with chats.

feature: Memory and Instructions for Claude carry into tasks
detail: Memory informs task work; global preferences are set in Settings > Your Claude (older layout Settings > Account); Cowork Global instructions merged there; local-only task memory stays with those tasks.

feature: Projects usable in every conversation
detail: Projects keep files, instructions and context together and apply in all conversations in the unified experience.

feature: Research via /deep-research or plus menu; no web search toggle
detail: Type /deep-research or choose Research under the plus button; Claude searches the web automatically when helpful, with no toggle.

feature: Usage in unified experience counts toward plan limits
detail: Agentic tasks use more than quick questions; usage may be measured slightly differently during rollout; see Settings > Usage.

feature: Unified experience limitations
detail: No Add from GitHub, no conversation branching from earlier points, incognito chats cannot create files or run code, search excludes old Cowork tasks.

feature: Dispatch closed to new users
detail: Dispatch (assign tasks from anywhere) remains for existing users but is unavailable to new ones.

feature: Public link to a chat snapshot
detail: Anyone with the link can view a view-only snapshot of the chat without a Claude account; later messages stay private unless the snapshot is updated; attachments are excluded.

feature: Public link turn-off and Shared chats list
detail: Disable from the Share menu (set to Private) or Settings > Privacy > Shared chats; the link dies immediately but cannot remove third-party copies.

feature: Shared chats carry noindex and unguessable URLs
detail: Shared pages ask search engines not to index them, there is no public directory, and links are long random strings; reposting or archiving by others is outside Anthropic's control.

feature: Public links exposing Personal Finance figures
detail: If Claude used linked finance accounts, viewers of a public link can see figures and any chart or artifact made.

feature: Public links unavailable on Team and Enterprise
detail: Team and Enterprise shared chats are visible only to signed-in people: org members and, if allowed, externally invited emails.

feature: Share a chat with specific people by email invite
detail: Share button lists people with access; invites go to specific emails, are view-only snapshots (artifacts included) and cannot be forwarded; limit on invites per day.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Shared chat visibility limits
detail: Recipients cannot reply, copy to their account or download files; they do not see post-share messages, attachments (except within an org) or raw connector/MCP data.

feature: Invite people without a Claude account
detail: Free sign-up with the invited email prefilled is enough to view; pending invites expire after 30 days and can be removed; a different sign-in email shows 'You need access'.

feature: Update shared chat snapshot
detail: 'Update shared chat' replaces the snapshot with current content for everyone with access.

feature: Remove a person or turn off sharing
detail: Remove individuals under People with access, or Turn off to kill the link for all; deleting the chat removes the snapshot.

feature: General access: anyone at your organization
detail: On Team/Enterprise choose 'Anyone at [org]' so signed-in members with the link can view, unless admin disables it.

feature: Admin sharing controls: Share chats, with everyone in org, externally
detail: Org settings > Data and privacy > Sharing: master toggle; org-wide sharing (default on); external sharing by email (default off, unavailable for HIPAA-ready or CMEK orgs; disabling revokes outside access permanently).

feature: Audit logs include chat sharing activity
detail: Enterprise admins can export audit logs that record sharing events.

feature: Sharing a chat not available in mobile app
detail: Creating shares is web only for now; shared chats can be opened on any device.

feature: Admin in-product surveys
detail: Admins create named surveys with start/end dates, audience (all members or groups), surface (chat, Cowork, Claude Code), editable questions, and can schedule or save drafts; not available for HIPAA organizations.

feature: Survey default questions and user card
detail: Default questions cover most valuable use, time effect, a tip to copy, and what would break without Claude; users see a short one-time card at a natural break, answering one question at a time, dismissal declines.

feature: Survey results, early close and CSV export
detail: Table shows status (Live, Scheduled, Closed), responses and rate; results show bar charts and written feed; survey can close early; CSV export includes time, email, group, surface and answers.

feature: Survey data handling and CMEK
detail: Responses go to org admins not Anthropic, follow retention setting and support customer-managed keys (data from about the first day after adding a key stays under Anthropic's key); no PHI in answers.

feature: Console programs and grants assigned per workspace
detail: After approval via the Verification Portal (e.g. Cyber Verification Program), admins attach a grant to a workspace at Organization settings > Programs; some programs reject the default workspace or have seat caps.

feature: Per-workspace 30-day retention for ZDR API orgs
detail: Admins can switch a non-default Console workspace to Standard 30-day retention so Covered Models work; not retroactive, excludes Batch, Files and Managed Agents sessions, blocked off if CMEK used.

feature: Smart reports: AI analysis of team Claude usage
detail: Enterprise admins generate reports covering a team, up to 28 days, chosen products (chat, Code, Cowork, unified) with workstreams, spend at list price, friction and skill candidates; interactive, downloadable as HTML; ~hours to generate with email notice.

feature: Smart reports: monthly limit of 10 and exclusions
detail: 10 reports per month free (queued and in-progress count, failures don't), resetting first of the month; off by default; unavailable with CMEK, HIPAA or hybrid deployment; excludes Claude Code under ZDR.

feature: Smart report sections
detail: Workstreams, deliverables, cost per output type, task outcomes, pain points, inefficiencies, complex autonomous work, new and self-automated work, most expensive sessions, custom answers, recommendations (skills, repo rules, raising spend limits).

feature: Smart report scoping by group, department, cost center
detail: Scope via RBAC groups or IdP groups; department and cost center can be passed through SCIM enterprise-extension attributes.

feature: Smart report custom insights and templates
detail: Per-session custom questions answered as Categories, Yes/No or Scale, with reusable saved templates and attached files for context.

feature: Smart report enable toggles and attribution
detail: Owners enable Smart reports under Organization settings > Capabilities > Analytics; optional 'Allow attribution to individual users' hides names by default and logs each reveal.

feature: Share, archive and delete smart reports
detail: Reports share by link with chosen org members (optionally attributed view, can pre-share while generating); delete requires Archive first then Delete.

feature: Smart report privacy guardrails on restricted topics
detail: Always on: no custom questions on protected characteristics, health, union, legal/harassment, politics/religion, personal life or sentiment about people; such sessions are aggregate-only with no summaries; not for individual performance review.

feature: Claude Docs living documents
detail: Ask for a doc in conversation, Claude asks clarifying questions, drafts in front of you and leaves explanatory comments; rich text with headings, tables and multiple tabs; saved in the Artifacts tab; draws on files, memory, projects, skills and connectors.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Create a doc via /docs, Output menu or template gallery
detail: Start with /docs, Output > Docs in the message box, or pick a Docs template in the Artifacts tab; in Claude Code the doc opens in the side panel on desktop or as a web link in the terminal.

feature: Edit docs directly, by chat, or by @Claude comments
detail: Nothing locks while Claude works; edits autosave; mention @Claude in a comment to get an edit and explanation; Claude leaves its own comments and a 'Send to Claude' checkbox appears in comment box.

feature: Charts, diagrams and timelines in docs
detail: Claude builds charts from connected app data inside the doc; they do not refresh automatically, ask Claude to pull latest data.

feature: Real-time multi-user doc editing with Claude
detail: Editors work simultaneously with Claude and each other; Claude acts with the requester's permissions and every change is attributed.

feature: Doc sharing and access levels
detail: Owner shares via Share: viewer, commenter, editor (editors can export); only owner renames or deletes; Team/Enterprise: people, groups, org-wide, external if owner allows; Free/Pro/Max/Ultra: anyone with link, plus email invites on Pro and above (Free cannot invite).

feature: Doc export to Word, PDF, Markdown, Google Docs
detail: Export menu offers .docx, .pdf, .md or Google Docs; can also convert a doc to a Claude Slides deck.

feature: Doc deletion is permanent
detail: Deleting a doc has no trash and removes access for everyone it was shared with.

feature: Claude Docs admin toggle
detail: Owners switch Docs under Organization settings > Artifacts; Enterprise default on from Oct 15, 2026 and can be limited to groups via custom roles.

feature: Docs keyboard access and shortcut list
detail: Cmd/Ctrl+/ or ? opens a shortcut list; Escape/Tab move in and out of text; Cmd/Ctrl+F6 reaches formatting toolbar; Cmd+Option+M (Ctrl+Alt+M) adds a comment; VoiceOver needs Chrome 153+ or Safari.

feature: Docs limitations
detail: Version history overlay not keyboard reachable on narrow panels, in-doc activity not logged to Compliance API yet, sharing settings cannot be changed in the mobile apps; mobile can view and edit docs.

feature: Delegated smart report access for team leads
detail: Owners (or custom role with Analytics plus Identity & Access) add custom-role people under Manage access with a scope of up to 50 groups, departments or cost centers each; auto-creates 'Smart Reports delegates' group and role.

feature: Delegate limits
detail: Delegates see only their own or shared reports, cannot run whole-org reports, rename/archive/delete, or manage access; their runs count toward the org's monthly limit; no notification when added.

feature: Claude sidebar in Google Docs, Sheets and Slides
detail: Beta Google Workspace add-on that reads the open file and edits it in place (draft, analyze, restructure, restyle); edits appear under your name in Google version history; one Marketplace install covers all three apps.

feature: Workspace sidebar: Sheets modeling, formulas and data cleanup
detail: In Sheets Claude builds models, writes and fixes formulas, normalizes data, adds sensitivity tables and charts; in Slides it creates and restyles slides; in Docs it rewrites and restructures long documents.

feature: Workspace sidebar mode: Ask before edits vs Accept all edits
detail: Ask before edits (default) shows planned actions and waits for Allow; Accept all edits applies ordinary content edits but still pauses for links, external images, web addresses and access changes; Docs can propose text changes as accept/reject cards.

feature: Workspace sidebar security review prompts and refused actions
detail: Inserting web images, adding links and removing access always need approval with no always-allow; Claude cannot share files, change ownership, create menus or scheduled automations, or load arbitrary web pages.

feature: Workspace sidebar extras: model picker, connectors, attachments, web search
detail: Pick a model; org connectors appear in the + menu; attach up to 20 files per message (30 MB per document, 10 MB per image); 'Search the web' toggle off by default; chat history stored per file in browser only.

feature: Install Claude for Google Workspace: self, admin, allowlist
detail: Install from Workspace Marketplace yourself, or a super admin installs for everyone or groups/OUs, or allowlists the app; uninstall in Google Admin console; Firefox not supported (Chrome, Edge, Safari).

feature: Workspace sidebar limitations
detail: Works only on Docs, Sheets, Slides files (not converted Office files), only the open file, ops capped near six minutes, no dictation, no comment/suggestion handling in Docs, Slides charts insert as images, Connected Sheets unreadable.

feature: Workspace sidebar enterprise controls
detail: Compliance API, CMEK and OpenTelemetry export supported on Enterprise; third-party inference, zero data retention and HIPAA-ready orgs not supported; Claude account or SSO sign-in required; content not used for training, deleted within 30 days.

feature: Salesforce in Claude plugin (37 sales skills)
detail: Salesforce-built plugin bundling 37 sales skills (renewal prep, QBR decks, pipeline coverage, meeting follow-up), Salesforce and Slack connectors, and a first-run setup skill that personalizes to role and book of business; chat and Cowork on web and desktop.

feature: Salesforce plugin admin setup and distribution
detail: Salesforce admin requests access via AgentExchange; Claude Owner sets Installed by default / Available to install / Required under Organization settings > Plugins and enters OAuth client ID and secret for the Salesforce (Beta) connector; members sign in with own accounts.

feature: Add Salesforce plugin and approve CRM writes
detail: Enable via Customize > Plugins; Claude proposes each Salesforce change for review with Allow once, Always allow or Deny, and sees only what the user's Salesforce permissions allow.

feature: Artifacts master toggle and prerequisite
detail: Owners enable Artifacts under Organization settings > Artifacts after turning on Cloud code execution and file creation; turning off blocks open/edit/download/share for everyone and disables shared links without deleting anything.

feature: Artifact templates: Slides, Design, Design systems, Docs, Data, Motion, Sheets,
detail: Admins enable per template; Slides export to PowerPoint, Design artboards, Data dashboards/videos with query provenance, Motion MP4 export (Team/Enterprise only, beta), Sheets and Whiteboards (beta) with shared editing.

feature: Template default states by plan and date
detail: Docs/Slides/Design on by default for Team, for Enterprise from Oct 15, 2026; Data Enterprise from Nov 20, 2026; Motion off by default on Enterprise; Sheets and Whiteboards off on Enterprise until enabled.

feature: Claude Data certified queries and live sharing settings
detail: Certified queries (choose marketplace and plugin storing them) and live sharing (dashboard shows owner's connector data to others) are on by default for Team and off for Enterprise.

feature: Standalone Claude Design closing Dec 14, 2026
detail: claude.ai/design closes December 14, 2026; projects and design systems move into Artifacts (up to 60 projects show in the Artifacts tab) and have separate org setting until then.

feature: External sharing, single-artifact allow, email invitations outside org
detail: Separate toggles: public link sharing (off also kills existing links except individually allowed artifacts), per-artifact Allow external sharing, and email invitations (default on for Team, off for Enterprise; pending expire after 30 days).

feature: See and remove outside access to artifacts
detail: Published artifacts list marks Shared outside; Manage outside access lets owners remove people or invitations but not change levels.

feature: Artifacts that cannot leave the organization
detail: Artifacts connecting to other websites or with unchecked uploads stay internal; link viewers outside get no connectors; sharing outside unavailable for HIPAA-ready, CMEK, education/K-12, ZDR-with-redaction or hybrid orgs.

feature: Artifact presence toggle
detail: Lets users see who else has an artifact open with live activity; on by default; off applies immediately to new loads and within an hour to open tabs.

feature: Enable artifact connectors
detail: Under Capabilities > Visuals, lets artifacts read and write each user's own connected apps (live-shared dashboards use owner's connection); cannot limit which apps.

feature: Custom roles per artifact capability (Enterprise)
detail: Capabilities for Artifacts, Design, Design systems, Docs, Slides, Data, Motion, Sheets, Whiteboards and standalone Design; users without Artifacts can open shared items up to Contributor level and see New artifact grayed out.

feature: Org design systems: share with everyone, default, delete
detail: Any user with access creates and shares design systems; only Owner/Primary Owner shares with everyone, sets org default or deletes shared-with-everyone ones; default must be shared with everyone first.

feature: Artifact usage counts against seat or consumption limits
detail: No separate allowance: Team and seat-based Enterprise use seat session/weekly limits (credits purchasable); usage-based Enterprise bills at API rates with org, group, per-user spend limits.

feature: Compliance API, Data artifact filter and custom retention for artifacts
detail: Artifact-level events recorded (not in-doc edits); filter Published artifacts by Data type; custom retention can delete artifacts nobody opens within the period; no data residency for Design.

feature: Artifact special configurations (HIPAA, CMEK, ZDR, offboarding)
detail: HIPAA orgs may enable artifacts but not covered by BAA; CMEK supported; ZDR for Code excludes Docs and Code artifacts; removing a member or group removes access; not available via third-party clouds.

feature: Artifact platform availability
detail: Artifacts available on web, desktop and Claude Code; iOS and Android users can request artifacts, view results and edit docs, decks and designs.

feature: Pooled group budgets
detail: Groups get one shared monthly budget on top of each member's own limit; usage stops when either runs out; on seat plans it applies only to usage credits, not seat-included usage; managed under Organization settings > Usage by Billing-permission roles.
plans: Usage-based Enterprise; Standard/Premium seat Enterprise with credits

feature: Pooled budget controls: set, freeze, pause, priority order
detail: Set amount with suggested starting point (~3x last month); $0 freezes; Paused keeps amount unenforced; for multi-group users largest pool pays first or a custom order can be set; not in Admin API.

feature: Pooled budget alert emails and notices
detail: Billing-permission users get email and in-app notice at 50%, 75%, 95%, 100% of the pool; table bar turns amber at 75% and red at 90%.

feature: User message when team budget runs out
detail: Users see a message with a Request more button, requests land under Review requests; users never see group name or pool amount.

feature: Limit resets (five-hour, weekly, Fable)
detail: Occasionally granted to eligible plans: restores five-hour session limit, weekly limit, or weekly Fable-model usage (and refills five-hour limit); irreversible, may expire, no refund of billed extra usage; lost on downgrade or cancel.

feature: Use a limit reset via Settings > Usage or limit message
detail: Click Reset for free in the Limit resets section or on the limit-reached message and confirm; not available inside Claude Code terminal or IDE though restored usage applies there.

feature: Assign Anthropic programs/grants to custom roles
detail: Owners add a grant in Organization settings > Roles > Models > Grants and assign groups; members must be role type Custom; Grants page lists requirements and member caps; roles can show Grant withheld or Action required.

feature: Grant-based models under More models
detail: Models issued via a program appear under More models in chat, or via claude --model in Claude Code 2.1.251+; built-in Owner/Admin roles do not get them.

feature: Artifacts: significant standalone outputs beside the chat
detail: Claude creates an artifact for self-contained content (typically 15+ lines) like documents, code, single-page sites, images, diagrams, dashboards and small tools; opens beside the conversation, editable, shareable, saved in the Artifacts tab.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Artifact template availability by plan
detail: Docs, Slides, Design on all plans; Data on Pro and above; Sheets and Whiteboards (beta) on Pro and above; Motion (beta) Team and Enterprise only; Enterprise defaults begin Oct 15 / Nov 20, 2026.

feature: Artifacts require Cloud code execution and file creation
detail: Capability must be on in Settings > Capabilities (individual) or Organization settings > Capabilities (Team, Enterprise).

feature: Legacy artifacts (before Sept 16, 2026)
detail: Older chat artifacts keep working and can be published and shared but new ones cannot be made; view code, copy or download via panel controls.

feature: Start from template via Output menu or Artifacts tab
detail: Ask in chat, choose Output in the message box, or pick a template in the Artifacts tab; Slides present in-app and export to PowerPoint/PDF; Design builds visuals, mockups, prototypes, landing pages with design system.

feature: Claude Data template: dashboards, data stories, narrated videos
detail: Builds from warehouses or connected apps like Salesforce; Claude writes queries and each chart shows its query and last refresh.

feature: Sheets and Whiteboards templates
detail: Sheets: spreadsheets with cross-tab formulas edited together with Claude; Whiteboards: shared board for ideas with Claude and team.

feature: Motion template: animated explainers exported as MP4
detail: Animated explainers, charts and walkthroughs; targeted edits (word, number, timing) leave the rest unchanged.

feature: Design systems apply colors, fonts and components to decks and designs
detail: New decks and designs inherit a saved design system.

feature: Artifacts tab in sidebar
detail: Single place to see, start from templates and organize all artifacts across conversations.

feature: Edit with Claude on highlighted text
detail: Highlight text in a doc or Markdown file, click Edit with Claude and describe the change; multiple edit requests across Markdown files batch into the next message.

feature: Edit earlier message to branch an artifact chat
detail: Editing an earlier message makes a separate chat version with its own artifacts.

feature: Artifact export formats
detail: Docs to Word, PDF, Markdown, Google Docs; decks to PowerPoint, PDF or Google Slides; designs to zip, PDF, PowerPoint, standalone HTML; animations MP4.

feature: Build on a published legacy artifact
detail: Copy its code into a new chat to make your own separate version; only with trusted sources.

feature: Try fixing with Claude button on artifact errors
detail: Copies error details into a new message for Claude to diagnose and fix.

feature: AI-powered artifacts that call Claude
detail: Artifacts can be small apps calling Claude; users sign in with their Claude account, usage counts against their own plan, no API keys; legacy artifact toggle under Capabilities, permission asked first time.

feature: Connect apps and custom connectors to an artifact
detail: Artifacts read and write Asana, Google Calendar, Slack and custom connectors after per-tool approval; each person connects own apps; connector tools needing per-action approval are excluded; owner can disable org-wide.

feature: Artifact personal and shared storage
detail: Persistent storage either personal or shared (with confirmation that data is visible to others); default 100 MB and 25,000 records; uploads up to 20 MB each (2 MB SVG), 5000 files and 1 GB; legacy limited to 20 MB text and needs publish.

feature: Artifacts in Claude Code
detail: Session output published as a live page at a private URL that updates in place; /design makes Claude Design output; docs open in side panel on desktop or as web link in terminal.

feature: Live artifacts from Cowork (before Aug 19, 2026)
detail: Earlier Cowork artifacts still work but cannot be edited in place.

feature: Slides keyboard navigation: F6 areas and slide object traversal
detail: F6/Shift+F6 moves between editor areas; Tab/Return enter the slide and objects; arrow keys move free objects; Page Up/Down change slides; thumbnails list with Shift+F10 menu.

feature: Slides keyboard shortcuts for shapes, text and presenting
detail: Single-key add shortcuts (T, R, O, D, L), Cmd/Ctrl+D duplicate, bold/italic/underline, undo/redo, zoom; present mode uses arrows/Space, Home/End, 1-9 jump, F full screen, Escape ends.

feature: Artifacts start private
detail: New artifacts are private until shared; mobile apps cannot change sharing settings.

feature: Monthly Claude Platform API credits
detail: Max gets $100, Ultra $200, Team $20 per Standard seat and $100 per Premium seat (pooled, capped at $500); not on Free, Pro or Enterprise; claimed after 7 days on plan; unused credits expire each cycle.

feature: Claim API credits by linking a Console organization
detail: Settings > Billing > API credits > Link organization (Team: owners); one Console org per plan, changing requires support; no card needed; mobile subscribers claim on web.

feature: API credits scope: API, Playground, Managed Agents, Agent SDK
detail: Credits cover Messages/Batches API, Console Playground, Managed Agents and Agent SDK (also claude -p with API key); exclude interactive Claude Code, extra usage, Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry; spent before purchased credits.

feature: API credits behavior on plan change or exhaustion
detail: Cancel or downgrade stops new credits; Max to Ultra upgrade prorates immediately; when exhausted API stops unless credits/auto-reload exist, never billed to plan.

feature: Automatic model fallback from Sonnet 5.5 to Sonnet 5
detail: Classifiers on all inputs (including memory, connectors, search results, files) send a narrow set of risky cyber or frontier-LLM requests to Sonnet 5 in the same chat with a visible notice; picker stays on Sonnet 5 until switched back.

feature: Safety blocks without fallback: biology and distillation
detail: Serious-harm biology requests and attempts to extract verbatim reasoning are blocked outright; explaining reasoning or normal code review still works; Life Sciences Verification Program offers expanded biology access via High-risk Use add-on.

feature: Toggle: Switch models when a message is flagged
detail: Settings > Capabilities (or Config > MODEL & OUTPUT in Claude Code); when off a flagged request pauses the chat so you can edit and retry or pick another model.

feature: Billing for blocked and fallback requests
detail: Pre-output biology, distillation and LLM-dev blocks are billed; other pre-output blocks free; mid-stream blocks bill tokens at producing model; fallback billed at Sonnet 5 rates with cache-miss credit.

feature: Send feedback on incorrect blocks
detail: Use Send feedback to report legitimately blocked or repeatedly falling back requests.

feature: Cyber Verification Program access levels and security conditions
detail: Tiered access (Defense, Defense for Individuals, Red Team, Specialized) to advanced cyber model capabilities, with named security contact, 72h/24h incident reporting, personal sign-in, usage attribution and phishing-resistant MFA by Dec 15, 2026.

feature: CVP seat caps and credential rules
detail: Red Team grants cap 75 approved users, Specialized 25; static API keys phased out for short-lived credentials; managed devices, org-domain/SSO accounts, off-host egress allowlists, background checks and 3-day offboarding required at higher levels; individuals get no ZDR.

feature: Claude for Intune managed iOS app
detail: Separate App Store app (Claude Intune) for Microsoft Intune organizations with app-protection policies on company and personal iPhones/iPads; iOS/iPadOS 18+, Microsoft sign-in only, Entra Conditional Access supported.

feature: Intune setup: Microsoft sign-in, Entra admin consent, app-protection policy
detail: Anthropic enables Microsoft sign-in per email domain; Entra admin grants consent; admin creates iOS app-protection policy for bundle ID com.anthropic.claudeforintune assigned to user groups; employees need Intune licenses or are signed out.

feature: Intune deployment by device type
detail: Unenrolled personal devices and Apple User Enrollment install from App Store; company-owned enrolled devices get it as an iOS store app (Required or Available via Company Portal).

feature: HIPAA configuration for Claude Code and Cowork local mode
detail: Enterprise Primary Owner (with account team) applies it in Organization settings > Data and privacy, accepting the BAA, bringing local Code (terminal, Desktop Code section) and local Cowork under BAA; cloud sessions excluded; replaces ZDR for Code.

feature: Features turned off by HIPAA configuration
detail: Cowork, Desktop Code section, skills, Claude in Chrome, connectors (tool permissions reset to Blocked), built-in GitHub integration, desktop extensions, Remote Control, Claude Tag, cloud sessions switch off; scheduled-task approvals expire; Owner re-enables selectively.

feature: Not covered under BAA even when configured
detail: VS Code and JetBrains extensions, beta/preview features, Bedrock/gateway/custom base URL sessions, Console API key sessions without ZDR, connectors, MCP, plugins, extensions, Chrome and skills.

feature: HIPAA configured indicators and monitoring
detail: Confirm via Organization settings row, /status HIPAA line, and Desktop title-bar label; Compliance API captures session content for 30 days; OpenTelemetry for Cowork can leak prompt text unless otlpContentCapture is set to [].

feature: Local session data stays on members' computers
detail: Transcripts and Cowork data are stored locally; removing a member deletes nothing on their machine, so organizations must wipe devices and keep disk encryption on.

feature: Claude Design now an artifact inside Claude
detail: New designs, design systems and decks in Claude are artifacts; standalone claude.ai/design closes Dec 14, 2026; Design available on Free through Enterprise.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Move design systems from standalone Design
detail: Anyone who can use Design starts one move for all team design systems from the Artifacts page banner; non-private ones become shared org-wide; empty and starter-theme ones skip; failures list reasons with a Check/Fix flow; Move again skips edits made in Claude.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Move projects from standalone Design
detail: Project owner reviews what moves, can download a zip, confirms; copy becomes read-only; owners can Move everything (Owner/Primary Owner only); chats and comments are not carried over and are later deleted.

feature: Download Design project as zip
detail: Project HTML export (Project archive) yields all files free and without usage cost; bulk download of all owned projects rolling out, not available to HIPAA orgs.

feature: Design systems default-off on Enterprise; org default design system
detail: Owners must enable Artifacts and Design systems under Organization settings > Artifacts; Owners set the org default design system; custom roles need design-systems permission; retention periods can delete unopened moved artifacts.

feature: Moved Design content and CMEK/HIPAA/ZDR
detail: CMEK orgs get key encryption only after moving; moved projects are outside the BAA for HIPAA orgs; ZDR-for-Code orgs must enable artifacts to move, which ZDR does not cover.

feature: Haiku 4.5 removed from selector on Free, Pro, Max (Oct 29, 2026)
detail: Haiku 4.5 no longer in More models for chat, Cowork and Design; replaced by Haiku 5.5; still available in Claude Code, Team/Enterprise and API; old chats continue on Haiku 5.5.

feature: Switch model mid-chat from picker
detail: Click model name next to send button or More models; applies from the next response.

feature: Unified chat moves into isolated cloud sandbox VM
detail: Every conversation starts as chat and continues in a per-conversation Anthropic-managed VM for code and files; VM stops after idle with encrypted disk snapshot and sandbox expires after 30 days.

feature: Chat and Cowork unified org toggle and default date
detail: Owners enable under Organization settings > Capabilities (requires Chat and Cloud code execution and file creation); off by default, on by default Nov 16, 2026; custom roles auto-enabled Dec 8, 2026 if still default.

feature: Per-role unified access and rollout guidance
detail: Roles > Capabilities grants it to custom roles (SCIM waves); built-in roles get it with the org setting; checked on every request; suggested pilot of two to four weeks.

feature: Controls affecting unified experience
detail: Network egress (off, package managers, custom domains, all), connector policies, Always allow for connector tools, Skip all approvals and Automatically approve modes, share chats and cloud sessions, Computer access, computer use, Trusted Devices, scheduled tasks toggle.

feature: Desktop device policy and EDR for Claude desktop
detail: MDM can limit connectable folders, disable local MCP servers and extensions, require org sign-in and turn off computer use; EDR sensor can run inside the local VM (beta) but not the cloud sandbox.

feature: Unified data retention and deletion rules
detail: Conversations follow retention (min 30 days) and delete linked cloud sessions; memory migrates to new system with old memory deleted after 14 days; files created after Oct 8, 2026 delete with conversation; scheduled tasks and direct Cowork sessions are not covered.

feature: Unified usage reporting in analytics and APIs
detail: Usage filed under 'Chat and Cowork unified' in dashboard pages, charts, Cost and Usage API (chat_cowork_unified), Analytics API metrics and member usage pages; smart reports can target it.

feature: Efficient mode for unified experience
detail: Owners restrict members to Sonnet and Haiku with new sessions at Sonnet 5.5 low effort, org-wide on Models page or per custom role.

feature: Unified experience unavailable with ZDR, HIPAA, CMEK
detail: Organizations using zero data retention, HIPAA-ready or customer-managed keys keep separate chat and Cowork; enabling CMEK later makes it unavailable.

feature: Claude Data: dashboards, scrollytellers, visual shorts, visual analyses
detail: Formerly Claude Dashboards; connect a data warehouse (Redshift, BigQuery, ClickHouse, Databricks, Snowflake) or apps like Salesforce, ask in plain language, Claude writes a SQL query per chart shown with last refresh.

feature: Claude Data editing, version history and refresh
detail: Edit via chat or by clicking titles, captions and charts; version history with read-only preview and Restore; data refreshes when opened and due, not on a schedule.

feature: Certified queries (beta)
detail: Approved queries reusable across dashboards with a badge; certify by editing a query, Certify query, Test, Publish; can use dbt, Looker or Cube definitions; editing removes certification; Git-backed plugin option.

feature: Live sharing of dashboard results (beta)
detail: Shared dashboards can show results from the owner's connector access to org members who lack it, limited to approved queries; enabled per connector via Sources > Your access.

feature: Claude Motion code-based animations
detail: Prompt-built animated explainers, charts and walkthroughs made as code (no video-generation model, no realistic footage), editable by chat or editor, started via Output > Motion or Artifacts tab, exported as MP4.

feature: Artifact panel keyboard navigation
detail: Tab enters the artifact and Escape steps back out, closing the panel on the last press; F6/Cmd+F6 moves between editor areas; Return/Shift+Return go in/up a level in decks and designs.

feature: Keyboard comment mode on decks and designs
detail: Header Comment button toggles comment mode; Tab to target, Return to comment, Cmd/Ctrl+Return to post or save edits; 'Show all comments' list; Send to Claude checkbox; view-only users cannot comment.

feature: Keyboard tips for Mac laptops and Safari
