detail: Fn modifies keys for Home/End/Page and function keys on Mac laptops; Safari needs Option+Tab to reach all controls; web-page artifacts without links are skipped by Tab.

feature: Docs text and block shortcuts
detail: Bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, code, link (Cmd/Ctrl+K), heading levels 1-6 (Cmd+Option+1-6), numbered/bulleted/checklist (Cmd+Shift+7/8/9), quote, code block, indent/outdent, undo/redo.

feature: Docs slash, at-mention and emoji insertion
detail: Type / to insert blocks (table, code block, checklist, date), @ to mention people, dates, doc tabs or docs, and : to insert emoji by name.

feature: Docs placeholders for unwritten sections
detail: Sections Claude has not yet written show as bracketed text or ellipsis and can be deleted or extended with Backspace/Return.

feature: Docs table actions: sort, merge, add row, alt text
detail: Shift+F10 opens cell actions (add/delete row or column, merge cells, sort column ascending/descending); Tab in last cell adds a row; images get Edit alt text; Cmd+K link actions open, copy, edit, remove.

feature: Docs doc-tab list, renaming and heading collapse
detail: Doc tabs list with subtabs and headings navigable by keyboard; F2 renames a tab; headings collapse/expand with Cmd+Option+Return.

feature: Docs comment shortcuts
detail: Cmd+Option+M comments or opens comment at cursor; Option+Shift+C hides/shows comments; Return/Cmd+Return posts; Shift+Return newline; @ mentions in comment.

feature: Fable 5.2 launch: free week of Fable on Pro and Team standard
detail: From Nov 9 to Nov 16, 2026 all Fable models count in plan limits up to 50% of weekly usage on Pro and Team standard seats, plus one reset; afterwards Fable uses usage credits.

feature: Fable limit resets by subscription length
detail: Max, Ultra, Team premium and legacy Enterprise premium seats get 1 reset (<6 months), 2 (6-12), 3 (>12 months) measured from first paid bill; expire Mar 8, 2027; not for HIPAA-ready, Free, or other Enterprise types.
plans: Max, Ultra, Team premium, Enterprise premium (legacy)

feature: How a Fable reset restores usage
detail: Restores weekly usage spent on Fable models only and fully refills any five-hour limit; does not raise limits; verified Ultra has no five-hour limit.

feature: Claude Duet: message-like personal agent (research preview)
detail: Message Claude by text or voice like a person; it runs on its own cloud computer, uses your Claude memory, skills and connectors, keeps working after the app closes, with a main thread plus separate channels sharing memory.

feature: Duet morning brief and proactive updates
detail: Each morning scans email and calendar, surfaces what needs attention, starts first steps such as draft replies, sends progress updates and follows up on quiet threads.

feature: Duet larger jobs return files in Make tab
detail: Handles bigger requests by choosing apps and effort, returning reviewable files like briefs, financial models, decks and dashboards in a Make tab; Tasks tab shows work and what needs input; only user marks tasks complete.

feature: Duet connectors, plugins and cloud browser
detail: Uses connectors like Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Slack, QuickBooks, HubSpot, Docusign, Calendly and Stripe; supports plugins such as the small business plugin; uses its own cloud browser for sites without connectors.

feature: Duet purchases with Link and Shop Pay
detail: Pays approved purchases using one-time cards through Link (Stripe) or Shop Pay (Shopify), connected inside Duet only and asking before each purchase.

feature: Duet searches past chats
detail: Searches Duet chats and non-project Claude chats; controlled by the Search and reference chats setting in Settings > Your Claude (or Settings > Memory); deleted chats leave search.

feature: Duet access via waitlist invitation, US only
detail: Join via product page choosing plan and phone type; invitation tied to the email address; Pro/Max/Ultra US accounts only, not Team or Enterprise yet.

feature: Duet limitations
detail: No model choice (runs Opus 5.5), cannot watch or take over its browser, checks accounts at intervals, cannot change Claude work or see local files, no calls or texts, off-limits actions include trading and moving money; no Personal Finance.

feature: Duet approval before send, pay, sign or delete
detail: Shows planned action and waits for approval before sending messages, payments, signatures or deletions, queues approvals if unavailable, cites sources of figures, and has separate password form that bypasses chat.

feature: Duet usage limits and bonus resets
detail: Included free in preview; counts at same rate as chat including background work; Pro gets 3 full limit resets, Max/Ultra 1, expiring Dec 15, 2026.

feature: Opt-in sharing of voice recordings (mobile)
detail: By default audio from voice mode and dictation is deleted after transcription; users may opt in via a prompt after the first voice chat to share recordings to improve voice features. Free, Pro, Max, Ultra on iOS and Android only; not Team, Enterprise or ZDR.

feature: Voice data sharing: Always allow or Ask each time
detail: After opting in, a card asks per conversation (Allow or No thanks, deleting audio); choose Always allow or Ask each time; change in Settings > Privacy or the voice mode settings button.

feature: Delete shared recordings and retention rules
detail: Delete shared recordings button removes all across organizations; account deletion or chat deletion also deletes; shared recordings kept 30 days, per-recording encryption, included in data export; turning off stops new sharing only.

feature: Link by Stripe payments in Duet
detail: Connect Link from the Duet avatar (not in directory); Duet asks, you approve a maximum amount in the Link app, then it pays via one-time merchant-scoped card; Duet sees only last four digits, expiry and billing address; US plans and US payment method.

feature: Link in Duet limitations and disconnect
detail: No recurring payments, sites may block Duet, merchants may decline, failed buys may show pending; disconnect via avatar > payments > Link > Disconnect.

feature: Shop Pay payments in Duet
detail: Connect Shop Pay from the Duet avatar; Duet finds item, you Review in Shop Pay and approve, then it pays with a one-time card scoped to approved amount; distinct from the Shopify connector; US Pro, Max, Ultra only.

feature: Ultra plan $200/month (formerly Max 20x)
detail: Individual plan with 10x Pro weekly usage, priority access to new models, Claude Code, long background tasks and monthly API credits; existing Max 20x subscribers moved automatically at the same price; monthly billing only; app pricing may vary.

feature: Ultra: no five-hour limit for verified accounts
detail: Verified Ultra accounts have no five-hour limit (a temporary one applies until verification, automatic; no Current session bar in Settings > Usage means verified); weekly all-model limit plus separate Fable weekly limit.

feature: Annual Pro to Ultra credit and Google Play proration
detail: Remaining annual Pro balance becomes account credit if billing address matches; Google Play upgrades charge full price and convert unused value to extra days.

feature: Unified Plugins page replaces Customize, Skills and Connectors tabs
detail: Sidebar Customize becomes Plugins with Your plugins first, quick filters for skills or connectors, one detail layout, Verified/Community directory labels; skills used via + or / in chat. Rollout from Oct 29, GA Nov 9; Enterprise Nov 30, 2026.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Admin Plugins group and Skills-off blocks plugins in Desktop
detail: Org settings merges Plugins & skills and Connectors into a Plugins group with pages for plugins, connectors, policy, marketplaces, requests; from Nov 30 disabled Skills also block plugins in Desktop, Cowork and Code tab; needs Cloud code execution on.

feature: Run EDR sensor inside local Cowork VM
detail: Beta: Claude Desktop copies a signed vendor sensor package (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Tanium and others) into the local Cowork VM at each start; requires Desktop 4.4212.0+, MDM or Windows registry policy; cloud sessions not covered; no Anthropic charge.

feature: Personal Finance: link bank accounts via Plaid (read-only)
detail: Beta page of widgets (spending, cash flow, accounts, subscriptions, upcoming bills, insights) that you can add, edit, remove and reorder, plus questions to Claude; US only, Pro, Max, Ultra; reads accounts but cannot move or invest money.

feature: Personal Finance data scope and linking limits
detail: Reads bank names, account types, last four digits, balances, limits, up to 24 months of transactions, loans, cards and investment holdings; up to 16 banks; setup in Plaid must finish within 10 minutes; link-again choices: Switch, Keep as is, Keep both.

feature: Personal Finance chat privacy behavior
detail: Chats using linked accounts are not saved to memory, searched later or included in monthly recap; hub chats are not used for training; Claude asks before publishing artifacts, and shared links or artifacts reveal figures; limited to text, tables and CSV.

feature: Turn Plaid on or off per chat via Connectors
detail: Plus menu > Connectors toggles Plaid; on mobile set tools Blocked, Needs approval or Always allow, applied to new chats too.

feature: Personal Finance re-sign-in, unlink and unlink all
detail: Manage linked accounts offers Sign in again for expired access and Unlink (whole bank login; last bank also resets dashboard widgets and budgets irreversibly) or Unlink all banks; plan end blocks access but keeps links; Team/Enterprise move or account deletion unlinks.

feature: Personal Finance limitations
detail: US banks only; not usable in scheduled tasks, Cowork, Claude Code, Duet, and maybe projects; data exports exclude saved dashboard; hidden outside US or on foreign VPN.

feature: Centralized management parent organization console (admin.claude.com)
detail: Beta for Enterprise: a parent organization admin console manages SSO, SCIM, verified domains, groups, connector domain restriction, org-creation restriction and parent Compliance API keys across child orgs, which keep separate data and users.

feature: Parent roles: owner and admin
detail: New parent owner (everything incl. choosing admins) and parent admin roles separate from child permissions; neither grants sign-in to child orgs.

feature: Multiple identity providers and split domains
detail: Connect several SSO/SCIM configurations under one parent and route a domain to more than one IdP, controlling who sees each at sign-in; Require SSO set per domain for Claude and Console.

feature: Parent-level Compliance API keys and switch
detail: Create cross-organization keys with compliance or group scopes at admin.claude.com, toggle Compliance API for all child orgs, disable/re-enable/delete keys; child admins keep single-org keys.

feature: Parent enrollment flow and limits
detail: Eligible child admins start irreversible enrollment with approvals from every child org; tenant-restriction allowlist needs parent ID; HIPAA child orgs and Team-only parents cannot enroll; cloud-marketplace Platform orgs cannot join; group availability not yet.

feature: Parent domain claim and organization invites
detail: Parent owners start a domain claim migrating Free/Pro/Max/Ultra accounts into a chosen child org (Bring what you can or Start fresh) and invite Platform or Team orgs on verified domains; Enterprise orgs via account team.

feature: Parent groups synced from IdP or created by hand
detail: Groups live at parent with SCIM badge for synced ones; roles assigned within each child org; all Enterprise child admins currently see all groups.

feature: Hosted agent browser identifies as Claude-Agent
detail: Anthropic-hosted browsers (e.g. Claude Duet) add a Claude-Agent token to the User-Agent and come from published IPs at a .well-known/sail file, letting site owners allow or block this agentic traffic separately from crawlers.

feature: Security center posture review (beta)
detail: Enterprise Owners see Organization settings > Security posture comparing settings across Org, chats, Cowork and Claude Code to recommended values with Passed, Failed, Not attested or Shown for information statuses, trends and new/changed markers; view-only.

feature: Security center attestation, PDF report and Compliance API events
detail: Owners attest controls it cannot read (MDM, proxy), see roles and connectors per custom role and adoption figures, download a PDF report for auditors (not a certification), and read data via Compliance API with activity-feed events.

feature: Multiple identity providers per parent organization
detail: Parent orgs in centralized management can connect several SSO apps, each with its own SCIM directory (at most one). Users sign in via their email domain's provider and choose when several apply.

feature: Child-org group-to-role mappings per identity provider
detail: Child organization admins map directory groups to roles (and seat tiers on Enterprise), choosing which identity provider each mapping applies to and seeing each group's source.

feature: Highest-role-wins for same email in two directories
detail: The same email in two directories is one person who gets the highest matching role; removal from one directory keeps roles granted by the other. With JIT the role follows the last provider used.

feature: Deleting or turning off an identity provider
detail: Deleting removes domain routing, mappings and directory link; a domain requiring SSO with no remaining SSO provider locks users out. The parent's only provider cannot be deleted. Losing the last SSO or directory switches child orgs to invite-only.

feature: Split domains: one domain, several identity providers
detail: A verified domain can sign in through multiple providers; users see Choose your identity provider after entering email on claude.ai, platform, admin, Desktop and Mobile. Needs SCIM or invite-only provisioning, not JIT or Microsoft Login.

feature: Restrict an identity provider to its SCIM directory
detail: Option limiting sign-in to people active in that directory (owners exempt). Unlisted people are refused after sign-in with an Access managed by your organization page; needs directory sync.

feature: Hide identity provider at sign-in
detail: Removes a provider from every sign-in page while still allowing sign-in from its tile in the identity provider dashboard, useful for testing a new provider before rollout.

feature: Require SSO per domain for Claude and Console
detail: Each domain can require SSO separately for Claude and for Console; a required-SSO domain with no offered provider blocks email and Google sign-in too.

feature: Desktop one-click SSO via loginSsoOrgDomain MDM setting
detail: Claude Desktop can send users straight to an organization's SSO through an MDM setting, which does not check the directory restriction.

feature: Project tags for spend tracking by cost code
detail: Owners define tags (for example cost_code) and values; editors set a value per project (up to 16 tags each, one value per tag). Spend can be reported by tag in settings or via API.

feature: Create tag: predefined values, any value, required toggle, CSV import
detail: Owners create lowercase names that cannot be renamed, choose predefined-list or free-form values, may require a value on new web projects, and add values by line or CSV. Values up to 256 characters.

feature: Spend by project report with Group by tag and CSV export
detail: Organization settings Usage Spend by project can group by tag, filter by period and product, and export CSV; data runs to end of yesterday UTC, shows after discount and before credits, excludes seat-covered usage; private project names are masked.

feature: Set project for Claude Code via attributionProject setting
detail: Claude Code has no project picker; users add attributionProject with the project ID in settings.json to tag usage. Needs Claude Code 2.1.305 or Desktop 3.6556.1; untagged otherwise with no warning.

feature: Cowork desktop tasks pick one project for tagging
detail: Cowork tasks on the computer can be attributed to a project (Desktop 3.6556.1 or later); chat and unified chat in projects report automatically.

feature: Project tags Admin API and cost report API
detail: Admin API (read/write project_tags scopes, beta header) sets tags on projects by claude_proj ID; analytics cost API with read:analytics groups spend by tag in daily buckets (31 days per call, 1000 rows per page).

feature: Project tags not available for some data configurations and products
detail: Not available with HIPAA, CMEK, ZDR, minimal retention, non-US data or desktop via own provider; tags do not apply to Claude Code on web, Office, Chrome, Design, Slack, Teams, artifacts, voice, API, or Bedrock/Vertex use. Beta lacks per-chat tags, splitting, renaming, spend caps by tag.

feature: Claude Sheets: spreadsheet artifact edited with Claude
detail: A sheet is an artifact where Claude and users edit the same cells: tabs, cross-tab formulas, formatting, conditional formatting, dropdowns, checkboxes and charts, with each Claude edit outlined as it lands.

feature: Create a sheet from chat or the Artifacts tab Sheets tile
detail: Ask Claude in any chat, or open Artifacts and pick the Sheets tile and describe it or start blank.

feature: Ask Claude about a selected cell range
detail: Select cells and ask a question about them, or ask for changes; users can also type, write formulas, format and comment on cells.

feature: Sheet version history with restore
detail: Shows earlier versions and restores one, which also discards edits made after it; the way to undo Claude's changes.

feature: Sheet import from CSV, Excel, Google Sheets or paste
detail: Bring data in by CSV, Excel, Google Sheets, pasting, or start blank.

feature: Sheet export to xlsx or CSV and Send to other tools
detail: Download as .xlsx or CSV, or use Send to to continue elsewhere.

feature: Share a sheet with edit access for live co-editing
detail: Sheets start private; Share gives Can edit access so others work in the same cells live with Claude.

feature: Claude Sheets limits and unsupported features
detail: At least 200,000 filled cells; bar, line, pie and more charts. No pivot tables, protected ranges, shared filter views, multi-select dropdowns or PDF export; no macros, VBA, Power Query, DAX or print layout; no live connected data; limited on mobile; no HIPAA or ZDR.

feature: Admin toggle for Claude Sheets under Artifacts templates
detail: Owners switch Sheets in Organization settings Artifacts Templates: on by default on Team, off by default on Enterprise (where custom roles can limit it to groups). Artifacts must be on.

feature: Claude Sheets counts toward usage limits
detail: Sheet work draws on the plan's normal usage limits.

feature: Claude Whiteboards: shared board for thinking with Claude
detail: A whiteboard artifact where Claude draws shapes, arrows, sections, diagrams and flows from typed, spoken or sketched input, and anyone on it can rearrange. Not in Claude for Teachers yet.

feature: Start a whiteboard from chat or Artifacts tab Whiteboard tile
detail: Ask in any chat or open the tile and describe or dictate what to work through.

feature: Dictate into whiteboard chat box in 25 languages
detail: Microphone beside send; Escape or second tap stops, words stay in the box. Follows browser language: Amharic, Chinese Simplified, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swahili, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian.

feature: Whiteboard AI actions: regroup, timeline, find gaps, region question
detail: Ask Claude to regroup by theme or make a timeline, add suggestions for missing steps, or drag across an area to ask about only that part.

feature: Live whiteboard collaboration with follow mode and email invites
detail: Everyone edits live and can follow a teammate's view; Share invites people, including outside the organization by email (Team/Enterprise need Email invitations outside your organization on in Artifacts settings).

feature: Turn a whiteboard into a doc or deck, Send to Lucid, Miro, Zoho Vani, PNG export
detail: Claude converts a board into a doc or deck; Send to supports Lucid, Miro and Zoho Vani; Share Export gives PNG. Pictures and videos can be added; boards cannot be imported from a file.

feature: Whiteboard limitations: no connected app context, HIPAA and ZDR notes
detail: Claude uses only what is on the board, not connected apps. Not available to HIPAA-ready orgs; in ZDR-for-Claude-Code orgs it works in chat and Cowork without ZDR coverage and is unavailable in Claude Code. Counts toward usage.

feature: Claude Meetings: Claude joins Google Meet as a participant
detail: Claude joins as a visible participant, takes notes, answers questions and builds docs, whiteboards and slides live. Needs Google Calendar connected (owner must enable it).

feature: Add Claude to a meeting or auto-join all or non-one-on-one meetings
detail: Pick a calendar meeting and Add Claude, or set Settings Capabilities Meetings Auto-join to all meetings or all except one-on-ones (owners cannot set it for you). Host may admit; a declined host is not retried.

feature: In-call interaction: say Claude or Meet chat, artifacts, pause, leave
detail: Ask aloud or in Meet chat (answers in chat by default); say make a doc or whiteboard; live tile shows state; pause or resume from the meeting page; ask Claude to leave; stays up to eight hours.

feature: Claude uses attendees' connected tools during a call with approval
detail: Uses each person's connectors with their permission (asks first time; spoken requests re-confirm the speaker each time); approvals appear in Meet chat or on the meeting page.

feature: Meeting page: live transcript, notes, summary, action items, recap email
detail: After the call, org attendees get a recap email and can edit what Claude made; page is shareable within the org; Meetings calendar lists past and upcoming; regular chat can answer about past meetings you can access.

feature: Meetings with outside guests setting
detail: Team default allows, Enterprise default internal only. When disallowed Claude stays out or leaves if an outsider or other notetaker joins; when allowed it takes notes and posts a notice but does not reply in chat, and guests get no meeting page or recap. Per-user setting too.

feature: Owner controls for Claude Meetings and members' connectors in meetings
detail: Organization settings Products Claude Meetings: off, on for roles with Meetings, or everyone (Team default on); external-guest option; connector use in meetings; Enterprise custom-role capabilities.

feature: Meetings data handling and pricing
detail: Saves transcript, summary and screen descriptions, not audio; notes and answers are included on plans, docs and whiteboards made in meetings are free through February 10, 2027, connector use counts toward usage. Not available for ZDR, HIPAA-ready or CMEK orgs.

feature: Unified Claude: chat and Cowork in one conversation
detail: Every chat starts the same; when a task needs code or files Claude continues the same chat in an Anthropic-managed cloud environment and returns finished work. Tasks started on web can continue on desktop or mobile.

feature: Cloud environment per chat: VM, idle snapshot, 30-day expiry
detail: Each chat needing one gets its own virtual machine; after minutes idle it stops and its disk is saved as an encrypted snapshot; the environment expires 30 days after creation.

feature: Optional local access: link computer for local folders and apps
detail: Through Claude Desktop users may link their computer so Claude works with local folders and applications.

feature: Chat and Cowork unified admin toggle and rollout dates
detail: Owners turn it on in Organization settings Capabilities; auto-on December 1, 2026 unless Keep disabled; separate chat/Cowork retired February 1, 2027. Needs Cloud code execution and file creation; not for ZDR orgs; Efficient mode not on Team.

feature: Unified experience admin controls: egress, connector policies, approval modes
detail: Network egress off, package managers, custom domains or all; connector Blocked/Needs approval enforced on every call; toggles for Always allow connector tools, Skip all approvals, Automatically approve, computer access, computer use (beta, off by default), trusted devices, scheduled tasks.

feature: Share chats and Share cloud sessions both required to share cloud chats
detail: A chat that has used its cloud environment is shareable only if both Data and privacy settings are on; OpenTelemetry export sends the same events for these cloud sessions; MDM can disable local MCP servers, extensions and computer use on managed Macs and PCs.

feature: Unified experience retention: deleting a chat deletes its cloud sessions
detail: Chats live until deleted; deleting a chat removes cloud sessions it started and transcripts, but not directly started Cowork cloud sessions, scheduled tasks or local Cowork history; project memory goes with the project.

feature: Unified experience usage, credits and analytics line
detail: Code and file tasks use more seat allowance; usage credits bill overage at standard rates up to an org spend limit (per-member limits for some orgs). Analytics shows a Chat and Cowork unified page and chart option with daily active users.

feature: Claude Desktop on 3P: desktop app on Bedrock, Google Cloud, Foundry or own gatew
detail: Alternative to Claude Enterprise where all inference routes through the customer's cloud provider (Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry or an LLM gateway); no seats, provider bills tokens, no mobile app or claude.ai web.

feature: Desktop 3P platforms: macOS, Windows, Linux beta
detail: Claude runs only in the desktop app on macOS and Windows (Linux beta); Cowork needs macOS 14 or Windows 10 build 19041 and hardware virtualization.

feature: Import claude.ai history into Claude Desktop 3P (wizard)
detail: Users run Settings Import and export Import to sign in to claude.ai, fetch an export and copy their own chats, projects and on-computer Cowork/Code sessions; repeatable without duplicates; merge or keep-separate for same-named projects. Files and other users' content do not come over.

feature: Allow members to export own data and import allowlist controls
detail: Owner turns on member data export in claude.ai and Enable import in the Desktop admin console; options include import prompt banner, organization allowlist (sign-in only), group rollout, automatic import of earlier 3P sessions, session export to zip, telemetry event. Blocked under HIPAA-ready.

feature: Desktop 3P limits: local storage, no sharing, no voice, device must be awake
detail: History, projects and memory live on the device (deleted history unrecoverable); no sharing between users, no chat-history search or nightly summaries, no Voice mode, Claude Security or Claude Tag; scheduled tasks need an awake device; Chrome works only with the admin console.

feature: Desktop 3P config delivery: Enterprise Admin Console, MDM or bootstrap server
detail: Console gives SSO, SCIM, per-group permission policies and Claude in Chrome but needs api.anthropic.com at launch; MDM needs no Anthropic account; bootstrap server must stay reachable. forceLoginOrgUUID and deploymentMode keep devices on the managed setup.

feature: Desktop 3P cost control and telemetry
detail: inferenceMaxTokensPerWindow caps tokens per window per user (needs inferenceTokenWindowHours); budgets come from the cloud provider; OpenTelemetry export to own collector is metadata-only by default, with opt-in prompt/tool content and shell command detail; optional Compliance API in console.

feature: Desktop 3P distributes skills and plugins via a plugin marketplace
detail: Admins point allowedPluginMarketplaces at a git or HTTPS marketplace to roll out skills and plugins; connectors become admin-set managed MCP servers.

feature: Desktop 3P web search and fetch behavior
detail: Google Cloud and Foundry have native search (Google needs org policy allowance); Bedrock needs a separate search provider; Chat/Cowork fetch reaches only hosts in coworkEgressAllowedHosts.

feature: Desktop 3P Code permission modes: Auto mode, bypass, retention hold
detail: New Code sessions start in Auto mode unless autoModeEnabled is false; admins decide bypass mode and always-ask tools; legal hold via 3650-day retention periods since sessionRetentionHold ends December 17, 2026.

feature: Unified Claude combines Chat and Cowork in current Desktop
detail: On by default in current Desktop even if Cowork was off earlier; turning it off disables both Chat and Cowork (Code unaffected, Code-only setups kept until December 17, 2026).

feature: Winding down Enterprise: retention shortening, removal, org deletion
detail: Admins can shorten custom retention (minimum 30 days, permanent deletion on save; public artifacts and removed users' memory unaffected), remove users via SCIM or JIT (removal does not delete data), keep seats for mobile users, and request org deletion through Support from the Primary Owner.

feature: Cloud browser: a browser running on Anthropic servers
detail: Claude browses in a server-side browser shown as a card in chat or task; users can open it in a side panel (web, desktop) or tap Open (mobile). Not on Free, Team or Enterprise.

feature: Take control of cloud browser and hand back to Claude
detail: User selects Take control to sign in or complete a step (Claude cannot act meanwhile but sees input), then Hand back; control also returns on a time limit or when the panel closes; button shows only while a page is open.

feature: Cloud browser: what Claude sees and sign-in persistence
detail: Claude sees your entries and open pages; passwords, card numbers, security codes and one-time codes are hidden only best-effort. Signing in keeps Claude logged in for that chat or task, so sign out (including Google/Apple) before handing back.

feature: Claude Code CLI on a third-party provider or gateway
detail: CLI reads env vars, settings files and managed settings; provider variables for Bedrock, Google Cloud, Foundry or a gateway replace claude.ai login (needs gateway credential too); /status shows active provider and settings source; pin model versions.

feature: CLI managed settings delivery and allowedProviders
detail: Server-managed settings do not apply on third-party providers; policy comes via managed-settings.json, com.anthropic.claudecode macOS profile or HKLM registry key. allowedProviders (v2.1.285+) restricts providers; parentSettingsBehavior governs desktop-vs-CLI policy.

feature: CLI features unavailable on cloud providers
detail: Cloud sessions (--cloud), Routines, managed Code Review, Ultrareview, Remote Control, Chrome extension, voice dictation, claude.ai connectors, synced skills/plugins, Channels, analytics dashboard, Advisor and Code Mode need claude.ai sign-in; web search not on Bedrock; Fast mode not on Bedrock/Foundry and limited on Google Cloud.

feature: Claude Code teleport and resume local sessions
detail: claude --teleport pulls a cloud session to a local copy (needs claude.ai sign-in, clean tree, same repo, pushed branch); claude --continue and --resume reopen local transcripts kept in ~/.claude/projects (30-day default cleanup).

feature: Desktop 3P sign-ins: claude.ai, admin console, provider, bootstrap, connectors
detail: Users may face separate sign-ins: SSO for claude.ai import, a Claude account for the admin console (expires about monthly), the provider (IAM Identity Center, Google/Workforce Identity, Entra ID), a bootstrap server IdP, each connector, and CLI cloud credentials.

feature: Overlap-period controls: deploymentMode, forceLoginOrgUUID, Tenant Restrictions
detail: deploymentMode 3p hides the claude.ai option; forceLoginOrgUUID limits sign-in to listed orgs; a Require this organization in Claude Desktop setting stops users dismissing org-switch prompts; CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR separates CLI accounts.

feature: Cyber Verification Program and restricted models on cloud providers
detail: Access programs need linking AWS, Google Cloud or Azure accounts in the Verification Portal, about five business days after approval, short-lived per-user credentials; some programs (Life Sciences, beta) are not on third-party platforms.

feature: Control which models users can pick: inferenceModels, availableModels, provider
detail: Desktop 3P picker comes from inferenceModels (console policies can only narrow; highest-ranked group policy wins); CLI uses availableModels plus enforceAvailableModels; hard limits belong in AWS IAM, Google Model Garden or Azure Policy.

feature: Cloud provider comparison for Desktop 3P
detail: Bedrock and Google process data on their platforms, Foundry has Anthropic as processor; per-user sign-in via IAM Identity Center, Google/Workforce Identity or Entra ID; native search on Google and Foundry; GovCloud FIPS and FedRAMP notes; covered models retained at least 30 days.

feature: Linked billing: customers link Console org via OAuth (platform builders)
detail: Beta feature letting an app bill a customer's own Claude Console org directly through a connection ID instead of an API key; covers messages and chat completions endpoints, per-request choice of who pays; not for batches, Managed Agents, subscription plans or cloud-provider customers.

feature: Linked billing setup, testing limits and billing errors
detail: OAuth app with Bill and link to organizations permission; test mode allows up to 10 users with monthly limit of $50 or less; 402/403/503 errors; usage by user_profile_id in analytics API; HIPAA, FERPA and CMEK customers cannot link; some promotional credits cannot pay.

feature: Link your Console org to a third-party app (customer side)
detail: Admin or Billing member approves a connection so the app bills usage to your organization without sharing an API key; requires Anthropic direct billing; subscription plans and marketplace/cloud-provider orgs cannot link.

feature: Per-app monthly spend limit for linked platforms
detail: On the Console Linked platforms page set a whole-dollar monthly limit per app (or default), $0 refuses all; emails at 80% and 100%; limit not exact; unlink anytime; calls stop in about 10 seconds; apps in testing need limit of $50 or less.

feature: Computer use: Claude sees the screen and works in allowed desktop apps
detail: Claude clicks and types in apps a user approves through Claude Desktop (macOS 14+ and Windows), also reachable from web and mobile when Computer access is on and Desktop is open. Works only in unified chat/Cowork, not Cowork tasks or Claude Code. Off by default.

feature: Computer use admin toggle and Enterprise custom-role scoping
detail: Owners turn on Computer use under Capabilities (requires Chat and Cowork unified); Enterprise can limit it to custom roles with Edit role access; built-in roles get it automatically; changes take about an hour to reach Desktop; not for HIPAA, ZDR-for-Code, CMEK, FERPA/K-12.

feature: Computer use app access block list or allow list
detail: Owners choose Block these apps or Allow only these apps (macOS bundle IDs, Windows exe names or AUMIDs); users still approve each app. Lists do not cover Chrome extension, built-in browser, Claude Code, extensions, remote desktops, copied text or Record a skill.

feature: computerUseEnabled MDM key and macOS PPPC permissions
detail: Set computerUseEnabled false at machine level (Desktop 5.1231.0+) to keep it off; PPPC payload can preset Accessibility and allow standard users to set Screen Recording. Users still enable Enable computer use themselves per computer and account.

feature: Computer use screenshots are saved with the chat
detail: Screenshots may hold sensitive content, are stored with the chat, and the latest one may be seen by the automated action check and retained in its record; no sandbox between Claude and apps.

feature: Claude use cases: writing, learning, summarizing, coding, translation, image ana
detail: Overview of tasks Claude helps with: drafting, learning topics, summaries, coding in major languages, brainstorming, translation (best in English, then Portuguese, French, German), and analyzing images.

feature: Prompt design guidance: treat Claude like a new contractor
detail: Advice to give Claude very specific instructions and context since it knows nothing about you or your task; ask follow-ups or have it rewrite.

feature: Report content: in-product report on shared conversations and report form
detail: Users can report a shared Claude conversation via a report button or standalone form, and report policy-violating or unlawful output through a form; copyright and trademark disputes follow a separate path.

feature: Site owner controls for Claude web search results
detail: Site owners can remove content, password-protect, use noindex, robots.txt for images/video, disallow Anthropic bots, or request blocking of a URL appearing in outputs with proof of ownership.

feature: Safety filters and enhanced safety filters
detail: Detection models flag harmful content, prompt filters may block responses, and enhanced filters can be temporarily applied to users who repeatedly violate policy; not failsafe.

feature: Ways to access Claude: web, iOS, Android, Desktop, Console/API
detail: Claude is reachable through claude.ai, Claude for iOS, Claude for Android, Claude Desktop and the Claude Console/API.

feature: Plus menu and slash command in the chat box
detail: A + button at lower left or typing / in the chat box opens extra options and commands.

feature: Model selector shown below input (web, desktop) or at top (mobile)
detail: The current model is displayed and tapping it opens the selector; users can also set effort and extended thinking per response.

feature: Free plan usage limit resets every five hours
detail: Free usage is session-based with a five-hour reset, varies with demand, and Claude notifies you when you hit a limit or exceed the context window.

feature: Supported locations and 18+ age requirement
detail: Claude is usable only from supported locations and by people aged 18 or older.

feature: Memory import from other AI providers; no chat-history import
detail: Conversation history from other AI providers cannot be imported, but Free, Pro, Max and Ultra can import memory from other providers.

feature: Model knowledge cutoffs
detail: Lists cutoffs per model: Fable 5.2, Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 to June 2026; Opus 5 May 2026; Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Opus 4.8, 4.7 January 2026; Sonnet 4.6, Opus 4.6 August 2025; Haiku 4.5 July 2025; Opus 3 August 2023.

feature: HIPAA: BAA activation by Primary Owner in HIPAA-ready Enterprise org
detail: Primary Owner activates HIPAA under Data and privacy and accepts the BAA; covers only that org and excludes Console, Cowork in the cloud, and beta features such as Office, Design, Slides, Docs. Covered models need 30-day retention, not ZDR.

feature: BAA-covered Enterprise chat features
detail: Chat, projects in chat, artifacts in chat, file creation and code execution (no network), voice, web search and research are covered; skills, connectors, Ask Your Org and Claude in Chrome are usable but third-party data flows are not covered and skills/Chrome are off by default.

feature: HIPAA configuration for Claude Code and Cowork local mode
detail: Applying it brings terminal Code, Code tab and Cowork in Desktop under the BAA; extensions, cloud-provider or gateway Code, and Console API key without ZDR are not covered. Cloud sessions, mobile Code, Remote Control, Dispatch, computer access, scheduled cloud tasks, Code Review, Security, session sharing are unavailable.

feature: HIPAA mode: tools, memory and permission modes in local sessions
detail: Web search, voice, scheduled local tasks, auto memory and Automatically approve are covered; web fetch, computer use, built-in browser, screenshot capture and Skip all approvals unavailable; Bypass permissions covered; Fast mode and Chrome not covered; connectors, local MCP and extensions not covered.

feature: HIPAA mode: skills, sharing and monitoring
detail: Skills/plugins are off until Owner enables Skills (not covered) with separate toggles for user-created, sharing and group sharing; Record a skill, artifact publishing, transcript export and feedback unavailable; Compliance API, /usage, /stats, /insights available; OpenTelemetry not covered.

feature: BAA for API: eligible vs ineligible features
detail: Messages API with prompt caching, structured outputs, memory, web search, bash and text editor, plus token counting, models, org management, compliance and computer use APIs are covered; Batch, Files, Skills, Code Execution and Web Fetch are not; Claude in Foundry covered.

feature: Claude Console account for API access
detail: Organizations create a Console account to make API keys, add teammates, set billing and use the playground; subject to Commercial Terms.

feature: API usage tiers Start, Build, Scale, Custom
detail: Rate limits depend on tier (plus Evaluation tier for new orgs); measured in requests, input tokens and output tokens per minute; higher limits can be requested once at 50% of current usage.

feature: Monthly API credits for Max, Ultra and Team plans
detail: Max, Ultra and Team subscribers can link a Console org to claim monthly API credits without a payment method.

feature: Console prompt improver adapts prompts from other models
detail: Console tool that rewrites prompts originally written for other LLMs to work with Claude.

feature: Rename or delete a conversation on web
detail: Via the three-dot menu on a chat in the sidebar or Chats and tasks; confirm deletion; conversation leaves history immediately and is purged from back-end within 30 days.

feature: Bulk delete conversations on web with Select and Select all
detail: From Chats and tasks choose Select, tick chats or Select all, then Delete and confirm.

feature: Rename or delete conversation on iOS by long-press
detail: Touch and hold a chat in the list (View all) to rename or delete, or use the three-dot menu on the open chat to delete.

feature: Rename, delete and multi-delete conversations on Android
detail: Three-dot menu on the open chat renames or deletes; checklist icon in chat list enables multi-select with trash icon.

feature: Supported document and image upload types
detail: Documents: PDF, DOCX, CSV, TXT, HTML, ODT, RTF, EPUB, JSON, and XLSX (needs code execution and file creation on); images JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP.

feature: Upload paths: plus menu, drag and drop, paste from clipboard
detail: Add files or photos from the + menu, drag into the chat window, or paste copied images; files can go to a chat or to a project Files section.

feature: Chat upload limits
detail: 500 MB per file, up to 20 files per chat, images up to 8000x8000 pixels, PDFs up to 1000 pages; larger PDFs error as too large.

feature: Project file limits
detail: 30 MB per file, unlimited count but total content must fit the context window; text extraction only except multimodal PDFs.

feature: PDF processing: visuals analyzed up to 100 pages, text only to 1000
detail: PDFs of 100 pages or fewer get text and visual analysis (charts, images); 101-1000 pages are text only.

feature: Account bans, appeals, warnings and data export for banned users
detail: Banned users can log in to claude.ai to file an appeal, export data (possibly restricted) or delete the account; users in an org on hold see it and can Request a review; policy warnings are issued for violating prompts.

feature: API rate limit metrics: RPM, ITPM, OTPM
detail: Limits per organization in requests, input tokens and output tokens per minute; 429 with retry-after when exceeded.

feature: Phone number verification at signup
detail: Six-digit SMS code from a supported-location number is required; no VoIP, landlines or app numbers; max three accounts per number; number cannot be changed afterward.

feature: Pro plan benefits and price
detail: $20 per month in the US (local currency elsewhere), cheaper annual billing; more usage than Free, priority access, early features, Claude Code access, longer multi-step tasks; no Console API usage included.

feature: Pro five-hour and weekly usage limits, reset time and limit resets
detail: Five-hour session limit plus weekly all-model limit that resets at an account-fixed time (see Settings Usage); limit resets can refill them; usage credits extend use beyond limits.

feature: No standing discounts for individual plans; nonprofit pricing for Team and Enter
detail: No coupons for Pro, Max, Ultra; occasional promotions; eligible nonprofits get discounts on Team and Enterprise.

feature: Upgrade to Pro via Settings Billing, monthly or annual, auto-renews
detail: Sign up with email or Google, Settings Billing Upgrade plan Get Pro plan, choose period and pay by card; renews automatically; paid plans only in supported locations.

feature: Cancel Pro, Max or Ultra on web, iOS or Android
detail: Cancel in Settings Billing (web/desktop) or Manage subscription in the app store flow; effective at period end, cancel 24 hours before billing date; purchased usage credits are not refunded and need an active plan; Personal Finance locks.

feature: Monthly API credits expire each cycle and are non-refundable
detail: Credits bundled with Max, Ultra and Team are not purchased, expire at cycle end, and stop accruing after cancellation.

feature: Billing settings: invoices, payment methods, invoice name, default card
detail: Settings Billing offers invoice view and emailed receipts, update/add/remove cards, set default, different name on invoices; paid invoices cannot be edited; billing date cannot be changed; web accepts cards only.

feature: Model improvement data protections and incognito exclusion
detail: When chats help improve Claude, data is de-linked from user ID, access limited, filtered; incognito chats are never used; safety-flagged chats may still be used; users can change the setting anytime.

feature: Account email address cannot be changed
detail: The email on a Claude account is fixed; to switch, cancel any paid plan, ask Support to unlink the phone number, export data, then delete the old account and sign up anew.

feature: Supported countries list
detail: Claude is available in a long list of countries and territories (for example US, UK, Canada, EU members, Japan, India, Brazil, Australia); users must be physically in one to sign up or pay.

feature: Thumbs-down feedback on unhelpful responses and hallucination guidance
detail: Users can mark a response unhelpful with thumbs down; guidance says to check cited sources from web search and not treat Claude as sole truth source.

feature: Console playground replaces Workbench
detail: Stateless Console playground built on the Messages API: model selector, system prompt, temperature and max tokens, tools, structured outputs, raw request/response view, export as code; no saved prompts, history or evals. Workbench is retired.

feature: Chat context windows by model on paid plans
detail: On Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise chat: 1M tokens for Fable 5.2, 5.1, Opus 5.5, 5, Sonnet 5.5, 5, Haiku 5.5; 500K for Fable 5, Opus 4.8/4.7/4.6, Sonnet 4.6; 200K otherwise.

feature: Claude Code context windows (1M on most models)
detail: 1M tokens on current models; Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 1M via [1m] model suffix with /model and usage credits enabled (Pro; Enterprise usage-based exempt).

feature: Cowork context windows by model
detail: 1M for most current models, Haiku 5.5 500K, 200K for Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5; Sonnet 5 auto-compacts at 500K.

feature: Automatic context management summarizes older messages
detail: With code execution enabled, Claude summarizes earlier messages as the window fills so chats continue indefinitely; full history stays referenceable and long chats use more limit. Tips: use projects (RAG), concise instructions, few tools.

feature: Model menu next to send button: model, effort, thinking
detail: One menu controls model choice (More models for others), effort level and thinking toggle; changes apply from next response; Enterprise admins may hide models or effort levels or fix the default.

feature: Effort levels Low, Medium, High, Extra high, Max
detail: Effort selector on Fable 5.2, Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1, Opus 5, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Opus 4.7, 4.6, Sonnet 4.6; each model has a Default; xhigh for long coding/agentic work on Opus 4.7 and newer; higher effort uses more tokens.

feature: Thinking toggle (Extended) and always-on thinking models
detail: Toggle under Effort (or Extended) shows an expandable Thinking section with timer; cannot be turned off on Fable 5.2, Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5, Fable 5.1, Opus 5, so lower the effort instead.

feature: Incomplete thought process notice
detail: If thinking touches content flagged as elevated risk, the thinking summary is cut off with a message that the rest is unavailable.

feature: Color mode: Light, Match System, Dark
detail: Settings Appearance (or General in older layout) offers three color modes.

feature: Chat font choice including Dyslexic Friendly
detail: Chat font options are Default, Match System, and Dyslexic Friendly.

feature: Sidebar can be toggled but not disabled
detail: Button at top right of the sidebar opens or closes it; it cannot be removed entirely.

feature: Anthropic crawlers: ClaudeBot, Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot
detail: Three bots for training collection, user-directed fetches and search indexing; site owners control each through robots.txt including Crawl-delay; anti-circumvention respected; from Oct 30, 2026 a no-AI-training preference signal is honored. Claude-Agent browsing noted for Duet.

feature: Console prepaid credits, auto-reload, invoicing
detail: API, playground and Claude Code via Console use prepaid credits bought by Admin/Billing (expire after one year, non-refundable), optional auto-reload with threshold and target, or monthly invoicing; failed calls not charged.

feature: Monthly API credits cannot be used in Claude Code or apps
detail: Credits bundled with Max, Ultra, Team are spent first on API usage, expire each cycle, and cannot pay for Claude apps, Claude Code, extra usage or linked-billing third-party usage.

feature: Claude account and Console account can share an email but are independent
detail: One email may hold a Claude account and a Console account; they operate separately.

feature: Claude draws diagrams, charts and interactive visuals in chat (no photo generati
detail: Claude does not make photos or illustrations but builds HTML/SVG diagrams, charts and interactive visuals in conversation that can be adjusted by follow-up; beta on web and desktop. It can also read uploaded images.

feature: Support messenger with Fin AI bot and written Product Support
detail: Get help in the profile menu opens a messenger to search docs and chat with Fin, with human escalation by plan; replies arrive in chat and by email; no phone or live chat; chatting with Fin does not use Claude usage.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Support access by plan and Enterprise designated support contacts
detail: Pro/Max/Ultra, Team and Enterprise owners and Console admins reach Product Support; Team non-owners rely on Fin or owner escalation; Enterprise owners can designate support contacts; Free users get docs, Fin and account deletion help.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: I can't login support path for deletion, export and subscription help
detail: Logged-out users can start a conversation from the Help Center and pick I can't login to get account deletion, data export and subscription cancellation or refund checks.

feature: Regional compliance contacts for EU DSA, UK OSA and Australia
detail: Help Center links point to the EU single point of contact and reporting routes for UK Online Safety Act and Australian DIS Standard concerns.

feature: CSAM hash detection and NCMEC reporting
detail: First-party services compute perceptual hashes of uploaded images, compare to NCMEC known-CSAM hashes, report matches and notify the user or organization.

feature: Delete account (permanent) on web, iOS and Android
detail: Via Settings Account Delete account on web, Settings Profile on iOS, Profile Account Actions on Android; irreversible, loses chats, projects and credits; paid plans cancel and lapse first; Team members can close just a personal account.

feature: External Researcher Access Program: free API credits
detail: Application for free API credits (typically $1000) for AI safety and alignment research, evaluated monthly on the first Monday; no Usage Policy exemption, no non-public models; credits do not apply to claude.ai.

feature: API safeguards recommendations for deployers
detail: Guidance to store call IDs, hash user IDs, moderate inputs, warn or suspend violators, and use human review; Anthropic runs default real-time safeguards with no opt-in filter.

feature: Output blocked by content filtering policy error
detail: Refusal shown when output would reproduce existing copyrighted material; repeated attempts to elicit it can lead to warning or suspension.

feature: Team and Enterprise data ownership: Primary Owner controls data
detail: Primary Owner manages the workspace, can export user data and remove access; org governs available features; Anthropic acts as processor and consumer terms do not apply.

feature: Commercial data: customer is controller, no training on data
detail: For Team and Enterprise, customer controls membership and export while Anthropic processes data and does not train on it unless in the Development Partner Program.

feature: Claude for iOS and Claude for Intune apps; iOS 18 minimum
detail: Standard Claude by Anthropic app plus a managed Claude for Intune version for Enterprise using Microsoft Intune; both require iOS or iPadOS 18.0 or newer; uninstalling does not cancel a subscription.

feature: Upgrade to Pro inside the iOS app
detail: Tap initials, then Upgrade to Pro and complete an in-app purchase.

feature: Team plan standard and premium seats and pricing
detail: Minimum two members, up to 150 seats; Standard $25 monthly or $20 annual per member, Premium $125 monthly or $100 annual (US, excl. tax); Standard 1.25x Pro per-session usage, Premium 6.25x; limits per member; usage credits optional.

feature: Team plan included features
detail: Admin tools and billing, SSO with domain capture, JIT provisioning, role permissions, spend controls, enterprise search project, connectors (Drive, Gmail, Calendar, GitHub, Microsoft 365, Slack), Claude Code, Cowork, projects, 200k context, monthly API credits.

feature: Create Team org: business email required, upgrade in place or keep personal sepa
detail: Creator needs a non-public-domain work email; existing Free/Pro/Max/Ultra can upgrade in place (organization ID kept, prorated refund, public projects become private) or keep personal separate; App Store subscriptions create a new org.

feature: Team monthly API credits pooled up to $500, claimable after seven days
detail: One Owner links a Console org in Organization settings Billing API credits; needs Owner/Admin/Billing role in Console.

feature: Close personal account: Bring what you can or Start fresh
detail: After separate Team upgrade, Settings Account Close your personal account moves what can move into the Team or starts fresh and deletes the personal account.

feature: Role permissions: User, Admin, Owner, Primary Owner
detail: Users chat and use projects; Admins invite/remove members and (Enterprise) view analytics; Owners manage billing, integrations, capabilities, public projects, roles, SSO, audit logs, retention, feedback settings; only Primary Owner requests data exports and ownership transfer; one Primary Owner, may be a service account.

feature: Custom roles by group on Enterprise
detail: Members set to Custom have no default permissions; access comes from custom roles assigned to their groups.

feature: Team billing: proration, seat upgrades and pooled API credits
detail: Adding seats or upgrading prorates immediately; removing members gives no credit but frees the seat; billed on seat count at cycle start; API credit pool scales with seats (example $260 for 3 Standard plus 2 Premium).

feature: Cancel Team plan at Organization settings Billing
detail: Owner or Primary Owner cancels; access lasts to cycle end; member removal option disappears after cancel; monthly API credits stop and are not refunded.

feature: Move personal account into Team or Enterprise org (voluntary migration)
detail: From Settings Account Close your personal account (web or Desktop only), same email required: Bring what you can moves chats, artifacts, projects, files, memory, Claude Code memory, instructions and Design projects; irreversible, personal account closes, signs out all devices.

feature: What does not move in migration
detail: Custom skills, Docs, Sheets, data artifacts, new-version projects, oversized chats, app connections, custom connectors, Personal Finance, published legacy artifacts, public share links, pending invites, cloud Cowork tasks and Code cloud sessions are left behind and deleted with the account.

feature: Start fresh and Keep both accounts options; export link for closed account
detail: Users may keep both accounts, bring work, or start fresh with Download your data or Delete your data (link expires in 24 hours, may work once); blocked in HIPAA-ready or CMEK orgs.

feature: Refunds after migration by purchase channel
detail: Direct subscriptions cancel with prorated refund about 24 hours later; Google Play asked to cancel and refund in 1-2 weeks; Apple App Store subscriptions are not canceled so users must cancel; monthly API credit link ends.

feature: Enterprise domain claiming of personal accounts
detail: Enterprise admins can claim existing personal accounts on a verified domain; users get an email and notice with a deadline of at least 30 days to bring work or start fresh; HIPAA/CMEK orgs only allow start fresh.

feature: Switch between personal and organization accounts from the account menu
detail: Initials menu in lower left lists both accounts with a blue checkmark on the active one; each has separate chats and projects.

feature: Policy updates: Usage Policy, disclosure requirements, 30-day default retention,
detail: Notes the rename to Usage Policy with high-risk use cases and AI disclosure requirements, UK terms with Anthropic Ireland, and a default data retention period of 30 days.

feature: Guidelines for organizations serving minors
detail: Orgs building on the API for minors should add age verification, moderation, monitoring and education, comply with laws like COPPA, disclose AI, and may use an Anthropic child-safety system prompt.

feature: Payment methods: cards accepted, ACH for some, no PayPal or Venmo
detail: Credit and debit cards for all purchases, ACH for self-serve Enterprise and invoiced API accounts; 3D Secure may be required; billing address must match a supported location.

feature: Export your Claude data from Settings Privacy
detail: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra export chats, account data and shared voice recordings (no uploaded file originals or Personal Finance) with an emailed link valid 24 hours, possibly single use; not possible from mobile apps; cannot import into another account.

feature: Team and Enterprise member export needs owner toggle
detail: Members can export their own chats only if an owner enables Allow members to export their own data; Primary Owners instead export whole-org data from Organization settings Data and privacy.

feature: Projects: workspaces with chat history, knowledge and instructions
detail: Self-contained workspaces with project knowledge uploads and per-project instructions; available on Free with a maximum of five projects; context is not shared across chats unless added to knowledge.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Project RAG expands knowledge capacity up to 10x
detail: Paid plans automatically switch to retrieval mode when knowledge nears context limits.

feature: New version of projects (beta): one conversation with parallel cloud threads
detail: A project becomes a single conversation where Claude spawns parallel cloud threads that keep running when you close your laptop, share project files, repos, instructions and memory, and a Library of files; rolling out starting in Claude Code; waitlist; existing projects migrate with email notice.

feature: Project sharing with Can view and Can edit (Team and Enterprise)
detail: Creators share by email or bulk list or with the whole org; Can edit modifies instructions and knowledge and members; Shared with me tab and email notifications; Owners can disable sharing, which also disables public projects.

feature: Create a project: name, description, visibility, required tags
detail: New Project from Projects page; name and description are not visible to Claude; Team/Enterprise choose private or whole-org visibility; Enterprise may require project tag values.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Move chats into or between projects
detail: Chat dropdown Add to project opens a Move chat modal; chats can also be removed from or moved between projects.

feature: Star, archive, unarchive and delete projects
detail: Star from page or project for sidebar access; archiving keeps sharing and members and archived projects cannot be deleted until unarchived; delete confirms with Yes, delete.

feature: Per-project memory and Use account memory toggle
detail: Each project has its own memory used with account memory but not other projects; Use account memory off isolates it; Memory in the plus menu off for a single chat; memory on by default for Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, owner-controlled on Team/Enterprise.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Projects page tabs: Your projects, Organization, Shared with you
detail: Three tabs help find created, org-shared and individually shared projects.

feature: Project visibility: public to org or private invited-only
detail: General access dropdown in Share switches between Everyone at org and Only people invited anytime; chats inside a public project stay private unless shared.

feature: Share a project with a Group (Enterprise beta)
detail: Share to a group so access follows membership; admin must enable Share resources with this group; changes take up to five minutes; deleting a group removes access.

feature: When project sharing is disabled by admin
detail: Share menu says sharing is turned off, existing access can be changed or removed, existing shares stay, public projects become private.

feature: Share, update and unshare a chat link
detail: Share creates a snapshot link including artifacts; later messages stay private until Update next to New messages since last shared; set to Private to disable the link.

feature: Console Usage and Cost pages with model, key and workspace breakdown
detail: Developer, Billing and Admin roles see usage by model, date, API key with filters down to hour and minute.

feature: Console rate-limit usage charts and CSV export
detail: Usage page shows ITPM/OTPM against limits with cache rate, rate-limited requests, and CSV export; Cost page shows per-model daily cost including web search and code execution; no per-user breakdown.

feature: Artifact sharing options by plan
detail: Artifacts are private by default; Share with link (Pro/Max/Ultra/Team/Enterprise), org-wide or named people (Team/Enterprise), groups (Enterprise), email invite (beta, Pro and up), legacy publish (Free-Ultra) or Share and copy link (Team/Enterprise). Sharing cannot be changed from mobile apps.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Artifact access levels: Can view, Commenter, Can edit
detail: View reads and sees comments; Commenter adds comments and downloads offered files; Editor changes it but cannot delete and can upload only images and videos.

feature: Invite people to an artifact by email (beta)
detail: Owner (or editors on Team/Enterprise) invites by email; invitee needs a Claude account with that address; pending invites expire in 30 days, max 50 outsiders per artifact; invitees can report unexpected invitations; same-org addresses are added directly.

feature: Artifact viewer rules: own connections, shared storage, link-only visitors
detail: Viewers use their own connector access; link visitors outside the org see artifacts without Claude or connector features and cannot comment; stored shared data is visible to signed-in viewers; docs require sign-in and are view-only.

feature: Legacy artifact publish, embed code and unpublish
detail: Free-Ultra publish gives a public link usable without an account, an Allowed domains embed code, and Unpublish which is permanent and deletes stored data; Team/Enterprise Share and copy link gives viewers chat attachments access.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Owner controls for outside artifact access and creator-leaves cleanup
detail: Owners control External sharing and email invitations outside the org, and can stop sharing or delete artifacts by name in Organization settings Artifacts Published artifacts.

feature: Claude for Android install and Android 8.0 minimum
detail: Install Claude by Anthropic from Play Store on Android 8.0 Oreo or newer; uninstalling does not cancel subscription.

feature: Upgrade to Pro inside the Android app
detail: Tap initials top right, Upgrade to Pro, complete in-app purchase.

feature: API key best practices and GitHub secret scanning partnership
detail: Guidance on environment variables, rotation, separate keys, KMS and spend limits; GitHub notifies Anthropic of exposed Claude keys in public repos and Anthropic auto-deactivates them and emails the owner.

feature: Deleting chats on Team and Enterprise; custom retention on Enterprise
detail: Deleting chats removes them from visible history while backend retention rules still apply; Enterprise can set custom retention timelines.

feature: Console Workspaces: separate API resources, keys, limits and spend
detail: Admins create up to 100 workspaces with members and roles, per-workspace API keys, rate limits, spend limits and email notifications, usage views and archiving; default workspace cannot be renamed or deleted; one Console org per email.

feature: Enterprise plan: single seat with usage billed at API rates
detail: Seat fee covers access only and all usage in Claude, Claude Code and Cowork is billed at API rates with no per-seat limits; admins set org and per-user spend limits; includes audit logs, SCIM, retention controls, Compliance and Analytics APIs, CMEK, US-only inference, HIPAA readiness.

feature: Self-serve vs sales-assisted Enterprise purchase
detail: Self-serve: min 20 seats, card or ACH, USD, upfront credits; sales-assisted: min 50 seats, invoicing and multi-currency, billed monthly in arrears; also on AWS Marketplace; ACH activation can take five business days and has no auto-reload.

feature: Legacy Enterprise seat types ending at renewal
detail: Chat, Chat + Claude Code, Standard and Premium seat models end at next contract renewal and move to the single Enterprise seat; seat-based plans keep usage limits and usage credits until then.

feature: Factors that affect usage limits
detail: Message length, attachment size, conversation length, tool use like Research and web search, model, effort level and artifact use all affect how fast limits are used.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Settings Usage page: session, weekly limits and credits meter
detail: Shows five-hour session progress with time remaining, weekly limits (all models, and Fable if included), usage credits; verified Ultra accounts show no five-hour limit; usage-based Enterprise shows consumption.

feature: Project content caching reduces limit use; cache expires after inactivity
detail: Documents in projects are cached and count less when reused, with first message after a long break counting in full.
plans: Free, Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise

feature: Paid plans can search past chats and use memory to save context
detail: Pro and above can ask Claude to search earlier conversations and use memory and project summaries to avoid repeating context.

feature: Claude plans and Console API billed separately
detail: Subscriptions cover the apps; API through the Console is separate, except monthly API credits on Max, Ultra and Team.

feature: Add Tax or VAT ID and different invoice name on paid individual plans
detail: At signup or via Settings Billing Update; optional field appears for eligible addresses; Use a different name on invoices and Bill to field; changes apply only to future invoices.

feature: Console organization tax or VAT ID setting
detail: Add at signup or on the Console Organization page and save.

feature: Team plan tax or VAT ID and invoice name via owner billing settings
detail: Owner enters Tax or VAT ID and a different invoice name in Organization settings Billing; applies to future billing cycles only.

feature: Org controls: Share projects and Public projects toggles
detail: Owners (and Enterprise custom roles with Privacy Can manage) switch Share projects and Public projects in Data and privacy Sharing, both on by default; turning sharing off keeps existing shares but makes public projects private; Enterprise can set Share projects per role with up to 15 minutes delay.

feature: Audit log export (180 days) by Owners
detail: Enterprise Owners click Export logs in Data and Privacy to get an emailed link (active 24 hours) of the past 180 days; chat and project titles/contents are excluded; not possible with CMEK (use Compliance API).

feature: Audit log schema and recorded event types
detail: Columns include timestamp, actor, event, entity, IP, device ID, user agent and client platform; events cover sign-ins (SSO, Google, Apple, magic link, phone), project and document changes, invites, user deletion, SSO and JIT toggles, domain verification, org data export, file uploads and conversation create/rename/delete.

feature: Admin rollout guide and Admin plugin
detail: Guide for planning access, assigning owners and verifying rollout; an Admin plugin handles permissions, approvals and supported admin workflows.

feature: Configure dots permissions
detail: Admins manage dots access, communication, computers and custom rules.

feature: Manage Space sharing and access
detail: Admins control Library sharing permissions and help members share pages.

feature: Sites administration
detail: Admins enable sites, configure connections and review hosting, access controls and data responsibilities.

feature: Teams and Team Tasks setup
detail: Set team permissions, connect shared accounts and create recurring tasks.

feature: Set up @ChatGPT in Slack or Teams
detail: Admin prerequisites and responsibilities for deploying @ChatGPT in Slack or Microsoft Teams.

feature: Workspace connection for company-managed accounts
detail: Prepare company-managed accounts and configure a workspace connection.

feature: Local computer access for Work Cloud and dots
detail: Admins review shared policies and enable local computer access separately for Work and dots.

feature: Authentication overview: sign-in methods and enforcement
detail: Compare sign-in methods, credential storage and enforcement controls.

feature: Groups, dynamic groups and SCIM provisioning
detail: Membership from several sources, rule-based dynamic groups from SCIM attributes, and user lifecycle management that provisions users and revokes departing users' credentials.

feature: Roles and workspace permissions
detail: Reference for workspace, runtime, API, plugin and source-system controls.

feature: Personal access tokens
detail: Create and manage tokens for programmatic access.

feature: Service accounts
detail: Create and manage workspace identities for automated workflows.

feature: Windows app and CLI deployment
detail: Deploy the Windows app and Codex CLI on managed Windows devices.

feature: Codex with an NFS home directory
detail: Guidance for migrating a shared Linux home, verifying cross-host resume or using local scratch.

feature: Manage app updates
detail: Control desktop app updates and deploy approved versions through device management.

feature: Managed configuration
detail: Admins set required Codex defaults and policy precedence with supported runtime requirements.

feature: Desktop browser policies
detail: Deploy supported Chrome policies to the built-in desktop browser via device management.

feature: Self-hosted Codex configuration
detail: Serve Codex defaults and required settings from the organization's own HTTPS endpoint.

feature: Remote connections
detail: Start and control work on connected computers.

feature: Workspace model availability
detail: Separate model access for ChatGPT, Codex desktop, CLI, IDE extension, Codex cloud and Platform API.

feature: Run via Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI or GovCloud
detail: Connect local clients to models through Bedrock, Vertex AI (preview) or Bedrock in AWS GovCloud.

feature: Connect to an organization model gateway
detail: Use an organization gateway with or without ChatGPT sign-in; includes a rollout guide for routes and credentials.

feature: ChatGPT EDU plans and campus roles
detail: Compare education plans, set campus roles and recommended permissions, manage multiple workspaces.

feature: ChatGPT Work admin: cloud and local security, cost
detail: Reference for local and cloud execution, Local computer access, retention, audit visibility, shared credits and spending controls.

feature: GPTs sharing and ownership controls
detail: Manage GPT sharing, ownership, connected apps and third-party actions workspace-wide.

feature: Plugin and skill controls for admins
detail: Control plugin installation, bundled skills, connector actions and source-system permissions; compare workspace, local filesystem and plugin skill controls.

feature: Import and sync workspace plugins from GitHub
detail: Admins import and keep workspace plugins in sync from GitHub.

feature: Migrate custom GPTs to plugins
detail: Plan transition, migrate single GPTs or eligible batches, test and share replacement plugins.

feature: Workspace analytics, Usage Insights and Analytics API
detail: Review ChatGPT adoption and Codex usage, assess workflow results, and automate developer-activity and code-review reporting through an API.

feature: Retired untrusted approval policy
detail: The untrusted approval policy is no longer supported and can stop clients from starting; use read-only sandbox with on-request approvals instead.

feature: Sandbox modes and approval policies
detail: Two layers: a sandbox mode limiting what commands can touch and an approval policy deciding when to ask. Local default has no network and writes limited to the workspace.

feature: Auto preset: workspace-write with on-request approval
detail: Reads, edits and runs commands in the workspace automatically; asks before editing outside it or using network.

feature: Recommended mode by folder type
detail: Version-controlled folders default to Auto; non-version-controlled folders to read-only; may start read-only until the directory is trusted.

feature: Switch to read-only with /permissions
detail: Slash command to change mode for chatting or planning without edits.

feature: Slash command /status shows workspace directories
detail: Shows which directories count as the workspace (cwd and temp directories).

feature: Approval for connector and MCP tool calls
detail: Tool calls advertising side effects can request approval; destructive-annotated tools always require it unless marked read.

feature: Safety monitoring can pause tasks ((model name))
detail: Asynchronous monitoring in Codex and ChatGPT Work may pause a task on unsafe behavior; review findings then resume. CLI, mobile and zero-data-retention setups end the task instead.

feature: Auto-review of approval requests
detail: A reviewer agent evaluates eligible approvals (sandbox escalation, network, permissions, tool calls) before they run; statuses Reviewing, Approved, Denied, Aborted, Timed out; uses extra usage; admins can constrain.

feature: Network access off by default; enable in workspace-write
detail: Commands have no network unless network_access is set true in config.

feature: Network proxy with domain allow and deny rules
detail: Optional network_proxy feature constrains command traffic: exact, *.sub and **.apex patterns, deny wins, global allow, SOCKS5, Unix socket allowlist, local binding off by default, DNS-rebinding checks.

feature: Web search modes: cached, indexed, live, disabled
detail: Default is cached OpenAI index; live via --search; disabled turns tool off. Full-access modes default to live.

feature: Protected paths in writable roots
detail: .git, .agents, .codex and .aws stay read-only recursively inside the workspace sandbox.

feature: Run without approval prompts
detail: --ask-for-approval never works with any sandbox; granular policy keeps chosen prompt categories interactive and auto-rejects others.

feature: Full access flag: --yolo / dangerously-bypass
detail: Disables sandbox and approvals; marked elevated risk.

feature: Sandbox/approval presets and profile files
detail: Save combinations as profile files and select with --profile; common combos include read-only CI and auto-review.

feature: Test sandbox: codex sandbox / codex debug
detail: Runs a command under the macOS, Linux or Windows sandbox, optionally with a permissions profile and denial logging.

feature: OS-level sandbox: Seatbelt, bwrap/seccomp, Windows MXC
detail: macOS uses Seatbelt, Linux bwrap plus seccomp, Windows MXC with legacy fallbacks, WSL2 uses Linux sandbox; WSL1 no longer supported.

feature: IDE: run Codex inside WSL2 setting
detail: VS Code setting keeps the agent in WSL2 on Windows.

feature: Dev Containers and Docker usage
detail: Run Codex in Dev Containers; use danger-full-access inside the container when it is the isolation boundary.

feature: Opt-in OpenTelemetry export
detail: Off by default; choose environment label, exporter none/otlp-http/otlp-grpc and whether to log prompt text; emits events for chats, requests, approvals, tool results.

feature: History persistence settings
detail: history.persistence and history.max_bytes control whether session transcripts are saved locally.

feature: Cloud execution policy and Legacy Cloud two-phase runtime
detail: Cloud containers run setup with network, then agent phase offline by default; secrets exist only in setup.

feature: AGENTS.md custom instructions layered by directory
detail: Codex reads a global file in its home folder, then project files from the repo root down to the working directory; closer files override earlier ones.

feature: AGENTS.override.md temporary override
detail: An override file in a directory (or the global home) takes precedence over AGENTS.md there without deleting it.

feature: Fallback instruction filenames
detail: project_doc_fallback_filenames lets other filenames such as a team guide count as instruction files.

feature: Instruction size limit (32 KiB default)
detail: project_doc_max_bytes caps combined instruction size; raise it or split into nested directories.

feature: Code Review Rules section in AGENTS.md
detail: A Code Review Rules section in the nearest AGENTS.md customizes what Codex flags in GitHub reviews.
