feature: Codex web search modes: cached, live, indexed, disabled
detail: Local Codex defaults to cached search from an OpenAI index; web_search config sets live, indexed or disabled, with allowed domains; full-access runs default to live and --search enables live for a CLI run.

feature: Custom model provider standalone web search
detail: A custom provider can opt in with supports_standalone_web_search; feature is under development and off by default.

feature: ChatGPT on the web: Chat vs Work selector, projects, model and reasoning picker
detail: Web sign-in then choose Chat or Work, start a chat or project, and pick model and reasoning level from the composer; Work yields documents, decks, spreadsheets, PDFs and Sites.

feature: Site tools (WebMCP) in the built-in browser
detail: Websites can expose predefined actions to ChatGPT Work and Codex via the proposed WebMCP standard, so the agent shares your live page and signed-in session; needs a supported model and managed-browser policy permitting it.

feature: Site tools menu and Enable site tools setting
detail: The built-in browser address bar has a Site tools menu listing a page's available tools and Recently used calls under Sources; each call gets a safety review, and Settings > Browser > Permissions can switch site tools off.

feature: OpenAI docs site tools: search, read and open pages, custom guide
detail: ChatGPT Learn and OpenAI Developers expose tools to search docs, read a page, read the current route, navigate, and start an async custom guide; Open in ChatGPT launches Learn beside a new chat.

feature: (model name) Astra and Sol launch (Nov 17 2026)
detail: Astra targets the hardest projects (complex code, template-following slides); Sol targets everyday coding, writing and multistep work; in ChatGPT Work, Codex and the API.

feature: Custom instructions for your dot
detail: Tell your dot how to respond via conversation or Customize > Behavior.

feature: Reply to your dot from an iOS notification
detail: Reply to your dot directly from a notification and share a photo from another app on iOS; also report a problem to the main dot in conversation.

feature: Text your dot via iMessage or RCS
detail: One-to-one texting with a dot including text, photos and voice messages through iMessage or RCS on Android.

feature: (model name) Terra for visual reasoning and computer use
detail: Fast model with strong image understanding and precise computer use, available in Work and Codex.

feature: Your dot iOS widget and Apple Shortcuts action
detail: Home Screen widget opens the dot conversation with optional message and call buttons; Shortcuts Open your dot has Messaging, Dictation and Call modes and can be assigned to the Action button.

feature: Create and customize your dot in the mobile app
detail: Name the dot, customize its look and connect plugins from your phone.

feature: Ultrafast mode for (model name) and Astra
detail: Faster token generation in Codex and Work, limited to the Pro $500 tier and eligible Enterprise/Edu plans.

feature: Dots: agents with ongoing responsibility
detail: A dot continues work between conversations and returns results for review; rolling out gradually to eligible accounts with an admin guide.

feature: Continue synced Work tasks across desktop, web and mobile
detail: With local computer access for Work Cloud enabled, eligible tasks started on desktop continue on web or mobile; the computer must stay online for local-resource steps.

feature: Reusable cloud environments for Codex
detail: Prepare and publish a cloud development setup once and reuse its filesystem in isolated workspaces for new tasks; can be shared in a workspace.

feature: Plugin Extensions: sidebar apps, panels, editors, forms in ChatGPT
detail: Plugins can add interface surfaces to ChatGPT; composer mentions need the desktop app and Free/Go web extensions are coming soon.

feature: MCP Events: ask ChatGPT to act on MCP server updates
detail: Users can have ChatGPT respond to updates from an MCP server through webhook delivery.

feature: Website annotations with Browser Annotation API
detail: Sites can attach context and preview controls to feedback made via annotations in supported desktop browsers.

feature: Team Tasks: scheduled or event-triggered work via a service account
detail: Teams run scheduled or event-triggered tasks through a service account and approved workspace connections.

feature: Workspace connections and Agent Security admin controls
detail: Admins manage company-owned shared connections and control tool, file and network access for local and cloud agents, with managed configuration.

feature: ChatGPT in Slack and Microsoft Teams
detail: Bring ChatGPT and approved tools into Slack and Teams conversations, managed by admins.

feature: (model name) Sol and Luna in Codex; (model name)
detail: Sol Medium is the suggested default for coding and Luna High for focused repeatable tasks at lower token prices; Astra adds advanced reasoning and computer use for complex work in Codex and Work.

feature: (model name) retirement on Oct 14 2026
detail: (model name) was retired from ChatGPT, Work and Codex on all plans on that date; saved model settings, defaults, custom agents and scheduled tasks needed updating; API unaffected.

feature: Quick chat from floating Pets controls
detail: Floating pet or Mini controls in the macOS/Windows desktop app take typed or voice requests; Option+Space (macOS) or Windows+Alt+P focuses Quick Chat, @ adds context and $ picks a skill.

feature: Settings > Pets companion choice
detail: Choose a companion pet or Mini mode for the floating controls.

feature: Appshots: share a frontmost app window
detail: On Windows press both Alt keys to send a screenshot plus window text into ChatGPT; on macOS Appshots can start a chat in the Pets controls when Appshot destination is Automatic.

feature: Control Edge, Brave, Opera and Vivaldi as well as Chrome
detail: Bring an open tab from these browsers into a Work/Codex chat; Opera supports control but no side chat.

feature: Cloud browser sign-in request
detail: On eligible plans a Work task needing a website account pauses for you to sign in through a dedicated flow, not in chat; does not link your local browser profile; unavailable for Enterprise/Edu.

feature: Scheduled tasks triggered by Gmail, Slack or GitHub events
detail: Tasks can start when a supported event occurs rather than on a fixed cadence; requires connecting the app and approving access, with admin control in managed workspaces.

feature: Apple Messages plugin on macOS
detail: Find chats, summarize and draft replies, and send via Messages after approving the message and recipients; Work and Codex only.

feature: Editable site URLs
detail: Pick a new ChatGPT-hosted address for an existing Site without redeploying; the old address redirects.

feature: Computer History: searchable timeline and memories from app and web activity
detail: macOS desktop feature, off by default; choose contributing apps/sites, pause, review and delete; Pro, Business, Enterprise (admin must enable), now also in EEA, Switzerland and UK.

feature: Unified pinned threads between desktop and iOS
detail: Pinned chats sync across the desktop app and iOS.

feature: Export public plugin metadata CSV
detail: Enterprise owners/admins download a CSV of visible public plugins from Admin > Plugins > Public (snapshot up to 48 hours old); not in FedRAMP workspaces.

feature: ChatGPT desktop app for Linux (preview)
detail: Install a .deb on Ubuntu/Debian or .rpm on Fedora, x64 and ARM64; supports projects, local files and Codex; Computer Use not yet available.

feature: Import setup from Claude Code, Claude Cowork or Cursor
detail: Desktop Settings > Import brings instructions, settings, skills, plugins, projects and recent work with optional automatic sync; Codex CLI /import does it for Claude Code or Cursor.

feature: Daybreak Blue and Red security access tiers
detail: Blue covers general defensive work (code review, incident response, patch validation); Red needs separate approval for purpose-trained models; both require Trusted Access for Cyber.

feature: ChatGPT Voice with uploaded files and Projects
detail: Ask about a document aloud or continue a project using its chats, sources and instructions in a voice conversation.

feature: Education plugins: College Student, College Educator, K-12 Educator
detail: Study guides, quizzes and flashcards; course planning and assessments; lesson planning and adapted materials, via Edu and Teachers district deployments.

feature: Library: attach saved files, search Library, formatted paste
detail: Web lets you add a saved Library file to a chat, search within Library and paste formatted text; search matches folders and titles across web/iOS/Android.

feature: Long pastes over 10,000 characters become attachments
detail: On every plan, large pasted text turns into an attachment; Show in text field moves it back into the message.

feature: Remaining Work usage shown in web sidebar
detail: Eligible personal and Business users see remaining ChatGPT Work usage and credit options in the sidebar; Work and Codex share limits.

feature: Thinking slider for (model name) Sol; Luna default on Free and Go
detail: Plus and Pro users adjust how much thought Sol uses in chat via a slider; Luna became the default model on Free and Go; Work and Codex behavior unchanged.

feature: Codex CLI 0.147: chat sections, Agent Plugins, --approve-for-me
detail: Adds persistent manually ordered chat sections, portable Agent Plugins with catalog search, import from Cursor/Claude Code, and --approve-for-me automatic approval review; Bedrock gets cached search and compaction.

feature: Codex CLI 0.146: named chats, pinned threads, side conversations, temporary forks
detail: /new and /clear accept a name, threads can be pinned, side conversations switch without closing, and temporary forks, executor-provided skills and workspace plugin publishing are added.

feature: (model name) Terra and Luna price cuts
detail: Terra 20% cheaper and Luna 80% cheaper in usage rates from July 30 2026.

feature: Built-in browser history search; Chrome extension side chat and Ask ChatGPT
detail: Built-in browser address bar finds pages from history or Google; the Chrome extension mentions open tabs, brings selected text into a side chat, asks about YouTube videos and has an Ask ChatGPT context-menu item; history use needs approval.

feature: Multi-repository review across a local project
detail: A local project with several folders shows each repo and changed lines and a Review button opens all diffs together.

feature: Generated image viewer: Focused and Canvas views with comments
detail: The expanded image viewer switches between Focused and Canvas, supports comments across images, choosing versions and targeted edits.

feature: Desktop Activity view (bell)
detail: A bell in the sidebar opens a view of recently engaged chats and work needing attention.

feature: ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program
detail: Eligible faculty and postdocs get 12 months of free workspace for teams up to five verified researchers with Pro-level limits and business data protections; no API credits.

feature: iOS 1.2026.202: reliable task reconnect and plugin suggestions
detail: Reconnects to Codex tasks after returning or Face ID unlock, voice uses chosen voice with usage warnings, composer suggests plugins and skills, plus goal pause/resume and large diffs.

feature: Codex Security CLI, CI SARIF upload and bulk scans
detail: The @openai/codex-security package runs scans from a terminal, reviews PR changes with SARIF upload in CI, and runs resumable bulk scans across GitHub repos or a CSV inventory.

feature: Codex app-server: pinned-thread filtering, in-memory forks, connector state
detail: For custom clients, app-server can filter pinned threads, create in-memory forks, inspect installed connector state, and has experimental WebSocket to remote Code Mode hosts.

feature: (model name) Sol powers Codex cloud code review and QA
detail: Codex cloud picks its model automatically (Sol for review/QA); Terra and Luna remain on local and web surfaces.

feature: (model name) and (model name) mini retired from Codex (Aug 31 2026)
detail: Retired for ChatGPT-signed-in Codex users, with replacements Terra and Luna; API-key sessions unaffected.

feature: ChatGPT Voice (GPT-Live) coordinates tasks across Chat, Work and Codex
detail: Start a chat or task in voice and ask it to start, check or steer other threads; on macOS saying take a look at this shares an appshot when Screen context is on. Also usable via Remote on iOS.

feature: Local projects with multiple folders and a primary folder
detail: Edit project lets you add related folders; the primary folder drives new chats, Git, and AGENTS.md/skills/config discovery, while secondary folders are searchable and editable.

feature: Chat and Work conversations together in desktop ChatGPT view; cloud Work syncs
detail: Cloud Work chats sync across web, mobile and desktop while local Work stays on the computer; Projects now exist in the desktop app and Codex keeps its own history.

feature: Codex Micro physical control surface
detail: A limited-run hardware keypad with agent keys showing up to six chats, command keys, analog stick and dial for actions, push-to-talk and reasoning effort.

feature: Amazon Bedrock provider for (model name) in local Work and Codex
detail: The built-in amazon-bedrock provider works with a Bedrock API key or AWS credential chain in the desktop app, CLI, IDE extension and Codex SDK, with AWS billing.

feature: Inline Codex task visualizations on iOS
detail: Mobile shows inline visualizations in Codex tasks and better task creation and links.

feature: (model name) model family: Sol, Terra, Luna with Power setting
detail: Sol is flagship for complex coding, computer use, research and security; Terra balances cost; Luna is fastest and cheapest. The default Power setting is Sol at medium reasoning.

feature: Codex merged into the ChatGPT desktop app (Jul 9 2026)
detail: The macOS/Windows ChatGPT desktop app hosts Chat, Work and Codex with inline diff editing, side-panel PR review, faster Computer Use and multi-repo projects; Codex can be the default view or app icon; available on every plan including Free.

feature: Record & Replay turns a macOS demonstration into a skill
detail: Show a workflow once on macOS and it becomes an editable reusable skill replayable with new inputs; needs Computer Use and excludes EEA, UK and Switzerland initially.

feature: Chat handoff between local computer and remote host
detail: Moves a chat and its Git state between your computer and a connected remote host, creating or reusing a worktree on the destination; scheduled run history gained bulk mark-read and archive.

feature: Remote on iOS: workspace file browser, directory picker, MCP approvals, branch/worktree setup
detail: The mobile Remote tab connects to a desktop host; it can browse files, pick a directory, choose a branch, create a worktree, run setup scripts, manage goals, comment on diffs, and approve MCP per chat or across chats; also optional app lock and SSH to Windows.

feature: Memories and Chronicle rollout to EEA, UK, Switzerland
detail: Computer Use, Chrome extension, Memories and Chronicle began rolling out there; Memories off by default and Chronicle is an opt-in Pro macOS research preview.

feature: Browser Developer mode with full CDP access
detail: Settings > Browser > Developer mode > Enable full CDP access lets Codex inspect network, console, errors and page state in Chrome and the built-in browser after explicit approval; browser use is up to 2x faster.

feature: /init command for project instructions and onboarding import
detail: Migration flows import supported setup from other coding agents, and /init creates project instructions; also plugin management and completed-chat summaries improved.

feature: Terminal placement and activity insights
detail: Desktop added terminal placement controls and activity insights in the profile view.

feature: Computer Use for Windows desktop apps
detail: Codex can see, click and type in Windows apps via the Computer Use plugin, taking over the foreground on the active desktop; Remote supports Windows hosts.

feature: iOS Remote: Spotlight, Shortcuts, /side, archived chats, save images
detail: Entry points via Spotlight and Shortcuts, a /side command, browsing archived chats and saving or copying rendered images.

feature: Search past chats by content and branch name
detail: Desktop search covers chat content and branch names, with consistent visual identifiers for background subagents and chat coordination for projects and worktrees.

feature: Appshots on macOS (press both Command keys)
detail: Sends the frontmost app window as a screenshot plus available text into a Codex chat.

feature: Goal mode for long-running objectives
detail: Left experimental; available in the app, IDE extension and CLI for objectives that run hours or days, with pause and resume.

feature: Locked use: computer use continues after Mac locks
detail: Approved computer-use work can continue after a Mac locks, including via Remote on mobile.

feature: Share plugin bundles with Business workspace members
detail: Business workspaces can share reusable plugin bundles with members.

feature: Codex in the ChatGPT mobile app via Remote
detail: Remote connects the phone to a Mac running the desktop app so work runs on the host with its projects, files, credentials, plugins and config.

feature: Hooks general availability
detail: Custom commands can run at key points in the agent lifecycle.

feature: Codex access tokens for Enterprise
detail: Admins can let members create tokens for trusted scripts, schedulers and private CI runners.

feature: Chrome extension works in parallel across background tabs
detail: The extension can operate on several tabs in the background without taking over the browser, limited to websites you allow.

feature: Dictation cleanup and custom dictionary
detail: Desktop dictation cleans up text and accepts a custom dictionary for names, file paths and code symbols.

feature: Computer Use inside the built-in browser; automatic approval review
detail: Codex can click through local dev servers and file pages to reproduce and verify; eligible approval requests can go through automatic approval review showing status and risk first.

feature: Built-in browser live previews and page comments
detail: The built-in browser added live previews and comments on pages; Computer Use operates macOS apps.

feature: Standalone chats without a project folder

detail: Automatic or @Codex-triggered reviews on GitHub cloud PRs.

feature: MCP servers
detail: STDIO and Streamable HTTP with OAuth; Settings > MCP servers or codex mcp add.

feature: Skills with SKILL.md and skill-creator
detail: Package workflows; personal skills in home .agents/skills, team skills in repo; share as plugins.

feature: Scheduled tasks page
detail: Choose project, prompt, cadence and worktree or local environment.

feature: Pin chats and worktrees
detail: Pin long-running chats and create Git worktrees.

feature: Session slash commands
detail: /resume, /fork, /compact, /subagents, /status, /apps, /theme, /experimental.

feature: Speech dictation to prompt Codex
detail: Dictate instructions in the desktop app.

feature: Subagents for bounded work
detail: Offload exploration, tests or triage to subagent threads.

feature: (model name) Sol and Astra in Codex
detail: Start with Sol; Astra for cross-package changes.

feature: Codex Cloud task VMs
detail: Each cloud task runs in its own virtual machine.

feature: GPT Image for references in Codex
detail: Generate or edit images for reference-guided builds.

feature: SVG and 3D Design plugin
detail: Plugin with a skill guiding editable SVGs, icons, CAD and 3D scenes.

feature: Concept art workflow for SVG and 3D
detail: Requests a GPT Image reference, refines it, builds assets; themes share one SVG.

feature: Codex VS Code extension with Azure DevOps and Databricks MCP
detail: Cited example for logs and change review.

feature: Codex SDK in release workflows
detail: Programmatic runs can summarize release commits.

feature: Windows app: install with winget
detail: The Windows app can be installed through winget using the Microsoft Store ID, useful for IT admins managing Enterprise installs (Jan 2025).

feature: Windows app: attach screenshot via Snipping Tool
detail: Take a window, full-screen or region screenshot with the Snipping Tool and insert it straight into the chat.

feature: Windows app: take a webcam photo and attach it
detail: Capture a photo with the webcam and attach it to the conversation.

feature: Windows app: Companion Window with Alt+Space
detail: A small quick-access chat window opened with Alt+Space; the shortcut is customizable in settings and an 'Open in main window' button moves the chat to the full app.
plans: Plus, Team, Enterprise, Edu (early); later all

feature: Windows app: Advanced Voice Mode
detail: Hands-free real-time voice conversation on Windows with interruption and emotion sensing.

feature: Windows app: search chat history with Ctrl+K
detail: Ctrl+K opens search across past chats to reference or resume them.

feature: Windows app: redesigned sidebar with floating mode
detail: The sidebar was redesigned and can float over the conversation.

feature: Windows app: text scaling with Ctrl plus/minus
detail: Text size can be adjusted using Ctrl+ and Ctrl-.

feature: Windows app: check for updates button in settings
detail: Settings has a button to manually check for app updates.

feature: Windows app: early access plan rollout
detail: The Windows app started as an early version for Plus, Team, Enterprise and Edu users in Oct 2024, with free users to follow.

feature: Sidebar search across chats, projects, images, files
detail: Search from the sidebar finds existing chats, projects, images and documents in the account or workspace, and Google Drive files/folders when connected; it does not search the web.

feature: Search shortcut Ctrl+K / Cmd+K
detail: On web, Ctrl+K (Windows) or Cmd+K (macOS) opens Search.

feature: Search filters: All, Chats, Images, Documents, Projects
detail: Content filters narrow sidebar search results; availability varies by account, workspace and device.

feature: Search matches archived chats but not deleted ones
detail: Search matches titles and message text, includes archived chats (also listed under Settings > Data controls), and excludes deleted chats, which cannot be recovered via search.

feature: Locked chats: hidden from search, open via PIN or device auth
detail: Locked chats are excluded from regular search and found under Projects > Locked chats using account PIN or device authentication; opening one does not return it to normal history. Files in a locked chat are usable only in that chat, not in Library or Space.

feature: Chats ended for safety concerns vanish from history and search
detail: If ChatGPT ends a conversation over serious violence or harm concerns, it is removed from history and search even if not deleted.

feature: Library and Space for managing saved files
detail: Files found through search are managed, reused, downloaded and deleted from Library or Space depending on the account.

feature: Web search in Enterprise and Edu with workspace controls
detail: ChatGPT can search automatically or via manual Web search (+ menu or / menu), producing inline citations, a Sources list, structured results (weather, sports, finance) and image results; subject to plan usage limits.

feature: Regenerate a response with search
detail: Where available, the refresh icon then Try again retries the answer with web results; hovering a citation on desktop web shows source info.

feature: Admin Web search workspace toggle
detail: Owners and admins turn Web search on or off for the workspace and its own GPTs (not third-party GPTs); when off, search is unavailable even on request.

feature: RBAC Web search permission per role
detail: Role permission with Default (inherit), On, Off; Off in any role or group denies access; if unavailable, agent and deep research may be unavailable too.

feature: Search privacy: disassociated queries to Bing, approximate location
detail: Queries shared with Bing without user/account/device IDs or IP; approximate location may be shared; Healthcare workspaces do not use Bing or data providers; restricted modes may use cached results or disable search.

feature: Work with Apps on macOS
detail: ChatGPT for macOS reads content from supported coding, terminal and note apps and includes it with a message, with a banner showing which apps and content are attached; needs app version 1.2025.057+.

feature: Chat Bar opened with Option+Space or menu bar icon
detail: The Chat Bar launches with Option+Space or the menu bar icon; shortcut is changeable in Settings > Keyboard Shortcut; a Work with Apps button connects apps manually.

feature: Code edits in IDEs as reviewable diffs
detail: In IDEs ChatGPT generates a diff to review and apply, with an auto-apply option; revert in ChatGPT UI or Cmd+Z; editing only for IDEs.

feature: Advanced Voice while working with apps
detail: Wave icon in the main window's chat bar starts voice with Work with Apps; not launchable from companion window and does not support code edits.

feature: Supported apps and context sent
detail: Supports Apple Notes, Notion, TextEdit, Quip, Xcode, Script Editor, VS Code family, JetBrains IDEs, Terminal, iTerm, Warp, Prompt; sends last 200 terminal lines or the selection plus nearby text.

feature: Enable Work with Apps switch and Manage Apps
detail: A settings switch fully disables the feature; Settings > Work with Apps > Manage Apps lists compatible apps; relies on macOS Accessibility permission, which can be revoked.

feature: Admin toggles: Work with Apps and Allow code edits on macOS
detail: Enterprise admins can disable Work with Apps or code edits for workspace members.

feature: Work with Apps content joins chat history and training rules
detail: Included content is saved in chat history; consumer plans may train unless 'Improve the model for everyone' is off or Temporary Chat is used; business plans are not trained on.
plans: Consumer; Business, Enterprise excluded from training

feature: Work with Apps VS Code extension
detail: Extension openai.chatgpt enables Work with Apps on VS Code, Insiders, Cursor; VSCodium and Windsurf need a sideloaded VSIX via Install from VSIX; macOS only.

feature: 1-800-ChatGPT phone calls without an account
detail: Experimental line (1-800-242-8478) to talk to ChatGPT by phone from US/Canada numbers, no account needed; 13+ only.

feature: 1-800-ChatGPT 30 minutes per month limit
detail: Free calls capped at 30 minutes monthly (US and CA), with notices near and at the limit; may be adjusted for capacity; continue in app or web.

feature: ChatGPT on WhatsApp in the EEA
detail: Message the verified 1-800-CHATGPT WhatsApp contact without an account; availability depends on the WhatsApp number's country code and rolls out gradually.

feature: 1-800-ChatGPT retention, number linkage and blocking
detail: Calls and transcripts are stored and may be reviewed for safety; data tied to the phone number; numbers cannot be unlinked from accounts; numbers can be blocked for policy or unsupported region and appealed.

feature: Voice call tips: noise isolation and Voice Isolation mic mode
detail: Quiet room, headphones and iPhone Voice Isolation mic mode reduce accidental interruptions.

feature: Japanese Consumption Tax on invoices
detail: 10% JCT charged since Jan 1 2025 on direct purchases by Japan customers; shown in yen on Qualified Invoices; negotiated business contracts use reverse charge; checkout shows only an estimate.

feature: Report a conversation via thumbs down
detail: Thumbs down under a message, then Select an issue, then Safety or Legal concern, submits a report on web and mobile.

feature: Report shared links and shared scheduled tasks
detail: Shared conversations and shared scheduled-task links can be reported without signing in via a Report control, otherwise through the web form.

feature: Report a GPT or a GPT conversation
detail: Report menu entries exist for a whole GPT or for a conversation with a GPT on web, iOS and Android.

feature: Report an ad in ChatGPT
detail: The ad's overflow menu has Report this ad with a reason picker and optional details.

feature: Content, copyright and trademark report forms
detail: Web forms for general content, copyright and trademark reports; ChatGPT Sites have no in-product reporting and forum posts use the web form.

feature: Model access limits: capacity, permissions, usage, security
detail: A model or intelligence option may appear disabled due to capacity, workspace RBAC, usage limits with reset time, ToS flags, security downgrades or recent plan changes; fixes include waiting, password reset and 2FA.

feature: ChatGPT extension for Apple Intelligence
detail: Set up in Settings > Siri / Apple Intelligence & Siri on iPhone, iPad or Mac; works without an account or with a free or paid account to save history and use plan features.

feature: Apple integration: Siri, Writing Tools Compose, Visual Intelligence
detail: Ask Siri to use ChatGPT, use Compose in Writing Tools, or Visual Intelligence Ask on supported iPhones (Camera Control, Action button, Lock Screen or Control Center).

feature: Apple integration: Confirm ChatGPT Requests toggle and turn-off
detail: Confirmation can be turned off (not with Siri AI; 'Ask ChatGPT' skips it on v26 but files/photos still ask); Use ChatGPT/Use Extension turns access off; Setup Prompts stop Siri suggestions.

feature: Login connections lists Apple Intelligence
detail: Settings > Security and login > Login connections shows Apple Intelligence as a connected app; Business/Enterprise/Edu need admin help and data-residency workspaces are unsupported.

feature: Scheduled tasks: one-time, recurring and monitoring
detail: ChatGPT can run one-time or recurring tasks and monitoring tasks that notify on changes, use prior runs and stop at an end condition; managed from a Scheduled page.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Scheduled task management: edit, pause, resume, delete
detail: Open the Scheduled page, Settings > Notifications > Manage tasks, or conversation menu 'See scheduled tasks'; the task panel edits, pauses or deletes; deleting the chat pauses the task, deleting the task keeps the chat.

feature: Event-triggered tasks (Gmail, Slack, GitHub)
detail: Webhook tasks run in Work on new Gmail mail (filter by sender/subject), Slack channel messages (needs @ChatGPT added) or GitHub PR activity; set Trigger, Condition, Prompt; approvals may pause them.
plans: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu, Healthcare; not Free/Go/FedRAMP

feature: Admin: Allow event-triggered scheduled tasks
detail: Enterprise, Edu and Healthcare admins must enable it first; in Healthcare it is off by default and not covered by a BAA, so no PHI.

feature: Active scheduled task limits per plan
detail: Active tasks capped at 3 Free/Go, 5 Plus, 10 Business/Edu, 15 Pro/Enterprise; Free allows one-time or at most daily runs with flexible windows; hourly and exact times need paid.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Edu, Enterprise

feature: Event-triggered task rate limits
detail: Up to 30 runs per hour and 720 per day across all event tasks; events may be grouped; inactive tasks may pause.

feature: Scheduled task exclusions: voice, GPTs, locked chats, project files
detail: Tasks do not work in voice chats, GPTs or locked chats (delete tasks before locking); tasks created in a project cannot access project files.

feature: Scheduled task background usage counts against plan
detail: A completed task uses plan allowance or workspace credits even without posting an update.

feature: Scheduled task notifications: push and email
detail: Settings > Notifications selects Push, Email or both; web needs browser permission and mobile push needs a task created in the mobile app.

feature: Share a scheduled task link
detail: Active or paused tasks can be shared as a snapshot of title, instructions, schedule and time zone, without chat history, memories or files; recipients schedule their own copy; the link can be deleted and refreshed.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Shared task visibility rules
detail: Personal links open to anyone; workspace links only to members; Business/Enterprise members cannot schedule personal links; task links are excluded from data exports.

feature: Scheduled page in desktop app and Codex automations difference
detail: Desktop may lack Scheduled and can show but not create event-trigger tasks; Codex automations are separate.

feature: Weekly finances update task from ChatGPT Finances
detail: Connecting a financial account may auto-create a Weekly finances update task; tasks can also draw on Health/Finances data but not for event triggers.

feature: Scheduled tasks covered by Compliance API
detail: Tasks appear in the Compliance API, but shared task links and snapshots do not.

feature: Phone-only signup
detail: Eligible new users in some regions can sign up with just a phone number; password reset by SMS from a previously used device; upgrading to Plus/Pro/Business or SSO needs a verified email.

feature: Link email to a phone account, then MFA and social login
detail: Settings > Account > Email > Add; afterwards MFA and Google, Apple or Microsoft login can be used on the same account.

feature: Phone number reuse after account deletion
detail: A deleted consumer account's number is freed after 30 days; numbers still linked to any account cannot start another phone-only signup.

feature: Multi-currency billing on chatgpt.com
detail: Around 80 local currencies at checkout; app-store subscriptions bill via Apple/Google; existing subscribers stay in their currency and must cancel and resubscribe to switch; API credits are USD only; Enterprise/Edu excluded.

feature: Regional payment methods
detail: Cards everywhere; Link bank debit in UK/EEA; UPI (Go, Plus) in India; GoPay, Pix, GCash, MoMo (Go, Plus, Pro); Kakao Pay, Naver Pay in Korea; SCA prompts in the EEA.

feature: ChatGPT wallet balance and gift cards (US)
detail: Eligible US purchases in USD on the website can use wallet balance; gift cards are US/USD only; not usable for API or Apple/Google billing.

feature: Account sharing is not allowed; multiple devices are
detail: An account is for one individual; using it on multiple devices is fine, usage limits may apply; if compromised, change password and enable 2FA.

feature: Suspicious Activity Alerts
detail: Banners for odd sign-ins, spikes or concurrent sessions, which may limit features; remedies are password change, 2FA, log out of all devices, then clear cache, disable VPN/Private Relay or contact Support.

feature: Google apps data not used to train generalized models
detail: Data from connected Gmail, Calendar, Drive is not used to train or target ads, except feedback submissions, pasted/uploaded data, or content in responses; 'Improve the model for everyone' does not change that.

feature: Memory may use Google app data; Suggested prompts toggle
detail: With Memory on, eligible Google data can personalize replies and suggested prompts; control in Settings > Personalization; disconnecting an app does not delete chats or memories.

feature: Google app actions and OAuth scopes (Gmail, Calendar, Meet, BigQuery, Contacts, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides)
detail: Supported Google actions include Gmail modify, Calendar events with Meet lookups and transcripts, BigQuery, Contacts, and Drive, Docs, Sheets and Slides read/write; users can disconnect any time.

feature: Admin control of Google actions and Drive content
detail: Workspace admins enable or disable individual Google actions; Google Workspace admins approve scopes; Enterprise owners can allow or block shared drives and My Drive content.

feature: Google Drive in Library: My Drive and directly shared files
detail: Library shows content from the chosen Google account (My Drive and files shared directly); Shared Drives not yet included; viewing does not change Drive sharing; edits need write scope.

feature: Plus promotions and promo code redemption
detail: Partner promo codes (free trials or discounts, often new Plus subscribers only) are redeemed via a link; one code per subscriber, not transferable or reissued; renews at standard rate after promo.

feature: Cancel subscription on web: Settings > Subscription > Manage
detail: Web subscriptions are canceled on web, store subscriptions through Apple or Google; cannot cancel from the mobile app; cancel 24 hours before renewal; resubscribing does not restore promo pricing.

feature: Cloudflare Zero Trust TLS decryption can block Mac and iOS apps
detail: Enterprise/Edu orgs with Zero Trust TLS decryption need a top-priority Cloudflare firewall policy for the macOS and iOS apps; web, Windows and Android unaffected.

feature: Deep research: plan, sources, structured cited report
detail: Describe the outcome, review and edit a proposed plan, follow progress and interrupt to change focus or sources; yields a cited report.

feature: Start deep research via /Deepresearch, tools menu or sidebar
detail: Three entry points: typing /Deepresearch, choosing Deep research in the + tools menu, or from the sidebar menu.

feature: Deep research sources: web, uploads, connected apps, specific sites
detail: Defaults to public web and uploaded files; supported connected apps (e.g. Google Drive, SharePoint) read-only; Sites > Manage sites can restrict to given domains or prioritize them.

feature: Deep research report view and downloads
detail: Fullscreen report with table of contents, sources used and activity history; downloadable as Markdown, Word or PDF.

feature: Deep research usage counter and 30-day reset
detail: In-product counter shows remaining tasks; fixed monthly allowances reset 30 days after first use; availability varies by country.

feature: Deep research legacy model choice
detail: Runs on the latest model by default; users may pick a legacy model.

feature: Deep research RBAC and Compliance API
detail: Admins control access via RBAC; apps must support deep research and be enabled; activity is covered by the Compliance API; retention follows chat policy.

feature: Data retention: deletion within 30 days, Temporary Chats auto-deleted
detail: Deleted chats, memories and accounts leave systems within 30 days; Temporary Chats auto-delete within 30 days; some data kept for safety, legal or payment records; Atlas incognito history not saved.

feature: Contacts upload to find people using ChatGPT
detail: Optionally connecting device contacts uploads address books to check which contacts use the service and notify when they join.

feature: Ads data collected for Free and Go users
detail: Free and Go users have ad history and interest data collected subject to controls, to show ads in ChatGPT; refusing Korea consent restricts registration.

feature: Business admins can access member content; employer email domain sharing
detail: Enterprise/business admins may access and control member accounts and content, and the existence of an account under an employer email may be shared with the employer.

feature: Prohibited practices under EU AI Act
detail: Users in the EU must not use the services for manipulation, social scoring, crime-prediction profiling, facial database scraping, workplace emotion inference or similar banned uses.

feature: Google Drive app: connect and use in conversations
detail: Connect via Plugins or Apps with Google sign-in; search files and use Docs, Sheets and Slides actions; changing actions (create, update, move, share, delete) need permissions and may ask for confirmation.

feature: Google Drive admin controls and troubleshooting
detail: ChatGPT admins pick enabled Drive actions, Google admins approve scopes, managed workspaces may limit email domains; Enterprise Safety & Security Controls restrict shared drives and My Drive.

feature: Drive app in scheduled tasks and Workspace Agents
detail: Actions that work in chat may need different approval in scheduled tasks or Workspace Agents.

feature: Approval prompt before ChatGPT opens generated links
detail: The app asks users to approve certain generated links, especially to sites that opted out of cataloguing, because links can leak context to third parties or be prompt-injected.

feature: Enterprise file upload sources
detail: Files come from the computer, Google Drive, SharePoint, OneDrive, GPT Knowledge, Project Files, or a GPT Action.

feature: File handling by type: text retrieval, Code Interpreter, image, visual PDF
detail: Documents are text-extracted; csv/xls/xlsx go to Code Interpreter; jpg/png use vision; PDFs in prompts get visual retrieval of embedded images; images in non-PDF files are ignored.

feature: File context limits: 110k tokens stuffed, rest to search index
detail: 128k context model; up to 110k document tokens in context (55k split evenly across multiple docs), remainder in a private vector index; about 350 mixed pages fill it for multimedia PDFs.

feature: File search behavior: GPT-series one search, o-series multiple
detail: GPT models run one hybrid search per prompt; o-series run roughly 2-3 sequential searches, better for multi-part questions.

feature: SCIM directory sync: tenant, workspace and API scopes
detail: SCIM syncs users and groups from an IdP (Okta, Entra, Google, PingFederate, OneLogin, Rippling); tenant-wide via global admin in Admin Console, workspace-level via owner, API org via API Platform; independent of SSO.

feature: Assign synchronized groups to workspaces, API orgs, Ads accounts
detail: Users & groups > SCIM Groups > Product access assigns groups to multiple resources; new workspace users get Member invitations; owner and custom roles are not assignable this way.

feature: SCIM managed email updates and account matching
detail: Tenant-wide SCIM can change a user's primary email when both domains are verified, signing the user out; accounts match on work email; Support cannot edit SCIM-managed emails.

feature: Automatic account creation for verified domains
detail: Separate from SCIM and SSO; users with verified-domain emails are added on sign-in, but they may not be SCIM-managed, so review before enabling SCIM.

feature: Discoverable by workspace users for SCIM groups
detail: Identity & access toggle controls whether SCIM groups appear when sharing GPTs or projects; turning off can hide groups and remove group shares.

feature: SCIM for ChatGPT for Teachers K-12 districts
detail: District tenants verify a domain, configure tenant-wide SCIM, sync staff groups only (no students) and assign them to the Teachers workspace.

feature: SCIM deprovisioning and delete connection
detail: Removing a user from the IdP drops group-derived access after sync (typically 30-40 min) but does not delete their OpenAI account; deleting a tenant directory connection is irreversible.

feature: Personal workspace migration into Enterprise/Edu with 7-day deadline
detail: Employees added to a workspace with a verified domain must move personal content or export and deactivate their personal workspace within 7 days; admins cannot disable or change it; access is blocked until done.

feature: Business onboarding: keep personal workspace or merge
detail: Invited employees may keep a personal workspace separate or merge it into Business; admins cannot force a merge or deletion; personal subscriptions continue until canceled.

feature: Migration scope: GPTs private, no individual selection, Sites excluded
detail: Migration copies supported content and deactivates the personal workspace with no undo; GPTs become private; individual chats cannot be chosen; Sites do not transfer; Plus/Pro web subscription may be refunded.

feature: Data export timing and availability
detail: Personal exports can take up to 7 days and download links expire after 24 hours; self-service export is not available in Business or Enterprise workspaces.

feature: Automatic account creation seats and defaults
detail: On by default for the first Enterprise workspace in a tenant; consumes full seats even if IdP blocks sign-in; may invite to multiple workspaces sharing a domain; does not reactivate removed members.

feature: Resend workspace invite
detail: Owners can resend manual invitations; SCIM-managed invites cannot be resent directly.

feature: Domain verification via DNS TXT record
detail: Admins verify domains with a public DNS TXT record (DNS may take up to 24h; setup window expires after 7 days; completed verification does not expire); parent domain does not cover subdomains.

feature: SSO policy per workspace and per-member SSO exemption
detail: Workspaces can require SSO; owners set external members to Follow workspace SSO policy or Allow login without SSO (admins can only view); exemptions survive deactivation but not removal.

feature: Sign-in methods and error recovery (password, social, SSO, temporary code)
detail: Accounts sign in by password, Google/Microsoft/Apple, temporary code or tenant SSO; mismatched method gives identity_provider_mismatch; social-only accounts have no password to reset.

feature: Request access to a Business workspace
detail: A person with an existing account can request access to a Business workspace if offered, and an owner approves when a seat is free.

feature: SSO identity-provider settings: thumbprint, tiles, name attributes
detail: SAML certificate thumbprint must match the IdP, product-specific sign-in URLs and tiles exist for ChatGPT versus API, and first/last name are optional IdP attributes.

feature: Workspace analytics: Usage overview and Workplace health
detail: Admin Console Usage shows unique active users, messages by GPT/tool/project/app/skill, SCIM-group breakdowns, plus Workplace health (seats enabled, seats activated, WAU) across ChatGPT, Codex and Work.

feature: Analytics tabs: GPTs, Projects, Skills, Users
detail: Per-GPT, per-project and top-skill usage with reach metrics, and a Users view with seats purchased, enabled, active, pending invites, per-user activity and power users.

feature: Analytics viewer role and CSV exports
detail: Analytics viewer role, admins and owners see analytics; CSV exports for user report, GPT usage, project usage, benchmarks and survey results.

feature: Insights: industry benchmarks
detail: Compare activation rate, WAU per activated user and messages per WAU against industry medians, with model, tool and app message comparisons.

feature: Insights: in-product impact surveys
detail: Aggregated self-reported productivity, time saved, quality and satisfaction results; owners may create admin surveys with fixed questions; exports include identifiers only if enabled.

feature: Task insights: task type distribution and heat map
detail: Classifies conversations into task categories and topics without exposing prompts; heat map by SCIM group (groups under 10 members hidden); on by default, opt out in Workspace settings; off by default under EU residency; not exportable.

feature: Analytics freshness and limits
detail: Aggregated, refreshed every 1-24 hours (typically 6-12), no message text or file contents; use the Compliance API for raw logs.

feature: Create a project with name, icon and color
detail: New project in the sidebar (plus icon on mobile) with name, icon and color; unlimited projects; found under Explore > Projects on some mobile layouts.

feature: Project files with per-plan limits
detail: Upload PDFs, spreadsheets, docs, images or pasted text; 5 files Free, 25 Go/Plus, 40 Pro/Business/Enterprise/Edu; max 10 uploads at once; duplicate-name prompt Upload anyway or Skip; preview, download, delete.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Project instructions override global custom instructions
detail: Project settings hold instructions that apply only in the project and take precedence over global custom instructions.

feature: Add Google Drive and Slack links as project sources
detail: Paste Drive file/folder or Slack channel links via Add sources in private projects; a separate limit from file uploads; Drive does not pre-sync inside projects.

feature: Save a response to project sources
detail: Message menu action 'Add to project sources' stores a response for reuse in later project chats.

feature: Move chats into and out of a project
detail: Drag a chat or use Move to project; Remove from project reverses it; GPT chats and temporary chats cannot move; moved chats inherit project instructions and files.

feature: Tools inside projects
detail: Canvas, image generation, voice, web search, apps, and on paid plans agent mode and deep research work in projects; study mode does not; custom GPT only for follow-up messages in existing chats.
plans: Paid for agent and deep research

feature: Project memory: default versus project-only
detail: Per-project setting; project-only blocks personal memories and cross-project chat reference and disables Work; changes take hours; Enterprise/Edu chats stay contained; no list of project memories.

feature: Share a project with chat or edit access
detail: Invite individuals (Business+ also groups) with chat or edit access, or share links; the higher of group and individual access applies; confirmation emails go to invitees.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Project share links: invited only or anyone with link; collaborator caps
detail: Owner picks Only those invited or Anyone with a link (logged-in users); caps: Pro 100 collaborators, Plus/Go 10, Free 5, workspace projects 100; workspace link grants chat access by default.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Branch chats in shared projects
detail: Members open another's chat and branch it without altering the original; profile icon shows who started a chat; no real-time co-editing.

feature: Leave a shared project and keep a copy
detail: Leaving offers a copy of your chats into a new project named 'Copy ...'; owners can remove collaborators or delete the project; shared projects stay project-only memory.

feature: Share a single chat from a project via link
detail: A link shows only that chat, not the project's files or other chats; chats from shared projects are inaccessible until the recipient joins.

feature: Delete a project is permanent
detail: Removes chats, instructions and project-only files (Library/Space files stay), members lose access, cannot be undone.

feature: Project permissions: Create and manage projects, Share projects
detail: Workspace RBAC controls who can create or share projects (Enterprise Share projects also gates opening shared ones); workspace tool toggles cascade into projects; Enterprise can hide workspace member lists.

feature: Shared project training and compliance API
detail: Personal shared projects can train models only if the owner and every contributor have Improve the model on; business plans not trained; Compliance API supports Isolate project and List Project Shared Users.

feature: SSO exemptions for external workspace members (Nov 2026)
detail: Owners set Allow login without SSO or Follow workspace SSO policy per external member in Members; existing externals were auto-exempted, new ones are not; exemption is per workspace and cleared on removal.

feature: (model name) Astra and Sol preview in Work and Codex desktop
detail: Astra (frontier, complex work) and Sol (reasoning with speed) preview models, off by default, enabled by owners for workspace or roles; US and EU inference, not UAE; regular Chat unchanged.

feature: Admin Console model test lookup
detail: Admin console > Models > Test lets admins check why a member cannot see a model.

feature: ChatGPT for Healthcare: clinical search, healthcare plugins, AWS Marketplace
detail: Improved clinical search and more healthcare plugins in Healthcare workspaces; purchasable via AWS Marketplace by eligible organizations.

feature: Admin Console change user email for non-SCIM users
detail: Global admins can change emails within verified domains; accounts 24h+ old, max 2 changes per 24h and 20 lifetime; user belongs to one tenant; notice sent to old address.

feature: Dots: personal agents that keep working between conversations
detail: Personal dots continue tasks between chats; GA for Enterprise/Edu/Healthcare from Nov 18 2026; admins control who can use, view, pause and delete dots; supports data residency, EKM, HIPAA; not in UAE residency.

feature: (model name) Rosalind Research for life sciences
detail: Limited rollout to approved Enterprise customers in Work and Codex (not Chat) after a two-week admin preview, off by default, requiring Research approval.

feature: ChatGPT Sites enabled by default for Enterprise
detail: Use Sites under Permissions > Workspace capabilities; public publishing off by default and controlled separately.

feature: Automatic Instant-to-thinking switching retired
detail: Auto-switching from Instant to higher thinking was removed for Enterprise/Edu and its workspace control removed; users pick a thinking level in the model picker (except medical routing workspaces).

feature: Custom GPT creation disabled for Enterprise; Plugin Creator replaces it

detail: Per-project option so chats use only that project's chats, not outside saved memories, and nothing leaks out; needs personal and workspace Memory enabled; first on web and Windows.

feature: Study mode
detail: Socratic guided learning that asks about goals, breaks concepts into steps, checks understanding and uses uploaded images/PDFs and memory; start via Tools > Study and learn or chatgpt.com/studymode; works with any model.

feature: (model name) default with admin-enabled legacy models
detail: Single auto-switching system; admins can enable legacy (model name), (model name), o3, o3-pro, o4-mini for the workspace, consuming credits.

feature: Teams, Outlook, Canva, Notion, HubSpot connectors in chat search
detail: Connectors extended from deep research to chat search, enabled in Settings > Connectors; beta and off by default for Enterprise/Edu.

feature: ChatGPT agent for complex online tasks
detail: Switches between reasoning and action across public sites, uploaded files and connected sources, filling forms and editing spreadsheets with user oversight.

feature: Role-based access controls for Enterprise/Edu
detail: Default role for members, custom roles with granular permissions, assign multiple roles to groups, centralized management.

feature: Priority processing for Enterprise API
detail: Per-request priority tier with premium latency and uptime at pay-as-you-go pricing; API feature, not a subscriber app feature.

feature: Record mode in macOS app
detail: Records meetings, brainstorms and voice notes then transcribes, summarizes and turns them into follow-ups, plans or code; macOS only; disabled by default in Enterprise/Edu until owner enables under Workspace Settings > Record.

feature: o3-pro in model picker (replaced o1-pro)
detail: Pro model with browsing, Python, file analysis and image reasoning; no image generation, canvas or temporary chats.

feature: Projects: deep research, voice, share chats, start project from chat, mobile uploads
detail: Added capabilities for projects including deep research and voice, sharing project chats, starting a project from a chat, and file upload and model selection on mobile.

feature: Custom GPTs support all models; recommended model
detail: GPTs without actions can use any available model with a creator-recommended default and user switching; GPTs with actions were limited to (model name)/4.1 then.

feature: Original connectors beta: Drive, SharePoint, Dropbox, Box with citations
detail: Real-time access with inline citations, off by default; deep research connectors also include Outlook, Gmail, Calendar, Linear, GitHub, HubSpot, Teams; Drive synced connector adds semantic search.

feature: Custom MCP connectors in deep research (June 2025)
detail: Admins publish custom connectors to proprietary systems via a remote MCP server, initially deep research only.

feature: Flexible pricing for Enterprise: shared credit pool
detail: Workspaces buy a shared credit pool for advanced models and features with no per-user rate limits and unlimited core models.

feature: Composer Tools dropdown consolidating Search, Deep research etc.
detail: May 2025 change replaced separate buttons with a single Tools dropdown at lower left.

feature: (model name) and (model name) mini in picker (2025)
detail: (model name) under more models for Enterprise/Edu with (model name) limits; (model name) mini replaced (model name) mini and served as Free-user fallback.

feature: Export deep research report as PDF
detail: Share icon > Download as PDF yields formatted reports with tables, images and linked citations, for new and past reports.

feature: Mobile composer consolidated tools menu
detail: Individual tool icons replaced by a sliders-style icon opening a bottom sheet with tools like Create an image and Search the web.

feature: 4o image generation inside GPTs
detail: GPT creators enable 4o Image Generation under Capabilities in the GPT editor.

feature: Deep research monthly limits and lightweight fallback (2025)
detail: Enterprise/Edu had 10 deep research tasks per month; after that 15 extra lightweight-version requests until reset.

feature: Scheduled tasks with o3 and o4-mini
detail: Scheduled tasks run with those models; the separate 'ChatGPT with Scheduled Tasks' model option was removed.

feature: o3, o4-mini, o4-mini-high, o3-mini, o1 pro, o1 (2024-25 reasoning models)
detail: o3 and o4-mini superseded o1 and o3-mini; o1 pro mode limited to five queries per month; file support varied (no spreadsheets in o1/o3-mini; images only in o1 pro).

feature: (model name) image generation as default image generator
detail: Ask for an image or choose Create image in the composer; DALL-E remains via its GPT.

feature: (model name) in ChatGPT Enterprise/Edu
detail: (model name) became available to Enterprise and Edu users in March 2025.

feature: Deep research visible in Compliance API
detail: Search for the deep research global prompt or tool_name deep_research in exports.

feature: Canvas sharing
detail: Share a canvas asset (rendered React/HTML, document or code) from the Canvas toolbar like sharing a conversation.

feature: Visual retrieval for PDFs
detail: Enterprise ChatGPT reads text plus embedded images, graphs and diagrams in uploaded PDFs.

feature: Admin toggle for Apple Intelligence under Connections
detail: Admins enable or disable Apple Intelligence; when off, users cannot select the Enterprise/Edu workspace when logging in through Apple's integration.

feature: Canvas: GPTs, Python execution, paste shortcut, toolbox entry
detail: Canvas works in GPTs; executes Python with bug-fix passes (admin Canvas code execution toggle, off by default for Enterprise); paste-to-canvas shortcut in composer; Compliance API can get, list, delete canvas docs.

feature: Web sidebar redesign (Nov 2024)
detail: Floating mode with soft dismiss, limited recents with infinite-scroll flyout, recent and pinned GPTs, settings at the bottom, new chat button left of model picker, pinned sidebar stays open beside Canvas.

feature: Mobile web improvements: floating sidebar, keyboard, no composer autofocus
detail: Better on-screen keyboard behavior, always-floating sidebar that closes on thread switch, composer not focused when switching conversations.

feature: Advanced Voice on ChatGPT web (Nov 2024)
detail: Real-time voice chat on chatgpt.com on desktop, already on mobile and desktop apps.

feature: Windows app via Microsoft Store for Enterprise/Edu with MDM deployment
detail: Access follows IT Store policies, with MDM/MAM deployment planned.

feature: ChatGPT Images: create and edit images
detail: Generate new images from a prompt in chat or via Explore > Images, or upload an image and describe edits. Can add text, details and transparent backgrounds; generation can take a few minutes while you keep chatting.

feature: Images with thinking
detail: Image generation variant that uses reasoning; available on Plus, Pro and Business, coming soon to Enterprise and Edu.

feature: Image generation in Codex
detail: Images can also be generated and edited from within Codex.

feature: Image edit selection tool
detail: Highlight part of an image then describe the change in chat, or skip selection and describe the edit directly. Highlights are imprecise and edits may spill outside the area.

feature: Aspect ratio picker for images
detail: Choose an aspect ratio in a picker or state it in the prompt; the editor can regenerate an image in another ratio.

feature: Looping GIF creation
detail: Ask for a looping GIF or animate an uploaded still; edits are by chat, and the GIF opens with playback speed, save and share controls. Uploaded animated GIFs cannot be edited.

feature: Saved image reference photos with @name
detail: Save an uploaded photo as a named reference (ChatGPT may offer to), then type @name in later prompts to reuse it.

feature: Image templates (poster, logo etc.)
detail: Sidebar Images > Templates lists categories; pick a template, fill in details, answer optional follow-up questions (style, reference upload). Not yet available in Work mode.

feature: Sketch to image on mobile
detail: In the mobile composer type @ and choose Sketch, draw with color, eraser and undo, confirm, then add instructions to generate an image.

feature: Image editor: select, aspect ratio, undo, redo, cancel, save
detail: Open any image from a conversation or Images to highlight regions, change ratio, undo/redo selections, cancel or save; also has a text box for edits.

feature: Mobile image editing: Edit, Select with size slider, Resize, Remove
detail: Full-screen view of generated images with Edit, Select (brush size slider, undo/redo, Next), comments, Resize and Remove controls.

feature: Images library of all generated images
detail: Every created image is auto-saved under Images on web and mobile with a Create Image button.

feature: Image actions: copy, save, share
detail: From the image controls copy to clipboard, download to device, or share directly to another app.

feature: Delete an image by deleting its conversation
detail: Images are removed only by deleting the conversation that made them (hover menu on web, press and hold on mobile).

feature: Share an image prompt as a template link
detail: On mobile, Share > Prompt template > Copy link lets others recreate their own version of an image.

feature: Teen image upload reminder and parental control over images
detail: Teen experience shows a reminder not to share sensitive info before some uploads; it does not give parents access. A parent of a linked teen may disable image create/edit.

feature: DALL-E GPT retired
detail: The official DALL-E GPT is removed; ChatGPT Images replaces it. GPTs with Image Generation capability use the new model.

feature: Report images violating usage policies
detail: Content reporting guidelines are used to report generated images.

feature: Shopping results with product cards
detail: When shopping intent is detected ChatGPT shows products with images, details, merchants and purchase options; results are not ads and are kept separate from ads.

feature: Compare products and refine shopping options
detail: Ask for comparisons, trade-offs or alternatives with budget and preferences; results can be adjusted by conversation.

feature: Virtual try-on for clothing and accessories
detail: Try on button on clothing/accessory listings uses a selfie (taken or uploaded) and ChatGPT Images; you can also upload a garment photo. Does not guarantee fit.

feature: Reference photos setting for try-on
detail: Settings > Personalization > Reference photos stores photos for reuse; change or delete each one.

feature: Save products to Library favorites and folders
detail: Bookmark a product to Favorites or create a folder in ChatGPT Library; unbookmark to remove.

feature: Shopping uses Memory and Custom instructions
detail: Product selection factors in your query, Memory and Custom instructions plus price, reviews and third-party metadata; you can clarify preferences to correct it.

feature: Shopping labels, review summaries, Best price label
detail: Model-generated labels (e.g. Budget-friendly), review summaries from public sites, and Best price tag when several merchants sell an item; none verified by OpenAI. Price updates may lag.

feature: Merchant list ranking and Shopify Catalog
detail: Merchants ranked by availability, price, quality and being the primary seller; Shopify products are integrated automatically and merchants can apply for direct product feeds.

feature: Shopping feedback and reporting
detail: Thumbs up/down on products and a menu report option for incorrect or policy-violating items.

feature: GitHub connector with live read-only repo access
detail: Settings > Plugins > GitHub installs and authorizes the ChatGPT app and picks repositories; content is retrieved on demand, no synced index, read only. Availability may be in deep research or agent but not standard chat depending on plan.

feature: Manage or disconnect GitHub repository access
detail: Change repos via the Plugins > GitHub repo management option, or Disconnect; access is also controlled in GitHub by org owners. Repos take about 5 minutes to appear.

feature: Event-triggered Work tasks on GitHub PR activity
detail: Create webhook-based tasks for PR opened, ready for review, closed, plus reviews, comments, commits and merges on github.com repos; self-hosted GitHub Enterprise unsupported.

feature: Share scheduled and event-triggered tasks that use GitHub
detail: Shared links expose task instructions but not credentials or repo access; recipients connect their own GitHub account.

feature: GitHub repo search by name, function or error
detail: Selector only searches repo names; ask ChatGPT to search a repo by file name, function or error message, optionally with path.

feature: GitHub data use and training rules
detail: Business offerings data is not used for training; personal accounts follow Improve the model setting. Queries are sent to GitHub; data residency covers only in-scope content.

feature: GitHub IP allow list requirement
detail: If GitHub IP Allow List is enabled, OpenAI egress IP blocks must be added.

feature: (model name) Astra and Sol preview in Work and Codex desktop
detail: Off by default in eligible Enterprise/Edu workspaces; owners enable per workspace or role. Standard inference in US and EU only (no UAE); Codex CLI needs 0.166.0+; FedRAMP needs Work private preview enrollment.

feature: (model name) replaces Latest in model picker
detail: (model name) uses Sol for Instant, Medium, High, Extra High; Pro uses (model name) Pro on Astra with Pro Standard and Pro Extended controls. Picker is at top on mobile, in composer on web.

feature: Intelligent UI and early-streaming responses in (model name) Chat
detail: Responses can mix text, visuals and interactive elements and begin while the model keeps thinking; available Instant through Extra High, not at Pro effort.

feature: Instant no longer auto-escalates thinking in Enterprise/Edu
detail: Unless specialized medical routing is configured, users must pick a higher level manually; legacy models can still route automatically for safety or personal finance.

feature: Model access controlled by workspace settings and RBAC
detail: Admins set which models members see; access depends on eligibility, workspace settings and all roles, and a role that allows a model overrides one that denies it.

feature: (model name) off by default with owner enablement
detail: Owners enable per workspace or role; Early Model Access does not carry over and no two-week admin preview applies.

feature: Admin Model Test for member access
detail: Admin console > Models > Test shows a member's effective models, defaults, roles and preferences without changing anything.

feature: Enterprise near-unlimited messages with fair-use limits
detail: Eligible base models are virtually unlimited but still billable on token-based agreements; abuse, credential sharing and resale are prohibited and can trigger temporary restrictions.

feature: Enterprise rate cards: credit-based or token-based
detail: Pricing follows either the credit-based or Enterprise token-based rate card depending on the agreement.

feature: Taiwan 5% VAT and eGUI invoices
detail: From May 1 2025 Taiwan customers without a VAT ID are charged 5% VAT; an eGUI is emailed and can also be fetched on the Taiwan Ministry of Finance e-Invoice Citizen Audit tool.

feature: Custom GPTs being retired in favor of plugins
detail: Plugins bundle instructions, reference files and apps. Enterprise new GPT creation ended Oct 26 2026 (FedRAMP exempt); standard retirement Dec 11 2026, FedRAMP or deferred Feb 28 2027; migrated originals become read-only.

feature: Personal accounts cannot create or publish GPTs
detail: Free, Go, Plus and Pro cannot create or publish new GPTs or use the GPT Store; existing GPTs remain usable and editable.

feature: GPT apps and actions are mutually exclusive
detail: A GPT cannot use both; admins can disable apps for workspace GPTs and restrict action domains. Apps block public link sharing and Store publishing.

feature: GPT public publishing requirements and appeals
detail: Needs workspace permission, builder profile, category, privacy policy URL for public actions; moderation blocks can be appealed, and while pending the GPT is private and uneditable.

feature: GPT knowledge files, Code Interpreter downloads, Preview testing
detail: Knowledge suits reference material, not rules; file downloads need Code Interpreter & Data Analysis; Preview pane used to test changes.

feature: Report a GPT for content violation
detail: In-product report option with GPT name or link, what happened and timestamps.

feature: Codex included with ChatGPT plans
detail: Codex is included on every plan including Free and Go with plan-based usage limits; sign in with ChatGPT from desktop app, CLI, IDE extension or web.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Codex Cloud tasks on OpenAI-managed computers
detail: Reusable cloud environments created on desktop or web; tasks start and continue from desktop, web or mobile and keep running while your computer sleeps. Not for Free or Go; guest, K-12 and Enterprise view-only seats cannot create environments.
plans: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Healthcare, Edu

feature: Auto-review (Approve for me)
detail: A separate reviewer approves or denies actions that would pause for approval; Codex may retry safer. Checks are free and not counted against limits; select Approve for me in the desktop approvals menu.

feature: Codex CLI refreshed features
detail: Agent view, multi-agent tools to open/read/fork tasks, voice in and out, separate Git worktrees, usage stats, and LaTeX and Mermaid rendering in the terminal.

feature: Codex on Windows: Codex Doctor, Remote Control, WSL selection
detail: codex doctor diagnoses startup and connectivity; Remote Control drives other devices subject to permissions; choose among multiple WSL distributions. Managed orgs deploy approved builds via MDM.

feature: Codex workspace model defaults and Fast Mode
detail: Admins set starting model, reasoning level, speed, Fast Mode (on by default) and new-chat behavior in Workspace settings > Models, per role if available; managed requirements.toml beats workspace defaults beats user choice.

feature: Codex cloud access and environment permissions
detail: Cloud access is off by default for Enterprise, separate from Codex Local; members create personal environments, shared ones need the Manage workspace environments permission (off by default).

feature: Plugins directory with Available vs Installed per role
detail: Directory visible on all plans; admins choose Available (self-install) or Installed (preinstalled) per role in Admin console > Plugins, applying across web, mobile, desktop and Codex. Plugins can bundle skills, apps and templates; app must be enabled for the role.

feature: Sites in Codex
detail: Describe a site, review preview and share; building counts toward Codex usage and admins control creation and public publishing depending on plan.

feature: Developer mode with full CDP access for browser use
detail: Settings > Browser > Enable full CDP access lets Codex inspect console, network and page state in Chrome and the in-app browser; asks explicit approval per site; admins disable via browser_use_full_cdp_access=false.

feature: Codex RBAC and Compliance API logging
detail: Admins grant Codex access to roles; Compliance API logs local (CLI, IDE) and cloud Codex usage.

feature: Codex usage limits, /status and shared allowance pool
detail: Check Settings or usage dashboard, or /status in CLI; Codex, Work, ChatGPT for Excel and Workspace Agents share one allowance/credit pool; auto-review is free; Cloud VMs have no separate charge at launch.

feature: Token-based USD billing for Codex on Enterprise
detail: Some Enterprise agreements bill Codex in USD against workspace budget and user limits rather than credits.

feature: Usage and billing page with per-chat credit use
detail: Credit-based Enterprise members see monthly allowance, credit history and high-usage Work/Codex chats in Settings > Usage & billing; dollar estimates only if member cost visibility is on.

feature: Buy credits and one-time or banked usage resets
detail: Eligible Plus and Pro can buy credits without changing plan; occasional one-time resets and referral banked resets refresh 5-hour and weekly windows. Support cannot reset limits.

feature: Codex continues the active turn after reaching a limit
detail: On allowance or credit plans the current turn can finish under fair use; afterwards add credits, apply a reset, upgrade or wait.

feature: Codex referral invitations
detail: Profile menu shows Invite a friend (personal) or Invite a coworker (Business) with offer-specific rewards, limits and expiry.

feature: Record and Replay skills from a demonstrated workflow
detail: On macOS Codex desktop with Computer Use enabled, record a workflow once to turn it into a reusable skill; initial availability excludes EU, Switzerland and UK.

feature: Codex data controls and training
detail: ChatGPT training controls apply to Codex content including Computer Use screenshots; business plans are not used for training; Plus and Pro may be unless disabled.

feature: Codex in IDE and Codex Local vs Cloud permissions
detail: VS Code extension works with most forks; elsewhere run CLI in IDE terminal; admins gate Local and Cloud separately and Remote Control needs workspace enablement.

feature: Codex /init creates AGENTS.md
detail: The /init command scaffolds an AGENTS.md for the current project, same as the CLI.

feature: Codex Enterprise Analytics API
detail: Workspace-scoped Admin key with codex.enterprise.analytics.read, set in Admin console > Credentials > Admin keys.

feature: (model name) and 5.4 mini removed from Codex
detail: As of Aug 31 2026 unavailable with ChatGPT sign-in; replaced by (model name) Terra and (model name) Luna. API and own-key use unaffected.

feature: approval_policy untrusted removed
detail: Newer CLI and desktop builds fail to start if config still sets it; use read-only sandbox with on-request approvals instead. Project trust_level untrusted remains supported.

feature: Codex Memories, Scheduled Tasks, in-app browser, Computer Use
detail: Context features that remember, continue over time and connect to tools; managed via developer docs data controls.

feature: Codex stuck troubleshooting
detail: If context repeatedly auto-compacts, start a new chat with a summary; Windows Trusted RPC browser error also resolved with a new chat.

feature: AI phone support line
detail: Automated voice agent answering general product, account and troubleshooting questions in the US, Canada and Australia; no ChatGPT account needed, 13+. It cannot file reports, escalate or reach a human.

feature: AI phone support routing for reports and requests
detail: Policy, legal, fraud, privacy, copyright and trademark issues must go to the report tool, Privacy Portal or dispute forms rather than the phone agent.

feature: AI phone support call retention and training
detail: Calls (audio and transcripts) may be retained for safety and used for training after reducing personal info; calls are disassociated from the phone number so cannot be exported or deleted.

feature: ChatGPT Record: transcribe and summarize meetings
detail: Record button at the bottom of a chat live-transcribes meetings, brainstorms or voice notes and produces a summary canvas with action items; needs mic and system-audio permission. macOS desktop only; Windows and Enterprise coming.

feature: Record controls: pause, resume, send, cancel, upload, delete
detail: Stop icon pauses; Resume continues, Send uploads and generates notes; the X offers Upload, Delete or Cancel.

feature: Record notes transform into email, plan or code
detail: Generated notes can be edited or rewritten as emails, project plans or code scaffolds.

feature: Record session cap of 4 hours
detail: Sessions auto-stop at 240 minutes and upload notes as a private canvas; limits and pricing may change, free at launch.

feature: Record speaker labels
detail: Distinguishes multiple speakers with generic labels (Speaker 1) that can be renamed; works best in English.

feature: Record calendar auto-join for Google Meet
detail: With Google Calendar connected, Record joins scheduled Google Meet meetings; Zoom, Teams and Webex require manual start.

feature: Reference record history setting
detail: Settings > Personalization toggle lets ChatGPT use past recording notes and transcripts in new chats; deleting the conversation stops use within days. Workspace owners can toggle it.

feature: Workspace owner toggle for Record
detail: Record is off by default for Enterprise and Edu workspaces and must be enabled in Workspace Controls; owners can also disable it for Business.

feature: Record audio deletion, training and retention
detail: Audio is used only for transcription then deleted (immediately on Enterprise/Edu); transcripts follow workspace retention, deletion within 30 days, Compliance API captures canvases. Free/Plus/Pro transcripts may train models if Improve the model is on.

feature: Credits for advanced features on Business, Enterprise, Edu
detail: Credits unlock Deep Research, Thinking models, image generation, advanced voice and Codex beyond limits; core features like search, file upload and canvas need no credits.

feature: Business per-seat limits with optional shared credit pool
detail: Each Business seat has limits; owners can buy credits (Settings > Billing) with automatic recharge to unblock overages; blocked when pool is empty.

feature: Enterprise and Edu shared credit pool with overage limit
detail: Pool is bought by contract with no per-seat caps by default; overage limit starts at No limit, owners can cap it or set 0 to block; RBAC sets spend controls by group; alerts by email and in product.

feature: Credit balance, usage reports and usage alerts
detail: Owners view balance and download usage reports in Workspace settings > Billing, and configure usage alerts there.

feature: Credit expiry and refund rules
