detail: Business credits last 12 months (Japan purchases after Nov 13 2026: 180 days) and are non-refundable except billing errors or unauthorized use; Enterprise/Edu follow the Order Form.

feature: Auto-routed mini model messages cost zero credits
detail: Chat messages automatically routed to a mini model use no credits under credit pricing.

feature: Enterprise seat additions reconciled by quarterly true-up
detail: Added seats do not instantly grow the pool; pooled credits follow a true-up about every 3 months.

feature: Legacy Codex seats for Business
detail: Workspaces with a Codex seat or pending invite before June 24 2026 may keep legacy Codex seats.

feature: Credit rate: Chat messages by model
detail: Instant is unlimited; (model name) Sol (Medium/High/Extra High) and (model name) Sol cost about 10 credits per message; (model name) Pro and Sol Pro about 50; Rosalind models 20. Higher effort on one model does not raise its rate.

feature: Credit rate: Agent, Deep research, Voice
detail: Agent mode about 30 credits per message, deep research 50 per task, Voice about 1.25 credits per minute; image generation in Chat is token-based with no fixed price.

feature: Edu included deep research and image budget
detail: Edu gets 5 deep research queries per rolling 24 hours (starting at first use) and a daily image budget at no credit cost.

feature: Business Instant auto-routes to Medium
detail: Where automatic routing is enabled, Instant may switch to Medium for harder requests and is charged at the applicable model rate.

feature: Work and Codex token-based credit rates
detail: Charged per 1M input, cached input and output tokens by model; applies to local, cloud, automations, code review and delegated workers. Codex cache writes are free; no extra context-length surcharge when signed in with ChatGPT.
plans: Business, Enterprise, Edu, Health, Gov, Teachers

feature: (model name), (model name) and (model name) only in Work and Codex
detail: These models are not offered in regular Chat; (model name) Sol also powers (model name) in Chat. Code review uses (model name).

feature: Fast mode at 2x credits and Ultrafast at 6x
detail: Fast charges twice standard on supported models; Ultrafast is 6x (3x promotional for (model name) through Feb 28 2027) and available in Work and Codex on Pro $500, Pro $200 for (model name) Sol in Codex, and eligible Enterprise/Edu.

feature: Ultra reasoning effort may run extra agents
detail: Ultra uses maximum reasoning and can spawn additional agents for eligible users, so cost depends on tokens across agents.

feature: Trusted Access models: Astra for Law, Daybreak cyber, Rosalind life sciences
detail: Specialized configurations ((model name) Astra Law, Daybreak Red/Blue, (model name) and 5.5 Rosalind Research/Discovery) require approval programs; Fast and Ultrafast unsupported for Cyber and Law at launch.

feature: ChatGPT for Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Workspace Agents pricing
detail: Token-based credits; (model name) Sol default where available, admins toggle models. Typical use: Excel 5-20 credits, PowerPoint 10-50, Workspace Agent run 5-25 credits per message or run.

feature: Business shared allowance and Codex-only seats
detail: Standard Business seat includes ChatGPT and Codex; Work, Workspace Agents, Office add-ins and Codex share an allowance and credit pool; Codex-only usage seats need credits from first use.

feature: ChatGPT Sites for Business and Enterprise
detail: Sites with public publishing where supported, in public beta on additional paid plans; pricing not yet published.

feature: Legacy models and legacy Codex rate card
detail: o3, (model name), 5.4 Thinking and Pro variants billed per message; a small set of Enterprise customers remain on per-message Codex rates until migrated.

feature: (model name) Sol promotional pricing
detail: Promotion through at least Nov 21 2026 applies only to purchased credits; included limits unchanged.

feature: Connect apps through Settings > Plugins
detail: Install plugin or connect an app via the provider authorization flow; some apps support multiple accounts or admin-managed connections; very old mobile builds say Apps instead of Plugins.

feature: Invoke apps with @ or + menu
detail: Mention an app or plugin with @ or choose it from + (or More); ChatGPT may ask approval before reading or acting.

feature: App capabilities: search, deep research sources, interactive cards, actions
detail: Apps can reference data, serve as deep research sources, show maps or cards in chat, and create or update items; Live (voice) can use plugins with on-screen approval.

feature: Financial transaction plugins with per-trade confirmation
detail: Some plugins let adults 18+ with U.S.-registered accounts review and confirm provider-executed trades; each transaction needs separate confirmation and ChatGPT is not an adviser.

feature: Event-triggered Work tasks from Gmail, Slack, GitHub
detail: Tasks run when a connected app gets a matching event (new Gmail message, Slack channel message, GitHub PR activity); approvals pause the task; shareable; off by default and outside BAA in Healthcare.

feature: Conversation subscriptions to app updates
detail: Where supported, a conversation can receive matching updates, for example new messages from a monitored Slack channel.

feature: Workspace app defaults and Disabled by admin state
detail: Business has many apps on by default; new Enterprise/Edu workspaces start with selected apps; admins manage in Admin Console > Plugins.

feature: Restrict app connections to verified email domain
detail: Enterprise can block connecting accounts of its verified domain from personal or outside workspaces; enabled via support request, does not disconnect existing links.

feature: Compliance Platform app events
detail: Eligible Enterprise/Edu workspaces can review app and conversation events, with coverage varying by app.

feature: App permission levels: Always ask, Allow read, Allow low-risk, Allow all
detail: Controls when ChatGPT asks before reading or acting; Allow all is only for eligible apps/accounts and absent from account-wide and workspace-wide selectors; permissions do not grant new access.

feature: iCloud Mail and Calendar plugins
detail: Separate plugins with read-only contact lookup using Apple app-specific passwords; rolling out on web, desktop and iOS across plans.

feature: Provider apps list: Drive, SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, OneNote, Slack, GitHub, G
detail: Provider-specific setup articles exist; Microsoft guest connections need the guest organization's tenant ID.

feature: Apps versus plugins
detail: Apps connect external services; plugins package apps and/or skills into workflows, and installing one does not bypass authorization.

feature: Data shared with apps and training on app data
detail: Enabled apps can see conversation and Memory context plus IP, device, language and approximate location; Business/Enterprise/Edu app data is not trained on, personal plans depend on Improve the model.

feature: ChatGPT may remember info from apps
detail: With Memory on, information accessed from apps may be remembered unless the source restricts it, and can inform web search queries.

feature: SSO (SAML and OIDC) for ChatGPT Business
detail: Included with Business: owner verifies one or more email domains, sets up SAML or OIDC under Workspace settings > Identity & access, tests with a user then invites members by their identity-provider email.

feature: Allow External Domain Invites
detail: Owners can invite contractors from other domains; affects new invites only and cannot be on together with required SSO.

feature: SSO exemptions for external members
detail: When SSO is required, external-domain members need a per-member exemption (Allow login without SSO) set only by owners; cleared on removal and not granted to new externals.

feature: Automatic account creation for verified domains
detail: Adds eligible members when they sign in with a verified-domain email; independent of SCIM and SSO, does not reactivate removed members, and can invite to several workspaces.

feature: Business has no SCIM or directory provisioning
detail: Standalone Business lacks SCIM, synced groups and automatic provisioning; an eligible Enterprise workspace in the tenant may enable group assignment.

feature: SSO lockout recovery and same-email account preservation
detail: Using the same email keeps existing accounts and history; admins cannot force merge of personal workspaces; support can restore access after lockout and admins can restore the prior sign-in policy.

feature: Plugin and app admin controls in Admin Console
detail: Admins manage plugin installation, app access, actions and content restrictions under Admin Console > Plugins; installation and app access are separate; new apps are disabled by default for Enterprise/Edu, enabled by default for Business.

feature: Bulk plugin availability for up to 25 plugins
detail: Select plugins and choose Available for installation, Installed for workspace, Customize by role, or Disable.

feature: Role-based plugin and app access via custom roles
detail: Permissions & roles > Custom roles > Plugins & connected data lets admins allow plugins and pick specific apps per role; skills-only plugins can be auto-assigned by role.

feature: Verified-domain restriction and Manage domains per app
detail: Support-enabled restriction blocks new connections of verified-domain accounts from outside workspaces for about 33 supported apps; Manage domains lets admins list allowed account email domains per app (empty means all).

feature: App action controls: read, write and new actions policy
detail: Admins enable Read or Write actions and choose for new actions: enable all, only read, or disable; Workspace Agents use builder-set per-agent controls.

feature: Workspace default app permission (Plugin permissions)
detail: Workspace settings > General sets default Always ask, Allow read, or Allow low-risk, with per-app overrides; Allow all is not in the workspace selector.

feature: Google Docs, Sheets, Slides actions via Google Drive app
detail: Standalone Docs/Sheets/Slides apps are merged into Google Drive; actions are off by default on Enterprise/Edu and on for Business, and Google admins may need to reauthorize scopes. Synced app indexing is gone.

feature: Safety and Security Controls for content access
detail: Per-app limits: Drive shared drives and My Drive, SharePoint sites and sensitivity labels, Teams groups and labels, Outlook label exclusions; apply to live access.

feature: Microsoft Graph permissions review and Entra consent
detail: Admins review Microsoft permission requests in ChatGPT and an Entra admin grants organization-wide consent; consent does not enable actions or connect users.

feature: Custom apps and custom MCP tool list refresh
detail: Owners, admins and authorized members can add custom MCP apps; admins can refresh a published app's tool list; custom apps are unverified and developer-only.

feature: App templates publishing flow
detail: Admins review template-generated draft apps, publish, then manage availability, actions and permissions.

feature: Epic plugin and Healthcare Public Data plugin
detail: Epic connects patient charts per-user via an admin-configured Epic EHR app; Healthcare Public Data searches public sources only and must not include PHI. PHI warning appears when enabling apps.

feature: Compliance Platform app activity and auth logs
detail: Eligible Enterprise/Edu workspaces can see app requests, responses and connect/disconnect events; Business admins do not get members' private chats.

feature: Outage credit for Korea subscribers and Apple refund path
detail: A June 2025 outage led to credits for Plus, Pro and Team users in South Korea; Apple-billed subscribers had to request compensation via Apple's Report a Problem.

feature: Official channels, email domains and apps list
detail: Lists genuine social handles, email domains (including chatgpt.email used by dots and tm.openai.com for invites), official iOS, Android, Mac and Windows apps.

feature: 1-800-ChatGPT phone and WhatsApp line
detail: Official number +1-800-242-8478; phone and WhatsApp availability, eligibility and limits vary by region.

feature: Custom roles with Default/On/Off permissions (RBAC)
detail: Owners create reusable roles in Workspace settings > Permissions & roles; permissions combine additively across direct and group roles, with workspace default as baseline; changes take up to 5 minutes.

feature: Assign roles to groups, SCIM groups or directly
detail: Owners assign roles to groups (manual or SCIM) or directly to members; Enterprise owners can let group managers edit assigned roles.

feature: Role capabilities: Owner, Admin, Member, Analytics viewer
detail: Only Owners create, assign or delete custom roles; Admins view or update existing ones; RBAC cannot override seat type, e.g. Codex-only seats.

feature: Lockdown Mode role
detail: Role-level security configuration restricting network-enabled features like web search, deep research, agent mode, Canvas networking and some app or MCP behavior, overriding ordinary roles.

feature: Per-role plugin access and Disabled by admin state
detail: Plugin access can be set per role or inherited; restricted plugins stay visible but show Disabled by admin; app access settings remain independent.

feature: Model access via roles and Test tool
detail: Owners enable models for workspace or roles; Admin console > Models > Test inspects effective access for Business, Enterprise, Healthcare, Edu.

feature: ChatGPT agent mode retired in favor of Work and cloud browser
detail: Page states agent is no longer available; Work handles long multi-step tasks and cloud browser covers supported browser workflows. Operator was merged into agent earlier.

feature: Agent mode invoked via /agent or tools menu
detail: Describe a task and the agent runs in a virtual browser, pausing for clarification or confirmation and can be interrupted or guided mid-task.

feature: Agent monthly message limits
detail: Plus 40, Pro 400, Business and Enterprise 40 per month, or 30 credits per message on flexible pricing; only initial requests count, scheduled runs count, concurrent tasks are limited.

feature: Schedule an agent task daily, weekly or monthly
detail: Clock icon repeats a finished task; manage at chatgpt.com/schedules or via the Edit schedule menu to pause, edit or delete.

feature: Take over browser for logins without screenshots
detail: Agent pauses for logins; Take over browser lets you type sensitive data while screenshots are not captured; cookies persist until cleared in data controls.

feature: Agent safeguards: confirmations, watch mode, prompt injection monitoring
detail: High-impact actions need confirmation, some sites require watch mode, and blocklisted sites are not visited across browser and apps.

feature: Agent screenshot retention and training controls
detail: Chats, browsing history and screenshots persist until deleted (purged within 90 days); Improve the model for everyone toggle governs training.

feature: Agent workspace controls: toggle, RBAC, website blocklist
detail: Enterprise toggle default off, role assignment, app limits, domain blocklist by exact domain or wildcard via account team; Compliance API logs conversations but not individual actions.

feature: Study mode
detail: Guided learning that asks questions Socratically, explains in layers, quizzes you one at a time, and creates practice questions or flashcard-style review; works with any model.

feature: Turn on Study via @study, + menu or chatgpt.com/studymode
detail: Type @study or use + then Study; also a direct URL. Not available in Temporary Chats, GPTs or Projects; turn off by removing the Study token.

feature: Study mode with uploaded notes, slides and photos
detail: Upload class notes, syllabus, worksheets, PDFs or problem photos for study help; point to a page or paste text if missed.

feature: Study mode personalization with Memory
detail: Uses saved memories and past chats for goals and preferred style when enabled; works without Memory.

feature: Edu admins can require study mode
detail: In eligible Edu workspaces study mode can be applied automatically to regular chats and the selector is hidden; excludes GPT and Project chats.

feature: Study hours and quiet hours for linked teens
detail: Parents schedule times when new chats start in study mode (study hours) or block use entirely (quiet hours) in Settings > Parental controls.

feature: ChatGPT agent launch history
detail: Launched July 17 2025 for Pro, Plus, Team with virtual browser merging in Operator (standalone site deprecated); Enterprise and Edu added Aug 8 2025.

feature: Work Cloud browser signs requests with Web Bot Auth
detail: Outbound cloud browser requests carry RFC 9421 Signature, Signature-Input and Signature-Agent headers with public keys at chatgpt.com/.well-known so sites can verify them.

feature: Cloud browser allowlisting guides for Akamai, Cloudflare, HUMAN, Vercel
detail: Site owners can allow traffic as ChatGPT Agent (Akamai, HUMAN), dots OpenAI personal agent or detection ID (Cloudflare); Vercel needs no setup.

feature: Cloud browser cannot sign in or pay at launch
detail: Even if allowlisted, the cloud browser does not log into websites or complete payments at launch.

feature: Enable legacy models workspace toggle
detail: Admins turn on Enable legacy models under Workspace settings > Models; legacy models appear only while still available, remain subject to credits and limits, and retired ones are removed from existing chats.

feature: Personality: Base style and tone selector
detail: Settings > Personalization > Base style and tone picks how ChatGPT sounds; applies to all chats including existing ones and does not change capabilities or safety rules.

feature: Personality presets: Default, Professional, Friendly, Candid, Quirky, Efficient,
detail: Seven styles: neutral default, formal and polished, warm sounding board, direct and encouraging, playful and imaginative, concise answer-first, and sarcastic but practical.

feature: Personality interacts with Memory and Custom instructions
detail: Saved memories, custom instructions or in-chat requests can override a personality's visible traits, and generated artifacts like emails or code follow the request rather than the personality.

feature: Appearance: System, Light, Dark
detail: Settings > General (web, Windows) or Settings > Appearance/Theme (mobile); a per-device preference that does not sync across platforms.

feature: Contrast setting: System, Medium, Increased
detail: Web and Windows only; System follows OS accessibility preference, Increased mostly affects light appearance; saved to account.

feature: Accent color picker
detail: Blue, Green, Yellow, Pink, Orange, Purple or a neutral Black/White option (availability varies); recolors bubbles and buttons, saved to account; no custom or red colors and no bubble-only setting.

feature: Text size zoom in Windows app
detail: Settings > General > Text size with plus, minus and Reset zooms the whole app; web uses browser zoom and mobile uses device settings.

feature: ChatGPT Go plan overview
detail: Low-cost paid plan in all supported countries with higher limits than Free for images, file uploads, data analysis, longer memory, plus projects, tasks, custom GPTs and Library; monthly billing, cancel anytime, no annual option.

feature: Go includes Think ((model name) Luna) without Sol or legacy models
detail: Go users get Think on web and mobile (Think harder in the + menu) using Luna; (model name) Sol and legacy models like 4o are not included. Voice mode has Free-tier limits.

feature: Ads being tested on Go in select regions
detail: Eligible Go users in some regions may see ads; details in the Ads in ChatGPT article.

feature: Sign in with ChatGPT using Go plan
detail: Go plan limits can be used in supported partner apps and sites via Sign in with ChatGPT.

feature: Go billing, invoices and plan switching
detail: Web purchases managed under Settings > Billing; Apple or Google subscriptions via store history; downgrade from Plus/Pro takes effect at cycle end without refund.

feature: Business Standard and Premium seats
detail: Two seat types include thinking models, coding and agentic usage; Premium has higher Work and Codex allowance and no 5-hour limit but Chat model allowances are separate; downgrades apply at effective date.

feature: Business (model name) Pro Chat allowance
detail: Standard gets 15 Pro messages per month and Premium 50 per week, shared between (model name) Pro and (model name) Sol Pro.

feature: Higher intelligence setting for automatic reasoning
detail: Settings > General controls whether ChatGPT adds reasoning while Instant is selected; automatic reasoning may consume the reasoning allowance.

feature: Business Work and Codex local message estimates per 5 hours
detail: Standard seat estimates range from 5-45 on (model name) up to 250-2,000 on (model name) Luna; credits can extend beyond included usage if spending controls allow.

feature: (model name) Astra and Sol in Business Work and Codex pickers
detail: Selectable in Work and Codex model selectors by seat and permissions; Standard seats get limited Astra within existing allowance; not in regular Chat.

feature: Business Instant virtually unlimited with guardrails
detail: Applies to Instant chat only, not reasoning, Pro, Work or Codex; abuse and credential sharing are prohibited.

feature: Plugin use-case categories
detail: Example workflows across writing, meetings, organization, analysis (including HubSpot) and coding with Drive, SharePoint, Box, Notion, Gmail, Outlook, Calendar and GitHub apps, subject to availability.

feature: Usage Policies update effective Nov 20 2026
detail: Clarifies bans on training substitute models with outputs, child and teen protections, high-stakes use, national security approvals and model-access intermediary approvals.

feature: IP allowlisting for workspace and Compliance API
detail: Owners/admins add allowed IPs under Workspace Settings > Identity & access > Access Restrictions with separate lists; off by default, 5-15 minutes to apply, blocks all ChatGPT endpoints including file downloads; Compliance API enforcement is always on.

feature: EU AI Act resources and training-data summaries
detail: Lists prohibited practices, public training summaries per model, and a reporting form for EU support and copyright complaints.

feature: Content provenance: C2PA, SynthID and verify portal
detail: Image and audio outputs carry C2PA metadata or watermarks verifiable at openai.com/verify or the Content Provenance API; API customers can enable text watermarking.

feature: Voice dictation via microphone icon
detail: Recorded audio is transcribed to editable text before sending; audio kept while the chat exists and deleted within 30 days of chat deletion.

feature: Stop sharing dictation audio for training
detail: Data controls toggle Include your audio recordings or Improve the model for everyone off stops sharing both dictation and voice chat audio; business data not trained on.

feature: ChatGPT in KakaoTalk partnership
detail: Announced preview with no beta, waitlist or linking yet; will be in the Korean KakaoTalk with details on regions, plans and privacy to come.

feature: SharePoint app: search and reference work files
detail: Searches SharePoint and OneDrive for work or school content the Microsoft account can already open; personal OneDrive unsupported; supports .txt, .pdf, .docx, .pptx, .xlsx, .csv up to 100 MiB per file.

feature: SharePoint write actions: folders, uploads, sharing links, lists, pages
detail: When enabled by admins and approved in Microsoft, ChatGPT can create folders, upload or update files, manage sharing links and work with lists and pages, asking confirmation for changes.

feature: SharePoint guest connection with tenant ID
detail: Connect another account, Advanced settings, Connect as guest and enter the other organization's Microsoft tenant ID.

feature: SharePoint Microsoft Graph scopes and site allowlist
detail: Live access needs Sites.Read.All and Files.Read.All in both ChatGPT and Entra (Sites.Selected unsupported); site-collection allowlist and sensitivity-label exclusions are enforced by OpenAI.

feature: Admin Console tenant with Global settings and product scopes
detail: One console for tenant-wide identity (Global settings) and per-workspace or Ads account settings; roles include Global admin, User manager, Member and Ads admin, none of which auto-grants workspace access.

feature: Tenant rename and verified domains
detail: Global admins rename the tenant and review verified domains and product mappings under Access > Domains.

feature: Automatic account creation defaults
detail: Per-workspace toggle; on by default for the first Enterprise workspace in a new tenant, off for later ones, grants full seats; should be off when SCIM manages access.

feature: SCIM directory sync and Product access group assignment
detail: Tenant-wide and product-level SCIM can coexist; synchronized groups map to workspaces, Ads accounts and API orgs; Business has no custom groups.

feature: External access: Sign in with ChatGPT and delegated access policies
detail: Global admins set organization defaults and per-app exceptions for identity sign-in, data sharing and Ads access; members still authorize themselves; identity tokens linger up to 1 hour after restriction.

feature: ChatGPT Sites visitor-connected apps
detail: Sites can use each visitor's own connected apps after Sign in with ChatGPT; admins need Allow use in Sites on each plugin; identity sign-in is mandatory.

feature: Admin changes of user email
detail: Global admins change non-SCIM user emails with limits: verified domains, account 24 hours old, 2 per day and 20 lifetime, no unverified domains.

feature: Account switching between personal and work accounts
detail: Owners enable Enable account switching so members stay signed into separate accounts on web, iOS and Android; each keeps its own chats, files and memory.

feature: Admin analytics with windows and group filters
detail: ChatGPT, Codex and credit analytics (120 days; usage up to 12 months), refreshed every 1-48 hours, filterable by synced groups; Codex analytics via Allow members to administer Codex role.

feature: Audit logs and Admin keys
detail: Global admins see tenant audit logs; workspace audit logs cover Codex policy changes; owners/admins manage workspace Admin keys and Codex service accounts.

feature: Workspace usage limits with group and user overrides
detail: Limits page sets workspace default, group and user overrides, Unlimited option, monthly UTC or billing-cycle reset, and an option to show usage in credits and dollars to members.

feature: Workspace agents admin review
detail: Admins can review agents with their activity, connected apps, memory files, schedules and analytics.

feature: Parental controls: link parent and teen accounts
detail: Parent or teen invites the other by phone or email in Settings > Parental controls; one parent can link many teens, a teen links to one parent; either side can unlink and linking gives no chat access.

feature: Parental control toggles for linked teens
detail: Parent can set Reduce sensitive content, Improve the model, Reference saved memories, Health, Codex network access, Cloud browser, Voice Mode and Image generation (mostly on by default) plus Study mode (off by default).

feature: Quiet hours for linked teens
detail: Parent schedules one or more time blocks when the teen cannot use ChatGPT including Work; managed only in Settings, not in chat.

feature: Study hours for linked teens
detail: Optional schedule that starts eligible new conversations in study mode without blocking access; excludes GPTs and Projects.

feature: Change parental controls by asking ChatGPT
detail: Parents can ask ChatGPT in chat to update supported settings and approve with Allow or Deny; schedules and invitations cannot be changed this way.

feature: Teen safety notifications to parents
detail: Limited alerts about serious self-harm, disordered eating signals, permanent closure over violence, ended conversations and temporary suspensions; reviewed by trained staff, by email, SMS or push, without transcripts; gradually rolling out.

feature: Health toggle removes data when turned off
detail: Turning Health off for a teen removes it from sidebar and plugin directory, disconnects sources and deletes synced data; reconnection is manual.

feature: Teen turning 18 exits teen experience
detail: Account moves out of ChatGPT for Teens, parental controls end, teen protections and notifications stop; adults mistakenly in teen mode can Verify age in Settings > Account (up to 1 hour to update).

feature: Trusted Contact for adults
detail: Optional adult feature (18+, 19+ in Korea) naming one person who can be notified about a serious suicide-related safety concern.

feature: Reduce sensitive content setting
detail: Settings > Safety toggle makes responses more cautious about graphic violence, risky viral challenges, sexual or violent roleplay and extreme beauty or dieting content; on by default for teens, and may be locked by parents or workspace admins.

feature: Automatic teen experience from age prediction
detail: If an account is predicted under 18 it is placed in ChatGPT for Teens even with a stated birthdate; adults can verify age to leave it.

feature: Report unsafe responses with thumbs-down
detail: Thumbs-down on a response lets users report content inappropriate for teens with prompt and reason.

feature: Dots for Business Standard (US)
detail: Eligible Business Standard members in the US can create one personal dot in the workspace to help with ongoing projects like weekly updates; usage limits apply.

feature: Per-member SSO exemption control (Nov 2026)
detail: Owners choose Allow login without SSO or Follow workspace SSO policy per external member in Admin Console; existing externals auto-exempted, new ones not.

feature: (model name) Astra and Sol arrive in Business Work and Codex
detail: Astra is the frontier model for complex work and Sol balances reasoning and speed; selected in the Work or Codex picker by seat and permissions, not in Chat.

feature: (model name) Rosalind Research for life sciences
detail: Limited rollout to approved Business customers in Work and Codex only; requires Research approval; (model name) Rosalind remains available.

feature: Doubled Work and Codex allowance on Pro and Business Premium
detail: From Oct 29 2026 Pro 100 and Pro 500 get twice the prior allowance and Pro 200 lower-allowance users are raised to match; planned Pro 200 reduction canceled.

feature: Promotional API credits for eligible Business workspaces
detail: Eligible workspaces can activate API credits on a linked API organization, separate from ChatGPT credits.

feature: (model name) Terra in Work and Codex
detail: Supports visual reasoning, computer use and writing with Standard or Fast mode; not in Chat and no UAE inference residency.

feature: Business settings manageable in Admin Console
detail: Owners and admins can manage members and workspace controls in Admin Console in addition to Workspace settings; no Enterprise-only features added.

feature: Locked chats with 4-digit PIN or device auth
detail: Members lock a conversation via the ... menu to hide it from history, pins and search without deleting; unlock with PIN or device authentication; retention policies unchanged.

feature: Bulk plugin management in Business
detail: Admins manage up to 25 plugins at once in Admin console; first announced for Business Oct 2026.

feature: (model name) and Intelligent UI in Business Chat
detail: (model name) on Sol rolling out to eligible Business workspaces with mixed text, visual and interactive responses at Instant through Extra High.

feature: Plugin and marketplace admin in Admin console
detail: Owners and admins manage plugins and workspace plugin Marketplaces; apps stay under Workspace settings > Apps or Manage Legacy Apps.

feature: Codex Cloud isolated per-task workspaces
detail: Tasks use reusable environments with repos and dependencies, start and continue from desktop, web or mobile, and run while the computer sleeps.

feature: Shared team connections for approved tools
detail: Admins configure app connections so a team owner can enable workspace-level connections for recurring tasks without each teammate connecting; plugin sharing is separate.

feature: Private workspace Sites with connected apps, Edit site and schedules
detail: Business members build private Sites using teammates' read-only connected accounts (Allow use in Sites off by default); owners and editors can edit from a published Site on desktop and create cloud schedules from Automations.

feature: (model name) in Work and Codex
detail: Improves agentic coding and computer use; rolling out starting with Pro then Plus, Business, Enterprise, Edu (admins must enable).

feature: Teams in ChatGPT: share Pages and Spaces
detail: Create a team of coworkers to share Pages or Spaces, shared plugins and recurring team tasks; membership does not share personal chats or connections.

feature: Team tasks on schedules or triggers
detail: Shared recurring tasks run on schedule or supported triggers with approved tools, e.g. weekly update to Slack; teammates can review and edit together.

feature: @ChatGPT in Slack and Microsoft Teams
detail: Business orgs can DM or mention @ChatGPT to answer, summarize threads or draft work using admin-connected tools; must be installed and enabled by admins.

feature: External access controls for Sites and Ads
detail: Global admins manage whether Sites can use members' connected apps and whether apps can access ChatGPT Ads; both off by default in admin preview.

feature: Plugins in Voice and Voice in Work
detail: Live voice works with plugins on web and mobile and Work supports voice on web and mobile for documents, slides, spreadsheets, apps and browser; unfinished tasks continue in text.

feature: Privacy Center
detail: Hub covering chat privacy, memory, personalization, data use, connected apps and security with links to settings; on web via Help menu, mobile in Settings.

feature: ChatGPT for Word add-in
detail: Sidebar to draft from notes, summarize, revise selected text and adjust formatting; same Microsoft add-in as Excel/PowerPoint; admin toggle, default-on from Oct 1 2026; token-priced.

feature: Model Test announced for Business admins
detail: Admins check which models a member can access and why via Models > Test.

feature: Quick Chat and Pets Mini controls on desktop
detail: Send typed requests from floating Pets controls with Option+Space (macOS) or Windows+Alt+P; choose Mini in Settings > Pets; workspace restrictions on Pets apply.

feature: Appshots on Windows
detail: Press both Alt keys to send the frontmost app window with screenshot and available text to ChatGPT; shortcut and destination chat configurable.

feature: Data plugin for business data analysis
detail: In Work and Codex, ask business questions, investigate changes and build interactive dashboards or reports using team metric definitions; admins manage install policy.

feature: Voice uses (model name) or (model name); GPT-Live daily limits
detail: Voice can call a stronger model for search/reasoning; Business Standard gets up to 3 hours and Premium 15 hours of GPT-Live-1 daily, extra Voice 1.25 credits/min (was 5); separate Voice intelligence levels deprecated.

feature: Codex CLI worktrees and inline answers
detail: CLI 0.154.0 adds experimental separate Git worktrees for tasks, browse and resume them, answer questions inline, keep formatting on copy and refresh plugin tools.

feature: ChatGPT Images 2.5 release
detail: Sharper, more precise and faster images with templates, sketch input, mobile edit and comments, prompt sharing and a loading Snake game (not in Work).

feature: Partner plugin $50 credit promotions
detail: Business users who try Stripe, QuickBooks, HubSpot, Gusto, Dropbox or Canva plugins and finish a workflow within 7 days earn a $50 workspace credit (max 2 per workspace, expires in 30 days).

feature: Codex task and worktree improvements on iOS
detail: Reference another task with @, answer Codex questions without losing the draft, file browsing with recents, remote worktree branch choice and Live Activity on iOS 26.

feature: Zendesk and OneNote plugins (beta)
detail: Zendesk covers tickets, history, knowledge and reply drafting; OneNote finds and summarizes notes and creates or updates them; members connect their own accounts.

feature: Share Sites with named outside viewers
detail: Site owners can invite external viewers by email without adding them to the workspace or making the Site public.

feature: Import plugin marketplaces from GitHub with daily sync
detail: Admins add public or private GitHub marketplaces via Workspace settings > Plugins > Add > Import marketplace, with automatic daily sync and Sync now; importing grants no app access.

feature: Webhook-triggered and shareable scheduled tasks
detail: Work tasks fire on new Gmail messages, Slack channel messages and GitHub PR activity; scheduled and webhook tasks can be shared within the workspace with independent copies.

feature: Business Premium seats
detail: Premium seats give 5x Standard usage, no 5-hour limit and weekly resets; mix seats freely; $100 per user per month annual or $125 monthly vs Standard $20 annual or $25 monthly.

feature: Collaborate on Sites with editors
detail: Owners add workspace members as editors who can save and later publish to the same URL; owners keep sharing, settings, analytics and restore control.

feature: Apple Messages plugin on Apple silicon Macs
detail: Reads and searches iMessage, SMS and RCS and prepares or sends messages after user approval; admins can disable via Computer Use control.

feature: Computer History on macOS (opt-in)
detail: Records interaction events (not screenshots or audio, no private browsing) from chosen apps and sites into ChatGPT and Codex; off by default, needs Memories and admin enablement; extended to EEA, UK, Switzerland Aug 2026.

feature: Read-only snapshot share of a Codex chat
detail: Share links limited to authenticated workspace members, admins can disable them, snapshot does not update and redacts known secrets.

feature: Paste keeps formatting, Add from library, multi-select Library
detail: Pasted Google Docs text keeps headings and links on web; composer menu has Add from library; drag to multi-select library items.

feature: Search includes folders and conversation titles
detail: Search matches folders and conversation titles on web, iOS, Android and can search within Library.

feature: Background Voice safeguards
detail: Mobile Voice checks that you are still present and ends inactive background sessions; Background conversations toggle in Settings > Voice.

feature: Work usage visible in sidebar
detail: Eligible personal-plan and Business users see remaining Work usage in the web sidebar.

feature: Files and Projects in Voice
detail: GPT-Live accepts file uploads and works in Projects with project chats, sources and instructions.

feature: Voice in Work and Codex on desktop with iOS remote
detail: Voice starts tasks, checks progress and coordinates agents in macOS and Windows desktop apps; Business includes 1 hour of Voice in Chat then 5 credits/min and about 6 credits/min for Work/Codex voice.

feature: Desktop app layout: Chat or Work, Recents, Projects
detail: Global switcher between ChatGPT and Codex, Chat vs Work mode, unified sortable Recents with pins, Projects in app, cloud Work synced across web, mobile and desktop.

feature: ChatGPT Work agent launch
detail: Agent for longer tasks producing documents, spreadsheets, presentations, reports and Sites, with progress steering, approvals and Scheduled Tasks; rolling out to paid plans except Free and Go; Enterprise/Edu two-week preview off by default.

feature: Plugin Directory replaces App Directory; skills GA
detail: Plugins package skills, apps and templates; Enterprise and Edu find Skills under Plugins in the sidebar.

feature: New ChatGPT desktop app unifies Chat, Work, Codex
detail: Global macOS and Windows app; Work uses local files and desktop apps with permission and a built-in browser; Codex gets inline diff editing, PR review panel, faster computer use and multi-repo projects; old app becomes ChatGPT Classic.

feature: ChatGPT Sites public beta and public publishing
detail: Build dashboards, trackers, portals and lightweight apps from Work; Business/Enterprise can publish publicly by URL (off by default for Enterprise); beta for Pro, Pro Lite, Edu, then Plus; not Free or Go; public publishing and beta not in EEA, Switzerland, UK at launch.

feature: Group chats retired
detail: From July 9 2026 users cannot create group chats, convert chats or join via invite link; existing group chats stay available until they become read-only with messages retained.

feature: Atlas browser retired Aug 9 2026
detail: Atlas stops working Aug 9 2026; data like bookmarks and history do not transfer automatically (cookies and passwords can be exported to the desktop app, bookmarks to Chrome); replaced by browser capabilities in ChatGPT desktop and Chrome extension.

feature: ChatGPT for PowerPoint GA
detail: Create and revise editable decks in PowerPoint with Skills and apps; free for Business through Aug 6 2026 then credit pool; admins enable it.

feature: Workspace Agent runs token-priced from Jul 6 2026
detail: Credits are based on input, cached and output tokens; Business includes Workspace Agents, Excel and PowerPoint in the shared agentic pool.

feature: Simplified model picker: Instant, Medium, High, Extra High, Pro Standard, Pro Ex
detail: Medium, High and Extra High replace Thinking Standard, Extended and Heavy; Thinking Light removed; Instant can auto-switch to Medium; picker top on mobile, composer on web.

feature: Plugin admin page with search and filters
detail: Workspace settings > Plugins offers filters by status, install policy, roles, category and catalog plus Available or Installed-by-default policy.

feature: Improved memory with summary and Sources
detail: Memory uses relevant past chats beyond manual saves; users can view a summary and Sources under answers, correct memory, delete a referenced chat, mark a source irrelevant, turn off or go back to Saved memories; project-only memory stays isolated.

feature: Codex Remote GA with QR pairing and DigitalOcean plugin
detail: Business users start or continue work on a connected Mac or Windows host from the mobile app and approve actions; one-to-one QR pairing per device and host; DigitalOcean Droplet plugin makes a remote workspace.

feature: Slack connector actions with OAuth scopes
detail: With actions enabled ChatGPT can join channels, create reminders, upload files and update the Slack profile; may need extra scopes or admin approval and admin Action controls.

feature: Record and Replay in Codex announced for Business
detail: Demonstrate a workflow once to make a reusable skill on macOS; requires Computer Use; excludes EU, UK, Switzerland at launch.

feature: Codex coworker invitations with admin toggle
detail: Business users can Invite a coworker from the profile menu for a referral bonus; admins toggle in Workspace settings > Permissions & Roles.

feature: Codex updates: /init, Windows per-app Computer Use controls, usage-limit errors,
detail: Adds /init AGENTS.md scaffold, per-app access controls for Windows Computer Use, clearer usage-limit messages with reset timing and an Unread chats section.

feature: Sites via Codex plugin for internal apps
detail: Preview of lightweight full-stack JS/TS apps with hosted URLs, Sign in with ChatGPT, data and file storage; Business enabled by default, managed under Permissions & Roles and Workspace settings > Sites.

feature: Role-specific Codex plugins and 66 single-app plugins
detail: Packs for Sales, Data Analytics, Product Design, Creative Production, Investment Banking and Public Equity bundle skills, apps and prompts; plus integrations such as Databricks, Salesforce, Hex, Clay.

feature: Active sessions review and sign-out
detail: Settings > Security > Active sessions lists ChatGPT, Codex and API sessions with device, app, location, sign-in time and trusted status and logs out one or all; unavailable for SSO-linked accounts.

feature: Computer Use and Remote Control on Windows, Codex profiles
detail: Codex can see, click and type in Windows apps (not in EEA, UK, Switzerland) and be steered from iOS, Android or Mac; Codex profiles show identity, activity, usage and tokens.

feature: App templates for GitHub Enterprise, Snowflake, Databricks
detail: Guided admin setup for OAuth credentials, callbacks, webhooks and managed MCP URLs; published apps managed under Apps > Enabled with role access and action confirmation.

feature: Workspace agent model, guided setup, speech output, Slack threads
detail: Creators pick (model name) and reasoning effort, get guided setup questions, agents can output audio, and Slack agents can reply to follow-ups in a thread if chosen.

feature: Goal mode, Appshots, locked computer use, plugin sharing in Codex
detail: Goal mode lets Codex pursue an outcome with success criteria (app, IDE, CLI); Appshots attach an app window on macOS; locked computer use keeps working after the Mac locks; locally built plugins can be shared in the workspace; admin policy toggles exist.

feature: Codex in-app browser annotations and browser-use upgrades
detail: Annotation mode for styling feedback, faster asset extraction, read-only JavaScript context, tab grouping and fewer Chrome extension tabs.

feature: Codex analytics in global admin console
detail: Shows active users, credits and tokens, threads and turns, leaderboards, plugin usage, accepted lines of code and model usage.

feature: Workspace agents GA with per-app action safeguards
detail: Agents own workflows, are shared across the team, builders set allowed actions per app, admins see activity; free period extended to Jul 6 2026 before credit pricing.

feature: Codex access tokens and mobile Codex preview
detail: Access tokens let scripts, schedulers and private CI run with workspace identity; mobile app shows live host state (diffs, terminal, screenshots) in preview on iOS and Android.

feature: Analytics and Agents areas in global admin console
detail: Adoption trends and drilldowns for GPTs, projects, skills, users, tools and connectors; Agents view shows ID, activity, apps, memory files, schedules.

feature: ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets
detail: Spreadsheet sidebar to build, clean, update and explain workbooks with Skills and apps; free preview through Jun 2 2026 then credits; admin enables in workspace settings.

feature: Workspace Agents for Business: build, share, schedule, Slack
detail: Create from templates or scratch, connect Drive, Calendar, Slack, SharePoint, add skills, files and custom MCP, share privately, by link or directory, schedule runs, use in Slack channels, see versions and analytics; on by default.

feature: Japan data residency for all sync apps
detail: All apps with sync supported in-region residency in Japan for eligible Business workspaces.

feature: Simplified app Action control
detail: Per app choose all actions, read only or custom; for new actions choose enable all, only new read, or disable until reviewed.

feature: Workspace analytics replaces User analytics
detail: Dashboard with active users, messages and credits, per-member table with seat type, date ranges (7d to 12 months or custom), search and a Codex analytics link.

feature: Outlook shared mailbox and shared calendar actions
detail: With Microsoft permissions ChatGPT can read, move, mark and send from shared mailboxes and create, update, respond to, cancel and delete shared calendar events; admins enable new actions; users may reconnect.

feature: Codex-only seats on credit pricing
detail: New seat with no monthly fee and Codex access only (no ChatGPT workspace); requires workspace credits; subscription seats cut by $5/month in April 2026; Codex rate card moved to token-based.

feature: Updated Box, Notion, Linear, Dropbox apps with write actions
detail: Auto-enabled, admins review actions and authorize new scopes, members may need to reconnect.

feature: Plugins in Codex directory
detail: Curated directory of installable bundles of skills, optional apps and MCP configs for reusable Codex workflows; follows workspace app controls.

feature: Google Drive app unification (Docs, Sheets, Slides)
detail: Unified Google Drive app with new actions on by default for Business; existing users disconnect and reconnect to use them; Google scopes may need reauthorization.

feature: Legacy deep research mode removed Mar 26 2026
detail: Only the legacy mode was removed; current deep research and past results remain.

feature: Write actions for Microsoft and Google apps
detail: Outlook can draft emails, Docs and Sheets create files and calendars set meetings; write actions are off by default until admins enable under Manage actions; Entra approval may be needed.

feature: Codex app on Windows
detail: Windows desktop surface running multiple parallel agents with isolated worktrees and reviewable diffs, sharing workspace controls with other Codex surfaces.

feature: Add project sources from apps, chats and pasted text
detail: Paste Slack channel or Drive file/folder links, save responses into a project, or paste notes as sources for a living knowledge base.

feature: Codex app for macOS launch
detail: Command center for multiple parallel coding agents with isolated worktree diffs, progress views, skills and automations; Codex local must be enabled; limited-time 2x Business rate limits.

feature: App directory with in-chat interactive apps
detail: Browse and add approved apps; connectors became apps; Business apps on by default; developers can submit apps; some apps unavailable in EEA, UK, Switzerland.

feature: Apps admin UI with Enabled, Available, Draft tabs
detail: Search, filters and bulk actions for roles or disabling; per-connector action and sync controls.

feature: Atlassian Rovo MCP connector
detail: Brings Jira, Compass and Confluence context and supports write actions like creating Jira issues, approved in chat.

feature: Partner MCP access connectors (Amplitude, Fireflies, Vercel, Monday, Stripe, Hex
detail: Reviewed partner connectors that fetch content on request; default off for Enterprise and on for Business.

feature: Custom MCP connectors in company knowledge
detail: Custom MCP connectors with search/fetch appear in company knowledge for allowed users.

feature: Apps and Apps SDK for Business
detail: Interactive apps like Canva, Figma, Booking.com, Spotify and Zillow in chat; companies can build apps with the Apps SDK and test in developer mode.

feature: Synced connectors (Azure Boards, Basecamp, Zoho, Aha!, Asana, ClickUp, GitLab Is
detail: Indexed connectors on by default for Business that ChatGPT references automatically; users connect from Settings > Apps & Connectors.

feature: Company knowledge with citations
detail: Composer option that searches connected tools such as Slack, SharePoint, Drive, GitHub, HubSpot, Asana and returns cited answers respecting each user's permissions.

feature: Custom MCP connectors via developer mode (beta)
detail: Build, upload and publish read/write MCP connectors; admins review and publish to the workspace.

feature: Workspace settings reorganised (General, Identity & access, Permissions & roles)
detail: General tab holds name, logo, appearance and workspace-wide instructions; Identity & provisioning and IP allowlists merged into Identity & access.

feature: ChatGPT app and connector for Slack
detail: Chat one-on-one with ChatGPT in a Slack sidebar, summarize threads, draft replies and search accessible messages and files; chats sync to the ChatGPT sidebar; connector brings Slack context into ChatGPT.

feature: Slack app semantic search and paid Slack requirement
detail: Semantic search needs Slack AI on Business+ or Enterprise+, otherwise keyword; app needs a paid Slack account and the connector enabled; connector also works in Deep Research and Agent Mode.

feature: Synced connectors (Notion, Linear, Intercom, SharePoint)
detail: Admin-enabled indexed connectors users link via OAuth; ChatGPT references indexed content automatically.

feature: Codex in Slack and Codex SDK
detail: Codex works in Slack and via a Codex SDK for programmatic control, plus admin controls for cloud environments and CLI/IDE defaults.

feature: Project sharing with teammates
detail: Share projects by individual or group email or link, manage member access and files; memory stays project-only.

feature: (model name) for Codex
detail: Coding-optimized variant default for cloud tasks and code review and selectable locally; not in ChatGPT or API.

feature: ChatGPT Team renamed ChatGPT Business (Aug 29 2025)
detail: Name-only change with no feature, price or limit change.

feature: Codex IDE extension, sign in with ChatGPT, GitHub code review
detail: VS Code and forks extension, local-to-cloud handoff, and automatic PR reviews or @codex mentions in GitHub.

feature: Gmail, Google Calendar, Contacts connectors in chat
detail: Referenced automatically in chat; deep research still needs each connector enabled and selected per request.

feature: Project-only memory
detail: Projects can isolate memory so ChatGPT uses only that project's chats and nothing flows out; requires personal and workspace Memory enabled.

feature: (model name) launch with legacy model remapping
detail: (model name) became default auto-switching model; paid tiers get picker, Thinking and Pro; old chats (4o, 4.1, 4.5, o3, o4-mini) reopen on (model name) equivalents; voice then on (model name).

feature: Earlier four personalities (Cynic, Robot, Listener, Nerd)
detail: Aug 2025 set of tone presets; not applied to Voice; since replaced by the current list.

feature: Voice mode: custom GPTs, instruction-following style, Standard Voice retired
detail: Voice works with custom GPTs, adapts speaking style for paid users, Plus near-unlimited and Free hours daily; Standard Voice retired after 30 days.

feature: Team flexible credit pricing (Jul 2025)
detail: Credits unlock advanced models and features while core models stay unlimited.

feature: Projects file limit raised to 40 for Team
detail: Limit increased from 20 uploaded files to 40 in June 2025.

feature: Projects: deep research, voice, share chats, start from chat, mobile uploads
detail: June 2025 additions for focused work.

feature: Connectors in deep research and Google Drive synced connector
detail: Deep research can use Drive, SharePoint, Dropbox, Box, Outlook, Gmail, Calendar, Linear, GitHub, HubSpot and Teams; Drive sync gives semantic search with admin scoping.

feature: Export deep research report as PDF
detail: Share icon > Download as PDF produces formatted report with tables, images and citations for new and past reports.

feature: (model name) added for paid users (May 2025)
detail: Coding-focused model in the more-models dropdown with (model name) limits; since remapped.

feature: Scheduled tasks (beta, Jan 2025)
detail: Ask ChatGPT to do something once or repeatedly at a future time, beta for Plus, Pro and Teams.

feature: Projects launch (Dec 2024)
detail: Group files and chats with custom instructions; chats in projects share context and support canvas, data analysis, image generation and search.

feature: Advanced Voice on web (Nov 2024)
detail: Real-time voice chat on chatgpt.com for paid plans.

feature: Data analysis improvements (May 2024)
detail: Import files from Drive and OneDrive, expandable tables and charts, downloadable presentation-ready charts.

feature: Memory for Plus (Apr 2024)
detail: Tell ChatGPT what to remember; toggle in settings.

feature: GPT Store and ChatGPT Team launch (Jan 2024)
detail: Store of partner and community GPTs at chatgpt.com/gpts and a collaborative workspace plan with advanced models and admin tools.

feature: Invoices list in Billing settings
detail: Go, Plus and Pro web subscribers open Settings > Billing > Invoices, view an invoice and use View all for older ones. Business owners see invoices under workspace Billing or via Manage plan > Payment method billing portal.

feature: App Store and Google Play subscription receipts
detail: Subscriptions bought through Apple or Google do not appear in ChatGPT invoices; receipts live in the store purchase history of the paying account and are emailed on each renewal.

feature: Invoice help for deactivated Business workspace
detail: Owners who cannot open Billing for a deactivated workspace must contact Support with account email, workspace, billing periods and prior invoice number.

feature: Remove a saved payment method
detail: Settings > Billing > Payment methods > menu > Remove; some accounts use Settings > Account > Payment > Manage billing portal. Removal does not cancel the subscription or erase invoices; Free accounts can hold a card.

feature: Payment method removal blockers
detail: A default card shows only Edit until another card is set as default; removal is also blocked by an active or pending cancellation, auto-reload use, or an unpaid invoice. Store-billed subscriptions manage payment in Apple or Google.

feature: Only Business owners manage payment methods
detail: Business payment methods are changed by workspace owners in Workspace settings > Billing > Plan > Manage plan > Payment method; API organizations need billing permission and Billing > Payment methods.

feature: Do not enter payment card data in ChatGPT inputs
detail: Cardholder data (PAN, CVV, PIN) must not be placed in conversations, files or GPTs; customers are responsible, and payment details belong only on OpenAI secure payment pages.

feature: Box app (search authorized files)
detail: Connect via Settings > Plugins; ChatGPT searches, summarizes and compares Box files the account can access, with write actions only if offered and approved. No individual sync any more; admin can gate by role and action.

feature: Connect another account or disconnect a Box/Notion plugin
detail: Settings > Plugins lets users add another account via Connect another account, disconnect a single account row, or uninstall a plugin (which can drop all its accounts of that provider). Reconnect must use the same account.

feature: Box in Enterprise Key Management workspace
detail: Availability depends on whether the Box app or plugin is supported for that workspace and enabled by an admin.

feature: ChatGPT Go promo codes via partners
detail: Partner-issued one-per-subscriber codes redeemed through a unique link at checkout, giving a free trial, discount or promo price; some target only new Go/Plus/Pro subscribers. OpenAI does not reissue codes.

feature: Go promo cancellation and renewal rules
detail: Cancel on web or mobile where redeemed; free promos can end at once, discounted ones keep access to period end. A canceled code cannot be reused, resubscribing loses promo price, and some promos auto-renew at standard rate.

feature: Outlook Email app: search mail and people
detail: Searches the signed-in mailbox with from:, subject: and date filters, returns full text, looks up people, directory users and contacts. Large searches may be incomplete; split date ranges.

feature: Outlook contacts and folders management
detail: When admin-enabled, create, update, delete and list Outlook contacts and contact folders from both Outlook Email and Outlook Calendar apps.

feature: Outlook shared and delegated mailboxes
detail: Read messages, browse folders, mark read/unread, move messages and send plain-text mail from or on behalf of a shared mailbox, given its exact address. Attachments of shared-mailbox messages cannot be retrieved.

feature: Outlook Calendar app: events and availability
detail: Reads events, attendees, availability and meeting-time suggestions with date, keyword or participant filters; on supported shared calendars can create, update, RSVP, cancel, delete events and add small attachments.

feature: Connect Outlook as guest to another Microsoft tenant
detail: Connect another account > Advanced settings > Connect as a guest account, then enter the Microsoft tenant ID; requires guest access and the other org admin approving the ChatGPT app.

feature: Outlook sensitivity-label exclusions
detail: Enterprise owners and admins can exclude emails with chosen sensitivity labels, and their attachments, from searches, reads and actions.

feature: Microsoft Entra permission review and action settings
detail: Admin console > Plugins > Configure Microsoft permissions combines Graph permission requests for Outlook, Teams and SharePoint; an Entra admin accepts the whole request. Admins then enable read or write actions and choose Enable all, Only read, or Disable for new actions.

feature: Restrict connected accounts to approved domains
detail: Owners or admins can limit Outlook (and Slack via Manage domains) connections to an approved set of account domains.

feature: Outlook apps in scheduled tasks and Workspace Agent
detail: Actions that work in chat may need different authorization or approval inside a scheduled task or Workspace Agent.

feature: Apps SDK for building ChatGPT apps
detail: Open-source preview SDK on MCP to define app logic and UI inside ChatGPT; test via custom MCP app setup, submit to the app directory, featured placement for higher-quality apps. Agentic Commerce Protocol checkout planned.

feature: Custom app creation permissions
detail: Business owners and admins can create and test custom apps; Enterprise/Edu admins can also grant selected members that permission. Legacy Apps page reachable from Admin console > Plugins.

feature: Slack app: search and summarize
detail: Searches and summarizes Slack channels, threads and DMs the user can access, usable in chat, deep research and agent mode; keyword search everywhere, semantic search on Slack Business+/Enterprise+ with Slack AI Search. Fuzzy channel names.

feature: Slack actions on user's behalf
detail: When admin-enabled: join channels, invite users, create reminders, upload files, list stars/user groups/conversations, update profile. New actions may require extra OAuth scopes and user reconnect or Slack admin approval.

feature: Connect multiple Slack workspaces
detail: Settings > Plugins > Slack > Connect another account authorizes additional workspaces.

feature: Slack admin controls (role access, actions, domains)
detail: Business has Slack enabled by default; Enterprise/Edu must enable it. Admins use Role access (RBAC), Actions to disable scope-requiring actions, and Manage domains.

feature: Event-triggered Work task from Slack channel messages
detail: Add @ChatGPT to channels, then describe the task in Work and review Trigger, Condition, Prompt. Narrow by channel, sender or thread; DMs, reactions, edits and deletions do not trigger. Enterprise/Edu/Healthcare admins must enable event-triggered scheduled tasks.

feature: Share scheduled tasks that use Slack
detail: Shared task link exposes instructions but not Slack credentials or access; recipients create their own copy with their Slack account. Event-triggered Slack tasks also need @ChatGPT added to each channel.

feature: Slack content, retention and Compliance API
detail: ChatGPT sees only Slack content available via Slack APIs at request time, so deleted or retention-expired items vanish. Data sent to Slack follows Slack policies; eligible Enterprise/Edu admins can review app activity in the Compliance Platform.

feature: Slack per-user API quota with heavy modes
detail: Using Slack with deep research, Pro models or agent mode can exhaust the per-user Slack API quota.

feature: Notion app (search authorized pages)
detail: Connect via Settings > Plugins to search, summarize and compare Notion pages the connected account can see; may create or update pages depending on plugin and approvals. Individual sync is gone; admins cannot grant access to private pages.

feature: Asking ChatGPT about its own features
detail: ChatGPT cannot run diagnostics or see system status; best practice is to ask it to perform an action (e.g. save to memory), start a new chat, or tell it to forget prior context to re-evaluate available tools.

feature: Microsoft Teams app: search and read Teams content
detail: Connect a work or school Microsoft account to search chats and channels, list teams and channels, and summarize conversations; limited by the user's own Teams access and Entra policies.

feature: Teams actions: send messages, create chats/channels, Planner tasks
detail: When enabled, ChatGPT can send or reply to Teams messages, create chats or channels, and read, create, update or delete Planner tasks, usually asking for confirmation first.

feature: Teams meeting transcripts and recording metadata
detail: Retrieves eligible scheduled-meeting transcript text if one exists and is accessible; recording actions return only metadata, not the file. Depends on plan and Microsoft permissions.

feature: Connect Teams as a guest in another tenant
detail: Connect another account > Advanced settings > Connect as a guest account with the other organization's tenant ID; its admin must have approved the ChatGPT app.

feature: Teams team-access and sensitivity-label exclusions
detail: Enterprise owners/admins can configure team access and sensitivity-label exclusions in Safety & Security Controls; reading group info needs Group.Read.All. Role access applies for Enterprise/Edu, app availability for Business.

feature: Add custom MCP server from Plugins
detail: Plugins > plus > Add custom MCP server: name, public HTTPS endpoint or Secure MCP Tunnel, authentication, risk acknowledgement checkbox, then Create as a plugin and review discovered tools. No Developer Mode needed.

feature: Custom MCP availability by plan and platform
detail: Full custom MCP (including write actions) is web-only for Business and Enterprise/Edu; Pro can build apps with the Apps SDK and connect custom MCP servers with read/fetch permissions only. Not available on mobile; no geo restrictions.

feature: Who can create and publish custom MCP apps
detail: Business: only admins and owners create and publish. Enterprise/Edu: RBAC permission (Create plugins with MCPs) lets selected members create and test, but only admins/owners publish.

feature: Publish flow, action control and tool refresh for custom apps
detail: Drafts are published from Admin console after safety warnings; Enterprise/Edu admins choose allowed actions and groups, new actions are off by default and changes show as diffs. Tool lists are a frozen snapshot until an admin refreshes.

feature: Invoke apps per message with @ mention
detail: Type @ and pick one or more apps (first or third party) for a single message; selection is per message, not per conversation. Write actions may ask for confirmation and some risky ones are blocked.

feature: Secure MCP Tunnel for private servers
detail: ChatGPT only reaches remote MCP servers; servers on private networks or dev machines connect through a Secure MCP Tunnel without public exposure.

feature: Deep research with custom apps (read only)
detail: Deep research can use custom apps for read/fetch actions but not write actions. OAuth servers should issue refresh tokens (offline_access) or users must reauthenticate.

feature: Compliance API covers app conversations
detail: Enterprise/Edu conversations, including those using any app, are available in the Compliance API.

feature: Company Knowledge plugin
detail: Plugin invoked with @Company Knowledge or from the + tools menu to answer organization-specific questions from connected apps and custom MCP servers with search/fetch; shows source links, respects source permissions, replaces older company knowledge option. Interactive-UI apps not supported.

feature: Company Knowledge install policy and app defaults
detail: Admins set the plugin Installation policy to Installed; apps are on by default in Business, new Enterprise/Edu workspaces start with a selected set (not Healthcare). RBAC, groups, SSO and SCIM control access; no training on workspace data by default.

feature: Credits for usage beyond plan limits (personal plans)
detail: Pay-as-you-go credits cover Codex, ChatGPT Work, Word, Excel and PowerPoint after included usage is spent; bought in Settings > Usage or Codex Usage & Billing, with a custom amount option. Free and Go can buy only if the account shows Add credits (limited group).

feature: Automatic credit reload
detail: Set a minimum and target balance and optional maximum monthly spend; ChatGPT buys the gap with the default payment method. It buys usage credits, not wallet funds, and may fire immediately if already below minimum.

feature: Credit rules: expiry, refunds, wallet, transfer
detail: Credits expire 12 months after purchase (180 days in Japan after 2026-11-13), do not roll over, are mostly non-refundable and not transferable; balance can go negative with concurrent tasks. Wallet (USD, gift cards) is separate and may apply at one-time checkout.

feature: Shared agentic usage allowance across Codex, Work, Excel, PowerPoint, Word
detail: On Plus and Pro these features can draw from one agentic allowance; auto-review safety checks are free and not counted. Word, Excel/Sheets and PowerPoint use token-based credit rates by model.

feature: ChatGPT for Word model choice by plan
detail: Free and Go use (model name) Luna; Plus and Pro can pick Luna, Terra, Sol or Astra with Sol as default, priced per million tokens in credits.

feature: Share ChatGPT subscription with partner tools
detail: Signing in with ChatGPT in a partner app and enabling subscription sharing lets it use plan usage and purchased credits; off by default, opt-in, with separate credit-use controls.

feature: Age prediction moves accounts into ChatGPT for Teens
detail: A signal-based age predictor (topics, usage times, account age) can place an account in teen protections even with a stated birthdate; the account stays active, gets an email and in-app prompt, and sees no ads.

feature: Verify age with Persona (live selfie or government ID)
detail: Settings > Account > Age > Verify age lets 18+ users confirm via Persona with selfie and/or ID; confirmation removes teen protections and stops age prediction. Persona deletes ID and selfie within 7 days and OpenAI never receives them. A mobile bug may show the option to ineligible accounts.

feature: Age category display in Account settings
detail: Settings > Account shows an Age category (under or over 18); it is read-only and not an editable date of birth.

feature: Teen protections reduce sensitive content
detail: Teen experience limits graphic violence, risky viral challenges, sexual/romantic/violent roleplay and extreme body-image content; parental controls may manage selected settings without giving parents chat access.

feature: Localized crisis helplines (ThroughLine)
detail: When distress-related content is detected, ChatGPT shows one-click localized crisis resources and gentle check-in messages (also based on pages seen in Atlas); conversations are not shared with the helplines.

feature: Use ChatGPT on web and mobile, optionally without an account
detail: ChatGPT runs at chatgpt.com (try without an account in supported regions) and in iOS and Android apps; New chat starts fresh.

feature: Web search icon and /Search shortcut
detail: ChatGPT searches the web with citations when current info is needed; users can click the web-search icon or type /Search in supported experiences.

feature: Temporary Chat
detail: Started from the model menu; not saved in history, uses and creates no memories, and is not used for training.

feature: Export data and delete account
detail: Settings > Data Controls > Export sends a data download; account deletion is permanent and available in Settings or the Privacy Portal.

feature: Share conversation as read-only link
detail: Share creates a link to a read-only copy of a conversation.

feature: Generated images carry C2PA metadata
detail: Images created in ChatGPT include C2PA provenance metadata; file uploads for analysis are on paid plans with data analysis.

feature: Plan tiers overview and message limits
detail: Free has basic limits, Plus/Pro get latest models, higher limits, voice, images and data analysis, Business/Enterprise add collaboration and admin controls; limits vary by plan and model and may change.

feature: ChatGPT inside KakaoTalk (Korea)
detail: Co-developed with Kakao: tap ChatGPT on the Chat tab, share answers into chatrooms, ask from inside a chat; offers image generation, web search and Kakao Tools. Needs the Korean KakaoTalk app with a Korean phone number; Korea only.

feature: Kakao Tools: Map, Reservations, Gift, Melon
detail: ChatGPT calls Kakao services when relevant: place search, bookable options with deep link, gift suggestions with purchase link, music lookup with Melon link. A Kakao Tools button under the input boosts triggering.

feature: Kakao account linking and sign-up
detail: Link an existing OpenAI account to keep Kakao history in ChatGPT, or sign up with a Kakao account that also works in the ChatGPT app.

feature: Kakao ChatGPT Plus cashback promotion
detail: New Plus subscribers via KakaoTalk get one month of fees back after the third paid month; scheduled through 2025-12-31, first-come, terms managed by Kakao.

feature: Group chats retired
detail: Since 2026-07-09 users cannot create, convert to, or join group chats via invite; existing history stays viewable. UK chats are read-only, elsewhere messaging continues while enabled; exports via ChatGPT or Privacy Portal.

feature: Free year of Plus for US service members, veterans, retirees
detail: Verify via ID.me at chatgpt.com/veterans-claim (service end within past or next 12 months), then Claim offer for one free year of Plus; one per person, no combining, personal accounts only, not for Enterprise-workspace accounts or active app-store Plus. Renews at standard rate unless canceled.

feature: ChatGPT for Teachers (free US K-12 educator plan)
detail: Free through June 2028 for verified US K-12 educators; verification with school email, workspace creation with Teacher Access Terms and Student Data Privacy Agreement. Not for students; one district per workspace.

feature: Teachers plan included features
detail: Flagship model, file uploads and search, apps, data analysis, web search, deep research, voice, image generation, memory, shared projects, ChatGPT Work, plugins, Sites and Space.

feature: Teachers workspace admin: SSO, SCIM, domain claim
detail: Owners/admins manage members, roles, SSO, role-based access, analytics, domain verification and claiming (via Support), and tenant-wide SCIM sync of staff groups (exclude students). A sole owner cannot leave the workspace.

feature: Teachers privacy: no training by default, FERPA-aligned
detail: Data is not used to train models by default (like Business), with a student data privacy agreement; stored conversations are accessible only to limited staff and confidentiality-bound contractors.

feature: Enterprise Key Management (customer-managed encryption keys)
detail: Enterprise workspaces can encrypt content with a master key in the customer's own AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault or OCI Vault (OCI for API projects); OpenAI holds only encrypted data keys and needs only encrypt/decrypt permission. Start with a sandbox workspace.

feature: EKM unsupported features
detail: Features that are not generally available, including beta or alpha features, are not available in a workspace with EKM enabled.

feature: EKM key revocation and rotation behavior
detail: Revoking the master key makes the workspace unusable within about an hour (cached keys expire) and data is unrecoverable; rotation only applies to new data and is not re-encrypted. There is no backout from EKM except a new workspace.

feature: EKM data key caching and rotation
detail: OpenAI caches data keys in memory only, rotating them about hourly and revalidating with the customer KMS hourly, so KMS request counts are far below message counts.

feature: EKM onboarding via provider setup and OpenAI contact
detail: Customer sets up an AWS role/trust policy, GCP workload identity, or Azure service principal with limited encrypt/decrypt rights, then shares key identifiers with OpenAI who enables EKM on the ChatGPT workspace. Azure keys must be RSA and named with the org ID prefix.

feature: External keys in the Management API (EKM for API projects)
detail: Org owners with an Admin API key register, list, validate and delete external keys and attach one to a new or existing API project; test on a new project and roll out gradually. Delete is blocked while a project or workspace uses the key.

feature: EKM onboarding troubleshooting guidance
detail: Common errors per cloud (AssumeRole external ID, KMS encrypt policy, GCP audience, Azure service principal and key name pattern, OCI free-form org tag and region subscription) and how to fix them; validate endpoint rechecks access.

feature: EKM key rotation, revocation and verification
detail: Customers rotate keys in their cloud (access to old data stays) or revoke (access to data lost). After revoking, wait an hour; Enterprise loses past conversations, search and custom GPTs, API loses batch files, fine-tunes and stored responses. Admin can validate via the API; a new workspace or project is required.

feature: Per-user usage limits with workspace, group and user levels
detail: Admin Console > Usage limits sets monthly per-user limits via workspace default, group default and user override (override, then highest group, then workspace default); No limit on a group means inherit. Usage period is Monthly UTC or aligned to billing cycle.

feature: Usage limit increase requests and temporary overrides
detail: Members can request more usage from ChatGPT and Codex; admins approve or deny in Pending requests (default), route to a custom HTTPS URL, or disable. Approved or manually set user overrides can be temporary (until period end) or permanent; group managers with Manage spend controls can handle their groups.

feature: Spend Controls API for usage limits
detail: Admin API key scopes usage_limit.read/write let admins read and update workspace, group and user limits programmatically (limit_amount field after token-based migration); it cannot change the usage period.

feature: Workspace overage limit and monthly USD budget
detail: Credit-based workspaces can set an overage limit (default none; 0 blocks new credit requests after the pool is used); eligible token-based Enterprise (not Edu or Healthcare) sets a monthly USD budget. Usage alerts notify at thresholds but never block.

feature: Enterprise billing views, invoices and overage invoicing
detail: Admin Console Billing shows Plan, Grant activity, unbilled overage, usage report download and Invoices (owners only by default); overage invoices issue monthly after a five-business-day review and are separate from API billing.

feature: Members view own usage and dollar estimates
detail: Eligible credit-based Enterprise members can see their own usage and estimated dollar amounts for supported Codex usage; the old admin visibility toggle was removed.

feature: Health tab with connected health data
