detail: Dedicated Health area (sidebar, Explore menu or web ••• menu) to connect data, see charts, trends and synced records, tap a metric or lab for explanations, and revisit health chats. Asking health questions works without connecting anything.

feature: Health data sources: Apple Health, Health Connect, medical records
detail: Connect Apple Health (iPhone only), Health Connect (Android only), supported US provider portals, One Medical or Function Health, choosing data categories; wearables like WHOOP, Oura, Garmin sync through Apple Health or Health Connect. ChatGPT cannot write back to them.

feature: Health profile: conditions, medications, family history; @Health mention
detail: Users confirm or edit Active Conditions, Current Medications and Family History (also by asking in chat; changes affect only the ChatGPT profile). Typing @Health in a message makes ChatGPT use Health data; it also gives proactive updates on new records or trends.

feature: Health privacy controls and disconnect
detail: Health data is not used for training or ads and gets extra encryption; permissions follow Settings > Plugins > Health (default allow low-risk actions). Disconnecting an account in Health > Accounts deletes synced data within 30 days; US only, not HIPAA, no BAA.

feature: Parental control to turn off Health for teens
detail: A linked parent can disable Health for a teen, which removes it from the sidebar, disconnects sources and deletes synced data; re-enabling needs reconnecting. Old Health chats stay in a Health project with project-only memory.

feature: Characteristics: warmth, enthusiasm, headers and lists, emoji
detail: Under Personalization, each of four characteristics can be nudged more (+) or less (-); they work with personality, custom instructions and memory and apply to current and new chats. Less warmth or enthusiasm keeps length and completeness.

feature: Passkeys for sign-in and MFA
detail: Settings > Security > Passkeys > Add passkey (Face ID, Touch ID, PIN or hardware key such as YubiKey); passkey becomes default after entering email, can be added or removed, and acts as MFA under SSO. Not available to accounts without an email address.

feature: Advanced Account Security requires two sign-in methods
detail: Setup needs at least two secure sign-in methods, one cross-device such as a synced passkey or security key; Try another method offers fallback sign-in. A discounted OpenAI + Yubico YubiKey bundle exists for eligible users.

feature: Subscription is managed by the platform it was bought on
detail: Apple, Google Play and chatgpt.com subscriptions are billed and canceled separately; sign in with the same account to reuse an existing plan. Switching platforms means canceling at the original store first and waiting for the period to end; uninstalling the app does not cancel.

feature: Cancel plan paths and duplicate-charge refunds
detail: Web cancel is Settings > Billing > Cancel plan; iOS via Settings > Subscriptions, Android via Play subscriptions. Duplicate charges refunded by Apple (iOS), OpenAI Support (Google Play) or support (web); failed Apple renewals keep retrying.

feature: California training data disclosure; training opt-out and removal via Privacy Portal
detail: Disclosure that models use public, licensed, user and synthetic data; users can opt out of training and request removal of some personal info from responses through the Privacy Portal.

feature: ChatGPT for Healthcare clinical search with citations
detail: Enterprise healthcare workspace answers clinical questions from peer-reviewed studies, guidelines and public health sources with citations (title, journal, authors, date); admins enable it workspace-wide or by RBAC group. Users can also ask about a supplied paper.

feature: Healthcare plugins (UpToDate, Metriport, Photon, Epic and others)
detail: Admin-enabled plugins for clinical guidance, outside records, medical codes, e-prescribing (no controlled substances, prescriber review), eligibility, rates, scheduling, plus read-only Healthcare Public Data and Epic chart access via admin-configured FHIR; Epic not available for individual Clinicians accounts.

feature: Healthcare HIPAA support, BAA and governance
detail: RBAC, SAML SSO, SCIM, audit logs, data residency, customer-managed keys, no training, retention controls and a BAA; improved memory is off by default and not BAA-covered. Also sold via AWS Marketplace with a shared credit pool.

feature: Ads on Free and Go plans
detail: Labeled ads appear below responses (and a multi-image format during image generation) for eligible Free and Go users in test regions from 2026-02-09; never for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu, under-18 accounts, Temporary Chats, or near health, mental health or politics topics. Ads do not influence answers and advertisers get only aggregates.

feature: Ad controls: personalization, history, delete data
detail: Settings > Ad Controls lets users toggle Personalize ads and Past chats and memory, view ad history and topics, and delete ads data (removed within 30 days). Personalized ads not initially offered in EEA or Switzerland.

feature: Per-ad menu: hide, report, about, ask ChatGPT
detail: The ad ••• menu offers Hide ad, Report ad, About this ad and Ask ChatGPT, which shares that ad into the chat since ChatGPT cannot see ads by default.

feature: Ads-Free option on the Free plan with reduced limits
detail: Settings > Ads controls > Change plan to go ad-free removes ads but lowers message limits and drops tools like image generation and deep research; a limit banner offers Upgrade or Show ads to return. Go users must switch to Free or upgrade to Plus/Pro.

feature: Prism collaborative AI LaTeX workspace
detail: Separate app (prism.openai.com) for Free, Go, Plus and Pro accounts never in a Business/Enterprise workspace; embedded assistant generates LaTeX, diagnoses compile errors, fixes inline, proofreads, searches literature, with Keep/Undo and Skills such as Paper Review.

feature: Prism import, export, version history, appearance
detail: Import Overleaf or local projects as folder, zip or drag-and-drop; export a project zip (comments not included); version history and about 10-minute backups; System/Light/Dark themes. Zotero individual libraries only, no Git sync, no anyone-can-edit links.

feature: (model name), (model name), o4-mini, (model name) and (model name) retired in ChatGPT
detail: (model name), (model name), 4.1 mini, o4-mini and (model name) retired 2026-02-13; (model name) Instant/Thinking/Pro retired 2026-03-11; (model name) in Custom GPTs for business plans ended 2026-04-03. Chats and GPTs move to (model name) Instant or (model name) Thinking/Pro; voice and images unaffected; models stay in the API.

feature: Model changes keep conversation context
detail: When models are retired, prior conversations and shared background carry to newer models; personality and customization tools help preserve style.

feature: Library: saved files from uploads and creations
detail: Uploaded and created files are saved automatically to Library (sidebar) with search, filters (uploaded/generated, type), upload, download, Storage meter and Add from library in the composer; generated images stay in the Images tab. Replaced by Space where available.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Library storage quotas by plan and file size limits
detail: Storage: Free 500 MB, Go 4 GB, Plus and Business 20 GB, Pro 100 GB. Per file 512 MB, text/docs 2M tokens, spreadsheets about 50 MB, images 20 MB.

feature: Library favorites for products and places, with folders
detail: Bookmark icon saves products and places (and files, including images) to Favorites with optional folders and a Move action.

feature: Library deletion, locked chats, Temporary Chat and Health exclusions
detail: Deleting a file removes it from Library (Recently deleted restore, permanent within 30 days); deleting a chat does not delete a saved file. Files in locked chats are hidden until unlocked, a PIN reset deletes PIN-only files; Temporary Chat and Health uploads are not saved.

feature: Browse Google Drive, Box, Dropbox, SharePoint in Library
detail: Connected cloud storage appears in Library when the connection has browse permission and admin keeps required public actions on; Drive files can be added via composer or @mentions, summarized across folders, and edited at source where authorized. My Drive and directly shared items only, no Shared Drives; web first.
plans: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu, Healthcare

feature: Library sharing with Viewer or Editor access
detail: Where available, share files and folders with specific people or the workspace as Viewer or Editor and find items under Shared with me.

feature: Library retention, auto-reference toggle and compliance export
detail: Workspace retention policy governs Library files and use does not extend it; owners can stop automatic referencing of Library files (off by default in Healthcare); compliance admins export or delete files via Library Compliance API endpoints.

feature: US state privacy law disclosures
detail: Lists 18 states (e.g. California, Colorado, Texas, Virginia) whose consumer privacy laws require specific disclosures in the Privacy Policy.

feature: Restore purchases and subscription-account ownership
detail: A mobile subscription is tied to both the store account and the ChatGPT account that bought it; it cannot be transferred or shared. iOS offers Settings (or Account) > Restore purchases; Apple/Google accounts tied to another ChatGPT account can block new purchases, workaround is buying on the web.

feature: Request removal of personal data from ChatGPT responses
detail: Anyone, with or without an account, can file Remove personal data from ChatGPT responses in the Privacy Portal; reviewed case by case against factors like public role, accuracy and public interest, may need ID. Does not remove data from search engines or websites.

feature: Optional contact importing with hashed phone numbers
detail: Users may allow device contacts so OpenAI hashes phone numbers to suggest people to follow who use its services; names and full address books are not stored, lists are deleted after matching, hashed numbers may be kept; control via device settings. Non-users' numbers can be processed the same way.

feature: Lockdown Mode (limits web and external access)
detail: Optional advanced security setting (Settings > Security > Advanced security) that limits outbound network paths: cached-only web browsing, limited images, deep research and agent mode off, no Canvas network approval, no file downloads for analysis. Image generation, uploads, memory and sharing unchanged; Codex network access unaffected.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Turn Lockdown Mode off for a single chat
detail: Select the LOCKDOWN MODE label in the web composer and Turn off for this chat, or use the chat ••• menu > Lockdown > Disabled/Enabled; Manage lockdown opens Security settings.

feature: Lockdown Mode roles and app handling in managed workspaces
detail: Admins create a custom Lockdown Mode role in RBAC and assign members or groups; apps and MCPs are governed by workspace settings (not auto-disabled), with guidance to avoid write actions for untrusted apps. Personal/self-serve Business blocks app write actions and Finances/shopping agent.

feature: Elevated Risk labels on network-capable features
detail: Features that add prompt-injection risk (e.g. Codex network access) carry a consistent shield-with-exclamation Elevated Risk label, a Learn more explanation, and are optional, early-access and outside standard warranties.

feature: ChatGPT for Excel and Google Sheets sidebar
detail: Sidebar add-in (install from Microsoft Marketplace or Google Workspace Marketplace) to build, update, explain and clean spreadsheets, scenarios and formulas, @mention sheets, web search; separate chat history, no memory, VBA/macros limited. Excel add-in can be deployed by M365 admins via manifest.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Codex controls an open Excel workbook
detail: In the ChatGPT desktop app, Codex can @mention Microsoft Excel to inspect and edit sheets, formulas, formatting and charts via the add-in; requires same account in both and Allow Codex control in the add-in menu; Computer Use optional; Excel only.

feature: Spreadsheet add-in usage by plan
detail: Free and Go get limited usage, Plus and Pro share the agentic usage limit, Business/Enterprise/Edu/K-12 had a free preview through 2026-06-02 then credit usage; admins monitor and buy credits.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Skills and apps inside Excel and Sheets add-in
detail: Plus menu opens Skills (default finance modeling and formatting skills, invoke with @) and account apps; MCP tools must be annotated read-only and non-destructive to appear. Admin can enable via Permissions & roles.

feature: Spreadsheet add-in data handling and enterprise controls
detail: Data stored locally in the product with delete/download in Settings, logs kept up to 30 days; enterprise residency, EKM, RBAC and Compliance API supported; Microsoft may read workbook content under its marketplace terms.

feature: Skills: reusable shareable workflows
detail: Skills bundle instructions, examples and code that ChatGPT can use automatically once installed; supported in Codex and plugins can include skills, apps or both.

feature: Create, install and upload skills
detail: Plugins > Skills tab lists Installed, Created by me, Shared with me, Shared by workspace; create via chat, editor or upload from computer, install shared skills, default skill-creator. Uploads are scanned and may be marked Needs Review or Blocked.

feature: Share skills with people, groups or workspace
detail: Skill ••• menu > Share lets users pick people or groups, copy a link, set access, or publish to the workspace library.

feature: Skills admin permissions and admin Skills page
detail: Permissions & roles toggles: enable skills, uploading, sharing, publishing to workspace, installing for others. Admin Skills page lists owner, access, users, 30-day invocations, and lets admins add, download, change access, transfer owner or delete skills.

feature: Administrator access to managed accounts
detail: In Enterprise, Edu, Healthcare, Business or Teachers managed accounts, admins may access, export, audit, retain, delete data, restrict features or suspend the account; OpenAI general Terms and Privacy Policy do not apply while signed in. Owners alone create sensitive compliance credentials.

feature: Account switcher (up to two accounts)
detail: Stay signed in to two ChatGPT accounts and switch without logging out (web account menu; iOS/Android Settings > Switch account); chats, memory, files, billing and workspaces stay separate, new accounts start on Free, notifications arrive for both. Rolling out on mobile; Enterprise owners can disable via Enable account switching.

feature: HIPAA-eligible ChatGPT products and covered features
detail: With a BAA: Healthcare, Enterprise Regulated Workspace, FedRAMP, Clinicians, and API with Modified Retention. Covered functions include chat, Work, Codex, projects, GPTs, workspace agents, Voice, Record, Sites, skills, plugins and Excel/Word/PowerPoint/Sheets add-ins; web search uses OpenAI's own index.

feature: Features not covered by BAA (default off)
detail: Improved memory, event-triggered scheduled tasks, Canvas/code internet access, Work cloud browser and network access, Computer History, Codex Security administration, and workspace agents with agent-owned connections are outside the BAA; admins enable them via RBAC.

feature: ChatGPT Enterprise for FedRAMP Moderate
detail: FedRAMP-accredited Enterprise version with Chat mode only on web (uploads, skills, plugins, projects, offline web search, Memory 1.0, code interpreter, dictation, tasks, admin console, compliance API) and Chat/Work/Codex modes in the desktop app; no training on data; iPhone sign-in via browser only.

feature: One-time migration from commercial Enterprise to FedRAMP workspace
detail: Conversations, private copies of custom GPTs/projects (no files or integrations) and custom plugins (not MCP plugins) can be copied via account team; files and access do not migrate.

feature: Trusted contact safety notifications
detail: Adults 18+ (19 in Korea) on personal accounts add one trusted contact in Settings > Trusted contact (email required, phone optional); they must accept within one week. If automated monitoring and human reviewers see serious suicide-related concern, ChatGPT notifies them by email, SMS, WhatsApp or in-app with no chat content.

feature: Trusted contact limits: not in Voice or workspaces
detail: Unavailable in ChatGPT Voice and in shared workspaces (Business, Enterprise, Edu); the user is told when a conversation is flagged for review, and invitees can decline or remove themselves.

feature: Codex Security: vulnerability scanning of GitHub repos
detail: Connects to GitHub repos, builds an editable threat model, finds potential vulnerabilities, validates them in an isolated environment and proposes patches; uses model reasoning rather than fuzzing or signatures.

feature: Codex Security: full-repository scan or commit scan
detail: Choose to scan the whole repository (including history on the first run) or only commits; first scan builds the threat model and can be slow on large projects.

feature: Codex Security: editable threat model
detail: The threat model (entry points, trust boundaries, sensitive data, code paths) is visible and can be edited to match the deployment.

feature: Codex Security: validation and proposed patch PRs
detail: Findings are reproduced in isolation before being shown to cut false positives; a root-cause patch is proposed and can become a pull request, never applied automatically.

feature: Daybreak Defense Factory plugin for cloud scans
detail: Plugin used to run Codex Security cloud scans on connected GitHub repositories; Daybreak Blue access included applies only within the Cloud product, not other products or the API.

feature: Codex Security Cloud token-based billing
detail: Paid scanning is billed by tokens; existing customers get notice and must opt in, and scans pause if funding is unavailable.

feature: Codex Security RBAC permissions
detail: Admins toggle Allow members to use Codex Security and Allow members to administer Codex Security under Codex Cloud permissions, by role or SCIM-synced group; running scans needs both Codex Cloud and Codex Security access.

feature: Workspace agents: Agents page with browse sections
detail: Agents in the sidebar lists Recently used, Built by me and Team directory; off by default for Enterprise at launch and enabled by admins.

feature: Workspace agent: create from template
detail: Browse templates, pick one, choose tools, then refine in the builder and create.

feature: Workspace agent: conversational builder with draft plan
detail: Describe the agent in a prompt or start blank, review a draft plan, build, then refine; can skip to the builder at any time.

feature: Workspace agent: preview before publishing
detail: Test the agent with a sample prompt in the builder and review output before creating it.

feature: Workspace agent: choose model and reasoning effort
detail: Builders pick the model and reasoning effort the agent uses.

feature: Workspace agent: add apps, custom MCPs and tools
detail: Add apps (Google Calendar, Drive, Slack, SharePoint), custom MCP servers and extra tools such as image generation and web search; app list depends on workspace enablement.

feature: Workspace agent: end-user vs agent-owned authentication
detail: Each app connection either uses each runner's own account or a shared agent-owned account (service account recommended) so runners need not authenticate.

feature: Workspace agent: write action approvals
detail: Write actions default to Always ask; depending on the app can be set to Never ask or a custom per-action approval.

feature: Workspace agent: action constraints
detail: Builders describe restrictions in natural language (e.g. send only to one domain, read only one doc); a rule is generated for review. Constrains requests, not data returned.

feature: Workspace agent: add skills
detail: Create a skill, upload a skill file or pick existing skills to give the agent a defined process.

feature: Workspace agent: files limits
detail: Files section accepts up to 512 MB per file and 10 GB per agent; very large collections can degrade or block runs.

feature: Workspace agent: access scope for ChatGPT channel
detail: Set the agent to Private to me, Anyone at the org with the link, or published to the organization directory.

feature: Workspace agent: schedules
detail: Add a schedule with channel, schedule type, run-every frequency and extra instructions.

feature: Workspace agent: API trigger
detail: Add an API channel and create a Workspace Agent access token in Admin; a call queues a run and returns 202 with a conversation URL; token scope is limited to workspace agent operations.

feature: Workspace agent: starter prompts and appearance
detail: Add a short description and starter prompts and preview how the agent appears in ChatGPT.

feature: Workspace agent: multiplayer editing with access levels
detail: Owner invites members as Can chat or Can edit; editors change instructions, files, skills, apps and publish versions; sharing, directory visibility, deletion, channels and custom MCP stay owner-only.

feature: Workspace agent: save conflicts on simultaneous edits
detail: Edits are not merged live; a Save conflict message prompts Refresh agent, which replaces the local draft with the latest saved version.

feature: Workspace agent: share with groups
detail: Owners can share with workspace groups at Can chat or Can edit; access follows group membership and the highest level applies; personal agents cannot be group-shared.

feature: Workspace agent: version history
detail: Review, preview and republish earlier versions of an agent.

feature: Workspace agent: analytics
detail: Agent Analytics shows unique users and run counts over time.

feature: Workspace agent: duplicate and delete
detail: Duplicate creates a draft copy under Built by me; delete is permanent and cannot be undone.

feature: Workspace agent: run with @ mention or Agents page
detail: Run an agent by typing @ and its name in a normal chat or opening it from Agents; the sidebar entry can be pinned or unpinned and the link copied.

feature: Workspace agent in Slack channels
detail: Add the ChatGPT Agents app to a channel, connect the agent with its own Slack handle, and choose reply to every message or only on mention plus channel instructions; all app connections must use shared auth; changing Slack workspace resets channels.

feature: Workspace agent admin RBAC controls
detail: Role toggles for enabling agents, building, publishing to the directory, and publishing with agent-owned connections; plus enabling the Workspace Agents in Slack app under Apps > Directory.

feature: Slack handle creation permissions
detail: Builders may need Slack permission to create, edit and deactivate user groups to create an agent handle; a Slack admin may need to grant it.

feature: Codex $100 credits for verified university students
detail: Verified students in the US and Canada get 2,500 credits ($100) for Codex via SheerID verification with a university email; one per student, not shareable, not API credits.

feature: Codex student credits expiry and use
detail: Credits extend Codex usage beyond plan limits, show on the usage page of the claiming personal workspace and expire after 12 months (180 days in Japan for grants after Nov 13, 2026).

feature: Impact surveys: admin-created surveys
detail: Owners start a survey from Insights > User surveys with a name up to 64 characters and predefined questions; no custom questions; creating one starts it and disables the previous one.

feature: Impact surveys: OpenAI-created surveys
detail: Automatically run at day 120 and day 240 after workspace creation with 30-day windows, plus a possible catch-up survey; can be turned off in Workspace settings under Analytics and reporting.

feature: Impact survey reporting and CSV export
detail: Aggregated results appear within 1-2 days; individual responses are hidden; Export gives a CSV of all surveys, with names and emails only if the include-user-identifiers setting is on.

feature: Impact survey question sets and disabling
detail: Predefined Enterprise and Edu question sets on productivity, hours saved and agreement statements; owners can disable an active admin survey, which stops new responses but keeps existing ones.

feature: OpenAI Certified app (Coursera courses and credentials)
detail: Learning app in ChatGPT powered by Coursera: enroll in courses, take assessments, track progress, earn OpenAI credentials via Credly; requires Coursera and Credly accounts; invoked via the + menu or @OpenAI Certified.

feature: OpenAI Certified: admin enablement and role access
detail: Admin enables it from Apps > Directory after allowing members to use apps; custom-role workspaces use Configure access; users connect it from Settings > Plugins.

feature: OpenAI Certified data containment
detail: Coursera gets only course state, progress and assessment data, never chat history or memory; roleplay assessments return a score and summary only.

feature: Sora web and app discontinued
detail: Sora web and app shut down April 26, 2026 and the Sora API September 24, 2026; content can be exported at the sunset page and the rest is permanently deleted afterwards; purchased credits can be used for Codex.

feature: ChatGPT in Apple CarPlay voice chat
detail: Voice-first ChatGPT in CarPlay on supported iPhones with iOS 26.4 or later: start a new voice chat, start one inside a project, or resume a pinned or recent chat; global on all plans.

feature: CarPlay: Start automatically in voice mode
detail: Setting under Voice in the iPhone app makes CarPlay open straight into voice mode instead of the Chats screen.

feature: CarPlay limitations
detail: CarPlay chats cannot access maps, vehicle data or live location, cannot control the car or other apps; audio quality depends on the car's mics and speakers.

feature: Business workspace credits for usage beyond seat allowance
detail: Standard and Premium seats include usage for Codex, reasoning and agents; when exhausted, shared workspace credits cover eligible usage if flexible pricing and spend controls allow; credits valid 12 months (180 days in Japan after Nov 13, 2026).

feature: Business automatic credit reload
detail: Owner sets Minimum balance, Target balance and an optional Monthly recharge limit (blank means unlimited); may charge immediately if already below minimum.

feature: Business monthly credit limits per seat type and per user
detail: Owners and admins set limits for Standard and Premium seats plus per-user overrides that take precedence; default is no limit; only owners buy credits or manage reload.

feature: Business promotional credits and legacy Codex seats
detail: Promo credits go into the shared pool, are not API credits and may expire sooner (partner plugin offer: 30 days); workspaces with Codex seats before June 24, 2026 keep legacy Codex seats billed from shared credits.

feature: Marketing privacy opt-out for OpenAI promotion
detail: OpenAI shares hashed identifiers and basic signup/browsing info, never conversations or uploads, with ad partners; opt out in Settings > Data Controls > Marketing Privacy or site footer links (browser-only when logged out).

feature: macOS allowlist values for OpenAI apps
detail: Enterprise allowlisting uses a fixed Team ID, organization name and a new signing certificate fingerprint; policies checking the cert or org name need updating.

feature: GPT-Rosalind life sciences model family
detail: Models for biology research (target research, genomics, protein analysis, medicinal chemistry, literature synthesis, experiment planning), available only via approved trusted-access applications; a subscription or workspace membership alone grants nothing.

feature: Rosalind Research vs Discovery access tiers
detail: Research tier includes (model name) Rosalind Research and (model name) Rosalind Research; Discovery uses Rosalind 5.5 with stricter monitoring and does not grant Research; moving up needs further review.

feature: (model name) Rosalind Research in Work, Codex and API only
detail: Available to a limited set of approved organizations in Work and Codex (and API if approved) but not in the Chat tab; Enterprise gets a two-week admin preview, off by default.

feature: Rosalind Academic Plan for US university labs
detail: Business-based offer for academic labs at US universities with its own verification; separate from Edu and the academic researchers program; no API access or credits and enterprise privacy terms do not automatically apply.

feature: GPT-Rosalind access setup via custom roles and groups
detail: Owners create a group and custom role with Life Sciences, Skills and Codex permissions and the Rosalind model control on; default member role stays off; role changes take up to 5 minutes; admins cannot create or assign custom roles.

feature: Life Sciences Research plugin in Codex
detail: Plugin connecting Codex to scientific tools and databases; installing it does not grant model access; select (model name) Rosalind Research in the model picker.

feature: Rosalind Workbench
detail: Research workspace in Codex and ChatGPT with data viewers and guided workflows for sequencing, including FASTQ quality control, bulk RNA-seq and single-cell RNA-seq; usable without GPT-Rosalind model access.

feature: GPT-Rosalind API access for internal research
detail: Separately approved organizations can use it in the API for internal tools only, not customer-facing products; Rosalind 6 uses its own model identifier and is not on Amazon Bedrock.

feature: GPT-Rosalind data protections
detail: Enterprise deployments offer Regulated Workspaces, BAAs, SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA-aligned standards with no training on data by default; approval does not itself switch on Enhanced Privacy or Zero Data Retention.

feature: Trusted contact: add one safety contact
detail: Adults 18+ (19+ in Korea) add one trusted contact in Settings > Trusted contact with name, required email, optional phone and a consent box; the contact must accept within 1 week.

feature: Trusted contact: edit, remove, ask in chat
detail: Editing means removing and re-adding (new invitation); removal sends the contact a notice; chat can report status but cannot add, edit or remove; not in Voice or Business, Enterprise, Edu.

feature: Trusted contact safety notification
detail: If automated systems and trained reviewers detect a serious suicide-related concern, the contact gets a brief notification to check in, without conversation content; contacts need not have a ChatGPT account.

feature: Trusted contact invitation channels and data handling
detail: Invitations arrive by email, text, WhatsApp or the app with the user's name and contact detail; OpenAI keeps the contact's data only as needed to run the feature.

feature: Decline or leave a trusted contact role
detail: Decline in app, email, text or WhatsApp during the 1-week window; the inviter cannot re-add a decliner and is prompted to pick another; leaving after accepting requires Support and can take a week.

feature: ChatGPT Agents app for Slack
detail: Build a workspace agent in ChatGPT and deploy it to Slack channels, where it answers questions, acts through connected systems and returns files; works in private channels, can auto-respond in public channels and can post on a schedule.

feature: Slack agent response mode and thread follow-up
detail: Per channel choose Respond to all relevant messages or Only reply when @mentioned; in mention mode the agent can follow up in the thread on later relevant replies; extra channel instructions allowed.

feature: Slack install prerequisites
detail: Needs a paid Slack plan, members allowed to create user groups, app installation allowed, and a Business, Edu or Enterprise ChatGPT account; Enterprise admins enable the Slack app (on by default for Business).

feature: Slack Enterprise Grid setup in three stages
detail: Slack admin approves the app at org level via OAuth, adds it to workspaces, ensures members can manage user groups; members connect through one approved workspace and can then invoke any agent in their Slack workspaces.

feature: Slack agent respects Slack permissions
detail: Only messages and files the user can already access in Slack are searchable; agents are not available on personal accounts; connections tied to an org instead of a workspace cause handle creation errors.

feature: ChatGPT for Clinicians free tier for verified US clinicians
detail: Free clinician-focused workspace for US physicians, NPs, PAs and pharmacists; sign up with a ChatGPT account, valid NPI and third-party license verification; existing workspace stays switchable from the account switcher.

feature: Clinicians: trusted clinical search and deep research with citations
detail: Answers drawn from peer-reviewed studies, public health guidance and clinical guidelines with citations (title, journal, authors, date); deep research builds cited literature reports; users can ask about a supplied trial paper.

feature: Clinicians: skills, starter prompts and documentation drafting
detail: Pre-built skills and clinician starter prompts for care pathways, differentials, referral and prior-authorization letters, patient instructions; CME credits on eligible clinical questions.

feature: Healthcare Public Data plugin
detail: Read-only connected apps for PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, DailyMed, RxNorm, openFDA, CMS Coverage, CMS Open Data, Medicare Care Compare and NPI Registry, each connected and permissioned separately; no PHI in queries.

feature: Photon prescribing plugin
detail: Draft, review and send prescriptions via a connected Photon account after clinician verification; each prescription needs the user's authorization; controlled substances unsupported.

feature: Clinicians: BAA for individual use and no training
detail: Individual clinicians can sign a BAA under Settings > Agreements; content is not used for training; PHI only with a BAA in place; multi-user BAA and admin controls need ChatGPT for Healthcare; image generation and the Epic plugin are unavailable.

feature: Offline web search from OpenAI index and cache
detail: Web search served from OpenAI's indexed and cached pages rather than live providers, for stricter governance; coverage and freshness vary, no refresh SLA, no guaranteed URL retrieval or timestamps.

feature: Offline web search enablement via Lockdown Mode role
detail: Admins assign a custom role with Lockdown Mode, OpenAI configures it workspace-wide, or regulated workspaces have it by default; Lockdown Mode can restrict other features and there is no dedicated user indicator.

feature: Ads Manager Beta for advertisers
detail: Advertiser platform to create campaigns (guided or CSV bulk upload, not product feeds), monitor impressions, clicks and spend (15-minute refresh, spend delayed 7-8 hours) and manage members, permissions, API keys, billing and change logs.

feature: Ads shown below responses; not for Plus, Pro, Business or under 18
detail: Ads appear below ChatGPT answers with advertiser name, logo, headline, description, landing page and image; they are not shown to Plus, Pro, any Business plan or accounts identified as under 18; personalization signals are used only if ads personalization is on.

feature: Ads pricing, context hints and brand safety
detail: Views (CPM), Clicks (CPC) or Conversions (oCPC bills valid clicks) with ad-group max bids; advertiser context hints are not exact keywords; ads avoid sensitive contexts and qualifying advertisers can use Negative Phrases; UTM parameters pass through.

feature: Ads Manager: campaign, ad group and ad structure
detail: Campaign sets objective, budget, dates and countries; ad groups hold themes and context hints; ads carry title, copy, landing URL and image; limits are 5,000 campaigns, 5,000 ad groups and 5,000 ads per account.

feature: Ads Manager: guided creation or CSV bulk upload
detail: Build campaigns step by step or upload a filled ad schema template from Create > Upload bulk; failed rows give per-row errors and replaying rows with blank IDs can duplicate ads.

feature: Ads Manager: creative limits
detail: Ad titles up to 50 characters (16-24 recommended), copy up to 100 (32-48 recommended), square PNG or JPG images up to 1200x1200 on a public URL, landing pages must not block OpenAI crawlers.

feature: Ads objectives: Views, Clicks, Conversions
detail: Views bills per thousand impressions, Clicks per valid click, Conversions optimizes toward a supported event but bills by valid click (oCPC) or impressions (oCPM), never per conversion.

feature: Ads budgets: campaign-total or daily with weekly cap
detail: Daily budget is a 7-day average (Sun-Sat in account timezone) capped at 2x per day and 7x per week; minimum daily budget varies by currency (25 USD); total-to-daily changes cannot be reversed.

feature: Ads targeting: countries, platforms, custom audiences
detail: Target countries (new accounts may be home-country only), optionally states, cities and postal codes, platforms (Android app/web, desktop web, iOS app/web) and custom audiences (include needs 25,000 matched users; avoid in EEA/Switzerland).

feature: Ads campaign cloning and objective changes
detail: Objective cannot be edited after creation; Clone Campaign only produces a different objective or billing model, not an identical copy.

feature: Ads context hints for ad groups
detail: Free-text phrases describing what an offering is and who it helps guide relevance; not exact-match keywords and no delivery guarantee; up to 10,000 ad groups per campaign.

feature: Ads single-image and multi-image formats
detail: Multi-image ad (4-6 square 1:1 images, one URL, Learn more CTA) is an open beta from Oct 26, 2026 alongside single image; ads must pass policy review and allow OAI-AdsBot.

feature: Ads suggested drafts from site metadata
detail: Add new ad prefills an image, title and description from the advertiser's website metadata for review; it does not generate AI copy or imagery.

feature: Ads Manager signup and account names
detail: Sign up at ads.openai.com with an OpenAI login, optionally generating a first ad from a website URL; Account, Brand and Legal names are separate and brand or legal changes trigger review and may pause serving; country, currency and timezone are fixed.

feature: Ads Manager users and ad account limits
detail: Invite Admin, Member or Viewer roles from Settings > Users; up to 10 ad accounts per login can be created by oneself (invitations unlimited).

feature: Ads reporting: metrics, table, charts and CSV export
detail: Impressions, clicks, spend, CTR, CPC, CPM and conversions at campaign, ad group and ad level with chart insights and cumulative or daily CSV exports; clicks refresh about every 15 minutes, spend 7-8 hours, conversions 24-48 hours.

feature: Ads conversion attribution windows and view-through
detail: Choose 7, 14 or 30 day click-through windows and 0 or 1 day view-through; reporting only; last-touch attribution; per-event columns and by-conversion-time reporting selectable.

feature: Ads dynamic URL parameters and pixel measurement
detail: Landing page query parameters with macros for campaign, ad group, ad and account IDs; conversions via JavaScript Pixel or Conversions API, with automatic advanced matching that hashes form data in the browser.

feature: Ads in-line edits and Export for edit bulk updates
detail: Edit items in place from the three-dot menu, or export selected objects, edit IDs and rows in the schema file and re-upload; context hint lists are replaced rather than merged.

feature: Ads postpaid billing with payment thresholds
detail: Card accounts are charged after delivery when unpaid spend reaches an assigned threshold (rising $25, $50, $100, $200 with successful payments) or at month end; failed payment stops delivery; card verification holds are temporary.

feature: Ads account spending limits, tax IDs and PayNow
detail: Invoice-billed accounts can set daily or date-range account limits; VAT and tax IDs are added under Billing settings; India threshold invoices can be paid via PayNow; no Japanese consumption tax; delivered spend is generally not refundable.

feature: Ads troubleshooting and support
detail: Guidance for access, rejected ads (hover Not serving for the reason), zero impressions, upload errors and billing mismatches; contact ads-support@openai.com or the support widget; Ads Admin role is granted in the admin console.

feature: Ads bulk upload schema rules
detail: Tabs named campaigns, ad groups and ads with unchanged headers; names must match exactly; dates YYYY-MM-DD at 00:00 UTC (end exclusive); countries and context hints as JSON; Conversions campaigns need exactly one conversion event ID; product-feed campaigns cannot use bulk upload.

feature: ChatGPT Ads beta stage
detail: Pilot ran February to April and self-serve expanded in Ads Manager Beta with campaign creation, billing, access, reporting, conversion measurement and CPC bidding; delivery and spend may fluctuate as systems change.

feature: Ads quickstart flow
detail: Create an account, add logo, billing and verification, invite team, build campaigns via guided flow or bulk upload, then monitor serving status and metrics; first campaign may not offer start and end date until edited.

feature: Ads Manager self-service country availability
detail: Self-service is listed for roughly 80 countries including the US, UK, Canada, India, Japan, Korea, Brazil and most EU states; the advertising legal entity must be in a listed country; others can sign up and be notified; large advertisers use the sales team.

feature: OAI-AdsBot and OAI-SearchBot crawlers for ad landing pages
detail: Advertisers must allow OAI-AdsBot (and should allow OAI-SearchBot) so landing pages and feed images can be validated; 403, 404 and 429 responses block review; IP ranges are published; no manual bypass; Cloudflare verifies AdsBot.

feature: Advanced Account Security (passkey-only sign-in)
detail: Optional consumer setting under Settings > Security requiring at least two passkeys or FIDO security keys (one cross-device); disables password, email and SMS codes and email recovery; enables login emails and shorter sessions; mobile enrollment finishes in a browser.

feature: Advanced Account Security recovery keys
detail: Single-use recovery keys are issued at setup; using one starts recovery that unlocks after 48 hours; keys can be replaced under Manage; Support cannot reset, remove the setting or add sign-in methods.

feature: Advanced Account Security stops training and can be disabled
detail: Conversations are not used for model training while enrolled; disabling restores password, codes and email recovery, removes recovery keys and keeps passkeys; unavailable to Enterprise-managed or claimed-domain accounts; optional YubiKey offer in US, UK, EEA.

feature: Finances: connect bank accounts via Plaid (US)
detail: US users link financial institutions through Plaid to see spending, bills, subscriptions, net worth and investments and ask grounded questions; read-only, it cannot move money, pay bills, trade or file taxes.

feature: Finances: credit score and report via Experian
detail: Separate connection showing Experian report and VantageScore 3.0 with factors and history, updated monthly with credit-change alerts that can be turned off in notifications; soft inquiry; disconnect deletes report data within 30 days.

feature: Finances dashboard with editable widgets
detail: Page with connection status, last sync, starter prompts and widgets for spend by category, spend this month, upcoming payments, subscriptions, bills, net worth, portfolio and market update; pencil icon reorders or hides widgets.

feature: /finances and @finances in chat
detail: Type /finances or @finances in the composer to use connected finance data in any chat.

feature: Financial memories
detail: Dedicated memory type for goals, loans and manually described assets; viewable and deletable from the Finances page menu; temporary chats do not access finance data or create memories.

feature: Finances data controls and disconnect
detail: Disconnect Finances or individual accounts in Settings > Apps or the Accounts tab; synced data is deleted within 30 days; existing training settings in Data controls apply; history is deleted separately.

feature: Admin setup to deploy workspace agents to Slack
detail: Three steps: enable the Workspace Agents in Slack app in ChatGPT, add the ChatGPT Agents app in Slack, and let all Slack users create user groups (each agent gets a handle group); needs a paid Slack plan.

feature: Shopify merchant products in ChatGPT shopping
detail: Shopify stores can appear in ChatGPT when relevant via Shopify Agentic Storefronts and Catalog; users check out on the merchant's own store; merchants manage it in Shopify, not through OpenAI Support.

feature: ChatGPT for PowerPoint add-in
detail: Sidebar inside Microsoft PowerPoint to draft decks from source material, add or revise slides, ask about story and structure, and tailor for an audience; install from Microsoft Marketplace Add-ins or admin-deployed via manifest XML.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu, K-12

feature: PowerPoint add-in skills, plugins and apps
detail: Click + to browse Skills or invoke with @; plugins and workspace-approved apps are available where supported and admins enable the add-in and apps.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu, K-12

feature: PowerPoint add-in usage limits and credits
detail: Free and Go get limited usage; Plus, Pro and Business are subject to agentic usage limits shared with other agentic features and use the same token rates as the Excel/Sheets add-in; workspace plans draw credits once flexible pricing applies.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: PowerPoint add-in privacy and known limits
detail: Runs inside PowerPoint under Microsoft's add-in terms, which may let Microsoft read file content; advanced chart, shape and slide-management edits may be limited and a stale SSO callback URL can cause an add-in could not be started error.

feature: Writing blocks: editable draft areas in chat
detail: Drafts like emails, messages and documents appear in an editable block: edit in place, copy, ask for revisions of selection or whole draft, full-screen view, undo/redo of AI edits, formatting (bold, italic, headings, links, lists, checklists).
plans: Availability varies by plan, device and workspace

feature: Writing blocks: send email draft or save to Library
detail: Supported email drafts can be sent from ChatGPT or opened in an email app; supported document drafts can be saved to the Library where available.

feature: Code blocks: copy, edit, full screen, language label
detail: Code sits in its own block with a language label, copy, direct edit for supported blocks, ask-ChatGPT-to-edit and full-screen view.

feature: Code block Preview for HTML, React, SVG, Mermaid, Vega
detail: Preview toggle renders supported HTML pages, React components, SVG images, Mermaid diagrams and Vega or Vega-Lite charts in a sandbox that may ask permission for outside resources.

feature: Run Python code blocks with console output
detail: Run opens a code workspace showing console output or errors and lets you stop a running program; admins can control code execution and network access.

feature: Block edits autosave with the conversation
detail: Edits to writing and code blocks save after a short delay and are used for follow-ups; in Temporary Chat they may not persist.

feature: App templates for workspace-specific apps
detail: Admins enable a template from the Apps Directory, enter tenant, OAuth and scope details, create a draft, publish it and set role access, actions and approval prompts; members use only the published app; some templates allow one app per workspace.

feature: Personal Databricks and Snowflake templates
detail: Plus and Pro users can set up Databricks and Snowflake apps themselves from Settings > Plugins.

feature: GitHub Enterprise app template
detail: Admin creates a GitHub App on the Enterprise host (client ID and secret, private key PEM, webhook URL and secret, minimum permissions), enters hostname only in ChatGPT, publishes the draft, then installs and tests it; used by Codex to reach repositories.

feature: Snowflake app via Snowflake-managed MCP server
detail: Connect ChatGPT to a Snowflake MCP server exposing Cortex Search, Cortex Analyst, read-only SQL or procedures; built-in OAuth or a custom OAuth client; role-scoped access, network allowlisting of ChatGPT egress IPs and the Official Template must be enabled and connected.

feature: Databricks Genie app and AI/BI dashboards
detail: Connect via built-in OAuth or a custom OAuth client with a workspace hostname; granular scopes ai-gateway, dashboards and offline_access (or older all-apis); admin controls cover user access, action control and approval prompts; IP allowlisting may be required.

feature: Codex using OpenAI models through Amazon Bedrock
detail: Local Codex CLI, desktop app and IDE extension send model requests to Bedrock with AWS credentials or a Bedrock API key, billed and governed in AWS; unavailable there: image generation, voice transcription, cloud plugin store, cloud policy management and cloud agents (review, security, web).

feature: Configure Codex for Amazon Bedrock
detail: Set model and amazon-bedrock provider in ~/.codex/config.toml with region and profile, choose from five supported Bedrock model IDs, authenticate via AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK or the AWS SDK chain, and keep env vars in ~/.codex/.env for desktop and VS Code; needs CLI 0.128.0+.

feature: Political campaigning restrictions in usage policy
detail: Scaled campaign messaging, automated outreach, voter targeting, public campaign chatbots and fake endorsements are prohibited for everyone, while internal memos, research, speeches a person delivers, accessibility and data analysis are allowed; violations can restrict accounts.

feature: Active sessions list in Security settings
detail: Settings > Security > Active sessions shows signed-in browser and first-party app sessions with device, approximate location, sign-in time, trusted-device flag and current-session marker; excludes third-party apps and Codex CLI; not for SSO-linked accounts.

feature: Log out of one session or all sessions
detail: Log out ends a chosen session (Log out and remove for trusted devices); Log out of all sessions also ends the current one and can take up to 30 minutes.

feature: Plugin directory with categories and tabs
detail: Sidebar Plugins page on web, desktop and mobile with Popular, New & Noteworthy, Public, Your workspace, Personal and Installed views; OpenAI Verified badge for reviewed plugins; Desktop only label for plugins needing the desktop app.

feature: Plugins bundle skills, apps, templates and extensions
detail: A plugin packages skills, connected apps, app templates and extensions (interactive views, @ mentions of items, file editing, forms); installing may trigger an app connection flow but never bypasses permissions.

feature: Invoke plugins by @ mention, + menu or auto-use
detail: ChatGPT uses installed plugins when relevant; users can also @ mention them, use + and type the name, or pick Plugins in the composer; in Codex tasks use Sources > Use plugins.

feature: Plugin events and automation
detail: Ask ChatGPT to automate recurring checks or react to plugin events such as a document change or thread reply, where the plugin supports events; managed through scheduled tasks.

feature: Plugin Creator and local MCP plugins
detail: Install Plugin Creator and chat with @plugin-creator to build or edit plugins with skills, local MCP apps (desktop only), workspace apps or apps hosted on ChatGPT Sites; custom GPT creation ended Oct 26, 2026 for affected Enterprise workspaces with migration to plugins.

feature: Plugin permissions, ZIP upload and install policies
detail: Role permissions: Use plugins, Upload plugins, Create plugins with MCPs, Share plugins, Publish to workspace; admins upload ZIP files, set Available or Installed policy and bulk-edit up to 25 plugins; role-based controls for Enterprise and Edu.

feature: GitHub plugin marketplace import with daily sync
detail: Admins import a JSON plugin marketplace from a public or private GitHub repo, with Sync now and per-plugin Refresh; export the public plugin catalog as CSV (up to 48 hours old, not in FedRAMP).

feature: Share and publish workspace plugins
detail: New plugins start private; owners share with invitees, anyone in workspace with link or list in the workspace directory; recipients must install and authorize apps; Sites-hosted plugins need viewer access to the Site.

feature: Disable plugin and skills availability notes
detail: Disabling a plugin or app are separate controls and shared apps may affect other plugins; Codex directory changes can take up to 6 hours; personal Skills are generally available for Business, Enterprise, Healthcare and Edu.

feature: Coinbase plugin trades
detail: Plugin can submit Coinbase trades; outcomes must be confirmed in Coinbase since a chat reply does not prove completion and disconnecting does not cancel a submitted trade; OpenAI Support cannot change Coinbase transactions.

feature: Daybreak Blue: reduced refusals for defensive security
detail: Approval-based tier giving reduced refusals on supported mainline models for verified defensive work (triage, code review, malware analysis, detection, incident response); off by default until enabled for users or API projects.

feature: Daybreak Red: cyber-specialized models and offensive testing
detail: Organization-only tier with stronger verification providing (model name) Cyber ((model name) Cyber with separate approval) and reduced refusals on newer models for authorized pentesting and red teaming; not obtainable by individuals.

feature: Daybreak toggle in Codex app and /daybreak in CLI
detail: Codex app has a Daybreak toggle in the Advanced model picker (off by default; needs a recent app version); CLI uses /daybreak or daybreak=true (CLI 0.163.0+); the API uses access_programs.cyber with daybreak_blue, daybreak_red or standard.

feature: Individual Daybreak access requires hardware key and Advanced Account Security
detail: Individuals must be 18+, on a paid plan, enrolled in Advanced Account Security with a physical FIDO2 hardware key, pass identity verification and be approved; existing individual users had to meet this by Oct 1, 2026; no resale or customer-facing use, no Zero Data Retention.

feature: Daybreak Access (Trusted Access for Cyber)
detail: Vetted-access program that reduces some cyber-related refusals for authorized defensive security work; tiers are Daybreak Blue and Daybreak Red. Not available in every region; verification required.

feature: Daybreak individual access requires Advanced Account Security + hardware key
detail: Individual Daybreak needs an eligible paid plan, Advanced Account Security and at least one FIDO2 hardware key whose passkey stays on the device; phone or password-manager passkeys do not count. Existing users had until Oct 1, 2026.

feature: Advanced Account Security unavailable on enterprise-managed accounts
detail: Advanced Account Security is not offered to enterprise-managed accounts or accounts tied to a verified claimed domain; Business membership does not exempt Daybreak users.

feature: Advanced Account Security recovery key and 48-hour wait
detail: If all sign-in methods are lost, a saved recovery key starts account recovery with a 48-hour security waiting period; support cannot bypass it, and losing all methods and keys can mean permanent loss of the account.

feature: Daybreak identity verification
detail: Individuals verify identity to qualify; users under 18 are not approved; denied results cannot be overridden by support; retry may be offered. Enterprises go through organization-level KYB intake via Persona.

feature: Daybreak eligibility page (chatgpt.com/cyber)
detail: Page showing plan, account-security and verification status; losing Advanced Account Security or the hardware key revokes access without deleting the account or chats; reapplication needed.

feature: Daybreak workspace role override for Codex sign-in
detail: Workspace admins set Daybreak Blue (and Red if approved) to On under Cybersecurity in a role override; takes about 10 minutes; default off; users also see a Daybreak toggle in Settings > General.

feature: Daybreak API project control
detail: API org owners enable Blue or Red per non-default project under Project settings > General > Daybreak model access; default projects ineligible; about 15 minutes to apply; project owner alone cannot change it.

feature: Codex Daybreak toggle and /daybreak command
detail: In Codex signed in with ChatGPT the user turns Daybreak on per request; with an API key the Codex app (26.1013.0+) has a toggle, and CLI 0.163.0+ uses /daybreak or -c daybreak=true.

feature: Daybreak reduced refusals vary by model
detail: (model name) Sol and (model name) get reduced refusals with Blue; Astra and (model name) Astra/Sol keep standard safeguards under Blue and need Red; (model name) Terra needs Red plus explicit enable and is in Work and Codex, not Chat.

feature: Daybreak Red cyber models
detail: Red organizations are eligible for (model name) Cyber; (model name) Cyber needs separate approval, IP allowlisting and, with ZDR, Private Safety Processing; SSO must be enforced for Red workspaces.

feature: Legacy (model name) preview retirement
detail: The API model (model name) is deprecated and removed from the API on Feb 1, 2027; existing users select (model name) in Codex (app 26.513.20950+, CLI 0.133.0+).

feature: Cyber safety messages after Daybreak approval
detail: Requests can still be blocked, rerouted to a fallback model, return a cyber_policy API error or be refused by the model; Daybreak does not change data retention or ZDR.

feature: Daybreak on AWS Bedrock
detail: Daybreak is also reachable through AWS Bedrock but still requires OpenAI approval via the standard route.

feature: Enterprise Daybreak onboarding flow
detail: Organization submits an intake form, completes Persona KYB, gets an eligibility decision (Blue, Red or both), then admins configure workspace roles and API projects; a welcome email confirms provisioning. Controls start OFF.

feature: Daybreak workspace default and role setup in Admin Console
detail: Owner opens Admin Console > Models > Workspace default, turns Daybreak off at default, then uses Roles > Edit override or Add role override to turn Blue on for specific roles; check direct and group assignments.

feature: Codex Security plugin for Daybreak workflows
detail: Recommended first surface for approved defensive repo work; Codex CLI or the Codex GitHub Action for automation; Daybreak must be internal-only, not customer-facing.

feature: Daybreak and Zero Data Retention are separate
detail: Daybreak enablement does not turn on ZDR; ZDR must be requested separately for the exact API organization and endpoint.

feature: Automatic teen-to-adult account transition
detail: Accounts identified as 18+ automatically leave the ChatGPT for Teens experience; teen protections turn off by default, the holder gets adult features, other settings remain; rolling out gradually.

feature: Notice before teen protections are removed
detail: The account holder is notified about a week before the transition and again near the date; a linked parent or guardian is notified too; a banner may say they have access to more features.

feature: Parental controls link ends at age 18
detail: Transition ends the parental-controls connection: parent loses settings control and teen safety notifications, both are told, and the former member shows as No longer connected. The adult may re-accept an invite.

feature: Settings > Account > Age category and Verify age
detail: Shows the account's age category without editing date of birth; Verify age (via Persona) appears only when applicable and only the teen can verify, not a parent.

feature: Reduce sensitive content toggle (Settings > Safety)
detail: Adults can turn on extra safeguards for sensitive content after transition; it does not restore all teen protections.

feature: Trusted Contact for adults
detail: Adult accounts can add a Trusted Contact for extra support alongside optional parental controls.

feature: Enterprise setup order: roles, domains, SSO, SCIM, groups, RBAC
detail: Recommended rollout sequence for a new Enterprise workspace; confirm owners, admins, domain verification, SSO and directory sync before broad invites.

feature: Tenant-wide SCIM sync does not grant product access
detail: SCIM syncs users and groups to the tenant, but synced groups must be separately assigned to ChatGPT workspaces or Ads accounts; groups can then receive roles and gate shared GPT access.

feature: Automatic account creation for verified domains
detail: Setting that provisions full billable seats when someone signs in with a verified-domain email; may be on by default and should be off when using SCIM.

feature: Workspace Policy modal
detail: Owners and admins can show an AI usage policy to members from Workspace settings > General; it reappears every 30 days and whenever the policy changes.

feature: Work Local and Work Cloud permissions per role
detail: Permissions & roles control whether members can run local Work in the desktop app and/or start cloud Work tasks; Local without Cloud blocks cloud tasks; check effective permissions under additive RBAC.

feature: Models page defaults for Work and Codex
detail: Admins set starting model, reasoning level, speed, Fast Mode availability (on by default, role overrides possible) and new-chat behavior; enforced requirements still limit members.

feature: Default workspace role vs custom RBAC roles
detail: Default role is the baseline for all members; custom roles assigned to users or groups give targeted feature access for apps, GPTs, plugins, Codex and Work.

feature: Admin controls for apps, GPTs, MCP and approved domains
detail: Owners decide day-one availability of apps, GPT actions, custom MCP servers, write or open-world actions and allowed OAuth domains.

feature: Enterprise security controls list
detail: Compliance Logs Platform and Stateful Compliance API, IP allowlisting, Lockdown Mode, Enterprise Key Management, data and inference residency, and ChatGPT for Intune managed mobile access (needs active SSO).

feature: Workspace analytics and impact surveys
detail: Admins review adoption analytics, run impact surveys for employee feedback, and see Task insights and usage exports.

feature: Monthly usage limits and alerts for Enterprise
detail: Set workspace default limits, group defaults, individual overrides and alerts; credit workspaces have a separate overage limit; token-based agreements use a monthly USD workspace budget and spend alerts.

feature: Member cost visibility setting
detail: Workspace setting controlling whether members can see their own cost or usage.

feature: Workspace Agents and Codex access via groups
detail: Admins enable Work, Workspace Agents (including Slack deployment) and Codex for selected groups and designate a smaller admin group for rollout and governance.

feature: Ads Manager product feed campaigns
detail: Retail advertisers upload a catalog (CSV/TXT, hosted HTTPS URL or SFTP) in Ads Manager to run feed-based ChatGPT ads; items expire after 2 weeks, feed products appear in ads only, not organic answers; country-level targeting only.

feature: Product feed ads: auto layout, ad group filters, ad template
detail: Ad groups pick feed products with filters or ads_metadata labels; one ad template per group (only image selectable); OpenAI automatically chooses single card or carousel; Maximize results bidding by default.

feature: Hardware security keys and passkeys for ChatGPT sign-in
detail: ChatGPT accepts any FIDO-compatible security key; Advanced Account Security needs at least two secure methods including one cross-device; keys are optional.

feature: OpenAI + Yubico YubiKey bundle
detail: Eligible users in the US, UK and EEA can buy a two-key YubiKey bundle (C Nano and C NFC, no OTP) at preferred pricing via Yubico checkout; order can be made without enrolling in Advanced Account Security; refunds handled by Yubico.

feature: OpenAI Academy free courses
detail: Free self-paced courses (AI at work, build with AI, Codex, leadership, educators, college students) hosted on Gradual; sign in with a ChatGPT account to enroll and save progress; browsing needs no sign-in; available globally.

feature: Academy assessments, badges and pathway certificates
detail: Each course has a 10-20 question assessment drawn from a 50-question bank; 80% passes and earns an Accredible badge; finishing every course in a pathway earns a certificate of completion; neither is a certification.

feature: Academy organization reporting and LMS limits
detail: Organizations can ask their account team for learner progress reporting; course content cannot be exported to an LMS and SCORM packages are not yet available; accounts cannot be merged after starting.

feature: ChatGPT Desktop referral promotions
detail: In-product offers let eligible users invite someone to try ChatGPT Desktop; reward (credits, rate-limit reset, temporary usage) granted only after the invitee completes the qualifying action; caps, expiry and eligibility vary; can be wound down with 30 days notice.

feature: Referral rate-limit reset bank
detail: A banked reset applies only to Work or Codex and must be used within 30 days; referral credits are not API credits and cannot be cashed out or transferred.

feature: Admin switch to disable referral promotions
detail: Business workspace admins can disable referral promotions so members see no workspace referral offers and no new rewards are granted.

feature: Ads Manager roles and per-account access
detail: Roles: global admin, Ads admin (tenant) and ad account admin, member, viewer (per account); highest of direct or group role wins; one admin must remain; ChatGPT workspace roles do not grant Ads access.

feature: Ads Manager SSO policy and SCIM groups
detail: Admin Console Ads SSO policy is Required, Optional or Off; tenant SCIM groups can be granted per-account access (initial role Member); synced membership is managed in the identity provider.

feature: Voice Live mode (GPT-Live-1.1)
detail: Default full-duplex voice that listens and speaks simultaneously so users can interrupt; can use web search, memory, visual widgets, text and images in the same chat, and plugins/connected apps. No video or screen sharing.
plans: Free (Quip), Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Voice Advanced and Standard retiring Dec 11, 2026
detail: Advanced (older real-time voice, still has video/screen share on mobile) and Standard (turn-by-turn, transcribes first) switch automatically to Live on December 11, 2026.

feature: Voice daily limits by plan
detail: Rolling 24h: Free limited Quip; Go 3h Quip; Plus 3h; Pro $100 15h; Pro $200 unlimited (abuse guardrails); Business Standard 3h, Premium 15h, extra at 1.25 credits/min; Enterprise credits 1.25/min or $0.05/min USD; K-12 teachers 3h.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Voice plugin use with on-screen approval
detail: Live can call plugins and connected apps under existing permissions; actions needing approval prompt on screen and spoken approval is not supported.

feature: Voice in Work and desktop Voice
detail: Live in Work on web and mobile (needs both Voice and Work access; tasks continue in text after the call); desktop app on macOS and Windows has voice to start and coordinate agents with separate pricing.

feature: Voice with images and text in one chat
detail: During Live the add button attaches images and users can type; Live cannot search or add files from the Library.

feature: Advanced voice video and screen sharing
detail: Camera button shares live video; More options > Share Screen shares the screen; available to eligible subscribers on iOS and Android in Advanced only.

feature: Voice selection and additional language voices
detail: Settings > Voice offers nine voices (Arbor, Breeze, Cove, Ember, Juniper, Maple, Sol, Spruce, Vale) plus extra Live voices for Portuguese-Brazil, French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Mexican Spanish and English; switching starts a new call.

feature: Voice language setting
detail: Settings > Voice > Language fixes the spoken language if detection is wrong; users can also ask to switch language mid-conversation.

feature: Voice personalities not applied; speed by request only
detail: Preset personalities do not apply to Live; tone and pace can be requested verbally but no precise playback speed control exists.

feature: Voice in Apple CarPlay
detail: Start a voice chat, resume a recent or pinned chat, or start in a project from CarPlay on supported iPhones; Start automatically in CarPlay setting appears after first use.

feature: Background voice conversations
detail: Voice continues while other apps are open or the phone is locked; controlled in Settings > Voice; ends on user exit, force close, usage limit or max session length.

feature: Start with Voice setting
detail: Settings > Voice toggle that opens new empty conversations directly in Voice on supported mobile versions.

feature: Voice audio and video clip retention
detail: Live and Advanced audio and Advanced video clips are stored with the transcript for 30 days and deleted within 30 days of chat deletion; Standard audio is deleted after transcription; archiving does not delete.

feature: Opt-in sharing of audio and video recordings for training
detail: Free, Plus and Pro personal users may turn on Include your audio/video recordings under Improve the model for everyone; clips are not used for training otherwise, and the choice applies across devices.

feature: Voice captions and transcripts
detail: Live responses appear as text while spoken; Advanced has a cc caption button; a transcript is added after the call and may not be verbatim.

feature: One Voice conversation at a time; iOS Voice Isolation tip
detail: Only one voice session can run; Live suits one-on-one use and may respond to bystanders; ask it to wait before responding; iPhone Mic Mode Voice Isolation reduces interruptions.

feature: ChatGPT Work agent
detail: Agent in ChatGPT for longer multi-step research, analysis and finished deliverables (documents, spreadsheets, presentations, reports, Sites); runs in the cloud on web and mobile, and locally with files and apps on desktop with permission.

feature: (model name) Astra and (model name) Sol in Work and Codex
detail: New models selectable in the Work picker and Codex selector (not regular Chat); Codex CLI needs 0.166.0+; availability depends on plan, seat and workspace; Work Default upgrades in place and has a reasoning slider.

feature: (model name) 500k context in Work and Codex
detail: Default context window of 500,000 tokens with no extra surcharge for subscription-covered usage; (model name), Terra and Luna do not appear in regular Chat.

feature: (model name) allowance by plan
detail: Pro $100, Pro $200 and Business Premium use full Work/Codex allowance for Astra; Plus and Business Standard get limited Astra with optional credits; Astra may consume allowance faster than (model name) Sol.

feature: Ultrafast low-latency mode
detail: Lower-latency (model name) Astra/Sol, (model name) and (model name): Pro $500 draws allowance at 6x (8x for older), promo 3x credits through Feb 28, 2027; Pro $200 gets (model name) Sol Ultrafast in Codex; unavailable on Plus, Pro $100, Business; Enterprise/Edu via credits.

feature: Work permissions Cloud, Local and Codex Local
detail: Admins set Work Cloud, Work Local and Codex Local separately per role in Permissions & roles; browser use and network access are separate controls; Chat always remains available.

feature: Codex Cloud tasks from web, mobile and desktop
detail: Runs coding tasks on OpenAI-managed computers that continue while the machine sleeps; an environment must be created and published on desktop or web before a mobile task; legacy Codex Cloud still powers Code Review, Security Review and Linear/GitHub workflows.

feature: Remote tab for desktop Codex chats on mobile
detail: The ChatGPT mobile app's Remote tab accesses supported desktop Codex chats; this does not add them to web or mobile history and differs from cloud environments.

feature: Cloud Work chats sync across devices
detail: Cloud Work chats sync across web, mobile and desktop; local Work runs on the computer though context may be stored in the cloud; desktop Recents merges Chat and Work with sort, filter and pin; Codex history is separate.

feature: Event-triggered Work tasks
detail: Webhook-style tasks triggered by new Gmail, new Slack channel messages or GitHub PR activity, with editable Trigger, Condition and Prompt; admin must enable the setting on Enterprise/Edu/Healthcare; not on Free, Go or FedRAMP; no BAA coverage; created on web/mobile only.
plans: Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu, Healthcare

feature: Share a scheduled Work task
detail: Cloud scheduled tasks can be shared by link; recipients schedule their own copy with their own access; instructions are in the link; no history, files or credentials transfer; local-only tasks cannot be shared.

feature: Workspace starting defaults for Work and Codex
detail: Admins set starting model, reasoning, speed, Fast Mode and new-chat behavior in Workspace settings > Models separately from Chat, with role overrides evaluated separately.

feature: Switch between Chat, Work and Codex
detail: Desktop menu picks ChatGPT or Codex and a Chat/Work toggle; Codex Quick Chat opens from New chat; mobile Explore users pick Chat or Work from the model name; projects offer Chat or Work start.

feature: New ChatGPT desktop app replaces Codex app
detail: On macOS and Windows the Codex app updates into the new ChatGPT desktop app with Chat, Work and Codex; existing Codex chats and projects are kept and it opens in Codex for existing Codex users.

feature: ChatGPT Classic desktop app
detail: The previous desktop app can stay installed alongside the new one as ChatGPT Classic; no forced migration; it still gets model updates, fixes, security patches and existing Enterprise features, but new agent features may be new-app only.

feature: Preinstalled ChatGPT on Lenovo Windows PCs
detail: Eligible Lenovo PCs ship with the app; users sign in from Start and update via Microsoft Store before redeeming ChatGPT Business credits.

feature: Desktop built-in browser
detail: Browser inside the ChatGPT desktop app (macOS, Windows) opened from a Work or Codex chat toolbar or Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+B; own browser state, sign-in, autofill, password management, extensions, downloads; user and ChatGPT see the same page and can use multiple tabs.

feature: Built-in browser annotation mode and style preview
detail: Annotation mode lets users click or drag over page elements and describe changes; Adjust previews text, font, spacing or colour changes as reference only; some sites supply custom annotation controls and context.

feature: Built-in browser website permissions and data clearing
detail: ChatGPT asks before using a new site; allow/block lists in desktop settings; a Deny is remembered for that chat; cookies, login status and history can be cleared in Settings; admins may restrict browser use, history, file transfers and saved approvals.

feature: ChatGPT Chrome extension (@Chrome)
detail: Use ChatGPT on the web with the Chrome extension to work in the user's own Chrome profile, signed-in sessions and open tabs by mentioning @Chrome or picking a tab from the + menu; permissions managed in Settings > Chrome extension; no desktop app needed.

feature: Work creates and edits documents, spreadsheets and presentations
detail: Work builds editable files from instructions, attached sources or a reference file, and can match an existing deck or layout; native Google Docs, Sheets and Slides when Google Workspace is connected; PowerPoint not in the desktop Work flow at launch.

feature: Templates via @Template-Creator
detail: Create a reusable template from a .docx, .xlsx, .pptx or Google file link plus instructions; use via @Documents, @Spreadsheets or @Presentations gallery or Library; web and local Codex templates do not sync.

feature: Share templates through plugins or ZIP
detail: Templates are personal; admins can publish one as a workspace plugin for roles, and desktop users can share ZIP files; recipients need their own access to linked files.

feature: ChatGPT for Excel add-in with Codex
detail: In the desktop app, Codex with @Microsoft Excel can inspect and update an open workbook via the ChatGPT for Excel add-in; direct control not guaranteed for every request.

feature: Preview and refine files in desktop app
detail: Desktop sidebar opens supported documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDFs; users select a part (claim, chart, slide) and describe the change; cloud outputs may save to Library or Space; Temporary Chat files are not saved.

feature: Edu workspace data export permission
detail: Off by default; owners enable Allow members to export their own data via workspace default or custom roles; each member exports only their own data; not available for workspaces with data residency.

feature: Export data from Edu workspace
detail: Settings > Data controls > Export, email verify, Confirm; email arrives within up to 7 days; ZIP has conversations.json (or numbered files), assets and metadata, plus an export viewer; uploading the JSON to a personal account gives reference only, not restored chats.

feature: Cloud browser in Work
detail: Work gets its own remote browser to read pages, click, fill forms and act on public and signed-in sites; keeps running after the user leaves; pauses for input, sign-in or confirmation; chosen automatically, connectors preferred when available; not on Free or Go.

feature: Cloud browser secure sign-in
detail: A secure form sends credentials straight to the remote browser, unseen by the model and not stored; a review model checks for phishing first; sessions persist until expiry; 2FA supported.

feature: Cloud browser site permission modes
detail: Settings > Cloud browser: Always ask, Auto approve (pause only if unsafe) or Always allow, plus per-site allow or block overrides; consequential actions like payments still need confirmation.

feature: Take over the cloud browser
detail: ChatGPT asks, or the user requests, a link to control the remote browser from phone or computer when a task is stuck; some sites block automated agents.

feature: Clear cloud browser cookies and data
detail: Settings > Cloud browser > Browser data > Cookies clears all or per-site data, signing out of those sites; cloud browser never uses the device browser's tabs, history, passwords or extensions.

feature: Workspace Blocking via ChatGPT-Allowed-Workspace-Id header
