detail: Network-injected header lists allowed workspace UUIDs (comma separated); other workspaces including personal are filtered; no remaining workspace gives 403; malformed header gives 400; apply to chatgpt.com only, typically via SASE vendor.

feature: Block anonymous logged-out ChatGPT and app domains
detail: Block chatgpt.com/backend-anon/ to stop logged-out use; block android.chat.openai.com, desktop.chatgpt.com or ios.chat.openai.com to cut off an app platform entirely (personal accounts too).

feature: App certificate pinning and SSL inspection
detail: Desktop and mobile apps pin certificates; organizations doing SSL inspection must add their own certificates to the pin list via MDM for the apps to work.

feature: ChatGPT features inside Rakuten Viber
detail: Viber offers message translation, link and group summaries, AI Polish drafts, Image Remix, a ChatGPT tab and @ChatGPT mentions; usable without an account within daily limits, higher limits if a ChatGPT account is connected; availability varies.

feature: Viber ChatGPT data handling
detail: ChatGPT tab chats are saved to the connected ChatGPT account (may inform memory and training per settings); other Viber feature data is not used for training; account can be disconnected in Viber settings, reducing limits.

feature: Additional safety checks on biology and cyber requests
detail: Automated checks may delay a response or withhold content on some cybersecurity or biological requests; this is not itself a policy violation; narrower defensive framing, thumbs-down feedback or Daybreak application are the paths forward.

feature: Archive a Codex chat
detail: From the Codex sidebar chat menu choose Archive; archiving stops a running chat and removes any attached scheduled task after a confirmation prompt.

feature: Delete archived Codex chats permanently
detail: Settings > Archived chats lets users delete one chat (must be archived first) or delete all archived chats including project ones; removed from view at once, purged within 30 days unless de-identified for training or legally held; irrecoverable.

feature: Connected app data removed only by deleting the chat
detail: Archiving keeps connected-app data referenced in a chat; deleting the chat removes it; disconnecting an app stops future access but does not delete past conversations.

feature: ChatGPT Sites hosted pages
detail: Eligible users create and share hosted Sites from ChatGPT; owners review preview, choose audience, and may invite named external viewers with view-only access; editors can inspect the database and publish code using secrets.

feature: ChatGPT Sites usage restrictions and reporting
detail: Sites must not process PHI, target under-13s, distribute malware, phish or impersonate; card data only via a third-party processor; visitor content must be moderated; OpenAI may remove Sites, with an appeal link and a report form.

feature: Workspace controls for Sites
detail: Business has Sites on by default; Enterprise uses RBAC for creating and publishing, with launch access and admin preview rolling out; public publishing is off by default in Enterprise; US/EU residency applies to new Sites hosting only.

feature: Sites using visitors' connected apps
detail: Private workspace Sites can act on each visitor's connected apps after that visitor approves; plugins have an Allow site visitors to use this plugin switch (Business on by default, Enterprise off); tenant policy under External access > ChatGPT Sites can block it.

feature: Sites audiences, editors and ownership
detail: A Site can be shared with owner and admins, all members, selected users or groups, or anyone if public publishing is allowed; owner can grant Can edit, change name or URL, add custom domains, and transfer ownership.

feature: Sites external viewers
detail: Owners can invite named outside people as view-only viewers who sign in with the invited ChatGPT account; Enterprise requires a separate Allow members to invite external visitors permission; managed under Workspace settings > Sites.

feature: Sites private-network tunnels
detail: Tunnels let a Site reach internal services; require Allow members to attach private tunnels, and public tunnel-backed Sites need Allow public Sites with private tunnels for owner and publisher.

feature: Plugins hosted on Sites
detail: A Site can host an MCP server and plugin; recipients need access to both the plugin and its Site, plus any app authorizations.

feature: Sites hosting charges waived for Enterprise
detail: Hosting and running Sites currently costs nothing for Enterprise workspaces, but building or editing counts toward Codex usage and limits apply.

feature: ChatGPT Sites: build websites and lightweight apps
detail: Ask Work (web, desktop) or Codex to build a website or use @Sites; private preview, deploy gives a URL, private by default; available to Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise; not Free, Go or ChatGPT Classic.

feature: Sites usage and storage limits
detail: Building or editing counts toward Codex usage; hosting is included for Plus/Pro with no fixed site-count limit but shared usage and storage limits; each Site database up to 10 GB; file storage has no fixed cap.

feature: Sites versions, edit from published site and restore
detail: Save a version before deploying; Edit site on the published page sends instructions to ChatGPT; restoring an old version restores code only, not database or files; Codex can export source; no built-in data backup.

feature: Sites custom domain
detail: Owners add a domain they control from Site settings and copy DNS and TXT records; status refreshes after DNS propagation; Sites does not register domains.

feature: Sites automations (cloud schedules)
detail: Owners can attach one or more cloud schedules to a published Site; schedules cannot use apps that visitors approved.

feature: Sites sharing: URL, owner transfer, take down
detail: Default URL uses a random id for personal accounts; changing URL redirects old one; Settings > Account > Username can change the name in addresses; Delete site is permanent after typing the slug.

feature: Sites tunnels and Sign in with ChatGPT
detail: Tunnels (IT-run client) let Sites call private network services; Sign in with ChatGPT on a Site shares visitor name, email and photo after approval.

feature: Sites training data policy
detail: Conversations that create or edit Sites are not used for training in Business, Enterprise and Edu by default; Free, Go, Plus and Pro follow the Improve the model for everyone setting.

feature: Sites data controller responsibilities
detail: Site owners are data controllers for visitor data (GDPR and similar) while OpenAI processes under the DPA; guidance on notice, consent, minimization, rights, transfers, cookies and children; Sites must not process PHI.

feature: Privacy policy guidance for Sites
detail: Template sections for controller identity, data collected, Sign in with ChatGPT sharing, cookies, lawful bases, recipients (OpenAI as host), retention, storage location, rights and contact; not legal advice.

feature: Ads Manager custom audiences
detail: Upload CSV/TXT (up to 500 MB) of emails, phones, SHA-256 hashes or GAIDs for campaign inclusion, exclusion or ad-group bid multipliers 0.1x-10x; inclusion needs 25,000 matched users; files deleted within about 24h; avoid for EEA/Switzerland.

feature: (model name) in Chat with Thinking slider
detail: (model name) replaces Latest in the model menu; Thinking slider offers Instant, Medium, High, Extra High ((model name) Sol) and Pro ((model name) Pro on Astra); existing Latest picks move over, explicit (model name) Sol picks stay; Enterprise may keep old picker meanwhile.

feature: Thinking levels by plan
detail: Plus gets Medium and High; Pro, Business and Enterprise also get Extra High and Pro effort; Free and Go get (model name) Luna for Instant and a Think option, no Sol.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise

feature: Intelligent UI responses
detail: With (model name) Instant through Extra High, answers can mix text, visuals and interactive elements and may start before thinking finishes; not with Pro effort or older desktop apps; no separate quota; Settings > Layout and visuals reduces them on web.

feature: (model name) Pro availability and limits
detail: (model name) Pro (Astra) is in Pro $100, Pro $200, Business, Enterprise; not unlimited; Pro $200 falls back to (model name) Thinking Medium at weekly limit; Pro $100 and Business share one allowance with (model name) Sol Pro.

feature: (model name) family: Sol, Sol Pro, Terra, Luna
detail: (model name) Luna is default for Free and Go; Sol selectable in Chat for paid; Terra and Luna only in Work, Codex and API (Codex Terra also on Free/Go); Codex needs app 26.707.30751 or CLI 0.144.0.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise

feature: Free and Go Instant chat unlimited
detail: Everyday text chats are unlimited subject to abuse safeguards; uploads, image generation, voice and data analysis have separate limits; Support cannot reset usage limits.

feature: Higher intelligence setting (Business only)
detail: Settings > General toggle in Business that lets ChatGPT auto-add thinking while Instant is selected; not on Plus/Pro web.

feature: ChatGPT Atlas browser retired
detail: Atlas no longer gets updates; bookmarks, tabs, history and sessions do not transfer; exported bookmarks HTML can be imported to Chrome; Atlas memories are separate from ChatGPT memories and chat deletion does not clear them; the default-browser rate-limit promo ended.

feature: Ads mobile measurement partner integrations
detail: ChatGPT Ads connects to Adjust, Airbridge, AppsFlyer, Branch, Kochava, Singular and Tenjin using a Pixel ID and Conversions API key; click-based attribution; conversions appear in Ads Manager after 24-48 hours.

feature: OpenAI Presence managed agent platform
detail: Managed enterprise service for governed, high-volume voice or chat agents with policies, simulations, evaluations, monitoring, human escalation and rollback; deployed with OpenAI engineers or partners; not self-serve and separate from ChatGPT Workspace Agents.

feature: ChatGPT for Academic Researchers
detail: Eligible faculty and postdocs get three complimentary Plus seats for up to 12 months in a separate workspace with business-level data protection (no training by default); applications currently closed with a waitlist; no SSO/SCIM; institutional route via order form.

feature: Academic Researchers workspace rules
detail: Collaborators must verify (SheerID) at the same institution, one researcher workspace per email, owner cannot be changed, credits can be bought after allowance, API credits not included.

feature: Workspace Admin keys
detail: Owners and admins create workspace-scoped keys in Admin Console > Credentials > Admin keys for analytics, users, groups, invitations, usage limits, compliance logs and service accounts; no model inference; expiry Never, 30/60/90 days or 1-365 custom; secret shown once.

feature: Admin key permissions by role
detail: Owners choose All, Read only or Custom; admins pick None/Read/Write per category (Apps, Usage limits, Group Management, Users, Invitations, Codex/Enterprise/Workspace analytics, Costs, Service accounts); broad compliance and message access owner-only; admins edit or revoke only their own keys.

feature: Ads conversion measurement (Pixel and Conversions API)
detail: Advertisers send events via OpenAI Pixel and/or Conversions API, attributed through the oppref click reference, advanced matching (automatic hashing in the Pixel; toggle only in Japan) and modeled conversions; use shared event IDs to dedupe.

feature: Sign in with ChatGPT (identity provider)
detail: Use a ChatGPT identity to create or access accounts on partner sites (Airtable, GitLab, HubSpot, Notion, Supabase, Vercel), OpenAI Academy and ChatGPT Sites; partner receives only name, email and picture, not chats or memory.

feature: Share ChatGPT subscription usage with partner tools
detail: After sign-in a partner tool can ask to use the OpenAI usage included in an eligible ChatGPT plan; user sets limits and it gives no access to conversations or memory.

feature: Admin control of Sign in with ChatGPT apps
detail: On by default; global admins manage organization defaults and per-application permissions under External access in Admin Console; identity sign-in is separate from delegated data access.

feature: Locked chats with account PIN
detail: Move a chat to Projects > Locked chats, hidden from history, pins and search, opened with a 4-digit account PIN (plus Face ID, Touch ID or Android device unlock); not encryption, retention or training unchanged; admins cannot disable or unlock them.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Locked chat exclusions
detail: Cannot lock temporary, archived, group, Codex, local Work, scheduled-task, meeting-recording, background-task or Healthcare chats; project chats leave their project; no archive, pin, move or share while locked; Voice not in desktop locked chats.

feature: Account PIN change and reset
detail: Settings > Security and login > Account PIN: change needs current PIN; reset deletes all locked chats, locked-only memories and protected files permanently; support and admins cannot recover.

feature: Locked chat access timeouts and Lock now
detail: Web tab relocks on refresh, close or idle; mobile relocks after 1 minute away; Lock now ends access instantly; files in locked chats hidden from Space; memory in locked chats follows workspace Memory settings; Android blanks screenshots.

feature: Locked chats and compliance logs
detail: Enterprise and Edu locked chats still appear in Compliance Platform message logs; ads may still show in locked chats.

feature: Temporary chat vs locked chat
detail: Temporary chat stays out of history and training and can pick whether to use memories, instructions and plugins; locked chats are saved and follow the model-improvement setting.

feature: Ads conversion optimization objective and impression billing
detail: Ads Manager campaigns can optimize toward one standard conversion event billed per impression or per valid click; objective, billing and event are fixed after creation (clone to change); Bid Cap is max conversion bid.

feature: Ads average daily budgets
detail: Daily budget is an average over a Sunday-Saturday week; max single day 2x and 7-day 7x budget; US minimum $25; existing campaigns convert automatically.

feature: Enterprise token-based pricing rate card
detail: Token-based Enterprise agreements bill USD per 1M input, cached and output tokens across Chat, Work and Codex (e.g. (model name) Sol $2/$0.20/$10; (model name) Pro $10/$1/$50; (model name) Astra $8/$0.40/$40); replaces message-based rates; Instant is billable.

feature: Enterprise feature fees: voice, search, images, Fast/Ultrafast
detail: Voice $0.05/min plus tokens; web search $10 per 1K runs; GPT-Image-2.0 token rates; Fast 2x; Ultrafast 6x ((model name) promo 3x to Feb 28, 2027); long context above 272K 2x input (not Codex with ChatGPT sign-in); regional processing and FedRAMP 1.1x.

feature: Enterprise-only specialty models
detail: Rosalind Research/Discovery for life sciences, Astra for Law and Daybreak Red models need approval; (model name) Cyber is Codex-only and has no Fast or Ultrafast; promotional pricing windows apply.

feature: ChatGPT for Word, Excel, PowerPoint billing
detail: Office add-ins bill at API model rates ((model name) Sol default, Terra, Luna, (model name)) and share agentic usage with Work, Codex and Workspace Agents; admins enable models.

feature: Ads measurement partner and Pixel/CAPI tool integrations
detail: Ads Manager API keys (Settings > General > API Keys) connect Fospha, Hightouch, INCRMNTAL, LiveRamp, Northbeam, Rockerbox, Triple Whale, WorkMagic; Stape and Datahash help implement Pixel and Conversions API with deduplication.

feature: Gift ChatGPT credits
detail: Plus, Pro and Business Personal-workspace users buy a prepaid gift on web and share a one-time claim link (email or copy); Free, Go, Plus, Pro and Business Personal workspaces can redeem; recipient same currency; Business and Enterprise workspaces excluded.
plans: Plus, Pro (buy); Free, Go, Plus, Pro (redeem)

feature: Gifted credit terms
detail: Link expires in 30 days with automatic refund; claim must be redeemed once; redeemed credits expire after 12 months (180 days in Japan after Nov 13, 2026); nonrefundable once redeemed; not gift cards; used after included plan usage, including Codex.

feature: Business data residency region choice
detail: Region for stored prompts and responses is chosen only at checkout for a new Business workspace and cannot be changed later; does not set inference location; safety logs stay in the US; shopping unavailable with residency.

feature: ChatGPT for Teens experience
detail: Auto-enabled on Free and paid personal accounts identified as under 18 via age information, verification or prediction; includes study mode, homework reminders, quizzes, break reminders, image-upload sensitive-info reminders and age-appropriate safeguards.

feature: Age verification via Persona and age prediction
detail: Misclassified adults can verify age through Persona to remove teen protections, after which prediction stops; email and in-app prompt appear when prediction moves an account to Teens.

feature: Parental controls: Study hours and Quiet hours
detail: Linked parents or the teen set Study hours (new chats start in study mode) and parents set Quiet hours (limits access); parents cannot read conversations; limited safety notifications only.

feature: Site tools (WebMCP) in desktop built-in browser
detail: Websites expose tools via the proposed WebMCP standard; an address-bar arrow shows available tools (gray, blue while used) and recently used ones; ChatGPT picks them automatically and activity shows in the conversation and Sources.

feature: Site tools safety and off switch
detail: Per-call review, confirmation before sensitive actions (purchases, deletions, permission changes, messages), site instructions cannot authorize sharing; turn off via Browser settings > Permissions > Enable site tools; not available in Chrome.

feature: Violence-concern conversation end and 24-hour suspension
detail: After a warning, ChatGPT may end a conversation (removed from history and search) and after repeats suspend the account for 24 hours across all workspaces; email with crisis resources; appeal via the notice; Chat mode on personal accounts only.

feature: Safety notifications to linked parents
detail: Linked parents may get a notification when a teen's conversation is ended or account suspended for violence concerns, without access to chats.

feature: Ads Manager: Maximize results bid strategy
detail: Advertiser bid mode where ChatGPT Ads auto-adjusts bids toward the campaign goal (clicks, conversions) within budget; default for eligible new ad groups, no guaranteed CPA/CPC/ROAS; Manual max bid is the alternative.

feature: Desktop Settings > Usage & billing: monthly Work and Codex usage meter
detail: Shows personal monthly credit limit across Work and Codex, used and remaining amounts, reset info; admin controls whether exact values or only percentages show. Regular Chat usage is excluded. Needs desktop app 26.812.10818 or later.

feature: Request limit increase from Usage & billing
detail: When available, a member can submit a reason for a higher personal usage limit for workspace admin review.

feature: Usage history charts (7D/30D) grouped by surface, model, reasoning, speed
detail: Credit history over time, token history split into uncached input, cached input and output, plus plugin-call and skill-invocation counts. Daily charts refresh slower than the roughly one-minute live totals.

feature: Top consuming chats list
detail: Ranks locally available Work and Codex chats active in the last 30 days by lifetime credit usage; opening one shows model, reasoning and speed breakdown.

feature: Per-chat usage indicator in Work/Codex chat header
detail: Shows lifetime credits, estimated cost when available, and model/reasoning/speed. Excludes sub-agents, separate tasks, image generation, some background work, and delayed data, so it is not a full billing record.

feature: Admin toggle: allow users to see usage in credits and dollars
detail: Owner/admin sets Admin console > Usage limits > Workspace > Usage visibility and requests. Token-billed Enterprise workspaces show US dollars instead of credits.

feature: Personal Analytics plugin (@personal-analytics)
detail: Admin enables it in the Admin console plugin catalog; members install from Plugins, then ask plain-language questions about their own Work and Codex activity and aggregated workspace trends. Read-only, scoped to own identity; workspace summaries use a fixed 30-day window and need at least 5 active Codex users.

feature: Free referral campaign: double Free limits for referrers
detail: Selected Free users in India, Indonesia and Mexico (account 7+ days old) share a link; each qualifying new-account friend who sends a first prompt gives 2x Free limits for 7 days, up to 3 rewards (21 days). Campaign ran Aug 18 to Sep 17, 2026.

feature: Referral code and reward rules
detail: Codes expire 30 days after creation; friend must be in the same country with a new account and unused verified email and phone; one code per friend; rewards not for Codex or API, no cash value, and end immediately on upgrading to a paid plan.

feature: GitLab plugin: read projects, files, MRs, issues, pipelines
detail: Lets ChatGPT and Codex read GitLab projects, groups, repo trees, files, branches, commits, diffs, merge requests, issues, notes, pipelines, jobs, logs and test reports, limited to what the connected user can access. Installed from Plugin directory; uninstall via Settings > Plugins.

feature: GitLab plugin write actions
detail: When admins enable them: create branches and commits, create/update/delete files, create/update MRs and issues, add notes, approve/rebase/merge MRs, apply suggestions, create pipelines, play or retry jobs. Gated by Configure actions, Configure approvals, OAuth scopes and GitLab permissions.

feature: GitLab merge request review in Code Review plugin
detail: Preview in the Code Review plugin on desktop and web: open an MR to inspect changes and ask Codex to explain or fix. Automatic GitLab cloud code reviews are not available through the connection.

feature: Admin controls for apps: Configure actions, Configure approvals, Role access
detail: Workspace admins enable or disable individual app actions, choose when users must confirm, and in Enterprise/Edu restrict which roles may use an app; Business admins manage availability workspace-wide.

feature: GitLab Self-Managed/Dedicated app template (workspace-specific app)
detail: Admin creates a draft app from a template with hostname-only input plus the org's GitLab OAuth app ID and secret (scopes api, write_repository, openid) and the exact Redirect URI from ChatGPT, reviews actions, then publishes; draft is not visible to members until published.

feature: GitLab activity for Codex code review (service account and webhooks)
detail: For Codex review on self-managed GitLab, admin sets a workspace service account (Codex-created or personal access token), enables GitLab activity per project or group, and optionally a project environment. Review writes use the service-account identity.

feature: Privacy Center hub
detail: A page explaining privacy options and linking to the real settings (does not change settings itself). Opened from Help menu on web, Settings on iOS/Android, or Help menu on desktop if present. Not for Enterprise, Edu or Healthcare.

feature: Privacy Center topics: personalized chats and ads, chat privacy, data use and access
detail: Three categories: Memory, personalized ads and location; temporary chat and locked chats (account PIN); plugins and apps, MFA, model improvement, export or delete data. Ads shown only to eligible Free and Go; precise location sharing unavailable in Enterprise workspaces.

feature: Locked chats with account PIN
detail: An account PIN limits access to saved conversations; described under Chat privacy in the Privacy Center.

feature: Data export and account deletion availability by plan
detail: Self-service export is unavailable in Business, Enterprise and Healthcare; Edu may allow it if the admin enables it. Self-service account deletion is unavailable in managed workspaces. Business, Enterprise, Edu, Healthcare content not used for training by default.

feature: Healthcare Public Data plugin (nine read-only public-source apps)
detail: Searches PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, DailyMed, RxNorm, openFDA, CMS Coverage, CMS Open Data, Medicare Care Compare and NPI Registry; no patient records, no extra account, no extra charge. Connect each app individually; @ in ChatGPT or $ in Codex picks a source. Do not include patient identifiers.

feature: Plugin install policy: Available vs Installed, per role under RBAC
detail: Admin sets a plugin to Available (members may install) or Installed (installed for eligible members), per role when RBAC is on; each included app also needs separate enabling and User access, and healthcare warnings need acceptance.

feature: Compliance Platform visibility into conversation and app activity
detail: Enterprise and Edu admins can review conversation and app activity through the Compliance Platform; retention and residency settings may not cover data sent to external public-data providers.

feature: Epic plugin: read-only patient chart access
detail: Clinicians review notes, medications, conditions, encounters and lab results they are already permitted to see via an org-named plugin and each user's own Epic sign-in. Cannot write records, place orders or message patients. Not in individual Clinicians accounts.

feature: Epic template: custom plugin per environment (Non-Production/Production)
detail: Admin creates a draft from the Epic template with a name, description, environment and exact FHIR R4 base URL, then publishes with role access, permissions and tools review; OpenAI-managed OAuth registration is chosen automatically. Validate non-production first.

feature: OpenAI gift cards (buy and redeem)
detail: US-only USD non-reloadable cards, $15 to $250, bought from participating retailers, redeemed in full at chatgpt.com/redeem with a PIN into the wallet balance of a US-billed account; no expiry; non-refundable and non-transferable once redeemed.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business (owner or personal workspace)

feature: Wallet balance applied to subscriptions, upgrades, renewals and credits (web only)
detail: Balance is used automatically first, remainder billed to another payment method; not usable for Apple App Store or Google Play subscriptions or other-currency charges; auto-reload draws wallet balance first. Viewable in Settings > Billing with Transaction history.

feature: Gift card redemption limits and Business owner-only redemption
detail: Redemption can fail on account-balance or daily loading limits. In Business only workspace owners redeem into the workspace balance; personal funds cannot pay for creating a Business workspace.

feature: Legacy Codex seats in ChatGPT Business (usage-based, no chat)
detail: Seat type with no monthly fee that pays for Codex from shared workspace credits and excludes ChatGPT chat. Closed to new workspaces since June 24, 2026; only previously eligible workspaces can add them. No credits means Codex is blocked.

feature: Business seat management: invite by seat type, bulk CSV, change seat type, default seat type
detail: Owner picks role and seat type (Standard, Premium, Codex) when inviting, can bulk invite by CSV, change seat type, and set default seat type in Workspace settings > Billing. Seat swaps only between Standard and Premium; first paid subscription needs at least 2 Standard seats.

feature: Business credits: purchase, 12-month validity, automatic reload, monthly recharge cap
detail: Owners buy credits (valid 12 months; 180 days in Japan after Nov 13, 2026), set auto reload with minimum balance, target balance and monthly recharge limit. Owners/admins set monthly Codex spending limits per seat type or member; member limit overrides.

feature: Back to School offer: four free months of Plus for US students
detail: Verified via SheerID by US degree-granting college/grad students; four free monthly periods of Plus (incl. Work), then $20/month unless cancelled. Claim by Oct 31, 2026, once only, needs a payment method, not for Apple/Google store-billed subscriptions; cancelling forfeits remaining free months.

feature: Connect app accounts from Settings > Plugins
detail: Install plugin then Connect, sign in to the provider account and approve permissions. Some apps allow several connected accounts via Connect another account; Reconnect fixes expired access; availability depends on plan, region, surface and workspace.

feature: iCloud Mail and Calendar connections via app-specific password
detail: Connected separately with an Apple app-specific password (not the regular Apple password); both include read-only contact lookup; Reminders and Contacts plugins not included. Disconnecting in ChatGPT does not revoke the password at Apple.

feature: Google apps: all permissions required, Select fewer apps
detail: Google connections require approving every requested permission (Select all, Try again); Select fewer apps in ChatGPT limits which Google apps are connected.

feature: Use apps in a chat via @ mention or + menu
detail: Mention a plugin or app with @ or pick it from the + menu (extra options under More); ChatGPT may ask approval before reading or acting. Voice support varies by app and some apps work with deep research.

feature: Disconnect app account or uninstall plugin
detail: Settings > Plugins > app > Disconnect via menu; stops future access but keeps existing chats, files and memories. Uninstalling a plugin can disconnect all its accounts. For financial apps, disconnecting does not cancel an already submitted transaction.

feature: App permission levels: Always ask, Allow read, Allow low-risk, Allow all
detail: Controls when ChatGPT asks before using an app: ask always; read freely but ask to change; auto-approve low-risk; or no prompts (Allow all, only per app/connection, not in account-wide or workspace selectors). Set in Settings > Plugins > Permissions.

feature: Per-connected-account permission override with reset to Default
detail: Each connected account of an app can have its own permission; selecting Default (or Reset) restores the inherited setting.

feature: Approval card: Deny, Allow once, Allow low-risk, Always allow
detail: Before an app action runs ChatGPT shows a card with these choices; Always allow is withheld from managed-workspace members, auto-available connections and actions needing extra safety review. Some sensitive actions are denied outright.

feature: Financial transactions always need provider confirmation
detail: For trades via finance plugins a saved ChatGPT permission, even Allow all, never grants standing consent, including for scheduled or automated tasks; the provider's per-transaction confirmation remains required.

feature: Layered workspace app controls (install policy, app settings, role access, action controls, permissions)
detail: Business admins enable apps per workspace; Enterprise/Edu add role-based access. Workspace Agents have separate agent-level action-safety settings. Action restrictions do not necessarily limit data already synced.

feature: Plugin extensions not available on Free and Go
detail: Free and Go users can browse the plugin directory and recommendations but cannot use plugin extensions; app availability also varies by region, workspace, role, model and surface (some apps are desktop only).

feature: App availability messages (plan, admin approval, workspace setup, desktop only)
detail: Directory shows statuses such as Not available on your plan, Admin approval required, Requires workspace setup, Requires a workspace, Desktop only/Open in desktop app, and Disabled by admin.

feature: Microsoft guest account connection (Connect as a guest, tenant ID)
detail: Under Advanced settings of Connect another account for a Microsoft app, a user can connect as a guest of another organization by tenant ID, subject to that tenant's admin approval.

feature: Event-triggered and scheduled tasks using connected apps
detail: Tasks in Scheduled can read or act through connected apps under app permissions; actions that send messages or change data may pause the task awaiting approval. Workspace Agents have their own action-safety settings.

feature: Site tools in ChatGPT desktop app; cloud browser website permission
detail: ChatGPT can use tools offered by a webpage in the desktop browser (separate from plugins); cloud browser has a per-website permission that is separate from confirmation for consequential actions.

feature: Refresh custom MCP app tool list; bulk plugin changes by workspace default or custom role
detail: Business, Enterprise and Edu admins can refresh an existing custom MCP app's approved tool list without recreating it; bulk plugin availability can be set per workspace default or custom role (RBAC required for roles).

feature: Lockdown Mode restricts apps needing live external access
detail: When Lockdown Mode is on, apps that need live access to external services may be blocked in the conversation.

feature: App sync retired (Aha!, Azure Boards, Basecamp, Help Scout, Pipedrive, Teamwork, Zoho CRM, Zoho Desk)
detail: App sync including admin-managed sync is gone; old synced connections cannot be restored. Providers with live apps must be reconnected as live apps.

feature: Sites: publish site as plugin; add API Platform key in Site environment settings
detail: Owners of a Site can create a plugin for it (retry in latest desktop app if web fails) and store an API Platform key as a secret in the Site's environment settings when developer setup cannot finish.

feature: Codex banked resets (free one-time, saved to account)
detail: Promotional reset saved for later, redeemed from Settings > Usage & billing (desktop), Usage settings (web) or /usage > Redeem reset (CLI); not on mobile. Needs a covered allowance under 80% remaining; restores covered allowances to 100% but does not raise plan limits.

feature: Allow your assistant to use resets (desktop setting)
detail: Lets Codex redeem a banked reset on request, only when the 5-hour or weekly allowance is at 10% or less; can be turned off to use resets manually only.

feature: Automatic (global) resets and paid instant resets
detail: Global reset applies directly to selected accounts and limits without redeeming; paid instant reset is bought for immediate use by selected Plus and Pro personal accounts via Buy an instant reset. Neither appears in banked history.

feature: Codex allowance structure by plan
detail: Go has a monthly allowance; Plus and Business Standard have 5-hour and weekly allowances; Pro 100, 200 and 500 have a weekly allowance. Image generation, file upload and Chat Voice limits are separate and unaffected by resets.

feature: Usage limit resets history (30 days)
detail: Settings > Usage & billing > History under Usage limit resets lists Reset received and Reset used events and an Available list with expirations; not on mobile.

feature: Luna Reserve fallback usage
detail: After regular Codex/Work limits run out, selected accounts can keep working with (model name) Luna on a separate capped reserve; a moon indicator shows options to upgrade, add credits or apply a reset. Not in Business or Enterprise; not in regular Chat.

feature: SharePoint site-collection allowlist or blocklist
detail: Admins pick Allowed sites or Blocked sites mode (only one list populated at a time) in the SharePoint app's Safety & Security Controls; applies to whole site collections, filters SharePoint (not OneDrive), and never exceeds users' Microsoft permissions. Default limit 10,000 collections, up to 120,000 on request.

feature: CSV upload of SharePoint site collections
detail: Import GUIDs or Graph site-ID triples (max 1 MB, headers optional, additive, deduplicated); URL-only files rejected; changes stay draft until Save.

feature: Workspace Admin API for SharePoint allowlist (admin key chatgpt.enterprise.apps.write)
detail: Admins can read, add, remove or clear allowlist entries through api.chatgpt.com with a workspace admin key (Restricted, Apps: Write); up to 10,000 GUIDs per request; changes recorded in audit and compliance logs. Deny lists and labels are UI-only.

feature: Exclude files by Microsoft Purview sensitivity label
detail: Admins list label GUIDs so matching Office, PDF and MP4 files vanish from SharePoint app results; TXT/CSV are treated as unlabeled. Encrypted content is excluded by default unless fetch_advanced plus Entra admin consent are enabled.

feature: Import plugin marketplace from GitHub (daily sync, Sync now)
detail: Admins import a marketplace JSON catalog (Codex or Claude-compatible formats) from a public or private github.com repo with optional path and branch/tag/commit; daily auto-sync, manual Sync now, last working version kept on invalid update, removed entries marked No longer in source, deleting marketplace deletes its plugins.

feature: Move uploaded plugin to GitHub management; reference existing app via .app.json
detail: Adding pluginId to a marketplace entry transfers an archive-uploaded plugin to GitHub source keeping its ID and policies. A plugin may reference an existing app by ID in .app.json without granting new permissions.

feature: Desktop only label for plugins declaring MCP servers
detail: Imported plugins that declare MCP servers are labeled Desktop only and cannot run in ChatGPT on the web, even with remote HTTPS servers.

feature: Buy an instant weekly Work/Codex rate-limit reset
detail: Plus and Pro personal accounts can buy, from desktop Usage settings or the weekly-limit banner, an immediate restore of 5-hour and weekly usage; new weekly period starts at next Work/Codex request, cannot be saved, generally non-refundable. Not on Free, Go, Business, Enterprise, Edu.

feature: ChatGPT balance (USD wallet) in Settings > Billing
detail: US-dollar balance from redeemed gift cards and adjustments, applied automatically to eligible web purchases (Go, Plus, Pro, Business) in USD, showing Balance applied and Due today; separate from usage credits; cannot be withdrawn, does not transfer when merging personal workspace into Business.

feature: Transaction history labels (Gift card, Credits, Adjustment, Credit/Debit)
detail: Billing > Transaction history with View all separates gift-card fundings, usage-credit purchases and adjustments; optional payment method appears at some fully covered checkouts.

feature: Astra precaution pause or end of chats (Review findings)
detail: With Astra models a monitor pauses or stops chats when the agent may be misreading instructions (sensitive data transfer or access, destructive changes). User opens Review findings and may continue; monitoring stays on. On mobile or zero data retention the chat ends without explanation and cannot resume.

feature: Misalignment alert webhooks (safety.org_alert.created)
detail: Workspace owners add an HTTPS endpoint in Admin Console > Credentials > Webhooks to receive precaution-pause alerts for ChatGPT and Codex; API projects use safety.alert.created and API error misalignment_policy_violation. Admin or member roles are not enough.

feature: Admin policies for in-app browser, Browser Use and Computer Use
detail: Codex admins set workspace or group policies (Requirements vs Defaults, top-down processing, Stops after match) to disable the in-app browser, Browser Use via in-app browser or Chrome extension, or native Computer Use on macOS and Windows; can block importing cookies, passwords and history from external browsers.

feature: Browser Use site rules: access, uploads, downloads, Debug/CDP
detail: Default Allow or Block per origin with exceptions; Block wins on conflict; separate permissions for site access, file uploads, downloads and Chrome DevTools Protocol access.

feature: Browser approvals: auto-review, approval duration, saved Always allow
detail: Eligible browser actions can be auto-reviewed at no usage cost when signed in with ChatGPT; approvals last one turn or one thread; admins decide whether members can save Always allow per site or across sites.

feature: Computer Use app rules and locked computer use control
detail: Admins allow or block Computer Use per app by macOS bundle ID, Windows AUMID or signed executable publisher; can disable saved app approvals and, on macOS, prevent enabling locked computer use.

feature: Site tools in ChatGPT desktop built-in browser
detail: ChatGPT can use actions that a webpage exposes in the desktop built-in browser, only when the page supplies a supported tool; separate from admin browser requirements.

feature: OneNote plugin: find, summarize, create or update notes
detail: Searches and summarizes notebooks, sections and pages and can append or edit notes with approval; personal notebook operations only cover notebooks owned by the connected account, group/SharePoint notebooks use separate workflows; guest connection via tenant ID supported.

feature: Zendesk plugin: ticket review, knowledge search, reply drafting
detail: OpenAI-developed plugin connected by entering only the Zendesk subdomain and each user authorizing their own account; reads tickets and history and can act only with approval and permissions; BYOC/custom listings use a different flow.

feature: Ads Manager event quality score and warnings
detail: Advertiser diagnostics per pixel or data source, refreshed daily over 7 days, flagging limited email/customer ID, missing click info (oppref), delayed Conversions API events (over 1 hour), mismatched conversions, concentrated conversions, weak extra matching info, few event types, low Pixel/CAPI activity and idle goals.

feature: Business partner plugin credit promotions
detail: Eligible Business users see a directory banner for partner plugins (HubSpot, PayPal, Oracle QuickStart, Klaviyo); accept, install and complete a real workflow within 7 days to add $25-$50 agentic credits to the workspace, with per-user and per-workspace caps; credits expire 30 days after added, non-cash, non-transferable.

feature: Agentic credits usable for Work, Codex, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint and Workspace Agents
detail: Promotional credits are workspace-level agentic credits spendable on ChatGPT Work, Codex, ChatGPT for Excel or Sheets, ChatGPT for PowerPoint and Workspace Agent usage; not API credits.

feature: Ads Manager budget pacing (daily and campaign total)
detail: Daily budgets are averaged over a Sunday-Saturday week in the account timezone; campaign total budgets pace against schedule (end date up to 365 days, default 60 days if none). Changing budget or end date recalculates; no guarantee of full spend.

feature: Shared Work and Codex allowance with 5-hour and weekly windows
detail: Work and Codex draw one included allowance on Plus, Pro and Business Standard/Premium; both 5-hour and weekly must have room (new 5-hour window starts at first message). Pro 100/200/500 have no 5-hour limit. Check Settings > Usage.

feature: Local message estimates per 5-hour window by model (Plus, Business Standard)
detail: Estimated ranges: Astra 5-45, (model name) 15-160, (model name) Sol 15-150, Luna 350-3,000; cloud tasks cost more; estimates not guarantees.

feature: Model choices in Work and Codex: Astra, Sol, Terra, Luna
detail: Astra for hardest work, Sol balanced, Terra everyday, Luna fast and cheap; availability depends on account and workspace. (model name) Pro in Chat is powered by Astra on eligible Pro, Business and Enterprise, with separate limits; Plus gets Astra in Work/Codex but not (model name) Pro.

feature: Reasoning level selector (lower, medium, higher effort)
detail: Adjustable separately from model; higher effort uses more allowance and cannot supply missing info or access; Astra at Low can beat Sol at High.

feature: Ultrafast mode for Astra and (model name)
detail: Lower-latency responses: Pro $500 uses allowance at 8x then credits at 6x; Enterprise/Edu bill at 6x standard credit or token rate. Not included for Plus, Pro $100/$200 or Business, even with credits.

feature: Fast mode (faster, higher allowance use)
detail: Gives faster responses at the cost of more included allowance; supported models and rates listed on a separate page.

feature: Astra launch reset offers (Sep 3, 4 and 7, 2026)
detail: Eligible Plus, Pro and Business subscribers got banked resets on Sep 3 and 4 and an automatic reset on Sep 7; cutoffs applied for new accounts; one-time historical promotion.

feature: ChatGPT for Financial Services plan
detail: Separate plan built on Enterprise for banks and research teams: Work experience with Astra, editable models, research notes and pitchbooks in firm templates, citations traced to source tables. Sales-led, workspace-wide (no mixing with standard Enterprise seats); inherits SAML SSO, SCIM, RBAC.

feature: Included premium financial data sources
detail: OpenAI-hosted data on by default: SEC filings, Quartr, Daloopa (24-hour delay, 3,000 datapoints per user per month), Fiscal.ai, PitchBook Essentials, Crunchbase, LSEG/Reuters news (US professionals), FMP and Nasdaq pricing delayed 15 minutes. Not in standard Enterprise.

feature: Financial services admin settings (workspace default and role overrides)
detail: Owners enable ChatGPT for Financial Services and choose financial data source permissions under Workspace settings > Financial services, by workspace default or role.

feature: Data plugin (@Data): analyze business data and build dashboards
detail: Investigates questions over warehouses (Redshift, ClickHouse, Databricks, BigQuery, MongoDB, Snowflake), files from Drive and SharePoint, using semantic-layer definitions; builds interactive dashboards, works with BI tools (Omni, Oracle BI, Power BI, Sigma, Tableau, ThoughtSpot); can trigger implicitly and suggests installing related plugins.

feature: Publish dashboards with Sites and refresh via cloud automation
detail: With OpenAI Sites installed, Publish a generated dashboard to chosen workspace people (data is copied into the site, so mind permissions) and keep it fresh with a cloud automation.

feature: Templates and context skills for Data (@Template Creator, guided context skill)
detail: Turn a Site into a reusable skill with @Template Creator, or build a context skill via guided flow (audience self, team or company, can include a lightweight semantic layer); share as zip or admin-distributed plugin, optionally auto-installed.

feature: Custom GPT retirement (scheduled Dec 11, 2026; Feb 28, 2027 for FedRAMP/deferred)
detail: Custom GPTs and their pages become inaccessible at retirement; existing conversations with GPTs stay accessible. Enterprise creation of new GPTs ended Oct 26, 2026. Affects all plans; use plugins or projects instead.

feature: Migrate to plugin from My GPTs
detail: Creator (or Enterprise admin) converts a published GPT: instructions become a skill, connected apps become apps, knowledge files become reference files; custom actions, selected model and drafts do not transfer. Result starts private and the original becomes read-only.

feature: Bulk GPT migration via ChatGPT Admin plugin; Share Plugin audience prefill
detail: Admin plugin runs asynchronous bulk migration (full inventory needs a workspace Owner); Share Plugin can prefill the original GPT's users or groups; sharing needs Share plugins, workspace directory publishing needs Publish plugins to workspace.

feature: Projects as GPT replacement for ongoing work
detail: New project in sidebar keeps instructions in Project settings, reference files and chats together; existing GPT chats cannot move into a project and custom actions or sharing do not carry over.

feature: Plugin Creator and skill auto-selection
detail: Plugin Creator builds new reusable workflows; installed skills can be picked via @ mention or + > More, or chosen automatically by description. Standard Chat including Instant cannot run scripts bundled in plugins.

feature: Token-based billing for Enterprise (USD, invoiced monthly in arrears)
detail: Eligible Enterprise agreements (incl. Financial Services; not Edu or Healthcare) meter Chat, Work and Codex in tokens charged in USD alongside seat fees, with optional spend commitment; credit-based agreements draw down a purchased balance instead.

feature: Dollar spend controls: monthly workspace budget, user and group limits, spend alerts
detail: Admins of token-billed Enterprise workspaces set a monthly workspace budget and per-user/group allowances; alerts only notify. ChatGPT reports show ChatGPT spend only; API spend stays in the API platform.

feature: ChatGPT Ads: context hints on ad groups
detail: Advertisers add short natural-language hints at ad group level describing what, who and when a product fits; hints inform relevance but are not targeting or delivery rules.

feature: ChatGPT Ads integrations: HubSpot and Shopify
detail: HubSpot lets advertisers create ChatGPT Chat Card campaigns, send leads to CRM and view performance (Business/Enterprise orgs need global admin to enable Ads access). Shopify app syncs catalog and commerce events via OpenAI Pixel and creates product campaigns; US first.

feature: Sponsored Agents ad format
detail: Ad format letting users chat with an AI representative of a business from an ad; limited alpha for selected advertisers, no early access requests accepted.

feature: ChatGPT for Word add-in (sidebar in Microsoft Word)
detail: Sidebar from Microsoft Marketplace to draft, summarize, revise, reformat and check documents; works on the open document only, complex tables/charts may need manual fixes; same add-in as Excel and PowerPoint; separate from chat history, memory and skills; plugins unsupported.
plans: Free, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Admin control for ChatGPT for Word (default on from Oct 1, 2026)
detail: Workspace admins toggle ChatGPT for Word in the admin console and Microsoft 365 admins must allow the add-in; becomes enabled by default from October 1, 2026.

feature: Word add-in usage: API-rate token pricing from shared allowance
detail: Word usage is metered in tokens at API rates for the chosen model and draws from the shared allowance used by Codex and other premium features, which it can reduce.
plans: Free, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Skills and apps inside Word add-in
detail: Reusable skills for memo drafting, formatting or contract review, and supported apps (Outlook, SharePoint, Google Workspace, Dropbox) depending on plan and permissions.

feature: Astra for Law (Legal Search Index, Trusted Access)
detail: (model name) tuned for legal work with a daily-updated index of US case law, statutes, regulations, court rules and administrative decisions. Admins request via Admin Console > Trusted Access, sign an addendum, then activate under Models > Legal configuration; lawyers and supervised staff only, eligible geographies; also via API.

feature: Legal plugins (iManage, DeepJudge, community skills)
detail: Partner plugins such as iManage and DeepJudge, and community skill packs from LegalQuants, LECG and Skills.law, extend legal work in ChatGPT; availability per listing.

feature: Dot shares plugin connections and permissions with ChatGPT, Work and Codex
detail: A dot (personal agent) uses the same plugin connections and permissions as ChatGPT, Work and Codex, managed in the Plugins tab; it can also have its own Slack or email identity. Not available to users under 18.

feature: Dot Custom Rules and action approval tiers
detail: Strong defaults: password changes and money transfers require user takeover; deleting data or installing software need approval each time; some actions (recurring messages) can be pre-approved. Custom Rules set allow, ask or never per supported action but cannot override core guardrails.

feature: Dot proactive research (read-only background lookups)
detail: A dot can check permitted sources before you ask and save private notes, but its research tools cannot send messages, change plugin content or control a browser or computer.

feature: Dot Activity View and Auto-review safety checks
detail: Activity View in the desktop app lists ongoing and delegated tasks with status and steps, and lets you redirect or stop; Auto-review checks planned actions (e.g. email recipients) against instructions, Custom Rules and safety before they run and cannot be turned off.

feature: Dot memory shared with ChatGPT memory
detail: Dot receives ChatGPT memories and conversation context and can contribute to memory; turning Memory off stops sharing but does not erase what the dot already holds; individual dot memories cannot be viewed or edited, only deleted by deleting the dot.

feature: Dot data handling: retention, deletion, training, HIPAA, EKM
detail: Context kept while the dot exists, no credentials/images/screenshots stored; deleting a dot removes its context but not files, Codex threads or chats it made; pausing or removing access does not delete data. Personal plans follow Improve the model setting; HIPAA-eligible under BAA; EKM keys supported in Enterprise.

feature: Dot access to camera, microphone and screen
detail: Requires connecting your computer to the dot and granting the ChatGPT app camera, microphone or screen permission in device settings.

feature: Dot secure login form and card purchases
detail: For supported sign-ins the dot pauses while you type credentials into a secure form that never reaches the model; purchases with merchant-saved cards need your approval, which can be given in advance for a specific purchase.

feature: Dots: always-on personal agent with its own cloud computer
detail: A dot works between conversations toward a goal using ChatGPT memory, connected apps and its own cloud computer; user sets autonomy, reviews work, can pause it. Created in mobile apps, desktop app or desktop web (not mobile web); named @yourname-dot, with character or pet avatar; one personal dot per member.
plans: Pro, Plus, Business, Enterprise, Edu, Healthcare

feature: Dots plan availability and pricing
detail: Pro and selected Plus (18+, outside EEA, UK, Switzerland), Business Premium, rolling out to Business Standard (US); Enterprise/Edu/Healthcare default-on from Nov 18, 2026 unless admin opts out (not UAE residency). Enterprise free through Jan 13, 2027, then flat-rate billing; downgrading Pro to Plus loses the dot.

feature: Dot activity profile: In progress, Scheduled, Completed; take over computer
detail: Desktop profile lists tasks and opens the dot's cloud computer for viewing, Take over and Return control; tasks keep separate conversations; mobile opens the computer in your control.

feature: Connect your local computer to a dot (Allow access / Revoke access)
detail: Optional, off by default; enabled in desktop app on that computer, letting the dot create Work or Codex tasks, use local skills and local browser when its cloud browser is blocked; computer must stay online with app open.

feature: Dot can use Codex cloud environments
detail: A dot can start cloud tasks in Codex cloud environments, which must be created in Codex first.

feature: Dot connected apps, Slack and personal email
detail: Manage via dot profile Customize > Plugins (shared ChatGPT settings); dot can review connected data proactively and form memories; Slack connects from desktop, personal email supported; no standalone dot email at launch and dot cannot call you.

feature: Dot scheduled tasks and reminders
detail: Ask for reminders or recurring checks; manage under Scheduled or the dot's Recent activity (active, paused, completed; change repeat, time, completion notifications). Dot can also research and suggest help in the background.

feature: Dot texting via iMessage/RCS (beta) and in-app call
detail: Limited Pro users in US, Canada, Mexico verify a phone number in the dot profile to text one-on-one (no SMS, groups, or calling the number; not end-to-end encrypted, processed by Linq); reply STOP or Turn off texting to end. Calls use the phone button in the mobile app.

feature: Dot Custom rules, pause and delete
detail: Customize > Custom rules sets per-action behavior: take action without asking, if pre-approved, ask first, or hand off. Pause via menu (admin pause needs admin to lift); Delete ends the dot, archives main chat and deletes its own memories, cannot be undone, Work/Codex chats are kept.

feature: Daybreak (cyber) access controls and org consolidation
detail: Formerly Trusted Access for Cyber: API admins scope Daybreak to a project; ChatGPT/Codex admins choose which users get Daybreak Blue or Red tiers, users turn on a Daybreak toggle per task. Dedicated Cyber orgs migrate into a primary org with a 14-day grace period; internal approved use only; API-key Codex lacks user-level controls.

feature: Flashcards in ChatGPT
detail: Ask for flashcards on a topic or from uploaded notes; tap to flip, mark known or to practice, shuffle; ask ChatGPT to add or edit cards; decks are saved in the library with known/unknown views.

feature: Ads Manager onboarding: business verification, domain approval, ad review and appeals
detail: Advertiser accounts go through business verification (up to 7 business days, may be triggered by a spend threshold), domain approval, ad review with appeal/Request Review. Ads policy table restricts health, finance and legal categories by country; telehealth, prescription drugs, payday loans not allowed.

feature: Set up Daybreak Blue/Red access via Admin Console > Models
detail: Off by default. Business admins use Specialty Models > Set access per user or workspace toggle; Enterprise provisions via role overrides (Cybersecurity: Daybreak Blue or Red) and checks users in Models > Test; changes take about 10 minutes. API needs org owner, non-default project, ~15 minutes.

feature: Chromium browser policies for ChatGPT desktop via MDM
detail: The in-app browser honors Chrome Enterprise policies deployed device-side: Windows registry SOFTWARE\Policies\OpenAI\Codex, macOS preference domain com.openai.codex, Linux /etc/opt/codex/policies/managed/. No cloud management yet; verify at chrome://policy; Windows falls back to Chrome keys if the app key is absent.

feature: Extension policies for in-app browser (block, allow, force-install lists)
detail: Admins can set ExtensionInstallBlocklist/Allowlist/Forcelist, ExtensionSettings, ExtensionAllowedTypes and ExtensionInstallSources ahead of the extension install UI being available in the workspace.

feature: @ChatGPT in Slack and Microsoft Teams
detail: Mention @ChatGPT in a conversation to ask questions, summarize or draft; admin configures instructions and tool connections; it does not inherit the user's history, memory, custom instructions or private-channel access. Available globally to Business, Enterprise, Edu; replies visible to thread participants.

feature: Slack and Microsoft Teams apps used from within ChatGPT
detail: Connecting Slack or Teams as a ChatGPT app lets you work with them from a ChatGPT conversation under your own account; this does not install @ChatGPT in the org's channels.

feature: Previous ChatGPT app in Slack sidebar replaced by @ChatGPT
detail: The older Slack app using a personal ChatGPT account from the sidebar is superseded; existing installs keep working at first, and Slack admins must approve a scope upgrade to move Business/Enterprise/Edu to @ChatGPT.

feature: Using @ChatGPT: channels, DMs, guests, approvals
detail: Mention in an enabled Slack channel (assistant must be added; channel limits do not restrict DMs) or Teams channel/thread/1:1 chat. Runs as a service account; no Slack guests or Slack Connect; Slack Allow for a week remembers approval 7 days; no memory at launch; generated file permissions separate from thread access.

feature: Set up @ChatGPT agents in admin console (Slack or Teams)
detail: Admins add an @ChatGPT agent under Agents for each Slack workspace or Teams tenant (Teams needs Global/Privileged Role Admin), test in a channel, add company tools as plugins, set optional instructions; can restrict to selected Slack channels (blocks DMs), turn agent off or delete it.

feature: @ChatGPT spend caps and user restriction to workspace members
detail: Workspace default @ChatGPT usage limit with per-agent overrides (amount and duration) under Spend controls; credits required; option to restrict use to members who connect their Slack/Teams account to the same ChatGPT workspace.

feature: Codex Cloud tasks through @ChatGPT in Slack
detail: Where Codex Cloud is available, members request coding tasks via @ChatGPT; the service account finds shared cloud environments and the task runs as the requesting member under their repository access.

feature: Microsoft Teams permissions for @ChatGPT (channel messages, transcripts, optional Files.ReadWrite.All)
detail: Teams app reads channel and chat messages, members, channel settings and meeting transcripts under approved-together installation permissions; separate optional delegated file access that Microsoft admins can approve per employee.

feature: Shareable ChatGPT profile (chatgpt.com/profile, /u/username)
detail: Profile with name, photo, bio, theme/layout, sections, activity; private by default, shareable publicly (viewers must be signed in), no chat titles or content shown; changing username breaks old link; cannot block individuals or share Skills. Showcase not on mobile; rolling out to Enterprise.

feature: Member profile sharing controls (Business and Enterprise)
detail: Business profiles are shared with workspace members by default; admins/owners set the level in Workspace settings > Permissions & roles > Member profiles (private, or workspace members only); members cannot change it; Enterprise usernames may be managed by SCIM and links use workspace slug (/w/slug/username).

feature: Profile activity stats and Sites showcase
detail: Profile shows Chat message counts, Work/Codex token usage with daily/weekly/cumulative totals, streaks (Work or Codex tokens only) and top plugins; can showcase up to 12 owned Sites, reorderable, visible only if the Site is accessible to the profile's viewers.

feature: Team tasks: shared recurring cloud tasks
detail: Teams create tasks in the team's Scheduled section with name, instructions, trigger (schedule, one-time date/time, or app events like new Gmail or Slack message), plugins and model; run in the cloud under the team's service account using workspace connections; Run now, Previous runs, Edit, Pause, Resume, Delete.

feature: Team task access, connections and spend controls
detail: Enterprise admins use role-based controls for who creates teams and tasks; team owner picks which workspace connections a team may use; tasks pause if their model becomes unavailable; admins manage spend separately from personal scheduled-task limits; tasks can also be started from @ChatGPT in Slack/Teams.

feature: Teams: shared membership for pages, Spaces and tasks
detail: A team groups coworkers in one workspace so a page or Space can be shared once with the team; a Space can include several teams and a team can hold several Spaces. A team is not a separate plan and not Microsoft Teams.

feature: Team tasks: recurring cloud jobs run by a team
detail: Teams can create recurring or trigger-based tasks (e.g. weekly project update posted to Slack) that run in the cloud via the team's own service account and configured connections; they do not inherit the creator's memories, custom instructions or chat history. Members can review runs, including ones before they joined.

feature: Share a plugin with a team; team connections
detail: A plugin shared with a team can be used by members and tasks, but personal app connections are not shared; tasks use connections the team owner enabled from eligible workspace connections.

feature: Create a team and become its owner
detail: From the Teams list choose Create team, enter a name and optional description; the creator becomes owner. Only the owner can delete the team; owner status gives no admin rights.

feature: Convert workspace groups to teams (manual or automatic)
detail: Admins can convert eligible groups to teams in Admin Console, one by one (Enable as a team) or via the Automatically create teams setting that can also convert existing groups; SCIM and dynamic membership keep syncing. Not yet available for Business workspaces.

feature: Invite to a team or share a team join link
detail: Members of directly created teams can invite coworkers by name or email or copy a join link; anyone in the same workspace joining via the link needs no owner approval. Members can remove non-owner members, and anyone can leave a team.

feature: RBAC for creating teams and team tasks
detail: In Enterprise, role-based access control decides who can create teams and who can create or update team tasks; custom roles go to members or groups.

feature: Sign in with ChatGPT on other apps and sites
detail: Sign in to participating third-party apps with a ChatGPT account, sharing only name, email and profile picture; the app gets no access to conversations or memories and no API key is needed.

feature: Use your ChatGPT plan allowance inside partner apps
detail: After signing in, a user can let a participating commercial app spend their Work and Codex allowance or credits instead of an API key; open-source tools stay available to all users. Apps may charge separately.

feature: Per-app weekly usage limit (Settings > Usage > App limits)
detail: Go, Plus and Pro users see usage per connected app and set a weekly cap as a percent of overall plan usage; a cap is not a reserved pool and does not raise plan limits.

feature: Allow apps to use credits after plan limits
detail: Off-by-default switch lets partner apps draw on credits once included usage runs out; an app needs its limit at 100% to qualify, and automatic credit purchases could cause charges.

feature: Admin controls for plan use in other apps (Business)
detail: Admins allow each app under Tenant settings > External access (Use ChatGPT plan) and set a workspace percentage under Usage limits > ChatGPT plan > Usage in other services; members can add their own stricter limits. Usage-based members use workspace credits only.

feature: Login connections: disconnect a Sign in with ChatGPT app
detail: Settings > Security and login > Login connections lists apps signed in via ChatGPT and offers Manage connection > Disconnect where available; disconnecting does not reverse recorded usage or delete data the app already holds.

feature: Space: home for files and pages (replaces Library)
detail: For accounts with access, Space replaces Library; Projects stay unchanged. Pages are editable documents that can be nested and co-edited, and each collaborator uses their own ChatGPT agent on shared content.

feature: Page sharing: view or edit permissions, review and revoke
detail: Owners choose who gets view or edit access, can see who has access, change roles or remove people; only the creator or owner can delete a page; admin sharing controls also apply in managed workspaces.

feature: Shared pages do not expose your chats or Memory
detail: Sharing a page shows only its content; however personal context ChatGPT wrote onto the page becomes readable by viewers. Uploaded files inherit page permissions, but linked files keep their own permissions and summaries copied from them are visible.

feature: Model training on shared pages follows each user's setting
detail: On personal accounts, each person's Improve the model for everyone setting governs interactions their own agent has with a shared page; Business and Enterprise data is not trained on by default.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise

feature: Report a page or artifact via Report Content form
detail: A form lets users report a page or artifact that may violate policy with a link and short description; private content need not be made public.

feature: Codex Cloud: tasks on OpenAI-managed computers
detail: Codex runs coding tasks (investigate bug, change code, run tests) in isolated workspaces from a published environment; tasks continue while your computer sleeps and can be started or continued from desktop, web or mobile.

feature: Cloud environments: create and publish on desktop or web
detail: An environment bundles repositories, tools, dependencies and access settings; it is created and published on desktop or web, then usable on all devices. Published setup changes apply only to new tasks.

feature: Saved VM state recoverable for 7 days
detail: Default recovery window for a cloud task's saved VM state is 7 days after the last turn start or resume; uncommitted work is not carried to new tasks, so commit to source control.

feature: Share a Codex cloud environment in Enterprise
detail: Sharing makes the prepared setup usable by authorized workspace members without giving access to others' tasks or edit rights; environment-owned credentials and connections are shared, personal vault values are not.

feature: Codex Cloud (Legacy) still used for reviews and integrations
detail: Code Review, Security Review and existing Linear/GitHub workflows stay on the legacy cloud during transition; legacy environments can be migrated by the user, leaving the original untouched.

feature: Meetings plugin: bot-free meeting notes on Mac
detail: A plugin in the macOS desktop app records mic and system audio, then saves a personalized summary and action items to Space; works for online calls and in-person talks without a bot. Install from Plugins and grant mic and system-audio access.

feature: Meetings: suggested action items you can start in one click
detail: Summaries use connected-app context to propose follow-ups (draft email, update plan); each item can be edited and started so ChatGPT works on it. You can also ask ChatGPT questions about past meetings.

feature: Meetings reminders, call detection and auto-stop
detail: With a calendar connected (Google or Outlook plugin) it reminds you of upcoming meetings, detects calls and offers notes, reminds you to stop after silence, and auto-stops on lid close, long silence or a 4-hour session.

feature: Meetings privacy: private pages, audio deleted after notes
detail: Meeting pages are private by default; sharing exposes notes but not the transcript. Audio streams to OpenAI and is deleted after notes are ready. A consent reminder is shown only to the user, who must obtain consent from participants.

feature: Meetings availability: Mac only; Enterprise alpha; other OS coming
detail: Beta on macOS for all Pro and Business plans; Enterprise only via an alpha program; iOS, Android and Windows support is announced. Business needs Space and the plugin enabled by admins; separate from the older Record feature.

feature: Host an MCP server in a ChatGPT Site and expose it as a plugin
detail: Ask ChatGPT or Codex to add an MCP server with read or write tools to a Site; when the owner publishes the Site a plugin card appears to install and connect. Changes to tools require republishing.

feature: Plugin permissions: use, upload, create with MCPs, share, publish
detail: Workspace roles carry separate switches: Use plugins (on by default in Enterprise), Upload plugins and Create plugins with MCPs (off by default), Share plugins (invite coworkers) and Publish plugins to workspace directory.

feature: Share a Site-hosted plugin by invite or link
detail: Plugins > Personal > Created by you > Share lets owners invite coworkers or copy a link; each needs Site viewer access, to install and to connect on their own. Pro and personal users cannot yet share plugins; sharing a Site does not share its plugin.

feature: Agent Security admin area (replaces Policies & Config)
detail: Admin Console area for agent policies: Requirements (limits members cannot override) and Defaults (starting values), with Global baseline (approvals, web search, managed tools), Local environment and Codex Cloud environment overrides that inherit from Global. Codex Cloud and Work Cloud settings are separate; MDM and legacy managed-device rules outrank it.

feature: Local work sync: start Work on desktop, continue on web or mobile
detail: New Work tasks started in the desktop app can be continued from web or mobile while steps that need local files or tools still require the computer to be online. Existing tasks are not migrated; if the computer is offline a new turn runs in a cloud container without local access.

feature: Enable local work sync in Work permissions
detail: Admins must grant both Local and Cloud Work access, review Agent Security, then switch on sync with a consent prompt; switching it off interrupts running turns. Synced work is coordinated in the cloud, supports data/inference residency and EKM, but not Zero Data Retention.

feature: Space availability, age and platform support
detail: Space is rolling out to eligible Plus accounts and available on Pro, Business and Enterprise; users must be 18+. Pages are created and edited on web and desktop, edited on iOS/Android, and shared pages cannot be opened by Free users; Canada and UAE data-residency workspaces are coming soon.

feature: Pages: editable documents created and edited with ChatGPT
detail: Create a page from a Work or Codex conversation, directly in Space, or from a template on Space home; edit by hand or ask ChatGPT to revise a section. Pages can include ChatGPT-made charts, trackers and interactive tools, and you can still hand-edit after hitting the Plus message limit.

feature: Page comments on selected text and a page chat
detail: Select a passage to leave a comment describing a change; use the page's chat for broader questions or document-wide changes.

feature: Spaces with folders, subpages and personal space
detail: Each user has a personal space and can create more spaces by asking ChatGPT; spaces hold folders and pages, pages hold subpages, and ChatGPT can create, rename and move pages (edit access to both needed). Projects remain separate for chats and instructions.

feature: Space views: All, Pages, Suggested, Recents, Images
detail: All has Your items and Shared with you; Pages lists owned or shared pages; Suggested and Recents resurface content; Images separates Your creations from Uploads. On mobile use Space search or global search.

feature: Locked chats hide their files from Space
detail: Files uploaded or created in a locked chat are hidden from Space and openable only in that chat via Projects > Locked chats with account PIN or device authentication; permanently unlocking makes them visible again.

feature: Share pages or spaces with real-time co-editing; inherited access; no public links
detail: Share a page or space with view or edit rights; editors collaborate live. Subpages inherit access from parents, removing a direct invite does not remove inherited access, and public links are not available.

feature: Deleting a page sends it and its subpages to Trash
detail: Deleting a parent page also trashes subpages, even those owned by other people.

feature: Slides (rolling out) and Sheets (coming soon) in Space
detail: Slides are rolling out to accounts with Space access; Sheets are announced.

feature: Code Review plugin: find, inspect and discuss pull requests
detail: Lists PRs you authored or were asked to review with search and filters; shows description, diff, findings, comments, checks and merge conflicts, and lets you ask Codex questions or request a scoped fix before you comment, commit or merge.

feature: GitLab merge request review (preview)
detail: Merge requests can be inspected in Code Review via a GitLab connection; GitLab cloud code reviews and automatic cloud review are not available.

feature: Review local changes before opening a PR
detail: Codex can review uncommitted local changes; existing cloud code review is not migrated to the new cloud environments.

feature: OpenAI Marketplace: apply enterprise commitment to partner products
detail: Eligible enterprise customers can apply part of their OpenAI commitment to qualifying partner products; discovery and interest only, no self-service checkout, partner invoices the customer and eligibility is per purchase.

feature: Dots admin: Use dots permission and admin preview
detail: Workspace owners enable dots via Permissions & roles > Workspace capabilities (Use dots); off by default in admin preview that ends Nov 18, 2026 when it becomes default-on unless admins opt out. Needs Agent Security approvals to include on-request and auto-review; unavailable with UAE inference residency.

feature: Dots permissions: Slack, local computer access, custom rules
detail: Separate switches: add dots to Slack (dot posts with its own identity; only its owner can direct it), allow local computer access (files and commands; off by default; needs computer online with the app open) and custom rules for dot actions (off by default). Phone messaging via iMessage, RCS or WhatsApp is unavailable for Enterprise.

feature: Cloud computer controls: browser, network, computer use, password manager
detail: Workspace switches for cloud browser use, cloud network access, cloud computer use and use of the password manager apply to both dots and Work Cloud tasks; website allow/block lists in Agent security apply to the dot cloud browser. A cloud computer does not inherit the member's VPN or sign-ins.

feature: Personal dot inventory: view, pause, resume, delete
detail: Owners and admins see each personal dot's creator, active/paused state, cost tier, ID and Slack status; they can pause or resume (owner cannot override an admin pause) and owners can delete a dot, which pauses its billing. Deprovisioning a member does not delete the dot; members keep private Pause, Activity and Scheduled views.

feature: Dots analytics, audit logs and model settings
detail: Analytics show active dot users (needs a user message that day) and enabled-dot counts; audit logs record pause, resume, delete and tier changes. Enterprise model controls and default model settings do not apply to dots.

feature: Ads Manager plugin: draft and create ads from a site, brief or product feed
detail: Natural-language plugin that drafts ad copy and image from a website or brief, previews, then creates ads (up to 50 standard variants per request) or product-feed campaigns; every upload or write needs explicit confirmation of exact values and results are read back.

feature: Ads Manager plugin: manage campaigns, ad groups and ads
detail: Find resources by name, review settings, create or update campaigns/ad groups/ads, pause, activate or archive, and replace ad images. Actions depend on the user's Ads Manager role.

feature: Ads Manager plugin: performance analysis and delivery troubleshooting
detail: Ranks and compares campaigns, shows impressions, clicks, spend, CTR, CPC, CPM and attributed conversions with breakdowns by time, device or country (default last 7 completed days); delivery diagnosis is read-only. No revenue or ROAS since conversion value is not received.

feature: Scheduled daily or weekly recommendation-only ad reviews
detail: One-time or recurring reviews check readiness, delivery and measurement and prioritize budget, bidding, targeting, copy and creative suggestions; they never change the account and the schedule is previewed before confirming.
