feature: Ads Manager plugin: set up business ad account and manage users
detail: Guides self-serve creation of one business ad account (details, logo, terms acceptance) and can list, invite, re-role or remove users and replace the logo (new logo goes through brand review). Billing, tax, identity and appeals stay in Ads Manager.

feature: Device limit on paid accounts and card purchase limit
detail: Go, Plus and Pro 100/200/500 accounts count toward a per-device limit and a per-card subscription limit; Free, Business, Enterprise and Edu do not. Hitting it blocks a purchase or shows Device limit reached at sign-in.

feature: Device limit warning: log into another account or cancel with refund
detail: The warning offers Log into another account, or cancel and refund (ChatGPT and Google Play billing end paid access immediately and refund; Apple purchases refunded via Apple). Credits or resets do not clear the restriction.

feature: Buy credits for flexible usage (Settings > Usage; Codex Usage & Billing)
detail: Credits pay for eligible usage after included limits are reached but do not unlock unavailable models, merge subscriptions or move usage between accounts; availability depends on plan, region and feature.

feature: Connect Google Analytics 4 to Ads Manager (beta)
detail: Advertisers link one read-only GA4 property per ad account (Conversions > Data Sources), mapping GA4 events to Ads Manager events; OpenAI imports aggregate reports (30 completed days, then daily) for attribution comparison and optimization. A GA4 Conversions column can be added, and disconnect keeps imported data.

feature: Roughly 50% faster default text generation for Sol and Astra
detail: At the default speed setting, the top (model name) models generate text about 50% faster in OpenAI products and supported partner apps without enabling Fast or Ultrafast, which are separate options with own usage rates; faster text does not speed tool-heavy work.

feature: Promotional usage resets: automatic vs banked
detail: Offers can refresh Work and Codex limits automatically or bank a reset to apply manually before expiry; support cannot grant, extend or verify free resets, and paid resets are handled separately.

feature: Intelligent UI: answers with interactive layouts, charts, forms and buttons
detail: (model name) picks the response format, mixing text, graphics, tappable buttons, forms, charts and interactive diagrams in chat; some components (e.g. checklists) keep state after refresh but not across threads.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise

feature: Personalization > Layout and Visuals > Simple
detail: Web setting that reduces visual and interactive elements in answers (some may still appear); Custom Instructions can also steer layout, e.g. concise or tables.

feature: Intelligent UI scope: all reasoning levels except Pro; not in Work or Voice
detail: Works from Instant through Extra High on Luna (Free, Go) and Sol (Plus and above), but not with the Pro reasoning option (Astra), the Work tab or Voice. Connected plugins like Gmail, Health and Finance still work.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise

feature: Composer predictions: suggested next message in Codex (beta)
detail: After Codex finishes, a full next-message suggestion may appear in the composer; Tab accepts it into the box without sending. Only in local and SSH threads of the Codex desktop app with listed (model name) models, not in Chat, and not after every reply.

feature: Show predictions toggle (Codex Settings > General > Composer)
detail: Predictions are on by default for eligible adult personal Pro users and can be switched off there; they use only the current thread context and work with memory off.

feature: Composer predictions are free during beta
detail: Generating predictions does not count toward Codex limits or credits in beta; sending a message, including an accepted prediction, uses normal usage.

feature: Rosalind Academic Plan: free Business seats plus GPT-Rosalind for US labs
detail: Approved academic labs at US universities get up to 30 free Business Standard seats for 12 months (card required) with ChatGPT, Codex and GPT-Rosalind; PI applies, passes trusted-access review (Persona identity check, biosafety contact) and is sole workspace owner. No API credits, no Zero Data Retention, members must share the PI's email domain.

feature: College Planner: application checklist, timeline and financial-aid steps
detail: A plan tab for US high-school students (grades 10-12) that researches schools, builds per-school checklists and timelines with source links, explains aid and scholarship requirements, and lets users add, edit, complete or delete tasks or remove a school. It does not write essays, predict admission or aid, or rank reach/target/safety.

feature: College Planner weekly update schedule
detail: A Schedule weekly updates card sets a weekly check-in summarizing deadlines and unfinished work; it never changes the plan and counts against task and usage limits.

feature: College Planner read-only share link and plan deletion
detail: Copy a link to a read-only, live view of the Plan tab (viewers must sign in; chats and sources are excluded) and delete the link later. Deleting the plan permanently removes profile, schools, tasks, chats and files, though Library files may remain; not available in Business or Enterprise.

feature: Ads Manager Pixel test mode
detail: For a Web Pixel, Conversions > Data Sources > Test lets an advertiser enter a page URL, perform an action and inspect session events in Event Stream; test labeling lasts up to 30 minutes on one origin, uses existing consent settings and test events still count in analytics.

feature: Conversions API (CAPI) rules: key, time window, dedup, validate_only
detail: Server events use a Conversions API key (separate from the Advertiser API key), original action time in Unix ms within 7 days and at most 10 minutes ahead, one bad event can fail a batch, and a shared event ID dedups Pixel and server copies. validate_only checks events without saving.

feature: Ads attribution reporting details and Event Quality Score
detail: Attributed conversions take about 24-48 hours; conversions combine click-through and view-through when the view window is 1 day. Conversion-optimized campaign goals cannot change after creation and custom events cannot be goals; a low Event Quality Score does not by itself mean tracking is broken.

feature: ChatGPT Slides: build and edit decks with ChatGPT
detail: Create a deck from a Work request or Space > Create > Slide (blank or template, template-creator can make shareable templates); edit text, images, shapes, tables and charts by hand, or select an element and use Request edits or the prompt bar. Hand editing still works past the Plus message limit.

feature: Slides real-time collaboration, comments and @mentions
detail: Editors co-edit a deck live with shared comments and @mentions; @mention ChatGPT (or your dot) to request edits. Comment-only access is not available and Free users cannot open shared decks; no public links.

feature: Present Slides and export to PowerPoint, PDF or Google Slides
detail: Present directly from ChatGPT; on web export to .pptx, PDF or Google Slides, or open in locally installed PowerPoint or Keynote (Show in Finder on macOS).

feature: Windows limitation: local slide creation falls back to .pptx
detail: On Windows without the required MXC component (unsupported on Windows 10, may need update on 11), local AI slide work in the desktop app uses PowerPoint files; use cloud mode or web for collaborative Slides. Desktop can use installed system fonts while the web font picker uses browser fonts.

feature: Tunnels: connect a ChatGPT Site to a private network service
detail: IT runs OpenAI's tunnel client (installable via Homebrew) to let a Site call an internal HTTP/HTTPS service without exposing it publicly; the service keeps its own auth. Admin must enable Allow members to attach private tunnels for owner and connector, and Allow public Sites with private tunnels to publish publicly.

feature: Daybreak: reduced-refusal mode for authorized security work in Codex CLI
detail: Toggle with /daybreak in interactive CLI (applies to new turns, saved as default), -c daybreak=true or config.toml for headless runs, config in TypeScript/Python SDKs and app server (daybreakBlue, daybreakRed, standard programs). Requires Codex CLI 0.163.0+ and an account or API project with Daybreak access; some requests are still refused.

feature: Daybreak with a proxied inference provider and refusal prompt
detail: A proxy provider can enable cyber_access_programs and a model_catalog_url so Daybreak models are discovered (CLI 0.167.0+); when a refusal occurs with Daybreak off, the CLI offers Enable Daybreak or Not now. Desktop has Daybreak in the Advanced model picker, and Codex Security CLI/SDK take a separate --cyber-access-program option.

feature: Google Drive access policy: allowed or blocked shared drives, My Drive toggle
detail: Admins pick Allowed drives or Blocked drives (not both) by shared-drive ID or CSV, and separately toggle Allow My Drive (on by default) in Safety & Security Controls; applies to search, reads and writes on top of each user's Google permissions. Whole drives only, no folder, file, user or label exclusions; empty Allowed list blocks all shared drives.

feature: Microsoft Teams access policy: allowed or blocked teams and label exclusions
detail: Admins allow or block Microsoft 365 groups (by Object ID or CSV) and exclude teams carrying listed Purview sensitivity label GUIDs, which overrides an allow; needs Group.Read.All approval for labels. Controls cover team channels only, not 1:1, group or meeting chats or transcripts; unverifiable access is blocked.

feature: Outlook email sensitivity-label exclusions
detail: Admins list Purview label GUIDs (sublabels added separately) in the Outlook app's Safety & Security Controls; matching emails are hidden from search, blocked on read and action, and their attachments are blocked. Labels inside attachments are not checked and Microsoft permissions still apply.

feature: ChatGPT for Financial Services workspace setup
detail: Requires ChatGPT Work; admins enable Financial Services and member access, optional connections (Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, S&P CapIQ, FactSet, Datasite, DealCloud), firm templates and style guides, and monthly usage limits via defaults, groups or overrides. No @ command is needed to trigger it; Work Cloud can run with local access off.

feature: Financial Services: built-in datasets, onboarding and skill-creator for recurring workflows
detail: Users get guided onboarding to connect data providers, built-in financial data without a separate login, and can capture recurring workflows (earnings updates, portfolio reports) in the built-in skill-creator; no ready-made DCF, pitch-deck or earnings skills are included. /feedback in the message box sends feedback.

feature: Ads creative enhancements: automatic headline, translation, image and URL tuning
detail: ChatGPT Ads can auto-adapt headlines, descriptions, language, image sizing and destination URLs to the conversation, run without per-variant approval or preview. Default-on for self-serve and BPO campaigns from Oct 30, 2026 with account and campaign opt-out under Manage settings; ads do not influence ChatGPT answers.

feature: Prism retirement: export LaTeX projects and continue in Codex
detail: Prism is being shut down and all its data deleted; users export all projects (Settings > Data Controls > Export all projects zip) or one project, optionally download PDFs, and open the folder in Codex as a local chat. History, comments, collaborators, live Zotero and real-time editing do not carry over.

feature: Business workspace with a single paid seat
detail: Some new Business signups can start with 1 paid Standard or Premium seat instead of the usual 2-seat minimum; owners can add seats (prorated) or schedule a reduction to 1 seat at next billing cycle in Workspace settings > Members > Manage seats, but only if at most one seat is occupied.

feature: Shared ChatGPT and Codex usage allowance measured in tokens (from December)
detail: Plus, Pro and Business will share one token-based allowance across ChatGPT and Codex as Work's agentic features merge into main ChatGPT; heavier models and tasks use more, Instant chat does not draw from it. Combined remaining usage and reset times appear in Settings > Usage; at the limit users wait, upgrade or buy credits.

feature: API credits benefit for Pro and Business subscribers
detail: After 7 paid days, Pro 100/200/500 owners get $100/$200/$500 per month and Business gets $20 per Standard and $100 per Premium seat (cap $500 monthly, $6,000 annual) as promotional credits in one linked API organization; claimed in ChatGPT Settings > Billing or API Platform, expiring each cycle with no rollover. Not for Plus, Enterprise or Edu.

feature: Legal Onboarding plugin enabled per custom role
detail: Admins turn on the Legal Onboarding plugin under Admin Console > Plugins > Availability > Customize by role (Available for installation for role); members install it and open via @Legal Onboarding. It guides legal teams to practice areas, plugins and starter tasks and does not grant access to Astra for Law.

feature: ChatGPT Go India free year and continuation offers
detail: India Go trial lasts a free year then renews at 399 rupees per month; cancel via the billing provider 24 hours before renewal. An optional continuation offer, shown on web and Android (not iOS) when cancelling or returning, discounts 3 paid billing periods without restarting the trial.

feature: Ads conversion reporting: date basis and attribution settings
detail: Campaign reports use ad interaction date for Conversions and a separate Conversions (by conv. time) column; click-through-only counting can be chosen to match tools that exclude views. Conversions take 24-48 hours to appear.

feature: Business ad credits: up to $50 per month for eligible workspaces
detail: Business workspace owners with billing addresses in the US, UK, Germany or France can claim up to $50/month of ChatGPT ad credit (matched to seat fees) via Settings > Benefits through Jan 31, 2027; one ad account per workspace, credits expire after 30 days and have no cash value.

feature: Ads bidding: Intelligent bidding, Target CPA and Target CPC
detail: Intelligent bidding (formerly Maximize Results) and new Target CPA / Target CPC average-cost goals replace Max Bid and Max CPC from Nov 9, 2026; legacy controls retire Jan 1, 2027 and the API gets dedicated target fields. Targets are averages not guarantees; audience bid multipliers apply where available.

feature: Max Bid and Max CPC legacy ad bid controls retiring
detail: Existing campaigns using Max Bid (conversion) and Max CPC (click) move to Target CPA and Target CPC; the old controls are deprecated on January 1, 2027.

feature: Business Hub: claim and manage your business in ChatGPT
detail: Authorized owners claim a business via phone, business email, DNS domain or Shopify, then complete Persona identity verification to publish details (website, description, logo, delivery and return policy), view 28-day insights (mentions, website clicks, discovery topics) and connect a CSV or hosted product feed. Claims can be cancelled or disputed; a verified blue check follows Persona approval.

feature: Business agent: customer-facing agent for US ecommerce and online services
detail: Verified eligible businesses can create, preview and publish an agent that answers customers' product and policy questions from provided info and links to the website; it cannot buy, book or check orders. Businesses never see individual customer chats; teammates or agencies can be added by the claiming admin.

feature: Auto-approve join requests (auto-join) for Business workspaces
detail: Owners turn on Workspace settings > Billing > Seat preferences > Auto-approve join requests so eligible coworkers on verified or owner-domain emails join without approval, needing workspace discovery on. A new seat of the default type may be bought automatically with immediate prorated charge, or only existing seats are used; turning it off keeps purchased seats.

feature: CSAM warnings, conversation stop and temporary suspensions
detail: In Chat and Work on web and mobile for personal accounts (and signed-out use), a request seeking CSAM stops and hides the conversation and may suspend the account; repeat violations can lead to longer suspension or closure. Not applied to Business/Enterprise/Edu/Healthcare, voice, Codex or desktop apps.

feature: Appeal a temporary suspension via the email link
detail: A suspension email states duration and gives an appeal link; appealing does not restore access automatically, and permanent closures follow separate review instructions. Specialist self-help and survivor-support resources are listed.

feature: Advanced and Standard voice retire Dec 11, 2026; GPT-Live voice becomes default
detail: Users are notified Nov 10 and after Dec 11 can no longer pick Advanced or Standard in Settings > Voice, falling back to Live voice. GPT-Live is a full-duplex model that listens and speaks at once and delegates hard tasks to text models; live video and screen sharing stay on Advanced voice until GPT-Live supports them, custom-GPT voice stays on Advanced until it retires the same day.

feature: Free plan 'Context window full' / 'Chat memory full' notice
detail: On Free, long chats can fill up; the notice offers starting a new chat (optionally with a summary that may omit details) or upgrading to continue the original chat. Deleting saved memories does not free space.

feature: Business winback credits: 625 workspace credits per qualifying seat
detail: Invited former Business owners who buy paid Standard or Premium seats by Dec 31, 2026 (11:59 PM PST) get 625 pooled workspace credits ($25) per seat for eligible extra usage; one workspace only, not combinable, credits expire in 30 days and do not raise allowances or give API credits.

feature: Dots: personal always-on AI teammate with its own cloud computer
detail: A dot is messaged in ChatGPT or called in the mobile app, learns how you work, uses its own cloud computer and your connected apps to research, draft, run scheduled tasks, notify you of changes and parallelize work; the user sets what it may do alone versus ask first.

feature: Dot tiers and pricing: Standard $50, Advanced $200, Expert $500 per month
detail: Tiers set how much work a dot handles at once; all start at Standard and only admins can upgrade a dot's tier. No dot fee through Jan 13, 2027, billing starts Jan 14, 2027 from the usage commitment or credits; Work and Codex threads a dot starts still use normal allowances.

feature: Dots default-on from Nov 18 with admin Dots inventory and pause controls
detail: After admin preview ends Nov 18, 2026, dots are on by default in eligible Enterprise workspaces unless admins opt out via Permissions & roles > Use dots. Users pause their own dot from its profile; admins use Admin Console > Dots to see creator, state and tier and pause or resume; analytics count DAU only when the owner messages the dot.

feature: Sponsored Business Agent: chat from a ChatGPT ad
detail: Advertisers build an agent in Ads Manager Agent builder (business info, guidelines, tagline, conversation starters, optional product feed), test in Preview or Test in ChatGPT, publish, and enable agent chats on a Conversion-optimization campaign so users can Start chat or Visit site. No separate chat billing; advertisers see only aggregate insights, and custom plugins cannot be attached.

feature: Enterprise Key Management with OCI Vault
detail: Enterprise workspaces and API projects can encrypt data-encryption keys with a customer-held AES-256 key in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Vault (HSM or software), tagged with the OpenAI organization ID and shared via an IAM policy; ChatGPT workspaces are set up through an OpenAI representative and API projects via an Admin API key.

feature: Private Safety Processing recovery key in OCI
detail: API projects using Private Safety Processing register a separate RSA-3072 recovery key in OCI whose private-key operations stay with the customer; it does not change the project's EKM key.

feature: ChatGPT Wallet: dot pays with a tokenized card after your approval
detail: Pro users in the US (18+, US-issued Amex, Chase, Mastercard or Visa cards) save a card via their dot or Settings > Wallet; at checkout the dot shows merchant, items and total and the user approves with Face ID or Touch ID, after which a virtual payment token is used. Works only in dot conversations, not Chat, Work or Codex; no virtual cards or Chase debit.

feature: Manage Wallet cards by asking your dot
detail: Ask the dot to list saved cards (nickname, last four, expiry), set a default or remove one; removing does not cancel orders or close the card. Declining a request before approval cancels the purchase.

feature: Lenovo PC promotion: Business workspace credits
detail: On Lenovo Windows PCs with ChatGPT preinstalled (app 26.1117.31558+), signing in to an existing Business workspace adds $100, or upgrading to Business from the app earns $100 per seat bought in the first 90 days; credits expire after 60 days and the two offers cannot be combined. An Ask your admin request flow sends the signup link to an admin.

feature: ChatGPT for Sales plugin with partner CRM plugins
detail: A Sales plugin gives account research, meeting prep and follow-up skills and works with partner plugins such as HubSpot via @mentions; each user connects their own partner account. Available on all plans including Free.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise

feature: Bulk plugin deployment in Admin Console (up to 25 at once)
detail: Business and Enterprise admins select up to 25 plugins in Admin Console > Plugins and set each to Available for installation or Installed for workspace; default install does not complete each user's account authorization and required apps must be enabled separately.

feature: Accounting plugin with partner accounting apps
detail: Free-to-install plugin for closing books and drafting reports from spreadsheets or connected apps (BILL, Campfire, FreshBooks, NetSuite, Oracle QuickStart, QuickBooks Online, Rillet, Xero); handles reconciliation, invoice and receipt entries, month-end reports and audit support, with computer-use setup. Business members install freely; Enterprise admins must approve it.

feature: New mobile experience: Home and Explore tabs
detail: Redesigned app with a Home tab (start chats, open sidebar history) and an Explore tab (Projects, Images and other tools), plus a dot tab for users with a dot. Rolling out to eligible adult Pro users and a few Plus users; excludes the EEA, UK, Switzerland, Korea, iPhone SE, iPhone Duo and iPad.

feature: Pin tools or Projects to the tab bar
detail: Touch and hold a tool in Explore and choose Pin to tab bar (replace an existing shortcut if full); Unpin to remove. A pinned Projects tab opens the project list via a folder icon.

feature: Choose Chat or Work from the model picker in the message box
detail: Selecting the model name inside the composer on a new chat lets users pick Chat or Work mode.

feature: Chat history, search, archived and locked chats, delete on mobile
detail: Sidebar lists recent chats newest first and syncs across devices; Search finds archived chats, locked chats are only under Explore > Projects > Locked chats, and deleting via the more-options menu is permanent.

feature: New ChatGPT design switch, Haptic feedback, version and Restore purchases
detail: Settings holds a New ChatGPT design toggle to return to the classic app (Android restarts), a General > Haptic feedback toggle on supporting devices, an app version display, and Restore purchases on iOS for App Store subscriptions.

feature: Combine email/password with Google, Microsoft or Apple login; add a password
detail: An email/password account can also sign in with Google, Microsoft or Apple when the email matches and the methods merge; social-login accounts may add a password in Settings > Security and login. Apple Hide My Email ties the account to Apple's relay address.

feature: MFA is bound to the login method used
detail: To switch sign-in method after enabling MFA, disable MFA, sign in with the new method, then re-enable MFA; deleting the account does not change the authentication method.

feature: Change account email in Settings > Account > Email (web only)
detail: Verified by code to the new address; signs you out of all devices, and the same email applies to the API Platform. Not possible for Business, Enterprise, Edu or SSO accounts, nor from mobile apps; limits are 24h after signup, 2 changes per rolling 24 hours and 20 lifetime, and the old address stays reserved.

feature: Reset or change password (shared with API Platform)
detail: Forgot password link in login emails a reset; Settings > Account adds or updates a password, which also applies to the API Platform. Accounts created with Google, Microsoft or Apple have no password to reset.

feature: Prompting guidance: be specific, break tasks down, iterate
detail: Help article advises clear context, tone and task, splitting complex requests into smaller prompts, and refining via follow-ups.

feature: Improve the model for everyone toggle and Privacy Portal opt-out
detail: Free, Plus and Pro content may train models unless users turn off Improve the model for everyone in Settings > Data controls or choose Do not train on my content in the Privacy Portal; either covers ChatGPT and Codex. Business, Enterprise, Edu and API data is not used by default.

feature: Feedback and temporary chat training exceptions
detail: Thumbs up/down feedback on individual plans can send the whole conversation for training even after opt-out (not for Business/Enterprise/Edu); temporary chats are not used for training while temporary. Workspace admins control Allow response feedback; parents can manage training for linked teens.
plans: Free, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Delete ChatGPT account (web, iOS, Android, Privacy Portal)
detail: Permanent deletion via Settings > Account > Delete (web), Data controls > Delete account (mobile), or the Privacy Portal if you cannot sign in; data removed within 30 days, same email reusable after 30 days, not reactivatable. Unavailable self-serve for Business, Enterprise, Edu and Healthcare.

feature: Signed-out ChatGPT use: one conversation at a time
detail: Without logging in, ChatGPT supports a single conversation at a time; signing in is needed to save conversations.

feature: Contact support via Help Center chat bubble (virtual assistant then human)
detail: Support opens from the chat bubble on help.openai.com, starts with a virtual assistant, handles most languages, and may ask for a sanitized HAR file for UI issues (25 MB attachment limit; desktop app lacks dev tools).

feature: File upload limit note: files under 20 MB in troubleshooting guidance
detail: Support guidance for upload failures says to keep files under 20 MB and check extensions, VPNs or proxies.

feature: Admin Console for Team, Business and Enterprise
detail: Settings > Admin Console lets admins invite or remove members, manage seats, configure SSO domains and SCIM, review usage and audit logs, and set data retention, export controls and policies.

feature: Change display name (via API Platform profile)
detail: The name shown in ChatGPT comes from the API Platform profile; edit it there (up to 96 characters, letters and some punctuation, no digits) and it syncs to ChatGPT within about 15 minutes.

feature: Basic ChatGPT FAQ: content ownership, deletion and training opt-out
detail: Users own outputs for commercial use subject to policy; a privacy portal link lets people opt out of training and request deletion, but individual prompts cannot be deleted from history. Business and Enterprise content is not used for training. (Page text is dated: mentions (model name) and no internet access.)

feature: One OpenAI login works across ChatGPT, Labs and API Platform
detail: Existing Labs or Platform accounts can log into chatgpt.com with the same credentials; new users sign up at chatgpt.com.

feature: API Platform sign-in troubleshooting: match original method
detail: Users must sign in with the method used at signup (password, Google, Microsoft, Apple or phone); VPNs, extensions and cached data can interfere, and a domain verified by another organization can block login.

feature: ChatGPT Plus plan at $20 per month
detail: Paid individual plan priced at $20 monthly, billed monthly only; no annual or prepaid multi-month option. Gives priority access in busy periods, higher model limits, reasoning access and faster replies.

feature: Plus includes voice, image generation, file analysis, Deep Research
detail: Plus lists voice conversations, image generation, file uploads and analysis, and Deep Research where available. Model availability varies by rollout; the model picker shows what an account has.

feature: Plus message caps vary with demand
detail: Plus may apply usage limits such as message caps that shift with system conditions, especially in high demand.

feature: Sign in with ChatGPT: share plan allowance with participating tools
detail: Eligible Plus subscribers can let third-party tools draw on their included allowance after a separate explicit approval; usage counts against the same allowance and is not API billing. Credentials sharing and reselling are not allowed.

feature: Upgrade flow: profile icon, Upgrade plan, Get Plus
detail: Signing up for Plus is done from the profile menu via Upgrade plan, then Get Plus.

feature: Manage subscription and invoices in Settings > Account
detail: Subscription management, invoices and cancellation live under profile, Settings, Account. The invoice email may differ from the ChatGPT account email.

feature: Restore purchases in mobile Settings
detail: If a charged account still shows Free, the iOS or Android app has Settings > Restore purchases to resync; Apple Hide My Email users may have a privaterelay address and must continue with Apple.

feature: ChatGPT Pro is a higher tier above Plus
detail: Pro is described as a higher tier with extra features, higher usage limits and expanded premium tool access.

feature: Training opt-out available to Plus users
detail: Conversations may be used to improve models and safety, but users can opt out at any time through Data controls.

feature: Privacy controls overview: model improvement, memory, temporary chat, deletion
detail: Settings > Data controls holds model-improvement preferences; memory settings are in Settings > Personalization. Available controls depend on plan, account type and workspace settings.

feature: Temporary chat: choose personalized or not at start
detail: Temporary chats skip history, create no memories and are not used for training while temporary. Personalized ones can use memories, custom instructions and plugins; choice is made before starting. A safety copy may be kept up to 30 days.

feature: Saving a temporary chat turns it into a regular chat
detail: A saved temporary chat joins history and then follows the account's personalization and model-improvement settings.

feature: No training on business data by default
detail: Content from Business, Enterprise, Edu and Healthcare workspaces and the API Platform is not used to improve models unless the organization chooses to share it.

feature: Account deletion and email reuse after 30 days
detail: Deleting an account removes access to ChatGPT and the API Platform; a fully deleted account's email can be reused for a new account after 30 days.

feature: Phone number reuse and API verification cap
detail: A deleted consumer account's phone number is released after 30 days and can register again; a phone can verify the first API key for at most 3 accounts, and deletion does not reset that. A number cannot be unlinked from a live account.

feature: Clear chat history one by one or all at once
detail: Cleared chats are deleted from systems within 30 days, except de-identified data or what must be kept for security or legal reasons.

feature: Data not sold or shared with advertisers; privacy request portal
detail: Chats are not shared with advertisers or sold; content goes to vetted service providers; limited authorized human access for abuse, support, legal or training. Privacy requests go via Privacy Portal or the dsar mailbox.

feature: Refund policy: 7-day discretionary window for individual plans
detail: Payments are generally non-refundable; an unused individual subscription may get a discretionary refund if requested within seven days, with limits on repeat refunds and substantial use. No automatic proration after day seven; refunded access ends.

feature: Refund requests via Help Center chat widget
detail: Web and Google Play purchasers request refunds in the chat widget while logged into the charged account; processing takes 5-7 business days for web and 10 for Google Play. Wallet-funded charges can be refunded to wallet balance.

feature: Apple subscriptions refunded only by Apple
detail: Cancellations and refunds for subscriptions bought through Apple must be requested from Apple.

feature: Regional refund rights: EU, UK, Turkey, Korea, Brazil
detail: EU, UK and Turkey residents get a prorated refund when cancelling within 14 days; Korea gets full refund within 7 days if unused, else prorated; Brazil has tiered rules by refund count (full within 7 days, later prorated).

feature: Business seats generally non-refundable; seat reduction next cycle
detail: Unused seats in a self-serve Business workspace are non-refundable for the committed period; an owner can schedule seat reduction for the next cycle. Support may review seat-count errors or mistaken annual renewals.

feature: Payment disputes block separate refunds
detail: No separate refund is issued while a chargeback is active or after funds were returned through it.

feature: U.S. sales tax exemption request
detail: Eligible organizations submit proof of exemption via the support chat, naming OpenAI OpCo, LLC as seller (certificates to the old entity invalid from 2026-01-01). Applies only to future invoices on existing billed accounts.

feature: Card decline troubleshooting: 3D Secure, region, prepaid
detail: Declines come from the bank, 3DS/SCA failures or unsupported card-issuing regions; prepaid cards cannot buy API credits. Adding a new card does not confirm a failed renewal is paid.

feature: Cancel plan: Settings > Billing > Cancel plan
detail: Web subscriptions cancel in Settings, Billing, Cancel plan; Apple via iOS Subscriptions; Google Play via Play Store; Business via Workspace settings > Billing > Manage plan. Cancel 24 hours before renewal; access continues to period end.

feature: Uninstalling or deleting account does not cancel store subscriptions
detail: Uninstalling the app never cancels. Deleting an account cancels directly billed subscriptions but not Apple ones; Google Play ones must be checked. One subscription works across devices on the same account.

feature: Cancel without account access via support
detail: If the account email is lost, Support can cancel a direct subscription given the account or billing email plus any two billing details (card last four, expiry, billing address, recent charge date).

feature: Ads Manager access may depend on a Business workspace
detail: Deactivating a Business workspace can remove access to Ads Manager without pausing campaigns or charges; pause campaigns and confirm another owner first.

feature: Failed renewal: pay outstanding invoice, PayPal option
detail: Directly billed failed renewals show an outstanding invoice under Billing, which may offer PayPal; paying it does not authorize future automatic payments.

feature: Report unauthorized charges and suspicious activity via webform
detail: A fraudulent-activity webform has separate options for unrecognized charges and for unauthorized account activity; unauthorized charges are validated before refund.

feature: Log out of all sessions and password update
detail: Account security steps include changing password, a Log out of all sessions control, and rotating API keys for API users.

feature: Export data from Settings > Data controls
detail: Free, Go, Plus, Pro and eligible Edu users can request an export in Data controls on web, iOS or Android (mobile may hand off to web). Not for logged-out use or Business, Enterprise, Healthcare workspaces.

feature: Privacy Portal data download request
detail: As an alternative or when unable to sign in, consumer users can request a data copy through the Privacy Portal; the route and expiry follow its own notification.

feature: Export delivery: email or SMS, up to 7 days, link valid 24 hours
detail: A message announces the export; the Download data export link expires 24 hours after receipt and must be opened while signed in to the requesting account. Only one request can be pending at a time.

feature: Export ZIP with local viewer (index.html), JSON conversations
detail: The ZIP has a browser viewer that searches conversations and previews files locally without uploading, plus JSON conversation files and CSV extras. Older exports used chat.html. Exports cannot restore deleted chats.

feature: Export before moving personal workspace into managed workspace
detail: Merging a personal workspace into Business, Enterprise, Edu or Healthcare removes it; earlier export links and new exports may stop working, so export first.

feature: Sign-in methods: email password, Google, Microsoft, Apple
detail: Accounts sign in with email plus password or Continue with Google, Microsoft or Apple; the wrong method gives an already-exists or wrong-authentication error. OpenAI does not merge accounts made with different methods.

feature: Apple Hide My Email private relay account
detail: Signing up with Apple and hiding email creates an account tied to a privaterelay address; it must be accessed via Continue with Apple.

feature: Android sign-in uses browser flow (Chrome or Brave supported)
detail: The mobile sign-in opens a browser; Chrome and Brave are supported, and an outdated Play Store or Play services can cause errors.

feature: Login-code emails and suspicious login lockout
detail: Email verification codes from the OpenAI sender expire and the newest should be used; repeated failures can restrict login for up to one hour. SMS cannot replace email login.

feature: Temporary safety suspension after repeated conversation endings
detail: If conversations keep raising serious violence or harm concerns, the account can be suspended temporarily (24 or 48 hours for some violence or child-safety cases), signing the user out immediately.

feature: SSO invites for Business and Enterprise
detail: Managed users sign in via SSO/SAML after an admin invite; admins can resend invites or check identity provider settings.

feature: Support may ask for HAR file and request ID
detail: For reproducible browser issues support may request a HAR recording; error reports should include the full request ID shown.

feature: API payment method update causes temporary 5 dollar hold
detail: Updating an API payment method places a $5 authorization hold that reverses within 7 days; it is not a charge.

feature: Improve the model for everyone toggle
detail: On by default for Free, Plus and Pro personal workspaces; turning it off keeps history. Applies across web and mobile when signed in, and is saved per browser when signed out. Parent or workspace controls may lock it.

feature: Trusted Access sessions may use content despite opt-out
detail: Trusted Access programs for sensitive security work can use interaction content to improve safeguards even when the training toggle is off; other activity still honors the toggle.

feature: Separate training-data control for voice mode
detail: Voice mode has its own setting for sharing audio data for model training, apart from the main toggle.

feature: Codex training preference set in ChatGPT web Data controls
detail: Personal-account Codex users review or change their model-training preference through ChatGPT web Settings > Data controls.

feature: Locked chats hidden from sidebar, search, recents and notifications
detail: Locked chats stay saved but are hidden from the regular sidebar, search, recents, notifications and previews; archived chats stay archived and project chats stay in projects when training is turned off.

feature: Delete account from Settings (Free, Go, Plus, Pro)
detail: Self-service deletion is permanent and affects data and subscriptions; unavailable in managed workspaces, where the workspace owner handles it.

feature: Memory and training controls are separate; safety context persists
detail: Turning off memory does not disable safety features that may use limited safety-relevant context in rare high-risk cases.

feature: Ads personalization controls
detail: Where ads exist, separate controls govern how ads are personalized.

feature: Feedback thumbs can send whole conversation for training
detail: Even when opted out, thumbs up or down feedback may let the entire related conversation be used for training.

feature: Managed workspaces: org retention, memory, compliance settings
detail: Business, Enterprise, Edu and Healthcare workspaces can have organization-level retention, memory, compliance and access settings; API inputs are not trained on by default.

feature: Privacy rights requests: objection and personal data removal
detail: People in some jurisdictions can object to model processing of their personal data or file rights requests through the Privacy Portal or the dsar mailbox; website owners can block the GPTBot crawler via robots.txt.

feature: Upgrade on iOS in-app or via web checkout
detail: iOS users can upgrade from an Upgrade button above the chat or from Settings; Apple handles App Store purchases while web checkout is managed on the web. Offered plans and prices depend on country and account; an in-app purchases unavailable message may appear.

feature: iOS app limited to supported countries
detail: The iOS app is available only in countries on the supported countries list.

feature: Mobile Projects list under Explore (new) or sidebar (classic)
detail: In the new mobile experience projects are reached via Explore (four-circle icon) then Projects; the classic experience lists them in the sidebar. Search has a Projects filter.

feature: Mobile DeviceCheckError fix steps
detail: A device-check error points to wrong date, time or network; correct them, update, or try the browser. Rooted or jailbroken devices may fail.

feature: Reinstalling does not reset usage limits
detail: Deleting and reinstalling the app does not clear usage limits, workspace permissions or account restrictions.

feature: Share a conversation or single response via link
detail: Share creates a link to the whole conversation, one assistant response, images or uploaded files; mobile can use the device share sheet. Personal links are anonymous by default and open to anyone with the URL.

feature: Update link refreshes personal snapshot; workspace links stay live
detail: A personal share is a snapshot; Update link adds later messages. Workspace shares automatically include later messages and are visible only to workspace members.

feature: Share scheduled tasks via link
detail: Active or paused tasks, including webhook event-triggered ones, can be shared from Scheduled; the link carries title, instructions, schedule, time zone and possibly mode or model, but no memories, files or app data. Completed tasks and computer-only tasks cannot be shared or scheduled.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Recipient schedules a shared task in their own account
detail: The recipient signs in and needs task access, capacity, and connected-app permissions; event-triggered tasks also need Work access and their own connected app. Their copy is independent of the original.

feature: Manage and delete shared links in Data controls
detail: Settings > Data controls > Shared links > Manage lists conversation and task links, with delete per link or Delete all shared links. Deleting a link does not delete the original or saved copies.

feature: Locked chats keep old shared link but add no new messages
detail: Locking a chat does not remove its link; new messages while locked are not added, and a new link requires permanently unlocking.

feature: No expiry, no per-person access, not indexed
detail: Shared links have no configurable expiry or recipient list; pages are not meant for search indexing; links begin with chatgpt.com/share or chatgpt.com/s.

feature: Admin permission to disable chat and task sharing
detail: Enterprise and Edu admins can toggle Share chats and scheduled tasks under Workspace settings > Permissions & roles; Business links are workspace-restricted but lack a workspace-wide off switch.

feature: Allow event-triggered scheduled tasks permission (off by default)
detail: A separate Work permission, off by default in Enterprise, Edu and Healthcare; in Healthcare these tasks are outside the BAA and must not handle PHI.

feature: Shared-link metadata in exports; Compliance API task coverage
detail: Personal export includes shared_conversations.json (link ID, conversation ID, title, anonymity); shared task links are not exported. Enterprise Compliance API includes tasks but not shared task links.

feature: Report conversation on a shared link
detail: Recipients can report a shared conversation or task from the page when the option appears, otherwise via the content reporting form.

feature: Supported countries and territories list
detail: ChatGPT web, mobile and API work only in a published list of roughly 190 countries and territories; unlisted places get a not-available-in-your-country error and may see account suspension. Ukraine has exceptions.

feature: MFA methods: authenticator app, push, SMS or WhatsApp, passkey
detail: Multi-factor sign-in can use authenticator codes, push approval, a 6-digit SMS or WhatsApp code, or a passkey (hardware key supported); the most secure enabled method is offered first. Options vary by device, country and tier.

feature: Settings > Security and login: MFA and log out of all devices
detail: MFA methods are managed under Security and login, which also has Log out of all devices (can take up to 30 minutes); enabling MFA does not sign out other sessions.

feature: MFA recovery: one-time email login via support; Advanced Account Security recove
detail: Email is not an MFA method; if all methods are lost, support verification (can take days) grants a one-time recovery login, after which a backup method must be added or MFA disabled. Advanced Account Security users use a recovery key.

feature: Admins cannot enforce MFA for workspace or organization
detail: MFA enforcement at workspace or API organization level is not currently available.

feature: Cloudflare block page for VPN or risky locations
detail: A Sorry, you have been blocked page appears when Cloudflare flags the IP, often from VPNs or high-risk geolocation; turn off the VPN, change location, or wait.

feature: Common error messages and fixes
detail: Covers something went wrong, network or websocket errors, suspicious activity warnings, preparing your chat, response generation errors with a Regenerate button, slowness and stuck Thinking states with Stop generating then Regenerate.

feature: Generated file downloads expire quickly; 512 MB download limit
detail: Download failed or file not found errors occur when generated files have expired or exceed 512 MB; custom GPTs need Code Interpreter enabled and the GPT updated.

feature: Phone number required in Windows and macOS apps
detail: The desktop apps may ask for a mobile number from a supported country to verify and continue.

feature: Custom instructions with Enable customization toggle
detail: Free-text preferences applied immediately to all chats, including existing ones; set in Personalization on web and desktop or Customize ChatGPT on mobile. Not shown to shared-link viewers; may be sent to plug-in developers.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Custom instructions length: 1,500 characters Free and Go, 5,000 paid
detail: Free and Go save up to 1,500 characters; Plus, Pro, Enterprise, Business and Education up to 5,000. Included in data export and deleted within 30 days of account deletion; edits affect future chats only.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Classic mobile app: sidebar with chats and projects
detail: The classic layout opens a sidebar for chat history (newest first) and Projects; the new layout uses Home and Explore tabs. Some Pro users start in classic and can flip on a New ChatGPT design setting.

feature: Search chats including archived; locked chats via Projects
detail: Sidebar search covers titles and messages and includes archived chats; locked chats are hidden from history and search and open through Projects > Locked chats. History syncs across devices.

feature: Delete a conversation from the more menu
detail: The three-dot menu has Delete with a confirmation; deleted chats cannot be restored.

feature: Haptic feedback toggle
detail: General setting that turns haptics on or off, shown only on devices that support the effects.

feature: Official apps: iPhone, iPad, Android, Apple Vision Pro
detail: Downloaded from the App Store (developer OpenAI OpCo, LLC) or Google Play (publisher OpenAI); also on Apple Vision Pro. One account and subscription work on all devices.

feature: Restore Apple purchases in Settings
detail: The iOS Settings screen (or Account) offers Restore purchases for the Apple account that bought the plan.

feature: Android text selection; iPad drag response to other apps
detail: Android: touch and hold to select text, with Copy, Read aloud and Share via buttons below responses. iPad: press and drag a response into apps like Notes.

feature: Mobile links: precise location, voice dictation, email change
detail: Mobile Settings point to Data controls, export, email change, precise location sharing for search, voice dictation and ChatGPT Voice.

feature: Billing renews on subscribe date; invoice dates not changeable
detail: Monthly plans renew on the day of the month subscribed and the invoice date cannot be altered. On Business, assigning an already-paid unused seat costs nothing; adding paid seats can prorate.

feature: Enterprise billing set by agreement; token-based USD option
detail: Enterprise periods and invoice schedule follow the contract; eligible agreements can bill token usage in USD monthly in arrears. ChatGPT workspace billing stays separate from API billing.

feature: CAPTCHA puzzles to limit bots
detail: Game-like CAPTCHAs may appear occasionally on web, iOS and Android; constant ones suggest a VPN or extension issue and the puzzle request ID can be sent to support.

feature: ChatGPT Enterprise plan: privacy, admin, SSO, SCIM, usage insights
detail: Organization-level managed plan with default no-training, centralized member management, domain verification, SSO, SCIM, usage insights, longer context, advanced data analysis and customization. Bought through sales only.

feature: Standard ChatGPT seats include GPTs, Projects, Apps, Company Knowledge, Agent
detail: Standard seats cover ChatGPT plus those features and Codex; on credit-based agreements, usage past included limits draws on purchased workspace credits.

feature: Codex-only seat for Enterprise (usage-based, credits)
detail: Introduced April 2026: a seat with Codex access but no ChatGPT, no fixed monthly fee, billed through workspace credits; Codex pricing moved to credits per million tokens from April 23. Users on it see a not-available message in ChatGPT.

feature: Token-based Enterprise billing not offered for Edu or Healthcare
detail: USD token billing is limited to eligible Enterprise agreements such as Financial Services; Edu and Healthcare do not get it.

feature: Personal-workspace merge or export-and-deactivate, 7-day grace
detail: Orgs with a verified domain can require members to merge personal data (permanent, Sites excluded, GPTs not auto-shared) or export and deactivate within 7 days; admins cannot turn this off. Eligible web-billed Plus/Pro may be cancelled and refunded in the flow.

feature: Workspace switcher in profile menu
detail: Users with several workspaces pick one from the profile menu; each has separate conversations, GPTs, files and settings, and switching copies nothing.

feature: Workspace membership separate from API organization membership
detail: Enterprise workspace access and API Platform organization access are managed independently; a user may hold either or both. Seat types are set by owners and admins only.

feature: Built-in workspace roles: Member, Analytics viewer, Admin, Owner
detail: Four roles with a permission matrix: all can chat and create GPTs; analytics viewers see workspace analytics; admins invite members, manage groups and apps; only owners change roles, invite admins/owners, see invoices, manage identity, settings and GPT settings.

feature: Group manager designation for delegated group admin
detail: An owner or admin can mark a member as group manager for selected group tasks without changing their role or seat; only owners toggle Edit permissions on assigned roles.

feature: Invite members by email, CSV (1,000 rows) or SCIM
detail: Workspace settings > Members > Add lets owners and admins invite by email or CSV with email, role and seat type columns; bulk progress shows in notifications. Blank or invalid role becomes Member; default seat type set under Identity and Access and inherited by SCIM users.

feature: External member SSO exemption
detail: For members whose email domain is not verified, an owner can set Allow login without SSO or Follow workspace SSO policy in the Admin Console; deactivation keeps it, removal clears it.

feature: Review employees with personal workspaces and invite them
