detail: Feb-Apr 2024: ChatGPT remembers across chats; users say remember or forget in chat or via settings, view what it remembers, and turn it off.

feature: ChatGPT Team plan with shared workspace and admin tools
detail: Jan 10, 2024: collaborative workspace for teams with admin management and no training on business data; later renamed Business.

feature: GPT Store and custom GPTs (planned retirement)
detail: Nov 2023-Jan 2024: build GPTs from instructions, knowledge and skills, share them and browse the store at chatgpt.com/gpts; Plus and Enterprise could create.

feature: Voice conversations on mobile (headphones icon)
detail: Sep-Nov 2023: speak with ChatGPT using the headphones icon with a choice of voices; opened to all free users Nov 21, 2023.

feature: Image input with drawing tool on mobile
detail: Sep 25, 2023: attach photos and discuss them; the mobile drawing tool highlights part of an image.

feature: Interface languages alpha: nine languages (2023)
detail: Sep 11, 2023: opt-in web UI languages Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), French, German, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish via a browser-language banner.

feature: ChatGPT Enterprise launch (Aug 2023)
detail: Aug 28, 2023: enterprise security and privacy, unlimited higher-speed (model name), longer context, advanced data analysis and customization.

feature: Prompt examples, suggested replies, multi-file upload, keyboard shortcuts
detail: Aug 3, 2023: starter examples on new chats, follow-up suggestions, multiple file analysis, long login sessions, Cmd/Ctrl+/ lists shortcuts and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+; copies last code block.

feature: Android app launch (Jul 2023)
detail: Jul 25, 2023: Google Play release starting in US, India, Bangladesh, Brazil, then more countries.

feature: Code Interpreter beta (Python with uploads)
detail: Jul 2023: run code on uploaded files to analyze data, chart, edit files and do math; later became advanced data analysis.

feature: Disable chat history on iOS; 30-day retention
detail: May 2023: chats with history off are not used for training, do not sync across devices and are stored 30 days; setting does not sync across browsers or devices.

feature: Shared links origin: view or copy conversation to continue
detail: May 24, 2023: recipients can view a shared conversation or copy it into their own chats to continue.

feature: Browsing with Bing (2023 beta, now general browsing)
detail: Sep-Oct 2023: Plus and Enterprise browse the web with source links, no beta toggle needed after Oct 17, 2023.

feature: Plugins beta and continue generating past token limit (2023)
detail: Mar-May 2023: experimental third-party plugins, browsing and code interpreter via a beta panel; later a continue generating option counted against allowance.

feature: Stop generating button and conversation history (Dec 2022-Jan 2023)
detail: Early releases added stop generating, saved conversation history with rename and delete, and an experimental daily message cap.

feature: ChatGPT Plus launch (Feb 2023) with Turbo choice; international sales
detail: Feb 2023: Plus subscribers chose between Default and a faster Turbo version and Plus became purchasable internationally; (model name) added Mar 2023 with demand-based caps (later 40 per 3 hours).

feature: Minimum age: 13, parental consent 13 to 18
detail: ChatGPT is not meant for under-13s; 13 to 18 need parent or guardian permission. For under-13 classroom use an adult must conduct the interaction.

feature: Shared chats as evidence of student work
detail: OpenAI recommends educators ask students to share ChatGPT conversation links to show work and accountability, rather than relying on AI detectors; OpenAI says detectors are unreliable and ChatGPT cannot tell if text is AI-written.

feature: Known limits: bias, hallucination, knowledge cutoff
detail: Documented limitations: Western skew, best in English, can reinforce user bias, may hallucinate quotes or sources, has a knowledge cutoff, and may be blocked by paywalls or robots.txt.

feature: Accuracy tools by plan: search, data analysis, deep research
detail: Search, code interpreter/data analysis and deep research are the tools ChatGPT uses to improve accuracy; availability depends on plan. Search and deep research icons in the input bar show whether they are active.

feature: Educator starter prompts and OpenAI Academy
detail: Wharton-authored prompt templates for lesson planning, explanations, student-teaches-AI and tutoring; OpenAI Academy is a free learning hub. Assessment decisions require a human in the loop per usage policy.

feature: Language setting follows browser or device
detail: ChatGPT auto-detects browser or device language for supported languages; logged-in users can override it.

feature: Change language on web
detail: Profile icon, Settings, General, Language drop-down. Only available when logged in.

feature: Change language on mobile app
detail: Sidebar, profile icon at bottom, App section, Language, then pick from drop-down.

feature: Supported interface languages (about 60)
detail: Lists roughly 60 languages from Albanian and Amharic through Vietnamese, including Arabic, Chinese, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Swahili, Urdu and many others.

feature: Free-trial invite referral codes
detail: Eligible subscribers may get a limited number of referral codes or links to give friends a free time-limited trial (for example 3 months of Plus). Eligibility, count, duration and expiry are set per campaign by OpenAI.

feature: Promo redemption rules
detail: Invitees sign in or sign up, review and accept terms; some promos need a payment method. Codes are single-use, not stackable, usually only for free-plan users, may start immediately or at next renewal for existing subscribers.

feature: Trial end: renewal and cancellation
detail: Some promos end on expiry, others renew as paid; cancel at least 24 hours before renewal via chatgpt.com, Apple or Google Play depending on where subscribed.

feature: Image inputs
detail: All models accept images on Free and paid plans, subject to plan limits. Add via the plus button (Add photos & files), drag-drop or paste. Mobile web allows attaching photos before sign-in.

feature: Image input formats and size
detail: PNG, JPEG and non-animated GIF, up to 20MB per image; count per conversation depends on image size and accompanying text.

feature: Video file attachments
detail: Videos can be attached via supported upload methods, even on Free; analysis may be incomplete and may not interpret audio. Counts toward file-upload limits; live camera and screen share in Voice are separate.

feature: Image input limitations
detail: Weak on medical scans, non-Latin text, rotated text, varied line styles in graphs, precise spatial tasks, panoramic or fisheye images; ignores metadata, resizes images, gives approximate counts.

feature: Enterprise Workspace settings hub
detail: Admin surface (profile icon, Workspace settings) covering General, Members, Groups, Permissions and roles, Models, Billing, GPTs, Apps, Analytics, Identity and access. Visible to all roles; owners and admins control workspace-wide settings.

feature: Workspace name and image (owner only)
detail: Only owners can edit the workspace name and image, which apply to all members.

feature: Workspace AI policy modal
detail: Owners and admins can set organization AI policy text that is shown to users every 30 days and whenever it is updated.

feature: Account switching toggle for Enterprise
detail: Lets members stay signed in to separate accounts (personal and work) with separate chats, files, memory and subscriptions; owners can enable or block it for the workspace in Admin Console. Works on web, iOS and Android.

feature: Groups and delegated group managers
detail: Create/delete groups and manage membership; owners and admins may delegate selected group tasks to group managers without granting billing, identity or seat control. Useful with role-based access control.

feature: Permissions and roles feature controls
detail: Per-role control of available models, GPT creation and sharing, canvas, projects, shared and improved memory, link sharing, and member/group list visibility; Work Local and Work Cloud access are separate.

feature: Admin control: shared memory and improved memory
detail: Roles get Use shared memory with a nested Use improved memory setting. Improved memory is off by default in Healthcare and Regulated Workspace and is not covered by the BAA, so PHI must not be entered.

feature: Admin control: event-triggered scheduled tasks
detail: Permission under Work, off by default in Enterprise, Edu and Healthcare, needed for tasks that react to events; members also need Work and connected-app access. Not BAA covered.

feature: Admin control: share chats and scheduled tasks in workspace
detail: When off, members cannot create shared task links or schedule from shared links. Task links open only for same-workspace members and carry title, instructions, schedule and time zone, not creator name, history, memory or credentials.

feature: Admin default model and reasoning level
detail: Separate starting defaults for Chat and for Work & Codex, either an admin-chosen model/reasoning or the user's last choice; Work & Codex also has speed and Fast Mode availability and role-specific overrides.

feature: Admin GPT management
detail: Review ownership, transfer ownership, delete GPTs and manage GPT actions created in the workspace.

feature: Admin apps and plugins management
detail: Enable or disable apps org-wide, assign access to members or roles, enable sync for supported apps, and create and deploy custom MCP apps; plugin administration lives in Admin Console.

feature: Workspace analytics
detail: Shows daily and weekly active users, messages per user, total messages, total seats and GPT usage.

feature: Identity and access: login, provisioning, IP allowlist
detail: Manage login configuration, provisioning (SCIM), identity management and IP allowlists; SCIM-provisioned users take the workspace default seat type.

feature: Age verification where legally required
detail: Users in some locations must verify age; in Italy it uses Persona (live selfie and/or government ID). Missing a deadline can restrict access; OpenAI gets only age-related result, not the ID or selfie.

feature: Age verification to remove teen experience
detail: Users 18 or over placed in the ChatGPT for Teens experience by mistake can verify age to remove protections; a failed check leaves protections in place.

feature: Recover account deactivated for missed age check
detail: Via Verify your age on the deactivation screen or a Stripe recheck without signing in, using the account's email (including Apple private relay); restores access without changing teen-experience status.

feature: Data analysis supported files
detail: Analyzes spreadsheets (xls, xlsx, csv), PDFs, and json, xml, yaml, txt, md; can attach from Google Drive, OneDrive and SharePoint where plugins are available. Types vary by model, plan and workspace.

feature: Python data analysis environment
detail: Writes and runs Python in a stateful Jupyter-style sandbox with no external web or API access; shows pandas DataFrames as interactive tables; users can review code and outputs.

feature: Interactive charts
detail: Bar, line, pie and scatter charts can be toggled between static image and interactive via Switch to interactive chart or Switch to static chart; other chart types stay static.

feature: Compromised account response
detail: Changing password logs out all sessions within 30 minutes; Microsoft or Google sign-in users must reset that provider's password; an Unauthorized Activity web form handles compromised account or key reports.

feature: Business plan seat pricing
detail: Standard seats $25 per user monthly or $20 annually; Premium seats $125 monthly or $100 annually (USD, varies by country). A workspace can start with one paid seat and mix seat types.

feature: Standard vs Premium Business seats
detail: Both include ChatGPT, Work and Codex; Premium has higher included usage and no five-hour usage limit. Overage can draw from workspace credits under spend controls.

feature: ChatGPT Team renamed ChatGPT Business
detail: Rename took effect 29 Aug 2025 with no change to features, pricing or contracts; existing Team workspaces became Business.

feature: Business seat cap of 200
detail: From 24 Aug 2026 new Business subscriptions are capped at 200 paid Standard and Premium seats combined; larger needs go to Enterprise. Older workspaces keep their previous cap.

feature: Seat billing rules
detail: Owners add seats with immediate prorated charge; reductions apply next cycle; swapping paid seats is free; removing a member does not lower the billed seat count; unused seats are not normally refundable.

feature: Legacy Codex seat type
detail: New Business workspaces since 24 June 2026 cannot add Codex-only seats; older workspaces that added them keep managing them. They cannot be swapped with Standard or Premium.

feature: Business available on iPhone and Android
detail: ChatGPT Business works on iOS and Android; workspaces switch from the sidebar on mobile and profile menu on web.

feature: Business data not used for training
detail: Business is under Business Terms and enterprise privacy commitments; workspace data is not used to train models. API credits and limits do not transfer to Business.

feature: Merge personal workspace into Business
detail: Joining Business lets users keep the personal workspace or merge it; merge copies supported content (no per-item choice), deactivates the personal workspace, has no undo, and Business admins do not see private chats.

feature: Business: no self-serve export, no Business-to-Business merge
detail: Self-service data export is unavailable in Business workspaces and two Business workspaces cannot be merged; upgrade to Enterprise goes through Sales.

feature: Admins cannot see members' private chats
detail: Each member has their own chat and Codex history and chooses what to share; admins and owners cannot see all private chats by default.

feature: Business roles: Owner, Admin, Analytics Viewer, Member
detail: Owners have full control including billing and identity; admins handle users and routine tasks and spend controls; analytics viewers view analytics; members use ChatGPT and create GPTs. Seat type is independent of role.

feature: Invite members by email or CSV
detail: Owners choose role and seat per invite; admins and members invite Members at the default seat. CSV columns are email, role, seat type. Invites do not reserve seats; invitees can Request to join if none is free.

feature: Pending invites and join requests
detail: Admins and owners cancel or resend invitations; admins can reject requests but only owners approve them or change a pending role or seat.

feature: Request a Premium seat
detail: Standard-seat members can request an upgrade; owner assigns an unused Premium seat or buys one before approving.

feature: Default seat type for new members
detail: Owners set the default seat type under Billing, Seat preferences; Standard unless the workspace has only Premium.

feature: External member SSO exemption
detail: Owners can let a member whose email domain is not verified sign in without SSO, or follow the workspace SSO policy, per member in Admin Console.

feature: Remove member or leave workspace
detail: Owners remove any member, admins only lower roles. Members can leave active or deactivated workspaces; the last owner cannot leave. Leaving does not move data to a personal workspace.

feature: Workspace discovery and auto-join
detail: People with a verified company email can find the workspace and request to join; owners may auto-accept. On by default in Business, off in Enterprise/Edu; auto-join may buy a seat.

feature: Workspace name and discoverable name
detail: Owners edit the workspace name (pencil icon) and a separate discoverable name used in join flow.

feature: Open admin console from Codex web
detail: Admins in Codex can open Workspace settings and return with Back to Codex.

feature: Custom GPTs being retired in favor of plugins
detail: Personal accounts (Free, Go, Plus, Pro) cannot create or publish new GPTs; Enterprise creation ended 26 Oct 2026 (FedRAMP excepted); standard retirement 11 Dec 2026, FedRAMP or deferred 28 Feb 2027; migrated GPTs become read-only.

feature: GPT builder: conversational or configuration
detail: Create from Explore GPTs: describe the GPT conversationally or edit fields directly. Web only; mobile apps can use GPTs but not create them.

feature: GPT fields: name, description, starters, instructions
detail: User-facing name, description and conversation starters plus instructions applied to every conversation.

feature: GPT knowledge files
detail: Up to 20 files per GPT, each up to 512 MB; some types need Code Interpreter & Data Analysis enabled.

feature: GPT recommended model
detail: Builder can suggest a model for new chats; a similar model is chosen if unavailable and users can switch.

feature: GPT capabilities, apps and actions
detail: Toggle web search, image generation, canvas, code interpreter and data analysis, apps; Actions call user-defined external APIs. A GPT can use apps or actions, not both.

feature: GPT preview, drafts and version history
detail: Built-in Preview for testing, autosaved drafts, Update to publish edits, and version history to review and restore (restoring actions may require re-authentication).

feature: Edit, copy link, duplicate, delete a GPT
detail: My GPTs lists owned GPTs; menu offers Edit GPT, copy link, version history, delete; duplicate only if still eligible to create.

feature: Use GPTs from Explore GPTs or links
detail: All signed-in users can use public, shared or workspace GPTs via Explore GPTs or direct link; public pages are viewable signed out.

feature: @-mention a GPT in a conversation
detail: Type @ on web to hand the next message to a GPT while keeping context; not available in iOS or Android apps.

feature: GPTs ignore memory and custom instructions
detail: GPT chats start fresh without saved memory, custom instructions or past conversations; builders cannot view user conversations.

feature: GPT data use and external service warning
detail: Training use depends on plan (Business, Enterprise, Edu off by default; consumer opt-out). Inputs may go to third-party apps or APIs, sometimes after user approval.

feature: Enterprise GPT governance via RBAC
detail: Roles control who creates or edits GPTs, sharing level (invite-only, workspace, broader), and third-party GPT access (all, approved only, none).

feature: GPT apps and action-domain restrictions
detail: Workspace-level toggle for apps in GPTs; owners restrict GPT actions to allowed domains (none listed means none allowed; parent domain covers subdomains).

feature: GPT permission levels and ownership continuity
detail: Collaborators get Can chat, Can view settings or Can edit; if an owner is removed, ownership goes to a workspace owner and is marked unassigned, restorable if the creator rejoins.

feature: SCIM group discoverability for sharing
detail: Owners control whether SCIM-managed groups appear when sharing GPTs or projects; GPT chats are in the Compliance Platform and analytics has a GPT section.

feature: File uploads: documents, sheets, slides
detail: Upload docs, spreadsheets, presentations, text and images on Free and paid plans on web and mobile, subject to limits; includes DOCX, PDF, TXT, MD, HTML, JSON, XLSX, CSV, PPTX, ODS and more. .gdoc must be exported.

feature: Audio upload and transcription
detail: Paid plans and Enterprise can attach audio (WAV, MP3, OGG, FLAC, AAC, M4A etc.) up to 512 MB; Chat transcription via (model name) at Instant handles up to 6 minutes. Not on Free, and not yet in Work or Codex.

feature: Upload limits: size, rate, storage
detail: 512 MB per document, 2M tokens per text file, about 50 MB for spreadsheets, 20 MB per image; 80 uploads per 3 hours (Free 3 per day); storage 25 GB per user and 100 GB per organization.

feature: Project file limits by plan
detail: Files per project: Free 5, Go and Plus 25, Edu, Pro, Business, Enterprise 40.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Library or Space saved files and storage
detail: Settings, Storage shows saved-file usage; saved files live in Library (with Recently deleted, restore, Delete forever) or Space, independent of chat deletion and follow workspace retention in Enterprise.

feature: PDF image reading
detail: ChatGPT reads text and images (charts, diagrams) in PDFs attached directly to a chat; GPT knowledge and project files may not include embedded images.

feature: Memory controls in Settings, Personalization
detail: Memory can draw on past chats, saved memories, custom instructions, Library files and connected apps like Gmail. Controls include Memory, Reference saved memories, Reference chat history, Memory summary; vary by plan, region and platform.

feature: Memory summary and Don't mention this again
detail: View and correct a high-level summary by editing or highlighting text; Don't mention this again reduces use without deleting the source; Delete and turn off memory clears it.

feature: Memory Sources under responses
detail: Responses may show sources (past chat, saved memory, instruction, file, email) that personalized them, with options to open, correct, delete or mark relevance; not included in shared links.

feature: Reference chat history and saved memories
detail: Chat-history memory evolves automatically; turning it off schedules deletion within 30 days. Saved memories are explicit, stored separately, can be searched, sorted, prioritized, with version history on some plans; deleted-memory logs kept up to 30 days.

feature: Improved memory vs legacy saved memories
detail: Settings, Personalization, Memory lets users switch between improved memory (broader updating summary) and the legacy explicit list; switching keeps chats.

feature: Project-only memory and locked chats
detail: Project-only memory limits references to chats inside the project; locked chats can read regular Memory but new locked messages do not personalize regular chats.

feature: Temporary chat personalization choice
detail: Before starting, pick whether the temporary chat uses memories, custom instructions and plugins (Unpersonalized opts out); fixed after start; no memories are created; saving converts to regular chat.

feature: Dot memory independent of ChatGPT Memory
detail: A dot keeps its own memory even if ChatGPT Memory is off; with Memory off it stops receiving new memories from chats and files, and in Work and Codex cloud it can reference only chats it started.

feature: Memory personalizes web search queries
detail: With Memory on, details like location or diet can refine search queries; disconnecting an app stops future access but keeps past chats.

feature: Cookie preferences by site
detail: Region-dependent cookie choices via Cookie Preferences in footer of chatgpt.com and help.openai.com, Manage Cookies on openai.com, and Manage cookies in profile menu or logged-out menu on platform.

feature: ID verification requests
detail: OpenAI may ask for a government ID for compliance and security eligibility; no exceptions are granted.

feature: Business payment methods and wallet
detail: Business accepts credit and debit cards; owners can see Wallet balance and redeem gift cards into the workspace wallet, which pays part of a charge. No invoice, ACH, wire, PO or net terms on self-serve.

feature: Business billing owner tools
detail: Owners review invoices, next charge and seat counts, update card and billing info, change monthly/annual cadence at renewal (Manage license, Billing schedule), enter Tax ID for VAT exemption, add credits or auto top-up, cancel plan.

feature: Business seat add, reduce, upgrade, downgrade, swap
detail: Added seats charge prorated at once; reductions at next cycle and not below occupied seats; Standard to Premium upgrade pays the difference; Premium to Standard downgrade may be pending until renewal and can be cancelled under Pending requests; swaps cost nothing.

feature: Business workspace deactivation and reactivation
detail: Cancellation or failed payment can deactivate a workspace; data is kept and only an owner can reactivate via profile menu with 1 paid seat minimum. A new workspace does not inherit the old one's data.

feature: Business flexible-pricing workspace credits
detail: Standard and Premium seats include baseline usage; workspace credits can be bought for usage beyond included limits, with spend controls for admins and owners.

feature: Business Standard seat contents
detail: Standard seats include ChatGPT, Work and Codex plus GPTs, Projects, Apps, Company Knowledge, ChatGPT Agent and Deep Research with baseline limits.

feature: Business excludes sales-led features
detail: API usage, invoicing, purchase orders, bank transfer, Zero Data Retention and BAAs require a contracted offering rather than self-serve Business.

feature: Business shared chat links within workspace
detail: Members create unique links to a conversation viewable only by workspace members; outsiders are redirected with no access; continuing a shared chat creates a private copy. Business cannot disable shared links (Enterprise can).

feature: Manage and delete shared links
detail: Settings, Data controls, Shared links, Manage, then Delete shared link; task links also deletable from the Share task dialog without removing the task.

feature: Share scheduled tasks in Business
detail: Eligible tasks can be shared with workspace members; link carries title, instructions, schedule and time zone only, and each recipient schedules their own copy.

feature: Event-triggered tasks via Gmail, Slack, GitHub
detail: Business members create webhook-style tasks in Work from supported Gmail, Slack and GitHub connections using their own app access; Slack tasks need @ChatGPT added to each monitored channel.

feature: Business data export by owner only
detail: Members cannot export their Business data; owners can use Export data per member on the Members page if available. Business data is encrypted and excluded from training.

feature: GPT sharing levels
detail: Invite-only, anyone at workspace with link, whole workspace, anyone with link, or GPT Store, with permissions Can chat, Can view settings, Can edit; direct sharing emails recipients, capped at 100 users or groups.

feature: GPT Store publishing and builder profile
detail: Public publishing needs category, builder profile with verified domain or social, policy checks, and a Privacy Policy URL on any public action; blocked GPTs may be appealed, during which they cannot be edited or shared.

feature: Appeal for GPT blocked from sharing
detail: Appeal via email link or openai.com form; GPT usable privately but not editable or shareable while pending; outcome by email; does not restore personal-account creation.

feature: Merge personal workspace into Business or Enterprise
detail: Settings, Data Controls, Merge data from your personal workspace, on web. Transfers supported chats, Library files, GPTs, projects, automations, memory, personalization, skills, plugins, connected apps and Sites; excludes dots, pages, spaces, others' GPTs and projects.

feature: Enterprise and Edu personal-workspace migration grace period
detail: With a verified domain, users get 7 days from being added to migrate or export and deactivate personal workspace before accessing the org workspace; admins cannot disable it.

feature: Personal subscription auto-cancelled on merge
detail: Merging into Business cancels an active personal subscription with prorated refund except app-store subscriptions; personal wallet funds and credits do not transfer.

feature: Delete a chat
detail: Sidebar menu or press-and-hold on mobile, Delete; removed from view at once and purged within 30 days, not restorable even by Support.

feature: Archive and unarchive chats
detail: Archive removes from sidebar without confirmation and stays searchable; manage under Settings, Data controls, Archived chats, with Unarchive or Delete. Archiving a scheduled-task results chat can pause the task.

feature: Archive all or delete all chats
detail: Settings, Data controls offers Archive all chats and Delete all chats including project chats; deleting all cannot be undone.

feature: Locked chats access
detail: Locked chats are found under Projects then Locked chats, opened with account PIN or device authentication.

feature: Verify domain for identity and SSO
detail: Global admin adds a domain in Admin Console and publishes a DNS TXT record; domain eligibility per workspace or API orgs; subdomains verified separately; verification does not enable SSO, SCIM or domain claiming.

feature: Restrict app connections to verified-domain workspaces
detail: Enterprise can ask Support to block new app connections with company email from personal or other workspaces; existing connections stay.

feature: Provenance signals on generated content
detail: Images carry C2PA Content Credentials plus SynthID watermark, audio SynthID, exported PDFs C2PA; ChatGPT text in the EU is watermarked (textGrain) per the EU AI Act. Video via Sora is discontinued.

feature: openai.com/verify provenance checker
detail: Upload an image, audio or PDF to check for OpenAI provenance signals; free, not stored or trained on; a Content Provenance API and a text detector (research orgs only) also exist.

feature: Temporary chat start and personalization choice
detail: New chat, Temporary, then choose Personalized or Unpersonalized before first message; locked after start. Account and workspace restrictions override.

feature: Temporary chat: no history, no training, 30-day safety copy
detail: Not saved to history, not used for model improvement while temporary, no memories created; a copy may be kept up to 30 days for safety. Works with GPTs.

feature: Save a temporary chat
detail: Saving turns it into a regular chat that follows personalization and model-improvement settings and may save eligible files to Library or Space.

feature: Compliance API access to temporary chats
detail: Eligible Enterprise customers can read temporary chats via the Compliance API for 30 days regardless of custom retention.

feature: Automated moderation actions
detail: ChatGPT may warn, decline a prompt, block sharing, end a conversation over serious violence concerns, temporarily suspend an account (24 or 48 hours for some cases), and OpenAI may permanently close accounts; ended chats vanish from history.

feature: Reporting content and GPTs
detail: Users can report problematic content in ChatGPT, in shared links and for GPTs; reports go to automated systems and trained reviewers.

feature: Deleted or deactivated account errors
detail: Deleted accounts cannot be reactivated; same email can be reused after 30 days if fully deleted; deactivated accounts need the recovery in the email, such as identity or age verification.

feature: New account after deletion
detail: Wait 30 days to reuse the email or use another address or alias; new account has no old chats, files or memories; deleting cancels direct subscriptions but not App Store or Google Play ones.

feature: Add password or change email without deleting
detail: Settings, Security and login lets eligible accounts add a password; email can be changed in place.

feature: EU DSA contact and reporting
detail: EU users contact support via the Help Center chat bubble or phone, and use an illegal content reporting form; OpenAI publishes monthly EU active recipients for ChatGPT search (about 185.6 million to Sept 2026).

feature: Business sign-up flow
detail: Sign in on the Business signup page, choose Business, pick seats, billing frequency (monthly or annual) and payment, then invite teammates; signer becomes owner; Premium seats are chosen explicitly.

feature: Phone verification: Codex desktop and API key
detail: Not required for ChatGPT; may be requested for Codex in the desktop app and mandatory for first API key. SMS or WhatsApp only (WhatsApp in 12 countries); no landlines, VoIP or Google Voice.

feature: Phone number reuse limit of 3 accounts
detail: A number can verify first API key for at most 3 accounts; deleted consumer accounts free the number after 30 days; phone-only signup beta in 13 countries.

feature: Chat retention rules
detail: Regular and archived chats stay until deleted or workspace policy removes them; deletion purges within 30 days; temporary chats may be kept 30 days for safety; saved Library or Space files persist separately.

feature: GPT and project file retention
detail: GPT knowledge files persist until the GPT is deleted; project files until the project or file is deleted; purge within 30 days. Enterprise transient files may expire after 48 hours; Library files appear in Compliance API.

feature: Update billing information and Tax ID
detail: Individual: Settings, Billing, Edit; Business owners: Workspace settings, Billing, Settings; changes affect only future invoices, reissue by Support not guaranteed.

feature: ChatGPT billing separate from API
detail: ChatGPT (Free, Go, Plus, Pro) manages subscription under Settings, Billing; subscriptions via web, App Store or Google Play bill separately; API credits are tied to an API org and not ChatGPT.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu

feature: Slow response troubleshooting
detail: Advice: clear cache, check status page, try other browser or extensions off, incognito, other network or VPN, hard refresh, switch model, and gather HAR file and request IDs for Support.

feature: Recover account after missed age check
detail: Verify via the reactivation link or Verify your age screen (Italy via Stripe); adults verify themselves, 13 to 17 need a parent or guardian; processing may take days.

feature: Enterprise sales and billing channel
detail: Enterprise is bought via a sales form only; self-serve Business and Pro accept cards, gift cards and wallet balance but no invoice, PO or bank transfer. Researcher Access Program offers subsidized access.

feature: Tenants, Admin Console and access layers
detail: An OpenAI account signs in; a tenant holds shared identity settings; ChatGPT workspaces, API orgs and Ads accounts have separate access. Admin Console serves Enterprise, Edu, Teachers district tenants and Ads; Business admins use in-ChatGPT settings.

feature: SSO, SCIM and auto account creation by plan
detail: Business supports SSO, invitations and optional auto account creation but not SCIM; Enterprise and Edu add directory sync, group-to-product assignment and API org assignment; ChatGPT for Teachers K-12 districts get tenant SCIM without auto account creation.

feature: Enterprise and Edu groups and custom roles
detail: Owners and admins create manual groups (name, description, members) to share GPTs, projects and apps and to assign custom roles; SCIM groups are managed in the identity provider; up to 10,000 groups, members cannot self-join.

feature: Group manager delegation
detail: Enterprise owners and admins can name group managers and delegate: view group analytics, manage spend controls, manage model access and defaults, and (owner only) edit permissions of assigned custom roles. Cannot create groups or change roles.

feature: Moving conversations between personal accounts
detail: Accounts cannot be merged; users can export from a personal (or Edu with admin enable) account and upload conversations.json into a new chat in another account as reference only, not as sidebar history; Business and Enterprise cannot export.

feature: Use ChatGPT without an account
detail: chatgpt.com lets signed-out users chat for free in supported countries, one conversation at a time, history kept only in that browser session; sign-up unlocks history, export, sharing and custom instructions. Access can vary by network.

feature: Improve the model for everyone toggle
detail: Under Settings, Data controls; the signed-out setting is browser-local and must be rechecked after clearing data or switching browser.

feature: Personal vs work account guidance
detail: Use a personally owned email for personal use; a Personal workspace under a work email stays tied to employer, and merging into Enterprise is permanent.

feature: Unsupported countries and payment methods
detail: Using ChatGPT from an unsupported country or paying from an unsupported country can block or suspend accounts; errors after travel may clear with cache reset or incognito.

feature: Phone number cannot be changed; phone-only signup
detail: Changing an account's phone number is unsupported; phone-only signup (no email) is rolling out slowly in the US and India.

feature: Interactive table view for uploaded data
detail: Uploaded data opens as an interactive, expandable table; select rows, columns or cells (Ctrl or Cmd for multiple) to ask about them, edit or add columns, and download results as CSV.

feature: Chart types and editing
detail: Supports line, bar, pie, histogram, scatter, box, heat map, area, radar, treemap, bubble and waterfall charts; only bar, pie, scatter and line are interactive; download PNG, expand, recolor by hex, toggle interactivity.

feature: Data cleaning, aggregation, merging and statistics
detail: Detects missing values, outliers, duplicates and wrong types; computes sums, medians, std dev; merges datasets by shared keys; runs t-tests, ANOVA, regression, correlation and time-series such as ARIMA.

feature: Web search availability and invocation
detail: Available to signed-out users and Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, Edu on web, desktop and mobile within usage limits. Auto-triggered, or via View all tools, Search, or / in composer; regenerate with Search the web.

feature: Citations, Sources panel and maps
detail: Answers can include inline citations with hover preview on desktop web, a Sources list, image sources, and maps on iOS and Android.

feature: Search query rewriting and privacy
detail: ChatGPT rewrites prompts into queries sent to search partners (for example Microsoft, Shopify) without sharing IP or account info; memory may inform query rewriting.

feature: Location sharing controls
detail: Approximate location from IP is used; precise device location is optional and off by default, managed in Settings, Data controls, Location, with separate precise-location toggle on iOS and Android; parents can disable it for teens.

feature: Restaurant reservation search
detail: Finds restaurants and times via OpenTable (global), Resy (US) and Yelp (US, Canada) for eligible consumer plans on (model name) Sol or Luna; not in Work, Business, Enterprise, Edu or voice. May fill name and email with permission; reservations are not saved in ChatGPT.

feature: Web search during voice conversations
detail: Voice chats can search the web under plan limits; restaurant reservation search is unavailable in voice.

feature: ChatGPT search Chrome extension
detail: Install to make ChatGPT Chrome's default search engine from the address bar; prefix with !g to send a query to Google.

feature: Site inclusion via OAI-Searchbot
detail: Websites become eligible for ChatGPT search by allowing OAI-Searchbot and its published IPs; placement is not guaranteed.

feature: Information shared with apps permissions
detail: Settings, Data controls, Information shared with apps lets users review name and email sharing permissions granted to reservation partners.

feature: Log out of all devices
detail: Settings, Security, Log out all ends the current session immediately and other ChatGPT sessions within 30 minutes; API Platform has the same control under profile Security.

feature: Network allowlist and WebSocket requirements
detail: IT should allowlist OpenAI domains and allow secure WebSocket traffic on port 443 to ws.chatgpt.com (updates) and chatgpt.com (Codex streaming); TLS inspection can break uploads and streaming.

feature: Voice firewall requirements
detail: ChatGPT Voice uses UDP port 3478 to published IP ranges, with TCP 443 as fallback.

feature: iOS and macOS network error troubleshooting
detail: iOS unusual-activity error: relog, reinstall, disable VPN, change DNS, test Apple app attest URL; macOS SSL errors from inspection: disable inspection, update app, use web as workaround; Cloudflare Zero Trust guidance exists.

feature: Core capabilities overview
detail: Chat, summarizing, translation, search, deep research, image input and generation with natural-language edits, file and audio uploads, data analysis, voice mode, memory, projects, scheduled tasks, custom GPTs and GPT Store.

feature: Compliance Platform for Enterprise and Edu
detail: Logs and metadata (conversation messages, audit, authentication, app logs) via workspace-scoped Admin keys for eDiscovery, DLP and SIEM tools; 30-day log retention; locked chat messages are included; Codex policy changes audited.

feature: Compliance partner integrations
detail: Prebuilt integrations with providers such as Microsoft Purview, CrowdStrike, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Relativity, Smarsh and Cisco Identity Intelligence; old stateful conversation route removed Jun 5, 2026.

feature: New desktop app: Chat, Work and Codex; ChatGPT Classic
detail: Since July 9 the new desktop app combines Chat, Work and Codex on macOS and Windows; the earlier macOS app became ChatGPT Classic and remains supported. macOS 14 or newer, Apple Silicon or Intel; download at chatgpt.com/download.

feature: macOS Chat Bar with Option+Space
detail: Global shortcut (default Option+Space, changeable in Settings) or menu bar icon opens a draggable Chat Bar to ask questions, attach files, take screenshot or photo, or request CSV analysis.

feature: macOS screenshot tool
detail: Plus menu, Take Screenshot lists open windows, or type an app name in launcher; requires screen and audio recording permission in System Settings.

feature: macOS photo and file upload, Take Photo
detail: Plus menu uploads from photo library or file system and Take Photo uses the webcam; needs photo library and camera permissions.

feature: macOS Temporary Chat toggle
detail: Click model name, switch on Temporary Chat; window darkens with a banner; no memories or history, not used for training, custom instructions still apply.

feature: macOS app data handling matches web
detail: Files and screenshots are uploaded to the cloud under web retention rules; deletions purge within 30 days; consumer content may train models unless opted out.

feature: Free tier contents and limits
detail: Free users get (model name) Luna, Think on mobile (rolling out on web), web search, data analysis, uploads, image creation, GPTs, and Library with 500 MB; unlimited everyday text chat subject to safeguards, with separate limits for uploads, images, voice and analysis. Ads may appear in some countries.

feature: Context window full notice
detail: When a chat is full, users can start a new chat (optionally with a summary) or upgrade to continue; earlier messages stay readable; limit is per conversation and unrelated to Memory.

feature: Usage limits reset on upgrade
detail: Free-tier rate limits reset when upgrading to Plus, Pro or Business.

feature: Business memory controls and deactivation behavior
detail: Users can disable Memory; owners can turn memory and personalization off for the workspace, which deletes existing member memories; memories are per account, not shared, and not used for training. Deleted workspaces lose memories permanently.

feature: Nonprofit discounts
detail: Eligible nonprofits (validated via Goodstack) get Business Standard seats at $8 annual or $10 monthly per user; Premium seats are excluded; Enterprise up to 75% off via sales; no BAA for Business.

feature: ChatGPT Edu contents
detail: Edu offers the latest flagship model, data analysis, browsing, file uploads, GPT building and sharing in university workspaces, much higher limits than Free, 50+ languages, group permissions, SSO, SCIM and GPT management; no training on business data.

feature: GPT actions: auth and OpenAPI schema
detail: Actions call external APIs using OpenAPI JSON or YAML (paste, import from URL, or example templates) with auth none, API key (basic, bearer, custom header) or OAuth; not available with Pro mode; do not transfer to plugins on migration.

feature: GPT action privacy policy and approvals
detail: Each action can carry a Privacy Policy URL, required for public GPTs; users may be asked to approve actions and can manage OAuth-connected accounts; Enterprise domain allowlists can block all actions.

feature: SSO setup guide and sign-in policies
detail: Interactive Admin Console setup (Okta, Entra, Custom SAML or OIDC) with domain verification via DNS TXT (up to 99 domains); per-product policy Required, Optional or Off for ChatGPT, API, Ads and Admin Console; SAML must be unencrypted with email attribute.

feature: Per-member SSO exemption for external members
detail: Owners can set an external-domain member to Allow login without SSO or Follow workspace SSO policy; exemption survives deactivation but is cleared by removal.

feature: (model name) Astra and Sol models (API)
detail: Astra is the frontier reasoning and coding model; Sol is a faster, cheaper multistep model. Both take text and images and return text, in the developer API.

feature: (model name) Terra in Work and Codex
detail: Terra handles visual reasoning, computer use and writing. In ChatGPT it is offered in Work and Codex only, not Chat, and is unavailable under UAE inference residency.

feature: (model name) Rosalind Research for life sciences
detail: Multistep life-science research model with biology safeguards, for approved Research customers in Work, Codex and API; not in Chat. Enterprise gets a two-week admin preview, off by default.

feature: (model name) Chat tone update: concise, less flattering
detail: (model name) in Chat was tuned to be more concise and less sycophantic for Free, Go and logged-out users. On Plus and Pro it only changes the fallback model used after (model name) limits are hit.
plans: Free, Go, Plus, Pro, logged out

feature: (model name) Sol flagship reasoning model
detail: Flagship reasoning model for coding, research, science, security, computer use and design. Paid plans only (not Free, Go or logged-out); managed workspaces depend on admin settings.

feature: (model name) retired from ChatGPT, Work and Codex
detail: (model name) was removed from ChatGPT, Work and Codex on Oct 14, 2026; API access is unaffected.

feature: (model name) Instant style update
detail: Instant responses are easier to read, more natural and less bullet-heavy.

feature: Canvas removed from (model name) Instant and Thinking
detail: Writing and coding now appear as writing blocks and code blocks inside chat. Paid users can still use canvas via legacy models until those are sunset.

feature: o3 and (model name) retirement
detail: (model name) retires from ChatGPT June 27, 2026 and o3 on Aug 26, 2026; both were selectable by paid users in model settings. API unchanged.

feature: (model name) mini as Thinking fallback
detail: Free and Go reach it through Thinking in the + menu; paid users get it as a fallback for (model name) Thinking at rate limits. It is not in the model picker; Enterprise can default Auto routing to it.

feature: (model name) Thinking upfront plan
detail: Thinking shows a plan first so the user can redirect mid-response; it also improves deep web research and long-context handling.

feature: (model name) Instant updates
detail: Updates improved web-search answers, follow-up tone and cut teaser phrasing and needless caveats.

feature: (model name) models retired
detail: (model name) Instant, Thinking and Pro were removed Mar 11, 2026; old chats continue on (model name) Instant, 5.4 Thinking or 5.4 Pro.

feature: (model name), (model name), 4.1 mini, o4-mini and (model name) retired
detail: These models were removed from ChatGPT on Feb 13, 2026; API not changed then.

feature: Thinking time level toggle
detail: Users can pick a thinking level (Light, Standard, Extended) per question; defaults are tuned periodically and are not comparable across models.

feature: (model name)
detail: Agentic coding model combining Codex and (model name) training, about 25% faster and steerable while working.

feature: Personalization: base style, tone, warmth and emoji
detail: Settings > Personalization lets users choose a base style and tone and tune warmth and emoji use.

feature: Model Spec and under-18 principles
detail: Public Model Spec describes intended behavior; includes teen (13-17) principles that limit harmful roleplay and push toward trusted adults.

feature: Sensitive-conversation routing to reasoning models
detail: Conversations showing acute distress are routed to reasoning or Instant models tuned for de-escalation; ChatGPT states the active model when asked.

feature: (model name)
detail: Long-running project-scale coding model using compaction across context windows, in Codex CLI, IDE, cloud and code review.

feature: (model name) and 90% usage prompt
detail: Smaller Codex model giving up to 4x more usage; CLI and IDE offer the switch when 90% of the 5-hour limit is used.

feature: (model name) for cloud tasks and review
detail: Default for Codex cloud tasks and code review; selectable in CLI and IDE; accepts screenshots; not supported in ChatGPT chat.

feature: (model name) auto-switching default
detail: Single auto-switching system for all logged-in users; Plus, Pro and Team get a model picker for (model name) or Thinking; Pro and Team also get Thinking Pro.

feature: gpt-oss open-weight models
detail: (model name) and (model name) text-only open models for self-hosting; not a ChatGPT app feature.

feature: o3-pro for Pro and Team
detail: Longer-thinking o3 variant with tools; limits at launch: no temporary chats, image generation or canvas.

feature: Advanced Voice naturalness and live translation
detail: Paid Advanced Voice got more natural intonation and can translate continuously between languages until told to stop; known minor audio-quality artifacts.

feature: Advanced Voice (audio in/out) daily limit
detail: At launch Plus and Team voice usage was limited per day; picks up emotion and speaking speed.

feature: (model name) and 4.1 mini in model picker
detail: (model name) under more models for paid users; 4.1 mini replaced 4o mini and served as Free fallback.

feature: o-series reasoning models (o1, o3, o4-mini, o3-mini)
detail: Reasoning models added to the picker over time; o3-mini added search; o1-preview launched with 30 weekly messages and o1-mini 50.

feature: (model name) research preview
detail: Large chat model launched to Pro first, later planned for all paid plans.

feature: Scheduled tasks (beta)
detail: Ask ChatGPT to do something later, as one-time reminders or recurring actions.

feature: Canvas introduced with (model name)
detail: Side editor where the model opens a canvas, makes targeted edits or rewrites; launched in early beta.

feature: (model name) improvements: memory, files, image tool
detail: Updates improved file use, memory saving, image-tool triggering and STEM; one update was reverted for sycophancy.

feature: ChatGPT Classic (previous macOS app)
detail: The previous Mac app is renamed ChatGPT Classic and still usable; no forced migration; a new desktop app replaces it.

feature: Work with Apps (coding apps)
detail: ChatGPT reads content from coding apps for tailored answers; launched as beta for Plus and Teams; later added Notes, Notion, Quip, Warp, VS Code forks, JetBrains IDEs, Nova, Prompt, TextMate, BBEdit.

feature: Code edits directly in IDE
detail: ChatGPT on macOS can edit code directly in a connected IDE.

feature: Canvas on macOS
detail: Create and edit canvases in the Mac app.

feature: Tasks support in macOS app
detail: Mac app supports scheduled tasks.

feature: Projects in macOS app
detail: Work inside Projects on Mac; at that time they had to be created on web first.

feature: Talk with apps in Advanced Voice
detail: Use Advanced Voice while working with apps such as terminals, documents and speaker notes.

feature: Advanced Voice Mode on macOS
detail: Hands-free, interruptible, emotion-aware real-time voice chat on the Mac.

feature: Conversation search
detail: Search past conversations by keyword from the search bar.

feature: Slash commands
detail: Slash commands to search, start reasoning or generate images from the Mac composer.

feature: Chat bar model picker and Temporary Chat toggle
detail: Switch models and enable Temporary Chat from the chat bar.

feature: Sticky copy button for code blocks
detail: Code blocks keep a copy button visible while scrolling.

feature: Sidebar toggle shortcut and toolbar layout
detail: Keyboard shortcut toggles the sidebar; the window toolbar layout is customizable.

feature: Text fade-in animation
detail: Responses fade in smoothly.

feature: Open chat links in browser preference
detail: Preference to open chat links in the default browser.

feature: Notification when reply finishes in background
detail: Mac app notifies when the assistant finishes replying while backgrounded, useful for reasoning models.

feature: Apple Handoff between iOS and macOS
detail: Continue a ChatGPT conversation between iPhone and Mac through Handoff.

feature: Find text in conversation
detail: Command+F or app menu finds text within a conversation.

feature: Draft message restoration
detail: Unsent drafts are restored.

feature: Conversation accessibility improvements
detail: Accessibility support in conversations was improved.

feature: Companion window (Option+Space)
detail: A floating window stays in front of other apps; Option+Space starts a chat, refocuses or reopens the last one; position, reset time and shortcut are configurable; chats can be popped out.

feature: Data analysis expandable tables and charts
detail: Expandable table and chart view, customizing and downloading charts, and selecting table cells.

feature: Stop streaming shortcut Command+.
detail: Keyboard shortcut stops a streaming response.

feature: Share screen shortcuts and display choice
detail: Command+Shift+1 shares the main display, Command+Shift+2 the active window; user can choose which display to screenshot.

feature: Disable macOS autocorrect and menu bar/dock visibility
detail: Options to turn off autocorrect and show the app in menu bar, dock or both.

feature: Horizontal scrolling for tables, code and formulas
detail: Wide tables, code blocks and math scroll horizontally.

feature: @mention GPTs
detail: Mention a custom GPT in the composer.

feature: Launch at Login option
detail: Optional start at login, off by default.

feature: Certificate pinning exceptions phased out
detail: Feb 2026 change removed certificate pinning exceptions; contact support for help.

feature: ChatGPT in Apple Intelligence without an account
detail: Via iOS 18, iPadOS 18 and macOS Sequoia, ask questions, write or analyze images and documents with no account; OpenAI gets no IP, stores nothing, does not train.

feature: Link ChatGPT account to Apple integrations
detail: Connecting an account unlocks stronger models and saves chats to history; account name, email, photo, workspace names and plan are shared with the device.

feature: Data controls apply to Apple integration
detail: Improve-the-model toggle, Temporary Chat, export and account deletion govern linked usage; business accounts keep enterprise privacy commitments.

feature: Continue Apple-started chat in app or web
detail: A chat begun through Apple integrations can be continued in ChatGPT apps or web under the normal privacy policy.

feature: Pro 100, Pro 200 and Pro 500 tiers
detail: Three monthly Pro plans at $100, $200 and $500; Pro includes Pro models, Codex, deep research, image creation, memory and uploads; Pro 200 reopened to new subscribers.

feature: Ultrafast mode (Pro 500 only)
detail: Selectable in model picker for (model name) and (model name); uses plan allowance at 8x then credits at 6x; credit purchases on other tiers do not unlock it.

feature: Doubled Work and Codex allowance
detail: Pro 100 and 500 doubled Work and Codex allowance; Pro 200 lower allowance matched; Plus unchanged; applies without renewal; earlier announced reduction canceled.

feature: Weekly (model name) Pro message limits
detail: Chat has weekly (model name) Pro message limits separate from Work and Codex allowance; Pro 200 now matches the higher limit.

feature: Model unavailable until allowance resets
detail: At a model limit it is unavailable until reset time (shown when known); limits cannot be raised or bypassed in settings; support cannot reset them.

feature: Buy credits for extra usage
detail: Credits continue eligible use after allowance in Codex, Work and ChatGPT for Word, Excel and PowerPoint; view and buy in Settings > Usage or Codex Usage & Billing; not for every model.

feature: Fast mode allowance rate
detail: Fast mode draws allowance at 2.5x Standard and Ultrafast at 8x; these are consumption rates not speed guarantees.

feature: Usage varies by model, context, tools, caching
detail: Allowance use depends on model, context size, reasoning, tool use, retrieval, caching and speed mode.

feature: Unlimited access subject to abuse guardrails
detail: Any unlimited Pro access is subject to abuse guardrails; sharing credentials, reselling or scraping can restrict the account.

feature: Manage or change Pro plan in Settings > My Plan
detail: Settings > My Plan shows plan and changes; moving 200 to 100 mid-week compares used units with the new weekly allowance.

feature: Cancel on purchase platform
detail: Cancel via ChatGPT, Apple or Google Play; keeps access to period end; undoable; uninstalling does not cancel.

feature: Failed renewal handling
detail: A failed payment does not instantly end the subscription; follow billing email or store settings.

feature: Refunds by purchase channel
detail: Web and Google Play refunds go through OpenAI Support; Apple purchases via Apple; refund ends covered access.

feature: Keep Pro with a Business workspace
detail: Pro continues if the personal workspace stays separate; merging into Business changes billing.

feature: Monthly billing only
detail: Pro has no annual or multi-month prepayment.

feature: US sales tax exemption requests
detail: Eligible organizations can submit exemption documents.

feature: Blocked prompt messages
detail: Prompts violating usage policies or appearing to exploit or bypass safeguards can be blocked; users can appeal through help chat.

feature: Login verification by emailed OTP
detail: New device, unusual location, sensitive changes or security checks trigger a six-digit emailed code; expires quickly; repeated failures lock temporarily.

feature: Push approval of login in mobile app
detail: Signed-in ChatGPT mobile app gets a push to approve or deny a login; fallback is Try with email.

feature: Multi-factor authentication and password reset guidance
detail: Recommends resetting password and enabling MFA after an unrecognized login.

feature: Data residency for Enterprise and Edu
detail: Customer content stored at rest in Australia, Canada, Europe, India, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, UAE, UK or US; free on Enterprise and Edu; new workspaces.

feature: Inference residency (in-region GPU execution)
detail: Requires data residency; available in Europe, US and UAE; applies to new conversations only; CPU processing and auth may stay outside; AWS Marketplace buyers US only.

feature: UAE inference residency limits
detail: (model name) family only, no internal search, no improved memory, no GPT-Live (Advanced Voice remains), external search stays unless disabled.

feature: Check residency in Workspace Settings
detail: Owners and admins see Data Residency Region and Inference Residency Region under Workspace Details; read-only.

feature: Features covered by residency
detail: Memory, Code Interpreter artifacts, Codex, conversations, custom GPTs, dots, files, image generation, Pages/Spaces, plugins, projects, Sites; backups stay in region.

feature: Data that may leave the region
detail: External integrations, transient processing, workspace metadata, billing and logins may be stored elsewhere; beta features, third-party GPTs and Apple Intelligence are not eligible.

feature: Dots residency
detail: New personal dots support data residency everywhere and inference residency in Europe and US, not UAE; older dots migrate within 30 days of GA.

feature: ChatGPT Sites residency
detail: New Sites in US or EU residency workspaces use that region; other regions do not apply; existing Sites not migrated.

feature: GPT sharing restriction under residency
detail: Residency workspaces cannot set GPT sharing to Anyone; only users in the same region can open a shared GPT.

feature: Age verification by ID
detail: Submitted ID is usually validated within hours with an email outcome and account reactivation; Stripe confirmation screen shows receipt; ID data deleted right after.

feature: ChatGPT Windows app
detail: Early Windows 10 (build 17763+, x64 and arm64) app from Microsoft Store for paid plans; some Mac and web features missing.

feature: Windows companion window (Alt+Space)
detail: Quick window to ask, upload files, generate images or start chats; remembers position; hotkey changeable in Settings > App.

feature: Organization deployment of Windows app
detail: Follows Store policies; IT can deploy via Intune MDM/MAM or winget with the Store ID.

feature: Reset the Windows app
detail: Settings > Apps > Installed apps > ChatGPT > Advanced options > Reset.

feature: Enterprise and Edu no training by default
detail: Business content is not used for training unless users opt in, for example via feedback.
